I have used other gel type creams from Belif and Aveeno and they worked well. This left my face feeling and looking dry and shortly after applying this I put on another moisturizer.  It has a powdery fragrance which I am not a fan of for face products. I would not purchase especially for what it costs.

I had some samples of La Mer at one point and when I used them my skin was supple and absolutely glowing. So I ordered this during the VIB sale. I didn’t open it immediately because I wanted to finish the moisturizer I was using at the time--I don’t like to waste products. When I finally used this product I was looking forward to waking up every day looking radiant, but instead, I was waking up with breakouts. I’m 100% sure this moisturizer cause my breakouts since it was the only change I made to my skincare routine. I was extremely disappointed! I was wondering if the formula had changed, because I sampled all 3 La Mer moisturizing formulas and didn’t have any breakouts. I just chose to order the gel cream since my skin is on the oily side. I contacted Sephora customer support to see if I could return the product since it caused me to break out and was told that I could not return the product because too much time had passed since my purchase. So now I have a $300 container of moisturizer that I can’t use or return. Extremely disappointed all around.

I really liked this after the first use as it made my skin so soft and silky feeling, even after I woke up the next morning. I read a lot of reviews claiming it made them break out and I was like huh..interesting. Lo and behold, after 3 uses, I have a handful of massive zits in places I don’t normally get them. My skin has really been behaving too, and this is the only new product I’ve used within the last couple weeks.
My holy grail moisturizer! I absolutely love this stuff, the original is a little thick feeling for me but this one makes me feel refreshed, hydrated, and calms my sensitive skin right away!

I originally sampled this (thanks Sephora!) and never would have bought it otherwise because it’s so expensive to just try on a whim. Well, I guess that depends on your income bracket... this was definitely a splurge for me. The sample convinced me, and to treat myself to help cope with the pandemic, I bought the 1oz. I think I generally have pretty good skin which fortunately doesn’t require a whole lot of maintenance, and I do well with most nightcreams (my most recent go-to being the Andalou Cannacell Dreamy Night Cream, which costs significantly less than this and I had been happy with the results). I didn’t really think there was much room for improvement, but the results of the La Mer have been insane and I wake up with my skin feeling extra soft and smooth after adding this to my nighttime skincare routine. This is way too expensive to be a year-round thing for me, but I think it will be a nice once-a-year treat for my face.
review_title: Insane splurge but I have no regrets!

review_text: I wish this cream wasn’t so expensive because my skin loves it. I purchased it a few months ago when a large department store had a 25% sale on beauty products.A little goes a long way and the gel texture glides on so effortlessly. My skin is combination/sensitive and acne prone, but this has not caused me to breakout. The smell is light and fresh. I highly recommend.

I have finished two jars already. The cooling sensation comforts the skin very well. I don’t have serious skin concerns, so there’s not so much improvement I can tell. But I’m addicted to its smell, which is nostalgic to me.

-caused breakout -my skin is combination and this cream was very oily on my skin-causing stickiness on touch-overpricedIf you really wish to have la mer and you have oily or combination skin I would suggest their gel cram moisturizer who didn’t give me breakout.

La Mer is a classic, iconic brand and you really feel like you’re spoiling yourself and the smell is wonderful. But it doesn’t justify the exorbitant price for me! I feel like it’s overpriced to the point it is to make it exclusive and bougie and I’m kind of uncomfortable with that messaging. Skincare should not be like that, it’s already expensive and confusing as it is, and I bought La Mer products before I started reading ingredient lists and understood how they/my skin work. Anyway, the ingredients are fairly basic, so a lot of other moisturizers contain them, and you can easily dupe this cream. You’re honestly just paying for the experience to use this exclusive magic cream.

the smell is absolutely pleasant and the texture is nicer compared to cream IMO, easier to apply. It does a pretty good job moisturizing my skin however it’s not so much better compared to other $60-$90 creams.

I like this gel lotion so much more than the cream. I had to use the cream only at night because it was so thick and greasy! It was a good night cream, but I can’t imagine people are wearing it during the day. It’s far too greasy to put makeup over it, and I usually don’t wear makeup to work, so my face just looked oily. This gel lotion is not oily at all, but it’s definitely thick enough to be super hydrating and last all day! Plus, makeup goes on nicely over it.

La Mer has quite the following and reputation!  I feel it is all well deserved.  Usually I use the original La Mer cream but do find that a bit heavy for the heat of summer so I thought I would try this as an alternative.  Glad i tried it.  It is moisturizing, non irritating and light for the heat and humidity.  Perfect for summer.

I absolutely love this moisturizer. Best I’ve ever used, and I’ve tried every brand imaginable. It’s light, makes your skin soft, and has never made my acne prone skin breakout. I use this with the Treatment Lotion and actually get compliments on my skin now. Highly recommend!

Got a trial size of this and was so excited because I love luxury beauty. Let me start by saying I NEVER, EVER breakout. So I read the breakout reviews and thought “bummer for people with acne prone skin”. I have never seen so much acne on my skin as I did after using this for a couple days. So disappointing but at least now I won’t ever be tempted to waste a huge wad of cash on it!
I have oily skin and this is the best moisturizer for me. It really helps keep my oil down.

This has caused the worst breakout in my entire life. I have over a dozen blemishes on my skin after using this for 10 days, and my doctor said the reaction could last for another 2 weeks. Definitely do not recommend.
Love this product. It is a bit pricey. But makes my skin feel amazing

I received a sample of this and was excited because I love the foundation. I’m 42 combo in the T-zone and dry everywhere else , acne prone, sensitive skin and a avid,prescribed by my derm, tretin user for a few years now. Before first use  my face was blemish free. 3 days in of using this product I currently have 7  good sized acne bumps and a few small whiteheads in various places... it’s the high content of algae in this product that disrupts my skin. This  ingredient is high on the list of pore clogging ingredients ( it’s in the foundation as well but not second on the list, it’s relatively lower which would explain why I can use it with no break out issues) If your a person that has issues with pore clogging , white heads , acne caused by algae RUN FAR AWAY!! If not then it is actually a beautiful product!!!
This stuff is trash. I got a sample out of curiosity, and it was so harsh and irritating. So many better options nowadays.

I almost didn’t want to try or fall in love with La Mer because of the price point. However, this has made a huge impact on my skin. I’ve been using it morning and night for about a week now. My skin is so hydrated and smooth with a visible difference in glow

I have a ‘’combination’’ skin and this gel cream is really great for improving the overall health & look of my skin. However it does annoy me that it works so well because it’s really expensive, I understand it’s La Mer but i’m sure there are gel creams out there who can do the work for a third of the price. Also, there’s a smell to it, which does not annoy me but can annoy others.
When La Mer was bought out, this moisturizer was reformaluated and now does absolutely nothing. Not worth buying at all. Neutorgena hydro line is much better.

I shared this with La Mer as well; they deserve full credit.  I have a scar near the right corner of my upper lip, the result of an assault when I was 17.  I took a blow across the mouth that opened a gash right through the full thickness of my lip, and I’ve lived with it for over 40 years.About two months ago, I picked up a jar of Gel de La Mer from Sephora (tyvm VIB Rouge!), and have been using it as directed every day.  Not only is my face smooth and hydrated, the scar is now softer, smoother, much lighter, and much less noticeable.  I’m happy to show before/after pics to give you an idea of the difference this product has made:  the pic of me in the gray sweater is from 12/11/2017, the one in the black fleece was taken 1/13/2020.
review_title: Magic gel that’s removed a facial scar

review_text: I got this as a gift and was extremely disappointed with the results that after 6 months of using it (once in the morning and once before bed - sometimes i skipped one, but at the very least once a day) I do not see any major results or changes to my skin. The biggest positive however, is that it did not react negatively to my skin. It did provide the moisture needed without being greasy or sticky and it sunk into my skin quite well. Didn’t break me out, but really didn’t do much either. A little goes a long way and I’m just now finishing the jar. Im just glad I didn’t pay full price for this and cant imagine how I’d feel if I had and received these results... Another thing to mention if its worth mentioning is that i mixed this in the morning with my SPF and it mixed and sat on my skin very well!

I have sensitive skin and rosacea and I use this cream nightly to just sooth my skin and it’s great for that. I had a reaction to a face mask one night and my rosacea flared up and started burning, I applied this several times and the reaction went down almost immediately. I’m also acne prone and the gel version has never caused me to breakout. I don’t like the prices of the La Mer products or how strong their fragrance is, but it has been a lifesaver for me many times. I’d recommend trying it or getting samples first if you can just because of the price and everyone’s skin is unique.

I‘m a man with seb dermatitis and moderate acne; I’ve been looking for a luxury cream without the oil content that would flare up those conditions. This is certainly luxurious. It smells and feels amazing, and doesn’t seem to aggravate my seb derm or break me out. Skin certainly feels very smooth and hydrated throughout the day. A lot of skincare junkies will drag jar packaging, but from all the research I’ve done, the preservatives in the formula will more than protect against bacterial growth, and I bought extra spatulas online to avoid dunking my fingers.It’s obviously very expensive, so I bought the large during the VIB sale to maximize value. I really like it, but once I get through this jar I may continue searching for something closer to the $100 range.
Very soothing and hydrating. Beautiful texture that really is cooling and hydrates instantly. I love using this in the summer or when my skin is feeling red, flushed, or oily.
Amazing product! Best cream to use if you have acne prone skin. Not heavy but still moisturizes!
I really like this texture and it’s very hydrating. There is probably an equally good product out there though but if you have the money get this!

Out of all the face creams I have used throughout my life, this is by far my favorite and one that I can wear in the summer and the winter. My face looks flawless when I use this stuff! I’ll be going back to this routine.

If you have oily/acne prone skin，you might wanna give it a try. I use it at night as a night time moisturizer, it really helps keep my skin hydrated while not being too oily. It does not break me out either. This is by far my favorite gel cream. Will repurchase!

This is not for folks with normal skin that want a “cooling effect“ in the summer! You will not get the results you expect.This moisturizer is meant for acne prone or oily skin that can’t take heavy product in warmer climate. With that being said, I’m one of the few that hated the original formula! It literally did nothing for me so I just used the original in the winter and skipped La Mer in warmer weather bc my skin couldn’t take it. However, this new formula works wonders and, I can truly say, it feels like the lighter equivalent of the original! After just one use my skin is completely smooth, the few bumps I had disappeared, and my skin was so soft, I couldn’t stop touching it, with the back of my hand of course! There is a technique to using all La Mer moisturizers and the little spoon it comes with will help ensure you don’t use too much at once. I also only use as a night cream bc #1) you should be using a moisturizer with SPF in the day time and #2) you will get clogged skin if you use this under the sun!!
review_title: For true oily skin/ acne prone skin/combo skin!

review_text: super cooling on the skin. improved my skins texture and was not greasy or sticky. i also loved the smell. i can tell it has quality ingredients by how calming it is on my skin.

I had been using the old gel and was worried buying the new one (last year) due to the reviews.  This does not give any cooling effect which is good and hydrates me just the same - i am happy but there was no need to change it

I’ve been using a free sample I got (figured it was the only time I’d be able to “afford“ the brand) and it’s fine. It’s smooth and feels nice. Absorbs quickly without any strong fragrance. My hypersensitive skin hasn’t reacted to it. Overall, it is a perfectly fine moisturizer that keeps my skin feeling nice. Do I think it is worth the price, though? Absolutely not. It’s not especially luxurious feeling, it hasn’t changed the way my skin looks, and it’s not anything world rocking. If you presented it to me without the name, I’d expect to pay $20 for a jar. You’re just paying for the branding, really, and, to me, that’s just not enough. It’s fine and I’m enjoying using it but I would never drop the cash for the full sized. You can get better products for less money.

I had avoided getting this because of the negative reviews until I went to a La Mer counter and tried it for myself. I am so glad that I did! I love it as much as my Tatcha Water Cream and Belif Aqua Bomb. These are the moisturizers I keep buying for daily use. I have oily skin, I swear you could fry an egg using all the oil I could produce! Lol. But seriously, remember people everyone is different! Just because it doesn’t work for somebody, doesnt mean it will be an epic failure for you too!

There are a few products that I cannot be without, and this moisturizer is one of them.  I received a deluxe sample of this and my oily/sensitive skin has never looked better.  I have been using this product for almost a year, and love how it gives my skin that fresh dewy appearance that I’m after, without causing breakouts.  The price tag is steep, but a jlo glow makes it worth it for me.  ;)

I was so excited to get his as a sample with my purchase.. DO NOT USE IT!! Within 10 minutes had dermatitis and it created breakouts.. I typically only get breakouts when I eat a lot of sugar and or on occasion. I don’t have very sensitive skin. This product really didn’t even give my skin enough moisture.

I dont understand the low ratings for this moisturizer. It is absolutely amazing. It has made my skin extremely soft and hydrated without feeling oily or sticky. I have combination acne prone skin and so far this has not made me break out. Also, sephora should be giving out samples for La mer, instead of customers buying and returning. This is one La mer item I will be buying consistently. Try it out!
this is designed for people with combo/oily skin which I have. honestly my skin would get oily after applying this so I didn’t work for me :(

I received this as a deluxe sample and was excited because I have always  wanted to try La Mer products. I LOVE this moisturizer! It leaves my skin feeling so smooth and soft, and I have found I don’t even need to use a face primer before applying my foundation when I use this. I have acne-prone skin, and this has not caused me to break out. I use it very sparingly, because a little is all you need, and also because I’m trying to make it last as long as possible because this product does not fit into my budget!

This gel cream feels like a heaven on your skin when applying. However, it made my oily areas oilier, and failed to provide enough hydration to the skin on my cheeks. Also caused a break out. I was rather disappointed in this La Mer product.

I had received a sample of this a while ago, used it and then tucked it away, forgotten. I was so excited when I saw it and couldn’t remember why I stopped using it. I used it one night, woke up the next day with a few small bumps (odd for my skin, but I didn’t attribute it to this). The next night I used it again and woke up with a forehead scattered with tiny whiteheads. I NEVER breakout like that, ever. Also, my skin rarely reacts to new things, so for this La Mer gel cream to make me breakout out so badly, I can’t help but to recommend you just stay away from this one.

A very light feeling moisturizer. If you have oily skin I think you will love this. Leaves no residue or slippery feeling on the skin and has brightened my skin! But i do think there are better moisturizers out there for me because i have dry skin.
Why reformulate when the original was so good? STILL searching for a replacement, this product is no bueno.

I will never understand why La Mer discontinued their beautiful Gel Cream and replaced it with this flaming hot mess. The Gel Cream was healing and non-irritating-- it cleared up the acne I’d suffered from since my twenties. This is... not it. It’s formulated with camphor or mint oil or something else that’s artificially cooling (not necessary) and leaves a sticky film on your skin that never fully absorbs. This film might be what contributes to the breakouts people complain of-- I certainly got a bad case of dermatitis on my forehead when I tried the sample of this. I’m switching away from the La Mer brand in general right now, because while they were the best thing in skincare 15 years ago, so many wonderful new brands are out on the market that are just as gentle and healing and don’t test on animals. Good riddance, La Mer and parent company Estée Lauder.

I really enjoyed this product. It’s much better than the previous gel cream. I always add the la mer oil to any lotion I put on my face to make it extra hydrating. I loved the way this feels on my skin, so silky and cool feeling. The only thing I don’t like about this and the other soft lotions is that I go through them so quick. I have really dry skin and a little dollup doesn’t do the job. I find that when I use the original creme and add oil, it’s so thick that I can make it last longer. Besides that, great cream, I just go through it faster than the original. And since they are the same price, I think i’ll stick with the original creme.

I’m on my 30’s so I think it’s worth investing more $ on skincare products, this moisturizer is perfect for nighttime, when you need extra hydration on top of your anti aging serum:) I wouldn’t use it for day time because I have oily skin, another factor is I live on Midwest, so here we have many months of cold and I feel my skin needs a powerful moisturizer specially for these months. I personally love La Mer products, they all go well together, the moisturizers really go well with the La Mer foundation on top, it gives a beautiful glow skin :)

I got a free sample with my purchase. I expect the same result as La mer original cream, sadly I can’t like it. I got a really terrible break out. I love original one and I will stick with it. No more adventure.
review_title: Break out, return back to original one

review_text: La Mer is one of my favorite brands of moisturizer, and I tend to alternate between the heavier cream and the soft lotion based on the time of year.  I thought that this cool gel cream would be the one to use during the summer, especially with the heat and humidity where I live.  Unfortunately, this product leaves my skin feeling sticky and tacky, and it feels as though the product hasn’t actually been absorbed.
review_title: Not On Par with Other La Mer Moisturizers

review_text: VERY tempted to get a full sized product after trying this product from a free sample! Have only used this cream at night for about 2 weeks, but a little goes a long way and I think I’ve only used about a third of my super mini sample. I have an extremely oily t-zone, and this product has helped visibly control oiliness during the day even though i only use it at night. It has also visibly evened out my skin tone! Dropped one star for the price tag, but if they come out with a value set during the holidays then I would definitely buy the full size!

I love this version of La Mer for my summertime moisturizer! It’s lightweight & absorbs quickly not to mention the wonderful fresh scent. I can’t understand why some reviews are saying it’s greasy. Either they’re using too much or applying it incorrectly. La Mer products are to be used sparingly with a certain “patting” motion to apply. I suggest googling it if you’re new to La Mer in order to reap the benefits.

Received this as a deluxe sample and was very excited to try it- I really WANTED to love the La Mer legend. It felt kind of greasy going on- kind of slick. I only used it for 3 days and had MASSIVE breakouts. Extremely disappointed and would not recommend.
review_title: doesn’t live up to the hype

review_text: Feel great on the skin - but caused terrible break out. I tried multiple times with same results - zits. Sad it didn’t work out for me.

This is definitely the best moisturizer I have tried. My skin likes to break out, and using acne products often makes it worse. Since my skin is also oily, I appreciate how light this gel cream is. It soaks right in and leaves my skin soft and soothed. It was worth every penny, and I plan to keep using it in the future.

Disappointed.... after being recommended this by a friend I was not aware of the formulation change.... after I had gotten it, i went home washed my face and put it on.... it was sticky and just sat on top of my skin... so i called her and told her my experience, she then came over and tried the one i had purchased and was shocked and said it was nothing like the one she has at home, so i thought maybe i just bought a defective one....but nope.... sad... if it was the old formulation I would definitely be buying it.
review_title: Dont change a thing that’s already good.

review_text: 4 stars because of the price, this is way too much even for La Mer. I was lucky to get a deluxe sample of this and I’m trying to make it last as long as I can, my skin is simply loving it. My skin used to be combination when I lived in Rio de Janeiro, but a few years ago I moved to Los Angeles and the dry weather here turned my skin into dry. The moisturizing power of this cream works perfectly, I’ve been putting it on before sleep and my skin just drinks it up even though it’s pretty thick. Some days I had to rush out in the morning and forgot to do my mourning skincare routine but the moisture from this cream lasted throughout the day. I have bangs which sometimes can cause my forehead to get oily, but it wasn’t the case with this cream. I’m very happy with it, but unfortunately for something that I would use every day, the price is just too high for me.

I got this in the trial mini size because I’ve never used a La Mer product, and thought I’d check out the hype. I use SKII Essence and serum, Claudalie toner and mist, and have been trying out Tatcha indigo cream for two months now (and feeling meh about it).I’m 45, with normal to slightly dry skin, roseacea and sun damage. Goes on smooth and a little goes a long way. It does not break me out, and absorbs fast. I noticed a plumper/smoother texture on Day 2, which makes it hard to figure out long term of this will actually improve my skin, but does mean my skin looks amazing.The biggest difference i notice is, usually even wth SFP50 sunscreen on, my face flushes in hot sun, and in the evening is still red when i cleanse - but not using this. I took me three days to figure out, the only difference in my routine was the gelv cream. My roseacea has been kept in check! That, combined with the excellent texture improvement and fast absorption make this 5 stars for me, even at the astronomical price.Silicone for me isn’t inherently “gross“ in cosmetics - it’s also the basis of undereye and decollete patches that prevent wrinkles, and it’s likely why i see results overnight with this gel, because it’s retaining moisture in my skin readout well, and helping calm my roseacea. I can’t use silicone primers, because they DO break me out, and is not consider this equivalent in texture or weight at all to them. I don’t find it to sit on the surface, or be sticky on me. As someone who didn’t try the old version and not dealing with acne (which seems to be a lot of those frustrated with the reformulation), i really love this product, and find it gives me at least short term results better than most products. I plan to buy a jar to see how it performs over 6-12 months.
review_title: Calms my roseacea, great moisture retention

review_text: Broke me OUT! I do NOT have sensitive skin and this literally gave me sooooo many acne spots the very next morning after using it the night before. It’s been over three almost four weeks now and the scars are still slowly fading away. It took the first two weeks to buy and figure out how to treat them because I’ve NEVER had to deal such bad deep breakouts. Horrible, horrible, horrible! I think the fact that it had fragrance in it really broke me out badly! Either way this product was an obvious hard PASS!

I have tried a few different La Mer moisturizers and the newly reformulated Gel Cream is by far my favorite for my combo/ acne prone skin. I have been using it since the weather started warming up and it as been ideal. The gel consistency is great and it always leaves my sin feeling refreshed an moisturized without feeling heavy. The only time I have ever felt any type of “tingle“ or cool sensation when applying this moisturizer is when it is following a strong serum.
Got a free trial size with another order - the texture is very gross, sticky and silicone-feeling.  Usually I’d use it on my body at least, but this was so gross I threw it out!!
this clogged my pores very badly after a week of usage, wanted to love it....but will try something else...and cheaper

I received a deluxe sample of this from Sephora, and I am in love! I’m a 65 year old with oily skin, and the LaMer cream was always too heavy for me. I use First Aid Beauty Intensive Peel, and this is the only moisturizer that soothes after that treatment without irritating. I have tried every moisturizer under the sun, and this is truly my Holy Grail since it moisturizes without making my skin too oily. Will be repurchasing again and again.

Received a free sample size with my purchase and I think i am going to have to give it to spend on a full size bottle. I am super oily around my T zone and I felt like this cream went on so smooth and made it feel nice and soft. A little going a long way. I definitely like.

If you have never been to Neiman Marcus and have one of the La Mer beauty consultant showing you the CORRECT way to apply their products, you’ve been missing out! Most people have a negative opinion on La Mer products because they either over use it, or applied way more than recommended amount. I have just received this product as a sample, and I am so so in love with it! Leaves me skin super smooth yet not sticky. It dries up pretty quick. That’s because you’re supposed to use a “pea” size amount when applying this luxurious product.  I love it! Definitely would spend on the bigger size of this.

Sephora sent me a sample of this product. I really wanted to hate this because of it’s ludicrous price tag. When I put it on I was floored by the way it makes your face look. Im considering selling a kidney so I can afford it on a regular basis.

I got a deluxe sample of this.... i had read many reviews about how this was not as good as the original. I never tried the original so I can’t say about that, but I really liked this. It spread easily and did not feel sticky at all. I’m not crazy about silicones, and I know this has quite a bit, but it didn’t feel that silicone-y to me. I really liked the texture. I took a star off just because my skin has been leaning pretty dry lately, and this didn’t seem quite moisturizing enough for me. Personally I will stick with the soft cream or the original. But I think it’d be great for not-dry skin types.
review_title: Great, but not for dryer skin

review_text: La Mer sent me a tiny sample sized jar of this and I’m shocked by some of the bad reviews. I have combo skin that’s prone to breakouts, and within a week of using this product, my skin was more moisturized, soft, and most of the acne on my cheeks dissapeared. The price is crazy, but so far after trying many different moisturizers, this is the only one that works for me.
review_title: Expensive but actually makes a difference

review_text: I used the original gel for twenty years, safe to say I was addicted to it. When the original was reformulated I was so disappointed, but gave this new one a try. It is NOTHING like the original. The original was cooling, absorbed like a dream, and left my face baby soft. This one does not absorb and leaves my skin feeling tacky. If I could leave no stars I would! Don’t waste your money. This new gel is far inferior to the original.
So lightweight yet effective. I like to use this as the weather begins to warm up.

I don’t know why this has so many negative reviews! I got a sample of this and I really like it! It’s super lightweight, NOT GREASY AT ALL, and immediately absorbs into the skin. In my opinion, it dries pretty matte. I have acne prone skin and this actually calmed redness and irritation that I had. I’ve also tried the original Creme de la Mer and I felt like that was way too heavy and greasy even though I have really dry skin. If you’re looking for a lightweight moisturizer that’s goes to leave your skin super soft and not sticky/tacky, then this is the moisturizer for you.

This poor gel creme is far inferior to LaMer’s last one. The consistency is sticky, does not moisturize, leaves skin with a waxy-like feeling. Also...I experienced breakouts from this gel creme. I do not recommend this creme at all! Far overpriced for such a poor product.
review_title: Bring back the old gel creme!

review_text: I personally love it. I love the feel of the gel cream as it is light and not too thick. Using La Mer is such a treat.
review_title: Love the light, cold feel. Totally recommend

review_text: Broke me out like no other skincare product. Packed full of pore clogging ingredients. This gel cream is a big disappointment and I would give it 1/2  or no stars of possible. It did not absorb well and was sticky. It was not moisturizing and actually left my face with dry patches. Spend your money on a different product.

I have a combination skin type, it is really hard to find something really moisturizing on my cheeks but not oily on the T-zone. I have used every moisturizer of La mer, and this is the only one which fits me perfectly. I really really love it, and it is amazing to feel my skin so soft but no oil at all when I wake up in the morning. Comparing to the old gel cream,this one is slightly richer, but the old one is too light for me. I just bought my 2nd one, and will keep using it!
review_title: The best moisturizer of La mer

review_text: I picked up just a little thing of this to go along with my creme de la mer. I have combo skin so i choose my moisturizer on a day to day basis depending if my skin is really dry or really oily. The original is quite thick and when my face is being extra oily the original just doesnt feel right. review_text: I had my daughter try this for scars she has and worries about. After finishing one tube, she sees no difference.
This actually works - if you stick with it. Don’t expect to apply once and have an overnight miracle but if you use correctly and stick with it you will see changes even with old scars!

I received this as a free product trial from PinchMe. I started using it daily and gave notice a difference but it has only been a short time of use, I believe over time it will help reduce the scars more and more. Great product so far.

I received this as a free product trial from PinchMe. While it hasn’t drastically reduced my scar, I am noticing improvements. I am continuing to use the gel and hope it will get less noticeable in the future. So glad I was able to see a change in my scar appearance.

Works with persistence. Like most things, there is no magic topical product that will remove something immediately. But with regular use, I noticed a big difference new scars I have and especially for picked acne marks. On older spots, I would say it lightened slightly, but it was not a miracle worker. Easy to use, no offensive smell, and absorbs well. Basically if you are looking to get rid of marks that are less than a year old ,this is the product for you.
I received this for free from pinchme in exchange for my opinion. I love this product! It doesn’t have harsh chemicals and it’s fragrance free. I started seeing results after a couple of weeks!

The first scar gel treatment that is ever worked for me. For years I’ve had these bumps on my back that I recently found out was the result of scars. I have been using the Dr. Zenovia skin care for about 2 weeks and I feel like I can already see a difference! So excited to see what happens in the upcoming months!
I really like this product. I have scars from having my gallbladder removed and it made the scars less visible. I think with long term use the scars will completely disappear.
review_title: Great for reducing the appearance of scars

review_text: I received a free sample of Dr. Zenovia Skincare Scar Gel Treatment from PINCHme. I’ve had great success with this product so far. I suffer from acne, so scars are just an everyday occurrence to me unfortunately. After using this product, I’ve notice the healing time is significantly faster than they would be normally. I’ve even tested it on old scars and they look to be healing as well. I’m very impressed with this gel treatment, and will have to get more when I run out.
review_title: Works on old scars as well

review_text: This product is an absolute must have! I applied the Dr. Zenovia Clear Scar Gel Treatment as directed and I honestly had results in about 14 days on my newer acne scars. For my older ones it took about a month to see real results and with continued use I know they will get better and better. This is a must please give it a try, I have always been self-conscious about my scars, and this has helped so much were other products failed me. Thank you Dr.Zenovia for creating this and so many other products of yours that I use.

While I was exited to try Dr. Zenovia Scar Gel Treatment, at the same time I was nervous of the results because of my past experiences with other scar treatments. I noticed on the first week of using Dr. Zenovia Scar Gel treatment, the skin looked more soft and hydrated. This gel is thick but not greasy and it also feels sticky while applying it, but once you spread it around the affected area the gel doesn’t feel thick anymore. It doesn’t have any scent and absorbs quickly. This gel is a blend of reg-ulate360 complex, silicone, bromelain and papain enzymes. I’m amazed at how many things this gel can treat, like scarring by acne, cuts, surgery, burns, insect bites and high friction areas. I’m so glad I found this scar gel treatment before my next surgery. Definitely an excellent product!

Dr. Lenovo’s Skincare Scar Gel Treatment seems to be working on my old gallbladder removal scars.  The sample I received from Pinchme was a full sized sample and the gel seems to penetrate and stay on the scar longer than scar lotions.

I am obsessed. I’ve been using this for a few weeks now and I’m SO happy it’s available on Sephora.com now!!! It is such a good *almost* Aquaphor-esque consistency, but lighter and more blendable and it really hydrates and the area and truly lightened up my scars in a matter of only a few weeks. I’m love Dr. Zenovia’s whole line, and this is just a another winner!
review_title: AMAZING for both acne scars and other scars!

review_text: I’ve been using this product for over a month now and it keeps my skin so soft and moisturized! The rose oil leaves my skin glowy and it’s been a staple in my daily routine

This is now my normal routine. The rose oil doesn’t seem to absorb quite as well so I use it at night. The eye cream makes me look more awake even when I don’t sleep well. The moisturizer is perfect. I gift the eye cream to my friends as well.
review_title: This is pretty much my routine now.

review_text: By far my favourite go-to winter skincare combo.  The moisturizer is light and hydrating. I usually apply 1 pump of the lactic acid and then 1 drop of the vitamin c as the last step. Flawless skin in the morning

I’m actually pretty obsessed; I used everything until it ran out. I hear what some people are saying about the sample sizes being small, but the lactic acid serum lasted a good few weeks for me (I only use 1 pump at night before moisturizer). I think the squalene oil would’ve lasted too if I hadn’t knocked it over when it was half-full :’)I can see why the serum is a bestseller--I have texture on my face from acne & scarring and my skin has gotten visibly smoother after only around 3 wks of use. Incredible. I’m not sure if the squalene oil played any part, but it sure feels luxurious and helps my face stay hydrated (no more waking up to flaky skin in the morning!).Yes, the creams don’t smell like daisies and roses, but they’re fragrance-free which is a huuuge bonus if you have really sensitive skin like I do. The face cream was okay but what I really loved was the eye cream. It’s super hydrating & feels lightweight and not oily.I’m a Biossance girl now :)

after using these products I would not recommend them, the tiny oil has a strong scent and give me a strong breakout all over my face, I usually only get breakouts on my period in my chin but after using everything I got pimples all over my face, I have susceptible skin and now have to figure out how I’m going to heal my skin, I don’t recommend :(

This little value set was so shrinkflated! Honestly the smallest amount of product I’ve encountered in one of these sets, it NOT worth the cost at all. The product is ok but nothing to write home about. Save your money!
review_title: Shrinkflation at work! Save your money

review_text: I love everything in this kit but the night serum.  I’m a huge fan of the moisturizer, and the rose oil and eye cream were nice to try as well.  I find the night serum causes slight burning to my sensitive and dry skin.

I have used this for about a week or 8-9 days, and I would not recommend thisVery unpleasant smell , moisturizer smells like some kind of ointment. review_title: Really great product for dry skin

review_text: I just received this, and I was thrown off with the smell from the lactic acid night serum. The products are okay, honestly only used the moisturizer. The value is okay but I think they could replace the oil with another sample product.

I have normal to dry skin, that’s mature. Purchased this set to see if I would like it. Since it is a higher price point line. A little bit goes a long ways, its very concentrated . I have pretty good skin to begin with but this paired with the pore minimizing cleanser has been a game changer for my skin. I will be purchasing the full sized of each next.
I have been using this set every night before bed, and it has improved my skin tremendously. It feels really oily when you first put it all on, but it soaks in by morning. I highly recommend.
such a good sample size of some amazing products! the eye cream especially goes such a long way & the size will last for a while!

The smell of the serum is weird. It’s not a fresh and clean smell… The eye cream doesn’t have a smell and it’s the best product of the bundle honestly. I would have just bought that. Also the oil is I guess ok but I would nt revuy.
review_title: Weird serum smell : - , but eye cream : +++

review_text: Originally when I got my first set, I was quite pleased with the creams and the lactic acid, but as my skin is oily, I did not use the oil. I forgot I even had it. This was my first experience with products containing squalane, and I was pleased to find my skin seemed to love it. I do not love hyaluronic acid; it irritates my skin, and because it is in EVERYTHING these days, I wind up with it in layers of products and I believe this results in foundations separating. I’ve really been having trouble in this regard, so I’m delighted to find a moisturizer that uses squalane instead. Now, recently I got hold of a benzoil peroxide cream that, unlike the usual stuff you get over the counter, was twice the concentrate (which I did not know at the time). After just two applications my face burned, itched, reddened, and finally peeled!  Horrible. Of course I discontinued use and threw it away. But my face needed repair, badly. Good moisturizer helped but not enough. I remembered the Biossance oil in this set, and dug it out of the drawer. It soothed my skin immediately. I applied it twice daily for a little over a week, and it did the trick. My normal (oily) skin finds it too much to use daily, but I apply it after a long bath or other drying environment and it makes my skin hydrated, luminous, and healthy looking.The eye cream in this set is one of my top five favorite products.
review_title: Great introduction to squalane; excellent products

review_text: On my second week of using this set, so far it’s been okay, have not noticed any major change to my skin. Not a fan of the scent though.

Personally for myself I was not a big fan of these products, they are a little too thick on application. I have combo/oily skin and after using the moisturizer it made it feel 10x worse. The lactic acid acid burned pretty bad on application. The vitamin c rose oil was okay, but tou only need a  a pea size amount
I’m hooked! Started out with this pack of skin care, and I can’t say enough about it. I have mature skin at age 51 years old. And YED Biossance is WORTH EVERY CENT!

It’s true that the omega moisturizer smells weird, like sweaty feet, however I didn’t want to waste the product and used it in my night time routine. Surprisingly, despite the smell, it actually left my face feeling very nice, smooth, and not greasy or anything. I’m not sure how it layers under make up, but I am loving how it works overnight. I have blemished skin, and doesn’t irritate, and seems to be softening my flare up areas.
The regenerative face lotion smell terrible!! I thought it was rancid. Jury is still out on the benefits
I bought it for the oil that smelled wonderful and I ended up liking the eye cream from all of them. The cream is smelly but it left my skin tight. I used it during my night routine

The Omega Repair cream smells like feet.  I can’t get past it.  I’ve used other Biossance products and never found their odor offensive or overpowering, but this particular formula could use some tweaking.  The other products in this set do not have an offensive odor.
review_title: Omega repair cream needs some help

review_text: I don’t know about this but I want to like it. I picked this up today and tried it for the first time ten minutes ago. I double cleansed, patted my face dry, used a toner with hyaluronic acid like I do every night, applied adapalene gel on my jaw line for acne, then I used all four products: vitamin c + rose oil - it went on beautifully without irritation or mess. Eyecream - there was a flash of heat when applying this but only on my upper cheek are towards the outside of my eyes and not towards the inner corners of my eyes. It overlapped with other products in other areas but only had the reaction in one spot (the same spot for both sides). I’m assuming I’ve damaged my skin barrier in the same spot on both sides of my face either by exfoliating or my make up application is removing my SPF. There is no redness 20 minutes later and the skin does not feel hot to the touch or sore but it did shock me and had me ready to wash my face quickly. Resurfacing night serum - it stung going over any broken skin but not when it went over the cheek area that came in contact with the eye cream. Omega repair cream - more of a watery formula that went on smoothly and let me use a controlled amount to cover face, neck and chest in one go. It didn’t leave my fingers feeling sticky or tacky like some of my other moisturizers have. I also spot tested my skin care routine on the inside of my wrist an hour before applying it to my face and had no reactions at allAs for the smell; the rose oil and vitamin C smell pleasant. The other three aren’t bad but they are not perfumed to cover up the smell of the ingredients so some people may not like them
review_title: Interesting skin reaction to eye cream

review_text: So I use the toner from this brand and wanted to try some of their other items. They have nice ingredients but that’s all I can say. The face oil is way too heavy for sensitive acne prone skin. I like my Youth to the People face oil better as it doesn’t feel thick. The creams all have a strong floral or plant smell & are heavy as well. Maybe better for dry skin. However I do like the lactic acid treatment. Would not buy these again due to not fitting my needs and the price.
It was as a Christmas gift, my daughter in law is vegan and she loved it ..
I love these products, and will most likely buy the full size once I run out, decent amount of product in the samples. definitely worth the price. The vitamin C oil is to dieee for

highly recommend set for moisturizer and brightening

The Night serum and Squalene oil are a big hit. The eye and face creams are good but not any better than Peter Thomas Roth. I have already bought a full size night serum and plan to get a full size Squalene oil.  I will also try try their plumping serum.
review_title: Two out of Four are Awesome

Love the oil and eye cream. The other two products make it hard to layer on the skin for consistency and product’s sake. Overall nice though
These products BURNS! Rose oil, moisturizer- all of it. My face was red/burning/itching within 10 minutes of application and I do not have sensitive skin.

Love this little set! It got me hooked on the brand, especially because it’s a routine! Perfect and left my skin glowing.
review_title: Tbh you have to try this set.

review_text: Wow! I absolutely LOVE this product!! I tried it, it’s amazing even with my sensitive skin. I literally bought the full size bundle. Highly recommend for fabulous skin on your 40’s!!

I did buy the full rose oil after though.
review_title: Some new holy grails items, others not so much

I’d avoid this unless you a) don’t care about real results or are only looking for hydration, or b) don’t care about the nasty, nasty smell.

I’ve used this brand on and off for a few years and never had a bad experience. The results are not immediate so it can be hard to get as excited about this line as some others that have more immediately visible results but it definitely seems to work over time so would recommend if you are patient
OBSESSED after trying this starter kit. I will be purchasing these items in all full size.
The creme smelled so bad I’m taking it right back to Sephora.  The oil was ok! Didn’t even bother with other products

I love the eye cream and the rose oil with Vitamin C.  However, the Squalane serum and cream irritated my skin and a big pimple appeared on my cheek threatening to invite friends.  Be careful when using these two products.  My skin used to be combination but now it’s dry.

Avoid if you have an oily face. I got it for price but the only thing that did not clog my pores was the night serum. I hated the smell of the night cream and wasn’t too exited for the eye cream after seeing it

I picked this up after seeing a you tuber…when I tell you I have been super pleased with this purchase. I love every item that comes in the set. I have purchased other products as well…I will be purchasing the full size. #winner

Absolute love this set!!  My favorite product in this set is the rose oil.  The rose oil makes my skin glow!!  The night serum reduced the size of my pores and improved the texture of my skin within a week. The day moisturizer is light and plumped up my skin.  Highly recommend this!

Love this set ! Great to try all these products & test them out . Also great for travel all the right sizes to pack . Thanks

And honestly the eye cream was the one I was looking forward to as I have used it before and it’s great.

I’ve been using the products consistently for about two weeks now and my skin has completely cleared up! I also had an uneven skin tone and it all looks the same now. I’ve had multiple people comment on the change. I’ll definitely be buying the full size products

This is a nice set. I love how it sets in my skin. I don’t usually buy products with rose because I don’t like certain floral smells… this rose oil smells great, not greasy and leaves a fresh feel and natural glow to the skin.
This brand is amazing the oil makes my skin very soft and smooth. I would recommend this to anyone who has dry skin or uneven skin tone.

I use this product this morning and again tonight for the first time and can already tell a difference.

Unimpressed. Not sure if everything is supposed to smell like sweaty feet ?

I read all of the positive reviews and to be honest, I’m glad this was a short term commitment on my end.I did not find any of these products to deliver what they purport they can. The eye cream is quite light, but after extended use (and I purchased the full size at the same time) no real difference in the appearance around the eye. I don’t expect all products to smell like roses, but this is another level. In the end, I have other oils, moisturizers, and serums that are hands down better - Babor, Biopelle, Clarins, Alteya, Starflower Essentials… I’m glad I went with this trial size (the full size eye cream the exception, which I now regret purchasing @$54).

I bought a similar set on sale, without the eye cream. I absolutely love the face repair cream and use it during the daytime with any serum, or as is. It is not the best smelling, but it is one of the most moisturizing creams without being too heavy on the skin. I find my skin has improved over time and not needing to use anything else. I love the night serum and am even able to use it as is. The rose oil, I’m saving up to use, but seeing the quality of the other items, I’m positive this will be another go to. I’m almost going to say this is holy grail at this point for me, using it for more than a month and a little going a long way, there is still a lot of the repair cream left. Note that you get the full size cream and thus, this is a great deal.. It also helps that the product is animal friendly and doesn’t have any harsh chemicals that are concerning.

This travel size set was really good and helped me try out the products before I bought the full-size version. I ended up buying the full-size version of the Omega repair cream. And once the eye cream runs out I will also buy the full-size version of the eye cream. I have also kept the small jar and now when I travel I take a bit from the full-size jar and put it in the smaller jar to make it more convenient to travel with.

Everything in this box is seriously amazing and a game changer. I always use biossance and changed to skin cueticals a few months ago and now right back to biossance. This makes your skin feel refreshed and definitely helps with dryness. Highly recommended!
I have used a lot of creams to help the skin look good a fight angling and this is the absolute best I have tried and believe me I have tried very expensive and run of mill stuff this is a keeper

Total game changer. I have acne scars and uneven skin tone. This totally changed my skin. Lactic acid and eye cream is amazing. Rose oil can be bit thick for oily skin people but it didn’t break me out. Moisturiser is nice for night use to have plump skin in morning. Overall loved it.

This set is an excellent value. I genuinely enjoy all the products in this set and will be repurchasing. I’ve been using for a month and still have half the product left of the rose oil, serum, and cream. I’ve been using the eye cream 2x a day and just ran out. No breakouts. Gentle effective skincare.

My skin never felt so good. I was hesitant to spend the amount of money, so this travel size set allowed me to see what all the rave is about without committing. I’m completely sold. All products work amazing and leave my skin with a fresh glow.
Great travel size, perfect to try the products which all work great
love these products!!! my favorite is the eye cream! worth every penny
wasn’t for me, couldn’t get past the awful smell of it.  returned it.

Ugh ! The smells of it is a No for me. I just can tolerate it. I wanted to try this kit because I love their rose oil + vitamine C, but it’s a no for me. I never smelled anything like this and I just don’t like it.

Fantastic set. Really nice way to try out a skincare routine before committing $$$ to full sizes. Most in love with the eye cream - it really does help fine lines fill out. The package rec is 1-2x weekly, I’m down to about once every ten days, but it has made a difference in my forehead lines.
Good kit to try products- eye cream though small will last you a month or two

A wonderful introduction to the Biossance brand! These products have truly made a difference in my skin within a month’s time. Otherwise, I definitely recommend this for someone getting into the skincare basics!

review_text: Really lovely product and a great value. I love when Sephora has this mini sampler sets. Everything has been working for the past week. The only thing is that if you have oily skin, this may leave your skin a little oiler than normal. I have combination skin and I find I can’t use this for my morning routine or my face is too oily. But it’s great for my nighttime one.

I think all the products in this Set are great ! but one stood out the most for me and that was the  Squaline & Vit C Rose Oil; I put on my skin before bed, and it feels amazing, soothing, and my skin was improved overnight.  All products are great, but what I will repurchase going forward is the Rose Oil. I’m 70 with highly sensitive skin.
review_title: SQUALENE + VIT C ROSE OIL IS THE BOMB!

review_text: I bought this set and I love it, I’m still using it after 1 month of consistent, everyday use and the products are still not even 1/2 empty. Biossance is amazing as a product line but this set is just BEYOND! Buy it ASAP!

I don’t know if it’s the whole set or the lactic acid serum or the rose oil but my skin was GLOWING and clear and soft the next morning. They have become my staple products. Super moisturizing. I didn’t expect to love them this much and they are definitely taking over for the products I was using previously. There’s nothing I don’t love about these products

This is a set of all my favorite Biossance products. I use the lactic acid, repair cream and eye cream at night, and omega repair cream and vitamin c serum during the day and get compliments about my skin all the time!

Great way to get an introduction to Biossance’s best sellers. My favorite ones from this set would be the serum and the eye cream. I am a huuuuge fan of Biossance’s serums (all of them might I add) and I think they are a great success. The marine algae eye cream is thick and creamy, my under eyes really feel it. I’ve only deducted one point because as great as the rose oil and omega cream are, I am simply just not a fan of rose scented things and the scent of omega cream is not for me. Great gift set to give someone or try out for yourself, I recommend it.
It was okay. I didn’t enjoy the smells of most of the products and didn’t really see a huge difference. Won’t buy again.
I am surprised that I have had results with this natural skincare line. The products leave my skin glowy and my wrinkles are less. Worth every penny.

I LOVE this little set!! Completely worth the price to try some great products. I don’t mind the smell of the moisturizer I don’t think it really smells like anything. The serum is a nice moisturizing squalane oil that doesn’t clog pores and works really well with my oily skin, especially as I’ve increased my use with acids. The lactic acid does burn a bit if you use it without putting on a moisturizer first, but after a while your skin gets used to it, or you can use a hyaluronic acid prior to using it and it helps. I normally think eye creams are a scam but this is the first one I’ve really considered buying full size. I wish full sizes of each product were just a little bit cheaper because I feel like I can only buy one at a time, but overall, a great little set!!
I LOVE Biossance products.  I have a very sensitive skin and i’m surprised how well their products suit my skin.  I can see immediate results on my skin : clean, glowy and healthy!
What I liked the most about this set is definitely the eye cream, second the omega repair cream.
I am obsessed with this brand and this set is an awesome sampling! Super hydrating and gentle on my sensitive skin. Highly recommended!

This set is the perfect size for travel or if you are on the fence about purchasing the full sizes. Biossance truly makes excellent products. They are cruelty-free (cruelty free kitty certified), vegan, and sustainable. The marine algae eye cream in this kit is my #1. It’s very hydrating and doesn’t cause milia. I use the lactic acid 2x a week to exfoliate my skin and even rub it on any pimples I get. The Omega repair cream is a lovely nightime moisturizer that provides extra hydration. I top it off with Vit C oil to lock in the hydration and rub the extra on my cuticles. Definitely worth the purchase.

This brand & their products sounded right up my alley. My skin loves squalene & their line is supposed to be super hydrating. This was the exact opposite in my experience. This dried my skin out terribly, uncomfortably so. Obviously this didn’t work for me, but we’re all different. I’m sure some will enjoy it. Glad I tried this set to know this line just isn’t for me.

review_text: This vitamin C serum is pretty good. The smell is delicate, and the citrus scent is not hard on the nose. After applying my essence, I gently rub it into my skin, and it immediately sinks in. Unlike other vitamin C serums that are too tacky, this serum has the consistency of simple syrup and feels cool to the touch before rubbing into the skin.After using this product for roughly three months and applying it every odd morning and evening, it did help brighten up my skin. A few scars did fade away a bit. The serum does deliver on what is advertised. My skin tone evened out, which made my average complexion look vibrant and well hydrated. Juicy like I like it.oHowever, this product is outside of my budget. Each bottle contains 0.5 ounces of product, which is far less than your average bottle. In under three months, I went through 4 bottles, and I did not use this product every day. Let’s calculate this for a second: That’s a total of 16 bottles used in a year. The bulk package containing 3 bottles costs $68, and a single 0.5 oz bottle is $28. That’s 5 bulk packages, and a single bottle purchased a year totaling at $368/year. In addition to all of my other skincare products, this is outside of my budget and lacks the longevity I prefer in my routine. I do not fancy the idea of completing a product in about 2-3 weeks. Everything I apply to my face is applied to my neck. With this product, I could not do this and would have gone through four bottles in about 1.5 months or less. Nah, that price per ounce is too darn high. Plus, the efficacy of this vitamin-c seems to be lower than others I have used because I have had better results. Although this product works, there are better ones out there for reasonable prices.

I keep it at the initial gentle vibration setting for a regular cleanse, but I push the Sonic Glow power button again to get a more intense vibration for make-up removal.  The handle is comfortable to hold and the bristles are soft and flexible and don’t irritate my sensitive skin or cause any redness. When I’m done cleansing, I rinse any make-up off the brush and it’s good as new.  Then, I pump my serum on to the rose quartz side, press the Sonic Glow power button either three or four times depending on whether I want a gentle or intense pulsation, press the Active Warmth power button, and glide the quartz side over my face in circular motions.  The warmth immediately kicks in, but it never gets uncomfortably hot.  I repeat this process for my oil and moisturizer.  The warmth is soothing and I can feel the pulsations pushing the serum, oil, and moisturizer further into my skin for deeper absorption.  Overall, the PMD Clean Pro RQ is easy to use, customizable, and more powerful and relaxing than just using my hands for these steps.  It’s now become an integral part of my skincare routine!

This is my first review of any product I’ve purchased from Sephora.  I had high hopes for this product, and was looking forward to having a nice replacement to my Clarisonic.  Unfortunately, I think this beauty tool needs some fine tuning in the design department.  First, the good: the bristles are gentle on the skin, and did a good job of cleansing the skin.    Now, the bad:  The bristles on this device are only on the flat side and really need to extend around the edges (at least partially) to soften the hard sides of this tool.   It felt awkward trying to clean my face just using the the flat part of this device.  The sides are quite hard and made it uncomfortable maneuvering around the nose and eye area.   The handle design is also not very ergonomic, and it does not come with a cradle/stand to place this on when it’s not in use.   It only comes with a plastic case, which is fine for travel, but not so great if you want a resting place for every day use.     Lastly, the portion of the charging cable that plugs into the device is not a micro-USB, USB-A, or USB-C, but rather is a special plug that you probably can’t use for for anything else (at least I can’t).  It would have been better to design this device with a more universal charging cable to avoid having another cable to keep track of.   All in all, I think a little more thought should have gone into the design.
