I also tried it out on a couple of my girls and they love it too. One of my daughters comes up to my bathroom and uses it at the end of the day. I don’t worry about sharing bacteria with my daughters because of the material the PMD is made of.
Amazing!!! I love this face brush so much. My skin has never been better
Great product! My skin has never looked or felt better!
I love this product! My face has never felt more smooth!! Honestly. It feels so nice on both the cleansing and the heat mode. Great purchase!
I have only been using this for 4 days and already can see such a difference in the firmness of my skin and appearance of pores. Absolutely love this product!!
I love this device! I can def see a huge improvement in my skin, as well as I just LOVE the heated stone to use with my serums.
I received this as a Christmas gift. I love it!! My skin feels so smooth after using it and my pores look smaller.
review_title: Smaller pores and baby smooth skin

review_text: I received this as a Christmas gift and have been in love with it ever since! I am 20 with light combination skin. I’ve been having trouble with clogged pores on my nose, dryness around lower cheeks and brow bone, and random pimples here and there. After my first use, the pores on my nose were practically erased! When I woke up the next morning, my clogged pores were back and I used the device again to get rid of them. The next day I woke up, there were significantly less clogged pores on my nose. Every time I use this device my skin looks smoother and clearer. To be honest, it’s given me a lot more confidence in my skin; so much so that I don’t even wear foundation anymore! I’ve heard some people say that their skin purges from using this product but, fortunately, I haven’t seen too much in terms of acne. As far as the rose quartz stone goes, it really helps my serums/ oils absorb more smoothly and evenly. I don’t know how well heating the stone works on my skin but if anything, it sure feels nice. It’s definitely pricey and I probably wouldn’t have bought it myself but if you can, I’d completely recommend it as I think it’s a great investment for your skin!

I use this and Goodal Phytowash Foaming Cleanser. It feels so soothing like a facial massage. Nose bumps have gone away, chin bumps are getting noticeably smaller, cheeks are feeling smoother. I do wish the device had more of a dome shape so I could more easily clean around my nose/cheeks/under eye area. I follow with ELF cleansing brush which does have a dome shaped silicone scrub side and a brush on the other so I can get those hard to reach areas around my nose and eyes without disturbing my lash extensions. The quartz is beautiful and feels good both hot and room temperature.

BUY THIS PRODUCT!!! After just one use my skin felt, how can I put this into words, like it was saying, “Ah.. I feel fantastic“. I always feel that my skin looks the best after a vigorous workout, that flushed, glow when your skin is plumped up from the highly oxygenated blood flow. That’s what this product did to my skin. When using the warming side to apply my serums/moisturizers it was gentle enough to use under my eyes and noticed that my under eye bags that are extra baggy due to ’monthly menstrual hormones’ were eliminated immediately. I am purchasing one for my Mom right now for a Christmas present. I have never left a review before and I am about as skeptical as they come, so a product must perform some fantabulous magic in order for me to leave a review. Do yourself a favor and get this for yourself today. You work hard all day everyday, you deserve to feel like royalty.
review_title: BUY THIS PRODUCT TODAY! IT REALLY WORKS!!

review_text: Overall I like this device. The warm rose quartz gliding on my face feels amazing, especially with the massage button. It really does help my serums and moisturizers sink in better, which is great for someone who doesn’t like feeling greasy. As far as the cleaning, it’s okay. It has a learning curve. The first few times I used it the device kind of took away my cleanser and it felt really weird on my forehead because it has no contour. But if you put the cleanser on your face first it’s usually better. I like that I don’t have to buy replacement heads or worry too much about bacterial growth. It does the trick, I am one that benefits from sonic cleansing devices, but it didn’t blow me away. I use it morning and night. If you can’t or don’t want to spend this much on a device, I would say save your money since it’s not necessary or skin altering. But with all the different vibrations and heat settings, I’ll be keeping this device as my all-in-one tool.

Received it  on 9/13 used it after it had been charged for 2-3 hours. I have too say the product was amazing after the first uses love how soft it is and the variation of speeds and the rose quartz that heats up on the other side is great too soak in the serums and moisturizers. Price is high but way better than spin brush cleans way better!

Really was excited about this product. Trying to find a cleansing device that doesn’t emit EMF signals. Actually made my acne worse. Do not purchase!! This one emits very high EMF. Normal is 0.5-1 this emits 11-13.7. TERRIBLE.

After thinking that I will always have blackheads and that will be that Clean Pro has saved the day! I use the second more intense vibration setting over my clogged pores and it has worked amazingly! Also the heated quartz on the back is brilliant for making sure my serum sinks deep in to my skin. Such a great tool!
I love this product, its amazing, cute and super useful!

I have had this for three weeks now. I didn’t want to write a review until I used this for a bit. I used to be a Clarisonic user, but I have now thrown it away. I am done with spending money buying brush heads and done with keeping it clean all the time.This is an amazing product! It’s easy to clean and travel with. I have use it with my Clinique liquid face soap and with my DHC oil cleanser. It works great with both. It’s very gentle on skin. It gets it super clean. The rose quartz side I use every night before bed when putting on my vitamin c serum. It feels so nice and I honestly believe it makes it soak in better. Especially when I put my face lotion on after, my skin is so smooth and I’ve noticed an improvement in my skin texture. This is definitely worth the money! I would recommend it to everyone.

To start, I am a bio male, and have extremely oily/combo skin in the summer. I have struggled with black heads, and texture even though I exfoliate and moisturize, I still haven’t seen a dramatic change in my skin... until I purchased this beauty tool, which I have been using for over two weeks.$179 is a l o t of money, so I was skeptical before buying, but more willing to spend than on the Clarisonic. I’ve seen reviews saying that using the PMD brush will bring up what’s hiding in your pores (getting worse before it gets better). Knowing this, I still purchased.Upon arrival, you will not be able to use this brush for a good 3+ hours as it does not come charged, but don’t get discouraged - it will turn on.Now to the core of the product:I use this brush every morning and night, in the morning I turn the low intensity setting on, and at night the high intensity. Although used regularly, my skin is not suffering or drying out. During the first few days I was shocked at how my skin was changing, by that I mean the areas of my nose that get clogged the most by blackheads and grease were coming out of my pores. My blackheads were literally falling off, my nose pores were becoming much smaller, the texture on my cheeks were so much more uniform and tiny than before. My skin looks absolutely polished.Tips for the warming quartz: It takes 1 minute to get very warm, but not to the point of burning. Through trial & error I apply only serums to my face and then use the quartz to evenly distribute, don’t try putting creams or oils on the quartz first, it will tug your skin. I did have 2 whiteheads come to the surface as a result of using the brush, but I’ve only seen the impeccable results. All in all, this has changed my skincare in the best most visibly rapid way possible. If you spend $ on luxurious products, you need a luxurious brush to truly see the results.

This is the best facial cleansing device on the market, and that’s coming from someone who used Clarisonic for years. You don’t have to change the brush ever and it has the best feature on the back! I love the warming quartz! It really aids in soaking in serums and moisturizers, all while getting a massage. With it being hot right now, it feels great without the warmer as well. It has made a world of difference for my dry skin, I highly recommend this device!

I was a loyal Clarisonic user for over 10 years, then one day I decided to switch and let me tell you...it was the best decision ever. Not only is this brush hypoallergenic, you don’t have to spend to constantly change the brush heads and I have received more compliments on my face since I switched over. My face is less oily, no more little breakouts and overall it cleans my face much better. I love the warmth feature on this brush as well. Worth of every dollar!
I have been using this line for a little over a year. and my skin has never looked or felt better! Makeup goes on great. Skin looks so radiant and fresh!

It doesn’t make sense that the people writing negative reviews about the scent, are also the same people that want a natural product. You’re not going to get a unicorn perfume scent and have it be “natural”. The scent isn’t bad, but if you’re used to perfumed moisturizers, then you’re not going to like this. If the light scent bothers you, then you don’t want a natural product. Go buy the cheap fragrance-filled products that you’re used to instead. This moisturizer works fantastic on all skin types but is exceptionally great on aging skin.  I’ve been using essential oils on my skin for years and some of the oils smell like wet towels, but that’s what nature smells like sometimes. You can’t always have it both ways. I took off a star because I do agree that the price point is ridiculous, and that’s why I always wait for a sale to splurge on this.

The bad reviews are mainly for the smell and this is a fragrant product. It smells like earthy florals which I love but if you are sensitive to smells don’t buy it. As a 30 year old who invests her money into skincare and is trying to stay away from Botox & fillers, tata harpers line is amazing. I also use her eye cream and find that it heals my dry, sensitive skin and works for me morning and night. I just add an oil on top during the nighttime. It also pairs well with my retina, vitamin c & sunscreen and I feel like it plumps up/fills fine lines. I highly recommend to someone who is starting to age and wants to invest in a great moisturizer!!

Received this only as a sample so, I dont know what the longer term effects are. But, overall, it is very moisturizing and my skin seems to love it to the point that Im considering getting the full size product. Not sure why there’s reviews about the smell but, mine smelled liked grapefruit! If it smells bad, then its possible that you did not get it from a fresh batch.

The cream has a nice earthy scent ( it does not linger once on), is smooth and easy to apply, no pilling. It leaves skin hydrated with a beautiful glow- not greasy or shiny( as someone with combo skin this is half my battle). The only reason for one less star is of course the price, although i love the locally sourced sustainable principle behind tata, it does make it hard for the everyday person to own a complete routine.

I enjoy this product and have been using this daily.The scent may not be a fav to most but it doesn’t bother me. The texture is a thickish moisturizer. My skin looks healthier with a nice glow. Lines are reduced. Overall skin tone evened out.I like to use half pump. Massage into fingers and lightly pat into skin or massage. A little goes a long way. You don’t be need a lot for it to absorb into the skin.I would repurchase and recommend this product.
Received a Gwp sample.  It smells like a barnyard!  Horrid.  I had to wipe it off right away.  Not sure if it was spoiled or if it usually smells like a dog’s chew hoof!

I recently started using this product and it does work - my only hesitation in giving it 5 stars is I’m not sure it’s worth the price. I appreciate how sustainable Tata is as a brand so I understand it makes it more expensive but if you had to choose which Tata product to purchase I’d recommend the water cream over this.
review_title: Like it but don't love it

review_text: All I can manage to say about this product is the scent is bad and I had to wash it off each time I tried it...
review_title: Can't Get Past The Strong & Lasting Scent

review_text: Excellent product, yes it has a strong scent but I find it quiet pleasant also its filled with certified organic ingredients so Im more than happy to enjoy these natural scents. I use this as the last product in my routine and it keeps my face moisturized for the entire day.

I wanted to give this product  0 stars however I had to give 1 in order to write the review.  This is the # 1 all time worst moisturizer i have ever tried and I’ve tried lots.  First of all the smell is extremely strong and unpleasant and it doesn’t fade at all.  My boyfriend couldn’t even come close to me because of the gross strong smell but i decided to keep using it anyway for 2 weeks despite the smell making me gag because assumed it was going to be a miracle product because of the price and guess what it made my completion dull and also gave me little bumps all over my skin and I’m pretty sure it gave me more wrinkles. This did not do anything for my skin at all except make it way way worse.  Do not waste your money!
Terrible product. Does nothing for the skin. And the price on top of everything. Complete waist of money. Have no idea why this brand is so popular.

I have repurchased this many times over the year - my trick is that I always repurchase when Sephora is having a VIB sale, even if I don’t need to replace my current bottle immediately. I have combo skin that gets dry during the winter, so I use this year round in the morning with a Vitamin C serum under and sunscreen on top, and in the evening with a serum under and a cream on top. I haven’t noticed a major change since using this product, but I do think it contributes to keeping my skin softer and moisturized - doesn’t trigger anything, which is great for me. It does have a smell, but it reminds me of a spa, I don’t mind it.

Just finished using a full bottle and it is an average product.  It is not exceptional based on price. Other products are equally good at a lower cost.  It is not greasy and a clean product. I feel that I am paying more for the packaging than the actual product.

I actually dont mind the smell but there are much better alternatives for A LOT LESS.Even if you are willing to spend the money I say, save it for something else.MY RESULTS: I saw little to no changes. I have combo skin and it felt a bit to sticky during the day. I ended up using it during night.
The results and price aren’t worth even trying to get past the smell.

Definitely one of my favorite moisturizers.  I have purchased it multiple times.  With its heavy price tag I tried other products but always ended up with this one since it showed the best results and the skin always looked radiant.

I don’t know but the scent reminds of trees, and not really good smelling trees. I didn’t buy a full size thank goodness but I just got a sample. It also didn’t do much for my dry skin. I guess it’s a bit unfortunate for the full sized product to be so expensive. The only thing I really like about this is that there are no harsh chemicals and it’s clean other than that it’s just meh to me. It’s hard to say it won’t work for anyone because everyone has different skin types so what doesn’t work for me might work for someone else. It’s just not my cup of tea.

I have facial redness/mild rosacea and spent close to a year searching for a moisturizer to help. This is THE BEST I have found. I use this at night and my face is noticeably less red in the morning, when used consistently. It only took a few days using a store sample to notice this effect. I bought the full bottle in the VIB sale to help with the cost. I’ve been using for 4 months and the bottle is close to halfway gone and I’m still loving it. If you have facial redness like me I highly recommend you try this. Dont let negative reviews from people with other needs deter you. I’m actually kind of sad to see this reviewed so poorly because its changed my appearance so much and I wish more people with my same problems were aware of how this could help them. I don’t mind the smell at all. Smell is a personal preference and this doesn’t deserve negative reviews because of that. It does have a thin consistency but I find it to be just as or more hydrating than some other thicker moisturizers. For me it is all about quality ingredients that affect the skin positively, and this delivers that in a way unlike any other for me. I am so happy I found this and will keep buying!

i cannot recommend this product.  the stench is just appalling.    no matter how well it works, the smell is just terrible.  it reminds me of vomit!  i kept wondering all day if someone is going to figure out the stink comes from my face.  now and again i would get a whiff of it, and i just had to stop myself from rinsing it off my face.  surely there’s an anti-aging moisturizer out there that smells better than this does!
Love this product. It works wonders. It feels amazing and it has helped minimize my pores.

I really like this moisturizer. I’ve used excessive amounts of others and this is in my top 3 for sure. I love the essential oil type smell and the bottle is stunning. I find it is super light weight and doesn’t make my skin feel heavy. My dryness has also gone away almost immediately after starting this product.

This is a lighter moisturizer so I apply in the morning or after the gym. It smells fresh, sort of like herbal garden. Hasn’t aggravated my redness. I’m in my late 30s so I appreciate a product like this. Love the glass bottle packaging.

I received this in a Sephora favorites set so full disclosure I didn’t pay the full price. I’m glad I didn’t though. Im 24, I have normal skin with rare breakouts. It was too oily & stinks. When I first tried this product the smell got to me before anything else. Not sure if it’s the oils or something else with the formula but the smell isn’t pleasant to me at all. It’s very overwhelming and doesn’t fade for a few hours after applying (I mist with a rose facial spray to off set the smell and it helps a bit). The texture is nice though and it absorbs quick into the skin, a pump and a half does my full face and neck to the chest. Overall it’s okay but I don’t think it suits my skin nor my preference. I’ve tried cheaper products that provide the same if not better results. The formula/finish on the skin reminds me of the Clinique dramatically different moisturizing lotion. I only recommend if you’re: rich/like to spend a lot on skincare, have dry skin or are combination and need a thicker winter moisturizer, those who don’t mind overwhelming smells (it might not smell bad to you but it is still strong nonetheless).
review_title: ok but not worth the money

review_text: Got as a sample.  Made my skin soft and seems to be moisturizing but the smell. omg. its VERY strong. I’ve had the moisturizer on for over an hour and I can still smell it. if it was good smelling i wouldn’t mind but it smells strange to me..  smells like chemicals or something. not a fan of the smell at all. maybe if they could fix that it would be a better review but I just can’t over look that.
review_title: Seems to moisturize but smells awful.

review_text: I received this as a sample. I was excited to try this moisturizer as I have found the winter weather has been drying out my skin. I cut open the sample and squeezed out the product. It had a lovely silky feel so I applied it to my face. What a mistake! The smell from the product hit my poor nose and I actually wretched!! I have never smelled any beauty product quite like this. It reminded me of mildew and vomit. And so strong!! I washed my face and hands several times but the scent lingered. I can’t imagine spending money on this! Especially $150. I can’t comment on the products ability to moisturize dry skin as I couldn’t keep it on. Tata Harper should reformulate and improve the smell. I would be hesitant to try anything from this company for fear that all their products smell like this.

i really love and respect Tata Harper and her products but for some reason her moisturizers are not hydrating enough for my skin- i used this in the summer as well so i thought a lighter moisturizer would work for me.
Love it! This is the first time I use it and so far so good!

I don’t understand some of these negative reviews. I am 25 years old and undergoing some of the harshest acne treatments on the market and this moisturizer is a DREAM for me. When writing this, it is summertime, so I cannot speak to how this will hold up in the winter (i’ll probably have to switch to their creme riche formula). I use 2 pumps of this for my whole face and neck - you really don’t need a lot. When you apply the moisturizer you might be thinking “wow, this sank into my skin really fast and doesn’t feel like I moisturized“ but that’s because the formula enters the skin quickly and keeps your skin moisturized all day without leaving a thick greasy film on your face - if that’s what you’re after, don’t get this product. It is moisturizing enough for someone who is undergoing harsh acne treatments and has perpetually dry skin. This absorbs quickly, smells fresh and clean, and leaves my skin looking like a porcelain doll.
I really like this moisturizer because it is natural. But, it also feel really nice on my face. I have not noticed it to break me out. It also smells really nice.

I agree with another commenter--this product is more like a serum than a moisturizer. Since the consistency is so serum-like, I needed almost 3 squirts to cover my whole face/neck. I also still found my face dry (and I don’t naturally have dry skin). Both my boyfriend and I did not like the smell. I would say this is overpriced for my results.
I have to say, no a big fan if it’s smell.... formula is light, maybe good for summer.
Great moisturizer. Didn’t leave my face felling greasy or nasty. But the smell is awful! It makes me think of an old dill pickle.
review_title: works great, smells like dill pickle.

review_text: I love this stuff. It’s definitely a stronger scent than most other moisturizers, but I personally don’t mind it. It’s very light feeling but does a great job. One pump is enough for my entire face   neck so the product goes a long way.

I wanted to love this particularly since it is a clean product. My skin is normal to dry, more dry in the winter. Unfortunately, this sat on top of my skin and didn’t absorb. Also the fragrance was overwhelming and gave me a headache. Sadly, I had to return it.

My skin loves all TH. This one is great, fragrance and silicone free, you are really putting only good stuff in your face. If you are into clean products you will love it.  I don’t care about smell, but it smells good, it dissipates immediately anyway. Even though it is a high quality product, is too pricey IMO. this would be my number 1 brand if it was a bit more affordable. If you are curious start with the Resurfacing Serum, it is amazing...

I bought the cleanser, floral essence and this moisturizer from Tata Harper, and every product is a huge disappointment, because they cause breakouts on me constantly. Ever since the day i received them, there are new acne popping out on me EVERY SINGLE DAY! Just imagine someone who always has clear skin and enjoys trying out new makeups suddenly has to deal with so many acnes alongside the chin, on cheeks, and underneath the ears. As soon as I completely stopped Tata Harper product my skin became flawless just in 2 days. This product smells like cucumber. The floral essence literally makes me want to sneeze every morning. I would give a zero star if I can.

I’ve tried all of her moisturizers and this one is the most drying one. I’m oily and it tightened my skin and as a result I’m less oily. However, my skin is beginning to crack on my forehead. I will use up the sample size but would not repurchase. This is not worth $110. Absolutely not! If you’re dry, try her rebuilding moisturizer. Would not recommend this for dry skin.
That smell! At this price point they should have figured out a “natural” ingredient that will make it smell less like a rotten egg. Had to return it.

This moisturizer is my holy grail! I mix it with a few drops of Josie Maran argan oil and OMG, the texture, the smell, the results are incredible - I feel like I am at a spa each time I use it! It has transformed my skin and I actually look forward to washing my face so I can use it.

I can’t even begin to express how disgusting this smells. It’s the most off-putting smell I’ve ever experienced in a skin care product. I am not someone who is easily bothered by a scent... I can deal with just about any smell but this is unbearable. If you’re thinking about purchasing it, I HIGHLY recommend that you go to Sephora and smell it before you purchase so you can see if it’s a scent that you can deal with...

I bought the mini kit that includes this moisturizer. I love the scent of it. It’s a perfect ending to a night skincare routine. It’s very moisturizing and sinks into my skin beautifully. It does not irritate my skin nor cause any breakouts. I will be purchasing a full size in the future.
This offers light coverage with real moisturizing. Don’t need to use much. 2 pumps is more than enough for face and neck. I have rosacea and this doesn’t irritate my skin
review_title: One of those things that’s actually worth the $$$

review_text: This product is so gross, it leaves a very sticky and heavy layer on the skin and it smells really bad. Will NOT be purchasing.

I LOVE this Moisturizer. I have very dry, sensitive skin and this moisturizer provided me with the perfect amount of hydration that I did not need to touch up throughout the day. My skin gets red from almost everything and anything, especially around the outer portion of my chin and my cheeks, my skin did not turn red/become irritated with this product, it actually kept it at bay. It didn’t cause any flare ups/small whiteheads. Everything about this product is great. The only reason I gave it 4 stars was because of the price. I totally understand the price, it’s worth every penny but it still breaks my heart a little to buy it. I do recommend the set that sephora offers to test out all tata products because most of them are great.
This is not moisturizer. More like a serum! you have to put on moisturizer after using this. Not good for dry skin. The smell also is very strong. Totally overpriced!!

I got this as a sample at my local sephora. I was looking forward to hydrated skin as that is one of the main ingredients in this product. first of all, it is very thin. maybe this would be more suited for oily skin goals, but definitely not dry like it states. second or all, it tingled my skin which is not supposed to happen and then I saw this has essential oils in it. I had to clean my face with a wipe to get it off. belief true cream beats this by a long shot and you can get 3 of those for the price of a single bottle of this.
This moisturizer changed my skin in about 1 week! I highly recommend it!

I use this only in the summer time at night as it could still clog in the day when combined with SPF. Since Tata Harper does not yet have a SPF. This is one of her original moisturizers and the best in the line. I use it with her refreshing cleaner when I have to buy at Space NK as Sephora does not carry it. The refreshing cleanser and repairative moisturizer work well together.
I guess as a moisturizer it’s ok.  Light and non greasy.  But the smell is so overwhelming I just can not use.  Glad it was just a sample I tried.

The good- it is a decent moisturizer, if you have normal, not dry skin. Worked fine for me in warm weather, but way too light weight for my winter skin. The bad- the smell (horrible), and the price (!!). For 100  dollars, I would have expected more. Does no better of a job than my $15 drugstore moisturizer, and certainly did not change the appearance of my skin. Wouldn’t recommend unless you don’t need a lot of hydration and have lots of money or blow. Disclaimer: I only had a sample, but I used it for a full week.
Tata Harper is the ultimate in skin care.

Love this lightweight moisturizer.  Not sure I’ll re-purchase because of the price point, but if I don’t find something else that I equally love I’ll definitely go back to it.  Smells amazing, locks in moisture, not irritating, natural, beautiful packaging.  Love tata.
Really disappointed in this product. It smells terrible and I can deal with that if I’m getting results but this moisturizer made my skin feel sticky after applying it. It also dried out my skin.
I was very excited to try Tata harper products.But after trying i was really disappointed.I didn’t like the scent.It does not deliver what it says.It is too runny

I bought the mask a few months ago and really loved it so I decided to try the moisturizer. I’ve been using it every night for about 2 weeks and really like it! Worth the price because I don’t need a lot. It might be a bit rich for me as a morning moisturizer but perfect for the night!

I TRIED to find a moisturizer I liked as well as this, because it IS a little pricey, but I ended up coming back to Tata because it is SO GOOD. I have very dry skin, and I needed something extremely hydrating but light and fast-absorbing enough to wear under full makeup. I tone with a floral hydrosol like helichrysum or rose, apply Tata Harper’s Beautifying Oil, then this. It is NOT a night cream if you have dry skin - you’ll want something heavier - but I absolutely glow when I’m wearing it and when I take my makeup off at the end of the day it looks better that it did in the morning.

I’m not a fan of the scent of this moisturizer, it’s natural so it wouldn’t irritate anyone sensitive to fragrance but it’s a little weird and lingers (not nearly as nice as other Tata Harper products). The moisturizer itself is quite lightweight and watery so it’s good for daily, year-round use and for any skin type. It feels nice on the skin and is not sticky at all, but it’s not super hydrating.

I LOVE THIS. This was recommended by someone at the Disney Springs Sephora; I was in a hurry and bought it without reading reviews, which I wouldn’t normally do, but I’m SO glad I did. I would describe my skin as aging, combination, and sometimes dehydrated. I’m not sure I agree with marketing this as a dry skin moisturizer, and I think that’s where a lot of the negative reviews come from. For me it is PERFECT. I don’t ever want to be without it. But if you’re used to a heavier moisturizer for dry skin, that to me would feel very greasy, you’re not going to like this.
review_title: AMAZING, but I can understand the mixed reviews

review_text: Too liquidy for my taste, stung a little and didn’t leave a soft texture. I have been trying to find my ideal moisturizer, unfortunately this one isn’t for me.

Needed a moisturizer to ad to my routine over the dryer winter months and this fits the bill.  Light and smells great.

I cannot be without it! My skin loves this soothing, hydrating repairative moisturizer. My makeup goes on smoothly over this and I no longer have uncomfortably dry skin. I use it day and night. I put it over serum and let it dry while I drink my coffee. than it’s primer and makeup, perfectly silky. No more patches. love it.
review_title: I love this as much as chocolate. No really!

review_text: Oh, Tata Harper – how I love you! This silky, refreshing moisturizer is super hydrating, fast absorbing and feels incredibly luxurious on your skin. It is full of natural goodies that will make your skin glowy and happy. Plus, its scent is divine and completely addictive. The packaging is gorgeous too – it comes in a lovely green bottle with a gold pump,  keeping air and bacteria out while giving you access to every last drop. I usually reach for this in the morning, although I do like to use it at night when I am not using an AHA or retinol serum. For additional hydration (and extra glow), I use it to seal in Tata Harper’s Rejuvenating Serum. tip: If your skin is oily or you live in a humid climate, opt for the equally fab Tata Harper Rebuilding Moisturizer, which is still hydrating but keeps your natural shine under control with a matte finish. (I use the Rebuilding Moisturizer in the summer and this Repairative Moisturizer in the cooler, drier months.)

OMG it feels so good to have this cream on my face! I have combo skin that gets really oily around my nose  and this cream doesn’t make it worst , it moisturize it without making it too heavy on my skin. It feels like my skin is moisturized enough not to overproduce extra oil and the cream doesn’t block my pores. Love it! I wish I could afford to buy it on the regular basis
I’m sorry but this horrible heavy herbal smell of this moisturizer made it impossible to use it.

Very moisturizing! Don’t use this before you apply makeup. My fave was an oil slick and I have dry/normal skin. I use this before bed and wake up with the softest skin ever. Probably wouldn’t buy again but it definitely works.

I got a deluxe size of this in a set. I don’t know what else it’s supposed to do but it does not moisturize. I don’t even have dry skin, just normal skin that almost never feels dry or tight. I get away with rich toner or serum only, but this product was drying even for me. Won’t purchase a full size.

tried this in a sample box. Was really excited to try a Tata Harper product as i have always heard great things. I was very disappointed in this product. The smell is terrible. The lotion is very thin, which i dont mind, but did nothing to moisturize my dry skin.

This doesn’t give my skin enough moisturization on its own-and my skin is combo to oily. I don’t mind the smell-it’s rosy mixed with other essential/herbal oil smells-but my husband hates it. There are several other lux and lower priced moisturizers that do a better job on my face that don’t send my husband running from the bathroom.
The first application of this product I knew I LOVED it. It left my skin feeling soft and moisturized with a lovely consistency that absorbs into the skin almost immediately.
Great day time moisturizer. Not heavy and sinks into the skin.

Compared to other moisturizers, this is quite light.  I almost always find myself applying another moisturizer over it because my face still feels dry.  I think it would be wonderful for teens or people who do not need a lot of hydration.  I can understand why some might dislike the smell because it’s different; it’s fresh and it reminds me of the outdoors.  I received a small bottle in the “Scouted by Sephora“ box and I was shocked when I saw the price of the full-size bottle.  Personally, I do not think it’s worth it.
review_title: Not very moisturizing but high quality

review_text: I received a deluxe size of this in a Sephora Favorites set. I’ve never really loved a moisturizer so much that I use it every day...I usually rotate between different ones. But this one I used daily until the very last drop!! I usually have dry patches and now I don’t see any...my skin is smooth!! I’m sad I used it all up because it is pretty pricey, but after I use up the rest of my moisturizers I will bite the bullet and repurchase this.

I tried the sample size from the Glow set. I’m not sure why this is marketed for dry skin. I am combo and my skin drinks this formula, making it feel like it’s stripped of moisture. I have to layer another moisturizer on top just to replenish. This moisturizer is lotion like consistency. It is scented due to all the oils in it. For people who are scent averse, I’d get a sample of this before buying the whole product.Sample size packaging is sleek and dispenses the formula quite well.

I️ honestly only have a small size of this but I’ve been using it recently so I️ figured I’d leave a review. It feels nice on the skin and is very thin in consistency, and although I️ didn’t have any really bad effects the scent of the moisturizer is extremely overpowering. It’s kind of a floral almost tea scent but it’s so incredibly strong I️ found myself not even wanting to keep trying it out. If you’re into strong smelling skincare maybe you should try it out, but otherwise I️ would skip it. I’m not usually really turned off by events either, so this surprised me.

I got this moisturizer in a Tata Harper kit and I’m actually happy I only have the sample size bottle. While it does moisturize my dry skin and it gives me a super healthy glow, I CAN’T take the smell. I even thought the product was expired! It’s herbal but not in a good way and it just smells terrible. I’ve used this product three times thinking that maybe I’m being a drama queen... but whenever I have it on my face, it’s the only thing I can smell. Oh and the pump in the sample bottle is THE WORST. It shoots out the product like a squirt gun and you end up with half of it on the floor. Too bad because I like how it makes my skin look/feel.

I have normal to dry skin and this just isn’t for me. I tried the setting mist a while back and I didn’t like it because of the smell alone. I received this moisturizer in a Sephora Favorites and the smell is the exact same, smells like an old warehouse to me! It leaves my skin feeling a bit tight and sticky.

I HIGHLY recommend this kit! Like HIGHLY!!! This is a great kit. And believe me when I say a little goes a long way. I first started out with a sample of the mask. Absolutely LOVED it! So I thought well I want to get the full size, then I saw this kit was only $2 more and it has the full size. At first you think THIS is the size?! But you serious do not need a lot! So not only does it feel amazing on your skin, but I have VERY sensitive skin and it does not irritate it whatsoever. I haven’t had a product I was this happy with in a while. There were dramatic results for me overnight! A little story about my sensitive skin for you - this past weekend my mom got a new laundry detergent and when she hugged me I could tell it was different. That very day my face started breaking out. I had about 20 teeny tiny zits on my cheeks. Made my cheeks extremely red. I got the kit on Monday, by the way, Monday morning I woke up and my face was so red it looked like I just put blush all over my cheeks. So that night I got home from work, washed my face, put the mast on, cleaned it off then used the moisturizer. Tuesday - Not only did I only have THREE zits but ALL the redness was gone. This has been like a miracle kit for my sensitive skin! It feels great, it doesn’t burn, and the mask doesn’t get so hard it hurts your face. I definitely recommend this to someone with highly sensitive skin. I don’t know if it’s supposed to help with breakouts too but it definitely worked for that too!
Light moisturizer with and odd scent that I am just not find of.
review_title: Nice but would not purchase full size

review_text: I have eczema and was looking for a gentle moisturizer for my sensitive but dry skin.  This was recommended to me by someone in the store and it is the best facial moisturizer I have ever used.  My skin feels so soft and nourished after I put it on.  My only complaint is the price but I will most likely repurchase the product when I run out.

I love this moisturizer, it helped repair my dehydrated skin. I was skeptical at first to purchase this product because of the price but it is worth every penny. My skin was so dehydrated that it was ’’drinking’’ my foundation. As soon as I started using this product, the problem stopped and my face is now appropriately moisturized. The cream does have an odd smell but so worth it!

It took me a while to find something like this mainly because I have combination-normal skin with cystic acne. That’s right, I don’t have “dry“ skin and I don’t live by the parameters set by what a product is generally geared for. No it didn’t clog my pores, no it didn’t feel heavy on the skin and yes it was good under make up. I think for what I’m using it for it’s great but for anyone with true dry skin all over this won’t be enough. Keep an eye out for the new tata cream that comes in a tub in that case - I know I will. It’s on the website but I’m hoping sephora will carry it. Until then I love that this comes in a pump versus most moisturizers that are more hydrating but come in a not so travel friendly tub. I also have DE lala retro that I love but I hate the packaging on that one since the pump clogs once in a while when this one doesn’t. The smell isn’t the best but keep in mind there is no artificial fragrance to mask any of the ingredients which I greatly appreciate. It is on an the expensive side which is why I removed one star and I’m on the edge of whether or not to repurchase if you’re curious as a gauge of how much I love this product.

This is one of the two products for Tata that I will continue to repurchase even though they are expensive. I need the smell of this to feel relax before going to sleep. It really moisturizing so if you have combo skin it a little to much to use morning and night.

I had a lot of expectations for this moisturizer considering all the great reviews I’ve seen for it online but considering the price, its just okay. My skin felt moisturized but not anymore so than it does with the products I use for a fraction of the cost. It also has a strong smell from the essential oils.

Bottom line, this stuff smells awful. At first I thought I got a bad sample, but I checked other reviews and it just really is an awful smelling product. On to the pros...this absorbs quickly and it did tingle a bit but my skin did feel hydrated for some time. Would I purchase again, absolutely not because the scent lingered.

I keep trying this brand because I keep getting samples, and every one of their products smells like bad, stinky incense. This was also super goopy and felt like a mask even though it’s just a moisturizer. Pass.

I received a sample of this and was excited to try a Tata Harper moisturizer given the emphasis on natural ingredients. It’s not a thick moisturizer and does not not feel greasy at all when applied. It left my face feeling amazing and moisturizer throughout the day. The only downside, as others remarked, is the smell; it’s not pleasant for a face moisturizer and is quite noticeable after application. It’s not quite a chemical smell, it’s probably a combination of some of the different oils, but it just isn’t something you want to smell all day.  Unfortunately won’t be purchasing the full size because of the smell even though the moisturizer works well.

I seem to be on a skincare brigade recently (maybe it’s because I’m turning 36 next month). I got a sample of this and the smell is overwhelming and it’s an average moisturizer at best. Definitely not worth the full price point in my opinion!!
Got this sample and I’m in love with it. Going to have to purchase it soon. Very moisturizing and makes my makeup better. The smell is strong but it smells like roses.
I really wanted to like this but the smell is way to powerful almost a strong chemical smell
This facial moisturizer is nothing special. It smells ok. It dries quickly. Doesn’t leave any visual or tangible residue. My skin felt a little tight afterwards, but nothing uncomfortable.

The smell is so so terrible i wanted to rip my face off it smelled ALL DAY. On top of that it dried out my oily skin and made my skin flakey!! This is not a good product. Thank god it was only a sample because I had to throw it away before finishing it. Not worth the value, not worth your time.

Got this as a sample--I love the ingredient list and although the scent is overpowering, it is not irritating at all. Seems pricey for what it is but I’ll finish my current moisturizer while thinking about getting this one...or wait for something better value to come along.

Because of the natural ingredients, I wanted to like this moisturizer. It is not moisturizing and does nothing for my dry skin. I would only recommend it to someone that has oily skin.
Love this thing. absorbs nicely and is not greasy at all.

I just feel like this moisturizer is very mediocre. For the price and claims I expected something special, but it’s a very run-of-the-mill moisturizer (with a heavy, herb/floral scent). I would advise people to skip it, and invest in something that may actually have an effect on your skin.
my skin felt dry after I used the product. i love the smell and i love tata harper products but this one was not great for dryish middle aged skin. i wanted the product to feel richer going on.
I was excited to try this organic moisturizer, however it left my skin very dry. My fine lines were more visible after using also. Would not buy this product again.

Love this product - I’ve been using it with the Rejuvenating Serum for the past month and I’ve had the best skin of my life thus far.  I didn’t care for the smell at first (very heavy flowery) but I got used to it in a couple days.  I like that the products are natural.

I also broke out on my forehead (again, pregnancy hormones are likely the culprit), but it could also be from my skin not being moisturized enough with this.
Loved it but could not continue to repurchase due to the price.  Knocked off a star because of this. Absorbed quickly and made me skin feel hydrated but not greasy.
Love this lotion.. Smells amazing, feels great, not heavy but hydrates well

Smells of chamomile and other flowers. My skin is noticeably different. No more redness or irritation. I exfoliate less now since my skin feels fresh, smooth, and moisturized because of this product. It goes a long way, one to two little pumps covers the neck and face. I’m hesitant to buy anything else now! I really love this and plan on investing in another bottle. I may try the cleanser, too!

I did not like this moisturizer at all. It didn’t feel like it fully absorbed into my skin, and somehow it made my pores look even bigger! My skin felt so gross I had to wash it off after a while, I just couldn’t take how greasy my skin felt.
This is not a very moisturizing moisturizer. It is not for dry skin. Must apply heavy serum or oil beneath it to stay moisturized throughout the day. However, it is lightweight and absorbs quickly.

I received a deluxe sample of this in a subscription box and absolutely loved it, so I decided to buy the full size. It’s very lightweight and sinks into my skin quickly, leaving it soft and hydrated. My only issue is that its so expensive. Almost ridiculously expensive. Although it’s a great product and has good ingredients I don’t think I’ll repurchase.

Goes on very light, but effective for my dry skin in winter. I have rosacea and had to stop using all of my prescriptions with my pregnancy. My skin was in terrible condition, but has gone back to almost normal with the Tata line, including this product. I’m so grateful.
I use this product along with the cleanser and it is amazing. My oil is under control and my pours have very much minimized. I also bought the sample kit for traveling purposes.

I love this lotion! It smells so so good and feels great on my skin. I have fairly dry skin and live in a dry climate. If anything, I wish it was a bit heavier and a bit thicker for the winter months, but it is awesome during the summer.Its expensive, but keep in mind that it is made of completely natural ingredients, all grown on TATA’s own farm. I can’t stress how important this is to be using real plant extracts on your skin rather than chemicals. I love

Finally a line that is as natural as it gets. This is the first moisturizer I’ve tried in a long time that has not burned my skin when I apply it. It is a little pricey but my priority is to keep as many chemicals as possible off my skin so the investment is worth it.

I really had high hopes for this product, as I’ve read rave reviews about all things Tata Harper. This is my first TH purchase and not cheap, so I expected great results. I would classify this as a very light moisturizer with a fresh scent. It’s very thin and not super moisturizing - not what I’d expect for “dry, mature skin“. My skin feels dry after I apply this lotion, and I see no improvement at all - it’s been about 3 weeks. Disappointing.
Lovely scent. Smells kind of limes, I think? I chose this brand because I appreciate how they use all natural ingredients. Although it is pricey, I find that a little goes a long way with this one.

This moisturizer is not only SAFE AND HEALTHY to use but it does its job!!! There is no need for carcinogenic ingredients in any makeup or skincare products and Tata Harper proves it. Yes, it is expensive and I was reluctant to buy at first, but you only need one squirt of it and it lasted me 6 months! Try it out for 2 weeks and let your skin get used to having natural organic ingredients on it and you will not regret the purchase!

So I just bought this moisturizer the other day, and while I can’t speak in terms of long term effectiveness, I will say that the immediate results are amazing. My skin is honestly glowing, and it just seems so happy to have an all-natural product hydrating it. It’s incredibly hydrating and works as a good base under makeup - no balling when rubbed or slippage at all throughout the day. I also saw that a lot of people have commented about the smell...if you’re wondering and maybe this is closer for you to access, this product smells IDENTICAL to Lush’s Marilyn Hair Treatment...which people tend to either love or hate. This moisturizer is a lighter amount of smell than the Lush Marilyn, and has scents of chamomile and lemon...but the main scent seems to be rose. It actually smells very similar to the Fresh Rose Face Mask...just with a bit of a more herbal/citrusy undertones. Hope this helps!

I LOVE THIS STUFF. If you have rosacea this stuff is for you with the cleanser and the floral mist. I am telling you I use most of her line. It has helped me so much and I have tried other natural organic products that did work but this one deffinetly worth the money!!! It hydrates and doe not leave my face glossy like other oils do. It smells wonderful. i see a lot of people complaining of smell i think they are nuts this smell is like flowers very earthy and calming. Guess they like chemical smells. Awesome product !!!!
Great moisturizer doesn’t have that petroleum based feel - pricey but good investment

What a great moisturizer. Has a beautiful feel and I enjoy the scent- smells natural, why I bought the product in the first place. My 15 year old daughter who struggles with dry skin said this is the best she’s ever used. I will continue buying this product. Will be trying the serum when I run out of my current one.
This moisturizer is a good weight to wear at night in the colder months, but the smell is overpowering. It isn’t a chemical scent, but it’s still very strong.

I bought this product for myself as well as for my mother (she is in her 50’s).Pros: I find it to be very hydrating and moisturizing. I live in a cold and dry climate and my skin can get patchy at flakey during winter months. I used this moisturizer for two weeks now and it resolved my dry skin issues. It absorbs very fast and goes nicely under make up.Cons: This products smells HORRIBLE and very strong. My boyfriend, my mother husband, and my dogs hate it. It makes my dogs sneeze if they come to close proximity of my face. It did not break me out, but sometimes my face feels a little itchy after application.Overall: I did notice major hydration improvement with my skin; my mother also likes the way her skin looks after using this. She did not notice much change in her wrinkles, but she has not been using it long enough. I’m not sure if I would repurchase as the price point is so high, it smells like herbal medicine and occasionally makes my face itchy. However this moisturizer did make my skin feel hydrated and I no longer have dry patches.

I was really appealed to this lotion because it’s all natural. My initial impression was that it smelled nice and felt nice on my skin. I live in Denver, where it’s very dry. After about a week I started noticing my skin feeling really dry later in the day. I took a trip to the mountains and this lotion just did not hold up. It provided no protective barrier for my skin and it ended up cracking. I plan on returning it. I think if you live in a humid climate it would be quite nice, but if you live in a dry climate or are dealing with harsh winters definitely don’t get this! It just won’t protect your skin from even moderately harsh conditions

As with all of Tata Harper’s products this scented moisturizer is not for those who are scent sensitive. It’s exactly what I was looking for: a clean line (1-2 on EWG scale), cruelty free, and has hyaluronic acid. I’ve read that hyaluronic acid is good for dry and dehydrated skin (which I have) and one pump over the serum does the trick. It’s moisturizing without being greasy and leaves a somewhat matte finish once it has absorbed. Very pleased.

I had a terrible allergic reaction to a product and needed a moisturizer that wouldn’t cause any additional damage. A salesperson recommended this to me and I still use it every night! It makes my skin feel soft, and makes me feel like my face is still clean when I wake up.The only downside for me is that it has a very vibrant fruity scent which isn’t the most relaxing thing to put on right before going to sleep.

I’ve been looking for skin products that are made with natural ingredients and I think I’ve finally found the moisturizer that I’ve been looking for! I tried this product out along with the rejuvenating serum and I’m really impressed with how well & long it moisturized my skin despite not feeling really ’rich’ compared with other products I’ve used in the past. It’s really light and absorbs very nicely. I have small pores in areas of my face so I tend to get clogged pores resulting in little bumps but this product doesn’t seem to cause any issues after about 5 days of use. It has a really lovely lavender/spa-like smell that I love. It’s like aroma therapy! I only held back from the 5th star because I haven’t used it for that long so hopefully all of this works out long term.

I have extremely dry skin - only have approx 8% hydration. Tried every cream imaginable including cream my dermatologist recommended and NOTHING compares. I use it on my face and neck and have noticed that the elasticity on my neck has visually improved. I cant say enough about this product, absorbs, smells very similar to Dr Hauschka, love the glass bottle (they need to improve the pump though-product escapes from the sides), feel moisturized all day and never greasy. Definitely for dry skin types
overpriced, and not moisturizing enough. I usually have to put another moisturizer on top. It also smells faintly like a bathroom airspray.

I have very fair skin and have found that hydration actually gets rid of my breakouts. Moisturizers for combination skin don’t do enough and every other cream I tried for dry or sensitive skin was too thick. This one is perfect. A little bit goes a long way and it smells AMAZING!
The smell is awesome , the texture on top of the serum is awesome In all just an awesome product

I am a fan of this moisturizer. I love natural Jasmine, which is the essential oil in this, and love that it is 100% natural and free from silicone which seems to cause breakouts for me. I spray a rose floral water, then apply this while my face is still moist and it absorbs really well.

I was looking forward to using this product, but have been disappointed from the get go.The packaging was mediocre, and for a company which promotes eco-friendliness, there was certainly a lot of paper/card packaging.The directions suggested a one pump use for the face, I needed three to four for my face, neck and décolleté. The spread of the product is not very good at all, hence the need to use a couple more pumps than is suggested. Moreover, the product does not absorb at all. It just sort of sits on my skin. I realize this is a natural product, but the ingredients don’t seem to read that way. Having said that, the product absolutely stinks. I haven’t figured it out, but it smells something like a gas station, or some sort of bleach or something, just bad. The smell just lingers. On top of that, this moisturizer has just caused my skin to be nothing but itchy, I have seen red patches and tiny white bumps. I am returning this product asap, because as soon as I stopped using it and reverted back to my regular routine, my complexion came back.

I got a sample by a Sephora sales person, who prognosticated to me that i will have rosacea because i have few broken capillaries barely noticeable in my face. Broken capillaries doesn’t mean i will have rosacea, that can happens because of too much sun, age, etc. I am 48 yrs old with a very good skin / no fillers, no surgery, all natural. I use Tarte Maracuja oil in the morning and works wonders. I will keep use Tarte Maracuja oil, since is a better product than this. See picture attached of my skin. I am wearing: Tarte Maracuja Oil, Tarte Concealer (light), Korres Wild Rose powder (medium beige ), Urban decay cream blush in QUICKIE and Borghese State of the art mascara. Tata Harper Repairative Moisturizer do nothing for me, but makes my face shiny and oily like if i was sweating. Kind of sticky. Overpriced.

Bobbi Brown, Clinique, Dior, Lancome, Lauder, ole henrikson, origins etc... and nothing compares to this line.. it is pricy but you only need a pea size a bottle lasts me 6 mos or so.. i use this am and josie maran argan in the pm.. i have normal/dry skin and this works wonders!

review_text: I had my eyes on these bars for a while, but I have sensitive skin and didn’t want to drop a lot of money on the full size bars just yet. When a last minute work trip popped up, I decided to buy these travel size bars with their cute case. There were a lot of reviews complaining about the size being smaller than they thought - maybe forgot the word “travel“ is in the name? For me, they were the size that I expected and they fit nicely into my palm. I rub them with water to create lather and then put that on my skin - you don’t need so much of the product that you have to actually use the bar directly on your skin. Mine have lasted me over 2 months - using the white one in the morning and the brown exfoliating one in the evening. Shockingly, my skin loves them and I didn’t experience any acne flareups in the first few weeks, either! I also see a lot of people complaining about the price. Personally I think that, in relation to the cost of the other products this company produces, this set is fairly priced and you get a cute little reusable and long lasting case for a few dollars extra. Would absolutely recommend to people who are interested in trying out this brand and are ok with compromising to buy something less expensive even though they’re not getting as good of a value as buying the full size bars.

review_text: Skincare is such a journey. I have mid-30s fair, sensitive, and acne prone skin and have tried a number of products/brands in an attempt to get clear/pretty skin. I stumbled upon an article that recommended Drunk Elephant’s Baby Bar Duo and decided to try it. It’s been about a month now, and my skin is surprisingly clear! Like many other people, I use the white bar at night and the darker bar in the morning. It does dry my skin a little more than my liquid cleansers but I use some pretty strong moisturizers so it’s not been an issue. This was such a pleasant surprise. Here I was looking for something that I could use for a week long trip, and what I found is something that will now be my full-time skin-care routine. I look forward to seeing how my skin does over the next couple months and continue to see progress. I’m a Drunk Elephant convert!
