Why doesn’t anyone talk about this moisturizer??  I bought it on a whim when it was on sale and I’m loving it.  It has a medium consistency (not too thin and not too rich), is extremely hydrating and is fragrance free.  It layers well with my other products, sinks right in and my skin is plump and moisturized when I wake up.  I have combo dry skin that’s also ultra sensitive and reactive and I haven’t experienced any sort of irritation.  It’s actually helped to reduce some of the redness I deal with. In regards to packaging, I love that it comes in an airless pump which is much more sanitary than a jar that exposes a product to the air each time it’s opened. I’ve been loyal to the Belif Moisture Bomb for years but this has replaced it.  I know people don’t like to buy skincare from makeup brands and vice-versa, but it’s clear that Tarte has hired some talented formulators as they have additional skincare products that also have great reviews.  I can’t recommend this moisturizer enough and will definitely be repurchasing!

I really like this moisturizer, the cream itself is great, it is fragrance free, very emollient, and suitable for the most sensitive of skin. I really love it when I am using stronger retinol products.The packaging is great, it is air-tight and gross germies from my hands don’t contaminate the cream. I am usually a drunk elephant lala retro girl, but this is a very close second to it, and a great cost effective replacement.
I really love this moisturizer. I’ve tried plenty on my dry flaky skin and this is a top contender as it’s super moisturizing and sinks beautifully into my skin. Highly recommend.

I was looking for a moisturizer that was a bit thicker and great for those cold winter days...after watching a video on YouTube from my favorite beauty guru, No BS Beauty, I decided to give this a try. It has a thick texture but still feels somewhat lightweight when applied. It is great for helping my dry skin on those cold winter days and nights. Does not have any noticeable fragrance and does a great job of keeping your skin hydrated. It does leave a bit of a “dewy” look on skin and can feel very MILDLY oily but for someone with dry skin, it did not bother me at all. Plays well with other products too! I use it after my FAB retinol serum and it keeps my face from drying too much during the night.

I really really really wanted this to work. I think for the most part it is gentle enough for sensitive skin but it is fairly greasy and does not sit well under makeup. My husband also asked my why my face was so sticky lol. I would not repurchase.

This has become my go-to nighttime moisturizer, and the amazing part is that I can use it all year. its thick enough for the dry winter months and yet still light enough for summer use. I have dry sensitive skin and this is amazing! Leaves skin balanced and rubs in nicely, its easily one of my favorite products!

I absolutely love this vegan moisturizer. It is very rich and I love the packaging it comes in. Contrary to other reviews, the product goes all the way down inside the inner pot and is 50 ml of product like most moisturizers. Give it I try, you won’t be disappointed.

I was looking for a night time moisturizer that had these qualities:-deep hydration for dry skin in the winter-fragrance free, no potentially irritating essential oils-airless container (preserves ingredients but also don’t want to stick my hands in there)this one not only checks all the boxes but has super cute packaging as well! also more affordable than drunk elephant moisturizers, which also check the boxes but are a splurge. but this deserves just as much hype!

I have very dry and sensitive skin so I am very picky with face moisturizers but this one is above and beyond what I imagined. it is a little thicker than I imagined and when I saw the consistency initially I thought it would be too greasy but it turns out it’s the best moisturizer I’ve ever used. I got a tarte serum to use with it as well in case it wasn’t hydrating enough but I haven’t even tried the serum yet because this is just so good. skin looks great and it’s never felt better to the touch
Very rich and moisturizing! Will definitely buy again. I have very dry skin normally and was using the tatcha moisturizer and decided to try this one as a cheaper alternative - it did not disappoint!
Amazing moisturizer. A little goes a long way! Makes your skin firm & plump with great absorbency.

Left skin feeling greasy (doesn’t absorb fast/great) and the jar is very misleading for how much product you would think you’re getting. The jar itself created so much waste from the outer layer of plastic, inner layer (where there isn’t even any product), and the purple lid (where the actual product is). 3 stars because I loved the pump top and not having to stick my fingers into the jar.
review_title: Greasy skin and lots of waste

review_text: I saw a review that says the packaging is deceiving because there’s nothing in the cup. That’s not right. Because it’s a pump when the product is full the cup is “full” but it’s inside the frosted part, as you pump the cream gets pushed up and therefore the frosted plastic moves up. The photo shown is web  the product is almost empty making the cup look empty. Not that I cleared that up, this moisturizer is amazing and plumps, hydrates and leaves my skin looking bouncy and fresh, I have sensitive skin with dry patches. I love this cream!
Great product, however the packaging is very misleading. I was so disappointed that the purple top part is all the product you get. THERES NOTHING INSIDE THE ACTUAL CUP! Waste of plastic and $$

Love! It’s thick enough to make my skin feel moisturized in winter, but the pump dispenser is what really sets this apart from other heavy moisturizers. It’s so nice not to have to dip your fingers into a tub.

I have such sensitive skin and honestly I am so nervous to try anything new. I have had such luck with every Tarte product I have tried. While I don’t like every single item, I haven’t had any cystic acne breakouts as a result of their product line. The Baba Bomb moisturizer is super hydrating, lightweight and leaves my skin feeling fresh. I use a tinted suncreen from EltaMD in the daytime as my makeup base and I use Baba after I deep clean my face before bed. It helps to reduce redness, and leaves my skin looking dewey and refreshed. I was specifically looking for a moisturizer that had hyaluronic acid and this one contains sodium hyaluronate which mimics hyaluronic acid that you naturally produce in your skin. Im highly impressed. I will keep Baba in my skin care regimen forever. Its so non irritating and proved to be safe for my sensitive skin!
review_title: SO rich and moisturizing, Safe for Sensitive Skin!

review_text: This didn’t feel as moisturizing as other moisturizers I’ve used this product for about a month and it’s ok. Nothing wowed me. The automatic pump is a great idea, but I felt like it gave me too much for my face and i could never pump less.

I can’t say enough about this moisturizer, it’s amazing. I was using  lala whipped from another brand which is also every bit as amazing no question but much more expensive. If you want the amazing results for less money, this is your bet.

I have really sensitive skin and have been trying to find a good moisturizer for a while. I love this one it’s super creamy and a little bit goes a long way which is grey because then it will last a while. Highly recommend

I grew up in Chicago and moved to Denver 5 years ago. It has taken me almost 5 years to find a moisturizer that works for my dry, sensitive skin. This stuff is the bees knees! It hydrates and absorbs nicely. No scent, which I think is key in any moisturizer. It’s just glorious.

I like thick moisturizers and this fits the bill. I use it at night because I feel like it would be too moisturizing for day or under makeup. It feels like a blend of a moisturizer and a facial oil. Very luxurious. Highly recommend.

My skin loves this product. I was having issue with dry flaky skin and this feels so moisturizing all day. Love that it only dispenses what you need for each application. I’ve been using it for the past 4 months and still haven’t run out. Love it!

I actually really like the moisturizer, it’s very hydrating and thick but doesn’t break me out and does not irritate my skin. However I will not be repurchasing because of the packaging. It’s basically a jar of thick plastic inside another jar of even thicker plastic. The amount of waste accumulated from 50mL of product is insane and extremely wasteful which is why I won’t be repurchasing. Please put this in a simple tube or pump container so I don’t feel like I’m stabbing the planet everytime I use it!

Baba bomb vegan moisturizer has been clinically proven to keep skin hydrated for 24 hours. Formulated with babassu, avocado, and green tea! Yum!⁣Personally, this moisturizer left a bit of a greasy finish on my face that I did not like. Sephora advertises that this moisturizer is great for all skin types but, I disagree. I have combination skin and I definitely would not recommend this for oily types. I think this product would be best suited for dryer skin types or maybe to be used as a winter moisturizer. I do love, Love, LOVE how this product is plant powered however, this moisturizer is just not for me.

I really love this moisturizer; it is extremely hydrating all day long and it gives my skin a beautiful glowing complexion. I had received so many compliments on how my skin looks after using this. It can take a little longer to absorb, so I will put it on about 30 min before I have to leave the house and then just before I go, I will wash my hands and just give it one more rub it and then it’s perfect! It smells nice, the texture is soothing and nourishing on the skin. The ingredients are good quality and the dispenser is great for keeping the product sanitary. Only problem I have is that I cannot tell if I am almost out of product, so I am just guessing and when to purchase a new bottle. But other than that, I highly recommend this to anyone who has dry/combination skin like me and likes to looks of glowing, dewy skin.
review_title: One of my new favourite moisturizers!

review_text: So far so good.  Been using for almost a week & already notice a glowing difference.

I have no idea how this moisturizer only has 70 reviews... it’s almost flawless. It’s thick, rich and silky feeling, it leaves the skin moisturized for so long, the ingredients are great, the packing is great for keeping product sanitary and not degrading. Beyond happy with this purchase. I would recommend this to anyone who has dry skin or loves a rich moisturizer.

I looove this moisturizer!! I use it more as a night cream because of it’s thickness / watery consistency. It’s so hydrating!! I have combination / acne prone skin and I was having problems finding a cream that was hydrating enough without clogging my pores. It also feels so light and helps soothe the dry parts of my skin from all the other AHA/BHAs I’ve been using!! Love ittt this needs more reviews!!
Best face cream I’ve ever had, no smell, light, gives my skin perfect amount of moisture it needs. My favourite moisturizer from now on!
Absolutely love this cream! It’s not thick and heavy under your make up at all! Yet it’s extremely moisturizing!
review_title: Nice and light under your makeup!

review_text: I wanted to love this but it caused small breakouts and a small patch of dryness that I have never had happen before. 3 stars for the pump, and it being really nice feeling and keeping my skin soft and moisturized. I might be sensitive to something in the ingredients.

I recently purchased this moisturizer as part of the tarte custom kit sale and I kid you not, my skin is looking better than I’ve ever seen it before. I don’t know what else it could be, I haven’t added anything else that would make this much of a difference so quickly! I’m considering purchasing it again while it’s on sale at Sephora; I want a back-up so I don’t have to worry about it running out.There’s no fragrance, it applies like a rich, calming, deeply-penetrating balm, almost like you added a few drops of the most amazing facial oil to your favorite moisturizer. I can definitely tell this is doing something and is improving my skin, vs. just sitting on top of my skin yet not helping in any way. If you’re debating whether or not you should try it, snag it while it’s ~$15 off  - it’s SO worth it. Plus you get 1.7 oz (approximately) which is a pretty good deal for such a great product.
review_title: Glowing, plump skin? Thank you Baba Bomb!

review_text: Excellent for sensitive skin! I had severe stubborn breakouts from product sensitivity. This will not aggravate redness, irritation or worsen existing acne. Would highly recommend for those who have issues with fragrances in moisturizers.
omg just got this on a whim and i LOVE it, good mix between thick&light, does fine under makeup but also heavy enough for a night cream. i love it ! seems to be calming my skin too
A little goes a long way. I don’t even need to full pump it to have a decent amount. Beautiful packaging. It takes a bit long to fully absorb

I have acne prone skin that is typically oily but can also be dry. I have been on the hunt for a moisturizer that is hydrating but doesn’t break me out. This moisturizer is everything I’ve ever wanted, it’s hydrating and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. After I put it on it’s like my skin just drank a glass of water. It is a bit thick and it’s a bit too heavy for me to wear under makeup unless I give it some time to sink in. It works great as a night time moisturizer though! Overall, I could not be more pleased with this product (the packaging is a big plus as well because the pump makes it much more sanitary). I highly recommend!

I never write reviews this is my first one. I have dry sensitive acne prone skin. My face will breakout at the smallest thing. Especially fragrance. I’ve used so many moisturizers and this one is by far the BEST. Its creamy and thick but not greasy at all. it feels so good on and make up applies so good on top of this. Its made my acne so much better. Please never stop making this. I am in love. I was so un sure but so happy I ordered this. all of the other 5 start reviews were right!
review_title: PLS NEVER STOP MAKING THIS! AMAZING!

review_text: Pleasantly surprised! Never thought of Tarte for a good moisturizer but as someone with dry sensitive skin this has worked well for me the past month. Definitely smoother and less flaky for makeup. I would say it’s on the heavier side for application but you don’t need much and you just need to give it a bit to sink in. Especially nice for before bed.
Ew. This is so greasy feeling. Stuff was sticking to my face. Super slimy and gross
I like the moisturizer itself but the packaging made it so hard to tell when I was out/use at all. I love that Tarte is vegan and cruelty-free but was annoying to use

I have really dry skin, so when I first heard of this product, I got excited. But when I tried it, it was really drying for my skin. Although it was drying, it brightened my complexion. I don’t recommend it for those who have dry skin, but if you have normal or combination skin, this is definitely a good choice! It also has some good ingredients too!

This moisturizer is BOMB! First of all, I love the packaging. Since I don’t have to dip my finger in, I can ensure that every dollop of cream is clean/germ-free. The formula is really great too! It makes my skin nicely moisturized and supple. The affordable price is a plus. Definitely will buy again when I run out.

Writing this review after 3 weeks of Tarte mini moisturizer daily use on my face.  I got the mini to try an alternative moisturizer and to replace Drunk Elephant Lala Retro as I heard that this moisturizer could possibly replace expensive DE Lala moisturizer.  I am really sad to say that this didnt workout for me.  I got face acne and bumps using this moisturizer.  A few other reviews mentioned the same thing but I wanted to try it out myself.  Also, this moisturizer just sits on skin similar to what other reviews said, like you can the shiny moisturizer on face.  I’m sad but I thought Tarte being a clean skincare line would suit me as I like this brands face cleanser.  This moisturizer is thick, no such scent and doesnt pill under unscreen or makeup.  Sad that it didnt workout on my skin.
review_title: Didnt work for my sensitive, acne prone skin

review_text: I think this product contains too much silicone (dimethicone). It goes on very slippery so it momentarily feels moisturizing, but that’s just the silicone. It doesn’t keep the skin moisturized, and I have not seen any major improvements. 3 stars bc it goes well underneath dry sunscreens and doesn’t give me any breakouts.

I use this moisturizer at night, after I’ve cleaned my face. There’s no off-putting smell, tackiness, or pilling. My face still feels moisturized in the morning. I use it behind a hyaluronic acid serum, so keep in mind that my skin has already got extra moisture from the serum. However, the moisturizer is a great combo with the serum, as it doesn’t make my face feel sweaty, greasy, or wet (all of which could happen when applying a moisturizer that’s too slick or thin directly behind a serum) — just leaves my skin extra soft. I like that this moisturizer has a pump. You press down, and out pops a small dollop of cream. It’s nice to not have to put my fingers in anything, and it’s also nice to feel like I get the right amount every time. For the price, I feel like portion control is important.

I’m on my 2nd jar and this is my new go to!  I have super dry, super sensitive, acne-prone skin.  It’s super hard to find a moisturizer that fixes my dry skin without causing a ton of bumps.  I used to use the drunk elephant one, but my wallet wasn’t crazy about the price of that one, so decided to give this one a try.  Super happy I did!  It’s pretty thick, but doesn’t feel too heavy on skin and haven’t had extra breakouts or anything!  I would highly recommend this for girls with dry, sensitive skin!
I’ve just bought my third bottle. My skin really likes this product (and also my budget). I use it with other serums or oils depending of the need of my skin (during winter vs summer).

Wish all my moisturizes had packaging like this! Such a good creamy face lotion and great for people who have dry skin. I on the other hand have oily skin, so this isn’t my favorite, since it’s a bit much.... but on days I use chemical treatments, I use this and it plumps my skin right up.
Great moisturizer. I have very sensitive, dry skin.. this has been a game changer for my skin.

Bought the mini size several times because I travel way too much and I just wanted a small one, but I have officially committed to the full size. (I literally bought 4 mini sizes of this.) But I am in LOVE. The moisturizer I used before always made my face feel tight and firm in the worst type of way. I have combination skin, but more on the oily side of that makes sense.. once I started using this, I felt my face.. plump. ALSO since I am more on the oily side, be aware, this moisturizer could be dew on you. When I put it on it definitely gives me a dewy look, with and without make up. One pump is definitely enough for me, and if I have excess I just use it on my neck too. I definitely would recommend if you are wanting some serious hydration.Texture wise, it’s whipped and it will also feel thick and when you apply it on your face you’ll feel that thick consistency but you literally feel your skin getting moisturized. (obviously that means it’s doing it’s job.)

I’ve been only using this for a short amount of time.  I had a bunch of mini travel moisturizers that I was going through, and I decided to pick this up.  For the past few weeks, I haven’t enjoyed any moisturizer I was using. I could feel the cream on my skin, it would pill or even feel sticky a bit.I use this and right away, it soaked into my skin.  Did NOT feel sticky, or pilling, or anything.  I felt like my skin was hydrated but didn’t even feel anything I used.  I would say if you liked Drunk Elephant Protini, but it wasn’t moisturizing enough, and Lala Retro was too thick, this is a great happy medium!! It’s nice and creamy, but not too thick!! Super impressed with this and would repurchase.

I was using Cetaphil daily face moisturizer 2x a day and it wasn’t helping. I decided to try this product on my whole face 2x a day. Within 2 weeks my dry skin is gone and my makeup is laying so much better. Thank you Sophora consultants at the Lehigh Valley Mall in PA for recommending this amazing product!
review_title: Highly Recommend TARTE Baba Bomb Moisturizer

review_text: a little bit thicker than i usually would like, but overall does a great job!
It works amazing! Does leave your face a little greasy so I suggest using before bed

I have extremely dry skin and have tried tons of moisturizers/oils and nothing works as well as this for me. It’s nice and thick/creamy but doesn’t feel heavy once it melts into the ski. No more dry patches and my makeup goes ontop of it so smoothly. I’ve repurchased this several times now. My only complaint is the amount of product you get - if you take apart the packaging only about 1/4 of the container is actual product - size is a little misleading so might consider buying 2 sample sizes.

It’s easy to get observed and apply foundation after, the smell is very very light so overall a great cream. I have dry skin so barely try new things, but I got it on sale for $36. I have my specific routine cream but will repurchase when it’s on sale again.
review_title: good one to get on discount

review_text: I tried this out after using the DE Protini moisturizer, which was a little too light for my very dry skin. This is definitely a bit thicker and oilier. I mix it with a drop of The Ordinary hyalauronic acid in the am to thin it out so I don’t look shiny, and add a sunscreen on top. In the evening, I apply it as is or mix it with a drop of Fresh sea berry face oil if my skin is feeling tight or extra dry. I’m pregnant and my skin has been super sensitive and prone to breakouts. Before pregnancy I had like 3 pimples total my entire life. This lotion hasn’t triggered any breakouts or redness, and I’m very happy with the price. I’ve tried la mer, tatcha dewy cream, and de protini, and I like baba bomb better than any of them.
review_title: Great for the price, slightly greasy

review_text: I never write reviews...but Baba Bomb was so amazing. Initially I had thought it was too thick and heavy but after sleeping with it, it does sink in rather than just sit and slip off your face like oils do. I have noticed a significant difference in my skin and my skin barrier seems to have been quickly restored by this. Sometimes I’ll do a light oil/serum and use this on top to really lock everything in but that’s usually not necessary. If I use during the day time, I’ll mix it with other lotions or just add some to my SPF. I’m not a huge fan of the packaging (too much plastic) :( so hope they make some changes. This hasn’t broken me out like first aid beauty. This hasn’t caused a rash or reacted with my sensitive skin (skin so sensitive that Milky Jelly Cleanser *burned* my skin). This has healed me. Who knew Tarte had good skincare?!?!?
review_title: great for my sensitive, dry, acne prone skin!!!

review_text: This is a good moisturizer but not... great.  I wanted it to be a little more moisturizing or maybe make my skin softer.  The packaging is great.
Love this. Under rated. my skin has never looked better.

I’ve been using this moisturizer for approximately 2 months now. My skincare routine is horribly inconsistent so sometimes I use it in the morning only, and sometimes I use it both morning and night. I love the thick consistency. Some people may be deterred by that, but I find it soaks into the skin well. My foundation applies well over it. I am also prone to breakouts and acne, and often I get flare ups when changing moisturizers. For the first time in a long time I did not experience that. Also the packaging is super convenient, basically the same as drunk elephants protini polypeptide container.

Nice moisturizer, a bit heavy but not scented and works ok with BB SPF that I use.However - NOT buying again as packaging wasteful and deceptive.There is VERY little product compared to size of jar, and you are unable to see how much you have left as  jar is opaque and product dispensed with a pump. Basically amount of product is about the size of the lid. See photos - inside lid is where product is stored, the rest of the jar is emptySo wasteful, a ton of plastic to package a few tablespoons of moisturizer!
Does the job (moistures my skin), but didn’t think anything special...so probably no repeat.

This is a heavy duty, non-irritating moisturizer that hasn’t broken me out in a week of use. I wear it over treatments and serum in the morning, and over an exfoliant or retinol overnight. My skin looks much more moisturized, soft, and this has really helped with the dry skin and breakouts (possibly exacerbated by dry skin) that I’ve been struggling with this winter. Now that I’m using this, I can use my retinol every other night, alternating with glycolic acid, without dryness or irritation. My t-zone does get a little shiny after 8 hours, but nothing a little powder doesn’t fix. If your skin is oily, this is probably not for you. I wouldn’t use it during the humid summer. But for my dry skin in winter and cooler months, this is perfect.

I’ve never thought of Tarte as a skincare brand, but I was pleasantly surprised with this moisturizer. I bought it because Beautypedia gave it five stars and I tend to find their reviews trustworthy, especially since there aren’t many products that earn a five-star rating. I got this as a cheaper replacement for the Drunk Elephant Protini, and I like that the packaging is very similar. The airless pump protects the ingredients from breaking down after being exposed to oxygen, and from becoming a breeding ground for bacteria after dipping your fingers in it repeatedly. It has a rich, creamy consistency that makes it perfect as a night cream. As another reviewer said, it’s great for locking in your serums all night. I don’t use it as a day cream since the texture is so rich and it doesn’t have any SPF. It sinks in during the night and my skin always feels very soft when I wake up in the morning.

I agree with so many of the 5 star reviewers, the Baba Bomb is right up there with Drunk Elephant quality at a much lower price. I adore DE’s LaLa Retro Whipped Moisturizer and pretty much use every night mixed with a few drops of Marula oil. The Baba Bomb is the equivalent, BUT it’s so perfect for daytime rather than night. It looks gorgeous under makeup, and really helps keep my skin moisturized and adds a nice glow. Baba is not too thick, not too oily, but moisturizes so well. This is the perfect concoction of ingredients! I much prefer the Baba Bomb over DE’s Protini, which tends to leave my skin dry wanting more moisture. So impressed with Tarte’s skincare. Love the packaging and airtight pump too. Their Vitamin C Serum is also amazing! 42 with combination to dry skin.

Almost no smell, vegan, supeeer hydrating and leaves a nice glow on my face. Would advice to those who have dry/normal skin and like a dewy look. Wouldn’t advice to those with greasy skin and who prefer a matte look.

So in love with this. It’s not thick or whipped consistency but, is very emollient. It spreads easily and little product is needed to effectively cover and moisturize. This imo is probably better for dry skin due to how emollient this feels. Almost feels like a facial oil after it’s on to me. Beautiful ingredients and a really great price for a nice nighttime cream to lock in all my serums. I love the delivery system with the pump jar.
I have dry, sensitive skin and this is one of my favorite moisturizers! It feels great on my skin and I can tell the difference with this one compared to others; and I also love the packaging!
J’ai une peau très réactive et après seulement quelques utilisations, ma peau était apaisée et mes rougeurs diminuées!

Love this moisturizer! I think I finally found something that will work for me this winter. I struggle every year to find one that’s not to heavy but has enough kick to help keep my skin balanced. So far so good because I’m loving this!

I prefer this product to Drunk Elephant’s Protini cream, as I need more hydration than it provides, at least during the colder months. This is not as heavy as DE’s Lala Retro cream, perfect for daytime. I have no dry patches surfacing during the day as yet. Baba Bomb prepares my skin superbly for foundation; it allows a smooth and even application. I am very happy with this unscented cream in an airless jar. It ticks all the boxes for me and I highly recommend it.
Too thick for my skin it didn’t completely absorb and gave me small breakouts, will use the rest around my eyes and on my neck

This just wasn’t for me. The formula is nice and overall I like the clean ingredients in this product, but it is so greasy, my skin doesn’t seem to absorb half of it. That may have something to do with the avocado oil (Tarte should have known better). I would only recommend this moisturizer for very dry skin, especially during those colder winter months. If not, better stay away from this product as it may not only feel quite heavy but also make your skin break out.
Perfect for winter months and dry environments.Rich without being greasy. A little bit goes a long way. And the price is right!

The best thing about baba bomb is the packaging/container. It’s very easy to push down to get the right amount of moisturizer. BUT...it’s very thick and doesn’t penetrate very deep into the skin. I feel like it should be absorbing way more and with better results. It Cosmetics secret sauce works better for my skin.
I’ve switched to this moisturizer for day time now that cold weather is in full swing. It feels so nice and absorbs quick. My skin stays hydrated all day.
moisturising but this feels so greasy and heavy - it makes me feel icky. I prefer lightweight moisturisers.

I love this moisturizer. It compares favorably with SkinMedica’s Derma Repair Cream at a fraction of the cost. The packaging is appropriate and keeps air and germs out of the cream. Very moisturizing for my dry-as-dust, irritable skin.

Love this stuff! Been using these for about a couple weeks now and I absolutely love the moisture and hydration this gives me! A little goes a long way because it’s that hydrating! The first couple times I used it I needed 2 pumps. After a couple days I just needed 1, now after a couple weeks, I can use half a pump!  Will repurchase! Amazing for dry skin!
I love the way this moisturizer feels on my skin, it hydrates my dehydrated skin without feeling heavy!

I have fairly dry skin and sometimes I need a bit of a boost especially after exfoliating. I use this in combination with the Tarte drink of H2O hydrating boost moisturizer. The gel is nice for everyday and then when I need something a bit more hydrating I use this. I LOVE how it’s not thick but still feels like its packing more moisture than the gel.

I have normal skin that leans a tad combo in summer. I was trying this to replace my $60 Origins night cream. I love the feeling..it’s very thick and moisturizing. I also really wanted to love it for the packaging (the pump up like Drunk Elephants protini). However, it broke me out with small whiteheads all over. They were so small I almost didn’t think it was causing it but once I stopped my skin cleared.

review_text: This is the only sunscreen I don’t mind wearing! I have very oily skin, but can have a little surface dryness/peeling occasionally from using tretinoin (if you use retinoids you understand this weird combo). It’s all mineral, so it’s good for sensitive and acne prone skin. Chemical sunscreens always sting my eyes (another reason I like mineral better), and I can put this all over my eyelids no problem. It has no other comedogenic ingredients and was approved by my derm for me to use - I’m acne prone and this has not broken me out! It’s fragrance free, but has a slight sunscreeny ingredient smell, nothing strong or lingering though. It has a light silicone/moisturizer slip feeling while applying, and is very easy to spread evenly with no pilling. I wear a gel moisturizer under it. On me, it felt a little drying when I wore it alone, but when I wear a gel under it, it’s just slightly oil controlling. Dries down to a satin skin like finish with a slight blurring effect and a little tiny bit of tack to it (I’m very oily so I hate the feeling of anything greasy or sticky, and this does not bother me), and it works great under makeup! No white cast on me, but I have a neutral fair-light complexion and the tint matches me well. The tint is not warm or orangey like a lot of tinted sunscreens, it’s more neutral maybe leaning pink. I have a feeling the tint would look too pink or white casty on dark skin, but cannot speak from experience. The tint does transfer off a little onto clothes if you rub against it, but that may depend on how oily you are, I’m very oily so everything transfers on me unless I’m freshly powdered. I combat that by using a different clear chemical body sunscreen on my neck instead of bringing this down my neck. I’m confused that there are bad reviews from people saying they have dry skin and this isn’t moisturizing enough... it literally says for normal to oily skin and matte finish on the product page and the product itself?

review_text: I always used the whitestrips with pretty good results, but in between my teeth were always still kind of yellow because the strips wouldn’t reach there. I was never that impressed with the original essence and this is really no different. These are very over priced skincare products with very subpar payoff. They smell wonderful, they moisturize. However, so do many other products that cost a fraction of what these do. I’m sorry, but if you’re buying this for any other reason than a boujee purchase you’re a fool.

Smells Good, Feels Good but the only difference I noticed is that after use, my skin is EXTRA oily for two days. I have combination skin and if I put this on during my bedtime routine, wash my face in the morning, and apply my usual primer, makeup, etc. I have to use 5-7 clean&clear oil sheets throughout the day whereas I usually would use 1 mid day. It’s pretty gross, my makeup just melts off throughout the day for a couple days after use. Gave two stars for smell, feel and packaging but just can’t use.
After keeping using it for 3 months, I can see some changes and improvements. It can not let your skin be whiter than your whitest part of the body. But it can brighten your face gradually.

Very nice product but expensive. I am in my late 20s and have non-sensitive combination skin. I got this product to prevent the formation of dark spots. I used Shiseido whitening line for years. This product is more aggressive than Shiseido whitening serum, which means you can see a huge difference within just one week! It doesn’t cause any irritation for me. If you are concerned about ingredients, this product may not be suitable for sensitive skin. In addition, this product might cause the feeling of dryness so that you should use cream or lotion after using it.
review_title: Quick whitening effect in just one week

review_text: I have been using the product for well over a year. It really does work, the sad truth that only expensive products work (with the notable exception of Jack Black). I have incredibly oily skin so I skip the serum in the summer and use only the Essence but I use this serum every day in the winter. As soon as you apply it a slightly shiny sheen appears, your skin actually glows a bit and without makeup my face does look a little oily but as soon as I apply my BB cream my face looks really good. It certainly works but my suggestion is to apply it as needed based on your skin type.
review_title: This serum works great if you apply it correctly.

review_text: I have dry skin and after using the kvd foundation it became dull and more problematic no matter how much I exfoliated or tried to treat it. I used the free sample I got and within 2 uses it restored my skin’s vitality and it made it velvety soft with a non-oily glow! I knew SK-II was good but I was skeptical of just the essence since I usually need heavy duty facial moisturizers but I didn’t even put on the night cream, and still woke up with beautiful supple and soft skin.

If you put some of this serum on the palm of your hand and rub it into your palm it shimmers like it has teeny tiny crystals in it. Imagine Edward Cullen’s face in Twilight when he’s in the direct sunlight - putting this on your face is kind of a toned down version of that look because basically you’re spreading teeny tiny light reflecting pieces of glitter on your face. I’m pretty sure most of the magic of this product is in the way the light reflects off these tiny specks of glitter and makes your face shine/radiate. So far, one week in, I haven’t seen any skin deep results where it’s cleared out any old sunspots or dark areas, it feels like it’s mostly a party trick with the glitter in the serum. If you have oily skin this might make your skin look a bit shinier because of the glitter in the serum. I will continue to use because I think if I use it minimally it can work well as a highlighter. The dropper applicator is also kind of weird because it’s just not the easiest thing to use and I’m concerned that I’m gonna be wasting a lot of product when I get to the end of it. I’m not sure if I will purchase this again, it will depend mostly on how my dark spots look when I’m done with the bottle.
review_title: Great if you want to look like Edward Cullen

review_text: I’ve recently got into the k-beauty craze and this is my HG product. I have had it in my “likes” for years and recently pulled the trigger to purchase. All I have to say is WOW. I have combination skin that is acne prone and prone to redness and has hyperpigmentation from acne scars. Ever since I started using this, it has evened my skin tone out so much and my skin has never looked so radiant. It seems my skins tendency for redness is diminished too. The price is steep but i don’t even use a full dropper of product to cover my face and would expect the bottle to last at least 6 months. I was confused and thought this was an essence, but it is definitely a serum. For all the k-beauty addicts, I definitely suggest using a snail cream with it. :)

This year I can really see that my skin is aging as a new sun spot started forming near the corner of my eye. I decided to purchase this serum since my skin have developed a lot of sun spots over the year. Within 2 weeks the new sun spot is completely gone. I don’t see any effect on the old sun spots though. I will continue buying this product.

Yeah... so I wasn’t as impressed as some of the reviewers on here. I tried a sample that lasted me almost one week. The serum is creamy but lightweight. It goes on smoothly and a small amount of product can cover the entire face, neck and décolletage. I did like the way my face looked when I put on the serum but I honestly didn’t think it did anything to my skin; it’s just that it has an iridescence to it and whatever shimmery particles are in it, they make the skin look like it’s glowing. I can glow by mixing a little bit of shimmer cream or drops into my sunscreen and I don’t have to spend a ridiculous amount on a serum. It’s a good product but I’ve tried amazing ones for less 80 dollars or less. This one is not amazing, it’s just overpriced because of the brand name. No, thank you!
Not worth the money. This sat on my skin and pilled when I put my moisturizer on. Too heavy and didn’t leave me radiant or hydrated at all.

I bought this just to try and was slightly skeptical, but then I saw huge improvements in my skin in just a couple of uses. I think the more concentrated pitera has something to do with it. My skin became brighter, less pigmented and blotchy.This is a must-have for me now. I would slather it all over if I could since it also smells wonderful.
I love this essence. My face is brighter and smoother than it used to be. all the people around me compliment me that my skin looks really good. Definitely continue buying this one
I recently finished the entire bottle and didn’t really see any results at all, just 240$ poorer. The consistency was light and had a nice scent but I wouldn’t purchase again.
This is the most effective brightening product I have ever used. I have tried a lot... Even though it is expensive, but try it! You will see the difference.

I’ve been using SK-II Genoptics Aura Essence for four weeks now and my skin has never looked better. It hasn’t cleared up dark spots or freckles, but the redness in my face has vanished and I’ve found myself going without make up some days, which is huge!!! I also feel like my face is glowing!!!I use this product at night before my nightly moisturizer. It has a pleasant scent and absorbs quickly. I also only use about a dime size amount so this product will last for months! I haven’t even made a dent in it yet!! I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review.

I got the free product as part of a campaign for BzzAgent.I have been using it for the last 6 weeks.The pros are that the dropper makes it easy to dispense the product. There is no waste and an adequate amount is dispersed.I have noticed that my face feels brighter, and I have no new pigmentation although the old brown spots are still there.I have been complimented by my friends and am always asked if I have had a brightening facial.The product is easily absorbed and does not feel heavy or oily.There has been no breakouts and the product is incredibly light and is absorbed without problems.The fragrance is pleasing and not heavy or overwhelming.I will continue to use it after I run out of my free product, hoping that my old brown spots will be lighter.I think this product will be good for any type of skin and is good for preventing formation of new brown and pigmented spots.

SK-II GenOptics Aura Essence is a luxurious product from the packaging to the feeling on my skin. A little goes a long way. The product itself is lightweight and non greasy with a pleasant light scent. I felt it made my skin look brighter and more fresh after just a few uses, and it was easy to incorporate into my daily routine. My one wish is that it had SPF which is why a removed a star. I received this product for free as a member of BzzAgent in exchange for an honest review.

I have to say that I love the bottle and the dropper. They look great on my counter. But mainly I love the fact that my skin feels better. I live in FL and the sun often makes my skin feel older than it really is. And with the dropper I never use too much, which was often the case with other moisturizers that I use. ** I did receive this as a free product from the brand as part of the promotion, but I chose to add this review here on my own.**

I have been using this for a little over a month now. amd the jury is in: although I wouldn’t call it a miracle worker and think it IS pretty pricey at $200+, I must say that it has helped reduce redness and even out my skintone in several key areas of my face (primarily my cheeks), and I do notice a dewy glow when I am made up. Now, I am an avid makeup consumer (and a smart one, I like to think) so I am skeptical of any wildly amazing claims, but if you approach this expectation that it is a serum, serums tend to be expensive, and this particular serum will help to reduce redness and even out skintone, I don’t think you will be disappointed, either. If you expect this to wipe out wrinkles, clear up acne, and make you breakfast....keep looking (and PLEASE: let me know when you find it!!) Note: I am 31, and have someshag sensitive skin (though less so than in my early 20s) and I break out mildly from time to time (mostly near my period) but this didn’t seem to contribute to any breakouts for me when used nightly in the quantity directed. Also important to note: I did recieve a bottle of this product to try at no cost from SK-II.

I’ve been using this for about a month now, and I’m really liking it. It feels really gentle, and I like the clean scent. It goes on very smoothly, and I do feel that my skin is brighter. I have freckles, so I’m not certain that it’s doing much to reduce their look, but I wouldn’t want it to! I do believe that it will last for a long time, which is worth it--a little certainly goes a long way! I’m really happy that SK-II sent me this product to try for free--I will be purchasing it in the future!

I received this product as part of a promotion from the brand and was so excited to try it. I have been using SK-II GenOptics Aura Essence for three weeks now. I have dry skin and was concerned about this drying it out. But it didn’t at all. It was the perfect amount of moisture for me. I am now in love with this stuff! First off, the packaging is so pretty! Second, the scent is AMAZING. The application is so easy! The dropper dispenses the perfect amount, a little goes a long way. I saw almost immediate results, about a day or two. But after three weeks, my skin is so smooth, has an even tone, and an amazing glow. I am in my mid 30’s and I wasn’t sure I would ever see a glow like this again. Love it!

SK-II unique formula is great to brighten and reduce age spots on my slightly sensitive, normal skin. The Pitera complex seems to be what makes the difference. I am Caucasian olive complexion, Mediterranean descent. 52, I don’t have extreme issues yet, but wanted to give this a try. I received SK-II Aura Essence product in exchange for my review. It is beautifully designed, very unique dropper. Simply beautiful, but the product does work. After a week my skin was more revived and brightened. Age spots on the back of hands were reduced greatly. Not inexpensive, so I will keep this as arsenal for my worst problem spots. If you want to lighten, this does work. My issue was age spots only, however radiance is always good!!

As someone with very oily skin, I found this to be way too heavy for me to use during the day, so I used this as a night treatment. If you have very dry skin, I think youd enjoy it.Id prefer this to be a tube since I was always afraid of dropping this on my bathroom tile and having it break.
review_title: Great moisterizer for someone with dry skin

review_text: I love SK-II GenOptics Aura Essence.  The product is easy to apply and I started noticing results just a few days after I started using it.  the results were very subtle at first just a slightly more even skin tone, but after using it for three weeks I have noticed that the sun spots on my face have started to stand out less.  they are not gone but they are several shades lighter than before.  One of my friends even asked me if I had started using makeup.  I received this product for free from SK-II in exchange for my honest review.

I received this product for free from SK-ll. I have been using it for about 6 weeks now and I have seen absolutely no change in my skin. While I absolutely LOVE the packaging, scent and the moisturizing this product has failed me when I had really high hopes. When I first opened the package I was very impressed with the bottle and it’s appearance. The dropper gives you the exact amount needed for application...a little goes a long way. Everytime I used it I felt like I was being pampered at a spa. The scent is amazing!!! SK-ll has moisturized my skin tremendously but it unfortunately has not made any difference in my unwanted pigmentation from the sun :(

I have been using the GenOptics Aura Essence now for about three weeks and I like it. I recently turned 30 and I have become concerned with the brightness of my skin tone and this product addresses that concern for me. I also have some acne scarring but haven’t really noticed a change in that. It smells amazing and feels nice on your skin. It has a dropper inside the bottle, allowing for easy, controlled application. One dropper seems to rub into my face well. For the price tag, though, I’m not convinced that this is any sort of miracle product. I’m not expecting to see any lasting results and I won’t be investing in such an expensive serum to keep up the minimal effects! I received the product as part of a promotion from the brand.
review_title: Good Product, Not a Great Value.

review_text: I have been using the SK-II GenOptics Aura Essence that I received for free from SK-II for the last few weeks and I haven’t noticed a huge change in the appearance of my skin. I really have a problem with redness and some blemishes. It seems to have made them look a little lighter and it does make my skin feel extremely soft, but I can’t give it five stars because I didn’t see a huge change like I expected. I do have sensitive skin and I will say this product doesn’t cause any issues.

I received this product free to provide a review. The bottle is pretty, an iridescent pearly white color. The dropper is convenient to dispense just the right amount of product. The product is milky colored with a fresh scent that quickly disappaites. One dropper full is enough to do my face and neck. My skin type is normal but can occasionally be dry. The silky fluid glides over my skin and quickly absorbs. I have some reddish areas and it evens my skin tone like a primer. I have been using the product for 4 weeks nearly everyday. It leaves my skin with a healthy glow and tone. I don’t have any age spots so I can’t speak to its affect on fading them. Over all I liked the product.

I received this product for free from SK-II for my honest opinion and I’ve been using the SK-II GenOptics Aura Essence Serum for several weeks now. Don’t expect to see results overnight, I’ve seen benefits but it has taken some time. I have freckles and other imperfections and I’ve used otherbrightening serums before which lighten my freckles and create white spots, this serum is not harsh and gently brightens. I have been using it at night on a freshly washed face under my night cream daily. The dropper makes it easy to dispense but I found if I use the entire dropperful it is too much product. If I dispense the entire dropper I have enough for my face, neck, and chest. It spreads smoothly and I don’t find it to have much of a smell. The packaging of the bottle is sleek as well and looks great on the counter. The product unfortunately hasn’t made too much more of an improvement from week 3 to week 5. I was hoping for more results. My skin still looks radiant but I don’t feel like it is an overwhelming difference from a few weeks ago. After daily use for 5 weeks I still have plenty left in the bottle. It does last a long time since the pre-measured dropped only dispenses so much each time.

I would love to give this a better rating, but I just haven’t seen the results that other people are seeing.  I’ll start with the pros.It smells great.  It goes on light and you don’t need much.I did not break out.My skin feels very soft after use.There seems to be a lot in the bottle and you don’t need to use a full dropper.Now the cons.First of all, the cost is outrageous.  I might feel differently if it had made a difference in my dark spots, but it didn’t.It didn’t fade my dark circles under my eyes, any facial scars or any other blemishes. I took before and after photos and I used the product night and day for three weeks.About me:I’m a Black 39 year old woman with minimal wrinkles and blemishes. It’s my opinion that the product did not make enough difference on my face for me to purchase this again.

When I was invited to try SK-II GenOptics Aura Essence I was caught by surprise, I have never heard about this product before and didn’t know what to expect but I was very excited for the opportunity.When I received the product my first impression was good, I like the bottle its heavy with holographic colors and the dropper is very useful because I only use the amount of product I need, the scent is light and fresh and works well if I want to use other products.I have been using the product every day for the past few weeks and I like the product itself, it’s easy to apply, its light on my skin that absorbs it almost instantly and I can see improvements. My skin has a nice glow, feels smooth and hydrated and my overall skin complexion looks even and healthy looking.I will definitely continue to use this product until the end, but probably won’t buy it just because I think it’s too pricey and there are other good options out there that are really good. But I would recommend it for someone who doesn’t have issues about spending money and wants a luxurious product that works.I received the product as part of a promotion from the brand.
review_title: Genoptics Aura Essence Very Nice Product

review_text: The product is a great moisturizer. I use it every morning. I can not tell that it has done anything for my fine lines or wrinkles over the past 4 weeks that I have been using it. It has a great smell and goes on smooth. My make up goes on well over it with no issues of creasing. I would recommend it as a moisturizer but not for fine lines and wrinkles. I would not purchase it because it is too expensive not to do what it is suppose to do. I received this product at no cost to review from SK-II.

I received a bottle for a review. I was surprised to see how much it was worth at Sephora. I didn’t know what an aura essence was supposed to be, and there isn’t much in terms of description in the packaging. The packaging actually looks almost as though it’s trying too hard, so I was expecting a bit less when I tried it. I actually really liked how it feels on my skin. It feels like a serum that moisturizes. I love that it absorbs fully pretty quickly and there’s an instant suppleness you can feel on the skin. I’ve been using it a few weeks now, and at night I add a night cream on top because I like extra overnight. I do like how it doesn’t feel heavy during the day though. I use a lot less than in the directions because a full dropper full is a lot of product. I’m not sure how much it does for reducing my hidden spots, but it does feel like my skin is happier after applying it. (It doesn’t feel like product sitting on top of skin, but product that gets absorbed into the skin.)

I received this product complimentary from SK-II for my consideration. First, it has more of a serum like consistency, different from traditional essences. It has a soft floral scent that doesn’t bother me but I think may bother some. After using GenOptics Aura Essence for a month, I found that it lightened some of my visible spots. I think I may have put too much faith in this product. It promises to do A LOT but I’m not quite sure it meets all of the claims. I have combination skin that is in good condition. The essence did not make my skin oily. After using the product, my skin is very soft. I have some sun spots and want to keep my skin from looking dull. As for brightening, this product is effective. My skin looks brighter and more even. As for spots, not so much. I freckle very lightly and have seen little to no improvement in lightening already pretty light spots. I’m not sure if this essence would work better with other products from the SK II range. I think this is a good product for brightening but am not sure how well it really works on visible spots.
review_title: Lightens Visible Spots- Good for Luminous Skin

review_text: I received this product free from SK-II in return for an honest review. I wanted so much to love this product. I was excited to receive this, the package and serum bottle look and feel very expensive. Unfortunately this product was just not for me. The first thing that I could not get past was the scent. It smells like a perfume you’d smell on an elderly lady - so strong. My husband actually asked me to stop using it because he couldn’t stand the smell either. On top of a scent that was not pleasing, it made my skin break out. I stuck with for over a week twice a day but it was not improving my skin, it was making it worse. I would recommend trying for a sample or promotion before paying the hefty price for this product.
review_title: Not the right product for me

review_text: I received SK-II GenOptics Aura Essence as part of a trial, I tried it for 6 weeks weeks using it every day, which was hard because I really detested the scent, it reminded me of my grandmother’s old lotions from the 1970’s.  I allied it over and over to my face daily but it made my skin feel sticky and wanted to wash it as soon as it was applied, I had several days of breakouts during the use and did not see any difference in my skin except making it look extremely greasy.  I do like the bottle design and dropper, the bottle itself is very pretty.

I’ve used this product for about 7 weeks now and I haven’t noticed any long term differences in my skin (tone, texture, etc.) I like the way the product feels and how it glides on my skin and I do notice a glow immediately after putting it on. It is a great moisturizer as well but I wouldn’t recommend it to others as I didn’t see a noticeable difference, as stated above. I received this product free of charge.

I love how this makes my skin feel... so soft and I get a really nice glow. BUT... it makes me break out. And I’m breaking out in areas that I don’t usually break out in. If I do break out, it’s usually my chin... but I am getting break outs on my cheeks,... never has happened before! So as much as I love how this feels, this product is not for me. SK-II sent me this product for free to try.

I received this product free from SK-II to try and review. I have been using this product twice a day for the past 2 weeks. My first impression was that the chemical smell of this product is very off putting. My husband complained when I came to bed after applying it! My second impression was that the product is very heavy and greasy. I have very sensitive skin so I am very cautious when selecting products. I started with 1 drop for my face as directed, but this left me feeling very greasy. So I used the 1 drop for both my face and neck. This seemed to work ok for the first week, but then my face started breaking out, so I started rubbing the 1 drop into my hands, then applying to my face and neck, this seemed to help. After application, my skin was very shiny and not in a good way. Living in Florida and having naturally oily skin, that is the last thing I want, a greasy sheen look. I will not continue to use this product.

I received the SK-II GenOptics as part of a promotion. The bottle was beautiful. I have used this product as a part of my beauty routine for the past 2 weeks. There has been a noticeable difference in my sun spots as well as my overall complexion. There is a more even skin tone. The only downfall is the price. It is a little more expensive then I am comfortable spending on a facial product. However, it does work.

This product is very luxurious.  The bottle is iridescent, smooth, and feels heavy in your hand. I love the pump top to make dispensing easier.  The essence has a light, fresh scent.Unfortunately, this product broke me out.  I did not patch test this product.  I used it and after a few days, I had a lot of acne, including places I don’t normally get acne.  I thought it might just be hormones and continued using the product.  Within a week, my skin was completely broken out.  It was not the product for me.  In between the acne, my skin looked great.  Without the acne, I would have kept using this product.  After doing a patch test, it appears I am allergic to this product.This product did not work out for me. However skin varies by individual and this product may be a game changer for you.  I would encourage you to try it.I received this product for free from SK-II in exchange for my honest opinion. Opinions are 100% my own.
review_title: Great product, but not for me

review_text: I received this product as part of a promotion from SK-II to sample so I wasn’t expecting much from it. At first, I thought of it as a great, light moisturizer. It has a nice light smell and is light on the skin. It is perfect to put on under my makeup each morning. At night I like to use it as a last step after cleaning my face. I love the dropper because it gives you the perfect amount and is fun to use. After a few weeks of using the product I noticed that some of my age spots had cleared up! I wasn’t even expecting this would happen so was totally excited when I could no longer find the darker spots on my skin. I probably wouldn’t pay this much for just a moisturizer but if you have any age spots or discoloration then I would highly recommend this product! My age/sun spots were getting me down and I feel so much better about my evenly colored skin again!

I have used SK-II GenOptics Aura Essence nightly, for almost 4 weeks. I wash my face, allow it to completely dry, and apply one drop full of SK-II GenOptics Aura Essence to the palm of my hand. I pat to distribute on my face, and spread it evenly. After the serum dries (which is pretty quick) I apply a thin layer of moisturizer to lock it in. I am not sure if the moisturizer step is necessary, but it does feel good. Honestly, I seen a difference after the first night of using this. When I woke up, my face had a dewy-soft glow, like I had just gotten a facial. Over the next few days my pores became smaller and much less noticeable. Now, almost a month into using this serum, friends/coworkers have noticed the improvements of my face. My pores have drastically improved, my dark spots have faded, and my skin is noticeably brighter. Because of the improvements in my skin tone, I am now comfortable with wearing a lighter-coverage foundation. My face looks fresh and healthy, which is due to using this serum and being able to scale down on my makeup coverage. The price is high. But, for me, no other product has delivered all the results I am seeing with this one luxurious serum. For me, this works just as the description says it does. Extra notes: The bottle is pretty, but heavy. I wish the bottle was clear or had some sort of level gauge/level window. I wish the package had more direction/ instructions/recommendations on how and when to use.I dropper/cap combo is awesome, it provides me with just enough and I never feel like I am wasting any product. The smell is very light and very nice, to me it smells like a spa/yoga room. The serum is a tad thicker than I expected, but in a good way. It’s consistency makes it easy to apply and cover your face… If feels like it goes on with purpose.  About me: I am in my early 30’s with an olive skin tone. I have combination skin, oily t-zone, large pores, clogged pores, uneven texture, dark spots, red spots, and my derm legit told me that I have “mature skin for my age.” I blame genetics, not wearing the correct amount/level of sunscreen, and frequenting the tanning bed way too much in my teens and early 20s. This serum has noticeable improved my skin and I would recommend giving it a try. I received this product complimentary from SK-II, in exchange for my honest review.

I received this product from SK-II for free in exchange for my honest opinion and was very excited to try this highly-anticipated serum!  My initial impression was positive: the bottle is attractive, the dispenser pump is innovative and easy to use, and the serum is luxurious-feeling with a pleasant but not overly-strong scent.  The product goes onto my skin very smoothly and once it has a minute to soak in my skin feels soft and has a nice glow.  Unfortunately, after close to a month of daily use, I have not seen any overall improvement in the way my skin looks.  Conclusion: I will continue to use the rest of this bottle but will not be buying a 2nd one.  I can’t justify spending so much money on a product that doesn’t have a significant benefit for me.
review_title: Feels nice on skin, but no significant improvement

review_text: I been using this product for month now. I have very oily skin and was skeptical to use this . I was excepting much. but as I start using for religiously everyday I notice my skin felt so smooth also this product blends in skin very well. my skin felt hydrated all day. I use this as base for my makeup. and my makeup comes out very well. I did not notice any change in brightening my skin but all together this is very good product .

I’ve been using this for several weeks now. I wasn’t expecting much and I didn’t want to have a light face (I have a tan body, lol) so I was skeptical to say the least. I’m so excited to share that my face didn’t get lighter but it did get incredibly soft and smooth. This is a very expensive product for me - I usually use Lancome Geneifique and Visionairre which are expensive but this is worth it. I’ll be getting it. I also want to try the other products because I’d bet like everything they work even better in unison!
review_title: SK-II GenOptics Aura Essence is amazing!

review_text: I’ve been using this product for around 1 month. I haven’t seen any actual brightening to my skin but, my skin texture has vastly improved. I have combo skin and this doesn’t make me oily or break me out. If anything my oily T zone has also improved. There is a very light scent but, once applied you can’t notice it. My skin feels bouncy and hydrated. I received the product for free from SK-II for my honest opinion.

I was super excited to get this complimentary product from SK-II to try and I’m now hooked. From the moment you open this lustrous looking bottle you know it’s filled with something amazing. The bottle is a delicate looking white pearl with a dropper. The essence itself is a smooth creamy texture that applies very well. First and foremost, I received this product for free from SK II in exchange for a review. These are my own, honest opinions. I have been using the SK II GenOptics Aura Essence twice daily for the past month, and I have to admit that I have been pleased with the results so far. I have light, combination skin with freckles on my forehead, nose, and cheeks. I also have areas of hyperpigmentation from past acne marks. The first thing that I noticed about the product is that the packaging is quite stunning. The bottle is feels very substantial and the dropper is easy to control how much product comes out of it, making it easy to conserve and use only what is needed. Both the bottle and the product have a beautiful opalescent glow to it. As for the product inside, the essence has a clean, spa-like scent to it. The product spreads out very nicely, so you don’t need to use that much of it. When applied to the skin, it absorbs almost instantly and provides a nice layer of hydration before applying your other face creams on top. My skin is left feeling very soft and hydrated. After one month of use, I do think that my complexion has become more luminous and my sunspots and hyperpigmentation are less pronounced. This does not make my skin look or feel greasy at all, it just leaves it looking soft and radiant. As for the actual ingredients in the product, Niacinamide is the third listed ingredient. Niacinamide is an ingredient that is used in treatment for rosacea, a skin condition involving facial redness and pimples. It does contain Dimethicone, which is a silicone based substance that will smooth the skin on the surface, but does not actually make changes to the quality of the skin. It is essentially a way of “faking” the smoothness. Towards the very bottom of the list is Methylparaben, which some people have issues putting parabens on their face, but research indicates that the minute quantities of parabens in skincare products have negligible effects on our health. Finally, let’s talk about the elephant in the room…the price of this product is WAY up there! Is it really worth it?? Honestly, for the average working person, I would say save your money and shop around for a more affordable option. If money is not an issue for you (lucky you), then yes, I would go for this product as it is very luxurious from the bottle to the product itself. Most importantly, I have noticed subtle results after using it for one month and am curious to see what the results will be after another month of use. I would LOVE to try other things from this brand…maybe when Sephora has their sale in November I will splurge on something for myself.

This is just your run of the mill niacinamide serum that also for some reason has a very strong cucumber scent that can be pretty unbearable if you dislike cucumber. If you’ve never used a niacinamide serum and you start using this one, you will definitely see amazing skin clearing, brightening, and sebum controlling results. But those results would be the same with any niacinamide serum you decided to start using for the first time. If you want a good dupe with cleaner ingredients, that is, something without phenoxyethanol, check out Revolution Skincare’s 15 percent serum which retails at 14 bucks online. That said, most people do NOT need a 15 percent niacinamide serum. The KFDA limits formulations to only 5 percent as there are scientific studies that indicate that any product that has more than that sees a significant reduction in effectiveness. That said, there are plenty of 10 percent serums floating around in the western skincare space. If you are already using The Ordinary’s 10 percent serum and it works for you, just stick with that. You can purchase twelve 1 ounce bottles of that for the same price you’d get for one of these for the same, if not better results. If you want to go a bit more luxe, Paula’s Choice 10 percent booster has a few more ingredients in it that enhance the niacinamide’s effectiveness. Again, based on the week I tested this Sobel Skin serum out, I can say that there is no reason to continue to purchase this when you have so many other more affordable alternatives available to you that are just as effective.
