I have dry skin, but this sunscreen works wonders for my face. I tried a trial size but ended up getting a full size cause I liked it so much!
Love this mattifying sunscreen for us oily girlies. It’s slightly tinted so can be thrown on for natural looking coverage. For the price, I wish you’d get a little bit more but it’s a staple for me.

I really like this product, but my only issue is it leaves a slight bit of an ashy look on my skin. But overall this product is great! The Matte finish definitely helps control the oil on my face. I would definitely use this as a primer before applying my makeup. I plan on using the Unseen version which I was told won’t give me the ashy look on first application. I would highly recommend this product.
clogged my pores gave me blind pimples a total disgrace
it’s so comfortable and lightweight. literally feels like primer

I found that this product was not matte but its not bad either. I thought at first that it made my skin look bad but then I realized that I needed to let it sink in before proceeding with my makeup. If I did it straight away my base makeup would break up! It’s super silky on, like a whipped silicone primer texture. It’s clear (at least it is on my fairer skin) and makes my skin look like it just has moisturizer on once it sinks in.

I’ve been wearing this every single day since I tried it! I finally found a product I can use as a sunscreen and primer. It works perfectly for minimizing the appearance of pores as well! Highly recommend to give this a try if you have oily skin.
I love this matte sunscreen under my foundation and I didn’t even need to reapply after being in the sun all day with fair skin. Supergoop is the best plus it’s nontoxic!

I absolutely LOVE this sunscreen!!!! It is so light and fluffy and makes your skin so soft! I prefer matte versus gloss/glowy so this is perfect for my skin. I also bought the mini just to test and it’s lasted FOREVER!!!

I have an oily skin a very oily T zone , I was struggling to find a sunscreen that would keep my skin looking Matt and out of grease along the day, I felt like this was expensive but No believe me this sunscreen definitely worth every dollar I paid , I’m enjoying using it also blends perfectly with my foundation it gives me the soft Matt finish for my makeup it does work as a primer … love it!!!

I have finally found a sunscreen that I can wear on my face that A) doesn’t burn B) doesn’t dry out my skin C) doesn’t pill and flake and D) isn’t greasy! I actually look forward to using this in the morning. I apply it after my moisturizer and it goes on really smoothly and the texture reminds me of Dream Matte Mousse from the early 00’s which is fun and nostalgic.
love this. super soft and lightweight. not tacky at all.

I bought this product bc a coworker recommended it to me and I really like it. I have been wearing for about 6 months and honestly since I bought it, I have maybe used my foundation about 3-5 times because I use this as my primer/ foundation everyday. It leaves your skin feeling so soft and even. The tint is beautiful and it matches my skin tone very well. It does not leave my skin feeling oily hence the name.

This is the best sunscreen I’ve ever used. Chemical sunscreens give me a lot of brown spots from the heat, so I have to stick to physical sunscreens, but they often make me break out from leaving a residue even with double cleansing, and also feel thick and heavy with a white cast. I have tried every possible other sunscreen, cheap, expensive, popular, korean, dermatologist recommended, none work the way this one does! Protects, feels lightweight (I don’t even feel it after 10 minutes) doesn’t make me break out, doesn’t leave a horrible white cast, doesn’t look like I’m wearing a layer of foundation. I don’t wear makeup during the day so I can’t speak to how well it works under makeup, but for me it’s absolutely perfect. Please don’t ever stop making this. The only bummer is it does stain white clothes, but I still wouldn’t give it up.
I’m sure everyone knows by now that these are the holy grail for spf thats also a make up primer! All of them are amazing and if you haven’t tried them yet, get with it people!
SILKY and MOUSSEY + sun protection. Love it. Please make this forever. The travel size is great. Only thing is wish the shade were brighter and not so neutral.

I’m an adult white male and I do not wear makeup. It’s very “matifying”, as the name suggests. I like it. After a few minutes of application, I looks natural. It’s not my favorite tinted sunscreen but I’m giving this product 5 stars because it and mineral sheerscreen are the only two face sunscreens at Sephora that do not have either a potentially toxic ingredient or potential allergen in the ingredient. Because of that face alone, I will purchase again.
review_title: Non Toxic Sunscreen For the Win

review_text: I’m very surprised by this Sunscreen. Let me start by saying this I am an oily gyal with beautiful brown skin. This sunscreen is a secret weapon for me. It does leave a slight cast on your face if you have darker skin, but that is ok. I love the MUFD HD Foundation but it never lasts on me; until NOW. I wear this under my foundation and it helps my make face last all day even through sweating. Protect your skin at all cost. Here is a picture after sweating. Protect yourself and and look good at the same time .

Best sunscreen ever!!!!! This is my go-to for everyday sunscreen. Even my husband uses it. It’s tinted and leaves the skin looking so natural and it’s non-greasy No one can yell you have sunscreen. Make sure you use a light moisturizer before using this sunscreen; makes it even better and it won’t smudge. This us my holy grail!! I hope they never stop making it.

Been trying a lot of mineral sunscreens recently since Replenix discontinued my favorite one, and finally found my new favorite. There is no white cast, and the tint blends nicely with my light brown skin (my tone is like Halle Berry). My favorite 2 features - which are missing from all the other mineral sunscreens I tried - are: 1) this is truly matte with no shine, and 2) it gets absorbed properly (after about 5 mins) and is not just sitting on the surface of my skin; this means it does not collect in my fine lines and does not just rub off when I touch my face. I can use a generous layer of it on my face and know I am protected well from the sun without looking like a shiny ghost.
review_title: No white cast, shine or settling into fine lines

review_text: My boyfriend has oily skin and he loves this sunscreen
Wonderful sunscreen, light and with a nice texture

I love this stuff, I’ve been using it for a year, I managed to make one bottle last that long! I love this sunscreen, though sometimes it does pill I found that when I add more sunscreen it doesn’t pill.( also, don’t press to hard when applying)  I love how it makes my pores look invisible after using, my face gets greasy easily so on really bad days I’ll avoid it but it rarely gets that bad. this saves my skin and it’s my favorite primer as well for makeup days! it comes out whipped and fluffy and blends in to be invisible. perfection!

Hello, i have oily skin hence i tried this out as i loved the unsunscreen one! I would wait 5 mins plus to settle my oil free moisturizer, this sunscreen and then my primer and foundation. It sadly moved my foundation. :( not a fan! I prefer their main one!

About me: I am a very fair-skinned 31 year old who has the joy of sensitive, acne-prone skin and nasolabial folds/forehead wrinkles from laughing all the time. I live between the Pacific Northwest in the US and the tropics of Latin America. So not only am I traveling a lot, but I’m also contending with mega UV exposure, full sun, humidity, year-round, during sweaty activities like hiking, running, and surfing. Sunscreen tends to clog my pores and build up, cause rashes, give me deep underground zits that sit in my skin for 1-2 months (which are not common for me), build up in my wrinkles and cause zits there, make my hair horribly greasy, not actually protect me in wind/water, or not playing nicely under/over makeup during casual wear. For a while I just gave up trying to look attractive while also wearing sunscreen which kinda sucks cause it’s a daily necessity. That was until Matte Screen.About why I love this sunscreen: Because I have so many skin concerns that are aggravated by chemical sunscreens, the mineral formula of this is necessary. I even find that my skin is clearer after using it. It’s not a wet-greasy formula as much as it’s a whipped smooth texture (kind of like silicon primer). The coverage mattifies and smoothes the skin while not looking like you’re wearing foundation and caking up with sweat/water. I find that if I apply it every 2 hours when I’m just out and about and every hour if I’m in the sun doing activities (surfing/hiking/swimming) I don’t get burnt, or even get color (which is ideal for me). It lasts for 1-2 months w/ regular useOther sunscreens I have tried and rejected:—Neutrogena Clear Face Liquid Lotion Sunscreen for Acne-Prone Skin, Broad Spectrum SPF 55—Shiseido Urban Environment Oil-Free Sunscreen Spf 42—Murad Acne Control Oil and Pore Control Mattifier Broad Spectrum SPF 45 PA++++—Coola Classic Face Sunscreen SPF 50 White Tea—Alba Botanica Facial Sunscreen Lotion, SPF 45—Supergoop Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 PA+++
review_title: Miraclescreen for acne-prone babe in Caribbean

review_text: I have a love/hate relationship with this sunscreen. It goes on smooth, doesn’t leave a white film on my skin and overall kept me matte the whole day. However it did make my skin feel greasy, but I never appeared oily. I definitely will continue to use this sunscreen, it’s the best one I’ve been able to find so far for my oily skin.
this product does the job, but definitely isn’t my favorite. it leaves a little bit of a white cast, and it isn’t worth the price in my opinion. still a good product.
review_title: a decent product, not worth the high price tag

review_text: Love this! It has a silky texture and no sunscreen smell. You just need to add a little bit at a time so it doesn’t pill.
At first I was skeptical because of the price. I use matte screen because I have oily skin. A little goes a long way! Will be repurchasing.

I love this product so much! However, I’m disappointed that this particular one is only 1.5 oz and the others are 1.7 oz and they even just released a few in jumbo sizes. Why not this one? Doesn’t make sense to me.

This is my go-to tinted moisturizer with spf. I’ve been using it for years, and while I’ve occasionally tried other new products, I keep coming back to it. Depending on the season, I sometimes need to lightly moisturize before applying or I get some dry spots. It’s the perfect light coverage for me that lasts all day and keeps a natural matte finish. Be sure you shake it up before applying- it should be a soft, whipped texture.
This is just perfect! It doesn’t cover my freckles and the texture is so soft and smooth. I love it!
Love this product, perfect smoothing foundation primer sunscreen. However $38 is too pricey. Sunbum has a dupe for $18 (only SPF 30 vs 40) but it’s essentially the same formulation.
review_title: love! but keep and eye out for dupes

review_text: Sunscreen is okay, I like the concept of a primer/SPF but it does feel like a layer on top of my face and I can’t imagine the tint is universal for everyone since it doesn’t blend in all the way? The packaging is what really gets me - the orifice is super small and there are a ton of air bubbles in the formula so the product spits out a lot, I have to hold it away from me. I’m also near the the end of the tube and need to crumple it to get product out, but there’s kind of a significant amount leftover that it’s been like this for 2+ weeks now. Honestly, the entire experience was annoying enough that I won’t buy it again.
I love it so much! It is perfect!!!  Doesn’t cover everything. Very natural.
review_title: So natural! Doesn't cover my freckles!

review_text: The matte idea is great but when rubbing this into my skin, it would ball up and almost peel off of my skin. Works better on a hand than on a face. Maybe it’s because of peach fuzz but I just wasn’t a fan :/

Love this sunscreen.  This replaces my foundation on casual days.  It is very matte, great coverage, works almost like a primer as well.  I wear sunscreen year-round, and with moisturizer, primer, sunscreen, foundation, etc. it is a lot of layers.  With this, it cuts it way back, and seems to do the trick.I had avoided this brand, as I assumed it was connected with Gwynyth Paltrow, but it’s not.

I love this sunscreen so much! I put this on top of my morning moisturizer and bam, it’s silky smooth matte perfection. My skin doesn’t feel irritated or dry whatsoever and it feels like barely anything is there. Absolutely no white cast on my skin (though I have fair skin, so I am not sure how it is for people of different skin tones). This is a dreamy facial sunscreen from a brand I’ve long been a fan of. My one and only gripe, and the reason it’s not a five star product is that you pay quite a hefty price for this product. Considering how much sunscreen is needed to protect the face and neck area, I feel like it’s a luxury to use this product, when it is something I use everyday. I would hope they could increase the size of this product because I’d love to see a larger size available, but the price point feels prohibitive.

Have been using for 3 years now and it’s the only thing I will use.  As a minimal makeup person, it has a great natural look that blurs the skin really well and blends into so many complexions nicely.  The mineral formula doesn’t feel greasy and controls shine throughout the day.  Holy grail for me.

I’m combo skin (oily in my t-zone) and this gives me a great matte finish all day. It’s an immediate blur that is great under foundation or with concealer. A little goes a long way and make sure you take the time to rub it in completely and set for a few seconds. Highly recommend.
I use this everyday as a smoothing and oil controlling base. Works well under foundation or on its own. I find it’s evening enough to put blush and bronzer on over it

I really love this sunscreen! It’s matte but not drying and feels great on the skin and I love the texture it leaves… it’s very silk like BUT YOU HAVE TO KEEP RUBBING IT IN. This isn’t something that you rub on your face for 5 seconds and it’s fine… no. You have to rub it in for about 30- 45 seconds and after you will see how it blends and sinks so well on your skin otherwise it will just sit in your skin and it seems like it’s pilling when it’s not. Yes it may take longer than you’re probably used to but it’s the only sunscreen that doesn’t make me oily, greasy, or smelling like sunscreen. Also this doesn’t irritate my skin either because it’s a mineral sunscreen and It sits so well under makeup. I have medium/tan skin and it looks great on my skin tone.
review_title: take time to rub and blend into skin!

review_text: It does not pill! Initially when it goes on the skin it looks like it’s pilling, but it’s not. You just have to continue rubbing it in. I tested this on freshly washed skin with no other skincare products then put my Kosas foundation and concealer on and it was perfect. I have very oily, acne prone skin and this kept my makeup on all day, through a workout and nap. Give it a go and if you hate it, return it- But great for oily skin!

One of the best products ever made! I have been using this for about two years now and I use EVERYDAY! It’s amazing by itself and UNDER makeup (confused on someone saying they used it over makeup and hated it). I burn very very easily and this does a great job at protecting my skin! I also have dry skin and sensitive skin and have no issues with it affecting my texture or pores.

This is the second supergoop sunscreen that I’ve tried and been disappointed with. This sunscreen does not play well with other products. If you try to layer this over anything it will pill all over your face. I love how it looks when I wear it alone but that’s not realistic. There are so many other sunscreens that don’t have this problem, it’s just not worth it.
Me fascina este producto, es matte y muy buena textura. Lo recomiendo!

I used to LOVE this product and it was my go to! But they changed the formula and I have noticed my skin is breaking out more and it has a horrible smell when you rub it in! I will be returning and need to buy something new! :(

I love this product.  I use this on those days where I’m not putting on foundation but I want a little bit of coverage and definitely sun protection.  It starts out looking a little orange, but I’m about as pale as you can get, and surprisingly it blends in and looks pretty natural, even on my ghostly pale skin.  It keeps my skin matte and I feel it looks really great for a minimal makeup look.  I don’t think I’d ever wear this as a primer under makeup, but I also don’t feel like I need to wear makeup over it as it blurs well.  This is pretty much the only thing I wear for vacations now and I love that this is all I have to take for complexion products!  Definitely a fav I’ll continue to buy.
Felt weird on the skin, dries out my oily skin in a bad way, and moves around so much on the skin

Really wanted to love this. I DO think it’s a great, incredibly smooth sunscreen with a bit of tint. But under makeup? Just don’t. This was literally the only thing I did differently in my normal makeup routine, and it made my completely separate and cake in my T-zone. Would probably be fine for someone that doesn’t become oily with makeup on throughout the day. Normally I use Lancôme foundation, Dermablend translucent setting powder and Mac Prep + Fix spray and I get a bit shiny lateen on but it stays smooth looking. I’ll still probably keep this just for the sunscreen, but I’m sad I won’t be able to use this as a primer as it claims it is.

I have acne-prone skin and this product did not break me out at all! My first purchase I was a complete fan and I loved how smooth it went on to my skin and it lasted me a good while! My second purchase didn’t go as well, I felt like it was harder to apply evenly (even when I shook the tube before applying) and it also got this really weird smell that wasn’t there the first time. I also went through the tube a lot faster as getting a good amount of product was difficult. Not sure if it was the batch or there was a slight formula change. But I ended up not enjoying it enough for the price, so I am no longer purchasing. I do recommend though, good for acne-prone/sensitive skin and a great starter for those getting into sunscreen. Could be better on redness coverage but the tint is still there.

This stuff is not heavy- if you’ve ever used benefit porefessional this is exactly that. It’s mousse like and light. The tint doesn’t leave a tint- it blends in totally clear on me. Was so sick of heavy sunscreens feeling like tooth paste on my skin. This is one of the most comfortable ones I’ve ever used.
I was excited to try this product as I’ve heard great things about it. But when I put it on it leaves white residue on my face. It is very noticeable, will return.

My favorite sunscreen ever! I’ve tried a handful of sunscreen and I love how this sits on your face. It’s not greasy, liquidy or thick. I also love that it is matte so I don’t end up looking shiny/oily. Doesn’t have a scent which is even a plus for me. Overall my fave now!
Really great! Non greasy! Really great! Non greasy! Really great! Non greasy! Really great! Non greasy! Really great! Non greasy!

I have a medium skin tone, and this is the first physical sunscreen that doesn’t leave me a cast. It’s easy to blend and leaves a silky finish. I have combination skin, so It’s a little drying for my cheeks but nothing too crazy. I was breaking out due to chemical sunscreen, so I switched to this one, and my acne is gone. I think that many bad reviews are because people expect this to perform like a chemical sunscreen when it isn’t.
review_title: great physical SPF that helped with my acne

review_text: Light weight and solid SPF! Feels great and wears well without irritation.

I was very excited when I saw that they reformulated this product to be oil free and have a more neutral undertone because the oiliness and warm tone were my only complaints. Unfortunately, now the issue with this product is the pilling. Even if you wait 15 mins after applying your moisturizer (which nobody has time for), and you swipe it on gently rather than in a quick circular motion, this product still pills as you’re applying it. It’s a shame because the subtle color helps a lot to even out my skin tone, especially my dark circles, but the pilling is super annoying. I thought maybe the unseen sunscreen would be better so I tried that next, but it pills even worse!!!
review_title: Blurs pores & evens skin tone BUT pills a lot :(

review_text: Perfect for outdoor activities. If you love running outside and hate your face melting in the heat this is perfect. I have a grease ball face and when I work out I need something that won’t just melt off me while I’m sweating outside. This is a perfect sunscreen. It stays matte and when I reapply it doesn’t feel too caked on. It works well on my friends skin who’s a man (sweats way more than me by the way). I love that it’s mineral, it doesn’t burn to put it all over your face if you have sensitive skin. The only issue I have is that if im not using it for sweat inducing activities it makes my skin feel a bit dry. But more like theirs a nice smooth powdery veil kind of dry. I guess that is the point though for it to be mattifying. As a primer type situation I love it my eyeliner doesn’t imprint itself to my brow bone. Perfect.
This feels like a cloud on my face, I love it! And even though its tinted it doesn’t get on my clothes.

Tried switching to a cheaper sunscreen, broke out and hated the feeling compared to this. Back to buying this one. Great matte finish and adds a bit of light coverage. Perfect since I’m not a makeup person. Just wish I could buy a bigger bottle. Four stars for this reason; it’s expensive for the size.

I love this product! I mean my routine makes my skin a little oily afterwards and this helps to balance that out. I know some people may see a white caste, but I don’t and I rub it out pretty gently until I feel comfortable with how it’s spread out throughout my face. Also, a little goes a long way, just remember to reapply. I’m on my second bottle and I still have a little left in my first one, so you get your moneys worth.

This sunscreen is my most high maintenance sunscreen. It only works well if you have the right actives or moisturizers underneath. I am often trying new products and I’ve found a 50% success rate. The wrong serum or moisturizer and the sunscreen starts pilling like crazy, becoming impossible to use. It also likes to converge in the corners between my nose and cheeks, eventually flaking off throughout the day. Not good for those with dry skin. This sunscreen just requires too much maintenance and is too much work. Also has a slightly orangey pink undertone. One shade fits all which is certainly not true.
It works perfectly. No shine, no whitening. Highly recommended for oily skin who hates typical suncream shine.

I love this sunscreen! It’s perfect to use under makeup and doesn’t get oily or clog pores throughout the day. It’s a vital part of my routine, and I highly recommend for anyone with combo or oily skin looking to start incorporating sunscreen into their daily routine.
I love how glowy this makes my skin feel and look! The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because I feel like there isn’t that much product inside.

New formula is such a disappointment. Why did they change it? Literally crumbles on the skin. I noticed they to the argan oil out of the new formula which is what I think gave it such a nice smooth consistency. So sad.
Highly recommend this for people with large pores and/or oily skin. It truly does matte-ify your skin and blur your pores, which was an unexpected added bonus!

NEW FORMULA is very different from the original. I still enjoy the product, but the new formula is less matte, more sheer, sits on top of the skin more and smells a bit strange. I also have noticed the new formula gives me pimples here and there. I still will use the product, but am disappointed in the new formula.
review_title: New formula is worse but still good

review_text: This is one of the best primers I’ve ever used! It makes my makeup last for a long time and still looking good by the end of the night. I’ll definitely buy again!

I usually use the unseen sunscreen which I swear by but wanted to try a mineral based one. I’ve been using this for over 4 months, overall impression- it’s good enough, the best mineral product I’ve tried, having said that I find it clogs my pores so a solid cleansing routine is a must when using this product. Will finish the tube and go back to my favorite which I already ordered. seriously the unseen sunscreen is the definition of holy grail.

Writing my first ever review because this used to be a holy grail product for me - but this new formula just doesn’t cut it. Disappointed and hope they bring the old formula back. This formulation doesn’t have as much coverage, doesn’t stay put and leave a smooth finish like the old one and doesn’t grab makeup applied on top.  As others have said, it even smells different.

I’ve used both Supergoop’s Glow Screen and Unseen Sunscreen, and love them both, so figured I would try this as I’m looking for a matte primer. My go-to foundation right now is Armani Luminous Silk, however I don’t like looking too luminous or dewy from my foundations and Matte Screen works so well to make it look for natural. I’ve used it with other foundations as well and it’s worked beautifully. Now I pretty much use Supergoop every day for primer and sunscreen.

This sunscreen in seriously so great! I have very oily skin and I normally hate to use sunscreen because it makes me even oilier. I’ve tried tons of different sunscreen (including other Supergoop sunscreens) without any luck. I’m glad I gave this one a try because it is perfect! It’s works great under makeup and has a nice blurring effect. And most importantly, it helps me stay matte all day! I’m going to buy it forever.

I have rosacea prone skin so most sunscreens tend to cause a flair up and leave my face red. I have had luck with mineral based but usually they have a pretty aggressive white cast. I bought this and though it’s not perfect, but it’s the best I’ve come across so far. On a normal day I try not to wear much face makeup. This allows me to do that confidently. It almost acts as a primer, blurs pores and mattifies. I do think it has to be the first thing that is put on my face, if I try to put a primer underneath it doesn’t distribute as well, but since I think it sorta acts like one its not a deal breaker. On days I do wear liquid foundation I can only use a blender sponge vs a brush or else it pills up. Still once again not a huge problem since that’s my go to anyways. Overall I like it and will repurchase again, its lasting longer than I anticipated so that’s a bonus, but if you are someone with an extensive morning product routine this may not be the best choice for you.
Great tint and smooth application. I’m constantly repurchasing

I have dark skin. I’ve used way too many sunscreens in my life. They’ve all either left a horrible white cast, are extremely greasy, or pill. This is the ONLY sunscreen I’ve used that does none of the above and actually makes my skin look amazing! It’s slightly tinted and blends in perfectly with my dark skin tone. It looks very natural and matte which I love. It even blurred my pores and some of my fine lines. It’s not greasy at all and applies smoothly. I finally feel confident with sunscreen on. The only complaint I have is that it’s way too expensive for only 1.5 fl oz. I can see this running out quickly since you have to reapply every 2 hours. I really wish the bottle was bigger for the price.

I have so much trouble with face sunscreens, and because there are many bad reviews for this one, I thought I might leave my opinion! I like everything about it, including the texture and lack of white cast. Mineral SPF is my favorite because I have easily-irritated eyes, and I’ve tried so many that look terrible and just sit on the skin like paste. (I’m white, with light-medium, warm olive skin.) It has the effect I’ve often hoped tinted moisturizers would have, and sits well under my concealer all day. No complaints here. :) it does also hold up under a mask.

I wanted to purchase a new sunscreen since I ran out out of mine..I was recommended this by and employee I tried it the next day but it was a no for me. It left a white cast on my face I had to wash it again. It made my face more oily. It almost felt heavy on my skin and made me break out.
I’ve never used a sunscreen that is this drying on the skin than this product.  It does matte the skin which is what attracted me to this product but I will not finish it.  It’s going in the bin!

This made my face so Mayte that my makeup started to give me cake face/ separated my makeup. This is great of someone has really intense oils. As for someone who is normal to combo steer away. This will make you feel like you have a cracked face at the end of your makeup routine. Love the texture but not a fan of the full experience. Will be returning.

This new formula is horrible. Doesn’t matter how much I shake it, it still comes out almost chunky and it doesn’t spread well on my skin. I have also been breaking out ever since the formula changed. Even the smell is different. Please go back to the old formula, I hate this new version.
review_title: Go back to the old formula!!

review_text: I loved it on its own but would never use it under makeup again. It had my foundation sliding all over the place.

this product is amazing. i have very oily skin, and no other primer was able to keep that matte look on my skin. With this sunscreen i was able to keep my makeup intact on a 6 hour flight, i definitely recommend if you have oily skin. I hope this becomes available in stores in Canada, i am truly obsessed !!!!!!!

I have a fear of them discontinuing this! I have tried every mineral sunscreen and clean primer. I have big pores and redness and this evens out both without feeling or looking like I have makeup on - I would use it even if it didn’t have spf! It’s also the only mineral spf that doesn’t make me look and feel greasy.

This is the best sunscreen I have ever used and I highly recommend it with the caveat that I personally cannot use it daily because I can’t use titanium dioxide. If you have no sensitivity to titanium dioxide and you have normal to oily skin this stuff is so good and also easy to reapply throughout the day. Gifted by FaceGym, honest review that hopefully helps you:Okay so here’s the deal. Every brand has their own aesthetic, right? FaceGym is over here with a very unique one: a gym for your face. I personally think that’s a cute idea, and may be the perfect fit for some people. This is certainly gender neutral, motivating, and the packaging on this kit is actually much larger than I would have anticipated.As a skincare enthusiast myself though, I do want to review these products with the aesthetic set aside. Also contains exciting ingredients including postbiotics and peptidesThe…the ball: I-. Okay. It’s a ball. Yes, you can use it to relieve tension in your face. Your dog will think this is the best skincare you’ve ever bought!! But is it objectively better than a jade roller or even a cold spoon? I mean, no. This one is hard to review without the aesthetics. Because in my perspective, the appeal IS the aesthetic.Alas, as an entire kit, it is fun, well done, and the ingredients are well chosen. Is it for everyone? Well no, because no skincare ever is. But if you’ve had trouble sticking with a skincare routine in the past, I’d say this might offer a motivating way to get into skincare.

review_text: While I did receive this as a #freeproduct through #trywithtopbox, I don’t blindly write glowing reviews of products unless I truly loved them. The real disclaimer I need to include is that I’m a huge Laneige fan – everything of theirs that I have used has turned out to be amazing. It might just be that my skin is the right fit for their product line, but I have never been disappointed (the water sleeping mask, lip sleeping mask, vitamin C cream, to name my regulars). Not surprisingly, this eye cream was great for me as well. It’s very lightly fragranced - I know that some people may not like that in their skincare - but it didn’t bother me, was a very lovely scent (particularly as I was using this at bedtime), and didn’t cause any adverse reactions. The consistency is on par with their other Water Bank products – very lightweight and almost gel-like, so it absorbs very quickly, which is much appreciated during the hot and sticky summer months. It’s always difficult to say whether skincare really works – my eyes did seem less puffy in the mornings, but I think I’d need a rougher night in order to truly gauge its efficacy. Given that I always use an eye cream in the evening anyway I’d have no issue sticking with this one in the long-run. I’ve come to trust Laneige and the fact that this contains hyaluronic acid is definitely a plus – even if I can’t see immediate, overnight results, it’s still important to keep that area moisturized and taken care of, even as just preventative care. Bonus points for the very cute and aesthetically pleasing packaging. It’s silly, but this looks Instagram-worthy sitting on the vanity. Also, as with all of Laneige’s products, a small spatula is included for hygienic purposes (big fan of this approach).

The Shani Darden Facial Sculpting Wand is a sleek and modern device that uses sound wave technology. It is easy to setup and use. It includes a charing cable, a flat disc attachment, a precision ball attachment, and a prep gel. The attachments are magnetic so they swap out easily and the included instruction guide is simple to follow. There are three intensity levels and two frequency levels. The gentle massage pressure feels soothing and instantly relaxing on the face. It helps improve circulation, releases tension, reduces puffiness, as well as lightly lifts and subtly sculpts the face. I really enjoy using this device everyday as it feels so amazing on the skin and improves the overall appearance of the face. It comes packaged in a nice box, but without a storage or travel case.

I received Facial Sculpting Wand complimentary from Shani Darden complimentary in exchange for my honest opinion. This is a one of its kind sculpting device that uses acoustic wave therapy to target crow’s feet and nasolabial lines. It also focuses on facial tightening using non-thermal technology. I have been using this device for almost a week now and I can definitely see some positive results.. My face seems a little toned. My cheekbones seem a little more prominent now. I love using this deivce. It is really relaxing. I also feel that the fine lines that were beginning to form near my eyes are becoming less and less visible, my skin seems a little tighter. I was really excited to try this wand because I am in my late thirties and gravity is starting to set in. I like that there are different attachments for different areas of the face and how easy it is to use. Looking forward to seeing results.

I loved it so much! It made my face look snatched which is an amazing thing especially in the morning when my face looks puffy or at night when I’m getting ready for bed, it is super gentle on the skin and the different settings are amazing

Love this tool! Ive seen alot of skincare tools but never tried any other than a roller. Shani Darden Skincare gifted me their Facial Sculpting Wand and my skin is loving it! This is so easy to use and I love that it comes with everything you need to get started.

Will it firm and lift? I highly doubt it since I have been using it for over six months now.  It promotes blood circulation and is more or less a beauty treatment device that is relaxing. My face feels good after the massage it gives but nothing else. I think the ads for this wand are very misleading.

Bought directly from S. Darden. I struggle with TMJ and am getting to the age where lines and wrinkles are starting to pop up. I used this for six weeks and thought I saw a slight difference, but when I took my after picture to compare to my before they looked exactly the same (basically, I’m pretty sure the placebo effect had me thinking my face had changed since I’d committed so much time and consistency to using this device). review_text: I purchased this directly from Shani Darden and was offered a free hydra-prep gel to write an honest review. This is quite literally, a vibrator for your face. On NO planet is it worth several hundred dollars. review_text: I actually purchased this product, based in part on the incredible reviews posted on Sephora.com. I would buy again for $99, not $399.

I really love the gel that comes with the device; although it was just a small sample size. I’m excited to keep using this device and track my results over time.
I love the chic design of this device. This is easy to travel with too. I love how this helps me relax my muscles and wakes up my face even if I am tired.

I have been using this wand consistently for two weeks and am happy to see a softening of the lines in my forward and as well as increased tone in my face.  I enjoy using it before bed and also in the mornings before applying makeup.  I also use Shani’s eye cream in combination with the wand in my eye region, and it seems to really help the eye cream absorb into that area and soften the lines around my eyes.

I bought this last week from Sephora and when I got it I was a bit worried that I just spent so much on a vibrating stick. After using it though it was quite nice. Depends who you are and what kind of disposable income you have. It’s a nice fun tool that gives nice results but I’m not sure it’s a total game changer especially for the price. Another plus is it really wakes you up. All in all im glad I purchased mainly to help with my really tense face muscles.
review_title: I actually purchased this from Sephora

review_text: Before buying it directly from Shani Darden I did some research to see if it’s worth it. Been using for 3 weeks (3 times a week) and felt some difference the next day. The wand design is sleek, has different levels for treatment. The manual is well written and an online video how-to (Emily & Shani herself). I am receiving a free hydra-prep gel as compensation for the review.

If you are a skincare lover and following beauty influencer, you definitely know Shani Darden. She’s been one of the most popular esthetician in Southern California and this title doesn’t happen by luck. She’s very knowledgeable about skin and helped many celebrities with their skin issues. So when she launched this sculpting wand, I didn’t even think twice even though the price was high. I knew it’ll help me prevent premature skin aging and save me money I would otherwise spend on many skincare products in future. I have purchased this wand directly from Shani Darden website and highly recommend to anyone who is also care about their skin. I am receiving a free hydra-prep gel as compensation for my honest review.

Bought this from their site before it released at Sephora. Been using for a couple weeks now. I use it after I apply moisturizer at night to really massage it in. I don’t even have to use the highest setting because this thing gets intense for its size. I wasn’t expecting it to be that powerful. And the battery has lasted quite a while too straight out of the box. I have used it with their hydra gel, (which I get for free with a review) and I have used it with 3 different cream moisturizers. I think the vibrations really help stimulate more circulation to your face. And the tip doesn’t absorb any of your skincare so you know it’s not being wasted. When I rub in with my hands I know my hands are picking up and taking away product from my face. I only wonder why the wand doesn’t come with some kind of cap for the head. Something to keep the dust off? Kind of like many other tools have. Some kind of lid or pouch even. This just has the box. And I’m not going to store it in the box because I use it every single day. The box does contain the charger and another smaller tip for more precise use. I’m only taking 1 star off for the price and the idea that I’m supposed to store it in the box because it doesn’t come with a cap or protective lid/pouch for quick storage. I might need to get a silk bag or something to keep the dust off. I can’t say if this does anything for wrinkles or anything long term because I haven’t used it long enough yet. But I believe there is something good to having your skincare thoroughly massaged into your face. And my skin looks more even and healthier from the better circulation. I have also tried it when I wake up too but I feel like it’s so relaxing and best used at night before bed. The tip is magnetic and easily swappable. Hoping they release more attachments in the future. Definitely a high quality device. Feels very weighty in your hand and the tip is very smooth on your face. I would recommend it as a gift too.

I really like this wand! I purchased it from Shani’s website. For full transparency, I am receiving a free hydra peel gel for leaving this review. I like to think it’s a little more firm, but it’s hard to tell. I just love how relaxing it is to use. It’s like getting a facial every day, and I look forward to the few minutes each evening when I can pamper myself. That makes it well worth it to me.

This wand is MUST HAVE for everyone’s daily routine . It takes just 5-10 mins in my daily routine. Very easy to use. It feels like having facial everyday at convenience of your home.

Make sure you have extra Hydra Prep Gel on hand. I have dry skin so I go through it more quickly than some. It makes my face feel toned and relaxed. I use the lowest settings. Sometimes I put it on the higher settings and use it elsewhere on my body. Solidly built and holds a charge for a long time.

Feels like you are getting a high end facial with every use. The two attachments are magnetic and super easy to swap out. Takes a little more of the prep gel than I thought since it soaks in quickly. Too soon to say whether it’s helped diminish my fine lines but overall really enjoying using it.

I can already see a difference after less than a week of use.  My skin feels tighter, sort of moving upward rather than pulling down which seems to be the direction it was going in and what I’m trying to reverse.  I am very hopeful for the benefits of long term use.

review_text: I love my facial sculpting wand!! I am a fan of anything that can help de-puff and sculpt and this sculpting wand is very effective. For lymphatic drainage on my face I find the wand more effective than my facial rollers and Gua Sha stones because it vibrates. Between the vibration and the two different attachments (a flat disk and a precision round ball ) you are able go deeper to access and stimulate your facial muscles - this is what gives you a smoother and more contoured appearance.  The wand does your face , eye area ,upper lip, cheeks, forehead, chin and neck. You need to use the wand on clean skin prepared with a generous layer of the Hydra Prep gel -very similar to the NuFace gel IMO.  The FSW (facial sculpting wand ) needs this gel to enable a smooth glide over the surface of your skin with no pulling or dragging.You only need a light touch, no need to apply a lot of pressure. Seriously- let the wand do the heavy lifting— pun intended!

review_text: Agree with the other reviews. I bought this 23 months after manufacturing according to the Tata batch number. I didn’t check it and did have to leave my stuff for a few months due to COVID. Completely unusable, dried out, half empty, won’t stay on my face. A very expensive mistake to not have checked it right when I purchased as it was likely already dried out by that time. Too bad as I had heard great things about it’s powers!

*Expired Product*. The product I received was dry, hard and peeled/flaked when trying to rub onto the skin (nothing stayed on). It had a thick, dried play-dough consistency. I was under the impression this is the product and I just didn’t like it. I could not return b/c used (new policy).. so I just took the loss. BUT I was recently made aware that you can see when your bottle was constructed! My bottle was handcrafted on December 5, 2017. Tata Harper’s products are good for 18 months after batch date, making my mask expired in June 2019! I bought Feb 2020. I reached out and Sephora did nothing about selling an expired product. I hope this is helpful to someone and you: 1. either buy direct from Tata Harper or 2. Look immediately at the 4 digit code on the bottom of the bottle and plug it in to Tata Harper’s website to see when it was handcrafted! After reaching out to Sephora they won’t do anything (and repeated they wouldn’t many times over..I feel jaded, I spend too much money here) - so I still have to take the loss, but you don’t have to! Recently, I’ve been battling some texture on my cheeks, chin, and jawline.  I decided to give this one a try again.  Not expecting much, I applied it at night (according to directions) and followed with my usual routine.  When I woke up in the morning, not only were my pores “sneaky clean”, but the tiny bumps I was experiencing were almost completely gone.  I know products from this brand are expensive, however this is the 3rd product I have used from them that is exceptional (I also use the Clarify mask and cleanser).  If it’s in your budget, give it a try.

Great product for getting rid of tricky blackheads! I ordered this product a few weeks ago and when it arrived, I discovered it was dried out. I called Sephora’s customer help line immediately and they gave me to option of a refund or they’d ship me another. The second mask arrived in perfect condition. I’ve read a couple complaints from others saying that their product also arrived dried out, so there must have been a bad batch. No harm done in the end since the company just sent me a new, undamaged product.

When I opened it, it wasn’t sealed and it wasn’t full and it looked dried out. I tried applying it to my face but it was impossible and it started to pill on my face. I Iove Tata Harper but I haven’t experience anything like this before with a high end product or with Sephora. Very disappointed!

I stupidly didn’t read these reviews before ordering -- but like others, my purifying mask came dried out and not usable. I instantly called to get it replaced (because these things happen) but they sent me a second one DRIED OUT and from the same batch number. Clearly zero quality control on Sephora’s behalf... I have a few other Tata Harper products and love them! You would think after a handful of replacements and returns for this product, Sephora would take more responsibility to check them all before continuing to ship -_-

I have oily and acne-prone skin. I use a lot of natural products to keep my skin acne free. I was experiencing some bad breakouts, and I splurged and bought this face mask. It helped so much. Using it weekly, I saw a reduction in breakouts and redness. It also helped some of my bad breakouts go down in size when I used it as a spot treatment. I would say the downside is the price. This is a very expensive luxury item.
I will stop buying from sephora, do you think I am a fool, sending me bad products, cant even return it due to current lockdown situation, the product is hard not smooth
Extremely small jar, offensive size for the price. Not an exceptional formula. But nice consistency and smell. I returned it.
What a terrible product. It pilled all over my skin into a clumpy disaster. What a mess to clean up! It doesn’t apply smoothly and clumps of clay would just fall off my face. Never again.
The mask was wonderful but such a small container. highly effective for chin and hormonal acne but only lasted six or so uses. highly expensive for the quantity.

This is an amazing mask although I did have to get my product replaced the first one came dried out. But the new one was great. It was smaller than expected for the price. Made my acne prone skin look better in one use. Not to drying on this dry skin.

Mask is quite thick and mud like. Easy to apply but boy does is harden after 20 minutes. Takes a lot of negotiating with warm water to remove it all (and the clay stained my face cloths). I will say.... MY SKIN WAS SO SMOOTH AFTERWARDS. WOW.
review_title: Lovely, just far too expensive to feasibly buy

review_text: Doesn’t help with black heads the bottle is tiny and paid 100 dollars I won’t re buy this product
So disappointed.  I am a huge Tata Harper fan, but this product arrived completely hard and dry.  It was impossible to apply.  I would give it zero stars if I could.
review_title: Hard, dry, and impossible to apply

review_text: I received this a sample and like it ALOT so I ordered the full product. What came was half full and it’s as hard as a stone. Is Sephora sending us products that was returned by customers now? Shame.
review_title: As hard as stone, half empty

review_text: This mask detoxify, clears skin. If U want a detoxifying mask and you need a clay mask. This is both in steroids! Sad the price keep increasing but not the ounces. That is quite disappointing! But the mask is a staple!
review_title: Detox & Clay Mask in One... but in steroids!!!

review_text: I like the feel of this mask. While it doesn’t clear your pores or get rid of your blackheads, it makes them much easier to extract. That said, there is very little product. Container is not close to being filled to the top and I finished it in a little under 3 weeks only using it 3 times a week..

I bought this product in Miami Beach, Lincoln road, during my holidays. When I finally got home, I opened it and was really dissapointed to find out that the product was full of mold and dried out. Really disgusting!

I bought this product in a Sephora store on Lincoln road, Miami Beach, during my vacations. I was very disappointed when I got home in Chile (thousands of kilometres away!), and found out that the mask I purchased few days ago was totally dried and full of mold! The product was brand new, with no apparent signs of use/manipulation. So, my advice is for Sephora, not its customers, to really make greater efforts on quality controls.
This is a GREAT purifying mask--my husband and I have both used it and it really works well

It seems to work well at freshening up my oil slicked face, but I wouldn’t repurchase. I either got a defective jar, a returned jar, or... this is just how it is??? I’d say the jar was only ⅔ of the way full and it’s not a large jar to begin with. It was also super dry and cakey which made it challenging to apply. I ended up having to gob a bit on my face and then add water so I could spread it around. Not an enjoyable experience. Because of all this I only got three uses out of it. THREE!If you plan to buy I’d do so in store and check the product first.

For the price, I wouldn’t repurchase. I feel this mask is okay, but not great. It didn’t really help me with my pores at all or improve blackheads. There are much better products like the Dennis gross clarifying mask that do a better job. This is about as impactful as the boscia pore pudding mask.

I really disliked this product. I have oily and sometimes dry skin. I read other reviews that this was hydrating and make acne go away almost instantly. I do not get very many pimples and this made me break out everywhere and also made my skin very dry and red. I would not recommend.
I absolutly love this product! It’s the best mask for both hydration and glow. My skin felt refreshed and pure sized reduced immediately.

I followed the instructions and used it 3 times in consecutive days and then lower it down to 2 times per week. I have relatively small face and it lasted for 1 and half month. And I don’t always apply full face. It feels cool, smells pleasant, and I can see that it does clear my skin. But that’s about it. Would not repurchase it again.
review_title: good product but a little overpriced

review_text: Love this mask! Worth every penny. This is my favourite mask when I’m having no skin concerns and just helps my skin feel cleaner, fresher, and more radiant. Love how it feels when it’s on.

Tried a sample of this when my skin was clogged and oily, and it worked great!  My skin felt smooth and the bumps were gone.  The only downsides are the strong herbal smell (makes me think of nettles for some reason) , which you can get used to, and the high price.  For me, this would be an occasional splurge, but even then I don’t think I would use it up very fast.  So, do I want to spend on something I might use a few times a year?  Maybe not.  Wish it came in a smaller, less expensive size.  Worth it if you need it, though.

I got this mask because I wanted a natural cleansing mask that didn’t irritate my pores (bye glam glow). It smells amazing. It is very expensive you don’t get much product, but I only apply this mask to target areas. You have to apply it for 3 days straight and from there once a week. I noticed more fresh and clean skin in my T zone area after using this product.

This is by far the best mask I’ve tried from Sephora. I didn’t know my skin could ever feel as soft as it did after just the first time using it. The ingredients are phenomenal too - even though it’s purifying it still nourishes with ingredients like aloe, arnica and calendula. I don’t think it’s necessary to apply a thick layer. The difference in results was marginal. With it.

Everything TATA is amazing.  I’ve been using her products for about 1 year. The compliments I receive on my skin (given my mature age of 59) is wonderful.  This mask leaves your skin feeling soft and free of any dead skin.  Your skin will glow after just one use of this mask. Hope you enjoy as much as I have.

I originally got this as a sample and I’m already on my 5th jar. After using it the night before, I immediately noticed a brighter complexion the next morning. I love this mask so much, it makes me feel so fabulous...Oh, really do rinse off with lukewarm/cold water as instructed!Pro- dries very evenly- noticeable difference next day, my skin is noticeably more even- face feels very clean and even after rinsing off the mask, it melts into an oily when rising... face feels moisturizer clean, not squeaky and dry clean (love it!)- lasts a very long time (I thought it wouldn’t last through applications because there seems to be so little product in the jar... but I get 6 to 10 applications out of each jar)Con- the amount of product in a jar is wayyy to small (why can’t they make a bigger jar?!)- like all clay masks... when it dries it makes my face tight... not a product specific problem

This mask is amazing.  But the price is obscene for the amount you receive, it’s very small.  They need to start offering this mask in a much larger size, like triple the size, because otherwise, I would be buying this stuff every two weeks.  I have very difficult skin, and at 47 years old, I’m fighting wrinkles and acne at the same time, this product really does the trick and I love the smell.  Does not over dry, my oily skin felt soft and smooth afterwards.

I tried the sample of this and this was amazing! as soon as I took it off I saw a difference and it made my skin glow Ive been wanting to get the full product but its so expensive but I’m starting to think that it would be worth every penny

I am 40 and have problem combo, fair skin. I purchased this mask and yes, I’m a skincare junkie so it takes a lot for me to be impressed - this mask cleans, and seriously brightens my face, somuch so that I end up with a healthy natural flush every time and intensely soft.  If I have any acne issues they all calm down and I’m not going to say they are erased but they are calmer and begin a retreat and all of that makes this one of the few “worth it” masks I’ve tried.  I will repurchase when empty.
This mask is insane! The improvement 20 mins after washing it off was unbelievable. I got this as a sample and am going to buy the full size. Best mask I’ve ever used.

I received a sample of this from Sephora and was hooked once I tried it.  Smells fresh and feels luxurious on skin.  Even though it’s expensive, I caved and bought a jar.  I’ve tried a lot of different masks and this is the only one I’ve found made a huge difference in getting rid of white heads and making my skin feel smooth after only 4 uses.  I wish the jar wasn’t so small but it’s worth every penny IMO if it actually makes a difference I can see and feel.  It makes me want to try Tata’s other products.  Will definitely purchase this again.
Got this as a sample. It’s super refreshing on the skin, with such a nice smell. It left my skin feeling super hydrated and clean! Will purchase!
Superbe pour les peaux seches

After I used this sample after shower, my boyfriend just said “what did you do with your face, it’s getting better” it does make my skin smooth and even I have some acne, this mask makes my skins seems nice. Totally recommend

I could feel it tightening on my skin. The mask is not drying and does leave your skin hydrated. However, I don’t think it did a lot for my acne. I’ve used other masks that have worked better for acne. This is best suited for people with dry skin.

This mask is amazing. It smells subtlety of real, fresh ginger and gives a cooling sensation to my skin while it’s on. The texture is almost clay-like but does not dry out your skin. It did not irritate my eyes and left my skin feeling fresh and awake.
This is my favourite mask! I love how my skin looks after I use it.  I have very oily skin and my makeup lasts much longer after I use this.

since I have purchased Tata Harper Clarifying mask and fell in love with it, I bought Tata’s Purifying Mask thinking it would also be a home run, I was sadly disappointed. Not that it’s a horrible product but the amount you get for what it’s worth just didn’t measure up for me. It’s a good smelling mask and even feels relaxing on the skin, but I have other masks that were cheaper and do exactly the same. Sadly It’s a pass for me.

Not sure if it was just luck - but I used a sample on my cruise trip and my huge nose pores were visibly smaller!  As noted on many other reviews, it is the first clay mask that didn’t leave my face feeling dry and stripped.

In love! This is a clay mask so it cleanses but also does so much more. It basically eliminates the dirt, pollution, etc. that seeps into your skin and accumulates there. It keeps your skin looking bright and clear. The mask feels cool and refreshing going on and has a slight tingly feeling as it dries (in a good way).  When you wash it off, a veil of dullness goes with it. I use this one every week. When I’m extra busy, I just layer this mask over the Resurfacing Mask on my t-zone, instead of using it separately.

I will spend anything and do anything for perfect skin. I didn’t feel this was any better than numerous other products, and for the price and the small size I just returned it. You’ll get the same if not better results with an exfoliant followed by a clay mask.

I love this product.  It smells great, isn’t drying, and makes my skin look and feel baby-soft after I use it.  I am taking away a star for the cost, because it is very pricey for the amount you get...I think I got maybe 7 or 8 uses out of my little jar.  However, I will almost certainly be buying this again (when the VIB sale comes around!).

Not so sure about this. It definitely minimized my pores which I LOVE however it tingles a lot to the point my face almost felt like it was burning. It did leave my face a wee bit red as if I have rosasia which I’ve never experienced.

I got this product as a sample and it did not work for me. At first I loved everything about it! Easy to apply, smelt nice, and felt refreshed afterwards. However, later on I broke out in an area of my face that has always been clear of pimples. I don’t recommend this if you have sensitive skin like mine.

Wow. I’ve been using all kinds of masks for 24 years. This mask wows me. And this is the first time I write a review here. The texture makes it the easiest mask to apply on. The smell is light and good as it’s all natural, which is a   . I got it as a sample, and I’ll buy it. Although it’s kinda pricy, it’s definitely worth the money.

I got a sample of this with a primer I ordered online. The smell IS strong but I really liked it. Reminds me of lush. I waited until the next day to write this review to see what my skin would feel like. And I must say it feels great. Super smooth, acne is definitely toned down sown a little and no breakouts to be seen. I took away a star for the price. I’m going to go to Sephora and see if they can recommend something similar at a better price point before I consider buying this one even though I really liked it.
review_title: Would buy if it were a bit cheaper

review_text: This is an amazing mask. Probably one of the best i’ve tried. It cleans my pores and doesn’t dry out my skin leaving it refreshed. I love the tingling and cooling sensation of this mask. The only problem is the price and the fact that you do have to apply a thick layer so it is a pretty expensive product compared to the number of uses you get out of it.
Got this as a sample and fell in love! It smells and feels divine and my skin felt amazing afterwards. But I have to knock a star off for the price. Just not affordable for regular use.

I have two masks that are staples in my routine: the Herbivore AHA/BHA mask and this Tata Harper Purifying Mask. I prefer to use this mask immediately after using my microdermabrasion device. It helps to soothe the slightly sensitive skin, and I feel that the product can penetrate better with the dead skin gone. I have normal/oily combo skin with the occasional breakout (typically hormonal). The dusty rose colour is pretty in the jar but looks slightly odd once on the face. As it dries quite fast (especially once the jar is mostly used up), I have to work quick to spread the product. It dries completely in about 10 minutes but I like to leave on for ~30 minutes up to an hour. I don’t like to waste product and apply a thick layer like the instructions say...I just use enough to cover my skin in an even-ish layer.The scent is herbal and slightly gingery...it’s hard to describe, but it reminds me of something from my childhood, possibly an ointment or cream that a family member used to use. It’s not unpleasant of course, but comforting to me. After rinsing off, my skin is brighter and smoother and the redness from the microdermabrasion is gone. I have not had any negative reactions to this product, and although super super pricey, one jar lasted me at least 15 uses. If you average that out, a single use costs no more than your typical sheet mask at Sephora. I see this more as a maintenance mask, than an emergency mask (which is what my Herbivore mask is for!)I bought the full sized jar in September last year and just used it up last month. I still have a small deluxe jar left from a Sephora Favorites set.  Once that’s gone, I will probably repurchase!

This mask is OK. It does a good job of cleaning out the pores but nothing special or amazing happens after using it. My skin felt nice but i did not notice any signs of radiance or brightness. The packaging is really nice and it feels luxurious but I wouldn’t repurchase due to the fact that I see no difference in my skin after applying it.
I love this product so so much. This gets rid of all my under eye wrinkles! Is very pricy though.

I love this mask. From time to time I have had problems with blackheads and this is seriously the only mask that will clear and tighten my pores. The price may seem steep, but a little goes a long way.

I love this mask to cleanse!  I leave it on for about 20 minutes and then wash it off in the shower with cool water.  I use it when my skin is a little problematic, and it works wonders for breakouts.  The results are fantastic, but I took stars for two reasons... 1. Its a bit pricey for a facemask that I could take months to a year to use up (I wish they would do a smaller jar for less money so I wouldnt be as concerned about it spoiling)2. Because Tata Harper isn’t as “green“ as they claim to be - they don’t grow everything in house, and it would be a whole heck of a lot better for the environment if they would do refills rather than just tossing the packaging every time I ran out
review_title: Love the product, hate the packaging

review_text: I was skeptical when I first ordered this, because basically every “cleansing“ mask, especially those made with clay, leaves my skin very dry and tight. I only wanted to give this a try because of the vib sale, and thought it was very small amount for the price when I first opened it, ready to return it the next day. But I have to say I love it!!!! It’s surprisingly not drying at all, has a nice natural smell, and leaves my skin clean and soft. Not to mention it’s all natural. I still wish it’s less expensive, but its a keeper!
review_title: The only clay mask that doesn't dry out my skin

review_text: I am pretty familiar with Tata Harper Products but this is was a new one for me… recently, I spent a decent amount of money purchasing masks and samples of masks because I am trying to find the best products for my skin care type. I think this is a very premium, luxurious mask. This is investment in your face because Tata is not cheap. I have used this mask twice in a week and the results were noticeable, yet I would need more time to see if it makes a long-term difference. First off, the smell is amazing - as always. When you put it on, and let it dry - it makes your face nice and tight and actually feels so good (to me),  because to me tightness = product doing its job. One tip I’ve learned over the years when applying masks that are tightening - is to keep any and all facial movements to a minimum. The more pristine the mask is on your face, and the longer you can go without touching any muscles or talking… For me, (personally) just makes it work better. I liked it overall… I had a nice, natural glow to my face. Because I used it at night I did not notice it the next day but it does do a good job of clearing out all of the little blemishes you may have on your face. My skin type is combinations and I have occasional hormonal breakouts. Since I’ve started using a nightly regimen that has decreased. So with my focus solely being on masks, the Tata Harper mask is one that I would definitely recommend to try/test/observe it - and the longer you can do this, the better chances you have of making and accurate decision on whether this is worthy investment for you! In conclusion, this is truly one product I am going to add to my “products to consider “list. I simply just need more time to experiment and document my results to see if I want to invest and not just this mask, but the Tata Harper line in general...;)

This works so well and gives a nice cooling feeling while pulling out impurities. I just wish for the price you got more product. You have to use a good portion of the product each time as well, it’s not one of those “a little goes a long way”. I have not repurchased due to price and small size, but if that is not an issue do not hesitate to purchase as this product delivers and truly purifies the skin.

Honestly I can’t really agree with the hype with this product! It is truly TINY. I don’t think I got more than a couple uses out of it. The first use broke me out which was cool- it felt like it was digging things up. The next few uses I noticed nothing different. I would say don’t waste your money and go for the Peter Thomas Roth clay mask if you want something for acne.
Loved my sample.  It felt good my skin looked fresh or after. It also doubles as an exfoliant!
Excellent results. Smells like a spa.
Great for combo skin. I have acne prone skin and this didn’t not break me out at all. It leaves the skin feeling very moisturized. It is pricey as other users have mentioned but it’s worth it.

This mask is...okay. I honestly don’t see where all the hype comes from. I’m oily and have acne. I didn’t see any difference with any aspect of my skin after using this except it was a bit softer. The tingling was nice. The smell was tolerable. Worth the price?Not in my opinion.

amazing ! feels great while on the skin, cooling but not irritating. doesn’t dry out the skin at all and draws all impurities to the surface while making my skin feel soft and clean. it works wonders on black heads and shrinking pores! I wish they had a bigger size honestly but I’ve had mine for 2 months and I have used this 2 a week since getting it. still plenty to go. definitely recommend for those who are looking for a skin detox especially if you wear lots of makeup during the week.

I got a deluxe sample of this from an online order and I like it, but I’mnot sure if I love it. The smell kind of threw me, it doesn’t smell awful, but it also doesn’t smell that great... the colour is the exact same as the bottle too, and was also not expecting that lol. I was able to get 2 uses out of the sample bottle and each time I used it I did not see a big difference in my skin. It may have helped with my pores a bit, but did not help with the bit of acne I had both times, or my oily tzone. It did make my skin soft though, but for the price you pay, I don’t think I will be purchasing this.

Hands down, the BEST mask I EVER used to clear those pesky “dots“ on the nose.  And it doesn’t dry my skin!  It’s a teeny tiny pot & it’s very pricey, but it WORKS.  I’ve tried EVERYTHING, & this is the real deal--it’s a beautiful, highly effective product, totally worth the splurge!

I’ll hit the downside to this product first: it’s really pricey for its size. That being said, I’ve gotten a couple of months’ use out of it, as I only use it once a week, and apply it with a brush. I LOVE how it feels as it dries on my skin - it’s got a tingly, soothing feel, almost like you get when you eat a mint. It did break me out the first few times I used it, which I expected since it has the word “purifying“ in it, and my skin is acne prone. Now that I’ve been using it for a couple of months, though, I don’t notice any further breakouts, and I love the way it makes my skin feel. I have combination skin, and this doesn’t dry me out, even on my drier areas like my cheeks. I will continue to purchase this as my go-to weekly mask, and am so pleased I took the plunge on it!

I don’t need a clay type masque as my skin needs moisture (not to be dried out), so this product sample stayed in my cosmetic drawer for a few months before I got to it!! After two uses, I’d say it’s decent but not for me. I’m sure if you need a clay type product for your skin, you’d enjoy this. It smells good to me (contrary to other reviews on here), but personally I didn’t find that this product changed or did anything worthy to my skin to make me want to repurchase. Not sure what all the hype is about & I will stick to my hydrating masques from Kiehls & Glamglow.
I received this in a Sephora favorites box and it was all dried out when I opened it up. Tried to reconstitute with water, but didn’t work. Smell was unpleasant.

only got 3 uses out of it but I love the smell and how it leaves my skin so soft afterwards.  I did notice some breakouts today so maybe it’s from the mask unclogging my pores.  I can’t testify to any long term effects but I would look for this product again.

I had a sample of this mask from a Sephora favorites kit I bought last year. I like to do clay detox masks to clean out my pores every week to ten days, depending on how much makeup I’ve been wearing and how hot it’s been. I live in Florida.  The pores on and around my nose were particularly clogged so my plan was to do the mask and follow up with a pore strip. The first thing I noticed is how I love the way this mask feels on the skin. It feels cool and refreshing but not at all uncomfortable unlike some of my other detox masks. Some literally bring tears to my eyes! After 20 min I rinsed the mask (very easily) off my face and I just keep staring at my face! I have a 4x mirror and I cannot believe how clear my face is! Literally no trace of anything that had been clogging my pores! And my face does not feel stripped or lacking moisture. No need to follow up with the pore strip. Amazing. The splurge is worth every penny.

Pricey for the size but loved the mask! I’d prefer to pay more for a larger size. Packaging seems to outweigh product, in the case. Not sure if this one will stay in the rotation but I am a huge fan of the Tata Brand. Love to support ’made in North America’ company with small batch manufacturing and sustainable products.

I have the clay & the resurfacing mask and I use them without any results... I didn’t return them since there isn’t many options for organic/ natural products safe during pregnancy and lactation... OVERPRICED PRODUCTS, I just make myself believe that works enough just to keep them

I absolutely love the way this feels on my face. I like to put some on my face and just relax with my eyes closed because it has the most amazing tingling cold feeling that makes me feel like I’m at a spa. However it is so expensive!!  Big downside for me. My rating is based on the overall product including price.

This purifying mask is just that! It’s amazing. I literally just used it and had to write this review!! Took away so much redness and reduced pore size. Also magically removed ten years of wear and tear! I will follow the directions and bask in the glory of not having to spend all that money on plastic surgery.

This is worth the cost if it works for you. This clears up my acne breakouts, helps smooth my skin, and makes my face so soft. I would use this everyday if I could, but use it once or twice a week. You don’t need a lot in order for it to work. I hope this works for you too, good luck!

I liked this one more than the resurfacing mask. It leaves your skin cool and doesn’t feel stripped of moisture like other clay masks. The smell is a bit strong, I know someone that has compared the smell to Dettol- but the results are worth it. It cleans your pores and leave you with clean balanced, soft skin. I like that it doesn’t irritate my combination sensitive skin too. It is a bit expensive for the small jar and the scent is strange thats why I only give it 3.5*

Product is good but to say its pricey is an understatement. When I received the item, it literally looked like a deluxe size sample and not the entire purchase. I have used it once and it did make my skin soft and smooth. But unless I see magic happening after the next few uses, I won’t repurchase.
review_title: if you can afford this tiny container for $65!

review_text: This mask left my skin feeling very soft, reduced the appearance of blemishes and did not dry out my skin. I am very prone to break outs when using new products and did not have that problem at all with this mask. I love it! I gave it 4 stars because it is quite a small amount for the price tag.

The Purifying Mask: this mask fights visible signs of aging caused by environmental stressors on the skin’s appearance by eliminated surface buildup and impurities, while minimizing the look of pores. Its got a very natural smell, which is enjoyable and not too overpowering. When applying the mask, it also had a cooling property to it. My face could definitely feel the mask working its magic. After removing it, my skin was extremely soft. Like baby soft. To use, apply over the entire face and neck. Leave on for about 15-30 minutes and remove with cold water.
Love Love LOVE this!!!!❤❤❤❤

This mask was recommended to me by an associate at Sephora, and I went out an purchased it after a week of trying it at home. IT WAS AMAZING! I used it in combination with the FAB Radiance Peel pads on an area of my face that is prone to break outs. I applied the mask as a spot treatment, in a very thin layer, for about 20 minutes. I then washed it off, moisturized, and went to bed. When I woke up, any pimples were GONE and the area looked so bright and smooth. AMAZING AMAZING AMAZING!
review_title: THIS MASK IS MAGIC IN A POT

review_text: Something seems different about this mask, I haven’t even read the ingredients but I love it & how my skin feels and looks after using it. I got the small sample & have been trying not to use it up too quickly.  It does seem to go a long way. The hefty price tag has been holding me back but I don’t normally skimp on skincare so I won’t start now, not for this mask anyway!

This mask smells really good and it leaves my skin glowing and smooth! My skin is very dry and this mask doesn’t help that but if you follow with a good moisturizer it’s all good! This is definitely my favorite clay mask!

My skin type is sensitive/dry. I tried this mask and did not notice any difference (for this price, it should). It requires you to Apply a thick layer yet the amount of this product is so little. All in all for this price and amount and effectiveness, it’s not worth it.

Used this mask for the first time the other week and my skin was noticeably smoother, brighter, and clearer.  I couldn’t stop feeling my face because it’s never felt so smooth before.  I would definitely recommend this product if you’re looking for a resurfacing mask!

I got a mini facial in store on Friday, she used the oil and purifying cleanser and my skin looked great!
