I use origins and glam glow, this one does not make your skin feel stripped after.  One day after mask the blackheads i learned to live with just rinsed off. I have to buy this.......but it’s sold out online and not in all Sephora’s in Toronto :( hope yo get it soon!!!!
I simply love this product! It works as a great pore minimized and leaves the skin fresh and clean without it being too harsh!
I have this on my face right now and I feel it working. It smells amazing and has a nice tingle. My skin is loving this!

I had heard everyone raving about this mask, and now I understand the hype! It leaves your skin feeling so clean and smooth. After applying the mask, I felt some tingling, but more of a cooling effect on the skin, even after I’ve washed it all off. The smell, like others described, is on the stronger side and smells like ginger. Personally, I don’t mind, but if you’re sensitive to fragrance in skincare products, I recommend getting a sample first or smelling it in stores before purchasing. I can’t really speak to its effects on acne, as I only had a few tiny bumps on my face. The biggest difference I noticed was how smooth my skin was afterwards. It was literally baby soft, and I can’t remember the last time it felt that way. My skin was also very radiant and glowy, like I had just gotten a facial! Yes, the price is a bit steep, but a bottle should give you 15-20 uses, bringing the cost per use much lower than the cost of a facial.

I had high hopes for this mask as the reviews were all good. I have sensitive dry skin and although it didn’t cause any irradiation it which is very common for me it left me with a patch of acne where I had applied it. I used it 4 or 5 times to really try it out and each time my skin looked no better or more hydrated. The only thing it left was acne. I’m not sure if this mask just isn’t good for dry skin. I’m guessing this mask would be more appropriate for people with oily skin who have normal non-sensitive skin. This is definitely not for sensitive dry skin!

I received a deluxe sample of this in the scouted by sephora favorites kit. It’s got a strong ginger smell, which I don’t mind, and is easy to apply and leaves skin hydrated after application. However while this is fun to try I’ll never purchase it because it’s so exorbitantly expensive ($65 for ONE OUNCE?!) and it didn’t really do anything amazing for my skin. I didn’t really notice any tightening, refinement, smoothing, etc. My skin looked about the same after as it did before - it was just very clean and hydrated, but no more so than if I just washed my face and applied lotion.

Super gentle and all natural, this purifying mask is so light yet powerful on my combination-sensitive-acne prone skin. I use it once a week and get compliments on it the very next day (thinking of using this 2x a week soon). It doesn’t dry out my skin, keeps my acne in check by minimizing any current acne and actually brings a nice glow. Was super stingy on the price but after receiving a nice sample in store from a Sephora representative that swore by it, I am hooked; it is worth every penny!! One of the most excellent purifying and acne preventative mask on the market!

This in conjunction with the Tata Harper Resurfacing Mask is like the VIP pass to quick, effortless, flawless skin. I prefer Tata’s products over Glamglow’s. Yes, that good. I was so hesitant to try this for over a year just because of the price tag, but honestly if thats the only thing thats keeping you from it, bite the bullet and try it out. It has changed my life.
The smell is the brown algae working its magic to purify the skin without drying it. Worth every penny!

If you are looking for moisture in a jar look no further...great mask to wear before applying makeup for a special night out...you will literally glow...it also exfoliates my skin but never dries it! Worth every penny!!!!
review_title: BEST MOISTURE MASK IN THE WORLD

review_text: I tried this out last night and it is amazing. It smells wonderful and it goes on so smoothly and easily. My products absorbed so well and I woke up this morning with a great complexion. One of my favorite masks!!You can check out some more reviews, tips, and tricks on my YouTube (just search my name) :)XOXO!
Worth the money. Gives the most lovely clarified feeling without being drying or “too clean“. Makes my skin feel so fresh

It definitely doesn’t have the super clean effect of the glamglow supermud, which is my all-time favorite mud mask, but I like the smooth/creamy texture and the moisturizing feel it leaves on my skin. It is a purifying and moisturizing mud mask. Smell is not my favorite though.

This mask is the HOLY GRAIL. I’ve tried everything from Bliss to Dr. Brandt to drugstore brand masks, and I’ve never ever noticed a major difference in my skin. I only ever saw results from professional spa facials. I typically have pretty good skin - combination, sensitive to dairy and toxins, prone to breakouts on the chin only. But lately, my skin has been awful, dull and dry with acne all over my chin (thanks wedding stress, travel, hormones) - and I ordered this mask on a whim. IT IS AMAZING. It’s truly a professional facial in a jar - and all natural. I left it on for 15 minutes before bed, and IMMEDIATELY my skin was brighter and clearer. My blemishes had reduced and were not as red, and my skin felt super clean but soft and hydrated, not tight or irritated. The next day, my skin still looked great and when I washed my face in the morning, I could feel the hydration. This mask is seriously worth the money. And, the best part is it’s all natural - the ginger smells and feels amazing! I’m a mask convert and will keep a jar in my home bathroom as well as my suitcase, and I’m now ordering other Tata Harper products. BUY IT!

Just have to agree with some other people that for the price it is a very small amount. That being said, it works miracles. I have acne prone skin and are constantly exposed to pollution (city life) and have not broken out since using this 2a week. Worth the splurge!!!

First off, Tata Harper products = holy grail of skin care.This mask 100% lived up to my expectations, as does the Resurfacing mask. Regardless of a hefty price tag, these products are definitely worth it for acne-prone skin and people who struggle with very reactive skin upon trying new products.Product itself it a dusty rose, opaque mask. A little goes a long way, feels minty upon application and wears off slowly. Warning that the smell of this mask is incredibly pungent, I can’t quite put my finger on what the scent is... the closest I’ve gotten is “spiced ginger“ which I personally am not a fan of, but the mask works well enough that I can look past that.I’ve been in the middle of an acne flare up due to another product my skin didn’t like, and this mask calmed it right down... visibly after each application. I left the mask on for about 20-25 minutes, there is no tingling sensation or anything of the sort that I’ve found. I’ve read reviews of others leaving this mask on for up to an hour, might try that next time.Overall love this product and definitely recommend it, will purchase again for sure.

Wow. WOW. I love this mask so much. Every time i use it, i take it off and my skin just looks ten times better. It’s a great mask & it leaves your skin feeling great after you use it. Of course this isn’t a face-lift in a tub but it’s a great product & if your expectations are reasonable, you should be more than happy with this product. Have a great day & be beautiful.

I am literally so in love with the Tata line. Especially because they are organic. They smell so good and this purifying mask Is Absolutely amazing!! I know this is pricy for a little, but it really works for oily and combination skin, it doesn’t cause breakouts or anything. Skin is so smooth and bright after using. Love Tata products!
By far one of my favorite beauty products. It deep cleans and leaves you with a radiant glow. Best part is it works immediately and is hydrating!

Since I already use the Tata Harper Purifying Cleanser, I decided to get this mask and try it out and so glad I did!I used it today for the first time around 10am EDT because I had a little breakout happening on my chin and put a thicker layer on, more than I usually would with my other favorite masks. review_title: Tata Harper Purifying Mask has instant results!

I’m not sure why, but this doesn’t seem to work for me at all. Zero tan. I even used a couple times a day. I wish I would have just gotten the Tan Luxe The Water again. I’d recommend that over the serum.

I felt as though this was a waste of money for me. The cream didn’t hydrate my skin and in fact I almost felt like it left it drier than when I just used my regular moisturizer.
I have dark areas under my eyes and just a tiny bit twice a day makes a huge difference; don’t use too much you don’t need to- a little goes a long way!

I’ve been using this product twice a day for about a month and there is a visibly different look to my eye area. They look brighter and smoother, both under my eyes and on my eyelids. I only have to use a small amount and it absorbs quickly! I’m impressed and plan to repurchase.

This eye cream was too oily for daily use. I live in a very dry climate (Colorado) so I wanted a little extra hydration which this cream gives, but it’s so oily that my makeup won’t stay while wearing it. I constantly have raccoon eyes from mascara rubbing underneath, no matter how waterproof it is, and eyeshadow has no chance of staying put longer than an hour. I don’t mind this at night, but I need an eye cream to use under makeup as well and this just doesn’t cut it. I do like this brand and prefer the ginzing one over this. I do not recommend this!

Redeemed this 100-point perk at Sephora to test out other eye creams. Don’t buy this. It’s not hydrating at all. It’s almost drying actually. I used it the first day and felt it did nothing. Fine lines still there. Then I used undereye concealer with it the next day and omg, it looked absolutely horrible. Dry, cracked, caked, and so unappealing. It wasn’t the concealer bc I’ve used it with other eye creams before and it looked fine. I gave it another chance the other day, same exact results. I would skip this and try something else.

I had planned on purchasing my normal eye cream but was drawn to this product by the salesperson and positive reviews. I appreciate how smooth the product is but it doesn’t hydrate like I was hoping for. I can tell no difference in my fine lines and feel they are even more visable now than they have been with other products. I wanted to be impressed with this eye cream. I’ve waited a month to review to make sure my opinion didn’t change but I will not be purchasing this product again. It is an OK eye cream but I did not get results I was hoping for.
Just purchased this few weeks ago and recommended by skin specialist at Sephora. After using few days later, my fine line seemed to diminish and get brighter as well. Highly recommend this!

Until I started reading Sephora reviews I never knew that otherwise sane women would take a hammer to packaging in order to extract the last drops of beauty product. And then I myself actually did it (strangely satisfying I must say though my husband was rather horrified at the process) in order to get at the last bit of this stuff. My poor abused 60+ eye area never responded to anything as well as this product and in fact often had terrible reactions to other eye serums so I will never be without it and keep a hammer at the ready when it is out of stock and my back-ups fall below two. I’m not surprised that it has no apparent effect on youngsters but for those of us in need of the big guns look no further...and rejoice because the price is a fraction of some of the other less effective products. But do give it a few weeks because the results are not overnight.
Goes on nicely, my skin doesn’t have any allergy to it. Use it morning and night. But honestly, I can’t tell if it’s working or not!
Cream does nothing at all for me. Some moisture but does not get rid of under eye lines and I’m 27.
A really nice rich cream but I didn’t notice any improvement in the appearance of crow’s feet or crepey skin

I’m only 21, and I know this eye treatment is meant for skin more mature than mine.  But I grabbed this as a 100 point perk at Sephora and I am totally in love.  I am young. but I still have the beginning of crow’s feet as well as fine (but noticeable) smile lines directly under my eyes.  This does moisturize without clogging the skin, and plumps the eyes beautifully.  It makes you look so much younger and much more awake.  If your skin is more mature, you might want to use this morning and night, but I only use this at night.  It is heavy, but it does deliver results - from a preventative standpoint.  Maybe it’s a little different in terms of treatment, but if you’re looking to prevent wrinkles and sagging and crows feet, this is the eye cream for you.

I got a sample of this with my Beauty Insider points. I was excited to try it since I’ve been thinking about adding an eye cream to my regimen. This one is not it. I have dry skin and this made it even drier. After only a day or two, my skin was flaking and my eye wrinkles actually looked worse. It might work for oilier skin, but it’s not for me.

I typically have horrible dark circles under my eyes no matter how much sleep i get. The first morning after using this I saw an immediate difference in the darkness under my eyes. This was so brightening I could not believe it. Non irritating and feels great on the skin. Little goes a long way!

**To those who’re complaining that it didn’t do squat to help dark circles, it does not address that issue. It’s strictly a moisturizing, anti-aging cream**I received this as a sample, so I can’t speak to long term affects or anything, but I’d say it’s worth a try. This wasn’t too heavy and it absorbed quickly. I’ve used some creams that made my under eye area so greasy my husband thought I was crying. This isn’t like that at all; it kept my under eyes nicely moisturized throughout the day and night without overdoing it. The clean/slightly floral scent is very light, almost unnoticeable. I haven’t used it under makeup though, so I can’t speak to that, either. I’m a huge Peter Thomas Roth Mega Rich devotee, but I just might give this a shot and buy the full size.

Very disappointed with this product. Applied twice daily for 3 months, but did not make any difference. Did absolutely nothing for dark circles and was not even an effective moisturizer :(. Will not be purchasing it again.

Let’s face it.  There is no miracle in a jar or tiny plastic surgeon in a bottle.  It’s a good product, moisturizes the eye area, minimizes the fine lines, somewhat plumps out the crows feet.   Eye creams, no matter if they cost $10 or $100,do the same thing. Would I buy this again, maybe, but I’m going to try another product later on. But this product is worth a try.
I loved this eye cream at first, but after about a week of use the skin on my eyelids and under eye area began to flake. I had to go back to my tried and true First Aid Beauty.
this is a great eye cream. Many other creams burn and irritate my skin. This cream is non irritating and goes on smoothly. I apply it morning and night. It is great under makeup.

This cream is a good buy for sensitive eyes, especially eyes that may water. It hydrated and plumps and works well under most concealers (I use YSL or NARS). I do use either Algenist or PTR eye creams at night to combat dark circles (non-hereditary) and find this is a great daytime product.
I love it is the best

I’ve been using this cream for more than a month now. Bought after reading so many rave reviews about it. It does moisturize, but so does any cheaper cream. It didn’t do anything to my fine lines or dark circles. I wouldn’t buy it again

Doesn’t do so much in the lightening which I don’t mind because it plumps your skins so well! I have bad under eye wrinkles that have been a struggle and this is seriously healing them! I am extra thought and use this ALL over my face! This is a heavenly product. It really helps in the strengthening and retextures my skin.
I have been using this cream for 5 months, twice a day, with no improvement in dark circles. It’s hydrating, but that’s about it. Not worth the price.

Nothing bad with this eye cream, but also nothing special. Didn’t notice a big difference in the dryness of my under eye once morning came when using it overnight. But was fine using under makeup. Still found my eyes to get dry but as said, nothing bad about it just nothing spectacular.

I’ve been trying a bunch of eye creams but I think this is the one I’m going to keep going back to. I love the consistency and how it soaks in quickly, yet leaves my under eye area plump and hydrated when I wake up in the morning. I won’t say that it reverses signs of aging, but it definitely smooths out any lines I have and prevents the appearance of new unwanted ones by keeping the eye area moisturized. And I absolutely LOVE that I don’t have to stick my fingers into a pot, the pump releases the tiniest amount so you aren’t wasting product and keeping it more sanitary.

I’m about half way through this product, and I like it, but I don’t think it’s worth rebuying. I don’t know that it does anything special that a regular moisturizer wouldn’t do... It does make my skin appear brighter directly following application but once removed or by morning once the product has worn off my eye area appears normal again and no improvements are noticed. So I feel like it just sits on top of the skin and makes it appear like it’s working but isn’t actually. I have other eye creams that I’ve purchased since this that do a much better job .It does however play nice with makeup!

I bought this product hoping to be able to write a shining review with amazing results. But alas, my hunt for the life changing, fine line erasing, radiant eye cream still continues.After using the whole bottle, the fine lines under my eyes and around the inner corner (due to 10+years of tugging from using contacts) are still very present. Though they have not gotten visibly worse, they have by no means gotten better. At least I can say, for all you ladies prone to milia (hand raised), this didn’t give me any. So thats a good thing.
A light weight moisturizer that absorbs quickly and reacts well at night or under makeup.

Eye creams are crazy expensive. I like this because it seems to last forever and doesn’t cost a fortune. Agreed with other reviews, not the most hydrating option out there but great for day use & works well with an eye makeup primer. For those who feel they should be using something different around the eyes but don’t want to spend a lot, I recommend.

This product was awful and the only product I’ve ever returned due to sheer quality. It dried out the skin under my eyes severely. At first, I thought it was an eye make up remover that I started using at the same time as this cream. I completely stopped using both products, then a couple months later tried this cream again. Within two days, the skin under my eyes was extremely dry. This product created lines!I was so disappointed in this cream. I don’t have sensitive skin or anything so I don’t understand how it dried out my skin so much.

I tried this for about a month and a half.....it DID decrease the look of wrinkles around the corners of my eyes but it did nothing for moisture :( I have really dry spots in the creases of my eyes where I normally will blend out my eyeshadows and they are still flaky and dry. I wish it did both or I would love it!

I’ve had a hard time finding an eye creme that is inexpensive and that I like. I’ve tried almost every one under the sun and for being 25 years old and having only the beginning signs of aging and minimal wrinkles, this is a great product.

I have tried alot of eye creams, from drug store to very expensive and this one, moderately priced, is very nice. You don’t even need a full pump for both undereyes. I think it is hydrating, and helps with my wrinkles. I’m 31 and trying to prevent crows feet. It soaks in nicely, my concealer looks smooth on top. Would buy again.

I bought this product because I have liked other Origins products. However, I did not like this product at all. I have very dry skin (including under eye) and I have tried many eye creams that will have long-lasting hydration. This product was not hydrating at all and felt almost sticky which made my skin look wrinkly (I’m 23). I stopped using it after 1 week. This may be good for those with no true under eye issues and are just looking for a basic eye cream, but for the price tag I would look elsewhere.

I bought this back when it was in the jar. Now its in a pump. If you have dry eye are this isn’t for you. It is not hydrating and doesn’t soak in easily. I wasn’t that pleased so now I just use it on my lips at night. The face cream is great, but this isn’t.
Good for a moisturizer, but have not seen any improvement in crows feet/eye wrinkles. If using for night cream, I would not purchase.
Love this eye cream!!! Really works!!! Noticed a difference within 3 days!
I use this on my eyes day and night. My eyes actually feel refreshed and hydrated. It’s like a mask for your eyes and the skin around feels so soft and smooth after using the product.

I began using this cream about three months ago, so I feel like I’ve given it a fair shot. While I give it a few points for quick absorption, I can’t say it does much in the way of hydration. Seems like it just sinks in and then disappears which means my make up just cakes up into the fine lines under my eyes. At $45, it’s not the most expensive eye cream I’ve ever used, but I expect more at this price point. I’ve gotten better results with creams that cost much less. I’m typically a fan of the Origins products, but this one wasn’t for me.
Sadly did not work for me. I did not see a reduction in lines or wrinkles. It does absorb quickly and easy to apply.

For this price I wasn’t expecting a lot. It is ok but nothing special. Though on the other hand , for an eye cream that does nothing , one can find cheaper alternatives everywhere else ! I will be trying others after this one is finished. Unlikely to repurchase.

Considering how expensive eye creams can get, I feel pretty good about the results-for-price exchange of this product. It smooths fine lines and makes my under-eye brighter when used regularly. The skin under my eyes is quite thin, so I’ll never get rid of the circles entirely, but the cream does what it can.My only complaint is that I don’t think it’s as moisturizing as it could be. Since my under-eye skin is thin, it also has a tendency to look dry and “crêpe-y“ under concealer if it’s not SUPER well-moisturized. Until I started mixing this cream with a drop or two of argan oil before application, I wasn’t sure I’d re-purchase.The addition of the oil makes it significantly more moisturizing, of course. And since I still like the other results and the price, I’ll probably buy it again. Especially considering most pricier creams haven’t yielded better results. But I do think the formula could be slightly improved.

This product goes on smooth and is very hydrating. I have used this for a week and see no difference between this product and some of the more expensive eye creams.I only use a tiny bit for both eyes; a small amount goes a long way.
I have tried many eye creams, this one’s a winner. Very hydrating. On my third bottle.
Throughout the years I try different eye creams thinking they will be better- nope! I always come back to this eye cream. Absolutely the best to help Keep lines away and diminishing existing ones

I feel like eye creams are just gimicks but this one is alright. Not too expensive and its overall moisturizing but doesn’t do much for dark circles or fine lines. It’s just moisturizing and that’s it. Meh

The first eye cream (under $100) that I feel like actually accomplishes what it sets out to do!!I recently turned 40 and have since decided to step up my skin care game as I head into this new decade; this product (after about a month of twice daily use) has made a visible difference to the fine lines that have started to set up shop around and under my eye area.Nice texture, I feel that it absorbs relatively quickly, only a slight tingle after application. I look less tired after use and am very happy with the results, especially at this price point.

I have been using this product for several weeks now and honestly cannot see much of a difference with my dark circles or puffiness. Also, it does not absorb quickly at all. I have to apply a layer and leave it there for a while before finally rubbing it in.
Nothing special. I’m turning 32, and have two fine lines under my eyes. I’ve been using this product for months now, and notice no change.

Let me preface by saying, Im 25yrs old, I work long hours and have had dark circles my whole life. I even struggle with dry skin. Luckily I have found certain products that work for me and this is one of them. I cant speak on if this works for wrinkles because I don’t really have them yet but it does what it says. Its super duper hydrating, its helped combat my dark circles and brighten my under eyes. I love this stuff. Worth every penny. Its never too early to start “anti aging“

Im 24 and have two lines underneath my eyes (pretty sure its from pulling the skin under my eyes everyday/night putting in and taking out contacts) never the less they are there and make me look a lot older than i should. The reviews on this seemed so good i gave it a try - been using for a month and have noticed absolutely nothing. The lines are just as visible as they were before this cream.

I had been on the market for a good eye cream that was under $100 - I really like this one. It absorbs quickly and doesn’t sting my eyes. I have been using it for about a month and I noticed my eyes are a bit brighter and my fine lines are a bit less noticeable. It’s not a miracle worker, it won’t erase your lines, however it does improve the look of them. I also love the pump, it is more sanitary than pots and also helps control how much you distribute, so it’ll prolly last you longer than a pot. A little goes a long way. Definitely will rebuy.

I got a sample of this a couple months ago cause I was looking for a eye cream that wouldn’t irritate my eyes and the Sephora girl recommended this so I took my little sample home and as soon as I tried it I fell in love with the creamy but not heavy eye cream , it sinks in and won’t leave a residue at all I would deff recommend this to anyone that’s looking for a good eye cream can be used both day and night , a little drop goes a long way and it’s made my tiny little eye wrinkles more smooth and hydrated even helped with my dark under eye circles will deff buy again and again

I’m 28 but suffer from allergies and have been rubbing my eyes my whole life! I think this is might be a good preventative eye cream, as it is good at moisturizing. I have a couple of deep lines under my eye and one that isn’t so deep -- I’m pretty sure this is helping to prevent future lines. I have been using it for a month now, day and night, and though I can’t say I’ve had dramatic results, I think that expectations must be realistic. Due to the price and modest effects, I might continue looking for something a bit less pricey. I would pick this over Clinique’s All About Eyes in a heartbeat.

The texture of this eye cream is between watery and richly heavy, just about right. Remember to massage a little bit around the eye and u will feel the slight heat sensation. After two weeks, i can tell a very obvious improvement on my black circles and under eye concealer creasing situation. Fair priced compared with department fancy useless brand. Highly recommended.

I tried literally 30 different high to low end eye creams and this one beats them all. The price is reasonable yet the result is amazing.This cream erased my craws feet and sleep lines under my eyes. It sinks to into my skin instantly.
My under eyes are much brighter and my fine lines are less noticeable

After seeing mostly all positive reviews, I bought it. I wanted to love this. But I’ve been using this product every morning and night since July ( it is now November), and I have not seen any improvements. My dark circles are still very dark, and my fine lines have not really diminished at all. I will say this is really good at keeping my under eyes moisturized, and works great under makeup. I will use it up, and try something else. I will not be repurchasing it.
Just about to re-order. I’m an eye cream addict, and this is the best one so far. At 49, this eye cream does the trick. I have not been disappointed in its performance.

I rarely rave about eye creams. I try them and stop using them quickly because I never see results. Well, that has stopped. After just a few uses, I can see this cream working. It visually improves the eye area. My fine lines look less “fine liney“ and my eye area is moisturized. I don’t have dark circles so I cannot speak to that. This product is fantastic, though. If you’ve shopped around for eye creams and want something that’ll really work- pick this little gem up. Wish I used it years ago! I’m only 32, but I never used to wear sunglasses so I have some slight fine lines I’ve been battling forever!

I have been using this for at least a month now, and I have not seen any improvements. My dark circles are still dark purple, and my fine lines have not diminished at all. It does, however, moisturize quite well. I really wanted to see results from all the amazing reviews.

I have hereditary black circles and this is the very first product that has ever helped. At least 50% decrease. Little white bumps... Gone. Slight decrease in lines. I love this product and am so grateful to have found it.
I don’t know why I didn’t give this eye cream a try sooner. It’s hydrating, absorbs quickly, and seems to work with my beginning fine lines.

After the total pillaging of my Hope in a Jar Eye cream sample, and trial and error that left me with milia on my cheek (closest to my eye but not on my under eye quite) I decided to pick up this eye cream. It felt quiet moisturizing and absorbed quickly upon trial and into my basket it went. I’ve had this product for a few months and so far NO milia insight! The skin around my eyes remains moisturized and bright. (I don’t believe this product has any claims of brightening) why is this labeled limited edition? It would be a honest shame to not make this a staple product. I may have to stock up!
Love! Very refreshing and hydrating.

This is such an amazing eye cream! I love it!! I’m 27 but I have 2 small children. They have aged me a lot faster. After using this eye cream for 2 weeks I noticed a huge difference in dark under eye circles, puffiness, and crows feet! Love it!!

I always hesitate when it comes to purchasing pricey products that go near my eyes because I’m a contact lense wearer with very sensitive eyes. When I used this the first night It won me over! As a new mom...let’s just say under eye concealer was my new pal. This eye cream has changed my eye area! No creases, no dark circles, no dry areas and no eye burning!! Hopefully this isn’t a limited edition product because this is a keeper! Worth every penny. Give it a shot, you won’t be disappointed.
Could take it or leave it...it has a nice scent and is OK for night use. For day, I had to get something more moisturizing to apply under concealer.

I struggle with very dry under eyes along with those little white dots and I can honestly say this cream has done wonders for me. Within a week the skin under my eyes has become so soft and much smoother, not 100% better but still a HUGE difference within that last week. It’s definitely my new staple item.
I am obsessed with this stuff. Every eye cream I have tried irritates my eyes and this one doesn’t! I love the way it feels and can already tell a difference!

This eye cream is amazing to me because not only is it reducing the fine lines and laugh lines around my eyes, but it has nearly completely eliminated the milia around my upper and lower eyelids (those small little white dots). I have also noticed a marked decrease in my dark circles.This cream does not irritate my sensitive skin - not even the skin on my upper lids, which is very sensitive. Very little to no scent. Added this one to my loves list!

I have tried so many different anti-wrinkle eye creams in the past few months and so far this the only one that truly fades away the wrinkle that i have in between my eyebrows. And what’s more amazing about this product is that i see results within just a few days! No other eye cream has given me results this fast. I also like the fact that it has no fragrance and does not irritate or cause burning to my eyes. LOVE it!

I got this as a sample and am now ordering a full size. I have never seen any change with other products. I have been using this for 2 weeks and the fine lines around my eyes are gone. Gone! I’ve been using morning and night. Absorbs quickly and non irritating to my sensitive skin.

So I’ve had these lines under my eyes for forever. I’ve tried everything and nothing has helped. Then one day while strolling through the mall a nice young lady asked if I wanted to try anything. I saw the advertisement and what stood out the most to me was “anti aging power“. I said “I must try it!“ OMG!!! I’ve been using it for like a week and I am already seeing spectacular results. I see the creases under my eyes becoming smaller and smaller. I am the pensive type and so I am always squinting my eyes when I’m analyzing something plus I work with criminals so I’m always noticing some manipulation. Then the sun doesn’t help but I wear shades everyday while outside to beat that issue. But with this cream I really like how my undereye area is looking. I mean I think it is beginning to look “flawless“. I am so happy. I even put it on my lips and my lips are looking so cute. I’m buying the full size. Oh I forgot to mention that I also had racoon eyes and always needed to use an undereye color corrector but this morning I skipped it and I looked absolutely fabulous. Now I don’t feel so disgusted whenever I saw dark circles around my eyes. This is a good buy ladies.

Please tell me what limited edition means?! It needs to stay around forever! I love this serum. Every other eye cream I’ve tried either makes my eyes burn or the underside stay red or my eyes look like an oil slick; the product doesn’t absorb. Origins has made this green bottle my morning and evening go to. It brightens instantly and, after a few weeks of use, I’m noticing my laugh lines and crepiness diminishing. LOVE! Never go away!

I’ve tried many eye creams and usually encountered one of two problems: 1. the cream seemed to do nothing; or, 2. the cream irritated the skin around my eyes so it became red and scaly. I got this cream as a sample (thanks, Sephora!) and really liked it. With continued use, however, I absolutely love it. No irritation, and a definite reduction in fine lines and wrinkles. It’s very gentle even using it twice daily. It’s now a part of my beauty routine.
I’ve used dozens of eye creams in my lifetime. Using one morning and night religiously since the age of 16. My eyes are still smooth but with a slight bit lack of firm/taught
Goes on smooth, non-irritating. All day moisture.
A really good eye cream
I have eye wrinkles since mid 30s. The texture around my eyes look and feel much better. I use this product before bedtime.

I have tried many eye creams including some much more expensive ones but have permanently come back to the Origins Plantscription line this year. I love the new Power Eye Cream as I have very dry but very acne prone skin. This eye cream transforms my undereye area while providing fantastic hydrating properties....and all without breaking me out. Those tiny lines I have under and around my eyes have diminished and disappear when I apply this. My concealer goes on completely smooth and line-free. I’m turning 40 this year. People honestly think I’m almost 10 years younger than I am, and it’s truly due in large part to the transformative power of the Origins Plantscription eye cream and serum line. I’ve stopped sampling and looking at other eye creams. It’s one of my “if I were stranded on a desert island“ products that I am never without.

Never did I believe this little bottle could bring me such joy, but it definitely delivered! I’m amazed just how fast this under and over eye cream, dab all around your gentle eye area, and presto!! You will be amazed; I am still reeling over these results. My bags are completely gone, moisture plus, fine lines have vanished and more compliments over this simple eye cream than any other treatment I’ve ever used, hands down! Who knew?! I hope this isn’t only a limited edition and they keep delivering this one! Try it, you’ll like it....in a big way!!
review_title: Lives up to its name....and then some!

review_text: I have been looking at this peel for months….. so glad I finally took the plunge and purchased it!  Used it today for the first time and I am amazed at how smooth and healthy my face looks!! It was so easy to use and is packaged perfect for storing until your next use.  It is gentle and the directions tell you what to expect every step of the way.  This was worth every penny and I have only used it once.  I have used many at home peels and this one has been the best by far.  No red or irritated skin…. Just a healthy looking glowing complexion!

I’ve only had a peel from my aesthetician, so this was new for me.  I loved everything about this facial treatment.  It was EXACTLY what Shani said would happen on Instagram.  My skin is glowing and so soft and healthy looking.   This is better than going to get a professional peel.

So far, so good! The acid packs can definitely be used more than once, there’s at least two full face applications in each and the mask only requires a small amount and it’s quite liquid. Mskin looks fresh

Wow! I first tried this a week ago and my skin is still buttery soft. This might replace going to a salon for facials— it’s that good. Easy to use and comes with 6 applications. I look forward to using every 2 weeks.

I have acne-prone skin, with texture, pigmentation, and even a recent breakout. This peel didn’t irritate my skin (even felt a bit more hydrated and healthy after tbh), and gave me a GLOW! No redness, dryness, or peeling. It didn’t solve all my skin problems miraculously in one use, but you can tell that it cleans out your pores and polishes the skin- it has me looking RADIANT! Will def use it frequently and anticipate incredible results over time :)

This is an effective yet gentle peel. Make sure to use a timer and follow the directions to reveal clearer, more beautifully radiant skin! I love the Retinol Reform for maintenance, but use this for a boost!

She’s back baby. Shani Darden knocks it out of the park with this one. This peel is incredible. I have extremely sensitive and dry skin, but like all of her other products, this one my skin can handle. Within one use, my skin was bright and gorgeous. Absolute must have!smooth

This broke me out so terribly! Now, everyone’s skin is different, so that doesn’t mean you’ll have the same unfortunate luck, but I struggle with acne as it is and don’t need any extra help making the red dots on my face worse. Hard pass.

This is really good. Read instructions and follow them. Very easy to use. It will tingle/burn a little, but it wasn’t terrible. Clay mask will begin to get tight, but keep it on as directed. Used warm water to wipe off. Followed with a light skin oil and moisturizer. I use retinol every night and will skip tonight and maybe tomorrow to see how skin reacts. It’s worth it y’all.

This was a lot of fun for an at home facial. The little packs had enough for my sister and I to both use it. There was a slight tingle at first but it goes away pretty quick and doesn’t linger. This was a very luxe experience

This is my first peel ever and I must say it has definitely improved the overall look of my skin. I don’t have any active acne, by my skin’s texture and tone could use some smoothing! After just one application I noticed a great improvement in the smoothness

I love shani Darden. There’s always quality ingredients and I feel like they’re great for my skin. This product just feels very lux overall. It comes with little pods of product and a really nice brush as well as a mask. It’s strong so I have only used it once but I’m looking forward to trying more.

If you have blemishes or even visible pores then this stuff is for you! With the treatment, you will see some kind of difference if you follow the instructions. This is something you have to be consistent with and worth the splurge. I would highly recommend this for acne prone skin or someone with dry, dull skin. Works like magic!
review_title: Must have in your skincare routine!

review_text: I absolutely love this triple acid mask. It is so easy to apply with the included brush (super nice touch) and works well to softly exfoliate the skin. It is a 2 part treatment, the second step being a clay mask to neutralize the acid. Great for drawing out impurities and giving a great glow to the skin.

review_title: Getting a Spa Treatment at Home

review_text: It’s been a few years since I’ve had a spa facial so my skin desperately needed a treatment like this. Right away I knew this would be a strong treatment due to the combination of lactic and glycolic acids. I started using this a few weeks back and so far I’ve had three treatments, and the overall dullness and texture of my skin has improved so much. The very first time I used this, I left the treatment on for only about one minute before my skin started to feel a little irritated, but after that I’ve been able to keep this on longer along with the clay mask. So don’t be alarmed as this may take a few treatments to get used to. My main concerns are textured skin and just overall dullness and this treatment helps with both of those concerns. I know it’s pricey but since you only need to use periodically (weekly or before special occasion) I think this kit will go a long way and will actually make a difference in the appearance of your skin. I know this doesn’t replace a spa facial but it certainly helps resurface skin and give you a glow especially during dry winter months.

I’m someone who gets a chemical peel at least twice a year to help even out my skin tone, so I l love the option of doing this at home!  This left my skin smooth and even toned (I had some redness which is to be expected).

I personally love at-home peels and I was beyond impressed! I LOVE how everything in the box was extremely beginner friendly. The individual Triple Acid Solution Peel comes in pods and the applicator brush makes it easy to apply,  clay mask is separate. My face was literally glowing after using this product! I love it!!

The Triple Acid peel makes my skin look and feel like I’ve had a day at the spa, getting a facial, but I’m able to do it in the comfort of my home! My pores were cleaned out and I was left with glowing, luminous skin! I’m obsessed with Shani Darden’s products and this one is an amazing addition!

Ever since I tried a professional grade peel by an aesthetician, I’ve been wanting to do it again but they’re so costly. This set of 8 is like the price of one treatment, which is great. Plus it has the second step of clay mask. The combo of both left my skin super smooth and glowy. Love it!

A perfect at home peel product to use when your skin needs a pick me up or before a special event. It’s easily packaged with all the steps. It’s hard to get out to get professional peels done living that busy Mom life so a quickie at home option is always amazing. My skin felt smooth, bright and really radiant after just one treatment!

Wow, I love this new product. I overall live the Shani Darden brand, and this new product is no exception. This product feels like you are getting a spa treatment at home. Your skin feels so soft and smooth after one use. I really love that they included a brush in the set to help you spread the product. I also love that each use comes in a single-use packet. It is so easy to use with great results a must-try.

Shani Darden Triple Acid Signature Peel, a two step peel that is perfect after all the holiday junk foods and late nights. It contains glycolic acid, Lactic, and Mandelic acids that helps clear skin conjunctions and breakouts in the first step, then the kaolin and bentonite clay will help clear the pores.  The clay is lightweight like cream. After using it, my skin feels soft and smooth. The kit contains 8 individual pack of the aids, and a tube of clay mask. It will last for months. I am happy to receive this new products and will share them with my family members.

Who doesn’t love a personal spa at home? I loved using this! The next day, my skin was still glowing. I haven’t felt any irritation or had a reaction to it. I will definitely be adding this to my weekly routine!

I’ve been a huge fan of Shani Darden’s products for a long time so I jumped at the chance to try this peel system. As someone with sensitive skin I was a bit nervous. I am a big fan of peels and this at home chemical peel did not disappoint! I really like Shani Darden products and this peel is a new fav! I love how easy it is to use and how it makes my skin glow. I love the effectiveness of this peel! I have gone to many spa days to get this kind of treatment, but being able to treat myself at home. My skin has many ups and downs, and this one is great for my finicky skin.

This is a very quick at home peel taking just 11-12 minutes. It comes gorgeously packaged and with an applicator. The results for me have been quite instant. Dark spots lightened, skin overall brighter and glowing. It has a blend of lactic acid, glycolic, and mandelic acids that retexturize and brighten by chemical exfoliation. To neutralize the kit comes with a kaolin clay mask packed with antioxidants. I found this to be effective but not harsh at the same time and I am really enjoying it once a week on my dry skin type.

I love using chemical peels to exfoliate and keep the skin looking bright. This set comes with a clay mask and peel. I love that the ingredients include glycolic acid, lactic acid, mandelic acid! Easy to use and left my skin soft. I feel like a good peel and clay mask really does help our skin “breathe” better!

I’m only applying it at PM .Light lawyer of Step 1 Triple Acid Exfoliating Peel Solution with brush. Then Step 2 one min later . Since my skin is really sensitive I did test first . Really important to apply sunscreen next day .  Love it .

This was such a cool concept. I like the way it felt and it left my skin so smooth and flawless. Such a great item to use before a big event when you want to glow a bit extra! Make up goes on great on top of it too!

As someone with drier, more sensitive skin, I was a little nervous to try a peel product! This one was a great experience and an incredible value. I’m really impressed with how clean and tight my pores looked immediately after. I also have an all over super softness and brightness- This is just after one use! Incredible to use if you’ve got some texture, scarring, or feeling dull!  Will use once a month from here (8 treatments are included,) really excited to see the overall effect, and definitely worth the price, too! (it comes out to just over $15 per treatment, and with REAL results, that’s fantastic!)

Okay. Let me start off with saying I LOVE THIS MASK!!!! The benefits were amazing, and my skin visibly was brighter and smoother after just one use. Now let’s talk application. I don’t have sensitive skin when it comes to masks having “too intense of a burn or tingle” but this baby definitely was one of the more intense masks I have tried. It wasn’t until step two that I felt “the burn”. I actually contemplated taking it off nearly immediately  because it was pretty intense for me. I thought maybe I didn’t follow directions, because this was more than a tingle. However, I’m glad I powered through because the burn didn’t last super long after the clay portion was fully applied and  I LOVE THE RESULTS! The directions are easy to follow. I applied step one with a brush evenly on my face, then I applied step two. At first I applied step 2 with a brush just to get an even layer, but then I  massaged it  in with my hands to help activate the mask to penetrate my pores more deeply. After rinsing with lukewarm water my face felt smooth, refreshed, and looked brighter. I have a more dry skin type so I plan to only use 1-2 times a month. Overall, I did really enjoy the outcome of this mask. Those who are sensitive to products that “tingle” should definitely be prepared for a semi intense burning feeling.

Let’s talk about this eye cream a little bit. It’s fine. It’s not BAD for my skin, which is why I gave it 3 stars, but it’s also not particularly amazing, either. I’ve been using it for a week and a half in place of my usual eye cream and I’ve seen no remarkable difference to justify the cost of this.Does it provide under eye hydration? Yes.Does it smell nice without a fragrance that’s overpowering? Yes.Is it groundbreaking? No.Is it worth the high price point? In my opinion - no.Looking at the ingredient list, the primary ingredients in this product which do much of anything are water (hydration), glycerin (humectant), shea butter (moisture), beeswax, titanium dioxide, various dyes, corn oil (moisture), mica (shimmer), various forms of tocopheryl (vitamin e), and linseed extract (moisture, vitamin b). With the exception of the shimmer (which is a bit silly in skincare), the others are perfectly reasonable ingredients to see in a moisturizer or cream. But where is that fancy rose extract?Whenever you read an ingredient list, remember that ingredients are listed in order of highest contraction to lowest. All the ingredients I listed are higher up - prior to phenoxyethanol. Phenoxyethanol is approved for use in cosmetics in concentrations of up to 1%. This means anything past it is either 1% or less of the product. Rose extracts in this product do not appear until the 17th ingredient AFTER phenoxyethanol.What does that mean? It means there is very little of those expensive rose extracts in this product. You are primarily paying for water, glycerin, shea butter, beeswax, corn oil, vitamin e, and shimmer. It’s going to be a decent and effective moisturizer, but is it worth the extreme high price tag?Ultimately, you can decide how to spend your money. If you want to feel bougie and like you’re splurging, hey - more power to you. But don’t fall for the shiny claims of the special “signature ingredient“ when there’s less than 1% of it even in the product.

review_title: Super moisturizer!!!! One of a kind

review_text: This mask moisturizes and wakes up my skin! I have sensitive skin and it did not irritate

review_text: I wanted to love this...unfortunately, even my dry skin was made “slippery“ after using this mask. I had a dry patch on my chin, and this mask dried it out so bad it became worse. I absolutely love this mask! I have combination skin with non stop acne. I got this as a 100 point reward and have since purchased the full size. After the first use, I was surprised at how smooth and refreshing my skin was. It was a little bit tingly a few minutes after application. I didn’t give this a five star rating because the smell wasn’t as pleasant. I would recommend this product if you have dry/ acne prone skin.
Literally a life saver! Had a break out so gave this a try from a sample I received. My skin never looked so good and all my trouble spots cleared up like magic!

I actually really like this! I use only the gray and have never had a problem with scabbing or veins. I only use once a week/ every other week.

I’ve been using this once a week for a month and a half now and I have less breakouts and my $$ product absorbs sooo much better. Love using before bed so I can put my hydrating oils and creams on after. Could not recommend enough!
I’ve been using this for about six months now and absolutely love it! My skin looks and feels so much better!!

Still getting the groove of it. I feel I’m moving it enough but then end up bringing pimples I didn’t have to the surface lol. Sometimes it’s easy to get anxious and focus on one area... guilty. But it has been getting rid of my dead skin! I think I need a good face humidifier to use before it that way it’s getting the dead skin easier
So far so good. I started with the small white disc as instructed, and my skin felt baby smooth immediately.

I got this because I was having a hard time controlling my adult acne and enlarged pores. My skin is always dry and oily and feels like nothing gets absorbed. All those reviews saying it left a red/hickey mark is because they kept the machine on at one spot. Just move it constantly and it’ll be fine. Never had troubles with that.

LOVE THIS PRODUCT! It works so well, the video was helpful on how to first the product. It’s an investment, but totally worth it! My skin has cleared (acne) and just has a natural glow to it now. I hardly wear make up- no joke!

I love this product. It does work but it takes some getting used to. The first time I used it I had some scratches from leaving it in one spot too long. This makes your skin feel sooo much softer and smoother after use! I definitely recommend.
Butter soft skin after one use! Dead skin GONE. I have super dry excema patches and lotions wont cure it, I need to get the dead skin removed. This works!
For the price, I would not recommend. After trying this on my oily prone skin on 3 different occasions, I could not tell if it worked or not. Returned.

Does more damage than good-way too harsh on the skin and not worth the money.

I LOVE this! In the past year I have started noticing a lot of sunspots.  I used a prescription from my Dermatologist but didn’t really see results. Using the PMD I have already noticed significant improvement. The tone and texture of my skin has also improved!

This product is amazing if you have cystic acne. After one use I saw a reduction in my pimples. Your skin will be sore for a few days because you’re manually exfoliating the top layer. Make sure to not use any AHA/BHA’s or retinol for a few days after using this. Wish I had known about this sooner!
review_title: I wish I had known about this sooner!

review_text: I have used this about 4x now. I’m loving how my skin is feeling. I’m only sad I didn’t buy it sooner!

Cute packaging, colour etc.

As a Florida native that has always loved the sun ☀️ my skin has had its share of damage at 45.  I am thrilled to have my own microderm tool. review_title: it’s okay, not what I was expecting for the price

review_text: I LOVE purchasing and trying new skincare products but I also know that how I cleanse and maintain my skin is as important as the topical products I use on it. I regularly get facials (once a month) and had noticed that when I started that routine, all my products at home worked better and my skin was much clearer, brighter, and smoother. Still, I have oily skin and have a big problem with dead skin cells buildup in my pores. I have to exfoliate frequently to keep my skin clear or it’s a mess...so being able to add a tool like this into my skincare between facials is a huge bonus! I do feel like I prefer the green discs at minimum (the “moderate” ones) for a good treatment feel. This leaves my skin feeling so nice and I can visibly see gunked up/crusty areas looking cleared up and exfoliated. I immediately follow this with a solid soothing serum, wait an hour or so, and then do a second face wash and whatever treatment/moisturizer I feel like. If you’re wanting to follow with an exfoliating serum after I would use a lighter disc. Anyway, just some tips!

My skin looks GORG. I used the PMD Pro for the first time as my exfoliator step and followed with all of my favorite products! Not only did I wake up GLOWING, but I also visibly saw smoother skin which tells me that the device is working hunny! I plan to use this one a week and I’m confident that it will be a staple in my “self-care“ regimen. I’m falling in love!

I had never gotten professional microdermabrasion before. I’m only on week 4 of using this product, so not sure of it’s full effect (as they say it takes about 8-12 weeks to see). My skin certainly feels smoother after use. And I like the gradations of coarseness. I’m in my late 30’s and some wrinkles lines appeared, this tool is so easy to use, my skin feels so soft and brilliant, a must have

I have used my sisters Kendal at home microdermabrasion machine for two years. We no longer live near each other and for me microdermabrasion is a must! I researched different machines. Skin feels red and irritated after, I put a lot of a really good moisturizer on right after. Next morning skin looks great.

review_text: I got this as a Christmas present and am in love!  It is so rewarding to see all of the gunk that comes off of your face. Seriously love this product, and it takes less than 5 minutes to do a treatment yourself.

In the past, I hadn’t been one to be super concerned or diligent with my skin care regimen; however, when I turned 30, I had this mini life crisis, and got by butt into gear regarding my skin care routine. I been using my PMD since 2015 I love it so much!

I was super skeptical to the point that I waited until it went on sale to buy. I was pretty sure I was going to be returning this after the first use. review_text: I came across this device whilst searching for options to perform microdermabrasion at home.  I tried some recommended creams but they didn’t seem to be making any difference.  I also tried a few facial scrubs to exfoliate but they didn’t seem to that effective so set about looking for a suitable device that might to a more effective job of exfoliating my skin.  Initially nervous about using any kind of equipment on my face, having read other reviews on the PMD I understood for some it didn’t have the desired results but as the majority were very positive I decided to take the plunge and give it a go and judge for myself.  I felt this was a small investment to make in something that would help resolve a longstanding issue as nothing else seemed to be working.  The device was easy to assemble.  It came with various exfoliating disks for the face and body, accompanied by instructions and a training video which can also be found online on the PMD website if you don’t have a disk player.  After watching the video I followed the instructions and initially did a practiced run on my arm using the training disc.  All being well I then did the same on my face just under the chin to get used to the feel of the device.  I then left this for an hour or so to check there were not effects.  As that was fine I then switched from the training disc to the first level disc for sensitive skin which is the grey disc.  When you parse it across the skin be sure to hold the area taut so the device can glide over the skin.  Do not pause at all over the area as you might over exfoliate, just be sure to keep it moving from end to end.  After using the grey disc my face my skin felt tingly.  I could see where the device had removed as the surface looked more matt which is helpful so you don’t go over the same area again.  When I finished treating the skin I lightly rubbed in some facial oil to moisturise.   Been using PMD for the past three weeks and seeing the results.  So far so good!

In my opinion this works just as well as a professional microdermabrasion.    So Easy to use.   Different strengths of discs so you can use on any skin type.   I use it weekly and can definitely feel an improvement in my skin texture.   I use a moisturizing sheet mask immediately after and it’s like a spa facial at home.   Strong enough to see a difference but gentle enough to use weekly.   For me has replaced professional microdermabrasion!  Love it.

Having combo skin and a history of acne in my youth, I have learned to take good care of my skin. Nearly 30 now and my skin is clearer but always had rough patches of milia and black heads. I’m sensitive also so I have to be cautious not to over exfoliate, otherwise I peel. This tool has been the key in the dramatic changes in my skin. My skin is so soft and clear, my oils, creams and serums have a chance to actually soak into my skin after using my PMD. It’s been over a year since purchasing and It is worth every penny and then some. I use it once a week and have gotten the hang of the suction of the tool so it only takes maybe 2 minutes total to accomplish!I’m so pleased I found the PMD a spot in my regimen that helps me keep my finicky skin fresh!

I was previously getting professional microdermabrasion at a dermatologist’s office for about a year. I absolutely loved it, but at $150 a session, I wanted to find a less expensive alternative. I read a lot of reviews on this product and saw that many people said it is very similar to professional microderm. After using this weekly for about 2 months, I would say while it is great for at home use, I can’t say it’s comparable to professional microderm. The professional microderm I got was recommended for every 4-6 weeks, while this can be used as often as once a week. I have pretty sensitive skin and my face would usually end up peeling a day or two after my professional microderm. On my first use of this, I went with the green medium disc. I definitely knew I could go up to the red disc and have been using that since. I really don’t get any peeling afterward even when using the red disc, so it’s clearly not as strong as professional microderm. All that being said, I do think that this exfoliates really well and you are visibly able to see the dead skin cells sloughing off. It helps keep my skin looking smooth and helps to reduce pore size. I do love that you can use the larger discs for other areas of your body which I wasn’t able to have done in the office. Even though in my opinion it’s not as strong as professional microderm, I would still highly recommend it and I’m glad I made the purchase and will continue to use it weekly.

review_text: This night cream is incredible! I had a lot of closed comedones on my forehead and this cleared them up in a matter of weeks. Reading some of these reviews, it’s clear that there might be some misconceptions about this moisturizer:1. This is a retinol product! Retinol products produce turnover in the top layer of skin cells, and clear clogged pores. When those nasty things unclog from your pores, they’re pushed up through the pore and form a blemish. It’s entirely possible that when you start using this product you might experience a purge period where you break out more than you normally might. This is temporary and is just a sign that the retinol is doing it’s job. As with all retinoids, be sure to wear SPF during the day and avoid any harsh AHA/BHA’s or physical exfoliants. 2. This is a night cream so it’s much heavier than anything you might be used to with daily moisturizers. It’s incredibly thick, and a little bit of product goes a long way. Either warm it up in your hands before applying, or apply it over a serum. If you apply it straight out of the jar and onto dry skin, you’re going to use too much product trying to drag it around your face, and will end up with a sticky mess.I worked in cosmetics for several years and have tried tons of skincare. This is the best night cream I’ve found. I hardly ever re-buy once I’m done with a product, but you can bet I always get a new jar of Magic Night Moisturizer. It lasts a really long time, and the results are incredible. Paired with CT’s Magic Cream during the day, you can’t go wrong!

Extracting squalene from sharks is very violent and even illegal in some countries and states. If you buy products that contain squalene, you are contributing to the shark fin trade and shark cruelty. review_text: I’ve been using Dr. Zenovia Hyaluronic Acid + Peptide Serum for about a month and my experience has been pretty good so far. I’m already starting to see an improvement in my gigantic pore size. I’m 35 with combination skin (oily t-zone and dry cheeks), acne scars, dark spots and discoloration, huge pores, textured skin, and early signs of aging. I’m fairly new to having multiple products in my Skincare routine. A year ago I was a cleanse, tone, moisturize kind of girl. Over the past year I’ve been incorporating serums and active ingredient products into my routine, but it’s still all a bit confusing to me. I wasn’t sure at first where exactly to fit this product in since the description says use day or night. I decided to use it at night because I knew my oily skin would look way too greasy after using this product. It definitely gives my skin a shine, which isn’t good for someone like me with acne and textured skin, so I really can’t use it in the morning. Still, I definitely feel like I’m reaping the benefits even though I’m only using it at night. I haven’t seen any incredible changes, but I do notice improvements, and it’s only been a month. One thing I for sure see a difference in is my pore size. They look smaller and aren’t as noticeable as before. I’m really excited to keep using this product to see what results I’ll experience after long term use. It’s a pretty large bottle and you get a lot of product, however, the price tag is absolutely a turn off. I’m not sure if I’ll be purchasing this after my bottle runs out, time will tell.

I loved how hydrated it made my skin but I did not like the sticky feeling it left after I put it on my face and massaged it in. It did help my skins overall appearance and also seems to have helped lighten some long lasting hard to get rid of discoloration from my 6 pregnancies.  Overall I accept the stickiness because the results were so great and will be buying it when this bottle is almost gone. I can’t wait to try some of the other products from the Dr. Zenovia brand !

My first thought when taking Dr. Zenovia Skincare Hyaluronic Acid + Peptide Serum out of its box was “Wow!“ The packaging was very elegant and definitely looked like a high-end product. In terms of the product itself, it is dewy and spreads well on the face. However, it does make your skin feel very sticky for a few minutes after application. Overall, my skin does feel less dry, but I haven’t seen any significantly noticeable changes. I’ve only been using the product for 2 weeks, and will keep using it to see if there will be more improvement!

After trying this product it does make my skin feel a lot lighter, like fresher. But the only thing I do not like is that it does leave your face feeling sticky after applying it. This is a pretty good sized bottle too.

Initially, when I saw the price tag of $72 for this hyaluronic acid + peptide serum, I couldn’t imagine why anyone would spend so much for a skincare product. However, after using this serum for a few weeks, it is now my skincare staple! I have combination skin and noticeable pores (especially on my nose). Within a few days of using this serum, my pores were less noticeable and my skin was so plump and hydrated! I also tried applying the serum before applying makeup, and it made my skin look amazing! I now have a routine where I use Farmacy Honey Glow AHA Resurfacing Night Serum twice a week and Dr. Zenovia Hyaluronic Acid + Peptide Serum twice a week, and my skin looks better than ever!

I was really eager to try Dr. Zenovia Skincare and the Hyaluronic Acid + Peptide Serum doesn’t disappoint. I’ve been using it for just under a month and though I can’t say the difference in my skin is photographable (it’s hard to capture “glow“!) my skin is markedly better. We’re approaching winter months and it’s like my skin hasn’t even noticed the dry heat pumping into the house or the blustery winds outside. Super lightweight and hydrating, and really appears to be brightening my skin. The only downside is that it appears to require commitment to the product, which is a little hard at this price point when there are so many other excellent serums available that don’t quite require extended use to start seeing results. That said though, it’s possible that by the time I finish the bottle I’ll have more dramatic results and will be perfectly happy to buy a second!

So this serum has one of the best and least problematic formulations I’ve ever seen.  Lots of great ingredients, little if any filler or potentially problematic components for the very sensitive. The main beneficial components are hyaluronic acid (hydrating), peptides (*potentially* anti-aging/anti-imflammatory), and bakuchiol ( a natural retinol alternative. I am not as yet convinced of it lol. Or peptides for that matter.) I’ve used it for a bit over a month. For the peptides and bakuchiol, you’d really need more time, perhaps 3 months, to gauge any benefit. I’ve used peptides extensively in the past and can’t say I really saw any benefit, and bakuchiol I used recently for a few months and didn’t notice much if anything either. If anything I think it might slightly irritate me and make me a little redder lol. So, honestly, I can’t really judge any potential anti-aging benefits yet, but I gotta get my review in lol! (I received this product free for review purposes). One thing I have noticed with bakuchiol is that it does seem to have a bit of a pore clearing/purging and slight skin firming effect. I think this certainly works great as a hydrating serum. It spreads easily and absorbs quickly. I always apply anything with hyaluronic acid to my face while it’s slightly damp (it binds water to skin.) But you can get an HA/antioxidant serum for much less. The main reason I gave this 3 stars is the price - I think it’s exorbitant and absurd really for ingredients you can buy separately for much less money. It is convenient to have them all in one formulation, but not for 72 dang dollars lol. First pic is before, second is after lol - not sure if any difference can really be seen.

HOW did I survive without this for so long?! This is the best skincare product in my collections - hands down - and I have tried many a skincare product. This has so drastically changed my skin that I will never go without it again. Worth every. single. penny. AND it smells AMAZING!!

I was recently using Drunk elephant retinol and it was ok, the results were nothing compared to this for my 40 year old face. I will never use anything else again!

I give this three stars because it does have two essential items in it and it might do more good for someone who’s skin is naive to both versus mine. #RetinolVitamimC

Two advices. 1. AVOID USING THIS PRODUCT ARIUND YOUR EYE AREA. 2.USE VERY LITTLE AMOUNT with lots and lots of moisturizer on top. I received this as a sample from Sephora. I was using DE A Passioni for two months and decided to give myself a break. I began to use this sample 2x a week and I am loving it! I have no flaking, no issues, just glass like skin. Definitely buying the full size.

I was using a prescription retinol and found it made my skin very flakey and irritated. I love the Kate Somerville retinol cream, it smells amazing and my skin looks amazing. It’s also soft and the colour is even toned.

A lot of the bad reviews are people going too gun ho on it. You have to get your skin used to retinols. I have very sensitive skin and I started with this one day a week for a few weeks. Then went up to twice a week. I will continue to do that until the end of the summer then go up to 3 times a week. It has worked very well for me my skin has a much smoother texture and I always make sure to wear sunscreen everyday. I will continue to repurchase this. I also like how the actual star ingredients are high on the list, proving they are more active than a lot of other things that have retinol in them.
I love this serum. It’s not greasy,goes on really smooth. Has a light scent of orange. It’s really started to fade my sunspots. Looking forward to see what my skin looks like in another month.

This stuff smells amazing! Like fresh, citrus, orange heavenly-ness. I have noticed a big difference in acne scarring and my skin being brighter since I started using it! I will likely buy it again when I have a coupon.
This actually works. After like 3 months of consistent use my skin looks brighter, more even, and smoother.

This serum sounds like it would be amazing because it’s a three in one with retinol, vitamin c, and hyaluronic acid in the one serum. review_title: Start slowly! It is easy to burn yourself!

review_text: This is the first retinol product I’ve used consistently and love it. I’m on my second bottle. Definitely noticed a difference and to me, it’s worth the price. It has helped with my dark spots and I’ve been very careful to use sunscreen while using the product. My skin can be sensitive and I had no reaction to this.

I actually love this product. This is my third bottle and the only product I feel like I can’t live without. My 46 year old skin is brighter, more clear and glowing. Maybe use it less often in the beginning if you are sensitive to it, but I have found this to be the best retinol product I have used.

My main skin concerns are dark spots, dullness and fine lines and this serum is transforming my skin.  I’ve only been using this nightly for 2-3 weeks and already noticing my stubborn melasma fading and my complexion is coming back to life.  I haven’t experienced the dryness and irritation others reported.  The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is because the scent is very off-putting (there’s a hint of citrus but I can only describe it as lemon yogurt) and I sort of have to brace myself before applying it.
After one night of use, it does smooth some tiny wrinkles magically, but the smell is 100% not acceptable. It smells like old shoes, which makes the application not very pleasing.
Cant say enough. Literally fixed my tires, acne prone, and scarred skin in just a week! I have literally tried everything out there from $700 creams to $50 ones and this one is the holy grail!

However because this is so loaded with silicone, nothing will layer nicely over it, and I ended up with it pilling terribly when I tried to moisturize over it. But if I can’t use an oil and cream overtop of this, it completely defeats the purpose for me. I’m sad I wasted a promo code to get this, and I most certainly won’t be buying the full size. Kate, you can do better.
review_title: Silicone doesn't belong in nighttime skincare.

review_text: I can’t stop laughing at the one star reviews stating their face is peeling and red. Fantastic product. Very very potent. I wouldn’t recommend if you have sensitive skin. I do recommend staggering use of it. I first used it 3 days in a row and my skin started to peel. So I now use it once every 3or4 days and that is perfect for my skin and still highly effective.
review_title: very very potent - not for sensitive skin

review_text: This stuff is really strong. I have never been sensitive to a product like this before.I can only use it once a week or else my skin gets red, irritated, dry and then flaky. If I only use it once a week the results are awesome.

When 2 of the first 4 ingredients are a silicone derivative, one should take note. I used this blindly & faithfully for several months straight. And as I’m sure it helped brighten a tiny bit, I truly believe the cons far outweigh the pros in this product. I have since educated myself in the proper skincare regimen. My educated self, would never ever consider this, as part of my regimen. Ever. I believe the fancy packaging, high price tag & “independent study” claims, give consumers a false sense of security, and blind you from what’s actually going on in the bottle.They are trying to jump on the Vita C train, yet the product stays good for one year after opened, with no expiration date? I do not usually see quality vitamin C products, have a longer shelf life than about 6mo or so. Because Vita C is so unstable. There are so many fillers maybe they help preserve the C? Like processed food?! They can make things last forever, but why would I ever put that on my skin, if I actually cared about it though? The nights I used this, it left my palms feeling extremely dry, rough & oddly. I believe there are so many better options out there, that are made of natural ingredients, have little to no silicone and are extremely effective. I would NOT recommend this product to my neighbors dog.

Best Retinol on the market at the moment!! I just turned 40, I’d been using another retinol since I turned 30. They stopped making it & for the last 3yrs I just couldn’t find anything that worked as well as my previous retinol. This one does. It increases cell turnover 2 fold. You see, as you use a retinol, your skin gets used to the turnover effect. With most retinols, you need to keep going up to the next strength level i.e say from a .1% to a .15% etc, to keep seeing even more cell turnover. My point? I’ve been using this now for 4mths, I use it every other week for 3 days or so, every other day. And every single time, my skin will shed like it’s supposed too, expose the new skin under it and am my skin is not getting used to the retinol!! That’s a huge breakthrough! Good job Kate Somerville. Am hooked! Ladies, don’t be afraid to try a retinol, it really is the holy grail of skin. I don’t use it in the summer at all since I live in TX, the heat is just too much but if you do, you have to use an SPF all the time...learned that the hard way...

Ok I had to read the 1 star reviews and laugh, retinol and Vit C will make your skin peel that’s the point, AND what retinol does!! I use this product at night and ALSO slap on a  great moisturizer on top, and a little peeling happens then I use Exfolikate which helps remove the flakes... this is a great product if you have a good regimen down already!
After two days of use my face start peeling

No makeup covers it except for the red because the peeling will just roll it off on application
