review_title: Retinol and Vitamin C in one.

review_text: This product is great, but you really need to ease into it!  I have used all of the other KS retinol products and also the mega C and never had any reactions.  With this, I had a reaction of raw and dry skin because I started off too quickly.  This is an intense treatment, so you need to start slowly. I would recommend starting once or twice a week and working your way up to more until you can tolerate it well.  The other thing that made a big difference for me was using a good moisturizer on top and that really helped to offset the dryness.  I have been using it for 2 months now and can still only use it every other day, but can see my dark spots fading.  I alternate it with Mega C and Wrinkle Warrior and that is working well for me.  I just turned 50 and my skin is in pretty good shape, considering all the sun I used to get. I attribute this to diligently using high quality regenerative products.  The only reason that I took one star off is because I feel there should be better instructions for easing into the product and sadly, many will never get to experience the good results if they give up on it early.
review_title: Ease into it !! And use a good moisturizer on top!

If you have sensitive dry skin this might be too powerful for you.

I received a sample of this product through Octoly. I didn’t have any bad reactions to it and after using it every night for seven days my skin did appear to be brighter. Love the fresh citrus fragrance but wish it weren’t listed so high on the ingredient deck. Overall, I am really enjoying this addition to the KS line up (my other favorites are the Exfolikate foaming wash and RetaSphere products).

I do not have sensitive skin, but this product makes my face peeling and drying out after just 2 days of use.

Unfortunately after about 3 days I had to quit using it as my face had dry spots and began stripping. Thus I give it  3 stars. I’d recommend it if you use it once or twice a week depending on your skin type.

Used twice and then discontinued when I noticed that it severely dried out my skin. I have been using moisturizer daily in hopes that it will help, but it’s been four days and my skin is still dried out and peeling. I love Kate Somerville’s other products, but this one is just not right for me.

*I received this products free for review through Octoly*I’ve used this a couple of times the past week and have noticed a brighter complexion the following morning after each application. There is a lovely citrus scent and a very slippery texture which gives you that “soft” skin feel. There is silicone and fragrance, so if your skin is already sensitive to those ingredients I would start off using this once every 2-3 days. Retinol and Vitamin C will cause skin sensitivity so make sure to wear sunscreen! Overall it’s similar to other products I’ve tried but silicones do clog my pores, so I won’t be able to add this to my routine.

Ok I’ll have to be brutally honest...what a disappointment!!! I’ve received this complimentary from Kate Summerville for reviewing purposes and it’s just a SAMPLE! With that being said the product itself is pretty good, does not burn or irritate my sensitive skin, it smells wonderful and absorbs immediately, there’s no residue left which is a big plus for me. I do have to use more than usual because my skin just drinks it up and I ran out of the sample pretty quickly so I think I need more than just a few uses for a proper review though...

I received multiple samples of this product and I’ve been using it for about a week. I already love Kate Somerville’s green exfoliating mask so I was very excited to give this a try. My skin is combination and sensitive.  Prior to using this product I was already using a lactic acid and mild retinol product. I used this product in place of my other treatments. I am bad at moderation and rather than only applying this product once a day, I used it am and pm for several days. I now have multiple red, scaly, dry, itchy patches on my face. They don’t appear to be an allergy problem. I’m pretty sure I’ve just over-exfoliated. The product itself is a lovely texture and has a light citrusy scent. I’m going to hold off on using this for a few days to let my skin heal and then try using it only once a day or every other day.

I have heard a lot of great things about this   RETINOL VITA C POWER SERUM and since I am a huge fan of serum I had to test it! Just after first try I already noticed the difference which my skin just drinks in. It’s lightweight and makes skin so soft. Smoothed the texture of my skin, reduced fine lines, and makes my skin look more radiant. Love it!

I received this product as a sample from Octoly. It is a cream base and glides on smoothly. I applied a couple pumps onto my entire face and neck. Although I’ve only used the product for one week, I’ve noticed that my skin is brighter and smoother.
review_title: Brighter and smoother skin after one week of use

review_text: Being someone to used to struggle with cystic acne, I have done my fair share of research on what to and what not to use. Studies show retinol’s are a holy grail for keeping your skin texture and health in top shape. This serum hits the mark with retinol and the added vitamin c. Spreads very easily, little goes a long way, has a nice but not overpowering scent, and really does work. I’ve been using it for about 2 weeks and I have noticed a true difference in the overall evenness and texture of my skin! Definitely will look at this when I run out, it is a little pricey but worth it for good skin!

I received this product as a sample to test from OctolyI’ve been using this Serum for a week and actually I couldn’t tell that I see much difference or result on my skin maybe needs more time to show results, even if it gives a smooth texture but skin goes a little bit dry that’s why I need extra hydration like using after it cream + face oil.

I am a 31 year old mother of 4 and a small business owner so I am under a lot of stress on a daily basis and do not have a lot extra time to spend on my skincare routine. I’ve already started to notice some fine lines, wrinkles and just dulling skin in general, so I’ve been looking for a product to help me minimize these issues and keep me from getting more. When I got the opportunity to be gifted a sample of the Kate Somerville Retinol VitaC power serum to review, I was very excited as I’ve head a lot of great things about the brand from friends and fellow influencers. I’ve only been using this product for about a week and I cannot believe what a difference it has made in my skin already! My fine lines on my forehead have completely disappeared and my skin is GLOWING! I didn’t think one product could make this much of a difference much less this fast! I cannot wait to see the long term results considering how great it’s working already! The packaging is also really great. Not only is it visually appealing but since retinol and vitamin C shouldn’t be exposed to bright light or air the packaging is perfect because the bottle is opaque and air right. It also dispenses the perfect amount to cover my face in an even layer with just one pump so even though the product is a bit on the expensive side it will last a long time with only one pump per use. I love that it’s quick and easy to use and that it has both vitamin c and retinol so it cuts down on the number of steps in my routine. The scent is light and pleasant, it smells sort of citrusy but isn’t overpowering at all it just smells fresh. I have dry sensitive skin and haven’t had any problems with sensitivity and It leaves my skin feeling soft and nourished. I truely believe I have found myself a holy grail product that I will continue to use over and over, and that I can recommend to my friends and subscribers with confidence that they too will LOVE the results.

I have been gifted a sample of this product and really like it! My skin already looks a lot brighter! It definitely works on my skin which is very dull looking. I have sensitive skin and recommend to use it every other day in the beginning to prevent sensitivity. Also always use an SPF in the morning.

Being in my mid thirties, I’m starting to notice fine lines and wrinkles. I’m trying to aim my skincare at prevention, but I’d also like to treat the signs of aging I already have. I love that this serum combines both collagen building retinol and Vitamin C to help fight daily environmental stressors. When I first applied this, I instantly noticed the silky texture and light fresh scent. It feels like it’s immediately working as it has a slight tingle on the skin. I was super excited to see the instant plumping and brightening effect on the skin (I was ooo-ing and ahh-ing in the mirror for a good 5 minutes :). I’ve only been using this serum for over 2 weeks, and my melasma spots are already lightening. I enjoy the light citrus scent, but just be aware of the fragrance, if you are sensitive. This is going to be a new staple in my routine, and it’s going to be added to my VIB sale shopping list! Thank you Octoly for sending me this sample.
review_title: Retinol AND Vit C? Yes Please!

review_text: Retinol and Vitamin C are two of my favorite ingredients ever, so I was thrilled when Kate Somervile gifted me their new serum to test out via Octoly. Super lightweight in consistency- its almost like silk on the skin. This serum sinks in quickly and dries down completely, leaving zero residue. After using this beauty during my nightly routine, I wake up in the morning to refreshed, bouncy and glowing skin. I’ve experienced a significant improvement in my skin’s texture and its overall tone after just a few uses. It smells lovely- a light orange citrus. While I prefer non-scented products, this one didn’t irritate or bother my skin at all. Hylauronic acid has been added to this serum to combat the drying effects of retinol- and it truly works. My combo skin feels totally balanced after using this product. Huge win! The packaging gets an A . I love the airtight pump, as it is more hygienic and will preserve the product’s integrity for a longer period of time. Bonus: It plays well with my other skincare products! Overall, I’m extremely impressed- this Retinol Vita C Power Serum is a dream!

The serum has light fruity scent, it reminds me of oranges. First of all, I appreciate the packaging. Both retinol and vitamin C should not contact with air as this is how they loose their properties. The packaging of the product preserves the contents, that’s great! The serum itself has white lotion-like consistency, it glides easily on my skin and dries down pretty fast leaving velvet finish. I have dry sensitive skin and my skin tolerates this product well. I haven’t been using it for a long time but it feels nice on my skin, ingredients are good and both retinol and vitamin C work well on my skin. I got a sample from Octoly and after I’m done with it, I’ll definitely consider picking up full-size version.

I’ve been really loving this serum. I’ve noticed that my dark spots have been slowly fading away and my skin texture has got better elasticity after continued use. Kate Somerville products always come through!-@blvckmattr

I was gifted a large sample of this to try and give my honest opinion on. I have been hearing lately about the importance of retinol and all that, but I wasn’t exactly sure why or what it did. I saw results using this fairly fast. It smoothes my skin and leaves it more glowy in the morning - almost like a glycolic acid would. I break out very easily and am always worried about disrupting my skincare routine, but this gave me no issues! I would definitely buy the full size bottle and keep using.

I am a total sucker for vitamin C serums and this one by far takes the cake! I love that it’s a retinol and I’ve noticed a difference in my skin. I’m unsure of how the long term use of this product will affect my skin but it does look visibly brighter and doesn’t break me out.I cannot wait to try more Kate Somerville products.

Obsessed with this product from Kate Somerville!! I love that it is a night brightening serum! It didn’t burn or irritate my skin at all and I have sensitive skin. The best part is waking up the next day with smooth glowing skin. Highly recommend this!

I received this product as a sample from Octoly. What I first noticed about this product is that it does actually smell like oranges. It is a cream base and glides on smoothly onto my skin. I applied a couple pumps onto my entire face and neck. Although I’ve only used the product for approximately two weeks now since I only have the sample size and I’ve been applying it every other night. I would like to purchase the large size to see its full potential from a one month use. I’ve noticed that my skin looks brighter in a short amount of time, less dull and more smooth-looking skin.

I received a sample of this product thru Octoly.   WOW what a difference in my skin already! The price point may be high, however a little goes a LONG way with this product. It’s silky smooth feel glides on the skin like butter. I use it in the PM because it does have retinol which can cause your skin to become more red in the daylight because of photosensitivity! Definitely put on SPF during the day to get maximum results so your skin doesn’t develop hyperpigmentation aka dark spots. If you have sensitive skin you may want to work your way up to using this product by only using a few nights a week until you have built up a tolerance to the product.
Really loving this new KS product so far!! My skin is reacting really well to it

I received a sample of this product and am obsessed with the results thus far! It has been two weeks and WOW what a difference in my skin already! The price point may be high, however a little goes a LONG way with this product.  It’s silky smooth feel glides on the skin like butter. I use it in the PM because it does have retinol which can cause your skin to become more red in the daylight because of photosensitivity! Definitely put on SPF during the day to get maximum results so your skin doesn’t develop hyperpigmentation aka dark spots. This is going into my vault of must-have skincare products! I am so happy I was recommended this product- it will not disappoint!

I just started using this serum for about 2 weeks & I noticed results immediately. Although I’m in the peeling phase & I have been breaking out a little more than usual but it’s all normal. I have normal skin with some dryness. The best thing to do when this happens is reduce the use from every night to every other night or every two nights & moisturizing daily 2-3 times will help the peeling not so noticeable. Slowly build up your tolerance to using this serum if you notice dryness or redness. I hate that I’m peeling but I did apply a little too much product to begin with which is not a good idea. Lesson learned. I highly recommend this serum for anyone looking to improve skin texture hyper pigmentation wrinkles and or acne. I’m definitely buying a back up during the Sephora sales since it is pricey. I will do another review after 2 more weeks of using this serum.
I just started using this serum and I can see results already. And I just love the way it smells.
Love the feel of this product and how it makes my skin feel!!

I’ve used this set for about two to three weeks in total, mostly to bed.I’m 46 and going through the change of life so my skin can be all over as far as moisture. this didn’t make me breakout, a plus.the samples are a good size. I find that the serum pump stinks. after the first week, it gives up the ghost as the product is rather thick for a serum, so I scooped out with the cream with the plastic tube. if I wear the moisture serum combo, I find my face sticky and I’m not a fan of that, hence why I wear it to bed. The spray is nice and I use it to refresh my skin if I can’t get to my moisturizer fast enough post shower (I have a toddler).I cannot comment on the smell as post COVID I am no longer as sensitive to such things. There is a scent but it doesn’t last.All in all, it’s a good collection and a reasonable price if you can grab it during that sale to try a new line.

I received this set as a gift. I used it tonight for the first time and I tell you, the smell had me nauseated. The essence was fine. Then I applied the serum and it literally smelled rancid. I thought maybe the moisterizer would be better so I tried that. Believe it or not, the smell was WORSE! I washed it all off and put on my usual SkinFix moisturizer and am currently laying down with an awful stomach ache. No kidding. Do not recommend.

Got excited to open it and try this 6 step skincare, felt luxurious. BUT then, I put it on my face and it smells god awful. I have asthma and I was not expecting it to be this strong. Smells like burning wood mixed with tobacco. Please do not buy this if you are sensitive to scents or it affects your breathing or sinuses. The smell is heavily strong.
I like the mask and cleanser but the the smell on the rest of the products is so strong, it’s almost unbearable. I can’t use them bc the scent is so intense.

$100 for testers … Not worth it at all. I read the comments about the smell, and dismissed them because I’m used to natural products … but this is on another level. They reek … I only used them a few times because I couldn’t stand it. I thought that the products would be bigger, but they are sample size … not worth $100.

Great sample to this line. All of the products are a good size. They smell SO good and my skin feels so soft and glowing after using these products. This sample set has definitely hooked me on this line!!! Good price point for the amount of product you get as well

Great products! However, I was disappointed that the eye cream was not included as part of the kit as mentioned on the description. I did contact customer service and they sent me a new kit but same problem. Sephora needs to update the misleading information on what’s included in this kit !

This is the most luxurious, spa-like, and results driven skincare brand that I have ever used, including medical grade. My skin looks and feels amazing but the sensorial experience and immediate glow after sing this kit was better than the spa facials I’ve dropped $100+ for and for $75, I have several more uses/experiences. I thought surely my sensitive/reactive skin (because I use prescription Tretinoin) would likely experience some redness and irritation, but to my absolute joy, this kit actually calmed and reduced existing redness. The exfoliation is effective but gentle. I can no longer use TLC Framboos, Good Genes, etc. because they are too aggressive for my skin now that I use Tretinoin. The mask gave the glow without the irritation (only left on for 5 min.). I actually ordered full size products of a few from the Tata website because I love it all that much. I’ve tried enough skincare and am familiar enough with my skin and it will let me know almost immediately if something isn’t compatible. I’ve hesitated on this line for over a year given the price point, but it is well worth it. My husband even let me give him a facial for the first time ever because I was like, “Dude, you have to try this!” I don’t intend to sound obnoxious because this is just skincare after all, but seriously, I’m kind of bummed at all the coin I wasted on other brands. I’ve been doing the whole clean and fragrance-free for 2 years and this was my last attempt at skincare before a basic moisturizer and cleanser and investing in Dermatologist treatments instead. I will use it for the glow and Zen-inducing experience alone. Got me feeling fancy, darling. Tretinoin will do the bulk of anti-aging if the serum doesn’t - definitely too soon to tell. On a separate note, a deluxe sample of the Water-Lock moisturizer that I chose with this order caused my face to immediately flush when I applied it a few hours later. That’s likely a no-go, but everything in this particular kit was heavenly.

These products are amazing! My skin has never looked better. The serum and the moisturizer do have horrible smells but it’s gone very quickly. It honestly doesn’t bother me because of how amazing they are. My skin looks so smooth and healthy with less discoloration. I will most likely buy these full size products despite the hefty price tag.

Love this product and it made me want to buy more however there are some issues with this kit. It shows 6 products but you only get 5, no resurfacing mask is included. Also, the serum only comes half full so just use small amounts.

This set is a great way to try out all the Tata Harper products. You can tell her products are very high quality. The only problem is that you’ll want to purchase them all once you run out. There wasn’t one product I didn’t love.
review_title: Great way to try out the entire line

review_text: This is too heavily scented. The scent is not even a nice scent too. It makes me nauseous. Please Tata Harper, remove the scent from all your products. Not worth the price honestly.

Pro: It was heavily scented, but it did not irritate my skin. My face felt great when I used the mask before doing the rest of the steps. It made me feel rich.  It lasted 4 weeks for me with just nightly use. The first day I thought my skin looked amazingCon: it was just okay. I think this set works better for people closer to oily skin. The cleanser has a physical exfoliant, and I started to hate using everyday. The moisturizer is very thin and watery. I noticed that my skin started flaking on my forehead even after doing all those steps. But my skin did great once I used the oil ALL over my face as well. I’m also not sure if the essence really did anything for me. I think i wasted a lot of it since it is a spray and I kept missing my face because I had to close my eyes. All in all, I don’t regret trying it, but I will not repurchase or get the full size items. I will just go back to using Fresh and only having to do 3 steps max
review_title: Spa like experience, but maybe not for dry skin

review_text: I absolutely HATE the smell of the serum . It is kind of grandmotherly smelling . I don’t want my face smelling like that.

Game changer, love this set! I was in the market for a full skincare overhaul and wanted to try something new. I’ve loved every single product in here. My skin looks and feels so different than it normally does, but for the better.
I was disappointed because on the description it says that includes an eye cream and the package came with no eye cream.

The resurfacing mask is one of the best masks out of the at least 50 I have tried in the last few years. I have VERY sensitive oily skin that needs exfoliating often. I barely NOTICE this mask is on, and my skin has nearly no texture after. UNFREAKINFBELIEVABLE. I am splurging on the big one some day soon, that is an investment I am willing to make. The scrubbing cleanser is the same, best. I. Ever. Had. And I love the smell. Serum soaks right in, moisturizer is a tad on the greasy side but I refuse to complain, I’ll use it as a night cream. QUALITY LADIES. QUALITY!!!
Super tiny bottles, two of them did not work, have to open the top and pour out the liquids. terrible

This was a great set to try out Tata Harper’s essentials. While the fragrance is strong, it’s herbal, which I don’t mind. All the fragrances of products seem to work well and balance each other out. I loved the serum. I was happy to have tried it before committing to it.

First, as another reviewer stated, this does NOT include the eye cream. I complained to Sephora about that and they sent me another kit AND refunded my money. Excellent customer service!I’ve been using this product for a few months now and have visible results. I was using Tatcha faithfully and while it was a good regimen, it wasn’t fantastic. I’m 50 and have been moisturizing since I was 17 (thanks for the advice Grandma!) so I have very little lines but hey nature is catching up :) I’m very fair and have a mild case of rosacea so have very sensitive skin too. These products caused no irritation aside from a minor acne breakout which always happens when I change skin products. My skin is brighter, smoother and my pores have virtually disappeared. My friends comment that my face always looks freshly washed and I’ve had complete strangers ask me what I use. It’s not break the bank expensive and I really love the “green” smell of the repairitive serum. Wonderful products, thanks!

this is advertised as 7 step regimen, but the box you get is 6, and marked as 6, the eye cream is missing. Fix your images and correct the listing please. The products seem nice so far, I do not mind the earthy fields of grass smell.

I wanted to like this, but unfortunately my skin did not. I have sensitive skin and having an all natural product was what prompted me to purchase. My face broke out with hard under the skin blemishes.
Strong flowery scent. Used it for two weeks straight and no noticeable results. Overhyped

It’s rare that I love every product in a kit like this, but I love all of these. They all smell SO good (like roses and citrus). The retinol oil is easy to apply, doesn’t feel greasy, doesn’t irritate my skin. My skin looks and feels glowing after using it for a few days. I will definitely be buying full sized Tata Harper products from now on. Worth the price!

Enneagram 4... buy this. buy two. I’ve never seen a bottle this beautiful. I’ve never smelled anything this perfect. My skin is as velvet as the voice of Lianne La Havas. I glow like Christina Ricci in Sleepy Hollow. This is the most bougie organic scientifically botanicalized hippy skin care you will ever want and they make it in Vermont! I could bathe newborn sheep in this and they would grow up to be silk worms. 6/5 stars.
review_title: green is gold. robert frost? buy this.

review_text: I’ve tried this kit a couple of times while trying to decide if I wanted to invest in the full sizes of the products.  It’s a good travel kit, my skin reacted well for the most part but I wasn’t a fan of the hydrosol and also found the moisturizer wasn’t “enough“ although everything does smell wonderful.
I am so disappointed in this kit.  The scents are so overpowering and it makes me break out.  I really wanted to love this brand.  They seem to have a great mission, but it’s just not for me.
I was really disappointed I don’t know how to use two of them it like there the same thing.

I bought this kit because I’ve been wanting to try Tata Harper for quite a while but couldn’t bring myself to spend that kind of money when there are so many products that work very well and cost far less. It’s been three days since I started using these products, and WOW! These products really work. My skin looks fantastic! I might have to break down and spend a small fortune on full size bottles!

It’s a great starter pack to try out the different Tata Harper products. These were much smaller than I expected but some of the pump bottles lasted me a good 2 weeks of daily use. I personally liked the regenerating cleanser and resurfacing mask; will definitely purchase the full sizes! The moisturizer and essence were okay for me. If you’re not ready to splurge on Tata Harper products, this is a great start to know what you want.
review_title: Try it out, Repurchase your Faves

review_text: Wrinkles started disappearing within a week. Skin feels incredibly smooth and hydrated. I’ve compared Tatcha and other top brands with Tata. On one side of my skin I wash with Tatcha and on the other I wash with Tata. Tata wins all the time, because my skin feels so much softer and hydrated. Tata is a winner for the best hydrated skin and diminishing wrinkles. I have sensitive skin and combination skin. Tata is the best I have tried for my skin concerns.

I read all the rave reviews and decided to give this line a try.  Not a fan.  The smell is very powerful (I didn’t mind it so much but I could see how others would find it overwhelming).  The moisturizer was useless on my dry skin and the serum did nothing.  Only product I liked was the cleanser as it’s exfoliating but still not worth the price tag for me.

I really love Tata Harper. I bought this set so that I can have products with me when I travel. I travel about 4-5 times a year and this lasted me throughout the year! Maybe even a little more than a year? I just love the scent and I love that it’s all natural yet STILL EFFECTIVE. I only give this 4 stars because it is a pricey product but... you get what you pay for! :)
review_title: You get what you pay for! Love Tata!

review_text: Good value for money overall.Scent is okay, more herbal than floral.Moisturizer could be a bit more moisturizing - would recommend it for summer rather than fall/winter/spring.Unpleasant surprise the eye cream sample that is listed in the description of this kit was >NOT< included.Does not make he weather, given that the sample was so small, but the advertisement should be corrected.

This set truly resurfaced my skin more effectively - and with more noticeable results - than any topical regimen I have ever experienced. (If there is one please message me I’d love to know about it! ) I’ve had the Fraxel laser procedure done a few times. For at least a month afterwards, the skin looks noticeably brighter, smoother, softer, and plumper with imperfections blurred. This kit affected my skin in the same way with similar results. While I am not claiming that it replaces - or performs on the exact same level as - something like a professional laser treatment. What I am saying is that after using this kit for only a few days (yes, days), my skin began to remind me of my post-laser skin. I received compliments on the quality of my skin while using this, much as I did after the Fraxel. I can’t believe this kit isn’t constantly sold out tbh...The opportunity to a) try an entire resurfacing skincare regimen; b) for a higher-end (imo) brand like this; c) which will last for at least a month; d) for under $100 is insane to me.*I took 1 little star off because I feel like the moisturizer could have been more intense.
I am a huge fan of tata, and i got this sample box for my bestie and she absolutely loved it!!!!!

Absolutely love this kit as it is luxury ingredients at a relatively affordable price. Each piece in this kit works wonderfully at exfoliating, but also nourishing and moisturizing the skin; my oily-normal skin loves it. Best part: it doesn’t break me out. Here’s a quick review of each piece in this kit: 1- eye cream: being in my mid-20’s, eye cream is just eye cream. This wasn’t anything overtly special, but I was not able to get a good opinion on this product due to the fact that I could only get 2-3 uses out of it. 2- Cleanser: good physical and chemical exfoliate. Most physical exfoliants break me out due to their abrasive nature, but this has the right amount of grit. I use a peanut sized amount on my whole face after my first cleanse and my skin is left feeling like it can breathe (after wearing makeup all day).3- essense: probably the “smelliest“ of product in this kit. it’s very refreshing and make the rest of the products glide on evenly. Would not use over makeup due to it’s smell and moisturizing effect. 4- Serum: beautiful rich and creamy serum that sinks into the skin. 5- Moisturizer: a creamy yet liquidly moisturizer that smooths out skin and leaves the face looking and feeling plump and supple. 6- Oil: the best product in this kit. Maximum impact with minimal effort. Leaves skin feeling exfoliated yet balanced. 7- Mask: not beginner friendly. Thankfully I’ve used this product before so I know that it really packs a punch. For me my skin is so exfoliated that it often takes a day or two for it to become calm and even (for about a day my face is a bit puffy and red). Afterwards though...omg...my makeup sits beautifully, plus my pores are smaller. Any breakouts also dimish. Overall: amazing. 10/10 recommend

I wanted to love these products so so much because I’ve only heard good things. However, within 3 days of using them, I had clogged pores, rougher skin texture, and breakouts. I’ve been pretty breakout-free for about two years now, and I’m realizing that it must be due to using products without any intense fragrances/essential oils. I’ve been using mostly Herbivore and Laneige products, and mixing these products in gradually sent my skin into remission from the very smooth and soft skin texture I’ve been able to improve on. I do think the resurfacing mask is great, but the other products just didn’t work for me.
review_title: Wanted to love, but made me break out :(

review_text: Love this set! I have concerns about aging skin and wanted to try something new. I also wanted the products to be earth - and animal - friendly, so settled on Tata Harper. Given price tags, this was the best way to try a number of the products at once. I saw a difference immediately, with my skin looking fresher right away. I’ve since purchased all the products individually.
Good way to sample all the products. I really enjoyed the mist, serum,  moisturizer and oil. The mask were alright... I have these for travel mostly.

Sad to say this broke me out. I was really excited to try this and thought the best way to see how it works was to get travel size. I’m almost out of everything after a little over two weeks and have 6 pimples. I don’t break out unless my skin doesn’t like a product. Such a bummer. Most enjoyed product would be the cleanser although I’m not sure it did anything great, it did smell like fruit loops which was fun.

This purchase was a huge disappointment for me because this was my first ever Tata Harper purchase and I wish i’d save my $75 and not purchased this. The only think I liked using in this purchase was the face wash and everything else was just useless

Read many good things about the Tata Harper brand and personally love all things clean, natural, and organic when it comes to beauty. Bought this kit to try out her product line, but man oh man does this stuff’s floral perfume knock you back. Some floral scents I can handle, but this line is floral-in-a-bad-way, like the musty potpourri aisle in the back of a small town craft store. The essence spray is tolerable (and I find myself continuing to use it with other clean beauty products I’m testing out), but once you factor in the perfumed serum, moisturiser, and oil, it’s just way too much. The scent also lingers for hours, so even if I did enjoy the effect of the products, I couldn’t just “tough it out.“ Wanted to love but *Simon Cowell voice* it’s a no from me.
review_title: Gagging from the Overwhelmingly Floral Smell

review_text: I love this set! I went to a Tata Harper event nearby and loved everything I tried. I wanted to get this so I could give it a few days. This set I have used twice a day for a week and there is still so much product left. I have only ran out of the eye cream.
Makes my skin glow and smells fantastic!!!

I used this product in it’s entirety and my skin is *amazing*.  I’m 3 months post partum - always had clear skin  pre pregnancy - and this made my skin glow.  At first, I wasn’t sure it was doing anything and was quite annoyed by all the steps but after a few weeks, I could walk around bare faced and look great.  My skin was clear, smooth, and even my undereye area looked improved.  I purchased the full size version of the serum, cleanser, and moisturizer.  Can’t use the oil as I realized it has vitamin A which is not good for breastfeeding :-\

This kit is a great way to sample a bunch of products from this line without commiting to the price tag of the full size versions. The standout items to me were the mask, the cleanser, and the serum. The others are nice too, but I know I’ll definitely be purchasing the full sizes of those three first. While these are smaller sample sizes of the product, there’s still enough for you to use consistently for a while so you can really decide if you want to buy more. I use these products at night and tatcha products in the morning, so this kit will probably last me at least a few weeks.

I bought this set to take on vacation with me and while I enjoyed it quite a bit, the sizes of everything are SO small, I simply can’t justify that it’s worth the steep price. There is a decent amount of all of the products except for the cleanser which was used up almost immediately while I still had plenty of the other ones. Felt kind of jipped to be honest!
In LOVE with all things Tata. Zero Wasters out there, comes in plastic packaging. I was disappointed to see this. Tata Harper, you know better. The full size products seem to be packaged sustainably.
review_title: Love all things Tata, minus the plastic

review_text: The product itself is good, but these samples went really quickly! I tried to use only a little bit, but a pump hardly covered my face. I DO recommend the face scrub and will definitely be buying that again in full size.
review_title: Good products, but does not go a long way.

review_text: Super sensitive /combo dry skin here and this worked, Murad has been my regular wanted to try something new. Moisturizer and oil has interesting strong planty smell, but it fades quickly. LOVE the serum and resurfacing wash. Not a big fan of the toners smell. Didn’t break me out or dry my skin. The oil I use at night; even with my dry skin it needed to be washed off in the am. This is definely a trial size. Lasted 7 days of am and pm washing.
Way way way too perfumed.  I know this is supposed to be a clean product but it is so scented it gave me a migraine.

First off, I love clean skincare that is cruelty free so was excited to try this kit. Secondly, I found that the size of the samples in here are too small to really do them justice. Thirdly they are in glass not making them travel friendly. Lastly the prices seem a bit steep for what you’re getting. I recommend going with the brand 100% Pure or Youth to the People. I’ve also had a lot of success with Biossance too

I bought this after receiving an in-store facial by a Tata Harper rep. My skin looked glowing that day, so I went back and purchased. There are a few products in this kit that I love and a few that are just okay. I love using the cleanser and mask together. They did this during the facial and it was good. I also like the oil a lot. I have used kit for about a month and really saw no difference and it’s not moisturizing enough for my super dry skin. I have found they have another moisturizer that may be better for dry skin, but it is SO expensive. I will most likely try the cleanser/mask combo again.

Thanks to this kit, I became a Tata Harper fanatic. This kit changed my entire skin regime. It makes my face glow. I have spent over 8000 on skin products and skincare and this brand us the best I have ever used. I have the entire line thanks to this kit. Definitely recommend it. It will change your skin.
review_title: The best skin I have ever had

review_text: I needed a kit for an extended stay away from home and I wanted to try Tata. It turns out Tata Harper is not for me. I don’t enjoy the strong fragrances nor the grit in the cleanser. I didn’t like the finish of the Serum and Moisturizer. The Spray is lighter with a more pleasant fragrance but did not have a significant effect.  The Resurfacing Mask was the only product I enjoyed.

I’ve been wanting to try out Tata Harper skincare and this was the perfect set. Although I wish the sizes where a bit larger..given the price and all. ALSO the eye cream sample is a bit of a joke...However I love the scent of these products. The retinol face oil is awesome I love the applicator and that it’s so small and cute. My skin has improved a lot since using and Ive been able to get about a month or two worth of use..but I don’t use it everyday. I have super dry skin so I supplement with a stronger moisturizer. Favs: retinal face oil, facial cleanser and essence

Beyond impressed with this skincare line! The price tag is high but it is worth every penny. My skin has never felt softer or looked more radiant without makeup. And a little product goes a long way. The best part is the scent! Its a fresh, floral scent without it being overpowering or artificial (yay clean ingredients!) Save your money and purchase some Tata Harper products, your skin will love you for it.
I didn’t like this product on my skin. And didn’t find it worth the money for me. The smell wasn’t my favourite. Also felt heavy on my skin and made it feel greasy.

I have been a fan of the oil cleanser so I wanted to try some other items. I must admit that I used up every last drop of everything and purchased almost all in full size as a result. I especially love the exfoliating cleaner, rejuvenating serum, resurfacing mask, and face oil. I didn’t think I would love the scent of the items, because it’s much more scented than I normally use, but I have to admit they’ve grown on me especially since they dissipate after a bit. I’m still not sure if there is any difference with the floral essence other than a lovely scent. Will try the routine without and see how it goes. Otherwise, I am very happy to have this kit to try the items before making the cost commitment with the full size products.
review_title: A great value to try Tata Harper products

review_text: I was so excited to try this kit! I am sorry to say that I was very disappointed once I tried it. The eye cream only had enough for a few applications which is not enough to tell if you like or dislike a product. These products were very drying to my skin and quit using it before they had all been used. Too expensive for the results.
Love these products and this was a great way to try them out.  Wish there was more eye cream but everything else was a good size and a full regime.  Products are amazing!!!

Seriously adore this set! Anytime I use it my husband tells me that my skin looks beautiful. It does not make me break out or cause irritation like other skincare does. Glad I tried it! I am going to purchase the large sizes now.
Would totally be 5star..... but the serum an moisturizer smells awful when I use this with my skin routine but I guess I can get used to it lol but I love the mask soooo much
Again a huge thanks to both Stephanie Nicole and Caroline Hirons these products are superb. Thank you ladies!!!
great way to try tata harpers line! absolutely love it! ready for my regular size items now :)

To be completely honest I am sadly very disappointed by this kit and the products. I was really looking forward to trying this kit to improve my complexion but found it very underwhelming.  For off, the $100 price for tiny sample sizes I found unreasonable. The sizes contained in this kit are the same sizes you receive when cashing in points as you checkout. I have very mild acne breakouts and I noticed the use of this product actually made me breakout more. If you have blemish prone skin I would not recommend this product. I also found the resurfacing mask to do the exact opposite of hydrating. It actually dried my skin out more. I was really rooting for this product but unfortunately disappointed not only with the product but also with the very expensive price tag.

If you’re looking for a new skin regimen, look no further! I’ve been making through the every skin care line they sell at Sephora, I’ve finally found one that might stick for the long haul. It also helps that the products smell amazing.
Expensive but awesome. It smells incredible!

I always prefer to go the less toxic route for my skincare and was really hoping to love something from this line. There was not one product I was impressed with. I found most of the products kind of harsh. I think these products are geared for younger women.
I loved how moisturizing this kit was, but the formula was a bit too heavy for daytime use. Blotting sheets were my best friends. However, this kit was divine for nighttime use!

This set is a steal!! Just their eye restorative cream is $126! But for $93 its a great little set to try out. The bottles are also re-fillable so great for travel time! I have gotten the set for my mom who is 59 and I have been using the samples and I LOVE the oil, cleanser, cream and eye cream! I know a lot of people may not like the scent but I like natural smells and this smells straight out of a garden. I am 28 years old, have dry olive tan skin. I especially love the cleanser - leaves my skin hydrated, bright and SOFT!

Loved being able to try this line at a more affordable cost. My main disappointment is that the eye cream sample only gave me two uses, which was not enough for a fair trial in my opinion (especially when paying for said trial). Otherwise, loving most of the products, especially the cleanser and mask!
I’m 46 years old and  have rosacea that flares up regularly, leaving redness that lasts for weeks - after using just a drop of serum

I noticed improvement the first time I used her products. I received this kit from my best friend for Christmas. She is a licensed esthetician. I LOVE all these items plus others and they are great! The smell is wonderful --not over -powering like some others described. Does wonders for my always dry skin except when I use Tara’s products. Holy grail for sure!
review_title: LOVE, love, love!! Can't say it enough!

review_text: I rarely write reviews, but this is one product worth writing about. It helps to talk about my skin type. I used to have pretty oily skin, but I’ve been on myorison (generic for accutane). It’s cleared up my skin, but done a number on my skin as well. I know have extremely dry skin. I’ve tried several products and nothing has cured the dryness. I decided to try this kit, I figured I had nothing to lose. I have to say every single product has worked. My skin is not only hydrated, but looks amazing. I’m so happy to have found Tata Harper. Yes it’s pricey, but the way it makes my skin feel is totally worth it to me. I say give this kit a try!!!
review_title: AMAZING, I’m in love with everything.

review_text: I purchased this during my search for a new skin care line. This set seemed to have everything but overall left much to be desired. The eye cream only lasted two uses, the cleanser is basically an apricot scrub that shouldn’t be used 2x day, the essence smelt awful, and the mask didn’t do anything for my skin. The search continues...

This kit is at fault for my love of Tata Harper, since buying this I have repurchase the moisturizer and the mask. If I could I would buy it all! But the high price in the products just made me pick favorites !I recommend this if you are interested on trying out the brand, as the products will last you about 3-4 weeks.
Love this kit. My skin looks and feels amazing! Easy you apply.

This is how I can afford to use Tata Harper.  I LOVER HER PRODUCTS, but they are expensive.  So I buy kits, buy when stores have gifts with purchase, get samples, and twice a year Tata sells travel sizes of her products on her website and I stock up.  I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE the Regenerating Cleanser and won’t be without it.  Another product that I love is the Retinoic Nutrient Face Oil which I also won’t be without.  I love everything in this kit.  Love the fact that the products are natural, love the scents and my 67 year old skin loves them.  The kits lasts me because I alternate my skincare with ARCONA and Sunday Riley.
This is my new holy grail for skin care! I see results, it smells amazing...what more can I say? I love it.

I feel like this was a pretty good way to sample these products, although there wasn’t enough of the eye product to really tell if I liked it or not. But this kit has lasted me a couple of weeks and my skin is glowing so I’m definitely happy with it. The hydrating floral mist smells a little weird, and not at all like I thought it would based on the name, but it works well and the smell goes away.

I’d heard a great many wonderful things from this company; natural products that do wonders and feel great. I purchased the kit as a way to get to know this company’s offerings and overall wasn’t disappointed. The packaging is lovely and easy to dispense. Aside from the eye cream, of which there wasn’t enough for even one application, there was enough for a few weeks of use.  Which I thought was odd, since there was a sample of an oil that I could do without in my regimen. And eye cream would have been a wiser insert into this kit. It was easy to use and I used all the products several times. I usually break out with new products but not even during my PMS cycle did I get one blemish! That’s a big seller for me.  The cleanser was just the right amount of exfoliating and the serum and moisturizer were great too. Light but enough for my aging skin ; day and night. My only negative here is the scent. It’s really my first foray into the All Natural Skin Care Product lines and it could be that unfamiliarity, but my family said it smelled funny and it put my hubby off quite a bit. (He’s sensitive to fragrance.) So while I liked the products overall, the scent of the toner and moisturizer especially are off putting a strong enough that I’m not sure if purchase it again. So if you’re not sensitive yo smell or can get to a Sephora where they carry the line OR can get a sample first, this is worth the trial kit price before you buy.
review_title: A great way to get to know TaTa Harper

review_text: I wanted to love these products and tried really hard but unfortunately they broke my skin out horribly! I have normal/dry skin and it’s very clear, I rarely get any breakouts. After using these products my face broke out horribly and it took weeks to clear it up. I used this specifically so I would know what effects it had and sadly it was not good.

I tried this collection to see which products I might want to invest in for the full size product. I ended up loving a few--the cleanser, moisturizer, rejuvenating serum, and eye cream. I noticed after using these products every day that my skin felt more moisturized but not greasy, and looked more youthful and smooth.

I love the smell of this product, I wanted to love it. I didn’t. The eye creme was way too small of a sample to really notice if it had any impact, 2x use max. The rest of the products were average and the moisturizer was not much of a moisturizer. I needed to use the oil on top of it for any benefit.

This was a great way to try a lot of new products at once. The only thing in this kit that I had tried before is the mask, which I love and already own in full size. I really liked the cleanser in this kit as well. The other products really didn’t do it for me. Here’s why...the serum and moisturizer were so highly frangranced that they continually made me sneeze. I don’t have sensitive skin and fragrance doesn’t usually bother me, but these did. I could smell the product on my face 4 hours later. The oil is ok, but definitely not anything special, or any better than oils I already have. I’m neutral to the toner mist. If I would have kept the kit I would’ve used the mist, but would not repurchase. I decided to return the kit since the only things I really liked were the mask (which I already own) and the cleanser.

Tata Tata...As much as I love this product ( because it smells sooo good) you have completely missed out on its main purpose: MOISTURIZE!  I think you got so carried away with its floral smells that you forgot to deliver its primary purpose. I don’t think people are buying it so they can smell like flowers. If I want to smell them I ll go to the garden but instead i need to moisturize my skin and I went ahead and bought the kit. Next day my skin was untouched. Even though I tried all the moisturizers none of them did anything. Absolutely dry skin and not even a little softness to it. You need to reformulate it so it does what a typical cream is supposed to do, especially for the price you have given it. Once again- I need to hydrate my skin I don’t need to smell like flowers without chemicals...I can get that anywhere. Sorry but unless this product is  reformulated it is useless and an absolute waste of money.
review_title: No moisture. Who needs to smell like flowers!

review_text: I have atopic dermatitis and I am very cautious about what I put on my skin. I bought the kit because it is free of toxins and to my surprise I love every product in it. Unlike some other reviews, I love the smell of the products. I feel like I am at the spa every night. I only use the product once a day, rather than two, to keep my skin from being overly dry or washed and instead I use a make up removing towelette in the morning to gently wipe my face. I’ve learned that it is so important to be mindful of what we are putting on our skin and ultimately in our bodies. The Face Wash is gentle enough to keep me from breaking out excessively, the toner is a must if you want to restore the ph balance in your skin (keeps me from being too oily) and the moisturizer and serum are added bonuses to nourish the skin. The face mask is great, you can feel it tighten without cracking and it leaves a cool breeze feeling. When I use these products I don’t want to wear my makeup, it leaves me feeling brand new :).  Everyone’s skin is different, if this product doesn’t work for you, I’ve heard great things about Tatcha. Remember, how you care for your skin is more important than the makeup you cover it up with.
Products had the most awful smell and gave me a serious breakout. Not pleased at all.

I ordered this kit because I liked the sample of the regenerating cleanser I tried previously. I can’t stand the smell of the serum and moisturizer so this has been a waste of money for me. I would buy the cleanser but none of the other products.

These products are amazing! My skin is glowing since starting to use these products. The moisturizer, serum and toner go a long way. Eye cream ran out after a few days. The serum has a pretty heavy scent to it that bothered me initially, now I don’t even notice it. Highly recommended!!

Really wanted to love this, but.... First of all, they are literally just samples! Really small size and packaging is cheap. Then I tried almost every items (except the eye cream). Hate the smell, and does nothing for my skin. I felt dry after one hour applying them. I had high expectation for this product since it’s so expensive, but it definitely not worth the money, going to return it. I have combination to oily skin, might work for dry skin though, not sure.

This kit definitely restored some life back into my face. Very hydrating and leaves face glowy and soft after a few applications. The mask is great after regular use. The only drawback is the price. However, it’s a high end beauty line and I can see why.

After having a bad couple of years (brain surgery, 2 devastating miscarriages) I decided to change some things in my life--including ridding my cosmetics and skin care collection of anything with toxins. I figured whatever I could do to make myself healthier, I would try. I had read about Tata Harper’s non-toxic line and decided to try this kit. Immediately my skin felt great after the first day. Within 3-4 days, I noticed my rosacea had cleared up. I have been plagued with rosacea for 5 years now but a week since I started with this line it is almost completely gone. I have only been using this trial set and am 7 days in. There is really a lot of product here--you will run out of the cleanser and eye cream first. I ended up ordering some other Tata Harper cleanser (not part of this kit) and also loved it.If you are looking to try this line, this kit is really a great price and you can see if you love the product. For me with my rosacea that hasn’t been helped by ANYTHING, this has been great.Sephora, please start carrying more of her line!!!

I love Tata Harper’s makeup so I figured I try this. Not impressed at all, other than that it’s all natural.  I didn’t find this any better than most less expensive skin care lines and it doesn’t even come close to what I currently use. Regenerating Cleanser - This is an exfoliator. The granules are way to harsh for exfoliation. It feels like sandpaper on my face, which would definitely cause damage to my skin rather than fixing it. I didn’t have any brightening or smoothing to my skin, it just felt dry and was very red after. Resurfacing Mask -  This is a gel mask. It dries very quickly on the skin, so I don’t think there is long enough time for the ingredients to really have a benefit. I did not have any improved brightness or softness. Replenishing Nutrient Complex - This is a moisturising oil. This one seemed to be the best thing out of the whole box. But the product is applied by a roller ball - not my favourite way to apply anything. You have to roll it on to your finger then dab it on because using the rollerball directly on your eye would cause to much pressure to that area. The one good thing about this packaging is it is travel friendly, so it would be good to have in your purse to apply throughout the day if you feel dry. I don’t think this is good enough to replace the oils I already use though as I did not find it very moisturising. Hydrating Floral Essence - There are so many moisturising sprays and I don’t think this one is any better than less expensive options. Plus it seems to defeat the purpose of the oil - both are meant to be used as on the go moisturisers that you take with you, so I don’t see the purpose of having both. It can be used as a setting spray, but I actually found my makeup wore off faster when I used this. I didn’t bother with the other 3 items in this kit because I didn’t like the 4 I did try so that was enough for me to return this. All 7 items would have to be great for the cost to be worth it.

Be prepared to completely change your skincare routine because this kit is incredible! I used every product and had about a month of use of the main ones (moisturizer, serum etc). I have since purchased most of them in full size. The mask transformed my skin and the essence is just a treat for the senses. Can’t say enough good things about this brand and the effective and natural products!

This travel kit is just perfect for everything you could need for your skincare routine and because it’s all natural you know anywhere in the world in whatever climate these products won’t harm your skin in any way. I love these because it leaves me with not having to worry about how to carry the bigger bottles and each little jar is a healthy food for my skin.

I watched the video & made up my mind to love these products & that they would be my “holy grail“ products. I guess maybe my expectations were too high, but I thought everything was just ok. For the cost of the kit, they amounts are product are inconsistent. I had maybe a few days of eye cream, but I’ve been using the toner for a month. I like the cleaner ok, but I don’t like that you apply it dry as I usually wash my face in the shower after I wash my hair. This was fine on the days I don’t shampoo. Just a little hang up, but enough that it bothered me. I won’t be trying any full sized products. There are a lot of negative comments about the smell, but I like the scent.
If you want to try the Tata Harper line, this is a great value and gives you all the basics. You will be hooked!

This was given to me first as a gift and I immediately fell in love. Not only did I buy the full sized bottles, I reordered this kit again to use for traveling. My skin has never looked so good, my oil is under control and all the products smell amazing!!
Love the Tata line, the smell the effect and IT WORKS. I saw an improvement in my skin fine lines and clarity with 2 weeks! WIll buy other items from her line

I have been buying this kit for several months. It lasts about a month, although the nutrient complex lasts longer for me. My skin is combination, doesn’t break out too often unless it’s from a product that my skin doesn’t like, and is blotchy. With this the oiliness is gone. I don’t break out. I still have blotchiness (mostly redness that I think is from food allergies) but it covers with makeup. The smells are unlike an natural products I’ve used and I’ve used many lines. I have purchased a full sized Floral Hydrating Essence because I run out of that first. It’s addicting. My only complaint is the price. It’s so hard to afford. The kit I can do and I’m trying to purchase one full size a month. But I feel after years I’ve finally found a line I love. And I recommend sticking to one line of products. I had never done that until a couple years ago and it makes a huge difference, in my opinion!
review_title: My Favorite Product Line, Not my Favorite Price

review_text: I don’t really get the hype about this line. the regenerating cleanser smells great and is a good gentle scrubbing cleanser but the rest is just ok for the price. glad I bought this instead of full priced products!

There is a distinctive fragrance to these products, and if you don’t like it, then you’re out of luck. I happen to like it, and it does fade pretty quickly, so this was a winner for me. I really thought almost everything in here was decent, and I will buy full size of several. A surprise win for me was the cleanser. I am not too interested in most cleansers, and will use water, Cetaphil, or even baking soda (for exfoliation). But Tata’s cleanser has got such a great texture and is not drying, so I think I will definitely add it to my repertoire. I also personally loved the serum and moisturizer. I have dry-ish skin, which is oily in spots, and this seemed to work pretty well for me. Actually, I would consider buying all of the products in this kit. Seemed like quality stuff.

The cleanser is nice, as is the resurfacing mask. However, the serum and moisturizer left my skin taught and uncomfortable; the nutrient complex comes in a tiny rollerball dispenser and it’s hard to tell if anything is even coming out. Really wanted to love these products but this is just so-so.
review_title: A couple nice items, overall disappointing

review_text: i got that kit as a suggestion from a youtuber , i really liked the kit especially the cleanser, eye cream and the mask , the others i didn’t really like them because the scent is very strong which i can’t deal with ! but it’s smells nice! i already finished the cleanser and the eye cream and definitely I’m going to purchase the full size ! overall , i think this kit is worth buying especially because the products is very expensive so that discovery kit will help a lot!

Most of the products were good and by skin reacted will to the products. However, I simply do not have $600 to spend on a skin care line .The only product from this that I will repurchase is the resurfacing mask- which is a holy grail for me. Even using it independently from the system it delivered fabulous results.This is a great way to try such a pricey line and find out if there are any holy grail products for you.

The toner is incredible and I’ve always found toner a waste of time before this. The mask gives a healthy glow but it’s smell reminds me of a cheap drug store mask my mom and I would get when I was a kid. The serum is too heavy for normal skin and the rest was ok. The branding, ingredients, and commitment to nature is great but most of the products are only ok.
The set gave me luminous radiant skin but I couldn’t stand the smell. I tried it a couple days. Had to return it. I am 32 and have combination skin leaning toward dry.

Can’t give it negative stars...made be break out in pustules!I woke up each morning with a new huge pustule on my face. I normally don’t break out at all. 3 days and I hipped it back. Smells bad, too.

I’m really surprised at the negative reviews for tata harper products. I’m glad I decided to go with my gut and try this set anyway because my skin hasn’t looked this good in 15 years. Seriously.If you are under 30, have really oily skin, and prefer the scent of synthetic fragrances to natural florals, these products might not work for you. If, however, your skin isn’t as dewey and plump as it use to be, and its combo or dry, try these out!!!There are two all- stars in this kit for me. The hydrating floral essence and the rejuvenating serum. Using these two products alone I have gone out without makeup- something that I never do. My skin just drinks this stuff up. Best part is no breakouts!!! I’m acne prone so this is a big deal. The toner smells like a bouquet of flowers, and leaves my skin looking refreshed and dewey. The serum has the texture of a light lotion, and is hydrating enough I don’t even need to use the moisturizer except on the apples of my cheeks, which tend to be dry.The mask really exfoliates and tightens. The cleanser is like a creamy luxurious version of St Ives apricot scrub. I’m not too sure about the nutrient complex oil - its a little heavy for my skin this time of year so I’ve been using it on my neck and décolleté.I’m definitely going to buy the full size toner and serum - worth the $$$ IMO.
Returned after first use. I broke out like crazy!!!! I’ve got oily skin and my skin just didn’t like the products.

Lived up to all the hype. My skin is clearer and softer than before. I love the scent but it is strong so you have to live it or hate it. It is several steps but I agree it takes a few min. A little also goes a long way. My favorites are the serum and moisturizer.

I’d read so much about this line that I just had to try it, and I’m not sorry I did. Although it’s a multi-step regimen, it’s quick and easy to do and the results are wonderful. Skin feels and look smooth, plump and dewy. The scents are strong, but natural and lovely, sort of earthy-floral. If you hate scents in your skincare, this is not the line for you. I do wonder if my bottles are mislabeled -- the “serum“ feels more like a moisturizer, and vice versa. Not sure if I’ll invest in full sizes of the whole line but I’m sure enjoying this kit while it lasts.

Basically, this is a deluxe sample sized array of products, lasting just long enough for you to see how beautifully Tata’s line can work miracles for your skin. Seriously. My acne-prone sensitive skin loves this stuff, with my face drinking in every drop as if she’s been starved for the right attention forever. Every morning when I wake up, I cannot tell you how beautiful and HAPPY I feel when I see that, yet again, I haven’t woken up with a new zit that’s chosen to dance across my dry face! I take a breath, close my eyes and thank Tata for this blessing ... what a journey it’s been to find the right skin care line for my particular challenges, I am so happy!
I’ve loved the TH products I had tried in the past. But this kit came with mystery products and no instructions for use. Also disappointed that the eye cream was basically a free single sample.
