I have very fair skin and I find this product looks dirty on the skin. Emphasizes light stretch marks and hair on body. Did not enjoy this product.
This is my HG self tanner. It’s beautiful, dark, and easy to apply.

Love this product. I have a fair skin tone and even if I leave this on for the full 4 hours, I’m really nicely tanned but it still looks natural and not too dark. Doesn’t streak if applied properly and love that you can determine the darkness of your tan based on how long you leave it on for. My only dislike is that it feels slightly sticky for about ten minutes and can transfer onto clothes very slightly. I recommend waiting for it to completely dry down before getting changed.

First time using a mousse self tanner. No streaks and stays on super well! It doesn’t smell good but I got rid of the scent on my body once I showered except for my one hand still smells a day later after 2 showers and many rounds of hand washing. Doesn’t really stain clothes or anything either but whatever you have extended contact with while wearing the product as it develops will smell like it. I didn’t find it got darker the longer I left it on. Overall I definitely recommend!

This is my first time writing a review for literally any product, but I had to give credit to a great product, especially after reading some negative reviews.I’ve tried every self tanner, from drug store to the most expensive. I have very fair skin with pink undertones, and heavily rely on self tanner. This is the best I have ever found. The color is a dark bronze with zero hint of orange. It dries quickly so you do have to be mindful when applying. I’ve also put on lotion on hands/feet/knees/elbows and that’s been very helpful. I haven’t noticed any strong smell, definitely nothing stronger than others. The best part for me is it doesn’t come off at all during hot yoga.  This is a holy grail product for me. PLEASE DO NOT DISCONTINUE!!!

This is the first review I’ve ever left for any product. Ever. It’s that disappointing....  I’ve been self tanning for almost ten years, so I know what I’m doing, and this stuff was a huge miss. It gives a nice, dark colour but does lean towards orange. The guide colour was almost non existent (I’m Canadian and on the pale side) and I was constantly second guessing myself if I’d missed any spots. The fade was very patchy and the overall tan was a son of a gun to remove even after a week. But the most unforgivable point was the god awful smell. After applying, I had that nasty, funky, self tanner smell for days. Even after multiple showers. I’ve never had that problem with St. Tropez. If orange, patchy and stinky is your jam then I suggest saving your money and just buying something cheap from the drugstore. I’m going back to St. Tropez’s Extra Dark Mousse.
review_title: You get what you pay for.

review_text: If you love Loving Tan then you will love this. It left me with a beautiful golden tan by morning. I used the brush that goes with it and it left no streaks. I highly recommend this product.

I am not a novice tanner so I felt pretty confident buying this. I applied using rubber gloves because my mitt broke (yikes). This mousse dries down very quickly, and you need less than you think. Start small and add as you go. I applied too much to one leg and that one came out patchy and a bit orange but that was due to USER ERROR. the other leg came out a beautiful toasted brown colour. If I had used the mitt, I’m sure that it would’ve been better. The reason why I am taking off a star is because of how quick it dries and how overwhelming the scent is. It doesn’t smell like DHA but it’s a strong perfumey scent. Also, if you are very pale you need to be even more careful. If you mess up anywhere it will be very obvious. Overall, use a mitt and be extremely careful and you will be fine. Definatley have someone do your back.
review_title: it works but be very cautious applying

review_text: Sooooo orange and extremely difficult to remove. Would give 0 stars if I could

I never write reviews but feel compelled based on how bad this product is. Application is fine but there is so much room for error and the fade over the next couple of days after application is trash. Fades totally splotchy in random parts but especially by armpits and on the legs and neck. Seriously there are better mousse tanners out there…

I never wrote reviews but needed so share this info. I’m on my second or third bottle and I’m over it. The tan is hit or miss. Two weeks ago I had a great glow, and this week there is absolutely no change in skin color. I’ve been self tanning for 8+ years and for the price this isn’t worth it. Although more fragrant, I got more color with Jergens. The tanning drops from isle of paradise however work really well, I was using these in lotion for my body in addition to face but I was going through bottle so quickly and it’s harder to get an even tan using drops and lotion. Better products out there if you’re looking for consistent color, nothing worse than spending 25 minutes doing your self tan routine to wake up the same color!
I’ve been using this since last spring when it first came out and have been obsessed with this self tanner! I get compliments on how the tan looks so natural all the time.

This is my favourite self tanner lately, I just ordered my 3rd bottle today. The last two bottles both lasted me for close to 4 months using it 1 to 2x a week on my arms, chest, neck and sometimes my legs. I find because it gives a nice dark colour, you don’t need to apply much!

First off: really wanted to love a clean tanning product. The application/actual foam felt nice and dried down enough that you wouldn’t feel disgusting sleeping in it. It was an even application and it’s been several days and I’m still evenly tan (some got on my palm, that’s my fault). However the tone of this product on me is orange. Most tanners I’ve used have been more olive or even red in tone: this says it’s violet, but my actual undertone is yellow and now I am orange. My husband said I look like a hot Donald Trump, love that for me.
review_title: “Hot Donald Trump” on a Yellow Toned Gal

review_text: The best!!! I have used self tanner since I was in high school and Isle of Paradise is by far my favourite. I used to use bondi sands but the smell was too much for me. Isle of paradise smells AMAZING, goes on smoothly, does not go orange (beautiful dark brown), and stays on for so long. I can’t express how much I love it! If you’re reading this, do your thing and buyyyyy it. I promise you will have no regrets

Easy to apply. The matching mitt didn’t help, my hands still went orange-y. I exfoliated, I made sure to moisturize all the hard skin spots(hands, elbows, knees) but they went SO dark. Plus the tab went blotchy after my second shower.

The smell isn’t as bad as a lot of self tanners. It goes on sort of gray and made me look sort of sick. It comes off super scaly too and in weird patches. It doesn’t deserve one star, but I’m definitely going back to Loving Tan or St. Tropez
review_title: There are much better tanners available

review_text: I tried this after using St.Tropez for the longest time and was very pleased. Cheaper, more product, smells good and in my opinion gets darker than St.Tropez and doesn’t look streaky. I have repurchased a few times now. I put it on at night and wash off in the morning, I like a deeper tan; if you like a dark tan this is the one for you.

This product is great. I use to use there old bottles they had for just the regular tan and loved it. The pumps would break though and it seems they discontinued them. Once I saw this I thought hmm, will it be good? & I was pleasantly surprised. I put on at 8pm and slept with it on and washed off at 10am. The colour is nice, a little on the orange side but still nice. Applies nicely & whoever said it washes off right away is insane. Mine stayed put after washing off with soap in the morning. I also went for a massage the same day and it stays completely put. It is kind of fading a bit patchy but that happens with most self tanners. I recommend forsure!

Background: I purchased this product last year after loving the shade in the tanning water but always struggling to apply that without streaks. I figured the mousse would be more my speed. I only used it once last year and accounted that it was because 2020. Turns out my mind just completely wiped my memory of my total dislike for the product. I decided to try it again last night and loved the application. Super easy, very fast. The guide color was very helpful. However, smell is not great and it’s now lingering in my room (ew). I let the tan develop overnight and woke up and was really satisfied with the color. I showered and it’s basically all gone. The guide color is what developed beautifully, not the tan itself. The only places where the tan actually stayed were my joints. So it now looks very awkward. Not sure if I’ll give this another go or just toss it because it’s been too long to return. But if you haven’t purchased this, don’t bother. Not worth it, unfortunately.
review_title: Guide color developed beautifully, not the tan

review_text: This is a really nice product! It does not look orange at all. I wish it lasted a bit longer though
AMAZING!! I’ve tried so many self tanner products and this is the best!!

At first I loved this mousse! It went on nicely and smelled better than most self tanners. The next day, most of the tan came off in the shower. The second day after application, my entire tan had separated and looked scaly. I use self tanner all the time so I always moisturize to avoid the tanner looking separated. This mousse just isn’t worth it.

LOVE. I have used MANY self tanners, my previous favorite being St tropez express. my tips: as always, exfoliate a day prior, moisturize and then apply the next day. Always us a mitt, I prefer the new st tropez mitt. Only leave on for 4 hours, especially on aged/UV damaged skin with dark spots or it soaks in. This lasted almost a full week for me and I shower twice daily and sauna. Great color, blends well, great smell! Clean by sephora and cheaper?! DEAL

I’ve tried many self tanners, this is not that great. Not dark enough, orangish and it’s very sticky for the first few hours after putting it on. DHA is all I smell as well. I tried it out twice and just don’t like the color. I honestly have had better quality and color with other self tanners I just wanted to try something different but I will be returning.
I absolutely love the isle of paradise line. The colour is great! Buttt my pimp for my mousse stopped working!!! How do I fix this! Am I able to bring it back to exchange??

The only reason I’m giving the product 3 stars is because of the lack of instruction provided. I applied the mousse last night after having done a successful patch test. I liked what I saw!!! BUT this morning, I woke up ORANGE! My boyfriend was in shock. I cannot leave the house looking like this. It’s awful. This is my first time using self tanner. While I am impressed by the lack of mess I am so sad at the end result. I am so embarrassed.
I like the color and consistency, but it made me slightly itchy and also it washed off really easily which I was hoping it wouldn’t loose so much color so fast. But the color was beautiful

This self tanner is amazing! I am fairly new to the self tanning game and I think I’ve found my holy grail product in the ultra dark! I left the product on overnight (around 8 hours) and woke up with a perfect amount of color. It may not be as dark as some of the other products on the market but there is no orange undertone at all, so the color is very natural looking. Added bonus, it didn’t transfer onto my sheets or towel! The only things to note, which are universal of self tanners in my experience, is that this product is sticky after application and definitely has the classic self tan smell if left on for long periods of time. BUY THIS STUFF. It is fantastic!
Just bought this a couple weeks ago and I’m loving it so far!   Easy to use and apply.   Wish I had purchased sooner

I love this product! I’m a self fan junky and have tried every self tanning mousse.. St.Tropez, St. Moriz, Bondi Sands, Jergens and none of those level up to this one! Here is why this product is amazing..1. The Isle of Paradise nailed the smell. I usually sleep the night with my self tanner on and shower the next day. With this product,  I don’t smell sour or gross, and my boyfriend doesn’t tell me that I stink (hallelujah). The smell of this product is so light and airy! 2. The nozzle works great! I noticed with some of my other brands that the product drips all over the inside and gets all over my bathroom and hands. This product doesn’t drip at all. 3. The violet tone is so pretty on the skin! My experience with all natural self tanners is that the ultra dark isn’t dark enough. This product is ultra dark, but not overwhelmingly ultra dark. They nailed the colour as well.4. It dries so fast! I think this is because the formula is so light and actually feels nourishing to the skin. It also wears for over a week with a shower every other day. It’s also not streaky and blends so nicely with any type of mitt! 5. The price is great. Overall, I’m very happy and highly recommend this product. This is everything a self tanner should be!

I haven’t gone for a spray tan since the reopenings and this is my new holy grail self tanning product.  Wanted to buy loving tan and this was way cheaper! Goes on beautifully, no streaks and doesn’t smell funky. I left it on all day and was left with a gorgeous nutty (not orange) tan ! So happy I found this product. I applied it with a St Tropez tanning mitt.

Better than St. Tropez, I’ve used their products for years , mainly the express mouse. I decided to give this a try when it came out. I LOVE it, it’s darker, lasts way longer, and doesn’t have as strong of a smell, and less it’s expensive!
This stuff is SO good. Goes on smooth, doesn’t smell or transfer, gives the most gorgeous golden colour that lasts, doesn’t dry out the skin AND it’s clean beauty!

Best self tanner hands down! I’ve used them all, and this express dark mousse is the most natural color (read: NOT ORANGE!) The least “tanner scent” I’ve ever had, and doesn’t shift/fade in a weird way. Holy grail.

I am very pale, and this colour looks incredible. It last for a week with daily showers + shaving and it fades like a real tan.  It does not smell bad and it goes on dark so its hard to mess it up.. I mean, I certainly have but its hard

Isle of Paradise is hands down my favourite tanning company, for me the colour it leaves is super natural but also provides ALOT of colour. I have the normal dark mousse as well which i love, but this product is great for days when you wanna be just that little bit darker. I find it develops so fast (like within an hour) after 3-4 hours from application.
Love the colour.  Purchased it twice and the pump stops working.  For this reason I will not purchase again.

I’ve tried all of Isle of Paradise products and this is good. It does give off a beautiful color. The only complaint is it feels pretty sticky after application. The serum and water formulas do not have that.

Super amazing! I am a self-tanner newbie so was a bit nervous to try such a ultra dark product.I also bought the tanning drops. Tried them all over my body & was not a fan (to start with)* I have a separate post reviewing that productGoes on smoothly & is easy to apply with the colour guide. Left it on overnight & woke up with a rich, deep colour ; although not ultra dark, the colour was even with no streaking or patchiness. Looks flawless as if you were in the sun for days. It is day 3 with slight fading but not obviously noticeable. I just applied it again to try & build up to the darkness I want.I love this product & find it difficult to find anything negative; smells great (no self-tanner smell), price is worth the results, no orange tones or patchiness/streaking.

This product is so very underrated! I’m a pale girl and I’ve been self tanning for a few years now. I’ve used isle of paradise self tanning mouse before and I haven’t been disappointed. It always gives me a very natural (not orange) tan. With that said, this one is by far the best sunless tanner I’ve ever tried. I won’t be using anything else from now on. Unlike the normal isle of paradise tanning mouses that develop overnight, this one develops in 1-4 hours. I always hate sleeping in tanner. I’m paranoid I’ll wake up with weird tan lines, it’s sticky, and I hat the smell. I love that I can put this on for a few hours before bed, shower off, and wake up with a gorgeous tan. On me, I wouldn’t say this is “ultra dark”. It’s pretty much the same color as the medium or dark isle of paradise mousse witch is perfect in my opinion. It lasts a long time before fading. The normal isle of paradise mousse lasts 3-4 days. This can last a week easily. I also like that this is a brown mousse instead of clear. It’s easier to apply for beginners. Buy this!! You won’t regret it!

I purchased this product quite some time ago, when it was first launched in Sephora Canada. At that point I had only been using St. Tropez tanner for about 5 years, but wanted to try something new. TLDR - Go with St. Tropez.For starters, the formula on this is really thin so I find that I have to use about 1.5x the amount of product to get as even of a coat. This formula is also incredibly drying and it takes a couple of days of intense moisturizing to get it under control after I use this. With St.Tropez I don’t even feel the need to moisturize after I wash it off, and while the thicker formula means you have to work it in to the skin a bit more when applying, it goes further on your skin. The St.Tropez is more expensive, but a bottle lasts longer for me.As for the colour, I am a light olive skin tone, and St.Tropez is the perfect colour for me since it has heavy green undertones and it looks exactly like my natural tan. With this product I found it way more orange/peach toned so it looked incredibly unnatural for my complexion. If you have yellow or pink undertones it might look better, but on me it looked like an early 2000s bad fake tan.And the wear on this product is horrific. It clung to every patch that was slightly dry (made worse by the drying formula) and wore off horribly patchy. I think it maybe lasted about two days before it became patchy and I had to scrub it off for three days straight before I removed all the orange patches on my skin. I even tried their tanning prep water, and it did absolutely nothing to help with these issues. With St.Tropez it fades evenly, lasts over a week, and requires little exfoliation before reapplying.
review_title: Worst Fake Tan on the Market

review_text: I am so happy with this self tanner! It does not have a strong scent which I appreciate and it gave me such an amazing color. I left it on for about two hours until I washed it off because I wanted a subtle tint, and the tan looks so natural!

I’ll start off with all the positives. This product smells AMAZING. My boyfriend usually hates the fake tan smell and even he actually enjoyed the scent of this. It goes on super nice and blends great. It also fades beautifully, I don’t ever get patchy spots. The only reasons it loses a star is because while it is a good color, it’s not ultra dark and isn’t as olive toned as I typically prefer. But I will definitely continue to purchase.

If you are stuck between this and st tropez don’t go with this. It doesn’t last long at all. It fades and leaves streaks. And leaves white marks all over my legs. Will not buy again. Going back to St.tropez just wanted a change of price.

This product is always out of stock! Now I know why. It’s amazing. I waited the 4 hours before washing the tanner off when I did I noticed not much of the tanner washed off which was great. When I got out of the shower I didnt notice a difference at all and figured it was a waste of money. Woke up the next morning, would have been maybe 12 hours after showering and was surprised at how much it had developed. Such a beautiful tan! Not sticky the entire time like st tropez and the price is right. This is my new go too self tan.

Total must have. I was pleasantly surprised how tan the color gets. If this helps, at full 8 hr exposure you can get to a “Tan - Deep“ shade ( it is the exact tan deep shade from tarte creaseless concealer that I use).I tried 2 hr exposure and it virtually did nothing so I have to do the full 8hr. I noticed my hands get very dark very quickly so half the time is extremely necessary. I am naturally medium neutral  when pale to tan sand/deep when tanned ....so I didn’t notice an orange tint, it just looks how I would normally look after sun exposure.
review_title: Can get medium deep in color- super pleased

review_text: So easy to use. Great color. I have olive skin and this blends in well. Usually lasts a week or so and I’ve been applying twice in a week and it doesn’t really peel much. Overall super impressed.
Ok wow. I love this brand so much. Obviously had to try this one out. I only left on for an hour and WOW flawless dark tan. No regrets on this purchase! ✔️
Obsessed!!! It’s quick, easy to apply and leaves you with a long lasting deep brown color.
review_title: My favorite self tanner on the market

review_text: This product is alright. I love a deep dark tan so I was so excited to see this ultra dark product in an express formula-even better! It does give a beautiful color but I would not say it is ultra dark. I also have discovered that I still have to leave it on overnight to get close to the result I want, so not really “express“ in my case. The formula does feel more moisturizing than others I have tried and I like that it is a clean product!

This product gave me a natural, olive-based toned tan. Not to mention that it blends so well. I finally found a product that applies evenly on my hands and feet. I gave this product four stars because it is sticky. Also, even if you are applying with a mitt, I recommend you wear plastic gloves. I have product on the palms of my hands which is not a look. Over than that though, this product is great!

Honestly a great product for the money! this lasts much longer than st.tropez, and is much darker than the original & express st.tropez. I actually don’t like isle of paradise mouse in the original dark or medium color, but this express ultra dark is pretty amazing! This is now my go to! I have naturally fair skin & this is pretty red/brown based, which is a nice contrast to typical olive color mouses!

This is a hydrating mousse and skin feels very soft after use. Price point is great compared to some other tans, however, it is not nearly dark enough. So it’s fine for a lighter tan, does not replace my holy grail.

This is the best tanning mousse I have ever tried! For very pale skin, if you only want to apply one layer, the trick is to leave the mousse on for 10-12 hours and make sure to shave and exfoliate at least 24 hours before if you want to achieve a dark tan. Otherwise, I get a nice, deep tan colour by putting one layer on, waiting an hour, putting another layer on, and then letting it sit for 5 hours before washing it off. The colour fully develops over 24 hours that I’ve seen, so if you have an event Saturday night, I’d put the tanning mousse on Friday day. The color isn’t orange and it doesn’t feel sticky compared to St. Tropez or Loving Tan in my opinion!

I actually love this product. It leaves a very natural looking tan! I typically use bondi sands but I like this one better now. I just wish the final tan was as dark as the guide shade before washed off (still dark but not ultra dark)

For some reason, my skin has an incredibly difficult time both developing and maintaining a tan. Thus, I have had to seek out numerous “ultra dark“ formulas to find one that gives me a relatively noticeable tan, and this is the best yet! It goes on super easily, with a very noticeable color guard, and actually gives me some color that stays. My one critique of this is that it is sticky after application, and sometimes can rub off onto clothing, but it is not that big of a deal. I just let it dry down for a little and then wear black clothes. It isn’t perfect, but it is the best mousse I have found. It is also a pretty good price for the size. St. Tropez and Loving Tan are both more expensive.
Best self tanner I’ve used and I used all the big name brands. Do not look orange at all with this one, the other ones I used to use I was always orange.

ive tried literally every self tanner and this is better than loving tan which was my previous fav this gives a deeper tan and longer lasting color, i apply it with the large body brush from iconic london rather than a mitt
The colour is the best I’ve ever had from a self tanner and I’ve tried A-LOT. But I will say, it fades super patchy, no matter how much you exfoliate and moisturize.
The color is really great but if you’re looking for a fake tan that last I don’t recommend this. I put this on Thursday night and it’s Saturday morning and the color is almost all gone :(
I LOVE the formula. But every time I purchase any isle of paradise mousse the pump stops working. It’s a total mess :(

ok. so the colour is really nice. has a slight fake tan smell. my problem here is that it doesn’t last!! I’ll have maybe 1.5 days of colour and then it’s gone! it’s so weird. it fades very very evenly, I’ll give it that. but it’s literally just gone. this is the 3rd time I’ve tried it. I don’t exfoliate with it, I don’t shave, I moisturize. I can not keep this tan on my skin. also, I find when I initially rinse it off I look super white. it takes until like the next day for the colour to actually develop. so if you wanna have a nice tan for a specific event, do it the day before. I don’t know... I’ve had better. I’ve had ones that last about a week. I’m just not that impressed. :(

This is hands down my favourite tanner ever. I went through two whole bottles this summer because I simply could not get enough. I love that it doesn’t have that tanner smell but is still a clean and vegan product. Definitely gets dark fast and is the PERFECT undertone - it doesn’t go on a green shade like some other tanners I’ve tried in the past. Layers beautifully. The only problem I had was getting it all off!

Idk what I am doing wrong but leaving this on for four hours does nothing to my color. I followed YouTube video tips, used a mitt and brush to apply but the color never stays after I rinse it from my face. I also use the IOP drops and they produce great color. Will stick with that from now on.

Very dark and doesn’t transfer onto sheets. I own the St. Tropez in dark and I find this Tanner much darker. Smells nice too. Does remain sticky but this doesn’t bother me because I go to sleep with it. St tropez Tanner transfers all over my white sheets, this one doesn’t.

Usually I’m a St Tropez gal, but thought I’d try this and holy am I glad I did! Zero orange colour, lasted over a week with one application and didn’t fade super patchy. Plus the price point is obviously a draw. Win!

I’ve been using sunless tanners for over 10 years and I must say this one was shockingly amazing. I wasn’t expecting to fall in love with the colour payoff and ease of application more so than St Tropez or Vita Liberta, yet here we are - me writing my first 5* review to post in a while. Colour is dark when you apply it and only slightly toned down after a shower , which I love. Took two applications to get the super dark colour I wanted and there is still TONS left in the bottle. Make sure you use the mitt!  Colour can be a tad orangey if you apply more than two days in a row , so be careful of that. Otherwise it’s literally perfect— I bought a second bottle before the 20% off sale ended LOL!

Guys! If I could give this ten stars I would!! I have used every tanner out there for years.... this is insanely and easily the BEST! Sorry St Tropez I’ve fallen in love with someone new... SO Wanna know why? Read on...1. The smell!!! It has a light beachy smell > the typical tanner smell2. The COLOR! Is olive and dark. I’m extremely pale and one application is enough for daily wear. It doesn’t have orange undertones like most (lookin at you my past love St Tropez...)3. The APPLICATION! Seriously never applied a tanner so easily. It blends like a dream! The only downside is it goes on very light olive brown so the color guide is quite hard to see. So make sure you get it everywhere!4. It LASTS! The color is smooth, even, and lasts for days! It’s the most natural tan I’ve ever experienced. Again cannot rate this highly enough!
review_title: BEST self tanner I’ve ever used!

review_text: Great color (a little darker than the “dark” line), but does not fade as naturally as the other Isle of Paradise products. By day 3, it begins to noticeably fade and by day 4 the color became incredibly patchy. I have used the product twice and had the same problem both times despite proper exfoliation and maintenance. I have not had this problem with the tanning water or color-guard free mousse.

best tan ever. better than dark 100% goes on so smooth and lasts forever. not orange, my undertone its hard to find a tan that doesnt look orange and this is a nice dark brown. wont use anything else.

Best tanner I have tried. This makes me astonishingly tan in just a few hours. I use the primer spray and I apply this with the mitt and it goes on perfectly! I never have any spots around ankles or knees using this tanner. The tan looks very natural and flattering. It seems to last a long time.

bought this because I tried the regular tanning mousse in dark and really liked it. The pump on that one broke so I exchanged it for this. after 4 hours it was NOT as dark as the other mousse. even the day after it still was a medium tan at best. It didnt dry down for atleast 2 hours and was super super sticky. it smelled like self tan after about 30 minutes as where the original mousse formula never really had a scent. the only thing I liked about it is that the tan itself has lasted about 2 weeks now before it started fading off.

This is one of the worst self tanners I have ever used. First off, it did not dry down and it stayed sticky all night. I usually use my self tanner at night and when I woke up the next morning it was still tacky. I applied it evenly with my tanning mitt but it washed off extremely patchy. My face and chest were about 3 different colors and since it didn’t dry down my hands got stained while I was sleeping. It was embarrassing to go out in public because I looked so patchy and ridiculous. I returned it immediately and the person who took my refund said they could understand why just by looking at my blotchy tanned face.

Simple to apply (I bought the applicator mitt from the same brand) with no offensive smell, or stickiness while it sat on my skin. I found the final results looked natural, and my skin was moisturized.

I picked this up when I went to return my Isle of Paradise Dark Mousse (the packaging was a nightmare but the color was the best I have ever used). BUY THIS ONE, NOT THE ORIGINAL! The packaging on this is completely different (more comparable to the packaging of St. Tropez, SOSU, and LovingTan- no leaks), but the undertone is the same as the Dark Mousse that I love! I am very happy I was able to get this one after my failed experience with the original. This is my new go-to self tanner!

I really wanted to love this product because of how highly rated this brand is. I am an advanced tanner, I have been using fake tan for years and have perfected a pre-tan ritual which gives me consistently good results no matter what brand I am using.This tan looked GREAT on initially, the guard was really dark and a really nice tone of tan. Day 1 post shower I was really pleased, I wouldn’t say it is the darkest tan I have used but again, the colour was really nice. Day 2 though things started to change, the colour started to look orange, and very shortly after became incredibly patchy. 2 days after applying, I was embarrassed to be in public. The tan was flaking off and it looked like I had splattered myself in tan vs. applying it properly. Why not take it off you ask?THIS STUFF DOES NOT COME OFF. I have a scrub, a tan remover mitt, tan remover liquid and a week of showers later, there is still tan stuck to my shins, elbows, and hands. I have never had such difficulty getting a tan off.I have tried the tan drops which are nice, but both this and the clear mousse were really disappointing.

Beautiful cool toned bronze with a lovely scent. The application was easy, the results were even, and it lasted six full days. I’ve tried most of the self tanners on the market and this has made it to my top three. Buy it!

This stuff gets you dark super fast if you are pale like me! I left it on about an hour and a half and got a pretty dark tan. But it’s been about 6 days and the weird dark patches left from the fading are horrible!! I have a solid line on my forearm between my super pale skin and super tan skin. I’ve tried multiple things to get it off without success.

Pros:-Dark color. This really does get ultra dark. First self-tanner I’ve used that can actually get close to a real dark tan.-Color (mostly) lasts. A week later I am still pretty dark, and it looks ok if you don’t look to closely (more on that below)Cons-Dry skin. I have NEVER had a self-tanner dry my skin out like this. I am slathering on my super thick, dead of winter lotion in late June and it still isn’t totally fixing things. -Leaves those awful little dark spots in your pores. I have been self-tanning for years and this is my biggest pet peeve in a self tanner and this was the worst I’ve ever had it happen. -Stains EVERYTHING. This doesn’t really dry down and until you shower, it’s going to get on all the clothes you wear and every surface you touch. I have used this several times and keep having the same significant issues. I tried tanning immediately after exfoliating and shaving, exfoliating and shaving then moisturizing the heck out of myself 24 hours in advance, I even tried moisturizing the spots where the tan was depositing in my pores immediately before application and still no change. I would maybe use again if I know there will be lots of pictures from afar and when I will have hours to let it develop without worrying about it staining anything, but this is just too high maintenance of an application and looks terrible up close, so it’s not a good option for most situations.
review_title: Great dark color but not worth the cons

review_text: Love this!! It definitely gives you a very good dark colour in 3 hours, no streakiness or patchiness and lasted about 6 days. I love how I can rinse it off my face sooner than my body and it still has a good colour! It is definitely darker than the st tropez dark mousse, and is darker than the isle of paradise “dark” spray! Can’t complain about the smell either, I’d definitely repurchase!

This product exceeded my high expectations as I had previously been in love with another popular brand that is quite a bit more expensive. The colour pay off was so great! I believe it is the deepest I have yet to encounter with a self tanner. It will seriously make it look like you have just returned from a week-long tropical holiday. The drying time definitely seemed to be above average and it wasn’t uncomfortable to sleep in. The smell from this brand is amazing, light and fresh. I have so far only used this particular one on my legs, but as far as fading I feel like it has lasted me about 4-5 solid days before I needed to exfoliate and reapply. However, there wasn’t particularly any patchy areas that stood out like a sore thumb! So that was a great bonus. The only negative I can say is the smell once it has developed. It’s absolutely not the worst, but for me it seemed pretty potent and lingered a little longer than the other salon brands I have frequented. Overall I would say if you have thought about this mousse, you should absolutely pick one up if you want a natural DEEP looking tan.

I was so excited that I found a “clean at Sephora” mousse tan and although this tan got me dark and I’m happy that it had the violet base instead of the green, I was super sad that this tan did not dry down. No matter how long I kept it on for (or even stood in front of a fan) this product unfortunately will not dry. The only reason I will be using it until it’s done is because of the long lasting color and darkness. Would not buy again

I self tan every single week and like to try all the new “Ultra Dark” formulas. I was excited to try this because of the express factor. Most Ultra Darks need to be left on overnight. The color guard has a great shade but definitely washes off to a med/dark. If you want a super dark tan that lasts more than 3 days, this is not for you. I will stick to the Sosu Dripping Gold in Ultra Dark. That gives the deepest tan so far...and I’ve tried them all. I do recommend the IOP Priming Water. That will definitely extend your tan and give you a deeper glow. I actually do enjoy this for my face. I own the IOP drops and water, but prefer this. After I apply my night time skin routine and let it set for 5 minutes, I take a couple pumps of this on a makeup brush and blend it into my face and ears. It gives me a beautiful, even glow that has yet to stick to any dry patches or leave streaks. This will definitely take the place of the drops and water.
Great self tanner, easy to apply, natural looking. Provides great color for fair skin.
Very easy to apply! No color transfer on bedsheets. No orange tones. I found using the isle of paradise mitt made it a breeze to apply the tan. Check their insta for application tips n tricks.

Best self tanner I EVER used !!’ Color guard is great you can see exactly where you apply. No funky odor when first applied, light smell after 5 plus hours of wearing it. Color is DARK AF but so beautifully brown. NO ORANGE !! Isle fan forever !

The color payoff is great however it is not as good as Vita liberata. I followed the directions and it still came out slightly patchy. my skin felt and looked very dry after washing off the color guard. overall this product makes you dark very quickly but I’d suggest if you are extremely pale to use a gradual self tanner instead of just jumping right to this product. I would repurchase but I would not leave it on over night since you dont notice the patches until you rinse off and then it’s too late to correct them. my next go around I’ll leave it on for 2 hours and then reapply to correct the patches. If you are new to self tanner this product could be a little to hard to work with and I’d suggest Vita liberata.

I previously owned (and retuned) the Isle of Paradise Dark mousse tan in the white/purple packaging because the pump malfunctioned and rather than foam, mine squirted out the almost black liquid everywhere.  So far having used this product twice, it’s not 100% foam, there is still so liquidity to it, but it’s manageable. I spread it out using the isle of paradise glove which works well.  You have a good amount of time to blend without getting stained immediately and the smell isn’t offensive like other tanners.  So far, I’m a fan and as long as this pump continues performing, I’ll likely repurchase.

This stuff comes out SO dark when first applied, so I was super excited. When I washed it off, it wasn’t that dark anymore. Overall it still looks incredible, and works great, but the ‘extra’ dark is only for before your first shower.

Color guard is a nice rich brown.  Spreads nicely with the Isle Of Paradise mitt and I’m sure any other mitt or method.  A little really goes a long way.  Ive used IOP medium and dark as well (both are nice too) and I think the express mousse spreads even better.Smells fine, after an hour it starts to get that smell but nothing tragic.  It is kind of sticky, however I may have used a little too much not realizing you do not need more than a pump per section.  I’m not positive if it’s because of the IOP mitt (I used to use the st Tropez mitt) or if the formula is better.  Kind of frustrating that no where on the directions or IOPs website does it explain if you should rinse off after four hours or if it’s okay to leave it on longer.  I ended up sleeping in it.  My skin is very soft and hydrated and it’s a beautiful color.  I don’t feel like this is an extremely dark tan by any means (I’m naturally medium olive), but it’s a believable healthy color.  I wouldn’t say it’s much darker than their dark color they already have, but I do think this applies a little nicer, and it’s less sticky.   I bet if you did a second coat of this it would be very dark.  I do like that their tanning mousses fade nicely and last pretty well.

This is a great hydrating moisturizer that last for most of the day (6-7 hours) without being greasy or heavy or irritating…to me it’s a better, fragrance free version of ester lauder’s revitalizing supreme.

I received the Rose Ingleton MD signature moisturizer complimentary from Rose MD skin.Rose Ingleton was created by Dr. Ingleton, a board certified dermatologist and a WOC. She’s from Jamaica and her line is cruelty-free, fragrance-free, sulfate-free, and vegan.When I first tried the cream I was pleasantly surprised with how emollient and how easily it absorbs into the skin. It leaves a lovely satin finish so you can use it during the AM and PM. The cream contains AHAs and Vitamin C, so do use SPF if using during the day. It also contains a Jamaican superfruit blend, which is a complex of antioxidants and naturally occurring acids to boost cell turnover. In addition, the cream contains ceramides and peptides which are great for anti-aging and skin firming.  I did notice that the cream contains mica toward the bottom of the incl list, so keep in mind if this is something that can irritate your skin. I like using this cream during the evenings on the nights that I am not using retinol. The acids in the cream are very gentle and have not caused any burning or skin irritation. The next morning my skin is still moisturized without looking greasy. I’ve not seen any brightening effects, but I stopped using Vitamin C while using this cream and my skin still looks even. One con is that this is a pricey cream, it runs at $85, however, since the cream is very emollient, a little goes a long way. I’m so glad I got to try this cream since it’s become one of my favorites.

I read so many raving reviews and I really wanted to love them. But I couldn’t .  They are ok but I can find similar products which are 1/10 of the price. I had to constantly remind myself how much I paid to motivate myself to use the products before they expire..after a year of trying, I just gave up on them.. if you can, try to get the samples before committing to full sizes.

I received the La Mer 1oz cleanser as a sample. I am almost done. I will say a little goes a very long way. I let it sit on my face just a little before rinsing it off. I’ve enjoyed it. It does not leave my skin dry, itchy, etc. I have dry skin, it does not leave my skin tight. My skin actually feels hydrated. I like the cleanser. Im not sure if I’ll rebuy it for $95, but it’s possible I may make my boyfriend buy it :) Long story short, it’s cool but not a must have like their moisturizer and eye cream.

Perfect for my combination aging skin! I have tried so many luxury face cleansers and this has been the best cleanser by far. I would not use it if you have dry skin though! My skin is prone to hormonal acne and this has completely transformed the texture of my skin. A little goes a long way - it is highly concentrated so I use a pea sized amount on my PMD wand.

Trashed it. Didn’t foam and stripped my skin. Pluses are that it’s not heavily scented and it’s lathering. If I had oily skin or wore heavier makeup, I could see liking this more. But definitely not for me.
Skin feels clean after use. A little bit goes a long way. Won’t use any other cleanser on my face. Will continue to buy.
It is drying on my combination skin and my cheeks feel tight and dry. good thing I tried the small size first. I like the texture and the subtle scent but I will look further.
I didn’t even try the sample size first. I went ahead and got a full bottle and it worked out for me. I like this face cleanser a lot. and I will probably buy it again.

Foams nicely and gets the skin clean, but it is very drying. Like crazy skin tight on the face feeling where it feels like it’s dying for moisturizer. Definitely a pass on this. I know foaming cleansers have a tendency to do this but there are some much better cleansers for much less, which foam and don’t dry you out.
review_title: leaves skin feeling dry and tight

review_text: It amazing face wash love it makes u face feel soft and clean. A little goes a long way  nice and bubbly  pea size is all u need
review_title: Love this face wash worth the $$$

review_text: This is hands down my holy grail cleanser. I have tried almost every cleanser for combination/oily skin just to find a backup for if this is sold out or ever not in my budget, I can’t even find a backup. It’s the only thing that thoroughly cleanses my skin and that keeps me from breaking out. This, the toner, and the gel cream *chefs kiss*

So when it comes to cleansers I will spare no expense. Cleanser are kinda my thang.But this missed the mark.Why don’t I like it? SUPER drying. Stings the eyes. Obviously I’m not putting into my eyes but just regular face washing it burned my eyes like crazy.The texture and lather of this product is very reminiscent of the gel shaving creams you’ve probably used on your legs at some point.This isn’t any better than the high end cleansers at the $35-$40 price range I have a lot of other La Mer products which I love including their foundation, face cream, toner, and primer. All of which I can justify the price. But $95 for this cleanser is ludicrous.You *might* like it if your skin isn’t dry. I do feel like it is a generous amount of product and a little does go a long way so + 2 stars for volume of product and the fact it will probably last you forever.- 3 stars for all the things I described above.
review_title: This ain’t it sis.Definitely not worth the $95

review_text: Such a waste of money. You’ll see better results using Cetaphil face wash and CeraVe moisturizer for less than $20 total, as opposed to the $560 + tax I spent on La Mer.

I purchased the mini to try but there would be no way i’d spend $95 for a cleanser.  It did a good job cleaning my face and i didn’t feel tight or dry but this does just as good as a job or less then a way less expensive sephora brand cleanser i use.

This is my favorite cleanser of all time. You only need a tiny bit activated with water to get lots of foaming action. The foam is very hydrating and leaves your skin feeling clean and soft. I have been buying this cleanser for many years.
This cleanser is not bad, but it does not live up to the hype.

This cleanser for me was just too drying. I have combination/ oily skin. So, that’s saying a lot. The smell of it is so fresh though! Very soothing and just smells clean. Sadly, won’t be repurchasing though.

Love this cleaning form !! My skin feel so soft and smooth, I’m also use The lotion treatment and the moisturizing cream after cleaning form  I’m so happy that I decided to purchased Lammer products it’s an expensive but it lasted long time you only need a little bit !!

I adore this cleansing foam for morning skin care routines. Firstly, the simple packaging and bottle speaks to La Mer’s incredible marketing team. However the real beauty is in the product itself. A turquoise blue cream comes out of the bottle and smells incredible, almost musky and certainly more on the unisex side of things as if reminded me on a good Tom Ford cologne. This stuff has instant results, feels amazing on the skin and within a week I noticed acne reduction, tighter skin, smaller pores and overall I just felt like I was glowing based off my complexion from my new routine. Very much a product that can and should be used by both men and women. Saving up for the famous La Mer Moisturizer and Eye Cream next as I would like to see what a purely La Mer product routine would do for my skin. Incredible stuff and would recommend trying the smaller bottle first at an amazing price point of $35 for a company known to be at the top of the food chain for beauty products.
One of the best face washs I have ever used you feel so clean!!! So freaking fresh and lives your skin looking like a million dollars it’s pricey but it’s worth it

I’ve been using this for years, the only one that works for my dry and sensitive face, it’s quite expensive but last me for a year or so I also used lamer moisturizer. I recommend this product if you’re willing to pay more money

I have very dry, sensitive, acne prone skin. I was using proactive plus for months and it was amazing to my skin, however I felt like there was something missing, so I have been trying different products. This product has been okay. I’m not in love with it, but it wasn’t terrible. It gave me a “clean feeling” after the first time using it and immediately looked brighter. I did notice a couple of small pimples pop up the next day so I’m not sure if this product triggered that to occur, but overall I’m going to continue using until it’s finished and will not be buying again.
Love this face wash . It is amazing , smells clean , and a little bit goes a very long way . This could last me almost a year so I feel it’s worth it !
review_title: love this above all other cleansers !

review_text: I really love this face wash, especially after a long day. I feel like it really digs in and cleans out everything. It does smell a lot like Irish Spring soap, but I don’t mind that. It also leaves a “tight” feeling on the skin, but again, I don’t mind that. It is pricey for what it is which is why I’d knock down a star. A little goes a long way so I see it lasting a while though. I’d say buy the $25 one first, and if you like it, splurge on the full size.
It was okay - an average foamy cleanser. I have oily skin and still had breakouts while using this cleanser.
Skin feels squeaky clean after every wash. It’s a bit drying so watch out if you have dry skin in the winter. I have oily skin so I enjoy this all year long.
It was good to be used in summer. However, in fall/winter, it’s too drying for my skin.
review_title: not to be used in winter

review_text: I have sensitive combination skin and it’s challenging to find a cleanser that works great for combination skin. I’ve tried so many cleansers and they never work. Either they would dry my skin or made it break out. until I found La mer cleansing foam. It leaves my skin perfect. It balances out the oily part of my skin as well as the dryer side. It has a light pleasant scent , and it makes your skin feel fresh and clean. FYI if you use a little too much it may make skin feel a little dry. Only use about a dime size. A little pricey but it’s worth 100%!!

Okay, so very reliable - I was purging, had sensitive and irritated skin, and this cleansed without stinging or making anything worse. It’s beautiful and smells a little soapy (it’s light though), but I’m kind of over spending so much money on a cleanser when there are comparable and cheaper options out there.

Everything LaMer on my skin is heavenly. This face wash is my go to- it cleans, doesn’t dry out my skin but leaves it looking like porcelain. I have combination skin, that tends to get somewhat oily. It’s a splurge I just can’t go without!

I love La Mer products. I have several of their items in my skincare routine. I thought I’d give this cleanser a try even though I think the cost is outrageous for a cleanser. I don’t mind spending money on serums and moisturizers but was weary about $95 price tag. But I needed to know if it’s a game changer.  I’ve only been using it for a week so not yet convinced it’s worth the cost. Pros: very creamy and not drying, nice La Mer scent,  foams up nicely, a lot of product as you don’t need much, and washes off well. Cons: Hefty price. I don’t dislike it but I don’t love it either. Just wondering if it really is that much better than other products I’ve tried and loved. I’ll enjoy using the rest of this cleanser but not convinced I’ll repurchase. I’d rather save the money for their other products. I wouldn’t deter people from purchasing it.
review_title: Still on the fence about this cleanser

review_text: Great cleanser, especially for oily/combination skin in my opinion. Doesn’t leave skin stripped.

I love this cleanser.  I use it each morning in the shower with a Mia brush.  The cleanser produces a gentle foam/lather and has a clean and fresh scent.  I am now 60 and have been using it for several years.  I am so glad that Sephora started carrying this brand!
Provides good lathering, removes makeup and dirt and feels refreshing but if I had to wash twice to remove heavy makeup, it’s a bit dryingI’m going to give the gel cleanser a try
Product is great. It foams well and cleanses nicely. This brand is just amazing at every product they produce. Never disappoints.
TOO oily- I got breakout everytime I wear it. I would not recommend it to oily skin type

Don’t get me wrong. I like this cleansing foam! It leaves my skin feeling VERY CLEAN!!! I’m sort of a clean freak, so I love just how cleansed my skin feels. :) It foams up quickly AND washes off very quickly. A TINY amount really goes a long, long, LONG way! I love that I also don’t need a lot. The scent is light and pleasant. I have sensitive skin, and this didn’t break me out. Unfortunately, I also have seriously dry skin that’s recovering from severe eczema, and this doesn’t leave my skin feeling as hydrated or comfortable after cleaning as I’d like. I would recommend The Cleansing Lotion or The Cleansing Oil, if you’re looking for something more hydrating.
review_title: Awesome cleanser but maybe not for super dry skin!

review_text: La Mer Foam cleanser is one of my favorite splurges!  It not only cleans extremely well  (and foams easily) but it smells clean - like a typical La Mer product.
review_title: 5 stars ***** for the La Mer foaming cleanser

review_text: Wanted to love this but it feels like washing your face with soap. I’ve got combination skin and this made my face feel so tight and horrible! Please don’t waste your money! There’s so many gorgeous cleansers out there for half (or less!) this price.

This is my go-to cleanser. I enjoy the light fragrance and it leaves my face clean and refreshed. I knocked it down a star for being somewhat drying.  I only use this a few times a week, and only a pea-size amount.  The rest of the week I cleanse with the La Mer Micellar cleansing water. I read another reviewer who commented on the instruction to avoid the eyes. As I understand La Mer reps only recommend products specifically formulated for the eye area to be used around the eyes period. Which in this regiment is the Micellar water for cleansing.
WOW WOW WOW ! J’adore ce nettoyant, oui il est dispendieux , mais je me sens tellement propre de la figure une fois que je fini de l’utiliser ! Lol
Dries my not dry skin and has an unpleasant odor to it. A complete waste if money in my case.

This product is a green cream that foams up nicely and it feels really nice and silky on the skin. However, I have oily skin   sensitive skin and this product made my face feel tight. It was a strange feeling because it didn’t look like it stripped my face as it left a residue on my face that made my face look shiny. But my face still felt tight and uncomfortable. I bought the small $25 tube and ended up returning it after 2 uses. I wanted to try a different cleanser and expected more from this product because I heard it was supposed to be a “hydrating“ cleanser but no cleanser has worked for me like Cetaphil’s Gentle Cleanser.

The cleanser smells like a bad of soap honestly, it makes my skin feel so tight. I wonder if that’s to get you to use the moisturizer afterwards? It doesn’t seem to have much affect on my skin. The L’Oréal micellar water I use seems better.  I am a La Mer lover, much to the distress of my bank account and feel bad saying it... But I don’t think I’ll be purchasing this again and am glad I only bought the mini.
review_title: I really really wanted to love this

review_text: I finally decided to write a review as I sit here with my face burning after trying the SK-II cleaning line. I’m not a hype person, I never buy into hype and I always do hours and hours of research and testing before buying something especially when it’s expensive. I used this La Mer Cleaning Foam for one year and absolutely love it. It’s the best cleanser I ever used, period. I have dry skin and this always made my skin feel cleansed without tightening/drying it up and is super gentle for my really sensitive skin that has a mind of its own. I was trying to find a cheaper alternative after I am almost out of this one so I tested a few cleaners. I immediately went back online and bought this again after some disaster situations with other cleaners where I face felt like it was on fire and all red and I realized this is still THE BEST! Sticking to this and I’ve been using one bottle for close to a year now, nuts! So in actuality, it’s not that expensive, also, because it’s priced higher than most others you will be more conscious of not wasting or overusing it which means less plastic waste buying more.
I love this stuff! Nice and creamy, foams up perfectly with my Mia and Luna!
very good product ..it makes my skin look so fresh and clean...
This cleanser makes the skin totally clean. You can actually feel how clean your face becomes. I always use the La Mer Tonic after using this to bring back hydration on skin.

to be honest this face wash is okay for daily wash of the oil skin or the combination. However it may be not good for the sensitive and dryness skin. Why you notice this product is solution of dryness. Do you know this product have the combination of the amino acid and soap base face wash? Even though it has amino part, the soap base is still the soap base. And soap base is not good for the dryness and sensitive skin.
skin feels super clean and soft after washing with this
Meh, i prefer the cleansing gel over this cream.
Not worth the money. Good foam wash but it didn’t remove traces of make up.

this was the first la mer product I ever bought and tbh it’s best to skip this one and invest in their cream instead. this leaves your face so tight and stripped, not to mention it caused breakouts and small bumps on my cheeks. the price for the mini is also ridiculous... I will be going back to a different cleanser. will say it does clean your face real good but it isn’t worth for breakouts and dry skin.

I like this cleanser. It doesn’t overly dry your skin (i have oily skin), and it has helped to speed up the clearing of my breakouts. Its just a bit expensive. I’m sure there are other cleansers likes this for a better price. Its green, with little exfoliating beads in it that I also like. It turns into a foam like texture when wet and a little goes along way. I swear I had this bottle for over a year.

This is a great product. I like using it in the winter months when the air is dry. Most cleansers seem to strip my skin of all moisture; however, this one has the opposite effect. After using this, my face feels amazingly clean with leaving a dry and tight feeling.
Love it! You wont regret if you give it a try.
Left my skin really dry... And it smells like cheap soaps. A waste of money.

Love it! One of the best cleansers and THE BEST foaming cleanser I have tried. In the last few weeks I tried few different brands including La Prairie, Lancer, Kiehls, Origins and few more. Some of them were too drying, didn’t remove the makeup or left my skin too dry/tight. La Mer cleanser gel made my skin very dry and irritated, so I tried the foaming cleanser. It foams perfectly, cleans skin well (I also use it with Clarasonic Mia). It is expensive but worth it. Keeps my skin clear, as well.
Love it. First time use, it drys out my cheek, but after several times use, I feel clean and comfort. Great product, but a little pricey.

This cleanser makes my skin feel more clean than any other cleanser out there. A bit comparable to Amore Pacific foam cleanser. You literally only use less than a pea size amount. And used in combination with the Creme de la Mer, the results are truly magical.
review_title: super clean and only use less than a pea size

review_text: love it. it can create nice foam without using foaming net. I love all la mer products

Do I like it?, YES. Do I love it?, No, Would I purchase this again?, NO. Would I recommend? The sample size yes.This isn’t a bad Cleanser. BUT, even for a travel/sample/small size whatever you want to call this 1oz, it’s expensive! $25 for this tiny bottle! It’s SUPER small so beware. I couldn’t get over how small the tube was, and the cleanser itself is not a miracle or holy grail cleanser, therefore I couldn’t see myself paying $95 for the larger/full size. The cleanser however, did cleanse my skin good without leaving it tight, stripped or dry. It actually left my skin smooth and feeling hydrated. The scent didn’t smell luxurious or anything but it wasn’t bad. It’s like a fresh, light, green Irish spring soap kind of smell, and I expected more from La Mer as far as that. It did have a great lather/foam to it, and a little bit goes a long way. Good enough for me not to return this, but I won’t repurchase it and can’t say I will recommend this over something else first.

This is a great cleansing form. It leaves the skin feeling hydrated and fresh. I have noticed a difference in my skin. It feels more fresh and also renergized. The only thing keeping it away from 5/5 stars it a) the price point and b) that you do need to use a bit of this product to get a good clean, most cleansers last my about 5 months and I wash morning and night, but this only lasted be 3 months.
review_title: Excellent Cleanser, But A Bit Pricy

review_text: Let me start this by saying that I am a huge La Mer girl. I have the toner, the cream, the oil, and the gel. I have used this stuff for about 20 years. But this cleanser?  Waste of money. I have washed my eyelids prior to every use (I usually only use mascara) and this cleanser still leaves so much behind. Are you kidding me?  $90 and I still don’t have a clean or exceptionally soft face?  Thought about returning, but why bother?  Just won’t be duped again.
Absolutely the best cleanser I have ever used! Pricey but a little goes a long way. Leaves skin feeling clean but not drying. Will definitely continue to use.
not good for dry skin, it will make your skin very dry after use

I have combination skin (more oily) and this left my skin very dry, which was incredibly surprising to me. I used it twice to be sure and I had to return it. The smell wasn’t luxurious, it smelled like hand soap. I was disappointed in this specific product.

Love the scent of this product. You will only need the smallest amount and it lathers nicely. Makes my face feel really clean. The only cons is it makes my face feels very tight and dry afterwards that I have to follow with rich moisturizers after, or it gets very uncomfortable.
This cleanser has worked wonders on my skin. I have acne and it helps soothe all my inflammatory acne!!! Price is steep but i have to keep having it!

Bought this on the recommendation of a cosmetologist.  You only need a small amount, so although the upfront price is higher than other brands, it is comparable when you consider how long a tube will last and the quality of the product.  Your skin feels clean, soft and healthy after using.  Would recommend as a great La Mer starter product.
I bought into the hype and purchased this.  It smells like soap, and left my skin feeling dry and tight.  Absolutely not worth the money.  Invest in a good retinol instead!
My face felt really fresh and clean after washing my face with it, probably my favorite cleanser.

It lathers up very well and I find my face squeaky clean after using it. However, my skin did feel a bit tight after using it. It does smell kind of like liquid hand soap as a couple of people had mentioned, but the scent isn’t bad nor does it bother me. Don’t think that’s a bad thing, but I’m assuming the issue is that they would prefer a better scent given the price point. I bought the mini and I’m glad I did as I wouldn’t buy it again. Sephora carries other foaming cleansers that perform better at a better price.
I love this stuff and anything La Mer! I’m almost 40,  and people think I’m 28-29. Love it!

This is a lux brand and great for pamping yourself. But I say if you can’t afford it, it’s not so extraordinary to splurge on. You can splurge on something not as expensive with the same results. I however love the brand, so I’m willing to spend my money on it. My skin does like it, but I wouldn’t say it is a holy grail item, I do recommend though for people who can care freely purchase this cleanser. It rinses cleanly and doesn’t strip the skin, has a nice scent and a little goes a long way.

my picky skin loves this creamy foam...I do love it. But I go through the small bottles quickly and I haven’t been able to buy full sized tube yet. it is a beautiful product I just wish it wasn’t so darn expensive
I bought it,  like it , smell perfect , but then for some reasons I start to have pimples , not sure  cz it is oily not water based ??

I purchased the travel size because full size was sold out - it is a nice rich foaming cleanser that I can use occasionally or as a shaving cream. It’s an amazing product but before purchasing you need to understand your skin condition and how to use the product. It leaves skin refreshing and hydrated.
review_title: Perfect for normal and dryer skin

review_text: Love how it cleans and makes my face feel , no dryness or tightness
Left my face feeling sticky, and very red. And somehow made my face feel more oily? I’m glad I bought the sample.

Purchased the mini for travel and the price point. FABULOUS cleanser and worth the hype. Use a pea sized amount for a full, rich lather. My face felt fresh, clean and soft--not stripped. You don’t have to use a lot of product so the mini will last a while. I definitely plan to purchase the full size when I run out of my current cleanser.
review_title: Best in the La Mer Product Line

review_text: This is the best cleansing foam ever! I’ve heard about La Mer, but stayed away because of the price. So, I decided to try this mini at $25 and I’m so glad I did.  It’s gentle and your skin feels so clean and pampered. I definitely want to try more of their products.

FAVORITE face wash!!!! It makes your skin feel clean and still moisturizing!! I always wanted that clean feel but usually that meant an overly drying feel too but not this product. Down side is it’s pricey
Smells soooooooo good and my skin looks so clear after I use it!
Not worth the money spent. May be I was expecting too much... but, after every use my face never felt clean: this product always leaves a film like residue... .
Favourite cleanser ever! Balances skin, keeps it clear of imperfections and leaves skin soft. Been using this foam cleanser for two years and I will never go without it. Worth the price.

First off the tiniest amount of product  foams up like crazy to wash you entire face. It cleanses throughly and leave skin smooth and soft. Does not irritate my sensitive skin at all. There is a slight fragrance to this but it dissipates quickly once rinsed off. I follow by applying sk ii toner, essence and rna cream. I have used sk ii face wash prior but it was more lotion like and didn’t seem to clean the skin as well as this one This has quickly become my go to face wash.
I LOVE this product, I will buy again for sure!
Nice product, but not for me. I prefer something less messy to use, like a cleansing wipe. Glad I got the trial size before committing.
Best!!!!i am using it day and night!!!
Works great. I was hoping to like thus & I really do.

This cleanser is absolutely amazing. I’ve tried quite a few from many different product lines and this is one of the few that leaves my skin feeling squeaky clean and but not super dry and typically once I clean my skin, it is aching for moisture. I’m interested to see the long term effects
I’m sensitivity skin, Lamer cleaner is the only one I can use. I love this a lot!!!! And I already used more than 2 bottles.
I love this cleanser.  A small amount goes a long way.  I have sensitive skin and had ZERO problems using this cleanser.  It is sheer perfection in my book.
review_title: A little dab will do ya

review_text: The only cleanser for me. I have tried others and nothing compares. It’s a splurge but since it’s the only cleanser that I have found that works without betaine that really cleans without stripping my skin.  I bought the 1oz to use for travel.  Full size is always on-hand at home.

Absolutely love it. This cleanser will have your skin squeaky clean without being dry. I use it about 4-5 times a week at night and a peptide moisturizer or just a hydrating cream or serum after it. Amazing product for any skin type.
review_title: Must have for all skin care lovers

review_text: Balances skin, evens skin tone and heals flare ups. This is the best cleanser I have ever used. I was a little nervous considering some of the ingredients. After using this and the gel, I have to recommend the cleansing foam for combo/sensitive skin.

Listen, I’m a La Mer devotee. I have six La Mer products in my daily rotation of lotions and potions. So I thought perhaps it was time to use their cleanser as well? Well, it’s mild enough for my sensitive skin, and it’s non-drying and doesn’t leave a creepy residue, but SERIOUSLY? $95 for something that smells like the dispenser soap we used in grade school? I’ll pass. You can do better with a cleanser from literally any other line Sephora sells.
I love this cleanser.  You only need a smidge as it foams up beautifully and has a lovely, mild scent.

Ahhhhh I  was so sad about this one! Maybe my expectations were too high! I tried the gel cleanser from La Mer and wasn’t too ecstatic about what it does for the price, so I figured maybe this one would be more suitable.I swear by the La Mer moisturizing cream, however this cleanser alternative also failed.I wear light makeup throughout the day and was hoping this would do the trick in taking it off and refreshing my skin. This left behind a mascara residue and my skin didn’t feel that clean... I ran a toner after this and my cotton pad still had a slight tinge of concealer on it.

I am absolutely loving this cleanser! It feels luxurious and works really well with my Clarisonic, and cleans without stripping my face dry. The price is definitely up there, however you only need a pea sized amount of product, so the tube will last a while. There is a slight scent but it doesn’t linger. The directions are correct - avoid getting the product in your eyes - it’ll sting!
This is great in the shower. Very refreshing and light scent. Would highly recommend.

I really wanted to like this. Unfortunately this cleanser left me with a tightness/dryness that was unreal. After using this, my face was always immediatley gasping for moisturizer. Seeing that this is recommended for dryness is baffling.

I thought this would be as good as my SK II foam but I feel like there was residue left. For the price I expect more. So disappointed it didn’t work for me. I wish Sephora had La Mer products near me for testing but they don’t. this has to go back I’m sorry. It smells wonderful.
Little goes a long way!  it smells amazing and i like the way my skin feels after!

This is really lovely! It gives you that wonderful clean feeling, without stripping or drying out the skin. I like to keep a bottle in my shower for occasional use, when I want that extra fresh finish. Whether or not it’s worth the money is of course dependent on individual opinion and circumstance - since I use it so infrequently (I prefer oil or cream cleansers on a daily basis), and a bottle lasts me nearly two years (sorry La Mer!), I’ve managed to just about justify it. That said, it’s worth mentioning that it’s easily the best foaming cleanser I’ve ever tried, and I’ve tried (and to be fair, liked) A LOT of them (Verso, Omorovicza, Chantecaille, Darphin, L’Occitane, Sisley, etc.).
One of my favorite cleansing foams. It leaves no residue and doesn’t dry out my skin after each use.I use this foam and chantecaille foam alternatively.

I LOVE La Mer, and already have the cleansing gel(which smells AMAZING) so thought I would try this as well, but it smells like men’s shaving cream! If U can get past the scent, it froths well and is gentler than the gel

I have used many cleanser in my life. This one is by far the best! At first, I felt that it left my skin dry...but pair it with the moisturizer and you’ll be just fine. I like the feeling of it after you wash your face. You have that clean feeling! The only cleanser I will use from now on! You only need a little bit so a bottle like this will last you about 6 months!

One of the best cleanser. Light green color and smells really fresh. Highly recommended if you have the money to spent. An alternative of this cleaner would be Omorovizca cleanser (slightly cheaper). My face is not dry after wash and feels really clean after washing.
Great for balancing combination skin. A little bit goes a long way. Love the consistency, and leaves your skin super soft.

I received this product in exchange for an honest review.I received 4 different products in this range. To start there are a lot of questionable things with this range. Because community sixty-six does not provide good instructions or product combination use information.Overall this cleanser wasn’t bad but there are still some issues with it. The first being it is marketed as something you should use every morning and night. Based on the ingredients in reality depending on your skin you probably only want to use this a few times a week. The next issue is the smell. It is not great, but it is also not the worst. It only last as long as you are using it, once you rinse the smell is gone. I only mention it because some people are bothered more by some smells than me. Using the cleanser it is very thick and a little goes a long way, you will probably need less than you think you will. All the packaging is basically identical. If two products are the same bottle and size it will take you a second to easily identify which you are grabbing. That could be altered a bit.  The only major issue with the line is that on all of their products there is more information on the box you will normally recycle about the product, use and warnings than on the bottle itself. That stuff should really be on the bottle as well.

This is a great product for my combination oily skin. I was afraid at first that it would be harsh on my skin but it did the opposite. A gentle cleanser that I would recommend for all!

I’ve use this twice now and every time my skin starts to burn. I’m not sure if this is normal for this product or if I’m allergic to an ingredient. I’ve had someone else try it and they instantly had burning as well.

I’m really conflicted on this, I was very excited to use the whole line because I’m always looking for clean and simple products, I’m a new mom so I’m always in a rush and wanted to have a few staples for everyday use. This is a powerhouse cleanser! It’s too drying for me to use morning and night with my current routine but I like to use it once a week or so on days when I don’t use other actives. I’ve been using this for a few weeks and so far I enjoy it. It feels gentle and natural. While the scent might throw people off, it’s a GREAT thing that there is no added fragrance to it. There’s zero benefit to a product smelling nice.

Eh, honestly. This cleanser was nothing special, I found it to be rather stripping actually and left my face feeling tight and a little sensitive. Love how lightweight this moisturizer is! Leaves my skin feeling soft and a little goes a long way. Also love that its unscented as I don’t like skincare to have a scent!

I have oily skin and it’s effective in removing the oiliness but does not make my skin feel too dry afterwards. It has a very light chemical scent to it but almost unscented. For its price, I think it’s a pretty good product.
I saw an almost immediate difference in my skin. The texture isn’t sticky like a lot of gel cleansers can be. My skin loves this.

I love the package on the cleanser. It comes in a tube bottle. I like how on the back of the box, it shows the suggested size amount to use. I love how it left my face feeling clean but not stripped. I first used the makeup melting blam, then the cleanser, Then the moisturizer.
The cleanser works well fine for my skin. I use itmorning and night. It leaves my skin clean andsmooth, ready for the rest of my routine.
This detoxifiying gel cleanser works really well i have very oily skin and it left me feeling nice and smooth.

It is pretty decent. I do notice that it is slightly irritating and leaves my face very dry. I would use on days my skin is having a breakout or for days you want a very deep cleanse. I do usually go for more hydrating cleansers though.

I received this product as a free sample from Influenster and Community Sixty-Six. I have normal-oily skin and was super excited to get this in! I love how this face wash lathers and washes.
