review_title: Great product, but be cautious with sensitive skin

review_text: I have very sensitive and oily skin and I also I have eczema. This gel / exfoliator cleanser is so great!! My skin feel so clean and plump after I use it!! I like the texture the Ingredients are great also!!  It has niacinamide  and salicylic acid !!  I highly recommend it!!

I love that this brand doesn’t add synthetic fragrances to their products! The consistency was familiar. It almost reminded me of a drugstore face cleanser. I didn’t notice a difference using it, other than it cleaning my face. Price point is amazing for the size of product.

I received this Detoxifying Gel Cleanser complementary from Influenster and Community Sixty-Six in exchange for my honest review. The packaging is very low key with minimalist color-way, which can portray a green message. It’s definitely not shouting luxurious, expensive skincare products but I like the price point compare to what you get in volume. I also thought the name of the brand is meaningful (60 seconds and 66 days is all it takes to form a habit) and the QR coding on the package was convenient to get more information on the product. It claims to be vegan and has no animal testing. I like that the cleanser is an all-in-one product including glycolic acid, salicylic acid, niacinamide and more. I am slightly surprised that it didn’t contain a sunburn alert with 6% of glycolic acid though.I used this cleanser intermittently for two weeks to test for effectiveness although I did use a retinol product once during that time. I had skin peeling but I think it’s the retinol that caused it in conjunction with the cleanser. When using the cleanser, there was a slight sting and my face felt a little dry, tight, and itchy afterwards but nothing I can’t fix with layering other skincare products on afterwards. You only need to use a small amount and it goes a long way. The product is a thick clear gel, has a good lather, and there is no fragrance, which makes sense since it’s fragrance free. I actually prefer this although others find it unpleasant. I never had issues with acne but I do think this product evened out the texture on my skin and there’s a refreshing look to it. Overall I like the product and will continue to use it.

I received these products for free from Influenster and brand(s) in exchange for my honest review. I have oily, non-sensitive skin and I was excited to try this gel cleanser; however, the amount of redness and tingling/burning I experienced after my first application made me want to throw this cleanser in the trash. I decided to stick with it and used it in the mornings with the gel face cream.  It took about 6-7 days before the post-application burning disappeared and the redness subsided. Besides this initial reaction this gel cleanser is pretty decent: it has a good scent and packaging, it’s easy to wash off and apply, and the amount recommended to wash your face is accurate (pea sized amount). My face feels great after washing and I can easily incorporate this cleanser with the rest of my morning skincare routine (toner spray, vitamin c, aloe Vera, eye cream, sunscreen). If you are willing to risk and endure the initial redness and burning this gel cleanser could work for you. If not I’d recommend you look into a different product/type of cleanser.
review_title: Good cleanser once redness and burning subside

review_title: Horrendous smell and left a film

review_text: I’m very happy with this cleanser. I have oily skin with large pores and uneven tone. I like products with niacinamide because my skin often has redness. I got this from influenster for testing purposes. It’s too soon to I know if I love it or just like it.

My newest obsession.  I am so happy with this cleanser.  It doesn’t dry my skin out at all.  It has really detoxed my skin.  My pores are so much cleaner and seem to have gotten a little smaller.  I recommend everyone to buy this and at least try it.

Love this cleanser it feels so good on your skin. It’s so smooth and glides so easily and a little goes a long ways. Makes my face squeaky clean is a bit drying but helps with the blackheads

review_title: Caution if you have sensitive skin

Prebiotics topically, are great for those using retinols, or topical acne treatments, as the prebiotics will help restore your skins barrier function, reducing redness, dryness, ect...My skin texture has improved significantly after using this two times weekly for four weeks!

So helpful for problematic skin. Probiotics bring back good flora to our skin’s natural Microbiome (defense against outside things like pollution, bacteria, and UV). This is a game changer for my rosacea, dermatitis around eyebrows and nose (good bye steroid cream!), and improves small texture issues (rough skin- not referring to actual pimples/acne- that’s the one thing I don’t think this is targeting but it has EVEN calmed down some sore follicular pimples for me before!) This is probably hands down my all time favorite clay mask, however, if you have extremely acne prone skin, this is something you may want to think about avoiding or patch testing before use. All of the negative reviews complain about breakouts or irritation and that’s probably because this product contains three ingredients that are common comedogenic acne triggers: Myristic Acid, Lauric Acid, and Palmitic Acid. Keep in mind comedogenicity is not a term that is regulated by the FDA and what’s comedogenic for one person could be totally fine for another. Also, how long you leave this mask on can also affect whether or not it clogs your pores. If you follow the directions and only leave it on for THREE minutes before washing off, you really should be fine even if you do have acne prone skin. I just read a review that complained about the worst breakout they ever had but then went on to mentioned offhand that they left this on their skin for 15 minutes. Not only are clay masks never supposed to be left on for that long since kaolin can be extremely drying and irritating, you’re basically guaranteeing skin barrier damage by not following the instructions that come with any skincare product you use. Skincare formulators are scientists who’ve done the research and extensive testing so they’ll typically know how their product will react on your skin, it’s always a good reminder to use a product in the manner that it was formulated for. I have oily, acne prone skin and this mask does a great job reducing the oil and making my skin nice and soft, without overly drying or stripping my skin like other kaolin clay masks do. I personally have not experienced any issues or breakouts, but again, that’s probably because I’m leaving this on my face for the absolute minimum amount of time that’s suggested by Algenist. I use this about twice a week and just think it’s a really lovely, elegant product. Hope it works out for you too if you do decide to splurge for it.

My skin typically doesn’t tolerate harsh acne products since they use very strong ingredients and are often combined with alcohol, which only makes the situation worse. I tried again a few months later with the same effects. This is only after using it once a day at night. Seems incredibly irritating if the company is telling you to use it morning and night. I’m probably going to end up throwing this out. Would not recommend.

Really like this better than any other eye cream I have tried. Very nice consistency and absorption, and only need to use a little bit each time. Skin around my eyes looks and feels better. Been using for about a month. I am 27 so using as a preventative anti-aging cream, not to reverse any current damage.
Extremely hydrating, only eye cream that my Mom... in her late 40’s has been repurchasing for the last couple of years.
Best eye cream ever. I love the texture and scent.
I like that it’s unscented and that is goes on quite smoothly but I find it’s just a decent moisturizer and doesn’t do anything that I can notice, that could be considered anti-aging.
review_title: algenist genius ultimate anti-aging eye cream

review_text: Was excited to try this. Unfortunately it didn’t really live up to the expectation. My eyes burned for the first 2 days of applying it, but then got used to it, however this cream also made my under eye area very dry and I swear to god new wrinkles formed. Will throw it away...

I have tried many creams from Sephora and all of their big fancy brands. I always come back to this one. It’s simply the best. I agree that it does have a funny consistency that makes it a little harder to get out of the jar, but soon as you smooth it over your eyes it absorbs very nicely. You only need to run your finger over the cream in the jar and that will get you enough to put it around your eyes. Every time I use it I notice a significant decrease in the fine lines around my eyes. I find it much better at battling wrinkles than the other Algenist eye cream.

I have been using this eye cream for about five years. I’m 27, so started around 22. The area around my eyes is the only place where my age doesn’t show at all (I get lines on my forehead and around my mouth, especially when tired). It truly works. I love the texture, it’s a little crepe-y. I tend not to like products that are too watery. I also feel like I literally cannot use my concealer without this as the base. Makeup goes on much more smoothly and doesn’t dry out that delicate skin.

I’m in love with this moisturizer. I’ve started seeing decrease in fine lines around my eyes and two deeper lines on my forehead. İt’s been almost a month, and I’m very pleased. (i was in a Sephora today and it was on sale for 78, and I stocked up) İt feels like I’m adding silk to face and it seems to lock in all the previous layers of my skincare routine. The texture is so elegant, and I love this step of my morning and evening.
This is the perfect eye cream for the morning underneath makeup. It helps prevent my concealer from creasing.

I never write reviews, but I’m getting ready to order my 3rd jar of this cream, and Its one of the few products I’ve repurchased.  It melts into my undereye and keeps me hydrated.  I also put it on my lids.  Love this stuff!

This is only one of four eye creams that I can use, as I am so sensitive. I am also extremely dry and this is one of the only eye creams that hydrates me. Great for plumping, Brightening, de-puffing, and hydration.

The Ultimate eye cream was my first Algenist purchase. I have or should say had substantial creasing in the eye area, primarily crow’s feet. Algenist has absolutely lessened the deepness of those wrinkles. After applying, the wrinkles relaxed, the skin softened, and appeared plumper. With continued use, about 3 weeks, I have noticed a continuous improvement in the appearance and depth of the wrinkles. I am looking forward to trying Algenist night cream.

I’ve been obsessed with eye creams since I was in my late teens. This was my go to eye cream and I’m literally obsessed but since I now live in the Philippines finding an alternative has become a mission. Would highly recommend -  a great product that your eyes will thank you for.

New to the Algentist line and love love love. Despite my age (48)y skin is still in pretty good shape after years of moisturize and sun protection, but did notice it’s time to step up. Don’t know what attracted me to the brand (none of my friends use), but decided to try and won’t go back to past long time brand (Clinique). Algeria the Clinical findings are true...significant results in 10 days. Love consistency (yes it’s a little weird like a smooth gelatin), emolemcy, and no scent. A little goes a long way.  Worth every penny!
review_title: New to the Algenist line and love love love

review_text: Didn’t see an improvement, it further emphasized the dryness in my undereye and lines were more noticeable. I stopped using it two times for a couple of weeks and after each time I restarted using it again the dryness would come up again. I threw it away.

This works so well I will compare it to a french brand that’s hundreds of dollars. It also doesn’t take much for applying. This will last a long time. I did buy this in a kit elsewhere but wanted to encourage other 50+ to give this a try.

I am 73 years old and I found that the eye cream I was using just wasn’t working. I decided to try Dr. Gross with retinol and also the Algenist anti aging eye cream. I really like them both so decided to keep both. I use the Dr. Gross at night and awake looking much better than I used to. I use the Algenist  in the daytime as it is more moisturizing. Overall using both eye creams is working for me.

There must be 5,263 eye creams on the market, and I have tried probably half of them. (Little exaggeration). But seriously, this eye cream actually does what it claims to do. At 38, I take care of my skin in a preventative way, and have since my early 20’s. My efforts have paid off and my fingers are crossed they continue to.  As I age, my concerns and products I use to treat them change. After not getting the results I really wanted from my previous brand, I switched to Algenist. I can always count on their skin care, so I figured I cannot go wrong with this eye cream. I was right. I have been using this at night for 10 months now. Within two months, my skin tightened up under my eyes, and the little smile lines became less deep. Results don’t happen overnight, they take time and application. After 10 months, my eyes are bright, firm, yet soft and not tight looking. I look like 24 year old me. This cream tends to have a spongy texture, so post-moisturizer, I rub a small dollop between my ring fingers to warm it up so it spreads evenly. I sleep pretty darn good at night even if my eye cream is hard at work.

I really like this eye cream. Yes, the consistency is a bit odd, and I do need to add some Marula Oil for additional hydration at night, but for how thick it is, it absorbs really well and works great under makeup. I have added a few other products to my routine - mostly Algenist and Perricone - so I can’t say for sure it’s from this product alone, but my entire eye area has shown great improvement over the past month, with increased firmness and diminished dark circles. Four stars because the consistency is difficult to break down, but this definitely has a place in my routine.
This is super smooth and goes on nicely without a greasy feel and doesn’t cause eye make up to run.
Love the way this cream makes my eyes feel!!
This has some terrific ingredients in it, so I was really looking forward to it, but it makes my eyes water like crazy!!  Disappointed.

I’m using this product and almost out of it because I won’t waste expensive product by letting it sit there. It is okay for night time but definitely it is not hydrate enough for underneath the makeup. It isn’t thick or too thin so that’s a plus. But I honestly believe for the price there is something better out there.
I’ve tried and loved other Algenist products and this one did not pass the test for me. I didn’t notice any difference.
Heavy duty eye cream that will get in those deep lines and wrinkles. This is for the advanced skin care needs and will reverse signs of aging!!!!
This product works well and wears well under concealer. I don’t like that it’s super think and jello-y and requires to really rub to get it in
review_title: works well but isnt the right consistency

review_text: Great eye cream. I definitely see some help with fine lines and puffiness. My darkness is less. It wears well under concealer.  It’s pretty emollient, a little goes a long way(like half a grain of rice per eye). Probably lasted me close to 6 months using it both day and night.

I have gotten so many samples of this over the years and kept giving them away because I didn’t care for the smell nor the consistency. I finally used a recent deluxe sample and to my surprise it works really well so I’ll have to get over it.

I’ve fallen in love with Algenist and this eye cream is no exception! It’s true, on my finger it has a play-doh consistency, but give it a second to melt on to your skin and it is pure silk under your eyes!
I really love this eye cream.  It has made a difference for me in the appearance of lines and dryness.

I got a deluxe sample of this last year and within two weeks of using it my hereditary eye wrinkles were MUCH less noticeable. This didn’t do anything for my dark circles but made my fine lines disappear. I tried switching it up to the Sheseido wrinkle eye cream because it’s a little cheaper and has such good reviews but within a month of using that one my wrinkles looked worse then ever! It’s like it actually dried out my under eye area. Back to this cream I go. Yes it’s a very thick consistency and you have to work a little harder to get it to sink in but you seriously need the SMALLEST amount. The other reviewers that were saying this balled up were using too much product.
I tried many eye cream, included la met. But this one becomes my favorite!
This is the best eye cream I have ever used! I notice a difference immediately.

I have many eye creams from all brands , price ranges from high to low . I got this in a kit 5mls and it has lasted me a long time , I am trying to use up other creams first but I keep on coming back to this one , I don’t like the other cream Algenist has in the white jar . But this one I really like . Its thick and hydrates the eye , a small amount goes a long way . I use this before bed and at night .  I’m in my 30’s but eye wrinkles run in my family , both my parents and grandparents have , so I have been trying to address the issue and find something that works immediately and gives everlasting results . This may be it !!!!

This is a total miss for Algenist. As others have noted the texture is thick and doesn’t emulsify when I tried to scoop it out. It balls up and won’t spread. Maybe I’ll see this in the 99 cent store soon with all the other worthless creams.
This has a weird texture that is not absorbed into the eye area easily. Kind of a clumpy gel cream. Will not purchase again

This product is SO AMAZING!! it has completely changed my under eye area and the lid too. It is never irritating, so hydrating and firming, and makes my makeup go on so much smoother. It also has considerably helped my stubborn dark under eye circles. I can’t say enough about this product. I love it!
Thus is my eye cream.  Love this product!

I started using a sample of this eye cream about a week ago and absolutely love it!!!I felt the firming and tightening effec after the first use! However would not be able to purchase it , too pricey for my budget???
The best eye cream ever!

Since using this product i feel like I have seen an increase in my under eye lines.  Also I never had a problem with caking under my eye with makeup and now I do.  So far after using this product for over 2 months I am extremely dissatisfied.
review_title: Not What Its Cracked Up to be

review_text: I absolutely love this eye cream. I started using it several months ago, and noticed right away it helped with fine lines. I have extremely dry skin and also a small spot of eczema on my cheek just under my eye. This is the only cream that has completely gotten rid of the eczema, and I didn’t have to use any other creams including any medicated creams. Very pleased.

This is one of the best eye creams I  have ever used and I have tried many over the years.  I am hooked on several of the Algenist face products.  Everything from the fragrance to the consistency and the moisturizing - it all really works for me.

I received a sample of this. Not impressed at all! My eyes felt dry and tight, and it did not create a good canvas for my concealer. I noticed my concealer was cakey and gross looking. Do not recommend!

I’ve been using Algenist Complete Eye Renewal Balm for the past three years, which I really liked. However, with the appearance of more fine lines and what looks to be the first sign of crow’s feet, I decided to upgrade to the Genius eye cream. The result was, however, a little disappointing.First of all, I didn’t notice any significant improvement (unlike when I first started with the Complete Eye Renewal balm) within the first 2 weeks of use. Secondly, this eye cream comes in a weird texture that’s between a cream and a gel. It’s really hard to break down. I don’t know why this is the case.I’ll stick with the Complete Eye renewal cream for the future...
The product is not very emollient at all. It has a very weird consistency and does not hydrate the eye area. Very disappointing.

So glad i didn’t have to pay for this.  Received as a VIB ROUGE gift.  It’s a weird consistency that is difficult to actually absorb out of the container from your finger to your eye.  And..don’t like the bacteria of a jar, especially for an eye cream. Can’t see it does a thing. Glad I discovered the new serum which is awesome.

This is a very thick cream-- I had to rub a little between my fingers before applying in order to get it to spread nicely. It was hydrating, though I found that it was a bit too thick/ didn’t absorb completely so I would not put makeup on afterwards because it would slide around. The main reason I am only giving this 2 stars is that after these weeks of regular use, I did not see any change in my eye area (fine lines, circles, etc.). I also did not notice any ’brightening“ effect.

Received a deluxe sample of this. I continue to use it because I have it around and I’m still hoping I’ll see some sort of results. But I can’t tell a difference at all. It’s a little hydrating but I’ve used eye creams that feel way more hydrating.Glad I didn’t buy this product.

I used the entire container waiting to see any difference underneath my eyes; unfortunately it did not happen. I would recommend asking for a sample before shelling out the money for this hit or miss product.

I have been using this for three weeks and have seen a big difference in my wrinkles lessening. It is a bit pricey but I will definitely buy again. I have bought so many products that don’t work but this does.
Love this eye cream!! Consistency is perfect for my on the dry side eye area. Noticed a difference around my eye area in firmness, texture and brightness after a couple weeks of use.
I’ve been using for over a month & see no difference. Waste of money.
But the skin around my eyes still feel tight and dry. I have not seen any improvements with fine lines.

Received this product as part of my free samples selection & I love it!! Noticed results first time I used it. Never seen an all area eye cream (upper lid to brows, corners & under eye) work so well. Looks like I had Botox but without the fake stiff look of Botox. Great product, I purchased the full size.

I’ve used a lot of eye cream, the last one which I didn’t mind was Algenist Complete Renewing Balm. While it did address some my dryness, it left me with my other issues, dark circles, early signs of aging and I would have liked a better moisturizing cream. I was recommended this and since I am familiar with the line and it’s the best I’ve found so far, I purchased it. I must say, it’s wonderful. Creamy, treats all of my problem areas. I do use it quite liberally. But it seems to last quit awhile. It is on the expensive side, which is a bummer. But worth it. I could tell a difference in about a week or two. It’s my new go to eye cream. Highly recommend.

I’m 45 and have been using eye creams since my early 20s. I have fair skin and have always been religious about sunscreen but nonetheless have had crow’s feet for sometime. No eye cream has never done much other than keep the area hydrated. This product has made a dramatic difference in the skin around my eyes. I’m a little crinkly when I smile (like most humans) but at rest there are not even fine lines. I’m writing this review as I purchase my second container. I also use the Algenist anti-aging oil (gold bottle).
review_title: The only truly effective eye cream I've ever used.

review_text: This product is addicting. It hydrates and really changes the eye area within a few days but you can instantly feel the hydration and make-up goes on like a dream. I’m mid 50’s and saying that is saying a lot. Use sparingly! A little goes a looooonnngggg way

I used this cream when I received it as a 10-day sample. There were 10 small sample packets, and I managed to use each one for a morning and evening application to the eye area. I really loved it! My skin looked brightened, hydrated, and generally plumped up (in a good way). It didn’t irritate my skin at all or break me out, which is always a concern with a new moisturizer.I really love this cream, but the price of the product is too high for me to be able to purchase it regularly. If you’ve got the money for it, definitely splurge!
My experience was this product worked better as a facecream. It was too heavy, yet not very emollient.

I have literally tried a plethora of eye creams, gels and serums over the course of two years in an effort to find a product that works well as an anti-aging eye treatment, while reducing puffiness and dark circles. Finally, I’ve found a solution that does what it claims! In my books, this is the best eye cream I’ve ever used. It smells wonderful, is non-irritating and extremely hydrating. I’m able to use the cream in the evening but also in the a.m. under my eye makeup, which blends seamlessly over top. This in particular is of benefit because I’ve had issues with previous creams clumping beneath makeup application. I’m noticing that my under eye circles have lightened and fine lines are already diminished after a short period of usage. A little goes a long way with this cream, so although the price may be somewhat high, I believe it will last quite some time.
I noticed the fine lines around my eyes were less visible.

I SO wanted to love this! I give it 5 Stars only for the Scent...It Smells Amazing - like a vanilla, cinnamon cookie!! It’s packaging and anti-aging promises sound Very promising, BUT for the Price, I had Better be wowed, but sadly after applying it every night for over a month, it did not. It was very moisturizing though, but I did not purchase for that reason...I purchased for its anti-aging claims, to which I was disappointed.

I love the consistency and feel of this eye cream. I’ve been using it for a week now and have already noticed a difference in the texture, brightness and firmness around my eye area. I look forward to using this product and will keep it in my beauty routine.

Well I LOVE the texture the second it hits my skin, and the few times I’ve gotten it into my waterline I’ve never felt any stinging, which is great. However one morning after a week of putting this on day/night my mother asked if I was stoned -- baffled, I asked why she said that, and she said that my eyes looked “unusually small“. After looking in the mirror, I noticed that the skin around my eyes was pulled so tight I looked like I was perpetually squinting. So, does this tighten the skin around the eyes? Absolutely! But unless you have bad crows feet, maybe avoid this product.

I got to try a sample of this awhile back and I was hooked...very luxurious & thick. You only need a small amount and eyes really look amazing after about two weeks now. Use at night and a lesser costing product prior to make-up AM. Request a sample if still available next time you shop!
I received a deluxe sized sample of this with an online order. I didn’t expect much as with all eye creams, I’ve never found them to really do much of anything.

Although this came highly recommended by one of the sales associates at Sephora, I noticed no difference around my eyes. It has a great texture and absorbs quickly. I did not notice any improvement in the undereye area except perhaps a little more moisturized. I was looking for more.,

I received a sample of this product and hoped that it would be an improvement on my current eye treatment product. Sadly, it wasn’t. I saw no effect whatsoever and it was though I wasn’t using any product at all. I’m glad to return to my go-to eye product.

I have tried many different products that are specifically targeted for the eye area. I have found this one to be one of the very best I have tried! It is super emollient and can be used as a 360 eye cream. I experienced no negative issues with this cream and found a 30% reduction in the visibility of the lines at my eyes, especially the crows toes! I will continue to use this product and full expect the positive results to continue. Algenist produces rock!!
I tried this cream and it made the whole area around my eye red and puffy. It also irritated the eyes themselves though I didn’t get the cream too close to my actual eye.
review_title: Irritated my eyes and the skin around them

review_text: i have been searching for the best eye cream and i think algenist is the best. I discovered them through sephora samples. I bought the full size complete version (which i love) and discovered this anti aging one (which i think I love even more. I can’t really claim if it “works“ with anti aging, as I have only used a sample, but I know that its really moisturizing, it absorbs nicely into my skin and leaves my eye area feeling great. I will buy the full version of this line.

This anti-aging eye cream has done nothing to improve anything about my eyes, and I’ve been using it for about 3 months. About the only thing I like is the texture of the cream. Extremely overpriced for a mediocre product.
I recently received a sample of this product with another purchase. It was so smooth and moisturizing that I will definitely be putting on my wish list!
Had no results with this cream. I would not purchase.
I was super careful to not put it too close to my actual eyes, but it still made my eyes burn and water and feel like I had something in them.

I received this as a sample, it’s a nice thick creme and did offer some lift in the two applications I got, but strangely made my freckles noticeable which usually only happens in summer. Didn’t help dark circles but who knows if using it for longer. Not sure I’d spend $72...would need a bigger sample to be sure.

As with most other Algenist products, this eye cream could not deliver on promises to firm, smooth, or minimize aging. There are a multitude of far more effective products on the market at 1/3 the cost. The product was alright, but completely unremarkable.

I chose this eye cream over numerous other eye creams because it was the only one I could find that didn’t give me an “oil slick“ (since I wanted one that I could wear under makeup during the day) AND didn’t break me out. I have acne prone skin, so even the area under/around my eyes can develop tiny bumps with the wrong eye cream. This one was gentle and effective at moisturizing and doing great under my makeup (no cakey effect), but I have to admit I don’t see any improvement in the fine laugh lines I have. For the price of the eye cream, you’d hope it would do a better job at “plumping“ those lines out than it does. That’s why I’m giving it 3 stars. Even though I bought it specifically because it did 2 things that I needed that all other eye creams I tried couldn’t deliver on, its overall value isn’t that great because it doesn’t do what I would say it a major claim of the product (anti-aging). So for those of you looking for a true anti-aging eye cream, I’d probably find a cheaper alternative.

This cream IS genius. I’m not one to leave reviews, but I could not resist. After a week of use, my eye area is NOTICEABLY smoother and softer, and fine lines are starting to decrease. My eyes look far more refreshed and rested. LOVE the whole genius line, I use all of it!!

I was hoping this would be as good as all the other Algenist products I like, but no luck. I love the oils but this is nothing short of a moisturizer at best. I had used LaMer for awhile but decided to try a less expensive option. I used this for a few months and didn’t see any results.

The texture of this eye cream is brilliant. You need very little to feel that your eyes have been moisturized. I like this product much more than the popular Algenist Complete Eye balm, which I used two full containers of. Also like it better than Caudalie’s Cru eyeball, which is heavier and difficult to get out of the pump near the end. I don’t have a lot of wrinkles, or saggy lids, but this is doing a great job of improving and preventing signs of aging.

I’m currently using a deluxe sample of this product, and when I’m done with that I intend to buy the full size. It is very rich but sinks in to my skin beautifully. It does not sting my eyes, nor does it have fragrance (which I appreciate). Highly recommend.

got a deluxe sample of this and was excited to try it but it burns! it burns went i put it on and made my eyes water like crazy. tried it a couple times just to make sure it was in fact this making my eyes burn/water. i gave it to my mother.

Got a pretty large sample of this cream with my last purchase and was excited. Hoped it would do something for my dark circles, early signs of wrinkling and loss of firmness. Twice a day for 3 weeks. Nothing at all. And it’s thick so it doesn’t really absorb well. Don’t waste your money.

I don’t write reviews that often...for different reasons..but certain things really blow me away..and being that this product is not exactly cheap, i feel like i should :)Bought this product online about month and a half ago just like another eye cream..even tho it’s on the pricey side i did not expect a miracle... I’m 32 and have pretty good skin, i DID NOT have crazy wrinkles, but started to develop some fine lines in my eye area...After about 3 weeks of using this product i was putting my makeup on while chatting on the phone..when i laughed, i suddenly realized - I DON’T HAVE THOSE LINES ANYMORE!! :O I was so happy! To make my point (to myself) and to prove that this product really works (again, to myself) i decided to use this product “outside of eye area“ and started applying it to my “expression“ spots, which is in between my eyebrows and the obvious around the mouth ones.....and sure enough the deeper one in between my eyebrows is almost gone now and no more fine lines around my mouth!!!!! :O :DSo, i’m really sorry wallet, but this one will have to stick around.. :( :PHope it works just as well for ya if you decide to buy it!

I am using this small sample pot now for a while -- it really lasts! I don’t have any wrinkles (genetic blessing) but thought it would help prevent them. The formula is mild and rich. I’m not sure what it offers to those who already have wrinkles or crows feet, though.

excellent product and excellent under makeup and you dont get the watery eyes like some eye creams give u. worth the money in my opinion and i tried tons and tons of eye creams even more pricey than this one and they dont work like this one does.

This stuff is amazing! I have spent so much money on every eye cream under the sun. I have fine lines as I approach 40 and have not found anything - NOTHING - that has worked to improve them. After just two days I see a difference! My under eye area is more hydrated and my lines have minimized. Not kidding - this stuff is amazing!

I’ve tried quite a few eye creams that promised to hydrate and minimize the fine lines I’m starting to get in the outer corners of my eyes. This fits the bill and smoothes my eyelids to boot. It’s very hydrating on my dry skin an really sinks in so my concealer and tinted moisturizer can just glide on and not crease! Will definitely be repurchasing when I run out.
review_title: I've found my HG eye cream!

review_text: I have tried other Algenist products that I would purchase and this is the second product attempt in this genius line and it’s not genius. Im in the early stage of fine lines... Just starting to try eye creams....I received a deluxe sample of this product from purchase. There is superior eye creams on the market for this price tag. I would not pay for this product and in fact I think it made my fine lines even worse....

It isn’t really a cream--it’s more of a balm. You really only need a very, very tiny amount. I used too much and noticed some white bumps forming under my eyes. I primarily purchased this in hopes that it would hydrate and help any forming wrinkles, but I think this product is too rich for my skin type (combination) and my age.

I cannot believe how wonderful this eye cream is, I was faithfully using the Algenist Eye Renewal Balm, and nothing compares to the Genius Eye Cream, I have been using it for a week or so, and my whole eye area feels tighter, I cannot say enough about this amazing product!

Yes, it’s a little awkward to get it out of the jar due to it’s consistency. It doesn’t feel super hydrating. After an hour or so my eyes feel dry again. It’s ok but I wish I had repurchased the Algenist Eye Renewal balm instead of deciding to try this.

Before I started using this, my under eye area was very dry and flaky, therefore making concealer really crease. I’ve been on the hunt for a good eye cream, and so far Ive been super happy with this product. Within 2 weeks, the dryness and flakiness under my eye totally cleared and Ive had no problems with my concealer creasing. The area under my eye is really smooth. I like a heavy, super moisturizing eye cream and this fits the bill. I always like to try new creams and constantly switch, but this is one product I would actually repurchase, and I think the price is very reasonable for the quality of the product.

This cream gave me results in two weeks. I have dry/sensitive eye area concerns with early signs of aging. I have noticed a visible difference in the brightness of the area’s tone and also firmness. The skin absolutely appears strengthened, especially right where my eye area meets the height of my cheekbones. This product is also very rich without being heavy, no signs of millia and cleared up extra dry patches under brows. I will repurchase this item.
The consistency of the product makes it hard to get out of the container. Once I can get it out and onto my eyes, It doesn’t seem to do much. I won’t buy it again.
I never thought at 44 the crows feet could actually disappear but they have! Absorbs in very nice.

This cream is too rich for me. Went back to using the regular Algenist renewal eye balm. Made the skin below my under eyes breakout. I gave this three stars still because I can see how this would be great for someone with very dry, creppy, mature skin (Im 28, have oily/combination skin).
I returned this. Using this left my eyes with a burning feeling. I tried using less, making sure that I wasn’t getting it in my eyes and nothing helped.

I’d been experimenting with eye creams for awhile - tried Clinique and Korres without luck. This stuff is great. I’m almost 52 and the area around my eyes is visibly smoother. I want to use on upper lid but haven’t done that yet. I’m very pleased with this.

Very moisturizing for my dry lids/under eye area. Great to use as night eye cream, I wake up with hydrated smoother plump eye area. Absorbs well yet leaves a moisture barrier which I love. review_text: The precleanse is an oil that glides on very smoothly on the skin. It smells like citrus; lemon and orange zest but not too overpowering. I didn’t notice any major changes or results until after using the product for a month and having a horrible breakout - that’s really when I saw the magic. My pimple went from a swollen nasty mess with puss, to a flat smooth and renewed surface within 3 days. I’m very surprised. I’m seeing the results of my skin cell turn over before my eyes.  I have combination sensitive skin. Oily T-zone but extremely dry everywhere else. When products are too harsh, I get eczema breakouts that sometimes crack and bleed for weeks. This product was sensitive enough for my face and never irritated my skin. 4 stars for being gentle enough to use every day. Didn’t have enough wow factor to be a 5 star though. The Microfoliant is gentle on my sensitive skin and leaves my face feeling smooth and soft. I have oily skin and It felt clean and not oily after use. I would recommend. This was definitely a first for me on both the cleanser and the exfoliant because previously, I’d only used cleansers that lathered and exfoliants that were in gel/paste/liquid form. The DERMALOGICA Cleanser was great at removing my tinted moisturize even though it didn’t lather. I think we’re conditioned to equate bubbles with cleanliness because I was definitely skeptical that the cleanser was doing its job, especially since it was so runny. Next, I used the exfoliating powder. This, as I’d said before, was a first. My hands were already damp from rinsing my face of the cleanser and with a few extra drops of water and rubbing it in with my fingers in a circular motion, the powder effortlessly turned into a paste. I went back in with a cotton round and alcohol free toner to check if any of my tinted moisturizer was left on my skin and the cotton round was clean. The biggest reason is the ease of use, I simply wet my hands and put some on my hand and rub it together and it turns into a creamy foam that gently exfoliates your face. It’s not harsh but it is extremely effective because after I use it my skin is baby bottom soft. This one just gives me the best results and I enjoy the process of using it. I use it in rotation with other products so the small size last me a very long time. However I find myself reaching for this one more often so I am going to upgrade to the large bottle. This set is a great way to try the products, also if you travel it’s great for that purpose. If you’re on a budget and simply can’t afford a large size at the moment, this will hold you over especially if you have alternates. review_text: I can’t say enough good things about this cleanser. I’ve been using it for a few years now and I’m just as thrilled with it now as I was when I started. One aspect I LOVE about this product is that it removes everything really gently. I can have a full face of makeup, (including eye makeup), and at the end of the day, simply wash my face and it gets my makeup and the day’s oil and crud off of my face. It leaves it perfect. I am so surprised by the reviews that say it strips their skin and is over-drying. I have normal skin, somewhat sensitive and all I can say is that the scent is subtle, the formula is non-irritating even to remove eye makeup, (though be gentle), and following i up with a moisturizer is all I need. This is coming from someone who had skin problems all of her life. And it’s not that I’ve grown out of it as i learned when I forgot to pack this cleanser in vacation. I bought some other cleanser to tide me over for 4 days and my face was not thrilled with me by the time I returned home as was evident by the blemishes that had cropped up. It is a little pricey but you use so little I literally only have to buy 3 tubes or so per year so it works out. My previous cleansers were AMOREPACIFIC and Dermologica. I think this Shiseido cleanser is much better than both of those and have no intention of changing to anything else in the near future because it doesn’t just meet my expectations, it exceeds them. My skin continues to get better. At 41 years old, that’s rare.

I used to use a very similar cleanser with white clay in high school that whips into a stiff foam and even had ‘face cleaning training’ from a family friend who worked for shiseido. It’s such a relief to switch back to this kind of cleanser that really does the job well. There is a scent to the cleanser, but it smells exactly like the lobby of the Hilton Tokyo (which I like). The key is to use a quality Japanese face cleansing/foaming net. (Sephora should carry one in their stores!) I used to use my hands to whip it up in high school, but now with a foaming net you get more foam and faster, and you can really get stiff foam. This is how I learned to use this type of product: Using a tiny, pinky-nail squeeze of the cleanser with a foaming net, you can whip it into a giant handful of foam. I like to whip it, squeeze it out of the net, and then put it back into the net and whip it into a stiffer foam, about the texture of really good freshly-whipped-meringue. Light, but stiff. The key is to start with a wet net and slowly add tiny splashes of water as you go (but not too much, or your foam won’t be stiff!)Then after spreading most of the foam across your face, you make the left over foam into a ball and begin to “roll” the foam in tiny circles across your face. It’s a really soothing feeling as the stiff foam gently tugs on your skin. It feels like the foam is lifting impurities from your pores. Then after washing all of the foam off, your face feels clean, soft, and hydrated. Get a foaming/cleansing net!

You won’t get foam or that tightness of ’clean’ we often expect from cleaning agents that dry out the skin. It takes some getting used to (your skin will feel different for a few days). Especially in how it rinses. It doesn’t feel like it’s coming off at first. It is. Things to note: one, use it on dry skin. Not wet. Not damp. Dry. It really is important or else the oil isn’t doing anything. Two, if you’re wearing heavy makeup, you’ll likely need to do something first to remove it. That’s not what this is made for. Try a magic erasing cloth - it’s so much better for your skin. Three, you may also need a second cleansing step, be it mct oil first or toner after, especially as your skin adjusts or if you’ve been using a bunch of products that day on your skin. But I don’t find I need to most days anymore.

After immediate use of this product, my forehead still felt clogged and textured, and oil production was visible on my nose just seconds after. I woke up feeling especially congested, and chose to give this product a 2nd try - this time doubling the amount, and taking more time heating it up and massaging it in. *This was also on my ’ordinary AHA/BHA exfoliation mask morning’, so I was curious if that would make a positive difference. However, the results were the same, even with the mask that I swear by. I will be going back to my old drug store cleanser and just enjoying pairing it with the Ordinary serums and masks instead.**The BENEFIT however: was that on the small dermatitis patches I’d developed from wearing/reusing n95 masks 8 hours long every day, are now A LOT less flakier. I’m not sure if it’s thanks to this cleanser, or the +HA Ordinary moisturizer, but I will keep this regime only for the perioral area until it’s fully treated, and my drug store cleanser for the rest. So I’m writing this review for the sole purpose of explaining the app. The Luna mini 3 may require the app for initial setup because you set the timing and intensity to be used for each section of your face. (See photo!) Once those are set then you don’t need to use the app again unless you want to change the settings. I was able to connect with bluetooth easily on iphone and android. Once you have your settings saved, you push the power button twice for the timed/intensity routine you set, or once for a 30 second super intense mode. The app also allows you to upload a proof of purchase for warranty reasons. I repeat, YOU DON’T NEED THE APP TO TURN THE DEVICE ON! My guess is people aren’t setting the routine and perhaps that’s why the device won’t turn on. One of the selling factors of the mini 3 is that you can customize the routine!As for the device itself, I purchased it when Clarisonic was discontinued. I think I preferred my Clarisonic but this device works and I like that i can turn down the intensity and timing. It’s a bit big for small crevices but it works. I’ve owned the original Luna Mini (still going strong since 2014) and tried the full size Luna 2, and the Luna Mini 3 is the best of the bunch. The longer bristles really do make a difference, and feel so much softer than the 1 and 2 (but the drawback is that the longer bristles trap more dead skin cells and water droplets). I also prefer the mini size, because it fits the contours of the face better and I never found the anti-aging mode on the full size to be effective. I decided to upgrade from the original because over time, I felt like the original bristles weren’t flexible enough. And as my skincare routine got more advanced, the original wasn’t doing anything extra for my skin that I couldn’t achieve with actives. The Luna Mini 3 fixes those issues and complements my current skincare routine. My skin is more smooth, my makeup applies nicer, and I feel like my pores are less clogged.However, the app is awful. It has a bad user interface and frequent connectivity issues. The app is required for selecting intensity (0-12) and duration (60s-120s). There’s also a quicker Glow boost mode that is intensity 12-16 and 30 seconds long. It’s annoying if I want to change things up depending on how my skin is feeling that day, but I don’t want to bother fiddling with my phone just to be able to wash my face. Another annoyance is that the duration is a minimum of 60 seconds, but I usually like to do less. I have to hold onto the power button for ~5 seconds before it will turn off. On the original Luna, power off was instant. The reviews for the full sized Luna 3 say it’s not possible to turn off manually,..it’s probably because people are confused about how to turn it off.Pics compare the original Luna mini (teal) to the Luna 3 mini (black). The Luna 3’s bristles cover a bigger surface area, and the shape is more ergonomic.

review_text: I have always had hit and miss experiences with Origins.  This mask, sadly, was a miss for me.  DRINK UP is thinner than I expected it to be given the ingredients, and it ultimately failed to keep my skin hydrated overnight--indeed, I never felt that it helped much with hydration, even in the immediate aftermath of application.  I typically use overnight masks to keep my dryer cheeks and chin hydrated; this mask did nothing to help those areas.  After a few weeks of using DRINK UP every night and still waking up with flakes around my jaw line, I decided to discontinue use (which was easy, since the mini I purchased was about out).To be sure, the mask did not irritate my skin, leave me feeling oily, or make me break out. It is a light, creamy mask that the skin drinks up quickly and happily.  It also had a surprising smell, sort of like a jolly rancher or those orange tic-tacs.  For some reason I really liked this aspect of the mask!  Given that the mask did me no harm, I do not begrudge purchasing it.  I just think that it is meant for skin that is not as dry as mine.  Final Note: I am very impressed that Origins makes so many of its products available as minis.  Having a more affordable option for trying their products has allowed me to test out products I’m interested in for a few weeks before deciding whether to commit.  Their minis have put me onto products that I eventually feel confident purchasing in full sizes (e.g., their Rose Clay Mask), and when a product doesn’t deliver in the way I want it to, I don’t end up having to choose between continuing to use a product that I don’t like or discontinuing it and wasting the remaining product.  I wish more skincare companies would follow Origins’ example on this front.

review_text: I bought this device in April of 2020. I’ve had a great experience with it and can definitely tell a difference when I haven’t used it in a while. I use in the morning, after cleansing I apply amorepacific vintage single extract essence followed by a thin layer of the nuface gel all over. I follow the 5 minute protocol from the nuface app and then gently wipe off remaining gel with saie reusable round and warm water. In between treatment areas I spray LRP spring water to keep the gel wet and I don’t need to reapply. I do not use the ELE attachment as much as I thought I would. I do use the LED attachment under my chin and target specific areas of my face that I feel need extra help. Overall I am very satisfied with this gadget and if it does break I will repurchase another nuface.

The micro current with the Nuface is meant to ’revitalize’ through time your muscles. This is something that oils, creams, etc., will not do. I’ll get straight to the point,... After my experience with this product, I’m a little hesitant to recommend it to others. These Dr. Zenovia Skincare 10% Glycolic Acid Acne Control Peel Pads initially reminded me of one of my favorite products, FAB Facial Radiance Pads. But there’s some noticeable differences between the two. First off, the Dr. Zenovia pads have a much rougher texture, it feels like it’s partially physically exfoliating your skin as you wipe your face after cleansing. Second, I’m assuming these pads have a much higher percentage of glycolic acid than FAB, not to mention they also include salicylic acid while FAB does not. I decided to replace all acne products in my routine with these Dr. Zenovia Pads because I didn’t want to experience any adverse reactions. After using these pads, I experienced an uncomfortable tingling sensation that lingered for several minutes. The jar does warn you that you may feel some tingling, so I was mentally prepared for this. But I cannot stress enough how uncomfortable it was, this product is definitely not for sensitive skin in my opinion. I have combination skin that can usually handle most products, but I was hesitant to keep using this myself... Now, to the main point: these Peel Pads claim to unclog pores, promote cell renewal, remove dead skin cells, and visibly target acne and post-acne scars. As for the visible effectiveness of this product,... I didn’t see any decrease in my acne or improvement with my acne scars. In fact, I saw a huge increase in my acne, almost like purging except it never went away. After several weeks of daily use, my skin only got worse. This product may be right for some, but I cannot in good conscience recommend it considering the current state of my skin. I’ll happily switch back to the products that I know work for me and hopefully clear up my complexion before my next Zoom meeting!

review_text: I was thrilled to have received a free bottle of SK-II from the retailer to try out. review_text: I was extremely happy with this eye cream from Dr. Zenovia Skincare. I am usually disappointed with eye creams because I find they don’t layer well with my other skincare products. I also usually do not see more than a subtle improvement in my eye area when using these products. However, I feel like I’m almost obligated to tell everyone about this amazing eye cream! I try so many skincare products and rarely feel completely amazed with the results I get. After using this eye cream with retinol for a month, my eye area feels and looks firmer and my fine lines (crow’s feet) and the lines underneath my lower lash line are DRAMATICALLY improved! I never have had an issue with dark circles or puffiness and bags under my eyes, but I can say that the skin in my eye area is definitely brighter looking and more even-toned. Best of all, this cream layers so well with my other skincare products. For real. No exaggeration here. I have yet to use this eye cream with a product that it doesn’t work well with, AKA pilling/rolling. This cream is rich, yet it absorbs completely into my skin within a minute. Just use a thin layer and pat or press into your skin. Because this eye cream contains retinol, it’s best to use at night because any UV light drastically reduces the efficacy of the retinol. Retinol is the star ingredient that does the “heavy lifting“ in this formula, so if used during the daytime, it may make it ineffective. The 15ml /0.5 oz. tube definitely will last much longer than a month when used once or twice daily in the suggested amount, which is a pea-sized amount. Personally, I use less than a pea-sized amount because this formula spreads really easily despite it’s rich, creamy texture. So, while this eye cream is a bit pricey, it’s completely worth it in my opinion. The results are not subtle, they are dramatic. The product lasts much longer than a month. The texture is rich and creamy, yet absorbs like a dream. And the formula works great with other products.

review_text: I’ve had this for 4 years and just wanted to update my review. First of all, when you purchase realize this is to REDUCE hair - this is not sold as a permanent hair machine. So in time you will have hair growing back. This will take time to show it’s full result. I followed the initial treatment on my legs of once a week for 7 weeks. For reference I’m of tan-dark complexion tone, my hair grows back the same day after shaving (fast hair growth throughout) and I have coarse, dark hair. I went from shaving my legs daily to maybe shaving once every few months (shaving stragglers hairs) otherwise I’m hairless and this has been 4 years out without doing touch up treatments. My wax lady (for bikini area) assumed she did a good job waxing on me when in reality I had been lasering between appointments. I went from seeing her every 3 weeks to 2 months. Your hair has different growth cycles so definitely continue beyond the initial 7 week treatment. At very minimal try once a month ongoing, it is a commitment. Wax prior to lasering to get optimal results and help penetrate into the folical better or shave, but laser on DRY skin. Follow the instructions. I exfoliate my skin while in the shower, avoid any lotion and get to lasering. At times I go over the same area 2-3x making the process daunting but well worth it. Some areas are more stubborn (facial, bikini and underarm) in my opinion. Just remember hair growth cycles, your hair will grow in different phases so you’ll experience patches or areas that seem resistant. The machine itself has a wide head which is better than other laser machines as you can do the process a lot quicker. The sensation is minimal to none, it’s emitting heat so the area I feel it most is the bikini area so I normally bring it down to level 2 and I’m fine. In the 4 years I’ve had it glitched where it stopped randomly or the light blinks but it restarted okay. I will always recommend it. The price is so worth not shaving!

review_text: I’ve tried a few hair laser removal devices and this one is probably my favorite. Prior to this product, I was using a Tria. And the Tria was great, effective and all, but I simply could not tolerate the pain. It just hurt too much. The pain level from this product is much more tolerable. I love that it can be plugged into the electrical socket on the wall for continuous use, unlike Tria, which runs on rechargeable battery. I also love that the laser head is so much bigger (Roughly about 2x0.5inch) which means that it can cover an area so much faster, which shortens my torment. For that, I definitely prefer this device over Tria, even though I found that the Tria’s laser is stronger and more effective. Oh, I should probably tell you that I use this machine everywhere but mostly on my problem areas which are my armpits and umm.. downtown. I have fair skin and very dark hair, also very coarse. So, I am a prime candidate for laser hair removal. And I also have a lot of hair. (Seriously, it’s a lot, like out of control, curse of a bush, a lot)Ok, now I’ll tell you from the beginning about my experience with this device. When I first got this device and began using it, I was so disappointed. I’d followed instruction, I’d shaved before zapping and I’d follow the steps that the booklet told me to do. I did that for several months with no results what so ever.I then began to use the device more frequently, on the highest setting, for experiment sake. But that yielded no better results neither. I was about to give up when I went back and read the booklet again to double check if I was doing something wrong. And the booklet said that for those with light colored hair, it is recommended to wax or epilate prior to zapping. I don’t have light colored hair but I decided to epilate before zapping anyway, for experiment sake, and that changed everything. My hair nearly stopped growing back after that first time. I was shocked. Normally, with shaving, it would grow back within 12 hours, with waxing or epilating, it would grow back within a week or two. I waited a full month and maybe only 30% of the hair came back. So, I repeated this process again. Epilate first and zap immediately after. And I do mean immediately afterwards, as in, within seconds… Yes, it sounds very hardcore, it did hurt, but it worked. (But it still hurts a lot less than Tria) For your information, I have never been one with sensitive skin, my skin is actually quite tough, so I knew I could handle this. I definitely can’t speak for everyone. When I do this, sometimes I’d literally smell the scent of burning hair, but I didn’t mind it because that was the scent of success, as each time, my hair would grow back slower and less. I went from zapping every two weeks to every month, to every few months. The longer I waited between treatments, the less hair seemed to grow back each time. In the end, my Rambutan became a Cherry and I am so happy with the result. I’ve been using this device for over a year now, but I wasted a lot of months, not epilating before zapping. Now, I have so few hair that can pretty count how many there are and that is astonishing to me. As far as the cartridge replacement go, I’ve never had to replace it. I’ve never gotten a warning and never had the device stopped working for me and I’m quite impressed with this part.Another thing too that I wished someone had warned me about is; the flashing…. Girls… It is so bright!! It’s as bright as camera flashes. I cannot look directly at it. I doubt that anyone could. So, I’d recommend putting on some shades to protect your pretty eyes or look away when you zap, that’s what I do.. I hold my breath and I look away.

review_text: Long overdue review. For reference I’m med-dark tone (mac nc42-45) with coarse, dark body hair. I Got this on Black Friday 2015. review_text: A Little about my skin and hair dilemmas. I am very light skinned around the tone of NC 20, NARS SG Fuji, Koh Gen do 113. My hair is extremely thick and course in the color of dark espresso to black. My hair grows extremely quick and I would have no choice but to shave my legs and under arms daily and even then by the afternoon my legs would start to feel prickly  Too bad I couldn’t bottle whatever made my hair grow so quickly, I would have made millions! Now on to this long winded review.So I have currently owned this device a little longer than 2 months now and have completed all the recommended 7 treatments. I wanted to wait so that I may give full review because 445$ is quite the investment for a lot of us. So the big question is does it work? And you will not like my answer because it depends… If you’re expecting to receive COMPLETELY hair free (think the Sphnx cat baldness) including all peach fuzz eradicated, it’s just not going to happen. BUT if you do have realistic expectations I hope you will not be disappointed. What I mean by realistic is 50-98% per area of hair reduction. I say per area because I have done my entire body, face, underarms, arms, bikini, and legs. Each area, even though treatment was all performed in the same manner at the same time, reacted a little differently. Let’s start from the face. I have mostly peach fuss on my face that is barely noticeable and does not bother me but what did were the small dark hairs that I would have to wax/pluck from the sides of my moth as well as 4 dark hairs that would come up on my chin. After 7 treatments the peach fuzz had only a little reaction while the 4 hairs on my chin I have not seen treatment 2!! As far as the hairs on the corner of my mouth they are drastically reduced by up to 80 %( That is 80% has not regrown at all!) Far as the few that are being stubborn they are much thinner and grow at a MUCH slower rate. Now most of the rest of my body hair reacted in the same way as the hairs around my mouth with thinner hairs and slower growth rate but what you really care about is how much is permanently gone so here is what I estimate. Arms: reduction by 50%. Underarms: 75% Bikini: reduction by 85-90%. NOW the big one and the one I really wanted this device for. Leg reduction by 98%!!!! This alone made it worth it to me! Now just because this worked out for me doesn’t mean it will work out for you. Every ones hair reacts differently much like skin care is different for all of us its very personal. Before you make a big purchase take a read on how IPL (Intense Pulsed Light) and RF (Radio Frequency) affects hair growth and see if that helps with the decision to purchase or not. So did it hurt? Not at all! I bump that baby up to highest level on the first treatment. The only thing you do feel is a very warm sensation especially around the more “sensitive areas”. This is not just a quick zap and you’re out the door oh heck no this take patience! Slowly and thoroughly ensure you hit each part of the area and be dedicated or you’re not going to see results. So get yourself a drink ( an adult drink if your old enough) turn on some NETFLIX and put on a face mask, might as well make it a SPA day! I hope this helps a little

I love this product! I found it gentle enough for my sensitive skin, and the texture is so silky and luxurious! It helped with hydration too. This is such a unique product that I will continue using. The addition of niacinamide is also a plus for me. Great product!

I picked this as a Sephora sample and idk....idk if it’s going to do anything yet because I haven’t been using it long but I’m surprised that not a lot of reviews state that it smells like sharpie. The smell throws me off and it makes me feel like I’m doing something wrong with skin care. Maybe my sample is bad? Idk. I just can’t get over the smell

I have extremely dry and reactive sensitive skin, so even as I’m looking for ways to soothe it and soften the effects of aging, I’m always worried about making things worse through irritation. After a ten-day trial run of this serum, I had to admit that, not only was I not reacting to it, I was seeing a generally more “glowing“ and even skin tone. It was subtle, but noticeable enough that now that the trial is over, I miss it enough to buy it.

I’ve used the Genius  Ultimate Anti-Aging Cream and Genius Ultimate Anti-Aging Eye Cream for years now and they work great on my sensitive, combination skin.
