It adds a healthy glow, while calming redness. The texture doesn’t fight with any moisturizer or oil that I layer on top. My skin is happy, plump and protected from pollutants.
review_title: Adds a nice glow, while calming redness

review_text: Definitely recommend testing or sampling this product before splurging on the full size. I have sensitive skin, but use many intense serums and active ingredients in my skincare routine. Unfortunately the AA Barrier Serum caused major breakouts. So disappointed, I really wanted to love this serum. I absolutely love Algenist’s Advanced Retinol Serum.

As others have mentioned, the smell is off-putting. However the feel and the results are great. I will definitely try this for a longer period of time to get lasting results of smoother skin, less lines :)

This is a fantastic product.  After ten days of use my skin appears much brighter and has a glow. I’ve received three compliments on my skin recently so it must be noticeable. I’ve noticed my skin is more toned and smooth. Thank you Algenist for making yet another great product.  I highly recommend!

I’ve switched from the algensit vitamin c to the AA barrier as it works well both morning and night. Am: to help with environmental damage such as pollution and sun (live in sf). PM: to sooth the redness when used with a retinol.  My skin is brighter and more even in tone.
review_title: Great for a  AM/PM base serum

review_text: I started using this almost a month ago, and have been really impressed! i love how this balancing my skin - hydrating my dry areas but also helping to control oil in my tzone. i feel like this has given my skin an overall healthy glow and has definitely evened out tone and texture. it doesn’t have much scent and absorbs easily, slightly tacky but i don’t mind that at all. i’ve been using sample sizes of this morning and night but will definitely be repurchasing full size because my skin is looking so radiant! i think this serum would be great for all skin types. i received samples from the brand in exchange for my honest review.

I really like this serum. These new environmental protectors are hard to fit into my routine but it does not pill and it does not break me out. It smells a bit like alcohol but it goes away quickly. I think that is the smell of the acid. All in all a great product with a function.

I have been using Algenist products for many years and I’m delighted with the condition of my skin. Anytime a new product comes out, I try it immediately and I am never disappointed! I recently tried the new AAA barrier serum and fell in love! After only 10 days my skin has a pretty natural glow to it and looks so much healthier and smoother! I will definitely be adding this serum to my daily routine. Another huge success by Algenist!
review_title: Algenist AA Serum does not disappoint!

review_text: I am a strong believer in Algenist products and was super excited about this new product launch! I have been using the AA Barrier Serum for about 3 weeks and am loving how well it incorporates into my skincare routine. I love how well it absorbs into the skin and how lightweight it layers under my other skincare steps! Since starting this serum, I have noticed an improvement in my skin quality. Because I work in a hospital, the air often causes irritation to my skin. However, since adding this serum into my routine, I haven’t noticed any annoying red, irritated spots that I usually get on my cheek area! Per usual, I can always count on Algenist to deliver and formulate beautiful, innovative and effective products!

I love this new serum. I’ve used it for 10 days now and notice a difference. My skin looks smoother, feels firmer and it glows I am so pleased. I have been using Algenist products for a couple of years and I can honestly say I will continue to use Algenist  products - definitely worth every penny!

it has the ingredients call out but the ingredient list says that it contains retinyl palmitate doesn’t matter much to me but some people might be sensitive to that otherwise a great product works great I love it
Amazing product . You will see it really can brighten your skin tone

I was lucky enough to receive a 10 day sample and I used it once a day in the morning.  I used it on my face, neck, eyes and chest area.  It worked well under my foundation.  I did not see much improvement until the 10th day and I am so excited about the results.  My neck is much firmer and so is my lower face area where I needed the most help.  In addition to the firmness, I also see less crepey wrinkled skin.  It is so hard to find something with these results particularly on the neck.  I have loved the Algenist products for some time now and this new addition is a winner!!!

This really does protect the skin. It left my skin more radiant and it helped heal scaring. I had a lot less breakouts while I used this, as well. If you use too much, it does get sticky and will roll off and/or cause your makeup to roll off. Be sure not to overdo it. Like all their products (in my opinion), a little goes a long way. I did see a change and improvement in the overall health of my skin. The first time I tried it, I did feel a slight warming sensation. After that, I didn’t feel it as much. The packaging also looks amazing. All in all, I would recommend this.

This serum is fabulous -- goes on smoothly and makes your skin glow and stay super soft.  The peptides in this product are what really make the difference in taking your skin to the next level.  Helped me with my fine lines and wrinkles -- they were less noticeable in a week.

I like this product very much. My skin feels smoother and firmer and looks vibrant and bright. Especially good for the season to be outdoors. A vibrant look and protection as well make a great combination.
review_title: Smoother vibrant look and protection as well.

review_text: As an Algenist devotee, I was pleased to have an early opportunity to sample this new serum formulation, with its higher concentration of Alguronic Acid and unique combination of antioxidants and niacinamide.  Since I already use both the liquid and sleeping collagen products, I didn’t anticipate seeing much change in the appearance of my skin.  Silly me, underestimating Algenist!  My face was brighter, smoother, and significantly more even in tone.  The fine lines around my eyes, already smoothed by daily use of Algenist products, were now nearly imperceptible.  The mirror seemed to reflect back a younger, more carefree version of myself.  This was after a ten-day period in which I used the product only in the morning, after applying liquid collagen and before moisturizing, as suggested in the serum usage instructions.  I have already ordered a full-size bottle, and plan to use this product both mornings and evenings.  Thank you, Algenist formulators, for this terrific addition to my skin care regimen.
review_title: Yes, you should absolutely try this serum

review_text: I’ve tried many high end serume and I highly recommend Algenist’s POWER, ELEVATE and Collagen serums which are all bomb. This one I tried once and it blew my pores open and left my skin greasy (used before bed). I tried it just in a triangle area on my cheeks and you could see in the morning the shape I applied it was red. I recommend patch testing this and getting a sample before buying as this is very spendy.It did feel a warming sensation after applying it, so it has active ingredients for sure!

I had the opportunity to test this product for 10 days and I have no regrets. I have acne prone skin and my complexion appeared brighter and smoother after just 10 days! My skin felt hydrated upon waking up next morning. I definitely plan to add this serum to my nighttime skin care routine!

I tried this serum for only ten days and I’m completely blown away with the results! From the first night I tried it,  I was really impressed with how smooth and radiant my skin looked.  As a 47 year young woman, it’s hard to maintain smooth skin texture,  this serum helped to bring it back to life! My skin looks brighter and fresher looking,  makeup goes on smoother too, I love it! The serum is light and doesn’t pill up under my moisturizer and makeup,  it also didn’t clog my pores. It’s full of skin loving antioxidants including alguronic acid, niacinamide , chlorine, and ergothioneine formulated to help protect the skin barrier against pollutants. It’s simply phenomenal and I would recommend it to everyone, especially those with dull uneven skintone! I recieved this complimentary sample to try, all opinions are my own.

Got this as a sample. Algenist products are my jam. I love the texture and packaging. I put it under my moisturizer. Too soon to tell if there are any effects that they promise, I haven’t seen any immediate results.

Ive been using Algenist for a little over a year now and I’ve seen such a difference since.  My skin used to be super dehydrated and I was starting to look my age.  Within four days of using this Serum my skin felt more supple, had a glow and my make up even looked better.  I definitely recommend it!
One the best serums I’ve used!! Great for hyperpigmentation and keeping skin hydrated and glowing!! A must have in any skincare routine.
I LOVE this product! It protects my skin from every day irritants. I have so many food allergies and environmental allergies. This keeps my skin from looking inflamed.
review_title: NEW Must Have in my routine

review_text: The only thing I regret about trying this, is not taking  before & after photos). this serum has cleared up my skin, I used to get a lot of breakouts but since using this I havent. it has also lightened up some acne mark’s! you only need a little. I applied too much at first and it was very sticky. It sinks into your skin so nicely. It has a nice smell that quickly goes away. over all I really like this serum. You will really enjoy this serum!!

I love this formula. It’s a lightweight but emollient gel that has a quick flash of that phloretin scent but its gone quickly. I understand it’s the concentration of all the stuff in the formula. My skin is smooth, I breakout less often and when I do its quickly over. very soothing and my pigmentation is also less. I love how my skin looks and feels. I use this in the day and Liquid Collagen at night.
AA Barium Serum gets a gold star from me!  Reduced redness and left my skin soft and glowing!! A must have!!

This product was amazing, especially for my guys out there, we have tougher skin. I travel for work and the morning after a flight I’m always broken out, not anymore! This product also helped  make me a couple of fine lines seem a lot less prominent so I would definitely recommend this for someone looking to prevent or who is just now starting to see signs of aging. The only thing for me is the smell but it  goes away in about 3 seconds  ( I feel like the smell makes it seem like it’s going to work very well though)

I am shocked by this serum, in just 10 days my skin is  tighter and more plump. Serum from brands costing 3x this don’t work this well. The only downfall is the smell but within a few seconds it’s gone. Your skin is left toned and  perfected.

Loving this serum! The texture is amazing, and it instantly soaks into my skin. It has helped even out my skin and definitely adds a glow. As someone who hates the feeling of caking on product, big fan of how light weight this serum is.

This product is amazing! I’ve been using for a week and a half and it has already evened out my skintone and helped so much with texture, my skin is super smooth! I have acne prone skin and it hasn’t made me break out at all. It soaks right in and doesn’t leave your skin feeling greasy or sticky. I use in the morning and follow up with moisturizer. The smell is a little strong at first, not bad, but it doesn’t linger and goes away very quickly. Definitely buy if you want a serum that protects against environmental damage and also makes your skin look great.

Hold my beer, (or maybe champagne glass is more fitting for this product!)because it is amazing! Reduction in redness, smoother more balanced skin that is visibly more hydrated. This is my go to AM Serum. Stop treating your symptoms and start protecting your skin from the aggressors attacking it. I got access to this product early and have been using it for weeks now. My opinion is my own, and I was not compensated to write this. So, buy this!

This stuff WORKS. Calmed my severely dehydrated  skin, and improved forehead wrinkles as an added bonus! It does take time, I didn’t see improvement overnight, but over the course of 6 weeks ALL  redness is gone, and my skin feels back to normal.
Love love love this product. This helps my dry sensitive skin. along with the rich cream these are my daily winter products.

I received a sample, upon application my skin felt extremely greasy ( I have dry to combination skin) I went on Sephora website to check the ingredients: this has vegetable oil high up on the list! Not for me..

After the AB Rich Cream was reformulated I developed an allergic reaction to the product. I was so upset because the original formula had given my skin an exquisite glow. I also continued to use it. The reaction became so acute that I had to see a dermatologist. The irony, I purchased the Ultimate Soothing Cream and it completely healed my skin. If you have sensitive skin, mild skin issues, etc. this is one amazing product.

I’ve been using augustinus bader products for 2 years now. There is not one I dislike, but they are each great for different times of the year. This is a great product for year round, and my new favorite from AB. I notice my skin is calmed within minutes of use, and I’m no longer getting the little breakouts. The smell (lead pencil) is interesting, but not bothersome. I am noticing my skin is tolerating the acids in my routine a lot better. I like the rich cream (great for summer), but this one is so much better. This cream pairs really well with the Victoria Beckham AB Serum. That serum did not pair well with the rich cream.
review_title: Great for calming - does what it says

review_text: I absolutely hate that I love this cream so much because it’s so expensive but unfortunately it’s the only thing that has helped repair my skin barrier. Repairing the skin barrier has also helped a lot with my acne.

My combo rosacea-prone skin has fallen in love with the Augustinus Bader Ultimate Soothing Cream. My skin can be sensitive/finicky, and at times, I get eczema flareups. I also struggle with hormonal acne here & there (but maskne has been the main culprit the last couple yrs). The calming power of this cream is unlike any skincare product I’ve ever used. It squashed almost every issue I was having in a short amount of time.I didn’t realize how badly my skin needed a rest from a lactic acid treatment in my routine until I first applied the cream. Its consistency is very thick, and I was concerned it might be too heavy. I am thrilled that the soothing cream has been the perfect fit, as it absorbs exceptionally well & isn’t greasy!As my skin was dehydrated, and practically DRANK the moisture in, I thought a 2nd application might be needed in a few hrs. Instead, my skin stayed calmed, hydrated, and balanced.I scaled down my skincare routine majorly to see what the soothing cream was capable of. I kept my double cleanse, a lil lactic acid when maskne arose, and brightening eye cream here & there. It’s a bit mind blowing how relaxed and supple my skin feels and looks when using the soothing cream day & night. My pores seem smaller, my skin barrier is MUCH stronger, and my redness is noticeably diminished.AB products are vegan, eco-conscious, and sustainable; and the glass packaging has an effortlessly luxurious yet understated feel. Almost as if they know the science and brains behind their patented TFC8® technology speaks for itself. (As do the results.)The AB website mentions the soothing cream can be used in addition to other AB products. I’ve also tried AB’s Cleansing Gel & The Cream, and loved how supple & radiant they made my skin! Both would pair well with the soothing cream. If pairing, I’d likely mostly use the soothing cream at night, on flareups, and in cooler months. The R.O.I. for AB skincare, and in particular the soothing cream, is high.

Este producto llegó a mis manos por casualidad  como una bendición para mi piel, la recibí como obsequio  para conocer mi valoración sobre la crema. Estoy fascinada y es mi producto favorito en estos momentos. He usado infinidad de marcas para hidratar y cuidar mi piel madura pero aunque mi piel es muy sana y saludable siempre tenía problemas con la irritación pues es muy sensible. Por fin encontré un producto que me hidrate, ilumine y no irrite mi rostro. Estoy sumamente feliz.

Probably one of my newest favorite moisturizer. It’s very hydrating and my skin feels so soft and smooth after using it. It’s pricey but legit a little goes a long way. Will definitely keep using this.
review_title: a little goes a long way

review_text: Augustinus Bader’s The Ultimate Soothing Cream is a wonderful cream moisturizer that soothes and hydrates my skin perfectly. I have normal to dry skin with redness from rosacea and after using this my skin is less red and so soft. I only need a small pea-sized amount to cover my entire face. This didn’t leave my skin oily at all. It soaks in and left my skin dry to the touch, but hydrated and firm. I could actually feel my skin firm up, as if I had a mini face lift, especially around my eye area. It plumps up from within the skin as opposed to leaving a layer of moisturizer on top of the skin. The blue glass jar is beautiful and I love that you can purchase a refill container that snaps into the jar. I would definitely consider purchasing this product in the future. Since I only need a small amount, it should last at least 3 to 6 months with daily use.

This cream is amazing! Word to the wise, though- it’s THICK. A little dab will do you! And I’ve been using this product about 2 months and I still haven’t figured out the perfect routine for it! My face was INCREDIBLY dry when I first started using it, so using it twice a day for over a week worked GREAT! ... Until it made my face INCREDIBLY oily. I cut down to once a day. Now I use it every other day, only at night. I really liked the fact that the jar was refillable, and the lotions snap in/out! The scent was incredibly neutral- almost undetectable (which made me nervous, because I kept thinking it should smell like something!) This honestly was a treat to use, and one jar will last an incredibly long time! Apply when your face feels like it needs a SUPER hydrating boost!
Luxurious feeling cream that soaks into the skin well. However the improvements in texture I did see, were not worth the steep price tag to repurchase.

This product is a pillow for your skin. It is plush hydration with minimal scent. A little goes fast since it is super rich. I noticed within weeks that my skin is more plump, and it’s taken down the visible redness on my cheeks. I would absolutely recommend this product to anyone who wants soft, plump skin that is in need of refreshment. Am going to try and get this cream again!!

Perfect fall/winter cream! I tried it in the summer for 30 days and while it gave amazing results and kept me hydrated for 24 hours, it’s so thick it makes my face sweat on hot days. You can feel the protective layer it gives when trying to wash your face. It seems like a waterproof layer on my skin locking in all the moisture. I would definitely recommend but I wish it was more affordable.

While this cream does a great job calming and moisturizing my skin, it’s too heavy for a regular choice in the sweaty Southern summer. It would be more optimal for daily use in the cold months or in less humid climates. I had a little patchy dry spot on my face and the cream eliminated it entirely in just one use. A little bit goes a long way. I have mild rosacea and a light layer quickly calms the reddish appearance. I like that there are refill pods available, so no need to buy a new container when you need more  - just the refill. On the down side, the container is really heavy and awful for travel so you need to transplant some in a small, light travel container.
Very thick, rich texture that leaves my skin feeling nourished. I don’t need to layer up when using this and my sensitive skin doesn’t get irritatef at all
Incredibly hydrating! The packaging is gorgeous and feels very luxurious. The cream itself is thick and doesn’t have any strong offensive fragrance! Love putting this on at night before bed!

I’m not going to lie, this cream is amazing. It was gifted in return for my honest review — if money was of no object, I would definitely keep this stocked up. The texture is awesome, it’s not greasy at all, and it really does what it claims.
Absolutely loved this! My face can be sensitive and I’ve yet to have a problem. Skin seems smoother and clearer!

I love this moisturizer! I had heard of the brand before and thought it would be good but I had no idea just how incredible it would be. My redness is almost completely gone! It just melts into your skin! Not greasy, light scent and makes your skin look fresh. I usually use LeMer but I’ll be switching to this for sure!

The Ultimate Soothing Cream by Augustinus Bader is a perfect example of luxury meeting efficiency. Not only does it feel delicious to apply, with its dense and silky texture, a little goes a long way and delivers instant, noticeable results. I’ve been using this for a couple of months now and during that time I’ve spent weeks making a movie in the frigid Alaskan winter, then flown long haul to Australia and back and battled the jet lag on both ends, endured a wicked case of the flu, and commenced the dry, hot California summer. All of that is a lot to ask your skin to tolerate and I swear, the product that has gotten me through and kept my skin hydrated, firm, even in tone and smooth is this cream. I absolutely love it. The blue jar is eye-catching and chic, and I also love that Augustinus Bader offers eco-friendly, refillable packaging to reduce waste. All in all, I highly recommend this product. Whilst it’s on the higher end of the price spectrum, its quality and effect absolutely makes it worth the investment.
review_title: A truly luxurious cream of the highest quality

review_text: I am in love with this cream! I have been using it for the past three weeks, and I love the way my skin looks. I typically have a lot of surface redness, and it is gone. I mean, no redness—I’ve never had that happen. My fine lines are less noticeable, because this cream hydrates so well. I have oily but dehydrated skin, and this cream sinks right in, with no tackiness, and never makes my skin overly oily throughout the day. It doesn’t pill under makeup, and my skin feels and looks the best it has in a long while!

I’ve tried both The Cream and The Rich Cream, and this formula is by far my favorite Augustinus Bader moisturizer. I love the thick texture, and how soft and smooth it makes my skin feel. The smallest amount is needed, a little goes a long way. I’ve been using it regularly at night and wake up to clear, soft skin. I also love that the jar can be refilled. As with all the Augustinus Bader products, this formula is relatively unscented.

This is a heavy rich cream that goes on the skin smoothly and easily. It’s greasy at first but once absorbed you won’t feel it anymore. Has a nice smell to it, doesn’t bother me. My skin feel super hydrated after using it. I suggest using it during winter season when skin is dry.

I recently received a complimentary sample from influenster for my honest review. I received a full size sample which really is what’s needed for a good review of the product any skin care you should atleast use for 30 days to work it into your routine to allow it time to start working. I immediately notices lighter blemishes and noticeably softer skin. I used it a full 30 days before I reviewed and it is a must have I used it with the Augustin bader cream and the cleanser and they really are wonderful and worth the money.  Pricey is my only not like but if you can afford this skin care routine you will get results.
This cream is Amazing!!! So smooth and not greasy.

I love that this is product that actually does what it states. After my first use, I could notice the smoothness in my skin and I wasn’t as puffy as I normally would be in the morning. I use this as my night cream. It’s creamy and thick. It is excellent for dry skin. I also enjoy that it has little to no scent. I recommend this Soothing Cream to anyone, but I definitely recommend for individuals with irritated dried skin.

This cream is very thick and does leave your skin smooth but it also leaves it slightly greasy and I’m not a big fan of the smell. The greasy feeling does go away after a bit so that’s not to bad and it does leave your skin feeling smooth. My main dislike is the scent; it’s like a heavy lotion smell if that makes sense. The scent is my main reason for the 3 stars.

This cream makes my face hydrated,  smooth and glowing.  The cream is a bit thick but it doesn’t left you with an oily uncomfortable feeling.   The price is on par with a luxury brand,  highly recommend.
Good moisturizer works well, my skin feels great. The only dislike I have is the smell, it’s smells to me of pencil shavings. Besides that it is great and the packaging is absolutely beautiful!

I was so thrilled to get the opportunity to try this product!  I have normal skin and I have used it day and night religiously.  It is rich and a little goes a long way.  It is formulated with antioxidants, anti-inflammatories, vitamins, and oils that are intensely nourishing, moisturizing, and soothing.  My skins feels and looks amazing and I have noticed an improvement in texture and firmness.   Overall, this is a lovely product and it lived up to the hype for me.
I love it, I have dry skin y sometimes eczema, this moisturizer work excellent for me.

I have used this cream frequently but I haven’t noticed too much of a difference in soothing my skin or smoothing even minimal lines. It’s a heavy cream so it seems to be quite moisturizing which is great! The reusable pot is also an amazing idea (you can swap out the internal cream pod). I will say though, the smell is horrible. Even my boyfriend commented on how bad it smells. Reminds me of my mothers face cream 20-30 years ago when scent wasn’t a selling point and it just simply smells like ingredients.
I love this face lotion. I have been using it every night and morning. I definitely see a difference on my skin tone. I will be getting this again.

I love that it has no scent. It really does hydrate your face. Doesn’t leave a sticky or nasty film. since it’s only been a few days I haven’t noticed a dramatic change but I do see my pores not as big. I’m sure in a couple weeks I’ll see a difference. I have no complaints with this cream.

I absolutely love this product! It’s thicker in texture than my other moisturizers, but it absorbs quickly and does not leave an oily residue. Within a week, I would already tell a difference in texture, and suppleness. The positive is, a little goes aong way, so my current supply has lasted me for more than 1.5 months (using one a day - in the AM). Also, it is fragrance free and comes in a reusable jar (can purchase replacement package and save some $).

A super luxurious face cream. I received this product free from AB & Influenster in exchange for my honest review. The best moisturizer I’ve used. Has calmed some of the redness on my face and my skin looks the best it has in years.
I am loving this! It feels amazing and makes my skin so soft. I put this on at night and love the fact that it isn’t greasy.

I love the thick texture of this cream. It really makes your skin smooth and soft. It’s fragrance free and even though I don’t love the packaging I would certainly purchase this product. A little bit goes a long way and it’s amazing. I’m rarely wowed. I’ve tried other Bader products and this is by far my fav!

I use Tretnoin and have very irritated dry skin because of it. This was SO soothing. I can’t even believe how gentle and moisturizing this is. It has an odd scent, but it doesn’t stick around long. I love that there is a refill option so I don’t feel as wasteful throwing the jar out every time I purchase a new o e.

After hot desert vacation my dry skin was wrecked... Honestly I’m shook how quickly this miracle cream healed my irritation, improved texture and smoothed out deep wrinkles! Thank you Augustinus Bader for sending the Ultimate After just one application my face was visibly hydrated and bouncier. Pure bliss to apply. I’m using it as a nightcream because of the thick creamy formula. Face feels healthier. Perfect as an overnight “mask“ treatment. Obsessed with this new brand and very curious about their other products... :) Thank you @influenster @augustinusbader
review_title: Amazing Soothing Cream - lives up to name!

review_text: I received this product in exchange for an honest review, and I couldn’t recommend it highly enough. It absorbs quickly, doesn’t feel greasy or oily, and leaves my skin feeling fresh and supple. No strong scent, and a perfect texture. I wake up with glowing, dewy skin that feels fully rested and moisturized. The only negative thing is when the container is empty.

I have used Augustinus Bader skincare and hair care before - and liked it - and this did not disappoint! As this cream is rich, thick and heavy, it is a sore thing post sun exposure, lasers or skincare peels/treatments. It may be quite rich for other purposes or should you have oily or acne prone skin. For the purpose of healing and soothing, five stars. Excellent. The lightest fragrance which is in no way “perfumey”.
I like how fast absorbing it is and how moisture my face feels. It is not greasy and doesn’t clog my pores. I feel more elasticity and a healthy glow since I’m using it. Def a product I recommend

I have  been fortunate enough to receive other products from this brand. Despite the hefty price tag I did not find those to be a fit for more. This soothing cream has, however, been a game changer for my combination skin exposed to high temperatures and dry air of the desert. It is hydrating, soothing and perfectly balanced for those who may live in places where keeping your skin hydrated may be a struggle.

This product is amazing! The packaging is beautiful and it comes with a capsule that you can throw out when done. Then all you need is to purchase a new capsule. It doesn’t have a scent and was very moisturizing. It’s a little thick so I’d prefer using it in the winter when your skin is drier. Strongly recommend.

My new obsession! This lightweight, luxurious, and moisturizing soothing cram is a miracle worker! With skin that can be sensitive and easily break out when I try a new skincare product, the Augustinus Bader Ultimate Soothing Cream was a seamless transition. The redness in my creeks was minimized, my skin had better texture and looked softer and smoother. Farmacy has been my go-to for moisturizers that are actually hydrating without making me oily as well. I have combo skin prone to acne that leans closer to dry so this has been amazing for me. Currently on my third bottle.

Pricey, but the best so far! Busts my dryness and just feels so soft. Doesnt take a lot because it so creamy and spreads so well. It is kind of expensive but worth the cost. It supposed to smell like honey, but I cant smell it...its too faint of a smell.

All time favorite night time moisturizer. I have dry, acne prone skin and this product lets me wake up with glowy and hydrated skin. It is a little bit pricey, but I would suggest getting the jumbo size because a little goes a long way and ends up evening out on costs!

Bought the big size, as I love ceramides in general for moisturizers. This had a lot of hype at the time. It’s just okay- I used it all, and it did last me a long time as a little goes a long way. I love it, it’s soft but its texture super moisturizes my skin.

Absolutely love this moisturizer! I have dry skin and this sinks into my skin and absorbs so well. I stay hydrated all day and have no issues with dry patches. I also mix it my Tretinoin at night to prevent any drying/adverse reactions and it works so very well. Seriously my new staple moisturizer.
I love this! So moisturizing. Love the little spoon. Love the scent.

I’m obsessed. I’ve used all sorts of moisturizers—many of which were wayyy more expensive than this product—and this is by far the BEST. I’m panicking because it’s limited edition. Please keep this as a staple product!!!

This is how good it is! All gone lol so I used MAC products for years and liked them but they closed the store by me and call me old fashion but sometimes I like to go to the stores even tho I have packages delivered daily to my house. This works well and has a lovely texture and smell toboot!
Amazing night time moisturizer. Doesn’t break out my sensitive skin and the jar lasts forever. The bottle and applicator make it a luxurious experience every time. Love love love.

I have always had very dry skin (mixed ethnicity). Finding clean no fragrance products can be hard unless you want boring ones like CeraVe (which I love but sometimes you want something high-end). Not as hydrating as I thought, feels greasy on skin.

My skin used to be fairly oily, but as I’ve gotten older, it has become very dry. This dryness is mostly on my cheeks and the perimeter of my face. review_title: For me, this is better than Bader's Rich Cream

This product is amazing. Perfect for dry skin. I highly recommend
This is the best moisturizer I have ever used. Keep my skin hydrated all day. Has a nice subtle scent.

Super hydrating and feels nice on the skin. Also has great ingredients for dry skin.
It has taken me a while to find a thicker moisturizer that doesn’t feel too heavy without an astronomical price tag but I love this product! The 3.7 oz lasts me almost half the year!

I’ve been using this moisturizer for over a year now, and I can safely say this is one of my favorite moisturizer. The consistency is amazing. I would highly recommend for anyone with dry,  sensitive skin. The price is a little high but you get what you pay for. I give this review a 5 star.

If you have dry skin, this is worth the hype for winter. It feels like a whipped butter and has a faint pleasant honey scent. I have extremely dry skin and can wear it under makeup and sunscreen with no problems. Definitely recommend even with mask wearing for 8+ hours.

I thought I would never love a moisturizer as much as my tatcha dewy skin cream, but this is just as great. And this and the tatcha both ensure that never happens and keeps me so moisturized. I would rather spend the money on the jumbo size of this one (it’s also clean which is a plus), therefore this is my new fav!

This cream hasn’t done that and for that I am floored. I am extremely sad this is a limited edition size, as this jumbo size is so convenient, and the Green Clean Balm comes in this size as the standard! The regular size is way too small for a moisturizer. I have bought two Jumbos so that I don’t run out for a while, but I hope they make this value size permanent or else I don’t know if I would keep repurchasing and finishing smaller jars so quick—all and all, great ingredients, pricy but the best on the market. Keep the jumbo permanently PLEASE!

review_text: I’m a huge skeptic when it comes to spot treatment/masks since they rarely work for me. However! I am just LOVING this product. The smell isn’t bad at all, but the trick is! I use this every other night, especially when my acne feels irritated or for a quick fix if I am going out the next day. I also leave it on overnight and see a HUGE difference after I wash my face in the morning. My acne is less red and less bumpy. I will rebuy when I run out!
product_name: Saturn Sulfur + Niacinamide Spot Treatment Mask

review_text: I love this stuff! The smell is one you have to get used to, but it is WAY better than the U.F.O. Oil. The bottle does not contain that much product, but if you use it as a spot treatment it will last you a long time. I use it 2-4 times a week and have had the .5 bottle for 6 months. I just put a dot of this over a bump at night, after my night full face routine, and it’s gone or almost gone in the morning. I then cover the bump during the day with Cicapair from Dr. Jart and it’s almost always completely gone by 2nd day.

product_name: Saturn Sulfur + Niacinamide Spot Treatment Mask

review_text: I can’t speak to the change in packaging, as I only found this recently, but this stuff is one of the few (if not only) things that has made me want to write a review. I’ve been struggling with hormonal cystic acne and awful scarring since I turned 30 (4 years ago) - tried every cream, every patch, every everything. This isn’t easy to apply initially, but I tend to rub it in on and around each spot (rather than try to cake it on like a mask) and it WORKS. Not only removing acne, but preventing new spots, and has been the first thing to make old scars fade (been spreading it over old spots as the new ones became few and far between). Sure, I’d love if it came really full to the brim, but otherwise I hope they never stop making it.
review_title: The first thing to WORK on new acne and old scars!
product_name: Saturn Sulfur + Niacinamide Spot Treatment Mask

review_text: I struggle with hormonal cystic acne on my chin in a normal year and maskne has amped that up to eleven.  This stuff works WONDERS. It immediately helps with the redness and the pain and, if left on long enough really does make a difference.
product_name: Saturn Sulfur + Niacinamide Spot Treatment Mask

I can see this working if you have a couple whiteheads or acne that’s already surfaced but for cystic and serious clusters I would try something else. review_text: I have mixed feelings! First of all- the smell totally doesn’t bother me. However, I feel like over time my skin was less responsive. Get it with the SR acne kit- full size & the other products in it are great for acne.
product_name: Saturn Sulfur + Niacinamide Spot Treatment Mask

review_text: Miracle for cystic acne. I have had no luck in my search for an answer to my painful, large facial cystic acne. I don’t get the pimples frequently, but when I do they are BAD. I put this spot treatment on overnight and over the course of a couple nights the pimples in question are almost completely gone. Typically if left alone, the pimples would take over a week to calm down naturally. Agree with the other reviews, the product is tricky to initially put on and I wish the packaging was larger, but the benefits far outweigh these small nitpicks.
product_name: Saturn Sulfur + Niacinamide Spot Treatment Mask

review_text: Tiny amount for the $$. I thought I received a used product because it was like squeezing an empty tube of toothpaste to get anything out of it. Going back to Control Corrective.
product_name: Saturn Sulfur + Niacinamide Spot Treatment Mask

review_text: Not understanding the negative reviews, this spot treatment truly works. I struggle with PCOS hormonal acne... there’s times I’ve just cried over the frustration of dealing with painful cystic acne due to this condition. I put this stuff on the acne cysts and keep it on overnight. After another day, the cysts go down significantly. It also helps to prevent scarring, which is another huge issue I deal with. I do understand the reviews about its trickier to put on, but I think it just takes a bit getting used to is all. Even if you think you haven’t applied it perfectly, it still works great. The reviews about the scent, I mean, it’s sulfur so it’s gonna smell like sulfur lol. It’s not that big of a deal, it’s an acne treatment doing its job. I don’t think it’s that overwhelming really. It’s honestly worth a try if you get frequent hormonal acne that you don’t want to scar.
review_title: worth a try for cystic hormonal acne
product_name: Saturn Sulfur + Niacinamide Spot Treatment Mask

review_text: It works if you use it right - 30s lady with hormonal and cystic acne and this works better for a breakout than retinol or anything I’ve gotten from the derm. For a big sucker I just use it as a spot treatment but for my whole chin during that time of the month I add a squeeze to my acid mantle moisturizer and rub it all over the area at night. Works amazing, avoids pilling and over drying, lessens healing time. The bad- yeah smells like sulfur it stinks but I don’t care at all. It’s also such little product in a decent sized container. Wish they filled it up more bc this stuff is life
review_title: It works if you use it right

review_text: I don’t get all the negative reviews based primarily on scent. I think this product is particularly good for fungal acne (in my case, acne caused by wearing a mask all day) since it’s effective on the type of blemishes that seems to be resistant to the standard benzoyl peroxide/AHAs and BHAs. I definitely plan to buy the larger size when I finish my smaller tube I bought to try it out.

I’m happy with this product but won’t repurchase. It is hydrating which is lovely, however the mist isn’t super fine (which personally I would prefer for a more even distribution of product).
Nice mist, feels great on skin contact and dries out easily. I’m taking one star down because I would like it to be a bit more hydrating, though it’s perfect to use prior serums and creams.

I love love love this product HOWEVER the mister was defective and felt like someone was just spitting product onto my face. 10/10 on the toner 1/10 on the mist bottle. If the bottle was better, I’d make this my daily everyday toner because it’s beautiful! Left my skin so dewy and hydrated and soaked in great.

I love this toning mist! I tried several brands, including Youth to the People’s, and this one has won the cake. It’s extremely gentle mist without any crazy scents, and gentle enough that it doesn’t sting your eyes if you accidentally get some in them. It works very well with my skin and regimen, I use it before my moisturizer. Love this product!

I’m 42 , fine lines. I use this after my primer & after my foundation. It hydrates and plumps my wrinkles and helps everything set. I absolutely love this product and can’t be without. If my skin feels dry durning the day a quick mist and I’m hydrated again. I don’t know why the stores I go to don’t carry it. It’s so underrated  I think it’s once of bioOSSANCE’s best products and I’ve tried most.

I just purchased this and I’m loving it!! I mist this on after I’ve cleansed my face and my vitamin c serum sinks in really nicely. The mist is super fine and it adds a nice step of light hydration. I have super dry sensitive skin and for me personally I wish it had more hydration that’s why the 4 stars vs 5. I actually like this better than the Tatcha one. I love japanese skin care but this a good alternative. I didn’t notice any scent. It’s just clean. I’ll be re-purchasing this again. Hope you try it out and enjoy it as I do. Cheers!

Best product I’ve ever used. I was out of it for 1 week and my skin HATED being without it! I didn’t realize how much it helped keep my skin soothed and healthily moisturized without being oily. My other products are fully absorbed when using this mist. 100% recommend. You will see result after some use, not right away, but so worth the wait period!
review_title: PLEASE NEVER DISCONTINUE THIS AMAZING PRODUCT

review_text: Great refreshing product to spray on after your moisturizer or throughout the day.

I love incorporating a mist or essence into my regimen. This one is great — it’s lightly fragranced but not enough to be uncomfortable inhaling (some are overpowering and make me feel like I’m choking). This feels great and hydrating.

i really didn’t think much of this mist when i got it, despite being a huge fan of biossance. i discontinued use for a while and went back to it, now, i’m obsessed with it. i use it after TO HA + b5 serum and it really seals in moisture. my skin feels so supple, soft and i’ve noticed it’s eliminated the stubborn dry patches I had while also controlling my T zone. my only minor complaint is the smell, not horrible but not my favourite.

I love face mists and rarely meet one I don’t like. This one smells nice, feels lovely, and helps refresh my skin. I don’t know how beneficial it really is, but I enjoy using it and have repurchased it. As I don’t think it actually provides much in the way of hydration for me, it’s more of a nice refreshing and toning spray throughout the day and especially during warmer summer months. If you’re a Biossance fan, you may like this, too!
My mister came defective out of the package but other than that its decent but no wow factor.
Love it !! The mist is nice and leaves my skin so plump and soft! Might seem pricey for a mist but a little goes a long way! Will definitely purchase again!
I love face mists in general, but don’t think this one is worth the price. Didn’t really do anything for me and the mister is only okay in my opinion.

I got a travel size version of this toning mist in a discounted mystery bag from Biossance. I LOVE THIS MIST! During the dry winter months, I found this toning mist to help keep my dry skin hydrated, much better than the PCA Hydrating Toner that I had been using previously. On those extra dry days when dry skin patches pop up, I can spray this into my hands and pat it onto the affected area. Not surprised this was out of stock on Biossance and is now out of stock on Sephora. Will definitely keep buying this as long as it’s available.

This is a staple in my skincare routine since I discovered it. It’s such a great skin hydrator throughout the day. It’s so refreshing and plumps up my skin. I also love the scent and the spray nozzle is *chefs kisses*
Really brings impurities to the surface. Leaves my skin glowing. New must have. Only issue is how hard the cap was to get on and off, so I just threw that part away.
Love this product.  I use it on beauty blender when doing my makeup and it makes a dewy difference.  Refreshing as a mist.

Let me start off by saying- I have very acne prone/sensitive/dry skin. The only stuff I use in my routine is this spray and my non-comedogenic gel moisturizer. It gives me hydration and plumpness, and doesn’t break me out. My only problem is I wish it didn’t have any fragrance but like I deal wit it lol.
I use this after I get out of the shower and before I begin my beauty routine. Scent is nice and refreshing and it feels great on my skin. Would buy again!

Smaller than I expected so doubt I’ll buy again at this price but won’t use everyday, just an extra boost for the colder days ahead. Use this after a BHA toner or even as last step of routine to lock everything in. Can be used when skin feels dry through out the day too. It feels light and refreshing when spraying and does leave skin supple. Unsure if any benefits though as I already use squalane in my routine. But love biossance and their products.
The actual must might have been ok but the spray nozzle didn’t work. It barely sprayed anything. I went through quite a bit of liquid to get a few sprays
really happy with this product both as a make up setting spray and a skin refresher. took it to Dubai with me during a hot summer and it was a lifesaver.
LOVE this. The scent is amazing too! Definitely a must after cleansing!
My skin has honestly never looked better since I started throwing this into my skincare routine. Ive actually stopped wearing foundation. If you suffer from combination skin this one is a must!
EXCELLENT. It hydrates my skin and really helps plump up my dry skin through out the day. Very good product.Great ingredients list, reasonable price.

I’ve been using this daily at the beginning of my skin care routine as a toner. I like that it doesn’t have alcohol since I have dry skin and some acne. It really has calmed down my skin and super refreshing. The scent is strong when spraying so I hold my breathe. Love the fine mist, I can spray many times and it doesn’t really waste a lot of product.

I’m a hospital worker so during this pandemic, I’ve been running myself ragged and my face shows it. I have combination skin which can be sensitive/ temperamental and dark circles under my eyes. My normal routine incorporates BHA, vitamin C, ceramides and hyluranic acid. Along with moisturizer and SPF. I added the Biossance squalane + phyto to my nighttime routine several months ago and loved the way my skin felt plump and smooth however my skin still lacked that “inner radiance“ that you had as a teenager. So I looked into this because I’ve read a lot about how hydrating the skin can give you back that glow vs just using moisturizer. I have only been using this for less than 2 weeks and holy crap, my skin is freaking radiant.  The biggest area of improvement I’ve seen is my eye area. The crepe texture/ very fine lines have plumped up! Even the dark under eye circles have slightly improved. I will definitely repurchasing.
Wanted to love this but it broke me out so bad. Ended up giving it away.

I can’t decide if I like it or not, I haven’t noticed any changes in my skin since incorporating this into my routine. I have been using the Mario Badescu Rose Water Spray for a while now and I started using both more recently. I love Biossance but their products are a bit more pricey, and for $32 I would like to be able to see some sort of results.
it made my skin worse, i got textured skin. after i stopped using it i started to see a better change.

This has a really nice long fine mist that I wanted to love. I used this as a skin care first step. 1 night and loved it, but the second night I saw about 5-6 new pimples on my face (1 only had 1 pimple on my face prior). Used it for another 2 nights and a few more pimples popped up. I took 2 weeks from using it and my skin slowly cleared up again. Wanted to give it another shot because I was very stressed when I first tried it so I thought some of the pimples were stress related. Second time around... same thing. I don’t have sensitive skin but I think the amount of essential oils and citrus extracts was too much for me. Sadly, I will be returning this.
This product is life changing! A must have in your skincare regimen✨

This mist is amazing. I love using it as a dewy setting spray. Gives my skin and makeup the most amazing hydrated glow. It really plumps the look of my skin. It’s literally my holy grail. Anytime I use it I get compliments on my skin. The only reason I gave it four stars instead of five is because the packaging is terrible. I’ve bought four bottles of it, and on every bottle the sprayer has worn out and the mist begins to shoot out like a spray gun. I just hold it farther from my face so it doesn’t mess up my makeup. I would still totally recommend it because it’s the best. Hopefully they have updated their packaging, I’m on a new bottle so we’ll see how this one goes.

One of the things I love about this product is how it interacts with my makeup. Other hyaluronic serums I’ve used (and I’ve tried a lot) makes my spf/spf foundation flake off. This one does not, is no fuss misting, and it’s clean? I’m sticking with Biossance.

Definitely a new favorite! The smell is delightful and refreshing. I’ve noticed a significant difference in my skin using Biossance in general. The toning spray has helped with the moister in my skin and i love to use to set my makeup, for a dewy look.

Smells lovely.  Very refreshing and gives me a quick afternoon pick me up while sitting at my desk.  Currently, I only use this product after makeup application during the day.  I’ve been using SK II and Estee Lauder’s microessence after cleansing and don’t feel they are worth the money.  Most annoying is their products are highly degradable yet they house them in clear glass?

I love this mist, I think it’s a wonderful addition to my skincare routine. I use it after washing and after applying makeup, or even if I need a refreshing. The other line of products also are very effective and are great together. The clean line of products is a plus and help my reactive skin. As my skin matures I definitely notice some dryness even with oil use. I drink tons of water, so I know it’s not that. This line has helped tremendously and doesn’t feel heavy or greasy IMO.

Not sure yet.  Seems to calm, soothe and nourish.  Not sure if it helps to tighten pores though.  Also not sure if that’s a claim but is one thing I’d be looking for in a toner.  Also I may be using this incorrectly...it might be more of a hydrating mist vs a true toner.  I’d like clarification on that and will reach out to sephora customer service about it.

I have dry and now flaking skin.  This toner is cooling, relieves discomfort.  It is a fine mist so you may want to use 3-4 sprays.  I am going crazy with it.  Great toner. Set makeup and throughout the day.  I love it.  Feels so good I wish it came in TSA size!!! Definitely rebuying

Instant nutrition for your face! That’s what I feel when I spritz some of this on. It’s clean, I love the tone of green & the gold on the packaging, & the ingredients listed which all resonate healthy nutritious vibes. It’s portable & is a mainstay in my purse so I can just use anywhere I need a little on-the-go! My skin feels refreshed & happy after each use. definitely recommend!

I like other Biossance products but not a fan of the toning mist. The mist on this is very light so it isn’t spitting which is nice. But I feel like I have to spray a lot to feel anything and it really doesn’t seem to do anything for my face at all. I will go back to the Avene mineral water mist or try another brand after I am done with this one.

Yup! This is exactly what I was looking for. I wanted a hyaluronic acid, but wanted something easy to apply. Biossance to the rescue. This is an ultra fine mist and my skin drinks it up. Love this brand and the fact it’s a clean product. I use this after my toner. Smells nice and doesn’t leave your skin sticky.

I have very dry 40+ skin and travel a lot for work which dries me out even more.  I can’t live without this.  I always have the travel size in my bag and use it every hour during flights.  I use it to set my makeup daily.  It is so lightweight and gives just enough hydration without any oily residue.  Now, my skin looks amazing after a 20 hour flight.  Magic!
Rejuvenating and love all the ingredients to this. I spray this on after applying make up and I love the finish, glowy and dewy look.
I love this spray!  Use it before my serum and after I put on my make up as well as throughout the day.  No stickiness, absorbs completely.  Don’t ever want to be without it.

If you’re buying this mist, it’s definitely for the EXPERIENCE of misting your face (which I have to admit, I totally love). The mist sprays SUPER lightly, so your face doesn’t really get penetrated with much product (though I seem to be going through this thing pretty fast). The smell is really nice and soft, but again, it doesn’t really do anything to the skin. In the future, I’ll just go back to buying the Avene mineral water mist for something more cost effective that actually feels like it penetrates
review_title: Save your money, buy a mineral water spray instead

review_text: I used this mist after coming back from vacation and it was useful in hydrating my skin again.
I LOVE how this mist sprays. I can slowly mist it all over my face with one spray.
I like to use this before I go to bed when I’m too lazy to put moisturizer on.  Works great with a fine mist and helps keep my face hydrated

definitely one of my favorite products from one of my favorite brands. love love love Biossance so much! Specifically this mist is just amazing. so refreshing and clean and definitely a must have for every skincare lover.

I use this item to moisturize everyday. It’s the easiest and fastest way to nourish your skin without touching, tugging or rubbing your face. The mist is the finest gentlest mist you’ll ever feel. It leaves my skin looking refreshed, glowy and healthy all day. I don’t know what I would do without this product. I’m so happy it exists.

I was pretty hesitant since this product is $32 but I have really sensitive dry skin and I must say that it’s the most hydrated it’s ever been. I notice a small difference when putting in my makeup, it lasts way longer and the crease under each eye is much easier to cover up and doesn’t seem to stand out as much. This will be a constant in my makeup bag!
A nice hydrating mist for hot summer days. I believe this will prove extra hydrating for the colder drier months also. I appreciate the gentle mister on this product.

On my 2nd bottle. Not sure that Im seeing results. I’ve no doubt that I’m getting daily moisture, but thats it. Love that its clean   the packaging. Love the squalane...anxious to try their newest release.

This contains Squalane which is shark liver! Sharks are being slaughtered every 3 mins for things like this. There are so much more products we can use that are cruelty free and don’t contain any animals. Without these creatures our whole ocean ecosystem is ruined!

Really had a hard time finding the right facial mist for my skin type. Most do almost nothing while some leave me with a super wet look.This is perfect I spray my face until moist and pat it in until absorbed.10/10

This product did absolutely NOTHING for my skin. I did not notice one iota of a difference and it stung a little after I sprayed it on. Needless to say, it was not worth the money, so I returned it after a few days.

I have sensitive skin. I used this for about a month, day and night, but I think it broke me out and irritated my face. I think it’s the essential oils, which I’m sensitive to but didn’t think Biossance’s products would irritate my face since I use everything else from them. Would recommend if you don’t have sensitive skin.
My skin is super dehydrated and this has helped add so much moisture!  I’ve noticed a big difference when using this with the omega repair cream.

My go-to for hydrating my face throughout the day! I first heard about this as a good spray to take on flights to keep your face hydrated, since flying tends to dry out my face and just makes me feel sort of bleh overall about my appearance. Tested this out on my trip to Hawaii and wow! I stepped off the plane in Hawaii feeling pretty good about my face, even after spending the last 17 hours traveling! Since then, I’ve kept this at work with me and spritz it on my face throughout the day when my skin starts to feel a little dry or bleh. Definitely worth the price and I will be repurchasing when I run out! It also feels good when I spritz it on my skin because even after sitting in room temperature, it’s still slightly cooler than my skin, so it feels nice. Every once in a blue moon, when my hands are SUPER dry and lotion isn’t doing the trick, I’ll spritz this on my hands and they feel much better! It really does work.
review_title: A must-have for traveling, and also daily use

review_text: I love the feel of this mist and ever since i started using it, I feel it has helped my moisturizer absorb so much better. It is the perfect mist for all around the face. Although, when you spray it, it’s not long enough to be able to cover the face. I have to do 3 sprays: 2 to make an x and 1 for my chin cuz I feel driest there.Also, I have a big face so you have to take that into consideration. It has lasted for 2 months with everyday use, 2x a day. I was gifted this by @biossance with Jenn Im at the Feb Beverly Hills  event in CA.

I love this mist. It’s a wonderful product. And the spray on it is heavenly - it’s like walking through a cloud. Its a lovely hydrating mist that I put on after my toner and before my serums. I love the ingedients, especially hyaluronic acid. The best way I’ve found to apply it is to tilt my head back and then spray it downwards onto my face to get even coverage. It dries quickly without any sticky feeling, but it leaves me feeling hydrated and refreshed.
Less oily option compared to smashbox primer water, IMO.

This is similar to the Tatcha ingredients in their mist, but the price is much better. I would say that the misting is not quite as fine as the Tatcha. It’s very good for setting powder on the under eyes.
Hydrating and excellent for very sensitive skin. Absorbs quickly, the mist is very fine Biossance aced this. Overall an excellent product I took one star because of the cost/quantity.

My new fav hydrating facial spray! i love the spray it gives. a very gentle mist light as air. i love the way my skin looks renewed and hydrated after i use this. i use this with and without makeup, makes my makeup look fresh when i use it and my skin just looks very supple, fresh and hydrated. spray this all the time while at work under dry air. love that its alcohol free too!
I am dry skin. The smell is pretty good :) plus it is very hydrating and the nozzle is fantastic!! I love all of Biossance, this is my favorite of Biossance

Best fast must I’ve tried!  I love this mist.  It’s hydrating, the spray is just right, and the bottle is secure and easy to toss in my purse or yoga bag on the go.  I got this and another popular face must at the same time to compare, and this one wins hands down!  It’s so refreshing and a perfect extra dose of moisture throughout the day.  Will repurchase!

I tested out this product after having used the Kiehl’s cucumber one. This has better packaging ensuring a fine mist as well as a lovely scent. Knowing it’s in the “clean beauty“ category really helps as well.
review_title: a great face mist for when on the go

review_text: I bought this about a month ago from Sephora and I absolutely love it. I put a couple sprays on my face and neck after every shower and it leaves my skin refreshed and moisturized. This product is not oily at all and dries within a few seconds. Smells amazing too. I love all of Biossance products, but this might be my new favorite!
love this. its so refreshing i use it throughout the day perfect if your skin is feeling tight and dry throughout the day

this mist is the missing piece of my daily complexion arsenal i didn’t know i needed. a spritz of this over my primer slightly sheers out my bb and cc creams to blend seamlessly resulting in thinner layers of product - which make for an overall better look. i also like to use this after i set my face as it creates a glass skin “chok chok“ look that all the Kpop idols have: dewy and glowing without being an oil slick. i never want to be caught without having this product within an arm’s reach.
most hydrating mist I’ve ever used!

It does do what it claims to do. It does make your skin feel hydrated, it’s fine mist. It does moisture maybe because it contains squalane. Overall it’s great product. But i won’t purchase again since it’s considered high price to me. Maybe in winter, it’s more beneficial.  I like Caudalie beauty elixir better since it’s refreshing, hydrating, plus it does make your pores smaller and your skin will become a great canvas.
review_title: great brand and great product, but high price tag

review_text: I recently traveled to Mexico and with the heat and humidity had a switch up my skincare. I ditched all my heavy creams and brought this mist as moisturizer alone and it worked perfectly. Back in the cooler and drier temps of California I find a little goes a long way to keep my skin moisturized when I’m halfway through my day and my skin feels dry underneath my makeup.

I had a horrible reaction to this product. It was given to me as a gift so today I decided to try it under my regular moisturizer, 3 hours later my skin felt tight and greasy at the same time if that makes sense so I looked in the mirror and I had little white bumps all over my midly sensitive areas (nose, under eye, and shin)! Mind you I’ve never had a break out in my life!
review_title: DO NOT BUY IF YOU HAVE SENSITIVE SKIN

review_text: This is cooling and soothing, I don’t feel it does much other than feel nice though. Its not heavily scented. I feel that the mist is too fine and you need to spray it too many times to feel like you have enough on your face. I love the rest of the items in the biossance line, but I feel like this product is totally not a  necessary step or an effective product.
review_title: I don't think this does enough to justify the $$$

review_text: A facial mist that actually improves your skin.  I am in love with this beautiful mist.  I’ve been using it as an essence.  It adds nutrients to the skin, brightens, and hydrates.  Really, what more could you want in a facial mist.  The nozzle is perfect!  It sprays the most delicate mist over the face and neck, leaving beautifully healthy skin. I’ve already ordered two more bottles, just in case. For reference, I’m 43 with combination skin.

If your looking for hydration glowy dewy sought after look than this product gives you that. I am not 20 years but a 53 year woman who has dry skin and was looking for that fresh hydrated skin and this product gave me that ..

Ive been using this as an essence before applying the squalane rose oil, instead of spraying it on my face i spray onto my hand and pat the essence on my face to get more even coverage of my skin, this product is really hydrating, especially under an occlusive oil or moisturizer, it has helped my other skin care work better, very happy with it :)

I’m not picky about face mists because I don’t feel like I’ve come across one thats made me rethink face mists altogether. This one however, for the price point is pretty good, the mist is fine and even, smells amazing. The ingredients don’t seem terrible, overall I enjoy using this face mist, and I will repurchase this face mist. I didn’t give it five stars because I don’t think it makes a huge difference on my skin but its nice.

I wasn’t a fan of this mist. I was expecting something magical and wonderful after reading and hearing about this spray. But I was thoroughly disappointed upon its arrival....It feels like someone’s spitting at your face (not really a gentle mist) it did nothing for my skin (no glow, non refreshing) I just wasn’t a fan. And I really wanted to be!

but I do. I got this as a splurge during the VIB sale, and it’s the most moisturizing mist EVER. My skin is notably smoother after a week of consistent use. The mist is extremely fine, so it doesn’t feel like I’m wasting any product. Unfortunately for my wallet, this is will only last me about a month or two of daily use.
review_title: I did not want to love this...

review_text: This is a nice product but limited because the bottle is too big to carry in your purse.  I decided I like the Tatcha mist better.

Those geniuses at biossance have bewildered me again. I got this on a whim because I have their plant based retinol and vitamin c and rose serum... and this stuff is just ethereal on the skin. Was shocked to see my makeup after a good spritzing.

I’ve only had this a week and already obsessed. I use in the morning when I wake up, before bed as the last step in my routine, after a shower if my face is red, after a face mask, during the day when my skin needs moisture, before and after makeup. It has calmed my skin and kept it hydrated. Also a repeat customer of the Biossance squalane face wipes. Skin type - oily T zone and dry/sensitive everywhere else.

Didn’t work for my extremely sensitive skin. I have seborrhea (scalp eczema) which means that I have very dry skin around my mouth and on my forehead. There’s a strong rose scent. I like the mist, but it wasn’t moisturizing enough for my skin. I think that this would work for others who don’t have extremely sensitive skin. I will stick to using the squalane oil.
review_title: Might not be good with Seborrhea (scalp eczema)

review_text: FYI this is an amazing product but just a heads up that as of today (3/27) it’s marked on the Sephora app as $78 instead of $32 which is what it’s actually priced. Must be a pricing glitch. Hopefully they fix it soon because I highly encourage you to try and buy once they do :) It’s the best mist I’ve ever used and I love that it has so many healthy nutrients!

Love this set. The cleanser is so nice on the skin, the toner feels good and making my skin even, and the moisturizer feels lush. The serum is so-so, I had similar problems with the tube as mentioned in other reviews.

The cleansing balm and toner are amazing, I purchased both full size. The moisturizer turned out to not suit my skin type so I gave it to a friend. The nighttime treatment pump stopped working after about two times but defo recommend!!!
I bought this for a trip where I could only take a carry on. Such good products. Will definitely be buying the full sized versions!
These products changed my skin completely. The moisturizer alone cleared some of my redness and acne after buying the set and following the routine I noticed a visible improvement after 3 days
I have reordered the full size of these. Each one has transformed my skin to be much healthy and happier. My pores are clean, my wrinkles have blurred, and bumps I’ve had for ages have dwindled down
First time trying this brand, got it because it’s part of the clean at Sephora & I’ve heard great things! It lived up to all the hype, skin feels so smooth and just has an overall better look to it!
it’s so good but i don’t know if it was the tonic or serum what made my skin burn.but of course i’ll take the full size of the cream cause yess is a 10/10
I have been using this set for about 3 weeks now and my skin looks and feels so hydrated and glowy!I will definitely buy again
Great value and great skincare brand. Will be repurchasing there full sizes

I had been wanting to try the makeup removing balm for a while, so this was a great way to try some of Farmacy’s products for a good price. I have been using this kit for about a week now, and really enjoy each of the products. The makeup removing balm is a game changer! It melts off makeup without drying or irritating my skin. I’ve found the toner is also great for shrinking down any pesky pimples. I feel that this is a great gift or starter for someone interested in developing a skincare routine.
I loved the cleansing balm and the toner. It fit perfectly into a premade routine I already had going. The serum is hard to get out of its tube. The cream is HEAVY which I don’t hate but be warned.

I bought this starter kit because I’ve wanted to try the green clean cleanser for a while now. I was going to buy the 1.7 oz container but I’ve also been curious about Farmacy’s honey halo moisturizer so I decided to buy this whole pack. First of all, 10/10 for the green clean. No other cleansing balm I’ve ever tried has worked so well. 7.5/10 for the honey halo. Not bad. A little goes a long way. I get that it’s a honey product but it also really smells like that too. Some might like it, I’m not a huge fan. Does its job though! 4.5/10 for the deep sweep. I don’t really see a difference in usage. 5.5/10 for the honeymoon glow. It’s okay but there are much better AHA serums out there. Wouldn’t repurchase the second two. Might repurchase honey halo if discounted and I’ve already repurchased the green clean!

My problems are congested pores, hyperpigmentation, too much sebum, and sensitive skin. I feel that this starter kit is a great way to decide if the Farmacy line works for you. I’m not going to say I saw a radical transformation in my skin, but it works with it and is gentle and effective. The balm removes makeup pretty well without being too thick and greasy (other brands seem like they leave a film on my eyeball and blur my vision). It still leaves some sparkles and mascara behind for the second cleanse though. I like the toner as it’s not drying or harsh but does keep the sebum and grease down and works well with a light moisturizer over it. For these increasingly dry cold months in the West, the honey halo is a godsend for bed and doesn’t clog my pores--though it’s likely too thick for a daytime moisturizer for me. AHAs rip my face up so I gave the honeymoon glow tester to a friend.

Perfect kit for an intro to Farmacy brand. I personally think it’s worth the money. Just started using the serum so we’ll see how it goes but so far so good!Cleansing balm - LOVED IT! review_text: Just a helpful note for anyone confused about this moisturizer containing squalANE and being touted as an oil-free moisturizer. SqualANE is actually technically a hydrocarbon solution derived by hydrogenation of squalENE, which is typically sourced from olives or sugar cane these days. We refer to it as an oil because it is oil-like/oil-behaving. It is a derivative of squalene, which naturally occurs in our own sebum, and diminishes with the aging process. SqualANE is extremely stable unlike squalENE, which oxides very easily. It is also much lighter than squalene.So, rest assured, this moisturizer is indeed oil-free in the true sense.

If you buy products that contain squalene, you are contributing to the shark fin trade and shark cruelty.
