Complimentary from KateCeuticals. I have been using the lifting eye cream for a couple of days now and I’m in love with the results so far. I took a picture before I started the treatment to see the progress and I think it has change a lot. The fine lines are not so visible anymore and my under eye bags are not so bad. My eye looks lighter and not so dark, and they feel fresher and smoother. It is definitely worth the price.

Gifted by Kate Somerville, Loved the product made a difference rapidly i would recommend to everyone it is a great product! It does not have a smell like other products that i have bought and some do have a smell once you start to use but this is easy to use and great to blend to your skin 10 stars!

I received this complimentary from Kate Somerville, thank you so much for this opportunity. I highly recommend this Lifting eye cream. As i age I notice I need a little help with bags under my eyes and saggy skin. The hyloronic acid and triple peptides help to firm up my under eyes. I use it morning and night i have noticed a huge difference in just a short amount of time.

I received this complimentary from “Kate Somerville“ I really like this eye cream. It is very smooth and a very small drop goes along way. You only need one pump! Its very creamy well which I really like. Im not a big fan of strong scents on my face ans this had no scent. I would highly recommend this eye serum for anyone who has sensistive skin and the starting signs of aging. I can’t wait what the next 3 weeks bring!

I received this product complimentary from Kate Somerville for an honest review. First, the ingredients are fantastic! The triple-peptide complex, vitamin C and red and brown algae create a potent combination. The cream spread easily and absorbed quickly. Even after it absorbed, my skin still felt hydrated. I wasn’t expecting to be able to see a difference after only one use, but when after applied it in the morning, my under eye area was noticeably brighter and less puffy. I’m really impressed!

Great eye cream! There was a noticeable difference in the fine line under my eye when using it. It gave a light plump/lift and smoother look almost as a blurring effect to the area.  Kateceuticals Lifting Eye cream was Gifted by Kate Somerville.

I received this lifting eye cream complimentary from Kate Somerville in exchange for my honest review. A little definitely goes a long way with this eye cream. You just need a few little dabs under each eye, and just after a few days of using it in the morning and at night, I feel it’s visibly noticeable. The puffiness and dark circles under my eyes have definitely gone down quite a bit just after a few uses. 10/10 would recommend!

This eye cream was gifted by Kate Somerville and I totally love it. It is easy to apply. You just need a tiny amount. It doesn’t smell at all and the most important thing it’s absorbing fast into the skin, but in the same time you feel that the eye area is hydrated. Highly recommend this product.

This bottle was gifted by Kate Summerville and I’m so glad that I did! KateCeuticals Lifting Eye Cream by the Kate Summerville product line is absolutely amazing! The application is smooth and absorbs quickly. Almost immediately noticed a reduction of puffiness under my eyes. It makes my eyes look younger, hydrated and awake! Now that I’m in my mid-30’s I love anything with Hyaluronic Acid and Vitamin C. Those two ingredients really do work!

Great results from the first few uses. Easy to apply in the morning or evening and the skin feels nice to touch. Very refreshing feeling.I received this product complimentary from Kate Somerville for free but my opinion is my own.

Wow I’m speechless, only used it once and already see the difference! I’m 28 year old asian with very puffy eyes, and I started noticing wrinkles around my eyes a year ago. I have tried using different oils, creams and they seemed to make it worse for some reason. I just used the eye cream that was gifted by Kate Somerville, and my puffiness went away, the wrinkles-you could barely see them! Can’t wait to see the results in a few weeks or months!

This was gifted by Kate Somerville for review. I really like this eye cream! It is so easy to apply and does not feel difficult to rub in like many eye creams do. It is soothing and does not irritate my skin. I also think that the packaging is super cute.

This eye cream has a combination of great ingredients. I have fine lines under eyes and visible puffiness and triple peptide complex with hyaluronic acid are exactly what I need. I have a dry spot near one eye and it was hydrated very well by the oils from its composition. I used a small amount and it spread nicely on the entire eye zone.  I was gifted by Kate Somerville to try it and I am grateful for this opportunity.

I received this KateCeuticals Lifting Eye Cream complimentary from Kate Somerville. I took one star off for the high price. That being said, this eye cream is really good. I especially love how soothing this is around my eyes.

I was gifted by Kate Somerville the KateCeuticals Lifting Eye Cream. After just one use I could already tell that the puffiness and dark circles started to diminish. If this is one of your problem areas like mine, get this product!

The scent was to die for and the product itself worked GREAT. I am so disappointed that with every use of the pump oil leaks all over the bottle and counter.  For the price I can’t afford the waste and shouldn’t have to reboot le.

This is absolutely the best cleanser ever ! I was hesitant t to purchase at the high price tag, but I’m hooked forever! Fresh clean scent that is tough enough to remove all make up and not strip the skin

Bring back the old formula. Now olive oil is in the top 2 ingredients. The attached picture shows the original formula - they’ve changed the concentration of the ingredients so that now it’s just overpriced olive oil
This is the perfect oil makeup remover. Honestly I can’t use oils for my skin, but this is just amazing. I will repurchase.

I personally found this work well for my skin. I tend towards dry. One day, I decide to not apply any moisturizer after to see how my skin reacted. My skin was obviously drier, but there were no patches like I’ve experienced before with other cleansers. It removed my tinted moisturizer, mascara, and eyeliner just fine. I know I’ve seen other reviews talking about issues with the pump. I haven’t noticed that. I have been using this product for about a week now.
The pump always leaks. Period.I have started keeping a tissue roll underneath. Never buying this again.
Lovely product but just too expensive for what it is. Very hard to justify.
review_title: Too expensive for what it is

review_text: This used to be my favorite oil cleanser and I washed my face with it every morning. I hadn’t purchased a new bottle in a couple of years because I was trying some new things, so I treated myself at the last VIB sale. What a disappointment it was! They must have changed the formula because it didn’t have the beautiful light, herbal scent that I loved so much and it didn’t feel the same on my skin. The first two ingredients are sunflower oil and olive oil, and it felt very heavy. I remember it feeling much lighter and nourishing... now it feels like I’m applying cheap olive oil to my face. I took it back and will never buy it again. Very sad ending to what used to be a gorgeous product.
review_title: What did they do to this formula?

review_text: Doesn’t clog my pores like other oil cleansers I have tried. Great for oily skin, somehow seems to clear my pores. Removes the most stubborn make-up. I even got oil based stain from staining the banisters on my hands and this was the only thing that got it off!
Good product but way overpriced.  There are a lot of other superior oil cleansers at Sephora for 1/2 the price of this.

I love this oil cleanser. I’ve used several other oil cleansers at different price points (Boscia, Tatcha) and this is by far the best. I use this as the first step in my cleansing routine at night and love how clean it helps me get, especially after wearing makeup all day.

Let me start off by saying when I don’t wear any makeup and cleanse my face with this oil cleanser, it is really nice and feels great. My skins looks fresh afterwards. However, to call this a makeup removing oil cleanser is just false. When I wear makeup and use only this cleanser to remove it, I have makeup left all over my eyes and face. For this reason, I had to give it 3 stars. I don’t wear makeup often, so I will continue to use it, but anytime I do wear makeup I will take a makeup removing wipe to my face first before I use this.
review_title: Nice cleanser? Yes. Makeup remover? No.

review_text: This isn’t a bad cleansing oil, but it is too expensive. There are comparable cleansing oils and balms that work just as well for a fraction of the cost of this one from Tata Harper. I am a fan of the Boscia and Khiel’s cleansing oils and those are less than half the cost of this product. While I do enjoy Tata Harper serums and masks, I don’t think this cleansing oil is worth the high price tag. I’ll continue using this product until I finish off the bottle, but I won’t be repurchasing.

I hate that this works so well because it’s so expensive lol. I don’t use it to remove makeup. I use it on a clean face as a treatment as I massage my skin. It clears my pores and helps my skin feel nourished. My skin is also more smooth, lifted and even in tone when I use this. I finished the bottle a month or so ago, and thought I could find a cheaper alternative, but there just isn’t one. Going to bite the bullet and keep using this jar of gold. I love it that much.
review_title: A worthwhile treatment for your skin.

review_text: I love this oil cleanser.  I think it does an amazing job at not stripping the skin, but removing makeup/build up from the day.  The price is high but you are getting quality ingredients and glass vs plastic packaging.  To me that is worth it.
Love this. Good on acne skin too. I have bouts of cystic acne and this was gentle and removed flakey skin.

This oil cleanser is absolutely beautiful. It feels so good on my skin, gets rid of my makeup (I wear minimal makeup), does not break out my skin. After I use this oil cleanser I use Tata Harper’s Rejuvenating Exfoliating Cleanser and my skin feels clean, soft, and looks radiant.

It’s ok, A good cleanser but left my skin wanting more hydration, also had difficulty removing my makeup but as a cleanser it’s just ok. The smell is kind of a herb and something else smell which wasn’t overpowering at all but not something I loved either. I didn’t see any difference in my face at all, my pores missed my julep cleanser and for the price I don’t think it’s worth it.

I wish I didn’t love it as much as I do but this is the only cleanser that takes off all my eye makeup at once. I have tried many different cleansers and balms, farmacy, Clinique , nothing works as well as this. I am on my second bottle and I stock up before I run out.

I really like the way this product feels, removes all makeup and leaves nothing behind. No film. But the pump and the hefty price tag will prevent me from repurchasing. I love it but there are no ingredients to justify the price. It was a one time splurge.
Was amazing going on. Getting it off was difficult. It felt like crisco when it mixed with the water. But i double cleanse and it came off fine with double cleansing with the Mia.
I use this as a second cleanser at night, and it leaves my skin so soft! Feels just as soft when I wake up in the morning, and has also reduced redness significantly. I love it so much.

I LOVE this oil cleanser - it is the absolute best on the market. I’m 32 with normal/combo skin and I wear a full face of makeup everyday (most days). I use this as step one in my night routine and it gets EVERYTHING off. I love the scent - which is minimal but fresh - and it makes my skin feel so good. I have tried so many other kinds of oil cleanser and this is my all time favorite.
review_title: Top Oil Cleanser on the Market

review_text: Love the feeling of this oil! It smells amazing and cleanses the skin gently. It’s great for sensitive skin or as part of a double cleanse routine.
This cleanser is effective and gentle. I love that the oil traps dirt while leaving my skin hydrated and nourished. Will repurchase again and again!

I wanted to LOVE this oil, but instead I liked it (but not enough to keep it). It was so thick going on and I was hoping it would at least rinse off super clean, but it felt like it left a thin layer on my skin, which would be perfect for someone with really dry skin. I have combination skin with congested pores on my chin and I didn’t feel like this did a good enough job of clearing my pores, so it would just sit in my cabinet while I consistently reached for my Farmacy Green Clean cleanser. I got a sample of the Purifying cleanser and I really liked that, so I’m hoping it’ll work great as my second cleanser after the Green Clean.

OMG this is easily my favorite product from Tata Harper. The smell is ah-mazing!! Put a pump onto my fingers and rub my hands together. Place it over my nose and take a deep breath. Massage it throughout the rest of my face. Let the spa experience begin. This cleanser is very luxurious and rich. Makes my skin soft and melts away all my make-up. I usually follow it with either TH purifying or clarifying cleanser :) love all 3 cleansers -but can’t live without this one!!

Nothing has helped clarify my skin like beginning a double-cleansing routine. This oil cleanser from Tata Harper  fits the bill for step one of a double cleanse. (I like Tarte Deep Dive gel cleanser for step two.) It’s very gentle, smells heavenly and rinses cleanly.  My skin has its redness level toned down (I have sensitive skin with rosacea) by this oil cleanser. A win-win all around.

Love everything about it. The smell, the texture, the results. However, please know that this is a thicker oil. You WILL need a wash cloth to remove it because it doesn’t emulsify as easily as other oil cleansers. Nevertheless, I still am obsessed with this cleanser!!! It makes me so happy every time I use it. I am 34. My daughter is 17 and she loves it too, but finds that she needs a cloth to remove it as well.
review_title: Love! But you do need a washcloth!

review_text: This supposed oil cleanser was like glue on my face - it would not come off. Thankfully I have some other oil cleanser left that was able to remove this. Returning ASAP.

I have oily skin, with current hormonal acne.I am usually an all or nothing type of person with my makeup, although once in a while I will go with minimal or moderate makeup.For me, this wasn’t ideal for full on cake face, buffed right into the skin and almost to the bone makeup. But for days I had on no or minimal makeup it works great, but still needed a cloth after emulsifing the cleanser. If I don’t use a cloth I felt like there was a film on my face. So maybe a bit too heavy for my liking. Not drying at all. The scent is very strong if you are bothered by that, I didn’t mind it but my husband hated it.I will use the bottle but will not repurchase, I think maybe it was too heavy for my skin type. I’m sure you would love it if you had dry skin.

Pretty bottle with an ok cleansing oil in it. This cleanser didn’t do anything special, for the high price tag that came with it. I have several Cleansing balms/oils that smells better, and pretty much cleanse the same if not better with a cheaper price tag. Other than the pretty bottle that came with a dysfunctional top, there isn’t anything special about this cleanser. I returned it.

I don’t know how so many people love this and am wondering if I’m the issue. This leaves the feeling of a layer of oil left on your skin that can’t be removed. After thoroughly double cleansing and using a cotton pad with my Fresh black tea toner, I notice a huge amount of dirt and makeup come off on the cotton pad. Seriously disappointed with this, especially after an employee pushed this on me and now it’s too late to return.

This is such a revolutionary cleanser. I try and rotate my cleansers, because i have so many, but this one is definitely my favorite.  At first I was scared to use an OIL as a cleanser but after doing research on this product and studying the ingredients my mind was at ease. It does such a good job at balancing cleansing and replenishing its almost as if you have to try to believe. I noticed a difference in my skin about a week after constant use, and my face has never been so clear. The scent is mild and it does however, leave somewhat of thin oil coat but definitely nourishing factor.

This cleanser is amazing. It lightly lifts makeup from the day, and helps add healthy moisture when cleaning. I’ve gifted it now that I’ve fallen in love w how my skin feels after a few months of using it.

I really wanted to like this product since I’m transitioning to clean, non-toxic products, but after testing the product for about a month, I would not repurchase.My main issue was the pump. I had to push down at just the right spot in order to pump out any product. And you can forget about having any control over the amount that comes out.While I enjoyed massaging my face with the thicker, more luxurious feeling oil, it took significantly longer to remove all traces of makeup compared to any cleansing oil I’ve used in the past.The process of washing off the product was not super pleasant either. I found the oil a bit slimy upon removal. I will say that It left my face smooth and glowy afterwards, but I think I can find a similar product without the negatives I listed above.
All you’ll ever need.

Beautiful Green Beauty! Ohhhh its lovely! This oil cleanser is light and refreshing. The clean essential oil aroma is a welcoming calm after a long day in the office and I can honestly say that I look forward to my skincare ritual every single night thanks to this cleanser! Its pricey so I wouldn’t  be using this to remove makeup. no no! You want this on your skin for a good minute or two and then use a soft cloth to drape over your face to open up those pores. Follow up with your fave toner and a good serum/moisturizer and you’re done. Simply beautiful cleanser if you wish to splurge a little.. and why not? You’re worth it! ;)

Not a fan. The oil itself feels nice going on, smooth, softening, just nice all around - one star here. Trying to get it off though .. that was a nightmare. Like other reviewers stated, it left a film on my skin no matter how much water I used. Had to wipe it off with a towel and double cleanse. The second star is because it did soften and moisturize however trying to get it off isn’t worth the end results. Especially since I have used other oil cleansers that rinse/emulsify more easily. Dry skin folks might love this but not for me, and never again. I like other stuff from Tata Harper but this was a bust imo.
It’s just the best oil cleanser! It Smells unbelievably good! I highly recommend it!

I adore practically everything in Tata Harper’s lineup, and this all-natural oil cleanser is no exception. It dissolves dirt, pollution, makeup, and other icky impurities, plus so much more. It leaves skin baby soft, heals chapped lips, and keeps your moisture barrier intact. In summary? It is effective, gentle, and smells divine. I love the packaging too. It is the prettiest bottle and has a handy pump dispenser. For a great double cleanse, start with this (massage it onto dry skin – you can even apply it to your lips and eyelids – and rinse with warm water) and follow up with Tata Harper’s Regenerating Cleanser. This Nourishing Oil Cleanser is a new fave. I don’t know how I lived without it!

I wanted to love this, but for me the oil just doesn’t come off unless I do a double cleanse with my water base cleanser.  It just becomes a milky, sticky mess on my face that won’t come off!  Luckily, I bought it specifically for my double cleanse.  The oil itself has a lovely texture and it feels great on the skin.  Also, after a few weeks or more of using this at night, I’ve haven’t noticed any change.  I won’t be rebuying, though I love Tata’s other items in her line.
I’ve tried oil cleansers in the past and they always made me breakout. This one is so great. It is moisturizing, doesn’t break me out and feels great. Don’t expect suds.

I can not stress enough how much I love this cleanser.  I’m 37, combo skin, definitely aging. I get Botox and filler maintenance etc..  I’m on my second bottle of this stuff and TBH I was hesitant because it’s an oil and a bit scared that it would make me oilily and, this sounds silly but, get on my hairline and make my hair greasy. Ha. It has done none of that! I will forever use this cleanser. After using it, I wipe my face with a Beauty Chef probiotic toner (stinky, pricey, but WORTH it) and my cotton round has zero makeup on it. Meaning this Harper cleanser took off all of my makeup. Claims it doesn’t strip off natural oils and very true. It’s actually made my face much clearer and plump! The price is up there for sure but trust me, you HAVE TO TRY it! I now use 6 other products in her line.  The Hydrating spray and body oil is to die for.

I wasn’t sure what this might offer. I have dry, dull skin. Having spent years using soaps, it seemed odd to apply an oil. My skin is clean and soft and feels so good. And it’s allergen free, for me. Double-check the ingredients for more info.

Although pricey, this cleanser effectively gets rid of all of my makeup! You definitely need a flannel to wipe the excess off, but you get buttery smooth skin after. Definitely works well with my dry skin. Love the botanical almost herbal scent. I don’t even need to moisturize after, looove.
review_title: if you want buttery smooth skin...

review_text: very calming on the skin

I initially bought this off recommendation from Caroline Hirons...this is the fifth time I’ve repurchased. There is nothing bad you could say about this product other than it’s pricey...but once you try it the price is justified. Simply amazing. Will be a staple in my routine for as long as they sell it.

I got hooked on Tata Harper after getting a mini-facial with her products. I have to say this is one of my favourite cleansers. I don’t use it to take my make-up off as I find this is way to expensive as a make-up remover. I use it more as a cleansing treatment after I’ve removed my make-up. It doesn’t leave the face feeling tight.. it’s hydrating and has never caused me to break out. I’m really confused about people saying it smells like bug spray. The ingredients are all natural

Love this cleanser, leaves the skin perfectly clean and balanced, super soft and it will work great on dry skin. However this is more that what I am willing to spend on cleanser, I will continue to but the full size bareminerals oil cleanser that works as well and for $35 a bottle. Tata has amazing products with great ingredients, just wish it was a little more affordable!

I hate falling in love with something so pricey but I did with this cleanser. It applies differently depending on whether or not you apply wet or dry. I usually apply to my face after steaming a bit with a warm muslin cloth, massage into my face, then rinse off with the same cloth. It removes makeup and cleans my skin without leaving a tight or oily feeling. Doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. The scent is light but nice, doesn’t linger too long after washing. The glass container looks lovely on the shelf. Love the natural ingredients. The price, however, makes this more of a special-event cleanser for me. I use this only occasionally, when I’m wanting to pamper myself a bit.

Smells heavenly, making it a pleasure to use every day and night. Removes everything without leaving skin dry or tight. My favorite cleansing oil. Concentrated and does a beautiful job, safe for eyes as well.

i like the package and the glass bottle but it doesn’t do as a good job as the lancome one.the oil is very thick and not as effective when removing the eye liner which i draw on my upper waterline. will finish this and wont’ purchase again.

I stopped use this product due to suspecting an allergy. (I suspect it`s possible due to Citral, Citronellol, Eugenol, Geraniol from non natural sources) But it was the best cleansing oil which i’ve ever tried, I miss it (especially miss it`s smell) (i’ve also tried Tatcha, Juice beauty cleansing oils).

I’ve been using TATCHA’s cleansing oil and have loved the smell, the way it removes makeup, and how it rinses off nicely - without leaving residue or affecting my eyes.  I was excited to try TATA HARPER after seeing It highlighted on Goop.  I had the highest expectations, and am so sad to have this gorgeous green bottle sitting on my bathroom counter - that I dread using. The pump gets clogged and sticks, so you have to force it down (at the same time trying to not let it squirt everywhere.)  The smell reminds me of bug spray, and it leaves a residue, so my skin feels filmy while I rinse.  Forcing myself through the rest of the bottle with each frustrating pump.

This is such a good product. It’s amazing for sensitive and dry skin I love this but not as cleanser. So I my skin can enjoy the rich and decadent ingredients I use this as an oil. I like to use this after moisturiser. I apply this dry. Then I wake up and my skin has a youthful non-greasy glow. I love it

This is my favorite cleanser - as a recent Caroline Hirons convert I have been using this as my PM second cleanse (after taking off makeup) and AM cleanser. The smell is very relaxing to me and I apply it to dry skin and take it off with a warm washcloth. I think it’s helped my skin even out and stay moisturized. The only bad thing is the pump sticks and it’s quite annoying. It’s also hard to travel with - I had to pour some into a smaller container I had. I will not stop using it though since I love it!
review_title: Love this cleanser but hate the pump

review_text: I never ever break out after using this cleansers. If I go away and use a different cleanser I always regret it because my skin just isn’t the same. I immediately come home and use this cleanser and my skin is cleared up. I used to swear by the eve lom cleanser but I switched to this because it works just as great and it’s cheaper and lasts just as long.

I love the oil. It smells wonderful and cleans off my makeup beautifully. I use a washcloth to rinse it off as Caroline Hirons suggests. The only issue I have is the majority of the time the pump won’t pump. It’s very annoying that a product that costs this much has such a horrible pump. I’m seriously considering not buying it again because of the pump. I shouldn’t have to fight with it so much to get product out.

Pros: natural ingredients, nice texture, takes off makeup effectively. Cons: difficult to rinse off (though not as much of an issue if you double cleanse) and expensive. I found an ECOCERT certified oil-based cleanser that works better for less than half the price.

This product is currently collecting dust in my shelf. I’m really bummed about this product. When I did use it, it would just sit on my face. I would be spending a few good minutes trying to get it off but it felt like there was a layer of oil that would just be there. I had to use my foaming cleanser to get it off and make sure my face felt fully clean.

This is by far at the the top of all oil based cleansers. I’m especially pleased that it is infused with plant based products making it gentle on the skin and less of an irritant and the aroma is to die for!Moreover, it’s use and practicality are wonderful, at night I use it to take off my eye makeup,lipstick and even waterproof mascara gently massaging it into my skin and activating it with a little bit of water and then using a washcloth or damp cotton pads (as they suggest you do) to gently remove it. It comes off easily leaving little to no residue and my skin is baby smooth.  It is a little pricey but definitely worth it.

I like a lot of the Tata Harper lines, but this is the WORST oil cleanser I have ever used. It doesn’t remove makeup. At all. All it does is create an oily film on your face that doesn’t dissolve at all. No matter how many times I splashed my skin with this it just sat there on my face. I have used drugstore oil cleansers that are far superior to this. Do not waste your time or money with this one.
review_title: Hands down the WORST oil cleanser I've ever used.

review_text: I’m in love with smell and texture. Great makeup remover or as first cleanse. No eye irritation at all. Pump squirts too hard though so I am losing some of the product.

This is by far my favourite oil cleanser. It is packed with beautiful ingredients so I wouldn’t use this as a make up remover but as a second cleanser. It’s it the only oil that nourish your skin without leaving any greasy residue. It transforms into a gentle milk and it can be rinsed completely.Light herbal scent. The only con is that it’s a bit expensive but if you can afford it, go for it!

I bought this cleanser because I love the product line, not worth the price, does not “dissolve“ anything. It makes a filmy mess when trying to remove ANY type of make-up. I have a vast array of foundations and tried this cleanser multiple times. Does not remove any of them. You will need to use another cleanser and a scrub to remove the mess this cleanser makes. If you have extremely dry skin and want to create a barrier on your face, using this cleanser on clean skin may work for that. I rarely return products but this one had to go back.

Bought because Tatcha’s camellia cleansing oil was out of stock both times I tried to buy it last week. Figured I’d give this one a try. Nothing terrible, except the pump. Not a huge fan of the strong scent but it fades pretty quickly. Overall, nothing great about this either. Will not repurchase after this bottle is empty, going back to Tatcha. I just prefer it over this one.

I had extremely dry and sensitive skin. I use La Mer moisturizer but it only soothes my skin, it doesnt heal the driness. I bought so many products I lost count how much money I’ve spent until I met this oil cleanser! IT HEALED MY SKIN! My face is no longer red, and it doesnt sting anymore! I use it as a facial cleanser am and pm. I usually add 4 to 5 drops of rosehip oil I bought from Australia as well. It leaves my skin so soft amd hydrated. It created a barrier that seals the moist inside and no greasy feeling at all.And most amazingly, it makes my La Mer absorbed so fast! Before I had massage minutes before the moisturizer can be fully absorbed, but now it’s absorbed in seconds! I trully love this product. it is a life saver. I can actually swim in a pool now without feeling stinged in my face. HOWEVER, it doesnt work as well as a makeup remover, especially when you have thick makeup on. Luckily I only use tinted cream or CC cream. Overall, its fantastoc for dry and sensitive skin. its probably not suitable for other skin types.
review_title: use it as a cleaser, not makeup remover!

review_text: this did not take off my make up. it just created a mess that i had to use a washcloth and another cleanser to get it all off. will not use again.

I used it as a makeup remover, however, it would not be easy to rinse off. It created a filmy surface, which I then had to scrub off with a towel or another cleanser. When I used it just to wash my face, it was fantastic and made my skin soft.  As a face make up remover, it was disappointing. Maybe I was using it incorrectly?

Amazing for my red sensitive skin. Goes on like oil but has a nice gentle lather with some water.  Took off my waterproof mascara.  I switched over to Fresh’s Seaberry Cleansing Oil which works just as good for a fraction of the price. Love Tata Harper but the prices are $$.

I used this recently on my 2 daughters (ages 9 and 12) after dance dress-rehearsals and performances to remove waterproof eye-make up and cheek and lip stains.  They did not complain of stinging in eyes (as with other waterproof make-up removers).  Worked well with a couple of pumps, shower, and use of cotton pads to remove final residue.  My only complaint is that darn pump - it is difficult to use and almost caused me to return the product.  I am not sure if this is a design flaw or if it was just my luck, but the bottle must be placed on a stable surface before I am able to retrieve the oil from the pump!

I have had trouble skin since having my second son 6 years ago. I’ve tried everything and finally stopped treating my skin like an acne prone condition and started just treating it like skin. This Nourishing Oil Cleanser is the perfect makeup remover at the end of the day and the gentlest cleanser in the morning. It leaves my skin so soft and moisturized, a second lotion is not necessary half the time. At night, I use the Oil Cleanser to remove my makeup and follow up with the Regenerating Cleanser to exfoliate and then finish with Sunday Riley’s Good Genes. Twice a week I use the Resurfacing Mask. I cannot remember my skin being so clear and healthy before this combination.

I like this oil cleanser overall, but the pump on the bottle is awful. It’s stiff and then when you press it harder to get it to work it suddenly shoots the oil out and wastes half of it. This product is expensive and comes in a beautiful glass bottle, why spoil it with a cheap and ineffective plastic pump? Even a dropper would work better and waste less.The actual cleanser works well. It takes off my makeup and leaves my skin smooth, soft and hydrated. I double cleanse in the evening when removing makeup so I follow this oil with either the purifying cleanser or the refreshing cleanser from this line. FYI the other cleansers also have the same pump but I think since they are a thicker consistency the pump is not as much of a problem.

Smells gorgeous and has a beautiful slip to it, both before and after mixing with water to rinse. The bummer is that with so many natural flower and seed oils my skin allergies were triggered by one of them. Boo hoo. Had to return. If you have pollen or other skin sensitivities just double check the ingredient list. It is hugely expensive too...

I have been using this product for a couple of weeks, and overall I love it.  It takes off makeup beautifully and has the most amazing scent! It is causing me to break out a little, but this is not uncommon for me with a new product.  Will continue to use.

I’ve been using Nude Cleansing Oil for a pretty long time and while I love it, i am always ready to try something new. I’ve tried cleansing oils from several other brands, but this is the first time I’ve found one that may actually replace my old favorite from Nude.... Its great at removing all my makeup and smells good. The consistency is just right; not too thick and not too runny. My only complaint i think would be the pump: It dispenses waaay more than you need to actually remove your makeup, which is kind of wasteful considering the price of this stuff. A half pump usually does the trick. Between this and the Renewing Mask, I think my skin has been looking much fresher.

This is the best oil cleanser I have ever used!! It will take off waterproof mascara and long wear lipstick. I have really dry eye and very sensitive skin and it  doesn’t burn or dry them out. I love this cleanser. It leaves my skin so slow and clean. The smell is so divine.
Love this cleanser it even take off the stila waterproof liner and also the Kat Von D liner. And love that the ingredient is natural .

I put on base makeup almost every day, so I’ve been switching makeup remover since I was a teenager. I believe in oil because it is the most efficient cleanser to remove makeup. But they all make me worry that either my pore will be clogged, or my skin will be extremely dehydrated because of the emulsifier. But this Tata Harper oil cleanser is not the case. It smells like heaven and contains really great ingredients. It won’t be emusified super quickly once you splash some water, but it is definitely not greasy. You can only feel your skin left very fresh and hydrating after using it. I even use it sometimes in the winter mornings, just to make my skin more nourished. I will never reach to any other cleansing oil ever again!
review_title: Finally, I found my holy grail cleansing oil!

review_text: I have never in my life had a cleanser make such a difference in my skin. I have mature, dry skin and am very prone to dehydration. I usually have to layer a ton of skincare no matter what I cleanse with, and even then I’m left feeling dry in a few hours some days. After using this cleanser one time, my skin looked better overall. The crepiness from dehydration was almost totally gone, and my face felt smooth, and there was no tight/dry feeling whatsoever (which is something I’ve always had no matter what I used to cleanse). Within a week of daily use, I began to notice my fine lines looked softer and there was no more crepiness at all. I am a believer, I never imagined that finding the perfect cleanser would have such a monumental effect on my skincare and my overall complexion. I don’t have to layer tons of moisturizer anymore...just my nightly/morning face oil and serum! So, really, in the long run, even though it’s pricey I am saving money because I’ve been able to use much less moisturizer since I started cleansing with this Tata Harper oil! A HUGE win for me...I highly recommend!

I was skeptical of oil-based cleansers, but was trying out the carrot butter cleanser from the Organic Pharmacy. I could see where it was effective, but it was still too greasy and didn’t rinse completely. I am so glad I moved on to this one. It is moisturizing but still effective and rinses very cleanly (yes, with just water). I have rosacea and this cleanser has helped my overall skin tone and balance enormously. I’ll go ahead and say it is also a great value. It’s a high quality product and I only use one pump per use, which is ample, so I expect it to last for several months.

I’m surprised by how much I love this cleanser. I use it at the end of the day to take of my makeup and it gets it all - including eye makeup. It leaves behind a little bit of an oily feeling residue (I wipe it off with a towel) that freaked me out at first, but my skin has never looked better. I credit this cleanser with smoothing out my skin in general, and my crow’s feet especially, making it worth it’s weight in gold (and it costs almost as much). I have “normal“ skin, not prone to breakouts, so I can’t say if this cleanser is appropriate for everyone.

I have very dry skin and this product works miracles for me. Especially for the winter and washing off of makeup this is a god send. I put It on right before I get this the shower and once I wash it off my face is soft, hydrated, and ready for the day.
review_title: Everything I didn't know I needed

review_text: I was looking for a new eye makeup remover and a cleanser at the same time-found it all in one bottle! I have chronically dry skin, my forehead feels like sandpaper so I always used milk cleansers, never considered oil as I thought it would be too much. My go-to eye makeup remover is Clinique take off the day, better than anything else I’ve used including shiseido but was looking for something that would be nourishing around the eyes. I tested this on my eyes to see if if stung-it had a slight sensation but nothing compared to others including Chanel. This cleanser removes all traces of face and eye makeup, softens my dry skin to the point where I don’t need to exfoliate as often to get the same result. Final verdict-almost perfect except it can make my eyes water after rinsing

I really like this product and the results have been great. I can’t believe how nice my skin is. I was hesitant to use an oil cleanser but I am believer. The only reason I didn’t give this 5 stars, is the pump for the bottle. The pump doesn’t work. I will literally put all my weight on the pump and it won’t budge like it is either clogged or locked. When it does work it will shoot the product across the room. I will need to exchange my bottle as I think I may have gotten a bad one.

This is one of my favorite cleansers. I have sensitive, blemish prone skin and this never irritates it. It works really well at removing makeup. Since it is so expensive, I will use a cheaper makeup remover if I have a full face of makeup. I prefer using this if I feel like it will really get on my skin or to do a facial massage. It is a little on the expensive side, but it has lasted a really long time because a little goes a long way.

I’ve tried many natural oil and milk cleansers that would NOT remove makeup but this does and you don’t even need a cloth. It’s maybe faster with one but most of the time I don’t use one and I use tons of makeup. My skins moisture level is balanced and I don’t break out. I go back and forth with this cleanser and the regenerating one. My only complaint is my pump. It’s stuck until you push really hard then squirts out too much product. Since no one else complained about this, I think I got a bad bottle. I’ve contacted Sephora to figure it out. Too expensive to be wasting product.

I’ve been reading all the hype about Tata Harper and cleansing oils, so I finally gave in. I’ve used it alone and as a second cleanser, as other reviewers have suggested (after a Kiehl’s product I love) and like it either way. I don’t think I’d use it as a primary makeup remover, because it’s pretty expensive. And I like other eye makeup removers just fine - Kiehl’s, Sephora, even Almay - to remove Benefit mascara.The container is pretty too! I am excited to try other Tata Harper products as a result of this purchase.
Removes makeup, nourishes my dry skin and feels great after washing. My absolute favorite Tata product.
review_title: Best oil cleanser on the market

review_text: this was a game changer for me..I have always used makeup wipes to remove my makeup until I discovered this product and the tata harper line. I have sensitive skin and am prone to breakouts and this does not irritate my skin or break me out and it removes all of my makeup. holy grail product for me!
i really like this cleanser. it’s moisturizing but leaves no oily residue. it even removes benefit’s they’re real mascara which is not easy to do.
This cleanser is best used on a makeup-free asking or as a second cleanse, as its very luxurious and nourishing that you don’t want to waste it on removing makeup. And it smells amazing.

I recently started using the Tata Harper line and it has changed my skin and the way I think about treating my skin. This is a different kind of cleanser. It’s 100% natural, it’s gentle, removes makeup, and doesn’t strip the natural oils from your skin. Your skin never feels dry afterwards. And it will thank you for it.
review_title: Can be used with oily skin

review_text: Love this cleanser. I use it on dry skin, as my second cleanse. I love massaging my face with it, since it smells like an aromatherapy oil (my skin tolerates oil well). It washes away clean but I use a wet face towel/flannel anyway. I’ve noticed my oily/combination skin is more hydrated and happy in general.

Here is the full ingredient list for those asking: Aqua (Water), Glycerin, Methyl Gluceth-20, Polysorbate 80, Polyacrylate Crosspolymer-6, Phenoxyethanol, Squalane, Retinol, Polysorbate 20, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Solanum Lycopersicum (Tomato) Fruit Extract, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Oil, Macadamia Ternifolia (Macadamia) Seed Oil, Caprylyl Glycol, Sodium Stearoyl Glutamate, Disodium Edta, Citric Acid.Overall review of this is that it is a super gentle and easy to use starter retinol that works slowly overtime and is a nice addition to any routine.

This serum seems pretty gentle. I use it every other night and haven’t experienced any irritation. That said, I’m not sure whether I’ve seen great results, either. It doesn’t really help get rid of dead/rough skin and I’m not really seeing exfoliating properties.

This is my second bottle of vitamin A from alpha-h because I love it so much. I’ve tried retinol products before that are way too harsh for my sensitive skin, so this has been a lifesaver and game changer to my skin. My skin is soo much smoother and my complexion has never looked better. A must have!
review_title: Vitamin A and Retinol with ZERO irritation

review_text: I have very mixed feelings over this serum. Initially, I bought it directly from the manufacturer, and you do receive a bottle a little over half full. I hated the texture at first and ended up not using it for 2 months. The consistency is very watery, but also sticky and it makes it very difficult to apply only 2 or 3 drops. This  really becomes impossible to feel like you’ve covered your face well or even really use after a while. The dropper pumps air into the product, making it very difficult to get a solid amount.  The product bubbles up and loves to hold onto that air so you end up getting mostly air in your dropper. Result-wise I did notice a bit of an itchy burn the first few uses but it subsided. Oiliness dried up a bit and some acne seemed to improve as well as skin texture in places where I had some sun stress. I love that it’s silicone free, and has beneficial ingredients like evening primrose. However, the texture and container style really just are not good at all. I have some left and I just ended up buying an alternative because this really does become pretty hard to use.
Took a few months of light usage for my skin to get used to the retinol, but it’s the only thing that clears up and controls my sensitive, oily skin in the summer humidity.
Came in half bottle empty..wish it had more ..feels good on my skin
Makes my face feel amazing! My skin is so Soft, smooth and hydrated! I was really happy to see the size of the bottle But highly disappointed in the actual amount product in the container.
The serum feels sticky on my face. I have an oily skin and this does not help.
Smells great and softens the skin. However, I think it promises more than it can deliver.
Amazing little powerhouse serum! Great beginner Retinol and super lightweight consistency, and just glides right on.Its become part of my nightly routine 3/4 times a week.

I really liked the alpha-h vitamin A serum as it did a great job at keeping my skin hydrated and nourished. I also like the fact that it has retinol, which keeps my skin exfoliated and rejuvenated. Overall, I’d definitely recommend this to anyone in their late 20s and above, if they’re looking to invest in a lightweight serum that can even out their skin texture; and if they’re conscious like me about the ingredients that go into their skincare products, the alpha h serum is the right fit.

I really like the formula of this product and feel that it works well for my skin. my skin feels great and the packaging is cute too. I like how it contains retinol which I need for my skin. My skin also feels less oily! This was gifted to me and I think I will buy again.

I thought the scent was very nice and calming, I didn’t notice a complete change or hydration in my skin, even following the directions to let it soak in the skin for 10 minutes and apply moisturizer after.

I use this serum on top of my prescription tret cream and it seems gentle enough. It feels very light weight and perfect for layering skincare products. So far no problems with breakouts after using this but still waiting to see improvements on my skin.
I really like this sunroom. It feels great on the skin and I love to pair it with my favorite moisturizer. The color is a little weird though ha ha.

This is a great starter for a retinol, I did have a purging phase but it wasn’t bad. I love my skin texture. I started 2/3 times a week and doing it every other night. This has improved my skincare regime 100%!

I’ve used this product every other night for about a month now and I noticed that my breakouts have healed faster and I also don’t breakout as much. My skin feels so smooth the next day and less oily. I will definitely purchase this product again!
Absolutely love this product, goes on my face smoothly and leaves no stickiness or residue. Would definitely recommend.

This product is very lightweight and very easy to apply. A little bit really does go a long way but the pipet that it comes with is very helpful to make application easier. This serum did make my skin look a bit smoother and did not feel heavy or make my skin feel oily. Only applied it at night since it had retinol and makes your skin sensitive, if applied during the day make sure you use sunscreen. This product was sent to me as a complimentary gift for testing purposes.

I received the Alpha-H Vitamin A serum complimentary from Influencer for testing purposes. As a serum “newbie” I was not sure how my skin would react. I am happy to say that after two weeks of nightly use, I am pleasantly surprised! My fine lines and wrinkles are much less noticeable and my skin certainly has a much smoother appearance. I plan to make this product a staple in my skincare routine.
I loved that my skin felt hydrated after application. I received this complimentary, but I would purchase knowing it has the retinol benefits! Also a little bit goes a long way.
This product makes my face feel amazing. It doesn’t day out my skin and you only use a small amount so its great!!

I did receive this for free from Influenster but my opinion is my own. This is a great retinol! I haven’t had much experience in retinol before but this one was easy for me to use and I haven’t found it drying to my skin at all! It absorbed quickly and has done a good job on evening my skin tone overall!
This Retinol is a great product. I got it free to review. It absolutely leaves a glow in my skin the next day when I’ve worn it. I can also wear it a few days in a row.

I received this item for free from influenster and was so excited. I don’t have sensitive skin but after multiple uses my face got SUPER dry and would peel off. It made me really self conscious so I stopped using it.
I’m still not sure exactly what this product is supposed to do. It didn’t add anything to my skincare routine but it didn’t hurt it either...

ove that this product doesn’t get sticky like other serums I’ve used. I’d definitely recommend using this at Night to avoid sensitivity to the sun. I don’t love it but also don’t hate it either because i haven’t noticed any changes yet! However these ingredients are used to help resurface the skin so I am hopeful for good results slowly! I like that it is not too strong because my skin has suffered from strong rentinol before and it was just shedding all over with a lot of pain!

I really like this product. When it goes on your skin it’s silky smooth. I feel like it compliments my moisturizer and makes my skin feel great! The price point isn’t bad. It’s affordable. I haven’t noticed any new changes to my skin since using bu it’s only been two weeks!

I received this product complimentary to try from Influenster! So far I like it! Easy to apply & you don’t need to use much to cover your face. Cute packaging. I’m not sure if it had made any difference in my complexion so far, but will continue to use!
I love the glow it gives me! Need a bit more time to see results, but loving it so far

Loved how absorbent this was! I used it first on the backs of my hand to compare to the other. It smelled great. The color/thickness was unexpected, but neither was an issue. Super happy! I received this for an honest review from Influenster.
I honestly didn’t know what to expect from this product. I received it free from influenster. Used as directed and my skin had no reaction or changes.
Loving this serum. Noticeable difference in your skin the next day! Easily absorbs into the skin feels smooth going on. Packaging is cute!

I use this serum every other night and it leaves my skin feeling hydrated instantly. It gives my face a smooth texture. The smell is not strong or bad, but it smells like medicine at the beginning. It does fades away quick. I haven’t seen major difference yet, but I’ll continue to use it.
This product is absolutely amazing! Definitely 5 stars, however not sure if it’s worth $55. I did love the texture it gave my skin and can tell my skin immediately became hydrated.

The packaging could be better. Most of the product stays in the bottle and the dropper doesn’t reach it. Since the bottle is glass, it’s impossible to squeeze it out. While the serum itself seems okay, the packaging is definitely not even close to what premium brands offer.

I would give it a higher rating, but honestly I didn’t see a big difference on my skin. I used it every night for a few weeks and it might have worked, but I’m not sure. Not my favorite scent either. Not a bad product, but not something I would purchase.

Leaves my skin feeling firm and hydrated. I like that the amount of retinol is low and it does well on my skin. After use I haven’t seen much difference in my skin, I will keep using to help prevent wrinkles and fine lines.

Received this product for testing from Influenster. First off, cute, simple, little green packaging & bottle. Easy to use dropper. The serum itself is a light green color, kinda fun. Very subtle scent. This product was pretty decent. I didn’t see much difference when using it. It did however make my face feel super smooth & soft after putting it on. It wasn’t harsh like some RetinA products. I used it at nighttime, but I do prefer my glycolic acid serum to this. Remember a little goes a long way with this product. If you have sensitive skin, I would ease into this. Maybe start using it once a week. Also remember to use spf every day when using this and if you plan to have any facial hair removed via waxing, stop using this product a week beforehand.

I absolutely love this serum. It absorbs quickly into the face and left my skin feeling so smooth the next morning.  I definitely see improvement in the texture of my skin after a week.  The only con I have is the scent. It smells like old lipstick that has gone bad,  but the good thing is that the smell doesn’t linger. I would absolutely recommend this to anyone.  If you’re sensitive or not use to retinols, I would slowly incorporate this into your routine because it is very potent.

I like this serum for my nighttime routine, I have been using it for about three weeks now and I have noticed that my skin was not as oily as it used to be. My makeup looks more smooth throughout the day, as well as my entire complexion. The serum is fragrance free, made in Australia from only natural ingredients.

I received this as a free product from Influenster and I really have been enjoying it. It’s a bright fun green color with a very subtle scent. It was easy to apply and dried pretty quickly onto the skin. I have noticed that my skin looks smoother and feels a lot softer.
I liked that this serum has a very light scent and a smooth consistency. My skin became softer after this serum application.
I have super dry skin. Used with the moisturizer it was great! I have since purchased more and have told my friends and family about this product and the other provides they carry!

Overall pretty impressed with this product. I think the packaging is really cute and doesn’t have a strong smell. My face felt very soft and smooth afterwards. I will continually use this every night until it’s empty.

It has no scent (thing that I love), consistency is perfect, really easy to apply and absorb. You can notice a difference by next morning, my skin looks bright and smooth after applying, I would definitely buy a second bottle. Packaging is impeccable, great colors.

Received this in exchange for my honest review fromInfluenster. I’ve been using this for about a month now and feel like it has helped my face a lot. Easy to use and doesn’t really have a smell. My skin isn’t sensitive but I was able to use this pretty often with no issues.

Love how this feels on my skin!!! It really helped the redness.

I live for a great serum that will rescue my skin from this dry weather. This product is amazing but I found it best to use it at night .

Love this product so much! I have super sensitive skin and I have to be careful with which products I use. I had zero issues with using Alpha’s vitamin A serum and I can see a huge difference in my skin after using it for a few weeks. This will be a staple in my skin care routine

i really liked this product! unfortunately i wasn’t able to use it at the same time as my acne meds, so i broke out when i used it for more than a day. i will definitely still be using it, just not every day. the spots where i didn’t break out were soo smooth and i noticed a difference right away! i definitely recommend this product.

It has a light scent and is slightly tacky at first but it gets better. The next day my skin was so soft. Also, if you use 2-3 times in one week, my skin peeled a tiny amount. It wasn’t painful and my skin is sensitive. It didn’t even make it red! I love it!

Lives how this product felt so creamy and silky in your face. It felt very light and there was no tingly sensation which I usually feel when it comes to products but instead helped hydrate my face and gave it a nice glow.

I got this as a surprise item to try! I really love the packaging and bottle, super sleek and the glass helps keep it cold. I was surprised that the serum itself is green! I really love this product! I’ve never used a serum before because I feel like they’re too oily but this one is light, smells fresh, and leaves my fave feeling very clean. I use it every night after I wash my face. Definitely recommend to try if you’re looking too add to your nightly routine!
This product does everything it promises.Firms, hydrates, skin turnover - all natural with light scent.Highly recommend!

review_title: This worked wonders on my skin.

This does not work for me and I did not see a different with using this product.  At first I was using it two times a week and then started using it everyday and I do not see a difference at all. I will start by saying that I do not have sensitive skin. I can switch up all types of face products and even with the desperate use of cheap drugstore products, my skin is fine. i have been using this for the past 3 weeks and it’s incredible. retinol usually dries out my skin terribly and leaves it feeling burning, but this serum doesn’t cause any irritation at all. i wake up the next day and my skin looks plump and fresh. it hasn’t stopped breakouts completely, but i definitely notice way less pimples and flare ups on my face in general. will be repurchasing!

I am completely in love with this product. It has changed my skin for the better. I recently developed EXTREMELY sensitive skin and it’s one of the very few products that I’ve found that don’t break me out. The texture of my skin has improved TREMENDOUSLY. Will definitely be repurchasing.
This stuff is amazing. My skin responded well to this serum. No break outs and extra soft. Highly recommend!
I really like this serum plus it’s CLEAN product. I have oily skin but have not had any issues using it.  I wish Sephora can carries more products this brand!

Ever since Herbivore discontinued their retinol, i have been on the hunt for a serum formulated retinol that was “Clean at Sephora” and Fragrance Free. I ordered this one a couple months ago and am so excited that I did. I tried sooooo many different products and I didn’t like any of them as much as this guy. I never received any irritation from it, and every night that i use it, i wake up the next morning with my skin looking SO amazing. Best retinol serum I’ve tried. LOVE this brand. No irritation, no breakouts!
I really like this serum.  I have dry/sensitive skin and have not had any issues using it.  I wish Sephora carried more of the Vitamin and Hyaluronic Serums from this brand.

I have to give this little one some fair word. First I didn’t think it would actually do anything as most serums maybe just give your skin a bit softness. Then after 10days my skin started to show more smoothness and transparency. Then I realized it has been working. However, there comes a tiny tingling feeling afterwards when I apply other skincare products. It worth the time.

I have very sensitive problematic skin. I use this product daily and have noticed a big difference in my skin tone.  My skin looks more even and I havent had any issues with breakouts. Will definitely buy again.
I started out using this product every other day, then switched to daily.  I use this at night only.  In a month, this product has improved my textured skin and has clamed my hormonal acne.
I thought that the product worked really well. I was also able to snag a bunch from marshalls that were only $6! Marshalls carries a lot of dr.jart products for cheap
I love ALL of the Dr. Jart masks so much!!! They are all super hydrating & make the face look breathtakingly beautiful!!!

I bought this product from a recommendation of a friend but this product didn’t work for me. It didn’t make any difference to my acne even if I put it on every night on the some spot, it is also quite expensive for it only coming with a weeks worth of patches since I bought this product more than once hoping it would work after a few days of using it. So overall I rather use other products that have worked for me before.

These are literally the best at tackling nasty cystic pimples once they’ve opened a little bit. I get cystic acne a lot and honestly, these have saved my skin and helped get rid of them. 100% worth every penny!

These are expensive, but they really work!  Slap one on at night and the zit visibly better in the AM.  Because of the cost I only use them on the worst cystic zits and use a cheaper patch for general zits.

Huge fan and works extremely well. my pimples quickly dried out

I deal with some hormonal acne on my chin and I’m pretty impressed with these little blemish patches. They definitely get rid on the deep whiteheads, more like make them come to the surface and then they can just be gently wiped away. This doesn’t get rid of the redness though, so that’s why it’s a 4 and not a 5 for me. Reduces the pain and helps get rid of the blemish more quickly! I’ll definitely be rebuying!

So to be honest I’m not sure if the Origins spot treatment I applied or the Dr. Jart’s Focuspot microtip blemish patches are to credit but all I know is that the painful, under the skin, hormonal pimple I had last night not only came to a head after leaving the patch on overnight, but it actually broke and drained a lot and it didn’t leave a rough patch. My medium coverage foundation covered it perfectly. I am going to try one again tonight but I am so happy with this result!

I bought these because I ran out of my other brand of microneedle acne patches, thinking that they would work pretty well. They don’t. They have almost no effect whatsoever, and actually made my blemishes look more red! I used 3 on one pimple (1 per night) and it didn’t even come close to disappearing. It also leaves a residue on your skin that’s a little difficult to wash off. They don’t really even contain any acne fighting ingredients - just ingredients to hydrate skin. Don’t bother with these.

I really wanted to like these. I used them for the occasional cystic acne that I get due to hormones. I used all of them on the two spots I had and they made absolutely no difference. They seemed to freeze one in place so it didn’t get any worse, but the other spot I have had for a couple weeks and it just isnt going away so I tried this on it and it did absolutely nothing. really quite an expensive product and you only get 6 in the package. Not worth it in my opinion. They would also be too small to cover enough of the smaller at the surface acne to make this product worth the price.

Ok so first of all, do not listen to the bad reviews that say “oh I couldn’t even feel product on them” “oh it made it worse” because first of all, you’re NOT supposed to be touching where the product should be and you shouldn’t be able to feel it. Where the product “should be” is where the micro needle area is and that’s where the “product” is inserted into your skin. Now, I don’t know about the other ones like the wrinkle, dark spots, etc, but the blemish one actually worked. I was really skeptical about this and so was my mom but I tried it out. I am SO glad I did. 3 hours after keeping it on, the pimple was GONE. Completely. The skin became a little dry but so what? That’s exactly why moisturizer exists! However, I honestly think that this is over-priced. $18 for 6 tiny patches? Yikes...

These personally did absolutely nothing besides make my skin dry and red and itch so I would never buy them for myself just for normal hormonal acne I get once a month for two days. My husband however gets Cysts on areas of his body and he happened to get one on his hip a day after we received this product from influenster for free to review. Generally we use a medicated salve that takes a few days to make the cyst come to a head and burst but I put two of these on the area and then covered it with a big piece of gauze before he went to sleep. It worked it’s magic because by morning the gauze was soaked from the cyst popping!!! So I will buy these to keep on hand when he gets ones that are painful and need to be drained which I know is not the intended use but it worked. I personally cannot recommend for normal facial acne since it did nothing but aggravate my skin.
review_title: Worked for body cysts, not so much for normal acne

review_text: I used this for the minimum 2 hours, instead of overnight. Though it did help with the surface breakouts, it did not do much for my stubborn hormonal acne. I received this product in exchange for review from Influenster.

I wish there were at least 8-10 per pack, but I think despite the price, I will keep in my stock for those stubborn guys who a topical won’t help.

I received these items from influenster for free to review. I found that they do reduce the size of any blemishes that are on top of the skin, but they do not seem to do much for any deep pimples. When I put one on my forehead, it stayed fine, but as soon as I put them on my chin or any curved area, they fell off within a few minutes. As my problem areas are usually these more contoured places of the body, I do not think these will work for me.I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

I was really hopefully when I first got this product. The packaging was beautiful and ideal to be able to carry and use this product anywhere. However the actual product feel short for me. I thought this might have been because I have cystic acne... but then I tried another new patch on a white head and the same blemish again. Neither had much improvement. I sadly won’t be purchasing unless they reformulate the patches. I received this product as a free sample. The review is my own honest opinion.
review_title: Packaging had me hopeful, but product fell flat

review_text: I received the Dr Jart blemish micro tip patch  from Influenster for review and I loved it I am currently pregnant and was scheduled to do a session of micro-needling before I found out I was expecting and I was pleased with the results and it was easy and saw improvement over night I loved!!! It’s not magic. This product doesn’t completely make a blemish go away overnight. It does make a difference though. After using this product, my blemish was smaller and less inflamed. If I had used it more than once as recommended on the package it probably would’ve went away altogether in no time. I do think it’s a little expensive. I’m a spare no cost kind of person and often spend more on skincare products but $18 for 6 small patches is just too much. I wouldn’t but this again to use everyday but I would absolutely use again for special occasions. I received this product free for testing purposes for Influenster.

I received this product complimentary for review purposes. This Focuspot Blemish Micro Tip Patch by Dr. Jart  is a game changer. When you remove the protective cover you can actually see the little micro “needles“ of product sticking out of the patch. This makes it super effective because the product is able to “stab“ into the inflamed area of skin where the blemish is and really get to work. After using the Focuspot Blemish Micro Tip Patch overnight, I immediately noticed that the pimple I had was about half the size it was the day before and the redness had gone down so much! It started looking better and better over the next couple of days as well. I plan on using this product every time I get a pimple from now on to try and prevent any scarring from occurring. If you have acne regularly I highly recommend using this product to save your face!
Not impressed, it didn’t do much for me honestly. Don’t break out much but got a big zit. Applied overnight but did not notice much change in the morning like I had expected.

My first impression was that it comes in really nice individual packaging once you open it up compared to similar acne dot patches that’s typically come in one sleeve. review_title: A little pricey for 6 patches but a decent product

review_text: These come as individual patches that you apply kind of like a bandaid. Small and require nimble fingers, but easy to use. They are translucent circles maybe a half inch in diameter. I put a patch on a stubborn cystic pimple, and a patch on a mostly-healed whitehead and a small blackhead, and left them on for about 12 hours overnight. The patches didn’t help the blackhead, but did help the other two types of acne. It’s not a miracle cure, but they decreased inflammation and redness. I have sensitive skin and they did not cause any kind of negative reaction. I’d recommend these. I received them as a free sample.

I really like these patches, they actually do work. I have pretty sensitive skin, and they did not irritate me. I think they definitely helped keep my large pimples under control. They didn’t completely get rid of the acne right away, but they made a huge difference. They are also pretty easy to use. I received this product free as a sample.
Received from Influenster. Tried it on some hyperpigmentation I got from previous pregnancy. Worked okay but not the best feeling. Decent price for what you get.

I received this product for free from Influencer to try out, and I have to say, I was really disappointed in the results, or lack thereof. I will sometimes get pretty gnarly cystic acne, and I had a spot that had been bothering me for a while that I wanted to use these for. I used all 6 over the span of 12 days and there was never a change in the size or the pain associated with the spot I was trying to treat. This may be good for just regular acne, but definitely not cystic acne.

I received these for review from Influenster and I’m so pleased I did. I was already a huge fan of the Dr Jart line and these are no exception.  They knocked out a group of small hormonal acne overnight and significantly reduced a really aggressive cystic pimple. I’ve used regular acne dots before but these are a hardcore version of that and seem to pull more liquid out of the breakout.  I also like the individual style packaging. I’m certainly going to keep a couple of these in my travel makeup bag.

I had high hopes for this product because I love Dr Jart products so much. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes and was beyond excited to use it. I like the design, and I love that you could deliver focused attention to specific blemishes. I had a large cystic blemish I had hoped to vanquish and unfortunately the product didn’t meet my expectations or make a dent in it.

I’ve given this product a good try. I actually had a 2nd day cystic zit on my forehead (when they are at their largest, for me) when I received these and tried it out immediately overnight. It was easy to apply and the next morning it was right where I put it. I was extremely impressed with its staying power. Unfortunately, the formula made the top layer of my skin very soft and it easily rubbed off when washing my face. Hard to tell if it would have done that anyway, but it made little, if any, reduction in the size of this zit or any subsequent blemish I tried it on. The ingredients just look like moisturizing ingredients...I would have expected at least a blemish fighting ingredient like salicylic acid or benzoyl peroxide if this is targeted at blemishes...not just hydrating and soothing. I think these will be GREAT for preventing scabbing
review_title: Not exactly what I was hoping for...

review_text: I received this for free for testing purposes. I have more normal-to-dry skin but still get acne, so I’m always willing to try acne-fighting products that don’t dry out my skin. This worked great at both healing acne quickly and keeping my skin hydrated. I’ve tried different acne dots/stickers before, and these are by far the thickest I’ve tried, which makes them a little less comfortable than others. But they stay in place extremely well, which I can’t say for the other kinds.

This product is convenient and very easy to use. I used the blemish patches on a whitehead, zit underneath my skin, and a zit a few days after it appeared. I left the patches on for about 7 hours at a time and they stayed on well. After I took them off, there wasn’t a noticeable difference in any of my blemishes. However, the patches didnt make the blemishes any worse. There may have been a slight reduction in the size of my blemishes but that’s it. I received this product for free.

This is my first time using a product from Dr. Jart. Honestly, I had never even heard of the company at first. I wasn’t sure what to expect when I opened the package but was surprised to see multiple individual packets. It wasn’t as detailed as it could’ve been all it says is it’s best to put on at night since you have to leave it on for at least 2 hours but overnight is best. I have issues with acne occasionally but not all the time, right now my skin has been OK so I wasn’t sure how effective this product would be. Truthfully, after the first trial I did not notice a difference in my skin. I decided to try it again and honestly I didn’t see much of a difference. It isn’t very moisturizing and feels a little drying honestly. It’s not a magic solution but I’m not sure what the objective is for this product. It did not seem to help my skin at all nor reduce any of the blemishes I had. Not sure that I would buy this product on my own... review_title: Mediocre, nothing special from Dr. Jart

review_text: I only used it one night but didn’t really notice a difference the next morning. I liked that the patch is barely noticable and it stayed out through night. I received this product complimentary for review purposes.

I had received the Dr. Jart  blemish patch and was decently surprised with the results. I don’t get very many blemishes but shortly after receiving the product, I did get 2 blemishes. I first left the patch on for the minimum of 2 hours, but didn’t see any noticeable differences. A few nights later, I left the patches in overnight and in the morning, both blemishes were gone. Both blemishes were red with a small bump before the patches were put on. Unfortunately I wasn’t able to see how well they would work with a whitehead or if they were red with a larger more painful bump. They worked great for when first noticing the blemishes and getting rid of them before getting any worse. I would like to see how they work with a full on blemish, but don’t want to let the blemish get that bad. I received this product to try from Influenster.

This is my first time using products from Dr. Jart. The packaging explained the process and was easy to follow. I tested the product by wearing two patches at night on three separate occasions. Sadly, I never noticed a difference with my acne, the patches made my breakouts larger and painful. I did receive this product for free in exchange for an honest review.

I used the patches as described. I did not notice a significant difference until 3-4 patches in. I personally feel there are other less expensive patches that are more effective. I did like that these stay on MUCH better than other patches I’ve tried. The packaging, as always from this brand, is on point as well. I liked it enough to try the others in the line, but not enough to try this again.I received this product free from Influenster for sampling purposes.

I tried these patches on a stubborn blemish that’s literally been there for months. They are packed individually, and hygienic and easy to use. I apply the patch to the desired area after cleansing and toning, and it adheres well and stays in place through the night. After using 5 patches on the same spot, I can tell a difference with the size of the acne, but it really hasn’t been as effective as I had hoped. It will probably take two more entire packs to eliminate the blemish completely, and at $18 a pack, that’s kind of expensive for a single acne. I also tried a patch on a regular blemish, and while the difference it makes overnight is obvious, a salicylic acid product will have similar results. Nevertheless, I do think that with the microtips containing hyaluronic acid, these patches may lower the chance of scarring.I received the product for free from Influenster for review. I won’t be repurchasing it, but someone less concerned with money and more concerned with scarring might be interested.

I LOVE THIS PRODUCT! I don’t get many breakouts but when I do they are stubborn and leave dark scars. This honestly decreased my breakout time. I’m so glad I got to try this after receiving it from Influenster and I will be making a purchase!

Received this product complimentary for testing purposes and used this ONCE to make my huge pimple disappear and it worked within 1 day!! Easy to apply and wore it over night and the pimple was gone the next day! Amazing product and glad that I have more for when another nasty pimple decides to appear :) love this product. Definitely recommend!!

For blemish though there’s better options

woah, I didn’t expect this to work as fast as what it did. overnight a monster huge blemish was reduced to just a small bump before a big family event. A brand I use referred Dr. Jart  products. I thought I’d try this micro Tip Patch. It works like magic. Put it on over night and the pimple minimizes to almost invisible. I’d recommend this product!

The first patch I didn’t feel anything and it put it over a dry patch of skin. The second one I had on a small blemish and could feel the tips enter my skin. Doesn’t hurt at all but does feel weird. I leave mine overnight when I’m going to sleep and take them off in the morning. I recommend Dr.Jart and they also come with different packaging if you have dark spots or wrinkles. They have it all for you to try and the price isn’t bad either.
I love all the products from this brand. Especially this one. Perfect to help with breakouts. I received this product for free or complimentary for testing purposes.

I would purchase these again but only for special circumstances at they are pricey for only 6 patches.I received this product from Influenster for free testing purposes.
