All in all it was a great product! I received this product complementary for an honest review.
review_title: Worked on cystic and regular acne

The patches are simple and easy to use. Just peel them off, place over the zit, and apply light pressure to stick in place. Since they recommend using every other night I left it on again 2 nights later but still didn’t notice a significant difference. I love the idea of these patches, and they didn’t dry my skin out like most spot treatments do, but they didn’t do enough for me to recommend purchasing. I received this product free from Influenster for review purposes.

I recieved these patches from influenster to try. I was ver exited because I had a few blemishes on my face. I used them over night and they seem to significantly reduce the appearance of my blemish, it also shrunk the Flemish down. I’ve been breaking out a lot lately after having my twins. I used these on my trouble spots and it really worked! Would definitely recommend! I received this product as a free sample from Influenster.

You just put in on the blemish and let it sit overnight. When you take it off in the morning, you can visually see it shrink! I will be using these before special events to ensure flawless skin! It doesn’t sting and is easy to use. I recommend it!

review_text: I have been using this product for about 25 years.  I apply it religiously as the first layer of my morning skin care regime.  Until about five years ago, it single-handedly and dramatically softened the furrow between my brows.  In my late 40s, I decided to give it a little help and get Botox, but I still use this product daily and always will.

I find this product very drying. To me upon application, it feels very much like any of the primers loaded with silicon in it, very slippery and easy to spread out but it just sit on the skin and won’t absorb. My face feels dry and tight, almost to a wrinkly extent (although it doesn’t look like it in the mirror). It does blur my pores and even out my skin tone like a good primer would do, but I don’t think it’s doing anything skin care wise. I use it mainly for minimal makeup days to get a blurry effect but it’s too expensive for what it does.

I did not find it to be drying, as some do, but it did feel like it sat on my skin as opposed to absorbing into it. Oh well, on to the next product!

I like the way this smells (floral, soapy, perfumey - a lot like Estée Lauder’s Soft Clean foaming cleanser), but it has a sticky-ish and sort of dry consistency that feels like it does not absorb into the layers of the skin. I make sure my face is soaked with toner before I apply, otherwise I find I need to use way more product than recommended. My skin felt and appeared smoother immediately, but it was more of primer mask than it was my actual skin. There is just no way it happens that fast.  Regardless of its claims, the way this product feels is the reason I don’t think it offers nourishment or protection to the structure of the skin. That said, this is a nice sort of makeup primer or blurring product.

I use about 3 pumps on my face, 2 on my neck, one on my chest and the 1.7oz lasts me about a month and a half. I could use it once a day, but I really love this serum. I have had no reactions to it, it applies evenly and smoothly, and makes my face look dewy and just better overall. It could be used as a primer, it’s that good. I have been using this formula for quite some time, after breaking out using their advanced night repair formula, and I couldn’t be happier. The name of this serum really suits it well, it truly is perfection in a bottle. My Grandmother, who is 76 and looks about 60, swears by Estée Lauder so the first time I ever thought about anti-aging products, which was about 6 years ago when I turned 27, I thought about Estée Lauder. The ANR serum was the first I ever tried and it really helped to even out my skin tone and it was a great preventative measure. Now that I’m 34, I felt the need to try something geared more toward repairing and this is truly amazing. I have a lot of marks from past breakouts, large pores, and some fine lines mostly in the places where I used to get bad breakouts and this has helped with all of those issues. It’s helped over time and better yet, it helps improve the look of my skin instantly. The texture is silky and the silicones in it help to minimize pores, lines, acne scars, and it works so well under makeup. It didn’t dry my skin out as others have stated but then again, I still have a very oily t-zone. Oh and the silicone in it isn’t overbearing. It’s just the right balance - my skin can still breath yet it helps to make my face much smoother. This is one of the few serums on the market I can honestly say is worth the money.

I’m still in my twenties so I didn’t get this with the hope of reducing wrinkles but after using this for a little over a week the few expression lines that have started to form have suddenly disappeared. I can’t believe how well it works! I will definitely keep using.

I feel like a lot of people on here don’t understand what an essence is used for. If you are using a face oil which is an occlusive agent (meaning it makes a barrier on your skin) it can dry your skin out over time because it is not a hydrator, and it is meant to TRAP in moisture from a product that hydrates. Ideally skin needs both oil and water to stay healthy. Oil traps in the water. The best form of “water” to trap in your skin before an oil is a humectant. This product is NOT meant to be used as a moisturizer alone. It is meant to be used BEFORE a face oil. Using a humectant (there are a couple in this formula) alone as a moisturizer will do nothing and eventually pull moisture from your skin into the air. This isn’t meant to be used alone. This is why you think it’s doing nothing. If used with an oil, this will provide the water factor needed to be trapped in by the oil. It is best to research these products before wasting money on them, especially because tata Harper products are expensive. It is expensive, but if used correctly - you will have better skin. Don’t use it alone and expect any results.

Most people don’t know this but there are two main kinds of sunscreen products- mineral and chemical. What feels or looks best isn’t always the best option for your skin. Chemical products absorb chemicals into your skin in order to convert UV rays into heat- then release the heat from the skin. Mineral sunscreens have ingredients that sit on the surface of your skin and deflect UVA and UVB rays as soon as they’re applied. When I have a choice, I always prefer mineral sunscreens and I appreciate Kate Somerville being a progressive brand and offering these types of products! Something to keep in mind though is mineral sunscreens do tend to rub off easier and may need to be reapplied more often for maximum coverage. I was really hoping to love the Origins Checks and Balances Polishing Facial Scrub because I do really love the brand. However, I am disheartened by my experience with this product after just one use and can definitely never use it again nor recommend it to others. This scrub is extremely intense and abrasive. As soon as I applied it to my skin, I knew that it wasn’t going to be good but I powered through for the sake of leaving this review in hopes to help others. It has a thick cream consistency with an extremely rough, sandy exfoliant mixed throughout. After feeling how rough this product was, I made sure to be gentle when scrubbing my face with it. I used it for about 30 seconds before I knew it needed to be washed off because my skin could no longer handle it. I do have pretty resilient skin, but this product completely broke down my skin’s natural barrier, leaving my face hot and red and causing my normal following products (hydrating toner, calming serum, and moisturizer) to burn and sting - a telltale sign of a damaged skin barrier. I want to note that the last time I exfoliated was 4 days ago, so this is not a result of overexfoliation on my part. I should say that this product does exactly what it says it will do - it sloughs off dead skin cells and surface impurities, buffs the surface of the skin, and helps unclog pores - although not in a way that is safe for your skin. While this product does have many natural plant oils and healthy ingredients, the few bad ingredients overpower the benefits. I’m afraid that those who liked this product do not know enough about skincare to realize what this product is doing, in the same way that many people love the St. Ives Apricot Scrub. I have to say that the Origins scrub is worse than the St. Ives. Unfortunately I will not be using this product again and cannot recommend it to others. Here’s what I did...I mixed a quarter of the measuring spoon worth of powder with 4 drops of ’Matrixyl 10% + HA’. Not too sticky and applied smoothly and evenly. I did get a slight white/powdery layer on my face once it dried, but as I only used it last thing on a PM, it wasn’t an issue for me. WARNING: This product contains squalene. Squalene is made from shark liver oil. I checked the ingredients and it doesn’t say cruelty free AND squalene is their FIRST ingredient. Extracting squalene from sharks is very violent and even illegal in some countries and states. If you buy products that contain squalene, you are contributing to the shark fin trade and shark cruelty. There are 100 million sharks killed each year, and if we keep using products like this, there won’t be many sharks left to kill. Furthermore, do you want to rub shark liver oil on your face??? I sure don’t. Please be mindful in the products you buy. You can do research to see what products are safe. Thank you!!

I really hated the fragrance, so much so that I couldn’t wear this for more than an hour or two before running to double-wash my face. So I can’t speak to the long-term results you might get if you tolerate the smell and texture, only the first couple of hours of wear at morning and night.I assume the wash-off results are because it’s relying on dimethicone as the 3rd ingredient, per their website: “Aqua/Water/Eau, Cetearyl Alcohol, Dimethicone...“ The hyaluronic acid doesn’t show up until halfway down the ingredients list, as Sodium Hyaluronate. I’m guessing the peptide complex would be the various oils they list, also halfway down the ingredients list. In any case, these are in pretty small concentrations based on their positioning.But what about results? This cream goes on smoothly, but it leaves my face feeling slick like a silicone primer does. Nor does it really work well with makeup (oddly, since silicone primers usually work for me).Overall, there are far better products in this price range (and cheaper). review_text: After years of using tinted spray-on self-tanners, I was excited to try a clear formula for the first time. The old tinted products I used to use would always stain my clothes and sheets, even days after application and showering a few times. I was intrigued by this product and after reading some good reviews, decided to try it. Application: I sprayed the solution onto my body and used a self tanning mitt to rub it in. I’m quite sensitive to most scents and I found this product’s smell to be quite pleasant - light and fruity at first, which then fades into the standard self-tan odor. I assume that this common smell is caused by the active ingredient (DHA), since I’ve experienced the same smell with every self-tanner I’ve used in the past. This product does a better job of masking the smell than many others I’ve tried, without being overpowering. One small complaint, the sprayer only works well while the bottle is upright, making it a bit tricky to use upside-down on certain areas of the body.There is a slight tacky feeling left behind on the skin after the product dries, though it’s far less sticky than every other self tanner I’ve used - whether lotion or spray. This product also dries quickly, which I appreciated.The color developed slowly over about 6 hours. It gave my skin a nice glow, though it definitely wasn’t as dark as some other formulas I’ve used. This seems like a good product to use every few days to build up to the level of tan you’re looking to achieve. I was initially worried about streaking or uneven application - especially since it goes on clear - though it came out evenly!Overall, I’m very pleased with this product and plan to use it regularly. I give it high marks for low odor, not staining sheets, being vegan and cruelty-free, and letting a little go a long way. Perfect to spray on and go about your day without worrying about stained clothes. Highly recommended!

The spray thing can also get stuck or is difficult to use when you need to get hard-to-reach areas (can’t spray with it upside down). I’m putting ’would recommend’ because it may work better for some people, it doesn’t stain, dries quickly, and the color is nice.

Had Kate Somerville sold her product the way the SA in store did, it would be much easier to review positively, because that’s basically what it is-- a pleasant, silky hydrating eye serum featuring hyaluronic acid. The Ugly/Honest: Even at it’s hugely discounted price, this mask is still not worth it in my opinion. There are better, cheaper and more effective masks out there even within the SC collection. review_text: Clinique recently discontinued their Super City Block SPF 40 3-in-1 sunscreen/tinted moisturizer/concealer combination. It’s not a tinted moisturizer - it’s only a sunscreen - so it can’t double as concealer. It also has the thick, gooey consistency of toothpaste and doesn’t glide on like the other product. It’s not even like delicately fragrance, but it is so overwhelmingly floral from that lavender. I’m not even particularly sensitive to scents, but this was just so overpowering. Also, for those who aren’t aware, apparently this has patchouli oil which I did not know before I decided to choose it as an option from my box. Patchouli oil can cause adverse reactions in the skin. After using this product for the second time, I had little bumps, my eyes felt like they were burning, and my skin just felt...not good. Which is a shame because so many other people seem to be having great luck with it. But I will never be using again and instead I’ll just go back to my Inn Beauty moisturizer.
product_name: Do Not Age with Dr. Brandt Time Defying Cream

review_text: I’ve dealt with genetically large pores and texture issues and I have tried everything from microdermabrasion to countless retinols and other skincare products. None of them have done for my skin what this moisturizer has. As someone who has been through a million of those little tatcha dewy skin cream samples with no noticeable results compared to my usual cerave route, I was not expecting much from this pricey option when it showed up in my Ipsy Glam Bag X box last year. Boy was I wrong. Within a week I noticed my pores appeared smaller and my makeup was going on more smoothly. The full-sized container wound up lasting me just under 3 months and while I didn’t want to justify the price for a moisturizer as a full-time grad student, Sephora offering Klarna allows me to continue to enjoy this product and be able to love my skin! My only complaint (aside from the priciness) would be that the packaging is bulky and heavy and not the most eco-friendly. I would love maybe a refillable option for those of us who buy this product regularly!
product_name: Do Not Age with Dr. Brandt Time Defying Cream

review_text: This stuff is amazing. It softens the skin with just a tiny amount of product. If you like a moisturizer to be unscented, this is not for you. However, I personally adore the smell. I think it is mainly lavender. Wonderful before bed. Very expensive stuff, but I wouldn’t be without it.

review_text: After 2 weeks of use my skin looks way younger. I used to have to blur out the wrinkles in my pictures but not anymore (I’m almost 60). My skin looks almost perfect like it’s been photoshopped. It is also firmer than its been in years.

I kept seeing this online, and I wondered who paid $99 for a single king size pillowcase? I wondered if it was possible that it lived up to the hype and rave reviews I saw here and on other sites. During the 15% off sale, I decided to get it, almost to prove the claims were wrong! I waited for over a month to write this review just to be sure!I’m currently undergoing daily IV treatments for an illness and the meds haven’t just made me lose hair, they started making it break. So, I was more interested in the people who said they woke up with their hair looking the same as when they went to bed. My hair is very long, to my waist. Not by choice, just not up for a salon visit yet. As it has been this long before, I knew it doesn’t break from length. Something my friends have been in amazement of since we were young! And, yes I eventually cut it myself - ha! I just wondered if all my time spent in bed scrounging on pillows was leading to some of the breakage? At the same time, my doctor says the night sweats that come along with the illness - and often get worse during treatment - are much more than what most women ever go through during menopause. All I know is I was waking up several times a night laying with sweat all over me, on a soaked sheet, with wet hair to boot! The FIRST NIGHT I used this...I woke up to no bed head!!! I was amazed! I didn’t really need to brush it! The crown of my hair, usually sticking up and all a mess from rubbing into my pillow...was flat!!! And my fear that night sweats would be worsened using a silk pillowcase - turned out it was totally  the opposite! My night sweats hadn’t woken me in the night! In fact, they have been SO MUCH BETTER! I realized over the next couple of weeks that this pillowcase stays cool...even though I still turn it over in the night, pretty sure that’s from habit! My night sweats were still occurring on my chest and abdomen, but it was like from my shoulders up...no more sweats!! I couldn’t believe it! Then, I saw the difference in my skin. By this I mean, I was sleeping on 100% Egyptian cotton sheets that felt almost like silk themselves, but I didn’t realize they were soaking up some of my nighttime skin care products! I just noticed my skin had a nice dewy glow, yet I had used the same facial oil. I saw that it was the lack of absorption from the cotton pillowcase! My overnight cream masks... I saw my skin was brighter than it had been before! I pay good money for my skin care products, so this was just a huge bonus! I don’t think I have used it enough to say anything about long term use helping with wrinkles. But, I know that my face slides across this like butter, so I feel like it’s probably at least keeping me from forming any future wrinkles. I did my research before I bought this because there were several other places selling silk pillowcases for much cheaper. Turns out that just because they say 100% silk, it doesn’t mean that the pillowcase itself is made of only silk. Just that the silk used is real silk, but apparently often mixed with other materials like polyester! I also researched what the big deal was about “the highest grade mulberry silk“ - I found out that it’s the best sillk produced and there’s a big reason it costs what it does! Also, I figured the 22 mm must be somewhat like the thread count of cotton sheets, and I was right. This is actually stated on several sites discussing silk as “the best for silk sheets“. Then one morning my mom came to see me and couldn’t believe that I hadn’t brushed my hair yet! She saw my skin was actually looking more fresh and glowing...then said it would be nice to try one out. Yes, this was just a week before Mother’s Day so - hint, hint! I got her one and she said her 72 year old skin was so thankful for not having to deal with what had become more than sleep “creases“, they were looking like sleep “crevices“ - the pillowcase stopped those for her!I’m so glad that my hard headed self decided to order this just to prove it couldn’t do all it claimed -  I proudly admit now, it does do it all! So much so, that as I am in bed all day, my husband said to get another one!!! That’s always the true test --- when the husband notices enough to say spend another $99 on a pillowcase - ha!!! Seriously, I have fallen in love with this and honestly couldn’t go back to my others!! It may be expensive, but it is actually worth it!!!

I see some reviewers have reported breakouts with this cleanser, but my experience with the Origins MMSRelief has been just the opposite. This cleanser has been miraculous for balancing my moody combination skin. It gets everything squeaky clean and fresh WITHOUT feeling tight and dry (it is weirdly satisfying to see all the grime that comes off on a cotton pad after a few swipes of this). There is no scent or anything irritating at all about it.It leaves me feeling dewy and fresh without needing to wash, which is AWESOME after the gym, or if you hit snooze a few too many times and need to get ready quick! I also love that it’s replaced my dependence on facial wipes (which get pricey and, let’s face it, are pretty terrible for the planet). It’s gentle enough to use under your eyes, and though it certainly won’t cut through waterproof liners and mascaras like an actual eye makeup remover, it’ll sweep away any left over shadowy residue just fine. You get a generous sized bottle of this, and since just a little bit will do, it should last you a long time. I feel like this would be an incredible cleanser for dry or older skin bc of its lack of drying. I love it for my own oily/dry combination skin, and I personally haven’t had ANY breakouts at all in the month I’ve used it, so give it a shot if you hate drying cleansers.

Bought this product in a department store. So glad I was able to find it here. I tend not to use skin products on a regular basis. Not so with this cleanser. I love it. Leaves my face feeling squeaky clean.

I use this the same way I would a toner, but to remove make up and in lieu of washing my face in the morning. With this product my skin is clearer than it has ever been!
Love this cleanser. Really gets down and clears all the makeup off my skin. Doesn’t irritate at all for me. Definitely a staple in my skin care routine.

This is one of my favourite skincare products. I use it to remove makeup, or I pat it on after I wash my face as a toner. Since I started using it my redness on my face is almost non existent. My skin was so sensitive that I had to douse it in witch hazel twice a day and now that I use this, no pain or sensitivity either. I highly recommend it to people with sensitive skin and any redness they want to get rid of.

I bought this micellar cleanser right when it came out, and because I had never used a product such as this before, I had no preconceived notions of how it would work for me, but I’m a fan or Origins products, so thought I’d give it a try. Glad I did!! I use mine first thing in the morning, no water or soap, and add my moisturizers for the day. It’s divine!
Smells nice, leaves skin oil free, is alcohol free, leaves a bit more of a residue than I would like.

It gets the makeup off fair but my skin is tingling/slightly burning after use and I find I need to at least splash water on my face after to relieve it, which defeats the whole purpose of water free.

My skin was in a rosacea flare, and even the most gentle of cleanser with a cool baby’s washcloth was angering it. I read a few reviews about this line and decided to try the micellar and I could not be happier. My skin calmed right down and I now use it morning and night as my only cleanser. It removes makeup well and is so, so, so gentle!

I use micellar waters to remove my eye and face makeup before cleansing with my facial cleanser and clarisonic. I recently bought the bioderma brand for sensitive skin because of the good price, good reviews, and generous size. After using this for a few weeks, I noticed my under eyes feeling dry and tight, which isn’t normally an issue. I did use this product tonight to remove my eye and face makeup and had no dry, tight sensation. I will stick to this as the ingredients are safer and more gentle.

Prior to trying this cream, I had been using Farmacy honey halo Ultra moisturizing but wanted to try a less dense formula and I always wanted to try Kate Somerville product. Once I finish this product up, I’m going back to Farmacy - it’s half the price and I see the results within a few days of using, I don’t know what’s up with this KS cream, I don’t see any results.
love this product! so sad she changed the formula a bit along with sizing.

I have dry extremely sensitive skin.  Never have I used a moisturizer that has made such a dramatic change in my skin with one application.  My skin feels significantly softer and the effects last from one application to the next.  I have used numerous high end moisturizers including Kate Sommerville Goat’s Milk, but none has been so effective.

Purchased when it was full price ($90) with the hopes it would be amazing because Kate Somerville...right? Wrong. The product is “eh” at best but what really drove me to give it such a low rating was the fact that it irritated my eyes like crazy. Keep in mind, I did not apply it to my eyes or near my eye area but omg, did it make my eyes burn! Needless to say, I will not re-purchase this product and I feel my eyes will thank me for it.

I purchased this on a whim. And I don’t regret it one bit. This has transformed my skin. I had hyperpigmentation due to sun damage and tried so many products, then this miracle happened. It completely erased all signs of hyperpigmentation, has smoothed the surface of my skin and given me a rewind on new skin.
I did not see much in the way of results compared to other products I have used in the same price range. Nice scent and texture but pretty basic effects.
When I first purchased this cream I was so excited but It does nothing and my eyes burn even if I avoid the under eye area.

Gorgeous cream. I love this stuff. I’m 30 acne prone with combo skin. This is awesome. It doesn’t make me breakout, it’s a great middle of the road texture where it’s not too light but also not greasy. It makes my Skin feel soft and hydrated. I’ve noticed with consistent use it does a great job of minimizing my fine lines because it actually moisturizes my face and keeps tewl at bay. It has a light fragrance that doesn’t linger,  which is pleasant. I use this at night and will repurchase again.
I love this moisturizer from Kate Sommerville. I also use Exfolikate, which I love.

This gives my 42 yr old skin the best glow of any moisturizer Ive used. It also lasted me 6 months and I use it once a day. I’m not heavy handed but I’m not skimpy with it either. I’m not going to use any other bc I don’t think my skin could look any more luminous than it does when I use this.

I’ve been using this cream for about year now. Diligently once to twice a day with a few breaks to see if it felt like it was still working. It provides great lightweight moisture and is not oily under makeup. My super dry skin area (tip of my nose) it is not enough for, but it’s perfect for an all over general moisturizer. When I first started using it I saw a noticeable difference with my forehead wrinkles. It can’t make what’s there completely disappear! That’s not how this works! I do think it helps slow the progression. When I’ve gone multiple days without using it I noticed a change in my skin texture and wrinkle appearance. Or it’s all psychosomatic, but either way I’ve continued to buy it for a year now. Product lasts about 2 months for me.
I am so impressed by this cream. I came in thinking that it was going to be heavy but it has an amazing texture and absorbs quickly into the skin plus it doesn’t have unnecessary fragrance.
I don’t find this product rich enough for my dry skin

Hands down the best face cream I have ever tried. The price is steep but so so worth it, the cream literally melts into your skin. I can not recommend it enough, I live in Canada where skin SUFFERS during the winter but this cream gives me perfect hydration all year round.

I like think heavy night creams and bought it because it was recommended for hydration and for fighting first signs of aging. It was OK but I wanted more than surface hydration. Verdict: OK but will probably try something else next time
Love this moisturizer! It works as well on me as LaMer did and much better than my clarins products. I only wish it were a little less than $90 but it is worth it!

This is my favorite go-to winter moisturizer.  It feels great going on; thick and creamy, and has a pleasant subtle smell.  What it does for my dry skin is nothing short of amazing.  I swear by this stuff. The only catch is that it’s too heavy for the crazy hot Arizona summers, so I need to switch to something lighter for the summer months.

I bought this as a more economical substitute for KateCeuticals Clinic Reserve Cream (which is $250) that I sampled and loved.  This didn’t cause me any irritation, but at $90, this cream still isn’t exactly a bargain and I don’t think this product is worth the price for the quality.  Smell is pleasant and the dispensing pump design is great, but the product mostly sat on top of my skin and left a slick oily feeling and major shine.  As a moisturizer it was just OK, and I don’t feel it did anything unique for my skin elasticity etc. I used the whole container, but wouldn’t buy again (lasted about 6 months with near daily use).

I have never received so many complements on my skin and age before! The consistency is quite thick and I was worried that it would be heavy on my face, however, applying it appropriately didn’t leave any my face feeling weighed down. It absorbed quickly and left my skin feeling refreshed and hydrated. I feel that my skin texture and tone has become more smooth, even, and more glowing. I will be purchasing this for years to come!
Seems to be helping time will tell!
Doesn’t do anything. Not worth the high price tag.
Love this it has made my skin feel incredible.

I love this product. It’s got a creamy consistency, though not greasy, and, it has a nice soft scent.  It keeps my skin hydrated and soft, keeps wrinkles at bay, and I am constantly told I look younger than I am!
Absolutely love this product. Yes, its on the pricey side, but no need for day moisturizer. I use this in the morning and at night

I’ve used it for two months, every single night, nonstop! I love it with all my heart. It help my skin getting through finals, graduation (yeah, I’m 28 but still dealing with exams. Get ur master degree done ASAP, girl!). All the torture left nothing damage on my skin because of it, seriously! And I clearly knew it’s the night cream making the miracle b/c suffering from exams and papers and all that, I didn’t even use toner, serum, just the night cream, just! It!  But it!!! Coz why not~

Needed a new AM skin cream so tried this as the rep was in the store. Ideally wish it had SPF in it but now I just add that separately. Overall really love this, its a smooth cream and it sinks in fairly quick. It also lasted a fair amount of time for the price (3/4 months) so I was happy about that. Previously tried Drunken Elephant and was not as happy with the results or how long it lasted. I can see my skin having more of an even texture and my wrinkles softening.
review_title: Nice daily cream, smooth and leaves skin soft

review_text: Love this stuff! I felt like almost immediately that my fine lines were diminished! For my normal - combo skin, I find it best to use as my daily moisturizer because it’s not oily and has that tightening feel. That said, I don’t find it very moisturizing, so at night I need a heavier moisturizer, but that’s just my preference. Under my makeup, I still will add the Bobbi Brown hydrating moisturizer on top of this as my primer and it’s perfection together!
Kate Somerville is the only skin care products I use. They’re pricey but worth it.

I purchased this for my mom (56) as she was going through a weird zit breakout, like they were huge! Anyway, she used it for about a month and her face cleared up quickly.  It was unbelievable, her skin now looks smooth and youthful. She uses it once a day with Obagi Nu-Derm 3.
Liking the product but the push top stopped dispensing after the first day.  Face still looks better though!
Amazing cream for dry skin!! This absolutely saved my dry skin and now I can’t live without it.

I got this in sample size from a gift set from Kate Somerville, and I just bought the full size because I am in LOVE. The cream feels heavy when you apply it but absorbs quickly and leave the skin feeling ultra moisturized and GLOWING.

Love this cream.  I feel hydrated without greasiness, and it is so gentle (for me).  I did let my husband use this one day that he was feeling dry and he had a burning/peeling reaction, which I thought was strange, but then realized that this cream is anti-aging and has enzymes and such.  I have never felt anything, nor broken out...but would recommend trying a sample first.  I have been using this for years!!!
review_title: LOVE this cream, but try before you buy.

review_text: This product was suggested to me in store during the Rouge event on 9/9 as a great fall/winter moisturizer for combo skin that gets drier in winter. It felt great on my hand (different type of skin than my face of course).  I tried the product when I got home that evening after cleansing and found it dried my skin out terribly.  It was as if this was made for oily skin, not at all what I was expecting.  I will be returning this product.  It is not worth the high price tag. I have better results with Strivectin products which keep me balanced throughout the year (recently returned to the brand after straying).
review_title: Not what I was told it would be - Dried me out

review_text: I love it , and I didn’t know I would! I used with the wrinkle warrior and together under my smashbox foundation it is a dream!!!! I don’t like the fragrance but that’s ok. My dry skin soaked it up and it hasn’t broken me out

Save yourself $90.00 and invest in a different moisturizer. If you are hoping to purchase a moisturizer that will offer you visible improvements in your skin, this one disappointed me. After 3 months of use I see no difference.

It is very moisturizing but does not feel heavy orgreaser.  I don’t have wrinkles but I have quite a fewfine lines.  My skin feels and looks better every time I useit.  Also love the way it dispenses the lotion.
Honestly I have nothing to complain about it.If you watch my skincare routine (at YouTube channel MyTopThingsss), it’s my day cream nowadays.

I’m getting fine lines and decided to up my skincare game to the max. Get this I did my research and this product is backed by a Nobel Prize anti-aging breakthrough and also the cheapest in the Prize winners so it’s a no brainier for me. It doesn’t smell the best but it’s not discussing and I can tolerate it because it’s the best. I use the serum, eye cream and this moisturizer and my skin looks amazing. When people find out how old I really am which is only when they ask for my ID (strange at my age to me) they say wow no way what’s your secret? I say skincare is and should be your major splurge besides foundation. These items are put all over your face so they should be the best! Other items can be skimped on because most major makeup brands are owned by the same company as the drugstore brands. Research is key to good skin as well. I do use an exfoliant, sometimes a peel, hyaluronic acid and C but those items can be found in lower priced products in high amounts.

I have been using this for about a month and I love it. It is very moisturizing and hydrating on my combination skin. I love how it feels in the morning when I wake up - still clean and not oily (since I go straight to the gym without washing my face). I will continue to use this as long as it keeps my skin feeling soft, moisturized, and clean.

Although this is an anti aging product, I would recommend to people who are looking for an amazing moisturizer alone. This moisturizer is truly amazing. I have extremely dry skin and eczema and this product is by far the best I’ve used. It leaves your skin feeling like silk. And the anti aging never hurts either! (I’m 17 lol)

I was looking for a great moisturizer to put on daily and I had the hardest time finding a cream that worked for everyday.  I finally tried this and it was magic.  This, combined with the Exfolikate cleanser is the best combo ever on the planet.  It is never oily, just absorbs immediately and your skin is crazy soft.

Doesn’t leave me feeling greasy, good consistency, but isn’t worth the price. I see no difference in my skin after using this for 2 months. I purchased it based on a recommendation from a friend who raved about it, but I don’t think it does anything for me at all. Won’t purchase again (especially because there are some amazing brands at a lower price point that can do the same thing) I also don’t think it moisturizes that well.
Not worth the $ in my opinion. I think it broke me out. I really didn’t like the scent. I also didn’t see any great results.

I wouldn’t consider myself as having sensitive skin, nor the type to review a product. Tried this on a recommendation from a super friendly and seemingly knowledgable employee. This broke me out like crazy. I couldn’t figure out why I was getting little pimples on my face. Started to apply in certain areas, the other areas cleared up. Super disappointed. Don’t spend good money on this. Did not do anything for my fine lines AND it broke me out. Two thumbs down.

I have always been satisfied with the sephora staff recommendations but on my last visit a representative from Kate Somerville was in sephora and really pressured me to try it. They stood in front of the brand I usually purchase so I thought it can’t be that much different than my usual brand and it cost less. Does NOT provide moisturizing,or lessen dark spots. I could get past the smell but my nose has been peeling badly using this cream. If I did not live so far from a sephora I would return it. I have used different high end moisturizing creams some I like better than others. I don’t usually write reviews but a product this costly should be better.

I use this just at night to make it last longer and still see nice results. I do hate the price tag but after trying to go without it I’m back buying it again. It’s the perfect consistency and I love it.

I used my first jar and was very happy with it but decided to try something else when it was gone. BIG mistake! This product moisturizes without being greasy and works well on my sensitive skin. I will be sticking with this one going forward.

No breakouts, no reactions...my skin is hydrated and smooth, and people have a hard time believing my age. I also use the eye cream, Vit C Serum, and retinol. I never thought I needed a moisturizer (having always had oily skin), but this is my holy grail.
review_title: A moisturizer that works for me

review_text: This cream is amazing. I’ve been using it for about two years now. It’s not too greasy and doesn’t upset my very sensitive skin. It gives just the right amount of hydration for my dry skin. It is however, pricey. The one time I did not repurchase this after I ran out I regretted it immediately. Tried several other cheaper products with terrible results. You get what you pay for. This is the good stuff!!
review_title: Tried to live without it: Couldn't

review_text: This is the nicest anti-aging cream I have ever tried. I HATE that is costs $90 for 1.7 oz!!, but it’s still the best cream I have tried. It makes my skin glow. I don’t wear any foundation, and I like the way my face looks after using this cream. The drawbacks, aside from the cost, are that you can’t tell when you are running out until you have run out because you can’t see inside the jar. I have taken it apart, but after you do that it doesn’t dispense correctly. I use it underneath KS RetAsphere with retinol every few days, which is also $85 for 1 oz. I hate paying that price for such a tiny amount of product, but they are the only cosmetics I pay lots of money for, so that’s my excuse. I would advise someone to try this cream, as it works and feels great on my skin. I am only giving it 4 stars because of the price. The product itself is 5 star!.

I really wanted to love this, but I just couldn’t get past the first two days. This product broke my skin almost immediately. I have extremely sensitive skin that is also dry, and a Sephora staff member recommended this. I would not recommend it to anyone with similar skin as myself. I returned it for a refund.

Absolutely amazing moisturizer. I am currently using a sample of this and it’s the most hydrating moisturizer I’ve ever used without feeling super sticky, too thick, or shiny. This cream absorbs quickly but lives your skin feeling soft, nourished, and it locks in the moisture!

Tried the sample. My forehead is now awash in bumpiness, which has never been my issue. Thank goodness for the other reviewer who indicated her sensitive skin’s reaction. My skin is sensitive, but? I’ve tried and used lots of products on it successfully. Alas.

For $90.00, this should have worked better. The gal who sold me in it said it was THE BEST product for dark spots...WRONG! Not only did it not work, I ran out in a little over a month! I used 1 pump each time, so it’s not like I was using to much. It also doesn’t have an spf in it. I took the pump apart to see if I could scrape anymore out (you don’t know your low until it’s gone because there’s no way to see inside), and the actual part that contains the moisturizer is much smaller than packaging! The outside is very deceiving! Bottom line, if your gonna spend $90 on a moisturizer, don’t buy this one!

I tried a sample of this simply because I had run out of my Clinique moisterizer and I didn’t baby time to get some more. Within three days my skin was glowing. I didn’t have any blemishes, my oily skin somewhat repaired itsslelf, and my skin was flawless. This is truly a miracle in a bottle. It’s worth the price I promise you!

I had been searching for an anti aging cream that I could fall in love with. This is it. I use it morning an evening under the KS line release serum. Together they are dynamite. I just turned 50,and my skin is good. No major issues. Believe me this cream is worth the investment. I’m a fan for life!. Thank you KS, your products rock my socks!

I just recently entered the high-end skin care world and did a lot pf research regarding ingredients before doing so. This moisturizer has a great list of beneficial ingredients and did wonders for my tired, pale, stressed skin, although I should note that I also used a serum, most recently Quench also by KS, and I expect that helped as well. My one issue with this cream is that it has a lot of fruit extracts and fragrant oils in it, and I am concerned about putting so many of such things on my face, but they don’t seem to bother my skin. In fact, I recently tried something else that did not have those ingredients and while it is okay, it is not nearly as moisturizing, so I will probably go right back to Age Arrest.I also should mention that I love the packaging. The pump slows degradation of the product and provides portion control. One pump is plenty.

This is a wonderful product. I ran out and got a sample of this cream after reading about it on a beauty blog. After using it for 3 days, i knew I couldn’t go without it and purchased it. I mix this with three drops of the Nude Skincare Progenius oil morning and night and my skin has never been happier.
The best! I’ve tried a lot and keep coming back to this product. Heavier than her other daily moisturizers.

I bought this following an in-store demonstration. I should have stuck with my instincts that this was not maybe the best “moisturizer“ for me when the rep said they suggest not just 1 serum before application but 2, so a pre-serum then a serum. Seriously. Within 24 hrs I could tell I felt dryer than usual and within 48 my forehead was flakey, a problem I hadn’t for 25 years. Then to make matters worse it caused mild breakouts in my chin and nose area. I used the product for only two days and two weeks later things are just settling down.
review_title: Not for sensitive or naturally dry skin

review_text: I tried it for a few days but the ingredients caused redness. I have fair, sensitive skin. I will continue using their regular daily moisturizer though.

I have been using this cream for about a year now and I absolutely love it! I am in my 30s, and about a year ago I started noticing that my skin was becoming more dehydrated, tired looking and I was developing fine lines. No matter what moisturizers I tried nothing seemed to help. So I headed to sephora and picked this up after one of the staff members recommended it. I truly feel like this has made a huge difference in my skin! I am sensitive/acne/combo and this cream has not irritated my face. It has just made my skin look more youthful, soft and smooth. I apply a thin layer all over my face and neck and I found that a little goes a long way. (I will use less or more depending on how my skin is acting that day but I usually never use more than 1/2 - 3/4 of a pump.) I highly recommend this cream for anyone starting to see the signs of aging, it will definitely take a few years off of your skin :)
I love the way my face feels after using this, plus makeup goes on great just a few minutes later. It has also helped my daughter who is a type 1 diabetic and has very sensitive, dry skin.

this product is lightweight and feels nice. however, i didn’t notice a difference in my skin at all. when i read the ingredients, it contained lavender extract, which can cause irritation on sensitive skin. for this price, i’ll stick to one without the irritants

I have sensitive skin and tend to react to some of Kate’s products, as well as a litany of others. I sampled this and was surprised to discover it does not react with my skin. Most importantly, it really works! I noticed an immediate improvement in texture and fullness that seems to have persisted. I use it as a moisturizer at night after cleansing and with a serum. Nights when I don’t use it I definitely notice a difference the next morning. Highly recommended,

This cream has a great feel and light scent and works well for me. I’ve noticed how easily and smoothly my make-up goes on and how pretty my skin looks since using it. I have light skin, combinations-type skin. No breakouts at all. I love it!
They product goes on sooo smoothly and there is a lot of product in the container. Your skin feels more soft right away and brightens up after a week. Great!

Totally inlove with this cream! I have super sensitive skin and unfortunately many creams dry out my skin or irritate it but not this one.... It instantly hydrated and softened my skin and absolutely NO burning like most products that I’ve tried and believe me I have tried them all! It left my face with the most beautiful glow and looks absolutely flawless under my foundation... Took care of my dry patches making applying makeup enjoyable again. Feels so wonderful on my skin.... Truly my hg I will never be without! Thank you for making such a fabulous cream!!!

What an awful disappointed this cream is. I bought it believing that their statement “this product is clinically tested to be safe for sensitive skin“ was actually true. This product caused nasty breakouts around my chin and jaw area. It has been over 2 weeks since I stopped using the cream and the breakouts have not yet fully cleared. Do not waste your money if you have sensitive skin!
Not heavy . Luv itNo wrinkles and prevents them I use the face cream and apply to my neck and the eye cream as well

Since I have only been using this product for the past 2 weeks, I really can only speak to 1 aspect of what the product is supposed to do. This Age Arrest Anti-Wrinkle Cream is extremely hydrating. It makes my skin soft and supple. With some other creams, I get this greasy sheen on my face, but this product absorbs well (but not necessarily quickly - give it 5 minutes) and hydrates enough to noticeably reduce the amount of oil production on my face. (When my oily/combination skin is dry, it overproduces oil.) It has an interesting scent, not unpleasant, but one that you get used to. Not the typical floral scent of some other high-end lines. Aside from hydration and decreased oil production, I noticed that I had less breakouts. I typically get the occasional clogged pore a couple times a month and hormonal acne on my chin. My skin had an even tone as well. The product is dispensed in this squeeze canister that I prefer to a jar where I have to scoop out what I use daily. I use maybe 3/4 of a pump on my face. I guess we’ll see about the Age Arrest Anti-Wrinkle part of the cream!
Complete an utter waste of money, One of the worst anti aging creams i have ever used. It is pure junk. it made my skin so lifeless, gray , dull and just horrid....DON’T BUY.

I’ve been using this cream for about 2 months now and I can honestly say it works. I bought this to prevent the natural aging process. Having just turned 30, I’d like to keep a youthful appearance lol. I use this after washing my face along with the moisture serum. It absorbs quickly despite being heavy. It leaves my face instantly soft and radiant. I also apply it on my neck, and it is here where I have seen interesting results. Before using this the skin on my neck felt goose-bumpy and sort of raised, if that makes any sense. But now, it is smooth when I touch it. I was pretty amazed. My face looks and feels just as smooth too. I will buy this again when I finish it.

I have been using this along with the age arrest eye cream for over a month abc do am very impressed... I have very sensitive skin and was a bit hesitant Because some of her other products were too intense for me, but this has done wonders! My face feels softer and tighter and it works amazing underneath my makeup, also I don’t think it works well as preventative skin care.... I don’t think it wouldn’t work well on younger skin!! Love love love this stuff!
I have a habit of trying different moisturizers every month because Im never satisfied but this one is a keeper looks like I found the one

I went into Sephora to find a makeup foundation. After cleansing my face the Sephora makeup artist applied Kate Somervile Age Arrest Cream. This cream is so luxurious, light weight and moisturising. The flakey dry areas of my face disappeared imediately and my skin glowed. I love this product. I have tried many face creams over the years with so so results. Age Arrest is a keeper. The pump on the jar keeps the product clean, fresh and free of contamination.
Thick and creamy. Not greasy. Absorbs and leaves my skin feeling great!! Defiantly will keep using this product.

Excellent crème. Très peu parfumée. J’utilise cette crème depuis 2 mois et je suis très satisfaite. Cette crème est dispendieuse mais je vais en racheter.

I’ve been using Age Arrest for about a month, morning and evening. From the moment I opened it, I’ve loved the scent. The push dispenser/top is pretty cool too. Immediately I noticed how soft and moisturized my skin was. I got this cream in the middle of January, so my skin was not happy, but this changed all that. I didn’t notice an immediate difference with my wrinkles, but after about 3 weeks I did. Now, this isn’t botox (or what I would imagine botox to be), but it does the trick for me right now! I will buy this product again!

I was talked into buying it by the rep along with a few other things. I returned those but kept this one. It’s actually really good and I’m noticing a difference in my complexion when I apply my make-up. My skin looks really good, glowing, and smaller pores. (I have medium pores, oily skin, and spend way too much on finding good products.). The exfolikate was really good too but I have so many similar products for less price point.

I was convinced into buying this cream by a sales associate at a Sephora store and it was horrible. I bought it on Thursday afternoon, used it that night and the following morning and 24 hours later my skin was peeling off my face! I had been told it was for sensitive skin and I could even apply it around my eyes! Good thing I didn’t listen!To top it off, when I went to return it two days later, a different sales associate spoke down to me as if was my fault for buying a cream that wasn’t meant for “young skin.“ I couldn’t even believe it!

I’ve been going to the KS clinic before Kate even had a product line and the results there are amazing!!! That said, I’ve always been very selective about purchasing KS products because I find other brands to be more effective for my skin. Other than Age Arrest, I use the KS Detox Cleanser and Clearing Mask. I have combo/ very oily T zone which is hormonally triggered. I found Age Arrest to be too heavy for my skin after about a week so discovering that it works around my eyes has been wonderful. I have been using this cream for almost 4 weeks now and I can say I’ve seen a remarkable improvement in hydration and crepiness under my eyes. I find that the less expensive more natural products that I prefer just don’t cut it for me in the eye area, so I was thrilled to start using this just around the eyes! I use half a pump and dot it around my eyes: including the brow bone area, corners and underneath. My boyfriend had never seen crystal rollers before and was delighted at the prospect of getting a rub with one but he was also saddened that only one roller head can be used at once. BTW I’m not sure what the difference is between the three heads other than color. The Mohs hardness of quartz is 7 and so is amethyst! Jade is between 6 and 7 hardness. So for those who claim they feel different, well, they really aren’t. They’re literally all the same hardness. So it’s just an aesthetic thing I guess? Anyway, after some CAD modeling work, we came up with a self-tapping, 3-ball, ergo holder so that all 3 balls can be used simultaneously for an epic back massage! I attached photos of what these look like all mounted together. The handle was 3D printed on my Prusa FDM printer using Taulman Bridge nylon. Added bonus, the nylon handle can be dyed so I’m debating what color to make it... though I kind of like the all white natural nylon look with the rose quartz, amethyst, and jade balls! It should also be noted that some of my crystals weren’t completely spherical. One was even slightly flat on one side. I use this primarily for back massages so it’s actually not too noticeable, but just be aware of variation in their manufacturing process. I plan to upload my handle CAD file to Thingiverse or other model sites as an open source file if anyone else has a printer and wants to make it!! :)

Most of the people here seem familiar with retinol and have made everything clear but I just want to clarify a few things and offer a few tips. 1) this is one of the best otc retinol products I’ve seen and most of the negative reviews are due to retinol itself, not this specific product. 2) don’t think that bc you don’t have sensitive skin, you can jump right into retinol np. 3) don’t let that scare you off as retinol is the best anti aging product we have to date. Just keep a few things in mind: To start, go very low and slow. The ordinary has some great products to start slowly, with small amounts, clean ingredients and great prices. Start with .2% retinol in squalene, then when you are comfortable with that, start using .5% retinol in squalene. (Studies show that this is a sufficient dosage to treat photoaging etc so no need to even go higher if you’re nervous or uncomfortable..but if you like you can then move up to 1% retinol in squalene and so on.) Now all this will certainly help and prevent the most drastic of the side effects, but make no mistake...if your retinol is working, your skin will get dry, even flaky and it will absolutely be photosensitive. To counteract these symptoms as much as you can there are a few things to remember; Obviously, use a high spf during the days and apply moisturizer before and after your retinol at first, (preferably one with HA) for additional help, try also try applying hydrocortisone and aloe. (I LOVE Loli’s blueberry and aloe moisturizer for this & for an addition pro, they’re an environmentally friendly and socially conscientious co.) Also, skip all exfoliants and acids, particularly for the first month or two, and use a very gentle cleanser. If you feel your skin is simply too sensitive or you don’t want to deal with becoming accustomed to it, but would still like some of the effects, try hpr instead, which shouldn’t irritate your skin. The ordinary’s granactive retinoid 2% in squalene is a good place to start.

If you want to save our oceans, don’t buy this product or ANY product that contains squalene. If it is plant-based squalene it is okay. But if they do not specify it, it is most likely from sharks. Extracting squalene from sharks is very violent and even illegal in some countries and states. If you buy products that contain squalene, you are contributing to the shark fin trade and shark cruelty. There are 100 million sharks killed each year, and if we keep using products like this, there won’t be many sharks left to kill. Furthermore, do you want to rub shark liver oil on your face??? I purchased this item 10/16 as a small birthday gift to myself.  I figured I spent enough on skincare, why not bite the bullet and get the brand I’ve keep seeing all over.  It took some convincing as I’ve been a diehard P50 1970 toner user for years.  It’s the perfect set to get to know the brand.  I haven’t used the sheet mask yet- but the treatment lotion along with the essence has done wonders to my skin in the 3 weeks of daily use.  I have combination skin, with my jaw and chin area as my problem areas (thanks PCOS) and my breakouts come and go. I can have clear skin for months with nary a whitehead on sight, to overnight cystic, painful bumps under my chin and jaw.  I purchased this set while dealing with some under the chin bumps.  I can usually get rid of them- but it takes time.  I used this set the very first evening after double cleansing.  I used the treatment lotion on my Shiseido cotton squares and wipe it around the face.  After 3-5 minutes I had the SK-ll with my hands and gently pat it into my skin.  These two products alone have helped my old pigmentation and old scares become noticeably lighter.  My breakouts are less intense and seem to heal within days rather than weeks.  And call me crazy, but the age spots around my eyes have gotten lighter as well.  Overall I’m thrilled with the products.  So much so I the Treatment lotion full price before the VIB sale- and for $76 it seems like a very reasonable investment into my skin.If you are thinking about trying to see what all the hype is all about, I would definitely recommend this set.  The treatment lotion is small, but it packed enough punch to get me to buy the big bottle, the essence will last you a while as I use it 2x a day and haven’t even put a dent in it.
review_title: Great set to try the brand

review_text: This is a great value set. This value set is the same price as the facial essence treatment alone. With this you get to try the clearing lotion and the sheet mask. I have been using the Essenes treatment for sometime now but wanted to try the clearing lotion and the sheet mask. The sheet mask i was glad I got to try in this set and didn’t have to pay 6. The sheet mask was underwhelming but again glad I tried it. It was hydrating but there are other moisturizing sheet masks and masks in general out there that are more moisturizing for much cheaper. But I’m very glad I got to try the clearing lotion. This will become a staple in my skincare routine forsure. I do not use the clearing lotion or the essence as a toner or treatment. It says to apply with a cotton pad as you would with a toner. But I use both with a serum dropper. So I use my regular toner, and then in the am I use the clearing lotion after toning and before cream. And in the pm I use the essence with a serum dropper and again after toning and before cream. These two products have completely changed my skin. My texture on my cheeks are gone, I barley get any breakouts now. My pores have decreased in size. My skin has a healthy glow to it. My skin heals faster. And the major change has to be my blackheads on my nose have finally disappeared ! I have been struggling with tones of blackheads on my nose for years. And this combo is the only thing that seems to keep them at bay and clear them up. Highly recommend for all skin types !

There aren’t many products that I can say actually work and make a visible difference in my skin, but this is one of them. Just like your gut has a microbiome, so does your skin, and this stuff somehow makes skin a bit smoother, a bit clearer, and a lot happier.  Will anyone mistake me for a 30 year old?  Absolutely not... but it does make my fine lines plumper, and gives me a nice glow and it evens me out. This kit comes with one mask, a big bottle of the essence, and a smaller bottle of the clear lotion. Note: Its core ingredient to these products is “Pitera“ which is an extract made from fermented rice wine yeast, so surprise surprise: these products smell like fermented yeasty stuff. The smell is not strong at all (not to me, anyway), but if you huff the bottle, well then yeah, you’re gonna be able to smell it. They haven’t added any fragrance to cover it up at all, which I appreciate. Once on your skin, the smell dissipates in 2-3 seconds anyway. You won’t smell like it, I promise. I’m so glad I forgot to return this, because otherwise I never would have tried it.

AB is the only skincare I will use on my face. If the price scares you, the ingredients in other skincare brands should scare you more. First, AB uses ECOCERT/COSMOS certified glass. The fact is that even the purest skincare products can fall victim to chemicals leached from plastic containers, meaning that not only the skincare product, but harmful chemicals such as Biphisenol A are applied directly to the skin. I’ll gladly pay more for glass. Second, AB uses safe and clean ingredients. Go ahead and download the Yuka app, pay the $8/year so you can search for products, then search for this serum. After applying it, the skin becomes like silk.  Indeed, the skin after the serum became smooth, toned, the complexion became fresh and healthy.  Expression lines are noticeably smaller. The serum has an amazing effect on the skin.

Love AB products even though they are so expensive! Overall this product is a 5/5 but this price?!…Is a 1/5 lol. This product does exactly what  it says; targets dehydration, dryness and visibly firms. I’ve been using this product 3-4x a week for about a month and it’s been lovely!  My skin feels soooo bouncy, supple, and soft. It almost looks like I have a filter on; let me also add that i use exfoliants but this product has elevated my skincare routine. And will more than likely close my eyes and make that purchase when the time comes because I feel like it has completed my routine!

I didn’t have any breakouts when I used this product and when applied to the back of my ears and neck, it didn’t feel greasy or oily. review_text: I consider myself a green lifestyle enthusiast, and am very strict about what I put on my skin! I have a blog dedicated to just that, and everything I use is made with clean and organic ingredients. This sunscreen definitely fits the bill! This is the first Coola product that I have tried, and I had the perfect opportunity to test it out at a Mineral Hot Springs Spa in New Mexico that was at 7,000 FT in 80 degree weather. I am VERY fair, and burn easily. The first time I went to this hot springs, I burned so badly I looked like a lobster. Not this time!! Thanks to Coola’s Sport Continuous Spray SPF 50, I didn’t burn AT ALL. That may be a first! I was in the sun continuously for about 3 hours, also slathered myself in mud clay, rinsed that off, and was back in the water without reapplying once and STILL didn’t burn. I’m serious when I say that this is a first for me! I also appreciate that it is unscented, because many sunscreens can have offensive scents. I applied the sunscreen an hour before getting in the waters, which by the way was very easy due to it being a spray, and was on my way! It dries quickly, and the cap swivels into a lock position so it won’t ghost spray in your bag! It’s also convenient for travel (I was traveling from CA to NM), as it is TSA approved at 3 oz. Awesome, right?! The only reason I am giving it 4 stars and not 5, is mainly because it’s a little pricey, but also because I almost slipped on the floor after applying it...so just be mindful of your surroundings when applying it! Otherwise, this sunscreen is awesome...I definitely recommend it, and will be purchasing it in the future. Way to go Coola! Thanks for preventing me from becoming a lobster again, AND making your products with green and organic ingredients.

review_text: Although I have very sensitive skin, I also have problems with large pores, oily skin and clogging. So I decide to purchase a PMD Microderm kit to solve the problem. “Microderm” sounds very professional, however, basically, PMD Microderm is an exfoliator. By the spinning disc, it exfoliates the skin, remove dead cells and boost the absorption of serum.In the package, besides the PMD Microderm, it comes with a power adapter, 2 caps, one starter discs and 12 general discs.Using experienceBefore using it, I read instruction thoroughly. The effect of PMD Microderm is much stronger than normal cleanser exfoliates, so it is important to know all notes.According to the instruction, I used the Microderm on my forearm to test if there is any anaphylactic reaction. After confirm that it is safe to my skin, I used the starter kit on my face. Starter kit is the least powerful of all discs. (compared with other discs, starter kit is more like a practice disc.) So I did not feel uncomfortable during using. I exfoliated my face in about 10 minutes. After using it, I applied serum and daily routine as usual.At the second time, I used sensitive skin disc. This is powerful than starter disc. During using, the machined stayed on my cheek a little longer than suggested time and caused a red mark. Unlike starter kit, this time I saw white chips on my face. I think that’s my dead cells. This time I can skilled operate the PMD Microderm. So it only takes me less than 5 minutes to clean my whole face. Generally, I use scrub and cleaning mask to exfoliate face at least twice a week, every time cost 20 minutes. Now, 5minutes per week is enough.Now, I have used it for more than 4 times. I do find that my skin is a little smoother than before. Moreover, now my skin absorbs skin care product faster than before. Because I don’t have wrinkle and fine lines, so I don’t weather it can improve these problems.summaryAfter 4 times using, I am very satisfying with PMD Microderm. It has many advantages. First, it is a professional exfoliator. It can deep clean your skin but will not cause any anaphylactic reaction. Second, it saves a lot of time than traditional exfoliator. Third, it boosts the absorption of skin care products.I do find the disadvantage of PMD Microderm. When it is operating, the sound is too loud. However, considering the good result, I can mind the noises.Although PMD Microderm is designed for aged skin and problem skin, I do recommend this product to all people who want to exfoliate efficiently. Deep clean is important for all ages.

review_text: So my first box was defective as many others. The powder was brown, dried up and clumpy. As others posted pictures of, it simply wouldn’t mix. I tried chopping up the powder beforehand for another batch, but it gave the same results. Turned into a brown/green clumpy mess unable to spread on my face. I returned it and luckily got a good batch on the 2nd box. Tips for this product - you have to work fast! The 1st time I used it, I spent too much time trying to smooth and even everything out. By the time I made it to my forehead, the remaining mask had turned clumpy and I was unable to spread it. I had no issues peeling it off though, even with it being uneven. So just focus on getting it on your face as quickly as possible (less than 5 minutes.) Results? Gorgeous, super smooth and perfectly soft skin. As soon as you peel it off your skin looks and feels amazing! Although this is def an awesome product, I don’t think I’d purchase again. Between the quality control issues and having to work so quickly, I don’t feel it’d be worth it. Recently had to return another Dr. Gross product due to horrendous smell (and I’m not one who is usually bothered by smell.) I love and use several of his products, but sadly this brand quality is slipping.

How I did it: step 1 Josie Maran exfoliating oil wash step two clay mask step 3 Dr. Denese serum Grand Finale this mask. I am an at-home mask girl and HydraFacial girl.  I have been on the hunt for my at-home masks and have finally found the one!  I also go get professional HydraFacials done and see instant results..dark circles gone, plumped up skin, lines filled out, dark circles gone and instant, lasting hydration.  This mask is an at home hydrafacial!  I swear.  I use it on my husband also and the results are so similar to my real HydraFacial...of course without the extractions and stuff.This mask drives whatever product you are using deep into your skin and infuses it.  I was lucky enough to get an in-store treatment and the Dennis Gross rep instructed me and gave me some tips on the best way to use it.  I’ve already done it at home and it’s the business!I am 30 and have pretty good skin.  I have some dark circles and blackheads on my nose are my biggest concern.  I’m dry in the winter and in the summer, my t-zone gets a little oily.  Sometimes I break out but infrequently.  I use masks and products on my face as preventative maintenance, to keep my skin hydrated and to smooth out any fine lines.  I already use the Dennis Gross Original Strength Peel Pads and love them.  The rep advised to exfoliate first, use the peel pads, then put on your favorite serum, eye treatment and lip treatment.  Then mix up the mask, put it on and you can even cover your lips so they can get in on the fun.  Once you remove the mask, do a spritz with your fav mist and moisturize with your regular cream/oil/etc.  The results are awesome. I really can feel the actual product hydrating my skin for like 12 hours afterwards.  My skin is plump, bright, super hydrated and glowing.  I even felt so good, I went out without any makeup on and just the aftermath of the mask. A few suggestions. 1. Be sure to use one pack **JUST** for your face. If you wanna do your neck and hands, that’s a whole separate mask.  If you use the whole packet on your face and layer it well, the mask will come off in one go.  If you get some pieces here or there, it comes right off with a little water on a cotton ball. 2. For sure use a serum before masking and moisturizer after.  It makes a huge difference. 3. It’s totally gentle and can be left on for longer. I do 20-30 minutes at a time. This mask has a cooling effect, like menthol on your skin.  It’s super relaxing.  If you’re looking for deep hydration and glowing skin, give it a shot.  And for 4 treatments for $45, it’s totally reasonable. Happy Masking!
It’s a great mask! Delivers deep hydration and beautiful plump skin. Worth the money

review_text: I love this facial roller. I’ve used it for over a month now and would recommend it. The quartz is beautiful quality and stays lovely and cool. I finish up using the larger end again for my neck and decolletage.I read a lot of reviews of all the facial rollers at Sephora before selecting this one (thank you beautiful community!) and from the design I can see how a slight defect can cause major problems. Mine doesn’t squeak when slowly and gently rolling my face but does when I do faster longer strokes on my neck and chest. I use it as a reminder to go slower (as part of a night time wind down routine any nudge to go slower is helpful!) if it was to squeak all the time, and it sounds like some of them do, it would definitely limit my enjoyment of using it. Mine also doesn’t have black marks where the metal touches the quartz and the metal is well placed and structurally sound.I desired a roller for its beauty and relaxing properties as well as to indulge myself in a little self love every evening. This roller adds a touch of luxury to my evening routine and a moment of calm to relax my face before bed

review_text: Okay so I’m going to be brutally honest here. Whether you love this oil or hate it, the ingredient list does not justify this price. Period. And guess how much it costs for a good bottle of 100% organic cold-pressed rosehip seed oil? A few dollars. I have to call this out because the rosehip seed oil and its retinoic properties is the highlighted, or “star“ ingredient in this product. But what really ruins this product is the sheer amount of essential oils they added to it for fragrance. You literally should not be putting essential oils on your face at this high of a concentration. Essential oils belong in my diffuser, not on my face. Fragrance, regardless of whether synthetic or essential oil, poses a risk of causing skin sensitivity with prolonged use.If the concept of this product interests you, then I highly recommend just going out and getting a bottle of organic cold-pressed rosehip seed oil. It’s very inexpensive, and is actually much better for your skin health than using this ridiculously overpriced perfume oil on your face. Check the ingredients list -- that’s because there’re Mica (actually a quite decent amount of it) and Titanium Dioxide in the product, and they “paint“ your face brighter. If you have some CEGEP level chemistry knowledge, you probably know that, Mica is what they add to your eyeshadows to creat the peralecent look; while Titanium Oxide is the solid white paint that gives your physical suncereen the dull white look on your face. I’ll say that’s kind of cheating as a skincare product -- most of the ingredients doesn’t work on your cells at all, and the brightening effect is easily washed off.
