And I agree with a previous reviewer who’s suspicious of what on earth could be in this product to produce such a smell, and how on earth it could be considered safe for your skin.
review_title: If patchouli and Gran’s perfume had a love child…

review_text: I absolutely love the moon juice line. What really drew me in was the aesthetic. And then I researched and really wanted to try the products. As somebody who is pretty minimalistic… I felt like this would last a long time and it actually has. I ordered the entire line last Christmas 2021 and it has lasted me until now February 2022. A little goes a long way. Here’s the thing, those who are saying they dislike to send… You really have to consider what “type” of person you are… what I mean is, if you’re someone who doesn’t like earthy patchouli-ish scents, skip this! I believe this company targets the more boho girl with its aesthetic, ingredients, and scent. It’s def not going to be for everyone for sure, but not all products are. I can’t stand any floral scents in any skincare… even if it’s great… so I get it, but be warned. Haha if you like earthy stuff… you’ll love this line. I think the products are really nice and they feel good on my skin. I haven’t had any issues and keeps my skin looking fresh. I don’t wear makeup outside if lip color (Noto is sooooo good btw) and a good mascara….. that’s pretty much it. So if you’re like me and super earthy, vegan… boho type. You need to try this stuff! Thanks and love you!

I received a sample of this product with my last order and I cannot wait to buy the full size. I have always struggled with SUPER dry skin and after putting this cream on, my skin just glows. I’ve tried so many moisturizers and never found one that left my skin feeling this soft and hydrated without being oily. It also smells like chamomile or lavender which feels relaxing. 10/10 recommend.

I’m happy I didn’t actually pay for this and got a sample. I would not buy. The smell is not peasant and my husband doesn’t want to smell me  lol I’d prefer no scent at all. My skin does feel amazing but the smell is something I can’t get passed.
review_title: A sample was all I needed

review_text: The smell is horrible…. Like a old perfume or something.

I just used a sample packet of this and OH MY… WHAT ON EARTH IS THAT SMELL!? Aftershave mixed with burning tires? Smells AWFUL. My partner even asked what was going on! For reference, I enjoy natural “earthy” scents, essential oils, cannabis and unisex cologne type smells. This is nauseating and I can’t get it out of my nose even after washing. Some other reviewers said they loved it somehow… so *smell BEFORE buying*

It’s funny that all the negative reviews for this product are based on the smell, because if you can get past that this is one of the best moisturizers for dry skin on the market. I was using the YYTP adaptogen moisture cream but it’s consistency wasn’t thick enough for my skin, especially in the winter time. This cream has ashawagandha in it along with multiple molecular weights of hyaluronic acid, and the texture is AMAZING. Most other moisturizers are either too watery or, if they are thick contain silicones; this one provides a luxurious texture that’s also super nourishing without any of that. It makes my skin look dewy and gives it a healthy glow. I personally don’t mind the smell, but If you’re concerned about that absolutely try and buy it in store so you can judge for yourself if the smell will be too much for you. I’ve not had any problems with breakouts or irritation while using this but I wouldn’t recommend this for oily skin. In all this cream is one of my absolute favorites and I would highly recommend to anyone with dry skin who wants something thick that doesn’t just sit in top of your skin.
The cream itself is decent but I can’t get past the smell. It’s so awful to me.

Love this product!!! Tried it as a sample and noticed how ultra moisturizing it was and a great all day performer especially on days I do a more glowy cream based makeup face. The earthy scent is amazing and honestly it’s partly why I purchased it - instant mood lifter! I’m guessing there’s a bit of patchouli (?) among other subtle natural light scents, very spa like. Also.. I do have oily/combo skin and have used this without any issues. Will buy again and also be trying other products from the same line :)

I REALLY want to give this five stars! However, like many of the others, the smell was less than desirable. I got this as a sample, and when I first applied it, it felt like I was applying butter cream icing to my face! It was absolutely amazing! I’m 44 and have started to develop fine lines around my lips. I’m not ready to admit I’m aging, but from the smell of this cream, I had no choice but to take a step back in to my 80 year old aunt’s house. Wowzers! I headed over here to buy the real deal, and had to leave a review to let everyone else know how amazing this stuff is.
Good moisturizer but wish it came in a pump or easier way to apply then a pot

I got a sample and fell in love with it. It hyrdates so well and keeps my skin soft for a long time. I’m shocked to see all the hate on the smell! I absolutely love it. I tend to stay away from scented skincare products, but this one is very natural and herbal.

Since I made the switch to a natural skincare routine, i’ve really struggled to find a staple moisturizer... until I discovered Moon Juice. Their Cosmic Cream has been AMAZING! Within two weeks of using this cream I found that my face was completely moisturized, plumped, and happy. Nearly everything breaks me out (including Khiels and Burts Bees etc) and this cream has never given me any acne. Another major plus is that a little goes a longgg way. I use under a dime size amount every night, and my face stays moisturized all throughout the next day. Considering that I have extremely dry skin, I am shocked at how little I can use and still feel extremely moisturized. I’m seeing a lot of complaints about the smell, but I personally love it. I don’t want my natural skin products to smell perfumed or to be unscented, and I find the smell to be deliciously earthy and calming. If you have dry, sensitive skin this product is for you.
I received a sample of this cream.  The scent is AWFUL!  It made me gag when I opened the package.  It feels nice on my skin, but I can’t get past the terrible smell.

Received a sample, so I cannot attest to that long-term effects, it felt great on my skin and looked nice under my makeup…but the smell is atrocious!  These things are subjective, and benefits would almost have to be a miracle like to me for it to outweigh how bad the smell is and it even lingered on my foundation brush the next day so I had to wash it immediately as opposed doing my daily wipe down and wash at the end of the week… it couldn’t wait!
I hate to give negative feedback but I received a sample of this cream and the SMELL is really really strong and not at all in any way a good smell. It actually made me feel nauseous to be honest.

Small amounts last a long way. Not a strong scent, and applied easily. No notable changes were noted as I received this as a sample but did not make my skin worse or irritated. It was a nice sample to try but would not pay this much for a product normally.

I originally got Cosmic Cream as sample. The texture is thick and creamy. Melts into the skin easily making your skin feel very soft and smooth instantly! I have a combination skin hence pretty oily in T-zone areas. Still I didnt feel my skin getting oily after applying the cream, felt moisturised. If you apply at night in morning you will specially notice how soft and plump skin feels. The cream definitely has a certain scent to it, but after few tries I got used to it. Hence I ordered the full size cream, Very excited!!

This, my first review. So I was impressed initially with how well it just melted into my skin. There was no sticky residue noted. My skin is sensitive and dry and I noticed no redness, itching or reaction after application. My skin retained the moisture level well into the next morning. I don’t recall the fragrance but maybe the single sample was too small to notice. I am ordering some before the summer heat sets in here.
review_title: Great moisturizer for aging skin needs

review_text: Great product! Smells like you’re walking into a crystal shop that has the essential oils and incense going, which I love! The performance of this moisturizer is outstanding, and does it’s job to plump and bring even more youthfulness to the skinny. Deep thought went into the ingredients of this product. Happy, happy customer! Received the tiny, complimentary sample packet with my order, so now I’m spending money again to buy the full size.

I had to wash my face again just 5 minutes after applying because the smell is like the inside of an woodsy Abercrombie + Fitch store. Even after washing it off, the scent lingers. Never touching it again.
review_title: Truly the worst smelling moisturizer ever

review_text: I guess it’s personal preference, because I LOVE the scent. It truly makes me feel pampered. I requested a sample of this product with one of my orders and wound up immediately purchasing the full-sized product. It makes my skin feel incredibly soft and moisturized and I have sensitive skin, so the fact that it didn’t act up while using this was also a mega bonus. I shall be back for more. :)
review_title: Silky smooth and LOVE the scent

review_text: Love the smell. Makes me feel like I just got a facial. Got a sample and had to buy the full size. My skin feels so smooth and ultra moisturised. This is going to be one of my faves.

I got this in a small sample with my last Sephora delivery and I really love this moisturizer. It goes on very cream and has a slightly thicker consistency but once it absorbs, it feels like your skin got a very tall drink of water. After the first application, my skin stayed feeling totally hydrated for the rest of the day. In the morning, my skin was noticeably firmer and fine lines were plumper. It does have a strong sweeter smell (if you have a sensitive nose, probably not for you), but I don’t think it’s as awful as some people think. For me, the pros outweigh the smell. Will give it a few more days to see how it goes through the week, otherwise, I might have found my new nighttime moisturizer!
amazing feel very good cream awful smell , smells like petroleum stinks everything , the facemask your boyfriend your pillow , so sad

Tried a sample of this and totally loved the texture of the cream and was surprised by the moisture it brought to my skin. The scent is really raw and organic (not for everyone). It’s sort of green raw ingredients scent which I actually prefer over an artificial one. Leaves skin plump and moisturized. Although it’s a thick cream, it was not heavy when applied and my skim absorbed it really well. It was not sticky either. I used this before bed so I don’t know how well it works with makeup. Will buy in future.

The scent is STRONG, like a mix of citrus and toilet cleanser. I could’ve tolerated that, but this cream made all my other skincare pill up underneath and create a heavy film in spots. I rotate a ton of different moisturizers over that same skincare routine and have never had this happen! It initially feels almost balmy and melts into almost an oil, so a little goes a very long way, but despite the oily feel, my skin became drier the longer I used it, and eventually started to feel rough and dehydrated. It never dries down, so wearing makeup over it didn’t work well at all. Lastly, keep it FAR away from the eye area, especially if used at night ...if it migrates into the eye, it STINGS. I wanted to love this so much, but I just couldn’t. For reference, I have dry/mature skin.
The smell is beyond terrible. There are so many better options out there. This brand should have just chosen unscented and it would have been much better.

This cream produces the absolute best result I’ve ever seen on my 38 year old skin. It has a terrible scent - like a health food meets new age store - but I don’t care because it erases the last ten hard years when my skin turned papery with fine lines and craters, and just so much texture. Cosmic Cream sets in a satin finish, just a hint of natural sheen - like children’s skin with that pearlescent quality. It’s like it’s dried down into a makeup primer. It plumps all the crepe and fine lines into what my skin looked like at 31 years old when I still passed for 23 years old. Do you catch my drift? It’s possibly going to make you look noticeably years younger. Really natural, velvety baby skin.   Something akin to the blur filter, not matte nor shiny. Yes, for real, the smell is just ... why. It’s astonishing, so just strap in now and brace for impact. But whatever crap is in this (glycerin?) just works for my particular skin (which is fair, just starting to show age). It boasts of being clean which hasn’t been super important to me historically but makes me feel better about how much I get into my eyes. It doesn’t bug them. It’s so hard to describe but it just feels ... witchcrafty, like it was made in a kitchen by your hot witch friend.For comparison, I’ve been using a combo of Dr Jart Ceramidin, Kiehl’s midnight recovery oil and Lancôme primer to get even close to this in texture improvement. I’m excited that this gives me a better result than combining layers of three other products. I feel like I can breath for a minute that I’m not shriveling into middle age right this second. Maybe I’m one middle part away from passing as Gen Z.I would never pick up this product of my own volition but the sample rocked my world. I’m not sure I want y’all knowing it but the smell is really polarizing. If you’re young I don’t know if you’ll see anything as dramatic as later thirties, but you’ll have goddess skin.

I got this as a sample with another order and am RUNNING to buy the full size version. I love how dewy this moisturizer makes my skin feel. And I *love* the smell. The first night I put it on I kept telling my family to smell my face bc I loved it so much!
SMELLS LIKE HEMP OR WEED TO ME, don’t mind at all and love my smooth and elastic skin after. Stays moisturized all day on days when I don’t wear makeup and just need an amazing moisturizer

Had to order a full size after using the sample one night.  I’ve never used a moisturizer that literally makes the fine lines on my neck look plumped up and less visible.  This does.   Makes my skin feel like I just had a facial.  The smell is different...natural, and definitely a little unusual.  But I appreciate that it isn’t perfumey, and don’t notice it either way after a few minutes.  Makes my skin feel firmer somehow as well!
I received a sample and I love it! The smell is pleasant, I agree with other reviewers about the smell being familiar to other great creams. I am definitely buying the larger container

Idk why people are so dramatic about the smell, it just smells like Aveda products and it’s not THAT strong. I got a sample of this and I’m buying the large size. It is absolutely my favorite moisturizer I have ever used!! I had PRP with microneedling done 6 days ago and my skin was super dry until I used this product. I also woke up glowing after putting it on before bed. I used it under the Laura Mercier tinted moisturizer and it was a beautiful, radiant primer. I love that this product is clean and does not cause combo skin to break out! Love love love! Can’t wait to try their other products.

I was so excited to get a few samples of this cream. It smells like cheap, expired teenage boy cologne. I wanted to leave it on long enough at least to see how it felt, but I couldn’t stand it long enough, my eyes were watering and I couldn’t stop sneezing after a few minutes. Just sad. I have no idea how this made into production. It’s so bad, I actually no longer want to try anything else from the company, they lost my trust.

I literally just put this on and started laughing when I smelled the product. This review is basically just for the smell alone because so many are focused on that. If you’ve ever used Aveda products,  it smells just like Aveda products. If you’re not sure about buying this because of all of the reviews about how this smells like a cleaning product, but you know you like how Aveda stuff smells, the scent won’t bother you.

I came to read the reviews because I figured everyone would love this cream as much as I do.  I was surprised to see all the negative reviews.  I got the sample and came here to find the full size product since it is awesome!!  It absorbs beautifully into my skin and makes it feel moisturized, plumped, and healthy.  The smell is different but NOTHING like Lysol like some reviewers stated.  It smells earthy for sure but is not overpowering and fades over time.  The way this makes my skin look and feel far outweigh the “bad“ scent.  I honestly don’t mind it at all.  Will be buying the full product once my sample is finished.  :)
My skin felt great after one application with the free sample, but I wouldn’t pay $60 for this. Agree with others, you’ll smell potently like a mushroom, which wasn’t for me.

I currently have dehydrated, uneven skin tone and I was looking for something to hydrate it. I chose a sample of this cream at a checkout as the ingredients intrigued me. This product is amazing. It immediately decreased my redness, my skin was more supple, less pore visibility and less lines, and my overall tone looked more even. I love the texture of this cream and it doesn’t even have any acrylics in it (yes acrylics add that nice texture but are harmful to skin). And the scent is just lovely!!!! If you are someone who prefers synthetic fragrance in a product then this is not for you. However, if you have been on the clean beauty wagon for some time like me, you will enjoy it so much !!!!! I also use their potion exfoliator and both products used together are phenomenal!!! Highly recommend!
It smells like toilet cleaner. I nearly gagged and had to wash it off my face. I can’t comment on the skincare benefits as the smell was so atrocious I could barely stand it.

I’m reviewing the free sample. I would not buy the full size. This stuff smells so bad I had to wash it off my face and I can still smell it. It smells like Lysol cleaner and it’s very strong.It also wouldn’t rub into my skin. I was just swiping it back-and-forth across my cheek without any absorption. After about 30 seconds, I decided to wash it off because of how awful it smelled.
The smell was so awful I had to wash it off immediately. Please save your money!!!

I was excited to use this moisturizer and applied it straight from my shower. The scent was overwhelming for me and lingered throughout the day and night. I would not use again. I have oily skin and I felt like it sort of sit on top of my skin.
I got it as a Sample and so far it makes my skin really soft an the smell is different but not bad. I would buy full size.

Before I read the reviews I said it smells like weird incense and musty subway station then I saw them and realized I’m not the only one who thinks that. In addition, it initially goes on like the Sunday Riley Peptide cream but after a few minutes it feels like greasy sunscreen and I have dry skin. God I would give it a -100 / 10 if I could.
review_title: Only buy if you have no sense of smell...

review_text: I got this as a sample with an order, so I can’t say anything about the long-term results of this. But I can tell you that I felt compelled to write this review solely because of how awful this smells. Another review said it smelled like a dorm room. It reminds me of the stores at the less crowded end of the mall that sells incense and the sweaters that look like Mexican blankets. It is so strong. I understand I am likely more sensitive to smell than others, but this is just not what I want my skincare to smell like.

This made my face feel super oily after using :/ got a sample and was stoked because of all the great reviews but my skin just did not like this. Had a few breakouts after using it too. (I have very sensitive skin)

love this! Such a hydrating moisturizer. I have normal to dry skin and on those days when I’m feeling a bit dehydrated, I love layering this over their plump jelly. I always wake up with juicy, glowy skin. The scent is mild in opinion and I LOVE it. As a skincare hoarder, I recommend!

I love this cream. I do understand that the smell can be totally divisive, but I personally really like it. It smells herby and earthy, and while I don’t think it is a really strong scent, it does linger. As for the cream itself, I find it to be really hydrating without being greasy. I live in Arizona and so having a good moisturizer is a must! I have sensitive skin and this didn’t irritate my skin. My skin looks so nice after even just 10 days of use. It looks plumper, more radiant, and the tone looks more even. This is on the pricier side of what I normally would pay, and I’m normally over zealous with applying products, but truly a little of this goes a long way. I see this lasting me at least 4-5 months.
I received a sample of this product and was not a fan after one use.  It has a lingering scent and pilled once I applied it on top of other products.

Amazing,  visible difference in one night. Nice soft smell.  I was hesitant to purchase this due to reviews complaining about the strong smell as I get migraines from odors like incense and am really sensitive to smells but this has a very mild soft scent.I am so pleased with the results of the Magic Potion and Moon juice supplements, I decided to give the Cosmic Cream a try.. I am amazed at the results after only one night of use!  I was happy with my It Cosmetics lotions but this product did what no other cream has achieved!  My skin is sensitive and reactive but Moon Juice products have improved the over all tone, decreased sun damage discoloration,  minimized pores, and most significantly decreased the fine lines on my upper lip that started to appear since I turned 45.  I woke up this morning -  immediately looked at the lines on my upper lip and was shocked at the decrease, one line has almost disappeared! Cosmic cream will be a life long purchase,  sorry It Cosmetics but Moon Juice products are now my every thing! Hopefully,  the deep lines on my forehead will also diminish with daily use, but the Amazing results so far are making the price worth it! It doesn’t take alot of this cream to cover entire face as long as you softly spread it.
review_title: This cream work like Magic to decrease fine lines.

review_text: The fragrance reminds me of Aveda hair products- earthy and organic. I was skeptical at first but decided to wait to until I used it for a couple of weeks. It is not a luxe cream as it is thinner. I’m old and I DID see results on my crepe neck. Seriously wasn’t expecting this so I’m a fan. I began the collagen powder supplement since I see results. I’m a fan and I did NOT get this free or was given a sample. I paid for it at full price.

Been looking for a nighttime cream and wanted to try this. The other reviewers aren’t lying, the scent took me aback at first, it’s not disgusting but it’s also not pleasant and doesn’t smell like “typical” skincare. I’ve tried to love this but wow, it has left my skin with a rough texture day after day of use, I thought it was my serum but it’s this cream. Feels nice upon application but the moisture doesn’t absorb well and ends up pulling and then leaves my skin rough and with a couple of those red itchy bumpies. I’ll be returning this if possible, I’ve been holding onto it due to the virus but I refuse to use it. If you’re spending this much on moisturizer do yourself a favor and get the biossance or the drunk elephant protini. I would not recommend to anyone with sensitive skin.
review_title: Rough Texture After Use/Not For Sensitive Skin

review_text: This moisturizer is lovely but the scent is WAY too strong.  It lingers on the skin too...
review_title: Smell it before you buy it!

review_text: The fragrance is way too much - not just because it’s unpleasant and smells like a incense-filled dorm room, but because it’s telling me that there are a ton of potentially irritating botanicals inside. I don’t know where we got the idea that these were good for our skin; but when they are as concentrated as they must be to smell this strongly (or in essential oils, etc), it’s just causing your skin to be stressed and fatigued and will actually accelerate, not halt, aging. Also, when I washed my face the next morning, it felt very slimy, as if none of the product had absorbed. It didn’t cause a breakout or make my skin much worse after only one use, but I also highly doubt that it does what it claims.

This cream is an excellent night cream and post exfoliation/mask moisturizer. Maybe it is because we are approaching warmer weather and more humidity, but I do not like this as a daytime moisturizer during these warmer months as it feels too heavy. I could see this being an excellent moisturizer during the winter time.
Love how this makes my skin feel, it’s rich but lightweight and it works just like their plumping jelly serum and it’s amazing, I highly recommend

I just finished my first jar and I’m definitely reordering. It makes my skin look and feel like I just had a facial. It’s not too heavy or too light. I like to add a drop of oil to it when my skin is on the dryer side.
I love the way this feels on my skin and the scent it’s lovely! It absorbs really well too.

I’ve been using their Plumping Serum for about 18 months and their Dream Dust for about 2 years and this is another superb product from Moon Juice. Yes, the moisturizer definitely has a scent but even if it’s a little on the heavy side, how good my skin feels after I apply this more than outweighs the smell (which dissipates after a short while post-application). It settles in really nicely after the Plumping Serum. Love it
review_title: Another amazing product from Moon Juice

review_text: I put a very small amount on wet skin and after about 5 minutes my skin feels velvety and smooth. This is how I recommend you apply it before makeup application.  The smell is very natural, and even though I have extremely sensitive skin the fragrance didn’t bother me at all!!! In fact my skin is less itchy, and significantly less red than usual

I have way too many moisturizers in my cabinet and this is no question my new go to.  I love how clean it is but more than that I love that is so moisturizing and seems to melt into my skin.  I can layer over anything and it absorbs quickly!  My new fave!!!!!

I applied this over a thin layer of Estée Lauder Night Repair Serum.  I applied this, normal amount not heavy, and it pilled like crazy.  Does not feel very moisturizing.  The smell is natural but very strong.  Definitely not for me.  Will be returning
Love this great product ! Bought it today and couldn’t wait to try it , my skin felt silky smooth and clean . Love gentle smell and love love the clean product! I am definitely moon juice fan
This is such a great value, even for exfolikate alone. The only thing that truly removes all the dead skin!
product_name: Glow In A Wink ExfoliKate Bestsellers Set

review_text: I’ve been looking for something to treat hyperpigmentation and bumps on my forehead. Ever since 35 I’ve dealt with skin issues I’ve never had before. These sizes were perfect to sample for 30 days to get a sense of whether it would work for my face. Within a week I could tell my skin was smoother and brighter. It has a clean scent and rinses clear despite the substantial suds. There was a very very mild burning sensation with each product, but it wasn’t painful or uncomfortable, just noticeable. If you have sensitive skin it might be problematic for you. Will be purchasing the full sized bottles of these products.
product_name: Glow In A Wink ExfoliKate Bestsellers Set

review_text: This set is such a great value for three amazing products if you love a good chemical exfoliation. I got it during the one-day deal for $54 and couldn’t be happier given that the exfolicate gel itself is almost double the price. This set is actually worth $129 rather than the marketed $119! Get it if you wanna try out her products or you already know you love any of these products.
product_name: Glow In A Wink ExfoliKate Bestsellers Set

review_text: Definitely a great price for the quality of the products! The exfoliating gel is amazing, my skin is as smooth as baby skin. I use the gel twice a week, and I will be using it for the rest of my life. It does not over-dry my skin, and it helps with my acne as well.
product_name: Glow In A Wink ExfoliKate Bestsellers Set

review_text: Chemical exfoliation is my fav to gently exfoliate my skin. Kate Somerville’s glow in a wink kit (gifted by Kate Somerville) has a gentle daily foaming cleanser with a mix of chemical exfoliants; this is my go-to PM cleanser. the exfoliating treatments have lactic acid and glycolic acid with other plant-based exfoliants. I wish it was made fragrance-free being facial treatments.
product_name: Glow In A Wink ExfoliKate Bestsellers Set

review_text: The Exfolikate Cleanser suds up nicely. It made my face feel fresh and clean. It has a slight, citrusy scent. I’d liken it to fruit loops. It didn’t react with my skin. It has a light feel to it. I think I’d have no problem sensitivity-wise to use it twice a day. I rather enjoyed the Exfolikate Intensive Exfoliating Treatment. It feels like it has microbeads in it. It is a green color. I did notice a slight tingling while it’s on, but that goes away. The scent is glorious. It’s kind of a cinnamon scent. Very nice. I plan to use this several times a week, as recommended. At night I used the Liquid Exfolikate Triple Acid Resurfacing Treatment. It can also be used as toner. It made my skin feel tight and clean. I’d recommend all three of these products, individually, or as a set! gifted by Kate Somerville
product_name: Glow In A Wink ExfoliKate Bestsellers Set

review_text: Gifted by Kate Somerville for my honest review. I am seriously loving this kit! I love when brands put together kits like these so you are able to try the products out before committing to the full sizes. This kit is made to improve the appearance of pores and to do reveal glowing skin! I am seriously blown away by how great my skin is looking since starting this kit. I have always struggled with big pores, but I can tell a huge difference in them! Just a warning though, your skin may tingle when using these products but that’s how I know they are working! Make sure to read the instructions thoroughly especially if you have sensitive skin.
product_name: Glow In A Wink ExfoliKate Bestsellers Set

review_text: This was gifted by Kate Somerville.  I’m loving these. I love sets. They are all a really good size and will give plenty of uses. My favorite product out of this set is definitely the mask. It’s so quick and easy to use and it doesn’t take much product at all. It does sting and is uncomfortable but once you wash it off after a minute it stops. My skin has been so clear and even and I’ve only used it twice. My breakouts are gone and so are most of my blackheads. The pores on/next to my nose are barely noticeable and my skin is smooth. My skin is dry and I haven’t noticed any extra dryness or irritation from this.
product_name: Glow In A Wink ExfoliKate Bestsellers Set

review_text: Gifted by Kate Somerville in exchange for my honest review. My niece and I have been using this kit and we are both enjoying it. My skin concerns are uneven skin tone and her concerns are skin texture. I have a few blemish spots on my chin and I have definitely seen some improvement. review_text: I’m definitely guilty of stocking up on concealers and highlighters to brighten up my dark circles and puffy under eye area that comes with having a stressful job with long hours on the computer. When I was initially sent the Augustinus Bader eye cream with TFC8 to test fro my honest review, I was highly skeptical that it could do everything it claimed, but I was open to giving it a fair try. Right off the bat, the packaging was gorgeous. A sleek gold bullet-shaped serum pump was nestled inside a cobalt blue and gold outer casing. It looks beautiful on my sink, but I have since moved the serum into my skincare fridge because I prefer the serum to be cooking when I apply it before bed and in the morning. After a week, I started to notice firmer skin under my eyes, but I was still using my go-to concealer. After 2 weeks, I noticed brighter skin under my eyes. It was like I finally had a good night’s sleep! Now, after using this product for a month, I’ve hardly had to reach for my trusty concealer or highlighter because my skin is GLOWING! Look, I’m not excited about the luxury price tag, but for what I was wasting in additional products, it’s worth every penny to be able to have my natural skin look plump, firm, and healthy! As someone else mentioned, I recommend storing this in the fridge for a cooling touch when applying. I also use silicone under eye strips (from Dieux) to help the serum soak in, but I don’t think that’s totally necessary. One pump should be enough to split between both of your under eye areas, which really helps to stretch the life of this product. It’s hard to tell exactly how much I have left after a month, but even Incorporating it into my morning and evening routines, I’m not worried about running out anytime soon because it seems to last a long time. Once this is back in stock, run to grab yours!!

review_text: Upon receiving this set, I was pumped (no pun intended) to see if this would help soothe the chronic dryness I’ve experienced since switching to a strong retinoid.The set claims to improve skin barrier function within an hour, which may sound like a lofty claim but if the set is occlusive enough, then that should be exactly the results. Occlusive properties lock in water, which is a struggle for dry skin to retain.My summary: yes, I did feel happy with the results BUT in my opinion, it was the cream that did the heavy lifting! Here’s my thoughts on the full routine:The cleanser was fine. I expected a bit more of a gentle cleanse with the use of the word “oil” in the name, but tbh it felt like any other cleanser to me personally. My sensitive dry skin likes the gentlest of the gentlest, and this missed the mark for me.The serum is fine. It has a bit more of a light moisturizer consistency. I wish the mini was a bit bigger as I’d like to see if I get more from the plant ingredients; but if the main player really is hyaluronic acid, then I do feel this serum has a whole lotta competition.I like the eye cream a bit more than I expected. It feels light to apply but does feel soothing. Might make a nice daily driver day eye cream.Which brings me to the final step, the cream. WELP, I was utterly blown away by this product. review_text: I got this as a free samplemy favorite product was the moisturizer. it smelled absolutely divine, it was citrusy and fresh Snelling. it also did a great job moisturizing my skin while not being to heavy. it is a thick formula so I was a little bit nervous but it went on light.the cleanser was good, it left my skin clean and smooth.I’m not sure if I would purchase this entire set, but I would purchase the moisturizer.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: This little kit is perfect for going away. I really love the citrus scent of each of the products, makes me feel my skin is refreshed. The micro-peel leaves my face super soft without irritation. The only reason I did not give 5 stars is because the makeup melt balm was not the best around my eyes (I have very sensitive eyes) but for foundation it works really well.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I’ve been using my set for about two weeks now. I am a big fan on the cleansing balm and the citrus mask. They smell great and leave my skin feeling clean and hydrated. The only product I’m not huge on is the exfoliator as I don’t feel like it does much. In all, it’s a good little set to have on hand.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I wore my makeup for 10 hours one day and was left pretty much how we all look after so much time in makeup and with a mask on… crusty, patchy, and oily. I used the Citrus Clean Balm & Make-Up Met to remove my makeup by massaging the product into my dry face, and then I washed it off with warm water. I felt like it removed my makeup quite well and left my face feeling soft without stripping it. As per instructions, the Lemon-Aid Detox & Glow Micro-Peel came next, so I applied it like a mask, massaged it to peel it, and then rinsed it off. I felt like my face looked brighter after one use, so I continued using it several times a week as suggested and I love how clean my skin feels. I finalized the routine by using the Citrus-C Mask & Daily Moisturizer, and I absolutely low how moisturized my skin feels without being too heavy. I am going to continue using these but as it stands now, I’d consider purchasing these again, and if I continue to enjoy them the way I do, I’m going to start recommending it to family and friends!
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I like this set- I received it for free for testing purposes. There’s nothing wrong with it but also nothing too special about it. The peel and moisturizer smell decently good and although I personally dislike all makeup remover balms, I can’t deny it did the job taking everything off. Overall I’d use this as stuff on the go or for travel purposes but I don’t think I’d use it regularly nor would I repurchase.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: This trio is simply great! The size makes it very easy to transport, amazing for when you’re spending the night away from home. The makeup remover balm is very smooth and efficient, a little really goes a long way. The moisturizer and mask leave your skin feel fresh and smooth and smelling amazing! plus the packaging is simply the cutest and the pouch is waterproof so you can leave it in the bathroom with no worry at all! I 100% would recommend it
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I have mixed feelings about this set. The cleansing balm smelled great but was hard to use and very waxy feeling. I found it difficult to warm up enough to spread on my skin and work with so it was not effective at removing makeup. I felt like I was irritating my skin trying to make it work and spread. The micro peel I liked as it was a very fine grit that was gentle enough for my sensitive skin. I felt like it worked really well to remove dead skin and left my face feeling soft without irritation. The Vitamin C moisturizer I liked as well from the set. It was moisturizing enough to use on it’s own and left my face feeling really smooth and soft. Overall, I would pack this set on my next trip as my regular skincare routine has too many liquids to properly carry with me and not have some spillage. I feel like I could make do with this set as an alternative to my regular routine.
review_title: Would be a good travel companion
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: This product made my skin so soft and smooth. My skin was bumpy, uneven and patchy. After using this product my skin was smooth and bright. I use this product nightly. Everything I use this product my face glows. I feel so refreshed after using it. I can’t stop touching my face.
review_title: My skin felt smooth like butter.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I really like this set for travel. I found all products moisturizing and good for dry skin. The size is quite generous and you get a very fair amount of product. There is a light scent which is really nice. Overall I think this is a great set for travel. Super convenient and recommended for dry, sensitive skin!
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: Overall I feel as though these do a really good job when it comes to hydration. Very lightly scented which is nice. The moisturizer isn’t greasy so it can be used right before primer which is really nice. I love make up removing balms and this one doesn’t disappoint. My only negative comment is i felt as thought you don’t get a lot of product, once you open it and squeeze out the product, you realize half of it is air. Overall good quality product and would recommend, especially to have as a travel skin care kit.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: Bestctrio especially for the price!My favorite product was the makeup remover, one of the best to date I’ve used and the smells were the perfect scent.Great for my sensitive skin
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I have really mixed feelings about this set. The balm was nice in that it removed makeup well, but since I’ve never used a cleanser balm better (normally use my Foreo luna with a liquid/foam cleanser), it took a bit of work to massage the balm in. The peel was decent in exfoliating my skin, but it pilled quite a bit during the process and was messier compared to other exfoliators and scrubs. The moisturizer was my least favourite. The moisturizer is really thick in consistency, to the point that I found it tacky and greasy, even for my dry skin. All 3 products have a nice scent. Although I do prefer all my products to have a milder scent or be scent-free. I honestly don’t see myself purchasing this kit or any of the products separately as they don’t positively stand out against the current skincare products I currently use.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: My usual combination skin became predominantly dry after my recent pregnancy and the cold winter. Aside from my night moisture mask, this has since become my staple. Found the cleanser to be ultra hydrating, and the moisturizer to be just thick enough to not need a serum underneath. The mask is a nice extra but the other two products were my game changers
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I’ve got mixed feelings about this kit, whileI think it’d be a good starter or travelkit - wouldn’t be my “go-to”. It comes with 3 products. The cleansing balm is okay for light makeup but for a solid cleanse, not the best option and a rather thick consistency which makes it hard to squeeze out. The detox peel I liked the smell but  once again, the consistency of it - not a fan and but would say does “brighten” your skin after user. The moisturizer is the only product I would consider purchasing again, a little goes a long way and keeps skin hydrated.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: As far as skincare goes, these are decent products. I quite enjoyed the cleansing balm, it was gentle yet effective. It would be better if it was in a different package as it is quite difficult to squeeze such a thick product out of a tube. The peel is just okay, it does leave your skin smooth and soft, but there are better products out there. I did like the moisturizer a fair amount, but if you have oily skin lie me this is more of a night time moisturizer as you will be a bit shiny in the day. One more thing to note is that these products are quite heavily scented, especially the cleansing balm. So if fragrance is not your thing, maybe skip these guys. Overall they are just decent products.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: This is the perfect travel kit. The make-up melt is great, it removed my waterproof mascara easily, did not irritate my eyes and felt silky smooth on my skin. It completely wiped off my layers of face makeup as well.  Only a dab was needed. For once, I did not have to double cleanse!The micro-peel is refreshing, it smells great and it gives the skin a great detox, I love this product.Lastly, the daily mosturizer is good, but it is the only product I am not as much of a fan of. It is VERY moisturizing, maybe a little too much for my skin, or perhaps I just need to use less product. It smells nice and really hydrates well.When travelling, this is a great kit to use! Practical packaging, fresh scents and great products.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: Love this gentle trio set, they’re gentle on my skin yet effective.  My skin looks more radiant and feels smooth to the touch. I’ve seen the difference in my skin’s texture and I love the scent.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: When I review skincare products, I like to use the same brand throughout the steps to truly test if the brand works for my skin. I like that this set comes with three different face product and how it is light in texture and its citrus scent. The Lemon-Aid Detox & Glow Micro Peel is a wonderful deep pore cleanser, exfoliate and skin brightener. It gently removes dead skin and impurities, leaving you with clean and glowing skin. The product is gently and doesn’t have any abrasive beads or whatnot so the skin is left soft and supple.The Citrus Clean Balm & Makeup melt. It massaged nicely on the skin to melt away even the most stubborn makeup. I like that there was no oily residue left and didn’t leave my skin feeling tight.The Citrus-C Mask & Daily moisturizer is very hydrating and doesn’t leave a greasy film. I have acne-prone skin and I’m happy that this hasn’t broken me out. The tubes are the perfect travel-size essentials and the clear bag make this kit perfect to bring along on a trip!
review_title: 3 steps to cleansed and hydrated skin!
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: This 3 piece set is amazing! First off all 3 pieces have a very fresh, citrusy scent that I love. You start with the Citrus Clean Balm and Make-up melt. It effectively cleansed my skin removing all traces of makeup including stubborn eye makeup. There was no residue left after rinsing and all traces of the balm and makeup rinsed away easily. My skin was left feeling cleansed, hydrated and really soft. It was not tight or dry and and appeared brightened. Step 2 is the Lemon-Aid Detox & Glow Micro Peel. This is great as a deep pore cleanser, exfoliate and skin brightener. It gently removes dead skin and impurities leaving you with clean glowing skin. The product is not harsh at all so I did not experience any reactions or redness from using this. Step 3 is the Citrus-C Mask & Daily moisturizer. I have been using this during the winter months and it’s amazing. Super hydrating and gives my skin an instant glow. During the winter I usually have to double up with moisturizer applications or add a serum as my skin gets extra dry and itchy. I have not had to do that with this. It has worked wonders for me and I’ve had zero issue with clogged pores or breakouts while using this.
review_title: Absolute must for clean and glowing skin!
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I’ve been using the trio for about a week and I really enjoy the balm and micro-peel. The balm removes all of my makeup very effectively and the peel leaves my skin feeling smooth and fresh. I especially love that the peel feels gentle enough for daily use. The moisturizer also does its job well and has kept my skin hydrated during the current dry winter climate.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I liked this set, but the moisturizer/mask is super heavy. Not appropriate for daytime but amazing for night. I liked the peel and makeup melt a lot though. I would definitely buy the melt at least again. The moisturizer should be categorized as just a mask/night mask type item. Love that NUDESTIX is doing skincare now!!
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I was sent this in exchange for my honest review. First impressions the packaging is very cute and perfect for a to go or travel kit. They all have very nice scents and each one being different makes for a fun experience. Let’s start with the cleanser, this was probably my favourite in this kit because a little bit goes a very long way and works at getting my foundation and eye makeup off. Now for the micro peel, I wasn’t a huge fan of this because it doesn’t apply super nicely, it pills a lot and isn’t very smooth, I wouldn’t say it properly exfoliates skin either, more so just a little mask and peel effect. Now for the moisturizer, it isn’t very thick so it’s nice if you want a light barrier during the day time but I wouldn’t suggest it if you have highly dry skin. Pretty basic moisturizer. As for the kit I love the ideas however it’s nothing extra special. Pretty sub par.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: This is the first time I’ve ever tried skincare from Nudestix! The travel bag this set comes with is super adorable and sturdy. I would say there’s about 6-10 decent sized uses per product and the first thing I noticed was the sweet and fresh scent of the products. First the Citrus Clean Balm & Makeup Melt, I felt like I had to use slightly more product than a normal balm/melt because it wasn’t as slick and oily but it still took my makeup off effectively! The Lemon-Aid Detox & Glow Micro-Peel did leave my skin feeling smoother but I really disliked the fake pilling effect to simulate ’dead skin’ being removed from the face. I just find it to be a gimmick and the product felt effective without that feature. Lastly, the Citrus-C Mask & Daily Moisturizer was nice but nothing special. The scent is a bit too strong while applying to the face, especially for anyone with sensitivity to fragrance but it does dissipate after a while and the product soaked into my skin fairly quickly and it felt soft for the rest of the night. It’s a cute set but I don’t think I’ll be purchasing it any time soon.
review_title: Cute travel set but no holy grails here!
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I really like this product. First, the packaging is the cutest and perfect for travels. All tree smell amazing  and feel great on the skin. The balm is a little bit hard but once it melt, it’s good. I use all of them after my shower and I had great results !
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

The moisturizer has a light scent but slightly too heavy for me.

review_text: I loved the citrus clean balm - even though it comes out solid, it melts so quickly in your hands and does a great job removing makeup. The best product in this trio though is definitely the lemon-aid detox & glow micro peel. It’s super effective but not harsh on the skin at all. I would definitely purchase the micro peel again!
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I’ve been using these products for a little over a week now and I love the make up melt gently takes off make up. I use a waterproof eyeliner that I usually have to use a cleanser twice to get it off but I found I only need a tiny bit of this product to remove it. I’m not sure how much dead skin the micro peel is actually taking off as it seems like the solution balls up before it’s even applied to the face but my skin does feel smooth after using it. I also loved the moisturizer. I worked great under make up during the day. The moisturizer doesn’t feel heavy and it gives skin a nice finish that isn’t shiny. I would recommend these products for anyone with fry or combination skin. Not sure if I would purchase the micro peel on its own.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I got sent this product as a demo and I have to say I’m fairly impressed the cleansing balm is better than the inkey lists’s oat balm and doesn’t leave my skin feeling like it’s got a layer of product on it. It took off every speck of makeup - and I did a full face just to try it! The exfoliating scrub is wonderful! If it’s truly my dead skin that it’s rubbing off than I am embarrassed! It left my skin feeling fresh and smooth. The only thing of the trio i’m not sold on is the moisture mask - there are better ones out there IMO. Over all, trio left my acne prone and dry skin happy and smooth, though the citrusy sent was a bit chemically for my tastes and the packaging doesn’t look as sleek as other products on my counter.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I received this trio from BzzAgent to review. First, the packaging was cute, and perfectly sized for travel to-go kit. Second, I love the makeup melt. I’ve previously used another brand and this works exactly the same and is easier on the pocket. The balm helps to melt even stubborn makeup off (I use hudabeauty eye liner) which was probably the highlight for me, as sometimes micellar water can be pale in comparison. The citrus moisturizer was nice; I did notice my skin get more brighter and cleaner but it does have a thick consistency from my skin. So while it worked to an extent, I didn’t like that it felt like I had moisturizer on (if you know what I mean).The peel was my least favourite product; I used it once and it felt too tingly and made me feel uncomfortable. I get very nervous about reactions so I will skip using this because of the sensation.Overall I loved the set and I would purchase the balm and moisturizer in the future!
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I received this set for free in exchange for my honest review. Overall, The set is cute but I feel like it didn’t do anything for my skin.The set came in an adorable reusable pouch that made me very excited to use the products. I will be using the pouch in my every day life.Now, the products! The Citrus Clean Balm & Makeup Melt got my concealer off my skin nicely, but it couldn’t handle my waterproof mascara. I wouldn’t recommend this makeup remover if you wear waterproof products.The Citrus-C Mask & Daily Moisturizer went on my skin well and it absorbed right in. It temporarily reduced the look of my dry skin, but it didn’t help in the long run. I also feel it wasn’t heavy enough to be considered a mask. There are better moisturizers and masks out there.The Lemon-Aid Detox & Glow Micro-Peel is a good product to use if you want a quick exfoliation, but I wouldn’t say it did much. It made my skin smooth right after using, but I don’t feel it had any lasting affect on my skin.Overall, these products look and smell really nice, but they were underwhelming.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: Citrus Clean Balm & Make Up Melt - seeing as these products are made in Korea, this cleansing balm reminds me a lot of some other Korean makeup cleansing balms. The texture is thick, and a little goes a long way. I find adding a little bit of water to it helps remove makeup very well (even though it does not say to add water in the instructions). The cleansing balm also has a slight fragrance to it - which is nice, as it is not too overwhelming, it has a bit of a “bitter“ smell/undertone to it and it didn’t bother me, and trust me, I have a very sensitive nose and I don’t typically like fragrance in my products at all.  Overall, it does what it should, and I am pretty happy with the results as it removed my 24-hour eye makeup during the first try. Lemon-Aid Detox & Glow Micro-Peel - I found it started peeling before I started even rubbing it into my skin, I’m not sure if it did much exfoliation (or I just have smooth skin and no rough patches to see the results...). As for the scent, it is very mild, which I like. However, again, like the previous item, it has a slight “bitter“ smell and undertone to it. Overall, I can’t say this did much for my skin, personally. Lastly, the Citrus-C Mask & Daily Moisturizer, the first thing that stood out to me was the scent. Now, by no means is it a strong scent. Like the rest of the kit, the scent is very mild and not strong at all (and I don’t mind it), but the turmeric may throw some people off at first, as it does have the most “bitter“ undertone to it which could be off-putting to some people. I enjoyed this as a moisturizer as it goes on nice and absorbs quickly enough with no greasy feeling. I had also used this as an overnight mask and found it did keep my skin moisturized and my skin felt super soft in the morning. Overall, for me, it was just okay, it wasn’t amazing. FINAL VERDICT: I think this set is just okay. In my opinion, there are plenty of vegan-friendly travel sets at a much lower cost.
review_title: Not bad, but other alternatives available
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I was gifted this in exchange for a review - and was SO excited to try it! Citrus Clean balm - I don’t prefer makeup “melt“ products but this was a decent one. The moisturizer I will be purchasing.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I received this product from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I was so excited to try some mini skincare products as I’m always on the hunt for new skincare! I love that these products are cruelty-free, recyclable and free of harsh chemicals. My skin is sensitive, combination and these products all were fine on my skin. I feel with continued use the beautiful citrusy scents of them all may cause slight irritation though. The face cream was really nice, lightweight yet hydrating for my dehydrated skin. The peel I wasn’t a big fan of as it left little pieces of product which were annoying to remove; but my skin felt amazingly soft and looked brighter after use! I’m not a big fan of cleansing balms But this took off several layers of heavy mascara. I can’t speak in regards to heavier makeup looks and full coverage foundations. The smell of all these products are amazing, especially the face cream. I really enjoyed the products and will continue to use them. Thanks Nudestix & BzzAgent for the opportunity!
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I was gifted this set in exchange for my honest review. As someone who loves the NUDESTIX line of makeup, I had really high hopes that this new skincare collection would perform just as well. Unfortunately all 3 products left me terribly disappointed (and one in particular has me raging). Let me break it down:Citrus-C Mask & Daily Moisturizer – while this product smells lovely and has a great creamy consistency, I did not find it particularly moisturizing. I have very dry skin, and it just felt like a heavy layer of balm that sat on the skin. I don’t mind it as a primer base for my foundation, but there’s other products that serve this purpose & perform much better. Citrus Clean Balm & Makeup Melt – Cleansing balms are one of my favourite formulations when it comes to removing makeup, so again I had high hopes for this one. While this does the job, the pain it causes it absolutely not worth it. It is very heavily scented & the citrus ingredients immediately stung my eyes as I attempted to remove my eye makeup. Lemon-Aid Detox & Glow Micro-Peel – This product is just downright deceptive. It claims to peel off dead skin with its exfoliating powers, but this is not the case at all. The product itself has texture, and when manipulated with your fingers it will ‘ball up’, leading the user to think it’s a dead skin being sloughed off. I know this to be true, as I tried it on a particularly dry and flaky patch of skin and it did not even come close to scrubbing it off. The only thing this product has going for it is the fragrance.At least the pouch will get to be reused, but otherwise I’d recommend you skip this lineup entirely.
review_title: NUDESTIX Should Have Stuck To Makeup...
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: I really like the moisturizer and and the peel. I found they were both effective in their marketing and did exactly what it said it would do. The makeup balm wasn’t as good. I found I had to use another remover after because it didn’t take it all off.
product_name: NUDESKIN 3-Step: Citrus Renew Set For Makeup

review_text: This is the first time I am trying products from Nudestix. I love how this is a three-step set that covers cleaning, exfoliating and moisturizing. These three products smell amazing and have my favorite citrus scent in them. The make-up remover really blends into the skin and takes off the foundation and eye makeup. I love how the exfoliator makes a difference in my skin. I feel that my skin texture is smoother after every use. The moisturizer pulls everything back together and gives my face a perfect hydrated feel without being too heavy. These three samples are large enough to bring with you on trips! I would definitely purchase this again and recommend it to my friends and family.

review_text: Love the cute bag that this 3-pc comes in, can definitely re-purpose it and use as a small makeup bag when travelling. My favourite of the 3 products would be the moisturizer. review_text: I am a huge fan of Nudestix makeup so I was super excited to learn they were coming out with skincare products, but unfortunately this set missed the mark for me. I didn’t notice any major positive changes in my skin after using these products for over a week. Overall this is a decent kit if you’re looking for something that won’t break you out and gets the job done but I think there are better kits out there.

review_text: The Night-Glow Mist is my first Isle of Paradise product purchase, despite being curious about the line for years. Love this product and concept! I woke up with soft, glowy skin.
Waste of money my acne has gotten worse since I’ve been using this product￼

I was kindly given this from a friend who found it too rich/greasy, and after sampling La Mer’s Matte Lotion in the past, which was good but not hydrating enough, I wanted to see if this delivered the right amount of moisture for my oily-dehydrated skin type. The moisturizer comes in simple but attractive packaging, as with most of La Mer’s products, and features a pump dispenser - perfect for protecting the ingredients. The cream consistency itself is quite thick, and it says the best way to apply it is to pat some gently onto cleansed skin, so I usually do this morning and night. In all honesty, I found it much more moisturizing than their Matte Lotion, however, I too have felt my face to be noticeably greasier by the end of the day, which from an expensive moisturizer, is not ideal. I was hoping this would be a middle ground between the Matte and the Crème itself, but this definitely veers more towards the richness of the Crème. I also tried using it just on a night but still found it too heavy and that it still doesn’t seem to sink in. On the plus side, it has brightened my skin and given it a radiant glow which wasn’t there before. As with all Crème De La Mer products, the cream features the key ingredient Miracle Broth: a mixture of sea kelp, vitamins, and minerals, and probably in part responsible for the hefty price tag. However, if it cannot control my oily areas and only add to my skin woes then I would not be repurchasing this.~ My Sephora Top 7 must-have list ~(My top 7 must-have beauty products of all time, focusing mainly on my purchases at Sephora)1. I was super happy with this product! I have combination skin and found it worked well with that type! It was light weight and absorbed fast, I hate it feeling oily on my skin. I felt hydrated all day and my skin looked super healthy!

I enjoyed this product very much. It had a nice scent but was not very strong. The application was also easy and it did leave my skin feeling moisturized and hydrated. Overall I do recommend this product.

Amazing lotion I have ever tried so far. This has a pleasant fragrance which does not irritate my skin. Gives my skin a glowing and shiny finish and leaves it soft instantly. My skin loves this lotion.

This La mer moisturizer is very hydrating and not to thick or thin. My only problem is that it is highly fragranced. I am usually not affected by scented products but this one is a bit overpowering for me.

review_text: My skin drastically improved since adding this to my morning routine. I use a very heavy moisturizer and serums in the evenings so I like that this is on the lighter side. La Mer is my favorite skincare line.  It’s my HG!  I can’t tell you how excited I was that Sephora was finally carrying it.  I’ve been using the line for 20 years.  When I started using it, there was one place you could buy it & the ladies at the department store would snicker & whisper whenever I was in buying it.  Finally, someone spoke up & asked me what I was doing buying La Mer products, since it was for “old people“ & I was 24... I told them that:A. It was Hollywood’s best kept secret (living in LA)B. I wanted to start early, so when I got “old“ it wouldn’t show.. Well, fast forward 20 years & EVERY TIME I order a glass of wine or a margarita, I get carded!  I got ID’d this week buying Sudafed.  Where are those ladies now?  I really want to find them. lol!As far as the La Mer “The Moisturizing Soft Lotion“ it’s my go-to, every morning after I wash my face & use my serum & I put it on.  Never fails.  It’s got the scent of the original Creme de la Mer, (natural beachy scent), it’s so smooth & hydrating.  It gives me an instant glow!  I remember once that my cleaning lady asked why my face was always so “glowy“ in the morning.. The soft lotion is the answer.  If you have oily skin, I think this would be really heavy first thing in the morning &/or underneath makeup.  But, dry-normal will benefit.  The cream itself gives your skin a translucent effect.  It’s beautiful.  I never break out from it or any other La Mer product.  I would suggest using the Gel version of the Creme de la Mer or the Perfecting Treatment  (not sold yet at Sephora) as a moisturizer in the morning/primer. Those would be my 2 recommendations if you have oily prone skin.  This might be too much to handle.  I’ve been layering the Perfecting Treatment over my moisturizers both in the morning (Soft Lotion) & night (Creme de la Mer).  It adds such a nice smooth look under makeup during the day & helps seal up the products & acts as a conductor, allowing everything to sink into the skin more effectively, at night.  Another use for the Moisturizing Soft Lotion is to use it in place of Creme de la Mer, as your moisturizer at night in the summertime.  To me, it’s just a much lighter, creamier version of the original creme.  If using it at night, I think ALL skin types would benefit!I highly recommend the entire line.  If possible, find those pre-made kits, to try things out for a few weeks to see how your skin will respond & what exactly will work for you before buying full sizes.  They’re available at high-end department stores.  But, chances are you’ll fall in love.  I haven’t had any complaints from anyone I recommended it to, over the years.  The most important thing I can say is: nothing works overnight.  (although your skin will feel great quickly), you may not see visual differences right away, give it time!  Also, with all of the La Mer products, a little goes a LONG way.. Some of my products last 6 months.  Make sure you speak to a Sales Associate who’s been trained with La Mer products.  The application techniques can make all the difference!  Here’s to your best skin ever in 2017!! XOXO

Look into Dr. Babor, it’s made at the same factory in Germany and the ingredients are suspiciously similar. That’s all. Just lookin out for your wallet.

If this is out of your price range, I don’t feel like it’s anything phenomenal to want to spend the extra money (Makes me think of La Mer in a sense). review_title: My Skin Thanks Me... My Wallet Does Not

review_text: Love this cleanser I can get my eye makeup off in one wash with it as well. If you can’t afford it don’t complain... nobody forced you to purchase it..

It gets the job done but no serious change happened Atleast in my skin. I’d keep if it weren’t for the price...it doesn’t work well enough for me for 70$ I think there is plenty of drugstore options that would do just as good of a job or not better

Started using this cleanser over two weeks ago so far I really like it. I have sensitive skin and I have a hard time finding a cleanser I’m not allergic too. This one is expensive but I’ll pay the price to keep my skin clear. Highly recommend

This leaves a nice tingly feeling on pores and foams well. It also lasts for a long time.

This is the best cleanser! I used to use the drunk elephant cantaloupe cleanser, which I loved, but this blows it out of the water! I got one for my mom too for Christmas, who is 61, and she can’t stop raving either!! Definitely would recommend!

My H.G. cleanser for the foreseeable future, and the only face wash I’ve noticed make a noticeable difference in my skin from the first use. If you have complicated skin like me and have seemingly tried everything, I’d give this one a shot. $70 is a lot for a face wash, but truly, I’ve tried everything from La Mer to Tata to drugstore to SkinCeuticals to prescription and thus has delivered me the best results, hands down. review_text: This & the Emerald hemp oil are my 2 top picks from Herbivore. I have tried the Phoenix, Blue Tansy & Emerald hemp oil. I have tried the Pineapple Glow mask, Prism mask & the Blue Tansy mask & the Pineapple glow mask is my top favorite for light exfoliation. I have also tried the moisturizer & it contains great ingredients, like sodium hyaluronate & feels good on the skin but it does pile easily & so I cannot wear makeup over it & it smells like whiskey to me for some reason LOL! This is my most favorite though!! It contains hyaluronic acid which is 1 of the best moisturizers for skin and that ingredient has been surprisingly hard for me to find in organic skin care that does not contain acne or skin irritating essential oils!!! It also contains aloe which is soooo soothing on my skin and Rosewater which is also very soothing & hydrating!! It smells like fresh roses & water but it’s not too strong and it doesn’t last for more than a second or two which I am grateful for because I am so sensitive to scents that I cannot even wear perfume. It also does not leave a sticky, oily or greasy residue on my face since it is a water texture! There are so many benefits to using facial mist. I use it in between my skin care regimen applications, before makeup, after makeup, before facial masks, during facial masks to help the product sink into my pores. Just to hydrate whenever I need it! This & the Caudalie grape water (not the elixir) are my 2 favorite facial mist a of all time & I would recommend them to anybody!!! Next I am going to try the green tea toner! :)
review_title: So hydrating yet light on the skin! Love it!!!!

Best hydrating mist I’ve ever tried. I normally never use the same product twice, but I will never go without this mist again. High quality, amazing performance

The rose hibiscus mist is hydrating! I like to use it after I workout and wash my face, so I don’t use it every day. But when I use it every now and then the tone of my face is balanced, I tend to have reddish skin. Recommend!

I am a an avid Herbivore lover and this mist is no exclusion. I love the scent and the fine spritz. It is perfect for using after cleansing and prior to applying my Herbivore serums/facial oils. I will certainly purchase this again.

This is just one of those items I always keep on hand -  I store it in my fridge and use it right after I wash my face as a prep for my serums. I love love love this product. It’s hydrating and smells amazing. Cleanse. Toner. Exfoliate. Toner. Mask. Toner. Serum. Toner. Moisturizer. Toner. Retinol or SPF.
I love this product. I’ve been misting my face for years. My dermatologist recommended I do this years ago and I love this natural product.

This used to be my favourite Sephora product but the changed formula has ruined it because of the smell!It used to smell amazing and made my skin feel incredible!!!!I’m so incredibly broken hearted they changed it!

Smells lovely! I love spraying this on my big happy face after I do my makeup just for extra pizazz

I love this humidifier! Just wanted to share a few things I’ve noticed since using it nightly for about 6 months: 1. Use the auto setting and leave it on always. it will run until it’s completely dry and this is how the unit will prevent mold from growing2. Don’t use tap water. The filter will last much longer if you use filtered or even distilled water3. If you have a separate air filter in the room make sure that is off while you are running this. The air filter will counteract with the humidifier and remove the humidity from the air. I run the humidifier at night and the air filter during the day4. You can get very similar filters on Amazon if you don’t want to pay $10 per from CanopyOverall it was a great purchase! You just need to know how to take care of it. Canopy could do a better job educating customers on proper usage.
review_title: Get it - but do your research first!

I used this spf for about a year along with a full Dr. Sturm skincare routine. It was effective, and I learned there is a knack to applying it to avoiding the pilling noted by other reviewers: your skin needs to be really hydrated. I found that when my skin was on the drier side, sun drops were really hard to apply. The product pilled and just wouldn’t sink in. But when my skin was hydrated and supple, it sunk right in and meshed beautifully with my skincare and under makeup. On the one hand, I liked realizing how much more hydrated my skin needed to be…on the other, our skin goes through phases and we doing want something as important and routine as our daily spf to be difficult to apply. Another trick when it did pill (which is something I do for any product that won’t sink in Shaun) is to spray a facial mist over the skin and then massage everything in. Works every time! There’s that hydration factor again I guess. Lastly: be aware that the regulations surrounding skincare filters are different in the US than in Europe, and the formulation for this spf is different here in the states. Sturm products are made in Germany, and my guess is they haven’t just perfected the formula for the US version. In summary, if your skin is generally well hydrated and especially if you have a Sturm routine, I think these drops are great because they can blend so beautifully and look very dewy on the skin. But there are so many amazing spf’s these days where you may get more bang for your buck. And since getting pregnant and now breastfeeding, I can’t even use this one anymore and have switched to mineral sunscreens by Tatcha and Odacité which both perform beautifully.
