I had a few trials of this as samples from other Sturm purchases which I took on a skiing trip. Dang. SO GOOD—with a catch. When I wore this just on top of my moisturizer it made my face glowy and hydrated and didn’t disrupt my eye makeup. When I tried to wear it with my foundation (Armani liquid, applied with Beauty Blender), it pilled. I tried to wait long enough for everything to be absorbed, as some of Dr. Barbara Sturm’s skincare line you have to let sit to soak in, but it seemed that layering was an issue. Oh well. As someone who rarely wears foundation the sunscreen aspect is my daily need and therefore this product is amazing. It’s my perfect skin without makeup, and the sun protection is there too.
Love that this spf is also a HA serum for your skin. Feels great even on my lips

Well, I mean… for the price id expect it not to start pilling uncontrollably 15 minutes after applying it. Started noticing it in the drive troughs for starbucks after leaving to work. Spent my whole day feeling greasy and flicking off pilled sun drops from my face. Thats a no from me *simons voice*

This product is great for days at the beach.  I use it on myself and my six year old sun.  Usually we have some redness with any other sunscreen (we both have very fair skin).  With Sun Drops, no redness.  We even forgot to reapply this the other day at the beach—no redness.  It is a super shield!This works for makeup free days.  I have had no problems with piling.  I have a very simple morning routine of rinsing my face with water, applying Sturm’s calming serum, and then her face cream.  I wait about 1 minute, then apply sun drops.  This appears greasy at first, but once rubbed in and absorbed, the finish is a soft semi-matte velvet.  I have very sensitive skin, and her line is the only line that I have tried that brings my rosacea to rest.Cons of this formula: it is thick and does not do well under makeup.  I use Tatcha’s poreless sunscreen for makeup days.  Also, the sunscreen smell is strong at first, dissipates slightly, but does stay for the day—which is fine for high sun exposure days outside.
review_title: A super shield to battle rays!

review_text: I am a fan.  Surely it is not for everyone but in my dry skin, it works perfectly.  I apply it after two serums: hyaluronic and Ferulic C; and, before an Erborian cc cream I use instead of foundation.  I love how light it feels.  AND, very importantly, it comes in a glass vial.  I don’t use products that come in plastic containers.  I use to wear Goop but it comes in single-use plastic tubes.  Glass is a cleaner and non-porous element.   The price reflects the quality of the product.
review_title: Sturm Sun Drops the future of your face and Planet

review_text: This is just a really mis-marketed product overall. I was expecting to receive thin sunscreen “drops” that absorbed nicely into skin. Instead, it’s a thick greasy formula that barely pulls through the dropper. It feels like cheap drugstore sunscreen that leaves a greasy sheen all over the face and absolutely does justify its price. I didn’t experience the pilling that others did, but would not recommend for anyone with combo or oily skin.
Just the absolute worst SPF. Pilling is out of control on bare skin so when try and put makeup on top it’s just impossible. So many better options in general not even mentioning the price!

This pills HORRIBLY! I narrowed it down to this product after I experienced horrible pilling after finishing my skincare routine with my routine. Not worth the price! I recommend the Cera ve daily moisturizer with spf or if you want something more luxurious, I recommend the supergoop unseen spf.
I received a free sample of this product with my order but it was expired. Not sure how effective it would still be.

I received a free sample of this with my online order and I can confidently say this is the worst SPF i’ve ever used. Absolutely no body can justify the price of this. I’ve tried it out 2 times, waiting at least 15 minutes after my skincare routine to apply it. It still piled BOTH times. It also left a greasy/shiny residue on my face. I’ve tried the La Roche Posay - dry touch, Paulas Choice - youth extending, and Dermalogica - invisible physical defense sunscreens and they’re ALL way better than this. You’re better off with any of those. Don’t even waste your money on this trash
I got the free sample. It worked well and absorbed thoroughly. While I enjoyed the lightweight consistency, I’ve tried other products that worked just as well that were a fraction of the price.
review_title: Nice but not worth the price

review_text: I got a sample of this product and my honest review is that this product isn’t worth the money. I have normal skin type along with sensitive! This product pilled a lot on my skin and left my skin looking oily. The product does have a lightweight consistency! This product had no white cast as well, but my experience with this product wasn’t well. If it didn’t peel on the skin, I would’ve given this 5 stars. This sunscreen was pretty hydrating, which is essentially a good thing, but the pilling was horrible! Reapplication would make your face probably look super oily, yikesss.
review_title: Don't waste your money on this!

review_text: I got a sample of this sunscreen with my last purchase. When I first applied it, I found it to be quite rich. It even had a light fragrance which I found nice as I am not sensitive to fragranced products. It gave me a really oily/shiny look when I first put it on top of a light oil free serum. But after I let it absorb for about 15-20 mins. It gave my skin a beautiful healthy glow. I did not put on any makeup on top of this except a bit of benetint. And as I was patting the benetint, I must have rubbed a bit on my skin because this product just started pilling like crazy and it kept pilling throughout the day. I really loved the glow it gave me without giving me any milia around my eye or whiteheads. But the pilling was disappointing.

I had high hopes for this sunscreen because of the claims of a lightweight, serum-like texture. Not only does it pill over the top of every moisturizer I’ve tried to pair it with, it also has a much thicker texture than described. So glad I got a sample of this instead of purchasing the full size.

Easily the worst sunscreen I have ever used in my life. It pilled within minutes of me putting it on my face. I hadn’t even touched my face and it pilled EVERYWHERE. I received a sample of this and I have never hated a product so much.
I received a sample packet of this recently, and fell in love. I didn’t experience any of the pilling other reviewers mentioned, it sank right into my fairly sensitive skin and protects all day.

This sunscreen has a thin, serum-like consistency, which I usually love. This is one of the worst sunscreens I’ve tried in a looong time. Very greasy, doesn’t absorb, & pills like CRAZY! It doesn’t matter what skincare you put under it or what makeup you put on top...be ready for a messy result & a disappointing finish.
Pills like crazy even just on its own. I honestly had to wash it off, it was totally unwearable. Very disappointing because I initially liked it until a few minutes after I put it on.

At first, I adored this product. The sunscreen felt light and blended nicely. I applied this to my neck and face and went out. No make-up was applied over the sunscreen. Within an hour, I touched my face and the pilling was intense. My skin routine contains no oils in the morning but only a light cleanser, an AHA acid, and vitamin C. I did wait about 10 minutes before applying the sunscreen. Next day, I did the same process. No makeup but my I of course did my skin routine. Same results. I haven’t been brave enough to wear try makeup with this sunscreen. And due to the reviews, I don’t think I ever will. I wanted to love this product but the price point is absurd for quality of this sunscreen and the amount you purchase.

Heinous! I got a sample and it pilled horribly. Rubbed off all of my other products and will now have to wash my face and reapply everything. What a bummer. For the price point I would expect a much better product.

Went on like a dream, noticed the pulling when applying makeup. Thought to myself that’s annoying, but it wasn’t bad....YET. Got to work and was so embarrassed when I looked in the mirror. Looked like I had a face peel there was so much crap on my face. Took 15 mins to get my face under control so I didn’t look like a burn victim. Glad I got it as a sample and didn’t pay the ridiculous price for this awful product.

I wanted to love this sunscreen. Actually, for the price tag, I *needed* to love this sunscreen. Things started out promising when I first applied it - the formula is silky but rich, it’s a strong SPF without the strong SPF smell, and it seemed to layer perfectly over the rest of my skincare. And then 15 minutes later, I went to apply my foundation (Makeup Forever Ultra HD stick foundation), and I noticed some significant pilling. I thought that maybe it was the foundation not playing nice with the sunscreen - hey, it happens sometimes - so I switched to a cream foundation (Armani Luminous Silk). And the pilling continued. I tried switching between a brush and a sponge and my fingers, and it just kept on pilling. I ended up re-washing my face and re-applying my skincare and switching back to my Shiseido SPF. Then went to apply my makeup again and this time, no pilling. If you are blessed with beautiful skin that doesn’t need a ton of makeup, this still may work for you. The formula really is beautiful, it just didn’t work with me and my routine.
review_title: Started out a silky dream, ended up a pilly mess

review_text: Nice product, but not sustainable for long-term use. You have to use sunscreen properly, in order to have adequate sun protection.. that is, a teaspoon for face and neck - $145 would turn out to hundreds of dollars for one months worth of sunscreen. Many put drops on their face, and think, i used sunscreen, I’m  protected. No. lol. no. You have to make sure you do not use oils in the morning, as that will reduce  the effect of the sunscreen. Example: Face wash, Toner, goops 20% vit C, Hyaluronic acid, and moisturizer. I don’t see how the cost of this sunscreen is justifiable, it should be no more than $75. Her skincare line is not that great, a face wash that costs $70? no. I will mostly be using goops mineral sunscreen.. spf 30. I gave it 4 stars because I will probably still buy it, but I also want to make sure it’s an effective sunscreen.

I use this right after my moisturizer and love how easily it glides on! No piling for me and I’m not sure what others are doing that would cause that. It does have a sunscreen smell and I’m wondering how different this actually is to more affordable facial sun screens out there but I’m loving it so far and this may be the product that gets me in the habit of wearing daily sunscreen.

I see so many people having issues with pilling.  I love this product.  it doesn’t pill for me, you do need to give it time between using it and putting makeup on but i find that to be the case with most facial sunscreen products or else they do pill.  It doesn’t leave a white cast on my face and there is no tint so it doesn’t get on my clothes.  Very light scent

I received this product as a sample from sephora and I had to look it up just to write this review. It is SO bad!! The first 10 seconds of application was fine but as I kept massaging it into my skin, it pilled like crazy. All over my hands and face it looked like my skin was peeling off. I had to do my whole entire skincare routine again. I’m glad it was just a sample and I didn’t buy the full size. The worst sunscreen I’ve ever used, I will stick to my Innisfree spf.
review_title: do NOT waste your money on this

review_text: I can’t believe this product was released in this form, especially for this price. The pilling is ridiculous. Probably the worst pilling I’ve ever experienced from any skincare product. It’s a fine product otherwise, but the pilling makes it truly unusable. I’d be really mad if I spent $145 on this.

I really like this product!! Definitely the best facial sunscreen product I’ve used. I don’t experience anything like some of the reviews which say it pills or balls up. My guess its reacting to skincare ingredients put on prior. I’ve tried this with Fab ultra repair cream or tata harper silicone free hydrator. This just soaks in so perfectly on top of my moisturizer - its like a glowy serum. No “sunscreen” feel. I hate how expensive it is but will prob keep buying.

I received this as a sample and was super excited to try it as I’m always looking for new sunscreens! However, it did pill like other reviews mentioned. If you use very little, pilling is minimal but sunscreen isn’t something that you should skimp on!! Although I loved how the finish looked (it made my dull skin look dewy and didn’t emphasize my pores like some other sunscreens do) I just can’t justify purchasing this only to have it pill everywhere.
Worst sunscreen I’ve used in a long time. It pills and it leaves your skin looking greasy.

I received a deluxe sample of this product and I am so glad I did. Don’t let the luxe price and multiple celebrity endorsements fool you into thinking this is worth your money, because it is not. While it does have a nice lightweight serum texture, applies easily and smoothly, any pluses end there. Application feels nice but it pills under makeup and on it’s own! $145 just to pill?! No. Not acceptable. If sunblock is your last step and you absolutely don’t touch your face at all, then maybe it won’t pill. I gently scratched my face and it pilled and rolled off in chunks! And applying makeup after it is the same way. There is a slight sunblock scent that does not go away. So if you’re sensitive to that smell, you won’t like this. It didn’t bother me personally, but I didn’t care for it either since there are so many other products on the market that do not leave a scent. My favorite sunblocks are still Supergoop and Elta MD and I could purchase 3-4 of those versus just one of this bottle. It just doesn’t make sense to spend over $100 on sunblock anyway. Save it for skincare instead. Thank goodness I did not waste my money on this.

I’ve sampled this product three times. The first two times I tried it I was clean shaven and thought drops were lovely. They made my skin feel like velvet and sunk in well with a nice glow. This third time, I tried the sample with a full beard and it broke me out all throughout my beard line. Which given that I typically keep some degree of a beard, means this product isn’t for me. I don’t get many ingrown beard hairs and when I do they are typically in the same place, so there was no doubt that this product broke me out. So to put it in perspective the price is thus asinine. I refuse to believe that anything in this ingredient list is sourced well enough to justify the price. I highly recommend the Elta MD UV Clear 46. Also makes my skin feel very soft and hydrated, and has never irritated my skin. Another good option for people is who are a lil more bougie is the Skin Medica Total Defense SPF 50 (mix with a little hyaluronic acid for more hydration). Can’t go wrong with either and at a much more humane price point.

Got this as a free sample with my order, and I’m extremely disappointed. For a $145 product, this should be a top of the line, luxury sunscreen. Instead, it isn’t even a mediocre basic sunscreen. It smells like bad cheap sunscreen, and pills like crazy. I didn’t even put make up on, just rubbing the product in made it pill all over my face. I didn’t purchase this product, but reviewing for potential buyers so they know what they’re getting into. I would recommend supergoop play sunscreen instead:)

Got this as a sample so when I saw the price it blew my mind. Didn’t even use it with makeup, just put it on over my moisturizer and it pills like crazy! Glad I wasn’t planning on wearing foundation today because I would have to wash my face before I used it. Had to wipe all of the little white balls off of my face as it is. There are so many better moisturizing sunscreens at a much lower price point.

I have tried several sunscreens and by far this is the best one I have found for my face. Have been using for 3 years now, in combo with high concentrated vitamin C and Hyaluronic acid serums and I have no new sun spots on my face and everyone compliments my skin.  I give this product a 5 out of 5 because is worth the price and highly effective.
review_title: best face spf I have found so far - Turning 50

review_text: Balls up!!!! Had to wash it off and redo my skin scare routine all over again and use a different sunscreen. This is so disappointing
review_title: Balls up under makeup, not worth it

review_text: Plain and simple, this serum leaves no white cast & also seems to hydrate my skin as well. Sometimes I mix it in with my moisturizer if I’m in a hurry. I spend summers in Long Beach Island (extreme heat) & winters in Vermont (extreme cold) and I’ve used this year round and my skin has always been protected. It is expensive, but it’s lasts me a very long time as you don’t need to use much product and it’s SPF 50.

As far as efficacy goes, I love this sunscreen. I’ve used it on days where I’ve been out in direct sunlight for hours on end and it’s held up even without reapplication. This is also the only liquid sunscreen I’ve found that doesn’t get into my eyes when I sweat, or rub my face/eyes. Unfortunately, it’s just not feasible to use this everyday due to the price. I save this for the days when I know I need maximum coverage, and use the Tarte SPF powder for everyday use. I really wish I could use her products consistently because I love that they are clean, but given that there are a lot of great options out there that are equally or more effective AND affordable, I just can’t justify using her products on a regular basis.

I bought this via another trusted store, violet grey in LA. I was looking for products I need for a ski vacation. The staff recommended adding a few drops of this to my Day cream. it worked. I didn’t get any sunburn. However!! I started seeing little bumps on my skin, especially on my cheeks and under-eye area. feels like clogged pore! I think the sun drop is too greasy. I hope she improves the formula. Because there really isn’t much options if u want to skip the sunscreen and just add it to ur regular face product!
review_title: heavy. even when added to face cream.

review_text: This is one of the worst products by BS. The stuff pills like crazy! No way I can wear makeup as my foundations just balls up. Even when I don’t wear makeup the stuff sloughs off into white flakes. How can any sunscreen actually work when it comes off the instant you put it on? The formulation is definitely off with this one. Will never purchase.
Not worth the high price. You can get other sunscreens that are way cheaper and better, with similar ingredients.

I really enjoy these drops. I was sent some to try by the brand. The texture is nice and lightweight. It blends in well and doesn’t leave a white cast. It worked well with my makeup. It really is a stellar sunscreen. The problem is the price. I can’t justify this much for a 1 oz. sunscreen. If you can afford it, it really is nice. The Giorgio armani UV primer is so similar if you want to know what these drops are like.

this product doesn’t feel like your wearing sun screen and it doesn’t leave your face greasy however...it smells like sunscreen. the scent does not fade. once I applied it I had a bunch of residue coming off my face and hands.

Really wanted to like this product. No matter what you do or if not right away this heavily pills on your face. I had white pilling all down my face and when you try and brush it off lightly it unleashes the avalanche. I use this will all sturm products. Let my moisturizer sink in no matter if I wait or not pilling and it’s heavy not like a little bit. Also the fact that there is not a pump is ridiculous. This dropper gets coated in thick sunscreen and trying to put the dropper back in the bottle you get a mess all around the rim and it’s just awful. She really missed the mark with this one. Do not buy REALLY terrible.

im allergic to all other sunscreens I have tried from extremely high end to drugstore. I have spent enough on sun spot removing lasers and products to know I need to wear spa every single day and I do. stinks its so expensive but its the only one I will wear everyday. so worth it.i mix it with my foundation or try to put it on before it.  If I need to add more later in the day I rub it on my hands and press it over my make-up and it looks glowy I just love it.
My cosmetologist has suggested this product for everyday use. Have not noticed any redness and it doesn’t make my skin feel dry. Will continue using it.

I love Barbara Sturm products - and typically her droppers work well, but something about the thickness of this sunscreen just doesn’t work well and u end up wasting a lot of the product.  As far as the product goes - it’s great - goes on smooth and not greasy.  I would never buy it again though because of the bottle.
review_title: Product is great, packaging ruins it

review_text: Overpriced chemical sunscreen.  Great branding and marketing but why anyone in 2020 is still wearing chemical sunscreen instead of clean (zinc/titanium dioxide) is beyond me.

ALMOST PERFECT....except it pills! It pills when I put tinted moisturizer on- it even pills over my moisturizer. I love the way this looks on the skin, I love how it absorbs but- and I hate to say this- for the price I don’t think it should pill. If they fix that this would be the best sunscreen I’ve tried.  I recommend this product for no makeup days.

I did not like this sun protection at all. The main thing I disliked about it was that it pilled.  I could not wear it under make up or even on my chest it just pilled.  I would say the dropper seems to be some marketing tactic so it looks medical I did not have huge problems with it but I definitely would have preferred a bottle that squeezed it would’ve been easier to use. The price point is ridiculous and it does not sit nicely under make up there’s no way I would recommend this product.  Purchase Shiseido they make the best sunscreen.

I love these! It’s so lightweight, it’s strange. Sheer, I’ve never sunburned with this product. I have sensitive skin and react to many things. Love this! No clogged pores, no rashes, no breakouts. The dropper is a little odd and different, but it works. So glad I found this and that Sephora is carrying this now.

I used to LOVE the sun drops but I think it’s been reformulated which is a bummer because no matter what products I use it with, Sturms line or others, it pills. It doesn’t absorb at all. Whether mixing it with moisturizer or as a final step, it just pills up.
Perfect for a seamless shield prior to foundation. As a person who had skin cancer on their face, I use this product for my first SPF application, daily.

Very disappointed. The packaging is not helpful at all. Since it is a lotion -type of consistency it all over the dropper so when you put the dropper back into the container the product is everywhere. Smell like any other SPF from CVS and to be honest if you put few drops of this product next to the  let’s say Neutrogena SPF I wouldn’t be able to tell the difference. Clogged my pores and made me break out more than usual (combo acne prone skin). Waste of money in my opinion.
review_title: Not what you expect at all.

Love it. I don’t understand the dropper problems. I use several of her products with droppers and have had no issue. I put it on last after serums. I just pat it on my nose and forehead then the rest of my face and neck, etc. I walk 2-3 miles a day and so far it has kept me from burning, yay. I use another product on arms and legs as this stuff is too expensive.

Great SPF but the dropper makes the entire ritual kind of a mess. When you put the dropper back in the bottle, there is a ton a product that gets scraped up onto the top and then it’s all over the place. If you don’t wipe it up, it dries on the bottle. For this price, I would expect a better way to get the product out of the bottle.

To quote my husband “why would a redhead opt to move to South Texas?” 6 months in South Texas and I became accustomed to wearing a SPF daily, unfortunately my skin care doesn’t have it (PTR Cloud), and I was relying on it from a foundation. I saw this and immediately purchased. While it’s an odd consistency (think sunscreen you’ve melted in a car), it’s still better than most products. One coat prior to applying foundation without SPF, and I know I’m covered.For the other pale princesses out there, be sure to give it the recommended 5 minutes between application of your next product. I let it and my eye cream absorb during cup of coffee 2, and everything went smoothly.

I was shocked by this. I’ve heard great reviews about this product and was thrilled when Sephora finally carried it. I thought it would be almost like a serum consistency, but no. First, it’s a liquid type  lotion, still thick thereby creating a mess every time you remove the dropper to get any product out. Rather than use the dropper, I just put my finger on the outside of the dropper to get product—just unsanitary and it defeats the purpose of the dropper. Second, it feels heavy once applied. It absorbs fast but it doesn’t leave skin feel silky or smooth. Not worth 150. Still on the hunt for that spf!

Unique SPF drops; I mixed into my eye cream, moisturizer to give me sun protection in my favorite products that are missing SPF. Worked great on its own. I have sensitive skin but had no reaction to this SPF; has gentle lightweight base.

Honestly, this is my sun protection holy grail product.  You can mix a few drops into your normal skin care for light protection, or apply directly for the SPF 50.  It feels unlike any other sun protection I’ve ever used and doesn’t irritate or break out my hyper sensitive skin.  If it wasn’t quite so pricey, it would be the only sun protection I used.

After trying this for about 3 weeks I did notice my skin felt smoother. I don’t really get pimples so it didn’t really help me in that way. It kept my skin looking very healthy. My one issue is at the packaging was faulty. I couldn’t get the product out without actually opening the entire container.
I got this as a complimentary gift from Influenster in return for my honest feedback. For me, this toner works wonders. I felt a difference after the first use. My skin feels soft and smooth.
review_title: An easy step for great skin

review_text: It’s an alright product, I like the results I’m getting when I’m using it, but I don’t find I get as much exfoliation action as I would have liked with a resurfacing toner. I’m not finding myself reaching for this product during my everyday routine, it’s the step I’m most likely to skip... To be fair, I still haven’t found a toner that I feel justifies the extra step on a busy morning, but that may just be me!
I got this product compliments of an influenster VOXBOX and love the way it makes my skin feel firm and smooth

After incorporating this product into my routine. I noticed slightly more smooth skin. It is not a drastic change but it is noticeable. I feel it looks more vibrant. I have very sensitive skin so I’m always aware of what I put on it. Tula has not steered me wrong once.

I have been consistently using this product for 3 weeks and have noticed that my skin is much smoother. I have not had any issues with breakouts from this product with my sensitive skin and I like the consistency. Many of these kinds of products are too watery and make me feel like product is wasted, but this one is a little more of a thin gel like consistency. The only thing I don’t like about it is the price.

I have been using this for a few weeks and have noticed clearer skin. However it does seem to dry my face out as well. It leaves a residue that feels slightly sticky mane from me applying too much. It hasn’t bothered me enough to stop using it tho.

I received this product free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. After one use my skin was noticeably softer and smoother. After a week of daily use my skin was even and looked better than it has in months! It didn’t do anything to help the redness that I struggle with, but also didn’t exacerbate it. Unfortunately the pump in the bottle didn’t work, which made it less convenient to use. I use it in the morning before moisturizer and makeup and everything goes on smoothly. I would definitely recommend this product.

Influencer send me this product to try. I have tried this for about 2-3 weeks now and to be honest I am not sure what it’s suppose to do. I haven’t seen any difference in my skin. I do like the scent it’s very very mild. I like the that’s it’s not something heavy that your applying to the skin. But I don’t think this was meant for my skin. I guess I will continue to keep using it til it’s finish and maybe it’ll take longer for my skin to get use to.

I have been using this for about a week 1/2 & I like it. It gives my skin almost a tighter feeling the first minute I blend it in my skin. I use it after I washed my face really good then I continue with my make up routine. I think it helps bring a brighter less dull look to my face. The price is absolutely reasonable compared to things I tried that done nothing. I’m going to continue to keep using this so far I like the product. Only thing I will say and why I only gave four stars is the tube it was detached from the pump when I received it, so I’m guessing it’s very sensitive and that it could detach very easily from the two so I have to hold it upside down when I pump it. Disclosure I did receive this product complementary from influencer.

I received this toner complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I don’t love it but don’t hate it I guess. I haven’t seen any drastic changes in my skin for one. I found it to be an odd texture considering it’s a toner but feels more like a serum to me. The dispenser is really annoying I had a hard time getting the product to come out. Overall I wouldn’t buy this product vs other toners out there

I have used Tula products in the past and have always loved them. My skin feels nice and clean when I use them. This toner works well and is a different consistency than a traditional toner which I like. I will continue using Tula and would recommend it!

Disclaimer: I received this product free from Influenster in exchange for my honest opinion. I really like this product! I have very dry skin that tends to get flakey in places, so I’m always looking for something to combat that. I’ve had good luck with glycolic acid, so I was excited to try this one. I had a bit of trouble getting the dispenser to work, the first time, and it still isn’t perfect, but I can live with that. It does dispense an appropriate amount of product, which I appreciate it. The product itself is an odd consistency for a toner - more like a serum - but I personally don’t mind that. It has a pleasant texture and a nice, light scent. I didn’t find this product to be too drying. The glycolic acid is definitely effective. After a single use most of the flaking was gone and my skin felt soft and smooth. Overall, I’m very pleased. Took quite a few pumps at first to get the gel out. After a few days of using my face broke out horribly. Will not be using again!

I got this product complementary in exchange for my honest opinion. I can’t wait to continue to use this product! I received this product complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review.

I received the product for free from Influenster and Tulu for my honest review. I love how soft and clean this toner makes my skin feel. It doesn’t not have a burning feeling or harsh smells. Absolutely love this product.

I am hoping to continue use as I believe in the benefits of glycolic acid, but will likely discontinue if the breakouts continue. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion.

review_title: A must-have in my skincare routine

review_title: A toner that feels like a serum

review_text: Very light and easy to apply. Goes on with a cotton ball or cotton round, and feels light and refreshing.

review_title: best toner, worst package but worth it!

review_text: I’ve struggled with finding a good exfoliant for my face. Sugar scrubs would be too inconsistent and AHA serum didn’t seem to work well for me. I am going to continue to use it to see if I notice a difference, but so far I don’t see really anything happening. I love that is a gel toner, means no waste/spill. I never really added a toner to my face routine but I loved this one, def will keep using it. I loved the packaging! The toner felt so good on my skin plus it has a good smell.

obsessed. Skin looked and felt amazing and My nighttime moisturizer absorbed so well after. Highly recommend
I usually don’t like sheet masks, but this one was AMAZING! I saw results as soon as I took it off. I left it on for like 30 minutes.. hope that wasn’t too long
Good relaxing mask. I noticed that my skin was more glowy and my pores cleaner the next day.

Quickly one of my favorite masks! I tried the holiday mask set and have since repurchased just this mask. My skin looks amazing the next morning. I’ve tried a lot of high end masks (SKII, Suluwasoo ect) and would pick Dr Jart over the others for my skin.

This mask is amazing for any kind of texture. I’m using retinol again, which comes with dryness, flaking and brings some underlying acne to a head. This completely feels like a baby peel when you’re done and you wake up the next morning with smooth, glowing skin with minimized pores.
Can’t believe that my face becomes so smooth and bright right after the first use. I love it. Definitely going to buy more of this!

Great mask, albeit a bit pricey. The sugar scrub is nice and thick, and although I hate the smell of olive oil it quickly dissipated once I applied the mask. Felt the bubbling/popping of the two combining and was left with skin so soft I could not believe my eyes. This mask is quickly becoming one of my favorites. I’m not sure why there are some bad reviews because people are expecting their skin to peel but this is NOT what this mask does. Try something else.

I have textured, red oily skin and this is my new favorite mask! I massaged the cream into my skin and then applied the sheet mask. The bubbles  are not foaming visible bubbles, instead it is like a pop rock sensation underneath the mask as it deeply penetrates the pores. I waited 20-30 minutes and then removed the sheet massaged the formula again into my skin and wiped it away with the sheet mask and then rinsed with water. In the morning my skin was less red, smooth and a few pimples I had were trying up. Excited to try this on a regular basis and see what happens. Pros: easy to use, not messy, resultsCons: 30 minutes might be too long for some skin care regimens, $9 gets to be expensive when used 2x/week

I’ve used this mask twice and it definitely makes my skin feel softer. Like others, I didn’t notice a bubbling effect, but my skin did appear smoother and a little brighter. I just wish it was a dollar or so cheaper.
This mask works so well. It exfoliated my skin without irritating. It was honestly staring at myself in the mirror afterwards, because my skin looked so supple and refreshed. Highly recommend!
You feel the difference with one use. You’re left with super soft skin.

Wanted to love it based off great reviews, but for the price and what it does it’s not worth it..never experienced bubbling or the “it’s working” effect and was nothing more than a super grainy scrub and a sub par sheet mask.  2 stars only because you get a decent amount of product and my makeup looked a little better after I applied.

this mask blew my expectations out of the water. it bubbles and pops like pop rocks after applying the sheet mask to the peeling solution “scrub” and it feels kind of funny but it’s worth it. it doesn’t give an estimated time to leave it on, rather it says to keep it on “for a while.” i left it on for about 45 minutes (worth every minute). the next day my face was soft and tight. i will be buying again.

Two steps included in the package. The first step is a nice exfoliating. Second step, which is the sheet mask, feels so soothing. Only complaint is the eye cut outs are small and not positioned properly so I have to lay still otherwise the product will cover my eye. Followed the suggestion to scrub face with mask on then remove and rinse with warm water. I followed up with my moisturizer. My felt felt sooo smooth immediately after rinsing! I would repurchase!
love this mask! love how refreshing the mask feels. the popping of the step one granular mask combined with the sheet mask is so fun. my skin feels clean and smooth. definitely buying again
This mask is so fun to do ! I don’t usually like face scrub but this one is a nice one and you can tell a difference right when you take the mask off ! Worth it !
Obsessed! I’ve bought more than 5! Every time I use it makes my skin so smooth and soft and my makeup looks so much better.

Felt the difference after one use.  I love masks and try to do masking 2 to 3 times a week, I have tried many sheet masks and other liquid applied.  This two step process really worked for me.  Got me clean and fresh, I have combo skin and am 40, so aging...booo. I used it on a day I went make up free all day and felt my skin was at it’s best after.  Totally worth $9!
review_title: Great mask, noticed different right away!

review_text: I was excited to try this and excited to feel the bubbles, I did not feel nor hear any of that.  My skin felt clean but somewhat dry after this. Will not purchase this again.

I followed the directions as described by applying the sugar solution and then the mask and there was no popping of any kind.  The mask kept sliding off and after a few minutes of waiting nothing happened.  The skin looked fresh and clean like after a scrub, wasn’t irritated or burning.  Wonder if I didn’t apply it correctly or if the mask is not as advertised.

Sugar scrub feels okay but the mask doesn’t bubble or pop AT ALL. Makes me second guess if by applying it to “a clean face” actually meant that you’ve supposed to apply it to a wet face? Idk. Clean means clean & dry to me. Which is what I did and it didn’t pop or bubble. Hate the directions
Did not bubble or make skin peel

I tend to have dry, flaky skin and I recently for a nice sunburn on my nose/forehead that was starting to peel. I figured why not speed up the process along with a face mask designed to help slough off the dead layer of skin? And this mask did just the trick! The sugar scrub helped to exfoliate and the sheet mask left my skin hydrated and - dare I say - glowing. I will definitely purchase more of the masks, both to help with future sunburns and my drier-than-the-Sahara complexion.

Love the fact this mask takes 3-5 mins!! Don’t usually have 20+ mins to sit with a mask on my face. The results are quick and amazing !! My skin felt sooo soft and was really smooth. I wore at night, applied my serums and creams then went to bed. Woke up to glowing and smooth skin. I do also see a benefit of using before an event for great makeup application. I’ve used and have many masks.. will def be picking up more of these to add to the collection. It’s quick, easy and fast results!!!

I bought it for my daughter and at first we were disappointed that the mask did bubble but as soon as she took it off her skin looked better, there was definitely a visible improvement. She has sensitive skin but it didn’t cause her any redness or irritation. We both loved it.
Disappointing that I didn’t get the bubbling sensation that the packaging described, however it left my face feeling smooth and refreshed. Would most definitely repurchase in the future.

I had the best makeup day ever after using this. My skin felt really soft and it looked brighter. As far as “bubbles“ go, I would describe them more like pop rocks popping when you put the mask over the sugar scrub. It was fun to use and I will be purchasing more in the future!

Been looking forward to trying this mask since I first saw it come out and was impatiently waiting for it to come to Canada.Peeling solution is a 2 step mask with a sugar scrub paste first and then a sheet mask that causes a carbonic acid reaction when applied over the scrub.It doesn’t bubble the way most bubbling masks do (no foam) rather it creates a popping sensation like Pop Rocks on your face. Feels very gentle and is super quick (5 min) and leaves skin feeling sooooo smooth after. I only wish Sephora carried the 4 packs.

I was worried about this because I have such sensitive skin but wanted to try it. I have white bumps on my face that never go away and if I try something new it makes them worse. I used the mask, I felt tingling and I did hear the bubbles pop. It was not too sensitive at all! After one use the white bumps on my face are almost completely gone! I don’t know what this was really supposed to do but it cleared my skin so well that I need to buy multiples of this mask to have on hand!
As stated in the directions the mask was suppose to bubble but for some reason mines did not. $9 for a single use mask that didnt do what it was suppose to is sort of dissapointing.
It makes your skin so smooth and the exfoliating serum is hands down amazing and the best I’ve tried. I didn’t hear bubbles pop but the mask did it’s job. I’m going to repurchase

Love this mask. My skin has been feeling irritated lately. I had small popping up, I saw and knew I had to have it. I heard the bubbles pops. When I took it off my skin felt amazing. This is my excuse to always go back into Sephora for more !

Saw this pop up on my email, I love Dr Jart sheet masks. My guilty pleasure. They all so far have not disappointed!! I have normal/ dry, 47, fair complexion. Prone to chin hormonal acne, very sensitive, can turn red easily. A 2 step sheet mask is a little odd definitely different than what I’m used to. I had NO redness, NO irritation, NO burning. Skin felt very very soft afterwards, which is also different due to the fact the other sheet masks hydrate but feel more sticky. I used my Caudalie grape water essence, then my Korres wild rose serum, Dr Jart Ceramiden moisturizer, and Peter Thomas Roth eye cream. If you are looking for a double bonus, exfoliating and a hydration mask, this is great!

Didn’t hear actual bubbles pop but skin felt crazy smooth afterwards. Love the two step method. Would not recommend for ppl with active breakouts or very sensitive skin since I did feel a little tingle but, I think it does what it says! Price isn’t bad so it’s worth a shot.
Just ok. I felt it made me more orange than other self tanners and it doesn’t wear very nicely. The only thing I liked was there was a minimal fake tan “stink” when having it on.
This is one of the best self tanners I have tried. The only issue is it stays a bit sticky for a while. It gives a great natural looking tan.
I used to do nuda spraytans (40$ every 2 weeks) and i get exactly the same result with 2 coats of this product. It really lasts and the finish is great.

I like that this self tan doesn’t smell as strong compared to others on the market. I thought it would be okay that there wasn’t a colour guard, but I was reaaaal wrong.. but that’s more so a user error/preference. I did find that it transferred on to my white sheets, just slightly. I really did enjoy the colour though, but I will be returning this.

I was really looking forward to trying this after seeing so many good reviews. Sadly, this is getting returned. Pros- Dries fairly quickly after application - Has a very mild scent. Not exactly a fake tanner scent, but maybe a perfume-y scent. - I personally like that it’s clear and does not hair a color guard. It was slightly nerve wracking at first when putting it on but I’m here for no transfer to clothes/sheets/etc. - Nice light consistency Cons- Slight sticky feeling after it “dries”. Not super annoying to me but reminds me that I have self-tanner on so not fun. - Dried my skin out SO MUCH. No matter how much lotion I put on, I couldn’t fix this issue. - My biggest con… faded very patchy. There’s definitely things I like about this tanner, but for the cost I just can’t overlook the patchy fading and very drying to skin.

LOVE this self tanner! It’s clear so I haven’t had any trouble with it staining my clothes/sheets! I love the color and it seems to stay on longer than the St. Tropez or My Loving Tan and also wears off without being splotchy or sporty! Also, loved that when I rinsed it off that a lot of the product still stayed on (except for my face ) which is something I really like.

So… I’ve tried A LOT of different self tanners. High end, drug store, in between. You name it I’ve tried it. This is by far my absolute favorite. My reasons are quite simple. I have WHITE sheets, I applied this on after my shower, let myself dry up for about an hour and then went straight into bed. I woke up the next morning and not ONE little bit of transfer anywhere which was very impressive. I also hate self tanning smells and although this does have a slight smell to it, it’s not as strong and gross as all other products I’ve used. I deff recommend using a kabuki brush when applying this to your hands, feet/ankles, and face because it is clear so you don’t really know just how “even” it’s spreading. However, what I like to do is if I use 2 pumps on my entire lower leg, I will use the exact amount on the other so it distributes evenly. It gave me a really nice tan, wasn’t orange at all and it didn’t leave me streaky whatsoever. I do also recommend applying with either a mit, or powder-free latex gloves (blues ones from CVS work great) just make sure to exfoliate and shave prior to application for best results!! Best of luck :)

Love the color it gives. People don’t even ask if I’m using self tanner they always assume I was in the sun! Smell is bearable (self tanner smell is really bothersome to me) It is a little drying to the skin so I definitely use a light moisturizer on top to maintain and on my dry spots before applying. Difference between Iles of paradise & tan lux is Tan lux- color is better + fades better - dries out skinILES- fades pretty ugly/splotchy smells not great
Must buy. Amazing formula, no streaking and zero transfer.

I have experimented with self tanners for the last 20 years of my life, and this is my holy grail. I use the Light/Medium on my face and the Medium/Dark on my body, and it comes out amazing every time!

Due to the mixed reviews regarding this (and the knowledge that clear self-tanners can be a mess) I held off on buying this for a long time. However, this past weekend, I was stuck on a trip without any self-tanner and picked this up on a whim at Sephora. I’m middle eastern with light-medium skin olive skin, so I picked up the medium/dark shade. Based on the reviews, I wasn’t expecting much, but wanted a little bit of color. I am SO happy I bought this. Save for one careless spot on my foot where I missed, this applied BEAUTIFULLY all over my skin. Its a gorgeous golden brown shade, not orange at all. This isn’t the darkest self tanner I’ve ever used, but the color it gave my skin is exactly how I look when I tan in the summer, a deep tan golden shade. Due to the fact that there is no color guard, this doesnt get stuck in pores on your skin, so it looks completely natural. I’ve been unimpressed with the last 3 or 4 tanners I’ve used, but this is my new go-to. Yes its pricey and clear but a little bit goes a long way (1-2 pumps per arm leg etc), and if you apply carefully in the mirror you’ll be left with a very pretty tan. If you’ve had your doubts, give this a try! I am very very happy I did.
review_title: Bought on a whim- Happy I did!

review_text: Patchy, clingy, not a lot of color pay off at all. Drug store quality with high end price tag. Not worth it !!!
Not a bad odor but color doesn’t show up much. Goes on clear so it’s difficult to see where you need to go over to make it even.

It’s clear and goes on so easy. It doesn’t stain my sheets or clothes and dries quickly. I also have gotten twice the use of it compared to other mouses. The color is very natural but still and good tan color and develops smoothly.

I’m very experienced in applying mousses, but this one is a pretty hard one to get right on the first try because it’s clear. That’s why I knocked off one star. I did it super carefully, and still had some streaks. I could even it out with a second application and a lot of scrubbing.I found that the result is great even on really pale skin. It gives a golden glow, not too orange. Its also really comfortable to wear all day, since it’s clear and won’t look too brown or green. It’s not too sticky and won’t smell until the 7th hour or so, and by then it’s time to shower.
review_title: Like results but tricky to apply

review_text: This color coats my pale quarantine skin and provides a natural glow. It could stand to be a tad more red-brown than orange-brown.The main issue is that a little doesn’t go a long way. I’ve done a full body application once per week and after a month, I’m more than half way through the bottle.However, the color is pretty decent for me (fair neutral), and it doesn’t dry out my skin--as many other bronzing agents tend to do. I recommend it, but I’m also looking for a less expensive replacement.

I’ve literally never written a review for a tanning product before...and I’ve tried too many to count. I’m pretty fair skinned, but the medium to dark shade is exactly the color tan I get after a week Long Beach trip (yes the other reviews are right, there’s definite orange undertones but not too much for my taste) So natural and when applied veeeery carefully, completely streakless! I also love how hydrating this formula is. There’s a definite fake tan smell after a couple hours but I really don’t mind it. Definitely worth buying if you want a hydrating, glowing self tan!

i dont know how this has any negative reviews..ive been using st tropez for years and decided to try something new and im sooo glad I did.i was skeptical about the light shade as i love a deep bronze but im pale so wanted to try the light first.firstly its a clear mousse so you have to be confident in your self tan skills to get a good tan. I coated myself in about 2 layers of it. it was sticky which I didnt like much but whatever.the smell is a strong perfume but it fades after a few hours.dha smell is strong but i dont mind it.l, its not terrible.the tan is fabulous and the color is lasting forever. i am at day 4, i have exfoliated and my tan is even and still dark. you need to moisturize daily to keep it nice.i read on a review online this comes with a mitt and it does NOT come with a mitt from sephora.i certainly reccomend this tanner and i am a total fan.

I have used a few self tanners over the years and this one is by far the best.  It went on so nice and my color developed very quickly.  No orange color.  And none of that terrible smell!  This is now my go to and I can’t imagine not using it!

This is seriously worth the splurge. If you have had practice with self tan before and are comfortable using it around your body then buy it and never look back. The color I had was incomparable by anything that is on the market today. I don’t think that it is as hard as it looks and it is worth an extra five minutes of ensuring to rub in.Note: I don’t burn easily in the sunlight and develop a tan fairly easily. If you burn easily I would recommend using light/medium because it will compliment your skin color the best!
review_title: Most Beautiful Natural Color I Have Ever Had

review_text: I used to use St Tropez mousse until my skin became extremely sensitive to Literally everything I put on. This does not cause any irritation whatsoever. I am very fair skinned and have to make sure I don’t leave it on too long or it begins to looks a little orange. Grateful to have found this product!

I’ve tried many different self tanners and this is by far the worst. It looks great for one day if you do everything to prep correctly, but this product is impossible to layer and fades extremely unevenly/patchy orange. When I returned this product after using about 1/3 of the bottle the employee agreed with me that’s it’s the worst self tanner on the market. Do yourself a favor and buy St Tropez express tan or water mousse instead!
review_title: Don’t waste your money or time

review_text: Works very well. Natural result. I’ve used it for quite some time. Unfortunately, my last bottle arrived without a top and the product was spilled all over the box. I’m not quite sure how Sephora would allow a product to ship without a lid, but that was surprising. I called customer service to let them know and they were not very helpful. 3 stars overall but had to deduct for packaging and customer service.

I’m very experienced with self-tanners and have been using them twice a week for the last 13 years. I’m pretty fair-skinned and look much healthier with a little glow. I’ve tried every brand, color and formulation. My favorite kind is a clear mousse, specifically like this one. I’ve specifically been loving Coola’s mousse, but didn’t love that the pump always broke on me. I tried Tan-Luxe for the first time and I LOVE it. You must be experienced to use it as there is no guide color. I put it on at 7:30AM, showered at 1:15PM and the color continued to develop throughout that night. I woke up to a beautiful bronzed color with only a teeny tiny bit of orange. The smell when you first put it on is fresh and light and I did get a tiny bit of the dreaded self tanner smell by noon and again after I showered, but by the next morning any trace of it was gone. The only streakiness I got was on my right hand by my wrist but the rest of my body is completely even! I am definitely adding this to my favorites and I’m sure will be purchasing again.

This seems to be a great self-tanner, and lasts for several days.  I used to use the tinted one from Isle of Paradise, but switched to the non-tinted and like the fact it didn’t discolor my clothes. I tried the Tan-Luxe because it was recommended by the salesperson at Sephora as being the most organic one they had.  The only drawback is the fragrance is very strong and it takes a few minutes for it to dry completely.  Otherwise, I would give it 5 stars.

I’ve tried every self tanner out there and was a religious vita liberata user until I stumbled on this. No transfer onto white sheets, easy to apply, gives nice color, and fades naturally (not splotchy)! In love! TRY THIS.
Meh. Easy to apply, dries relatively quickly, and doesn’t rub off onto clothing too terribly. Tans a little too orangey for my taste. Vita Liberata is wayyyyy better!

I wanted so bad to love this product. Everything about it is great! The product smells amazing, it’s super moisturizing, has no dha smell in the morning. No gross guide color to stain my sheets and clothes and was super long wearing and not streaky! It was everything I’ve ever wanted in a tan!The only issue was the COLOR! It was unbelievably ORANGE! I normally use st tropez which I find near unbearable with the smell, stocky was and the guide color, but it gives me a nice bronzey glow. I used the dark formula (which was hardly dark, it didn’t do much besides give me a slight orange veil) and it’s turned me a nice, long lasting shade of “dorito orange” hopefully tanluxe reformulates this product because everything else about it is amazing.

My new fav self tanner! I was using The Water and loved the results but using a spray has its challenges. Its pricey no doubt but well worth it. Im really into the clear/water self tanner trend and other brands did not have nearly as great of a color pay off as this.

I think this product is the best new self tanner at Sephora. I have tried other brands but the result I got from this one is my favourite so far. It was easy to apply (comes out as a white clear foam) and rubs on easily. It does go on clear so you have to make sure you are covering all spots. It does moisturize the skin which is nice, had a tiny bit of a sticky feel when first applied but goes away after it fully dries. At first it does not look like much of a difference but then wow!! After the few hours of development time my tan literally looked like I just came back from vacation. Such a nice natural bronze colour! If you want darker results you can just do the process over again the next day and you’ll go super dark. After the first shower nothing much changed the colour still looked the same. There was no transfer to my sheets which was a plus! Just make sure to moisturize dry parts of the body before applying and make sure to blend well, especially on those parts because the tan developed a bit darker on those spots but overall the results were very even. I will definitely continue to use and purchase this product! Doesn’t have a harsh self tanner smell. Has a bit of a sweet smell but nothing intense.
This product  makes you look way to orange ! I am a light tan color to begin with so I thought I would try it to see how it works. Definitely NOT WORTH IT!
perfect amount of bronze glow without being yellow--not streaky if you follow the directions on the bottle--nobody could tell I had sunless tanner.

Love this stuff! It doesn’t stain anything and does a great natural tan. The only thing that is a “negative,“ is that you have to practice to get good at making sure you covered anything. A normal taner shows you what you covered, whereas this is clear. I just really go over everything really well
This add an amazing color in one use. However oh have to be generous and make sure you apply it everywhere or else you’ll miss tons of spots. This is nice because you don’t have to shower it off.
review_title: great but have to be careful

review_text: This is hydrating, goes on easy and doesnt have an overwhelming smell. The color is a natural tan. The only downside is you cant see where it goes.

I’ve been on a search to try another self tanner other than my go to Tropez and purchased this due to good reviews. The product does go on very evenly and does develop fairly quickly but the undertone is very orange. I’d say I’m pretty medium skin toned and tan easily in the summer. The color was a miss for me, very unnatural. The tan did last nicely for a couple days but then came off terribly. I rarely have patchy self-tan spots on my skin while fading but noticed my neck had splotches after three days. The uneven/patchy fading is why I would not recommend this product.

This tanner couldn’t be any easier to use and the results are natural - no orange glow. The dry down time is minimal and amazingly there is no transfer onto clothing or bedding. This is a keeper- already tossed all the others I tried. I was so impressed with this that I also purchased Tan-Luxe “The Water”

Worth the high price tag. There is no smell, it doesn’t stain your sheets or clothes and the color is super natural. You do have to be more careful when applying since there is no color guide. This is going to be my new go to sunless tanner
so happy with the color. I am super pale and everything turns orange on me. this looked natural and beautiful. I couldn’t be happier.

So I bought this along with a couple other products by Tan-Luxe. Got The Water, The Face, and The Body along with Hydra-Mousse. The mousse was my least favorite. It does have an inconspicuous scent, but still a little something. This DID stain my white sheets, bleach got it out well, so don’t use it at the end of the day. Def a great self-tanner: easy to apply, subtle scent, not super sticky, develops and fades well; It’s just that Tan-Luxe makes better products. I’d go with something else, like The Water, unless you’re super set on having a mousse Self-Tanner.

Swatch tested this on the back of my moisturized hand. I let it develop from around 6 pm overnight until 8:30 am. The smell was pleasant but honestly if you can’t smell DHA then you are crazy or the product contains hardly any. I can always smell the DHA scent in every self tanner I have ever bought. I can smell it straight out of the bottle, as it develops, and the next day in my skin even after a shower.  So that being said, the fragrance here is nice, but not over powering because nothing is going to cover that up. There is no reason to offend everyone in the room. The color was great in the medium dark. A bit orange at my knuckles so make sure you moisturize those dry areas (I know we all forget or skip it) because this will cling. It was definitely tacky for over an hour or so but that’s pretty normal for a mousse. Not having a color guide makes it far less uncomfortable because of can put anything on and not worry about it.

This gives a nice but subtle color with absolutely no self-tanner smell.   It dries almost immediately, and doesn’t get on clothes.  It was advertised as being hydrating, but on me that is minimal.   Wish it was a bit more hydrating.   Other than that, I do love this.

I’m really on the fence about this product. I really like that it doesn’t have a scent/color and that it doesn’t irritate my skin. But the color is horrible. The first time I put it on, I was terrified, and was so careful, but ended up waking up with an even tan. However, the color of this tan is day glow ORANGE. St Tropez has a better color, but it makes my skin so sensitive and has the tendency to break me out, something tan luxe did not do. I was also able to put this on my face and it made my skin look nice.Really, the only con is the color. And it wears VERY patchy, despite my obsessive exfoliating and moisturizing. For the price, I expected better. I will use this bottle, because I appreciate how gentle it is, but will not repurchase.

The color goes on so even no streaks! I literally was shocked at the evenness of this tan. Despite being clear you can see where you’re putting it. You have to be very careful around hands and feet or any dry areas this product will stain. The color is gorgeous I am pretty fair and this gave me a medium to dark tan a hint of orange but gorgeous color.  The smell was fine initially hardly any smell then I smelled like chemicals(not sure how to describe) during the night. I didn’t smell any DHA whatsoever though. This product is STICKY! It will stay sticky for hours. This product does not come off! It took me 2 baths and scrubbing myself raw in order to get it off. So the claim on the bottle ’no mess no smell no drama’ is really inaccurate. Because of the gorgeous color I’m tempted to repurchase but hesitant because so hard to remove.

This is an awesome self tanner! I have a yellow undertone to my skin, which most self tanners would make me look orange. This product does not do that at all! The tan looks very natural and I have gotten many compliments. This doesn’t stain clothes or bed sheets, even the mitt it comes does not stain after usage.

This made me SO orange! It was also extremely blotchy, which may have been my fault since I still have pretty dry winter skin. Still, the color was so so orange—an issue I’ve never had with other tanning mousses. This is a pass for how expensive it is. The only positive things are the smell, and the fact that I had no color transfer on my sheets.

I just used this for the very first time. This is the BEST self tanning product in the market. I’ve tried so many brands such as St.Tropez (I used to swear by), Loving Tan, etc and this product beats them all! It goes on like water. No color. Very little scent to almost can’t smell. Dry instantly. Not sticky. Gives me really nice natural looking tan (I use medium/dark one). If you’re considering it go ahead and buy this. You won’t be disappointed. So worth it!!!

Best self tanner. Comes with a mit. No tanner smell, it smells like something light, but doesn’t linger. The mouse spreads beautifully. Yes it’s clear so you are missing the guide color, but it does leave a slight sheen where you’ve applied so you could use that as your guide. Skin actually feels nice and hydrated after use.  Does not transfer on to white sheets. Actually tans an even tan with no streaks. I am light with olive undertones and got medium/dark. This gave me just enough to be slightly tanned, but no orange.

IN LOVE. I’ve been a loyal St. Tropez user for 5  years now, but came across Tan-Luxe via an influencer I follow on Instagram. I was curious and checked out the reviews - I couldn’t believe people were saying there was no color transfer to clothes, sheets (as a St. Tropez or other self-tanner user, you know how annoying this can be). That point alone had me sold! No more changing sleeping in long sleeves and pants in the summer to avoid color transfer or changing my pillow cases out to avoid damaging them. Now I can sleep on my white silk pillow case without any color transfer at all! And I don’t have to go to bed looking like an ogre in the dark St. Tropez formula. Not to mention the color is amazing - not too orange and looks natural! It claims to attack wrinkles and fine lines, as well as evening out skin texture, which I consider to be a tall order to achieve without active ingredients such as retinol or vitamin C. I’m slightly skeptical about its promises, but I will gladly use this as a humectant to trap all the good active serums in without causing break outs.

So this cream is really nice, has a pleasant fragrance but can get overwhelming if you’re sensitive to fragrances. I use it sparingly for this reason. When I do use it, it doesn’t soak in very well because when I gently rub my face a while after application it rolls off with my hands. For the cost of this I think that’s unacceptable! I thought I might be applying too much but I also use the same amount of Drunk Elephants peptide cream and it completely absorbs with no issue. For this reason I prefer the peptide cream. review_text: If you’re looking for a product to replace Bonne Bell’s Bronzing Gel, look no further. product_name: Sun-Kissed Face Gelee Complexion Multitasker Bronzer

I thought this may be a good alternative to get that sunny glow but it does worse things to my skin than sunbathing ever would. Once it was on my face, it kept curling up at the ends and didn’t stay on properly. It was very sticky, but dried pretty quickly so there was no additional serum to rub in as other posters mentioned. I’d actually go so far to say that this is the worst sheet mask I have ever tried. I would not try it again.

It is a bit messy coming out of the package because there is so much serum on the gel. This isn’t even a negative though after using the mask and seeing IMMEDIATE results. My skin was amazingly soft and all my fine lines were softened or completely gone. I left it on for 40 mins, and then rubbed in the remaining serum. I will definitely be purchasing this one again....and soon!Dr. Jart products are some of the best!

I was a lucky tester of these new SK-II Brightening Derm Revival Masks and received a free sample of the product. When you see the price, you may balk a little, but remember that you get 10 masks in one package. This is far more affordable than going for a spa treatment - and much more convenient, too! The application of the mask is pretty straightforward. You don’t need to moisten anything or spread gels around your face. Just find a comfy place to relax for 10-15 minutes, tear open the package and pull the mask out. It is saturated with a hydrating, clarifying essence, so all you have to do is find the eye, nose and mouth openings, and slip the mask onto your skin. SK-II recommends to begin with your eye area, then slowly press the mask onto the rest of your face with your fingertips. I followed this recommendation, put my feet up and set a timer on my phone for 15 minutes. Note: if your husband rubs your feet during this time, it really is close to a full spa experience! The mask adhered to my skin perfectly, but I did have to adjust it a little because I have a small, narrow face. You can pull the eye flaps up over your eyes if they are closed to treat your lids, as well. As it works, it has a tightening effect. When time is up, you simply peel off the mask, rub the remaining essence into your skin and toss the mask in the garbage. No muss, no fuss! So, does the SK-II Brightening Derm Revival Mask live up to its claims? Here’s a refresher: it should be clarifying, moisture-boosting, brightening and exfoliating. I would say yes to all of the above! Check out my photos to see for yourself. The mask picture is a little scary but you can see how it is applied (I didn’t do a great job with the nose opening in the photo, but you get the drift). The after photo shows my freshly treated skin all aglow. I would have attached another photo showing before and the day after application - it was a healthy glow that shined through my makeup - but I only got to choose two. Now, for the (minor) negatives... The scent is a little strong for me, and it had a smell that stuck around for hours after. Also, I have fairly sensitive skin, so I experienced a little redness after completing the treatment. Other than that, it was well worth those tiny inconveniences to get glowing, moisturized skin. review_text: I am a huge fan of sheet masks and have tried every shape, kind and price range. I’m not sure what I was expecting from such an expensive mask, but I’m not sure the SK-II Brightening Source Derm Revival Mask lived up to its cost. The packaging is nice, it looks expensive, sleek and I love that the actual mask packaging is quite small (less waste and takes up less room, some packaging can be bulky or odd shaped in pursuit of being cute or charming ). It is very easy to open and retrieve out of the pack, and has a clear gel like serum all over the sheet mask. This is one of the only sheet masks I have seen that has flaps on the eye holes, allowing you to close your eyes and treat your eye lids as well (though I chose to just fold them down on to my cheeks every time I’ve used them). I find the mask fits a bit funny on my face, the forehead seems a bit short and wide, but realistically its impossible to expect them to be perfect for every face shape and size. If you’re new to sheet masks then it will seem weird and maybe even a bit gross applying the mask with the gel type serum, but once it is on your face it feels so refreshing and hydrating. This mask stays very well on the face, I am able to do just about anything around the house (sheet masks are not a pretty sight, you will likely want to stay in for this one haha), I have had some other types/brands that I had to lay down because it just would not stay. I personally leave mine on for approximately 20 minutes and then just pull it off and through it in the garbage (these are one use only!). Once removed there is quite a bit of essence left on your face, what they and I recommend is rubbing/patting it in to your face and pulling it down onto my neck and chest. I think because of the gel like consistency, it does leave your skin a bit tacky for quite awhile after application, not a deal breaker but it may be best to use before bed. I have combination skin, and normally moisturize after cleansing and stuff but do find I don’t need any sort of moisturizer after using this mask as it delivers a great amount of hydration. It absolutely leaves my skin looking dewy and glowing with absolutely no irritation (I have sensitive skin with some products). I do find it helps a bit with the texture of my skin as well, nothing life changing, but I can see a difference. I’m torn with these masks, they are great quality and have produced some really great results for my skin but I’m just not sure it’s worth the high price tag as I have had other great results with cheaper options. Over all a great product, I took a star away because of price. I received this item free from SK-II, my review is my honest opinion.
