I do have oily skin but this has not ever caused me to break out or become oilier. I only use this as a night cream due to its occlusive texture (the ingredients don’t seem to confirm that it is in fact an occlusive but it definitely has that texture, might be just a heavier emollient). And for the price, I’m not even halfway through the jar and it’s been four months since I purchased, so it’s turning out to be decent value. A little goes a long way for this moisturizer too. My only possibly negative note is that it does have a distinct rosy fragrance which is pleasant enough but not really my preferred fragrance.

Even my neck lines are diminishing!!! This gentle cream really has made a huge difference in my lines around my mouth, eyes, forehead and neck! I use the regular essence, skin optics and then this product. I feel my pigmentation problems have improved and my skin is firmer, brighter and clearer. I have fewer blemishes with shorter recovery times. My wrinkles have been smoothed out and I look 10 years younger.  I also use the Ultimate Revival Eye Cream, which has smoothed the beginning of crepe eyelids and plumped the wrinkles around my eyes. Also, both Ultimate Revival products go a long way! A small amount will smoothly spread further than you’d expect. It’s expensive but will last 6+ months! Highly Recommend!!!
review_title: Even my neck lines are improving!!!

review_text: I have mature skin and have tried so many different face creams. This is one of my favorites! SK-II delivers every time! I had to take a deep breath before purchasing it. The cream goes on silky smooth and is so hydrating. It’s not overly thick, just right and when I wake up, my skin is soft. I use this with the SK-II lotion and Pitera routines. Packaging is gorgeous. I like it way better than the Chanel Sublimage line.

I just bought my second jar. This time with whole LXP skincare products. It’s an amazing moisturizing cream. I live in Southern California near the coast line. It’s pretty much dry all the time except winter time when it rains little bit. I recently visited S. Korea when it was extremely cold like 4degree in Fahrenheit. But I was good to go outside because my skin was armed and moisturized with the cream. I’m in mid 40s. Some ladies are complaining about the cream being too greasy but I’ve no problem. Maybe women under 40 aren’t ready for this. Also little amount of cream goes long to keep my skin hydrates and gives nice dewy glowing look. LXP is certainly the ultimate line among SK-II skincare product. Also I love the luxurious rose gold like packaging.

I received this product for free from SK-II and I’m so glad I did because it is wonderful! My skin feels so soft and hydrated after applying this cream and the smell is absolutely lovely. This product is expensive, yes, but the quality is spot on. My face didn’t feel greasy after applying the cream. The coverage is light but super hydrating. Just a dab will do you! I would highly recommend this luxurious revival cream.

SK-II sent their Ultimate Revival Cream for free for me to try, and boy am I thrilled that they did! For starters, SK-II’s Ultimate Revival Cream is packaged in a beautiful rose gold metallic finish box and container. It’s also packaged with a matching rose gold applicator stick underneath. I’ve been using this product for several weeks and certainly notice how lusciously soft my skin feels, and it is almost like since using this product my skin has been regenerated. If you don’t go overboard and just use the pearl sized amount you will supply your face with just enough moisture to not be too greasy and leave your face perfectly smooth in all the right places. The rose absolut fragrance is also a must have for your face regimen. I’ve been using this product at night before bed and my face smells amazing all day long too, and so does mypillow! My husband also loves the smell. SK-II Ultimate Revival Cream has worked wonders for waking my dull and dry skin up in just a handful of weeks, I can’t wait to see how it does over the next several months!

I have been using SK-II daily for approximately 6 weeks. Before using this product, my skin was dry and dull looking. However, after using this product my skin is firmer, more moisturized, hydrated, and radiant looking. I can’t believe the difference. Just a small amount of this product goes a long way. I use about a pea size and it covers my entire face, jawline, and neck. The consistency of this cream is thick and rich. It can tend to be greasy if you apply too much. After application, my skin immediately feels so soft. Unlike other moisturizers I have tried, SK-II Ultimate Revival Cream is long lasting. This products claims to keep moisture locked in for 12 hours. I definitely agree with this claim. Overall, I really love SK-II Ultimate Revival Cream. It makes my skin look and feel amazing with very little effort. The only drawback to this product is the price. $385 is a considerable amount of money to spend on a facial cream. However, I have tried numerous products over the years trying to combat my dry skin with little or no results. I can honestly say that this product has changed my skin for the better. Hydration, firmness, and radiant looking skin. What more can a woman in her early 40’s ask for?!

This is a luxury product in every way. The rose gold packaging is absolutely beautiful. Even the box is the same shiny rose gold as the jar. The cream itself is thick and creamy with a soft rose scent that smells lovely but never overpowers. The moisturizing properties are very rich. For me, with combination skin, this was too heavy to use as an every day moisturizer, so I’ve been using it as a night cream. If you have very dry skin, this might be a good option for daytime. I received this product free for review purposes.

From first glance the product packaging is beautiful. The smell is subtle and inviting like a boutique of delicate roses. This mositurizer was luxurious to apply, a small amount goes a long way. I used it for about a week before I started to breakout. I think this is better suited for cooler climates then in the midwest heat & humidity of summer. My nighttime application left my skin feel supple, radiating and smooth in the morning. Unfortunately, the morning application felt oily once I stepped out in the heat. I definitely will continue to use it at night.

I’ve used this cream for several weeks now but have had to stop because of the summer heat was making my skin feel too greasy. This cream is great if your skin is severely dehydrated and so I’m saving it for fall and winter.

SK-II LXP is a mixed bag for me. There are some major pros and cons to it.Lets begin with the positives.1. Gorgeous jar: The SK-II LXP comes in a beautiful rose gold jar which looks absolutely classy and beautiful. It also comes with a dipper and stand for it, which I think is a very useful tool since it keeps the product sanitary.2. Smells delicious: The SK-II LXP has a very slight rose scent which makes application almost luxurious. And thats where the positives end for me.On to the cons:1. Greasy: As much as I wanted to like this product, its too greasy for me. It didnt get absorbed properly,it just sat on my skin, even when I used a pea-sized amount. 2. Unclear active ingredients: I some research on what the active ingredients for SK-II LXP are and I am still unsure. The product that I recognize the most is niacinamide, but then again I dont know in what concentration it is present.The info should be readily available since there are products with the same ingredients available for 1/15 of the price.3. Exorbitant price: No matter how I put it, SK-II LXP is way too expensive for a middle class salary. A jar might last up to 3 , may be 4 months if used sparingly. Replacing it at that rate,would cost almost $2000 annually.SK-II LXP would have to be a miracle product in order to justify those kind of costs, which unfortunately it is not.Overall, I was expecting more but was disappointed.
review_title: Is an okay product at best.

review_text: The first time I used SK-II LXP I noticed an immediate feeling of suppleness to the skin quality.  I’ve been using this cream for the last 44 nights (& counting).  Each morning my skin looks a little healthier and more hydrated from the privious day.  Due to how emollient the product is, I’ve found that rubbing my hands together to heat up my palms before applying the moisturizer helps it to sink into my skin. I’d absolutely recommend the Ultimate Revival Cream. Just be sure to use it for a couple of weeks before deciding how you like it.  I hope you find that your skin has improved a little with each use (just like mine did)!
review_title: This is truly a luxury moisturizer!

review_text: When I use this cream it only takes a tiny amount to make a big difference, which makes the jar last for ever. The SK-II Ultimate Revival Cream made my skin smooth and soft after 3 days of use. I shared a small amount with my mom to try and she fell in love! It even helped the red areas on my nose and cheeks even out. I recently started using it on my arms to help with my keratosis pilaris.

I received this product free to review.  It only takes a dab of product to moisturizer your entire face. The first night I put way too much on and it was very greasy. The next night I used a small amount and my face felt great. I have dry skin with age spots and wrinkles around my lips. I have used this product for about a month and have noticed that my skin is hydrated and brighter. My makeup application looks so even and bright.  I only use the moisturizer at night only and I have a nice dewy look the next day.  I have not noticed any changes in my dark spots or wrinkles so far but the other results are amazing. My daughter, who I see once every few months, came for a visit and told me that my skin looked great. I told her what I was using and she said it looked so smooth. She is in her early 20s and I gave her a sample to take home. She said that her skin is looking great too.  I really struggle with the price although the sample is full size but I feel it will last for 4 to 6 months or more. If my skin keeps improving, especially the dark spots and wrinkles, I will be purchasing this. The results I have seen in just this short time is already very positive.

I love SK-II LXP Ultimate Revival Cream!  I have being using it for about a month now and this product does great at moisturizing my face. It is also very cost effective product because you only need to apply a dab. This product got rid of my dry skin completely. I like that is it easy to apply. I put it on after I wash my face and it seals in the moisture. Disclaimer: I received this product for free from SK-II.

I’m going to give SK-II LXP Ultimate Revival Cream five stars after I’ve been using it twice daily for about three weeks.  This is a very thick cream, so be warned about this ahead of time!  If you just need light moisture, you may not enjoy the drenching this cream does to your skin!I only recently started to feel like I was starting to get saggy in certain spots, so I feel like I am late to the anti-wrinkle game.  However, I know a good beauty product when I try one, and this is one of them! The cream is very thick, so much so that you will be ahead of the game if you put a small amount in your palm and allow it to melt a little from your body heat  before applying to your face.This is one of those products that seems to have several functions covered in one step.  It is a moisturizer that truly will keep your face plump with moisture even longer than the promised 12 hours, it has great anti-wrinkle ingredients that go to work while you wear it, and it does a fantastic job of filling in fine lines (because it’s so hydrating or because of the ingredients or both - I have no idea!)This cream leaves your skin very soft and, once the cream is absorbed, silky smooth.  I find that it serves as a great base for other makeup items, such as bronzer and blush.  No need for a primer!  And this smells absolutely amazing, so despite all of the chemical-sounding ingredients, you smell roses on your face!!!!I really like this cream and will be continuing to use this as my day and night cream from now on.  The name says it all - this revives tired, dry skin!  Thank you to SK-II for the opportunity to try this cream!

I recently received this product as part of a promotion and was very interested/excited about trying it out. I have been looking for a really good moisturizer for a while now.  I wanted to use this for awhile so I can give an honest review of this product.I have to say right off the back, the packaging is so beautiful. Although most of my cosmetics/facial care products are usually hidden away in my drawers/medicine cabinet, this product has found a home right next to the toothbrush and face cleaner, “very counter space-worthy“.  But the main question remains, does it work? Does it do all it claims to do? In a nutshell, it does. One negative is that it doesn’t come with clear instructions, so I had to look up  exactly how to use it and how much to use and what exactly is that stick thing? Which by the way is an stick/spatula to use while applying said product, so that you don’t have to stick your fingers in it.which I very much appreciate. A plus for those germaphobes out there.  But clearer instructions would be very helpful. As for the product itself,  I didn’t really pick up that rose scent that it claims to have, but that is fine. I tend to prefer products without too much of a scent. It is very thick and creamy. I was worried that it would be very heavy and leave my skin feeling very oily. But since you only need a pearl sized amount, it is just enough to give your skin the moisture it needs without leaving your skin feeling like you just washed it in a vat of oil.  And the moisture does last and there is no need to reapply. I have been using it as part of my nightly skin care routine and I have found that the size my pores have diminished and that my skin no longer has that tight  and dry feeling it tends to get. The skin as whole feels firmer,  as well. Although they recommend using it morning and night, I only use at night because I prefer a lighter moisturizer during the day. The main negative is the price.  I have very mixed feelings, about this product. On one hand, I do love the results but I don’t think I can really spend nor justify spending a couple hundred dollars on just one product.

I received this from SK II for free and have been using this for several weeks. I use this twice a day and it has made a noticeable improvement in my skin’s overall tone and texture. People I know have commented on how it’s clear that my skin almost glows now. This cream is expensive but well worth it, as there is A LOT of product and there are real results.

I received this product for free from SK-II in exchange for an honest review. This cream is absolutely worth the cost. It’s going to last a long time! You only need a tiny dollop once per day. If you have extra extra dry skin, use this in the morning. If it’s slightly dry to combo or oily, then I’d recommend putting it on at night before bed then can wash off the leftover moisture in the morning. It smooths wrinkles, hydrated dry skin, reduced age spots etc. Very impressed. It has a slight rose scent to it so if you aren’t a fan of roses this might not be for you.
Amazing cream! I turned 33 in May and looking for a cream to help fight aging. Yes, it’s pricey. But it’s amazing. I love the way it smells and makes my skin feel.

I’m Asian, and in many Asian countries, SK-II is considered the queen of skin care. I’ve used many of their products, and all of them have performed beyond my expectation. My favorite product has always been their facial treatment essence. We literally call it “the magical water“ in Asia. SK-II Ultimate Revival Cream is the first facial moisturizer product I’ve ever tried from SK-II. The reason why I waited so long to try this out is the price tag, as you may see the price tag on this product is a bit intimidating. However, after using this cream for the past 4 weeks, I can truly say this is the most luxurious cream I’ve ever used. I have very sensitive rosacea skin and I usually steer away from scented products, but this SK-II Ultimate Revival Cream has the most beautiful and genuine rose scent in skin care products. It’s light and it doesn’t irritate my skin at all. This facial cream also seems to balance my skin as well, no more dry patches and oily T-zone. My whole face is moisturized but not greasy, and it works wonderfully under my full face of makeup. I use it day and night but a little goes a long way, so this jar should last you a while. Many people have noticed my skin tone being more even, and this is the only new product I added to my skin care routine recently, so I know it’s working. I just turned 30 and have no visible fine lines yet so I can’t comment on the effect of anti-aging, but I find my skin looking energized and soft, which does make my skin look more youthful. I’d definitely repurchase and would recommend SK-II Ultimate Revival Cream to every one that wants to pamper their skin. It’s truly a treat to use this facial cream.*I received this product from SK-II in exchange for my honest opinion.“

This cream reminds me of the old school Elizabeth Arden night creams my mom used, the thing about this product is we aren’t in1982 and it isn’t necessary to have a heavier cream. I’m an Aesthetician, over 40 and I honestly do not like the feel of this cream. It’s too heavy and it looks and feels greasy on my skin. If you use a smaller amount on a wet face it becomes easier to ware and absorb. I feel this maybe good for a very dry and mature skin, but not for an average or combination skin. It did work in hydration and I did see a small difference in appearance of surface fine lines. But for the price it wasn’t worth it for me. But keep in mind that everyone has different reactions so this may work and be the perfect cream for you. Just make sure you prefer a heavier feel to your products!

I have been using SK-II Ultimate revival cream for a month now both morning and night. I have normal skin and have found the cream to be hydrating but also greasy feeling. When I used it in the mornings I’d have to plan ahead to get other things done while the cream was sinks by in. Otherwise when I did my makeup immediately after applying the cream i looked way too dewy and I’d have to apply another layer of powder. So I think if you have dry skin and/or like a dewy look this cream could be for you. I received this product for free in exchange for this review.

I received this for free from SK-II to try out and review. First of all there is a mellow scent to it so if you are sensitive to perfumes like me then this should be great for you. Also, it blended instantly and did not leave a greasy feeling on my face. After a few days of use I really noticed a difference to my skin.....even my tiny line of sweat pimples on my forehead seemed to disappear. One more thing.....I have always hated wearing lotion on my face in the summer because I feel like it makes me feel and sweat more but this was not the case. I did not feel like lotion was dripping into my eyes. The overall look & feel of my skin definitely improved. I highly recommend this product.

I received the Ultimate Revival Cream from SK-II for free. The price tag is very intimidating and I would be reluctant to purchase without sampling first, however after using the product just a few days I noticed a major change in my skin. I turned 40 this year and have been noticing my skin looking dull, aging and breaking out more. After a week using the product my skin looked calm and more evenly toned. After two weeks it looked clear,  brighter and my fine lines more refined. I have been using the product for over a month now and I could not be more happy with the results. I have to say it is a splurge but SO worth it!! My skin looks amazing! New products usually make me break out but I have not with this. My skin looks fresh and younger!! The cream is so rich and luxurious and a little goes a long way. The smell is amazing, like roses, and the rose gold packaging and applicator is beautiful! I use every night and days that I do not wear makeup and I have to say there are more of those since looks so good!! I feel like I am having a spa experience every evening after applying the cream. I highly recommend this product to any women looking to treat herself.

I received this product for free from SK-II.  This is a nice face cream for night use - it takes a while to absorb into my skin but in the morning my skin is nice and smooth.  I can definitely tell a difference between using it and not.  The scent is very floral, which is not my favorite, but it fades quickly.  I like that it comes with a spatula to help prevent contamination and help with reaching the bottom of the container (when i get there, which will take me a while!)

I received this product for free as a promotion. I’m always skeptical on using new face creams, cause I’m pretty happy with my regimen already....however, I was blown away at the results!!!! My skin looks so radiant and youthful after just a couple weeks of using it. It is a bit greasy, but still love it and compensate by using smaller amounts. Yes, it is a bit pricey, but I will gladly spend the money!!!

Wow this SK-II moisturizer is amazing. I use to get dry spots on my face that were very visible. Since I have been using this moisturizer my skin has improved a lot. I love the scent of the cream. It’s a light rose scent. The cream has a nice consistency and absorbs into the skin really well. You don’t need to be heavy with using the cream you only need a little dab. The packaging of this product is exceptional. I received this product for free from SK-II for my honest opinion.

I received this product for free from SK- II to provide my honest opinion and I am happy to give it. This is hands down the best moisturizer I have ever tried.  It goes on extremely smooth and absorbs very well (if you use included spatula, if not too much product can give you a greedy feel). A little goes a very long way, so a jar of SK -II lasts much longer than any other moisturizer I have used as well. Only aspect I personally didn’t care for was the scent, and that is only because I prefer fresh clean scents over the luxurious rose scent.  Most impressive is that it lasts.  Skin feels just as silky smooth in the evening as it does in the morning after application. I really love this stuff!

I received this product for free from SK-II to share my honest opinion about it. I have been using this cream as my morning and night time cream for a month now. It works great for both morning (under my makeup) and night. First of all I have sensitive/combination skin and have a hard time finding a moisturizer that doesn’t leave my T zone overly oily but hydrated the other parts of my face. A little goes a long way and it leaves my skin super soft (even after I wash my face). I also like the light rose scent and the rose gold packaging looks gorgeous in my cabinet.

I received this for free to review from SK-II. This is an honest review and all opinions are my ownThis product works very well. I have normal skin. I only apply it at night and I have actually just used it every other night. My skin never feels greasy. I tried applying it every 12 hours and I felt it was too much. I just using  it every other night has worked very well for my skin type. The great thing about this is that the product will last even longer. It doesn’t cause me to have any breakouts. I was kinda concerned this might happen because this has happened with other brands in the past. The packaging is pretty and I like the wand to dip out the product so it doesn’t get under your nails.I plan on purchasing this product on my own once I run out of the sample I was given.

I absolutely love this SK-II face cream. I have dry skin year around, and at times can be insecure about it. I have noticed a huge difference in my skin since using this product. My skin looks and feels healthy and radiant. My face stays moisturized all day, so no need to reapply. The packaging is beautiful. I like that they give you a little tool to scoop the product out. The texture is soft and smooth, and a little definitely goes a long way. I received this product for free from SK-II, and I am so thankful. I am proud of my skin again.

I received this product from SK-II to test out in exchange for an honest review. After using SKII-LXP Ultimate Revival Cream for about two weeks straight, I noticed a difference in my skin. It feels smoother, firmer, and well-hydrated. The cream smells amazing. It’s a rose floral scent that isn’t too sweet or overpowering. The container it comes in is gorgeous and looks great sitting on my counter, and I absolutely love that it comes with a tool to get the product out of the container because sometimes I don’t like the idea of sticking my fingers into a jar every night even though my hands are clean. The scoop also helps you get the right amount for your face as you don’t need a lot of product! Everything about this product makes me excited to use it. It is worth noting that the cream takes a little while to absorb, so it’s good to massage this into your skin about an hour before you get in bed so you don’t feel like you have a face covered in cream that will get all over your pillowcases. Overall, it’s an excellent moisturizer to use at night and gives great results within just a few uses.

I would like to thank SK-II for the opportunity to try this product! I feel super lucky that I was chosen to test this SK-II LXP Ultimate Revival Cream for free in exchange for providing my honest feedback in return. I’ve been using the SKII-LXP Ultimate Revival Cream for almost a month now and I absolutely love it. I have normal to dry skin, get plenty of sun (that Texas sun!), and am in my mid-30s. First of all, I am a designer so the packaging design was a major plus for me. The container is a gorgeous golden color and the scoop is pretty yet practical. The cream smells and feels very rich and luxurious to me. I see that a lot of people are complaining about the smell, but I actually really love it. I scoop a pea-sized amount and warm it up in my hands before applying. It’s amazing as a night cream and does feel a little sticky after application but I feel like the moisture gets locked in after a little while. In the morning I just touch up on areas that need some moisture... I used to have to apply a moisturizer and then a primer before applying my makeup, but now I don’t. I feel like this is already doing the work and my skin feels great throughout the day. I lean towards a dewy look with my makeup so if you like a more matte finish, you may want to pass on this one. It’s been great to reduce fine lines like the ones on my forehead! lol. They used to linger even after I stop making faces, but now the wrinkles disappear when my face is neutral. It is very pricey, but I still would definitely recommend. I think I used maybe less than ¼ of the jar applying both night and day so the product should last a long time.

I was given this product for my review.  The packaging is fabulous.  Rose gold with an included spatula, and a place that spatula can be stored.  The directions tell me how to apply but not WHEN-  is it a night cream?  Is it a day cream?  Do I apply AM and PM?It is very expensive, with that said, a little goes a long way so it may last me forever.  since no directions came, I have only been using this as a night cream, I find it to heavy for day wear.It is a very light clean fragrance and offers premium moisture benefits.

First, and foremost, I would like to thank SK-II for the opportunity try this product. I feel very lucky that I was chosen to test SK-II Ultimate Revival Cream, for free in exchange for providing my honest feedback in return. I have been using the Ultimate Revival Cream for a month now.On that note, here goes:Packaging: The product is packaged very well. It is classy looking and I really like the container it is in. The included spatula is very helpful in taking out the perfect amount to put on your skin, and added bonus there is a slot for it on the base of the cream, so it stays with the product as opposed to it being separate. Now on to the actual product reviewThe good: The product DOES work. I live in Las Vegas, so it is a very dry desert climate. While we have a water softener in our home, your skin still dries out living here. SK-II Ultimate Revival Cream does a fabulous job keeping my face moisturized 24/7. I apply it both in the morning, prior to my make-up and again at night before bed. I spend the day with my face feeling fresh and not dry or itchy. A note of caution, a little goes a VERY long way. If you use too much, you will have a greasy feeling on your face. Simply use less cream the next time until you find your perfect amount. The good thing about a little going a long way is that the product will last for quite some time. I did try to use the cream the way they recommend (putting it on my palms and rubbing my hands together, I felt I lost too much that way to my hands. I had to use more than I wanted to transfer the product to my face. Now I dot much like you would using foundation and apply that way.The smell is very subtle, it smells very nice but it is not overpowering at all. The not so good: I wish it contained SPF. I have very fair skin and so I have to apply any additional sun screen if I will be outside. Typically, I prefer keeping straight sunscreen off my fact, luckily my makeup foundation does contain it.I was hoping to see some wonderful anti-aging effects from using this cream and I have not. Then again, the product is not at all marketed as such. Bottom Line:The good: It does do its job moisturizing your skin. It feels very luxurious on my face and my skin feels somewhat silky once it is applied. The not so good: The price is the only thing that would keep me from purchasing this item in the future. The price is also the reason for the 4-star review I would provide.

I received this product from SK-II to review.  The product is so pretty.  Rose Gold!  And I love the slot for the spatula.  Typically I end up losing the spatula because there’s no where to put it, and then I end up using my fingers.  Not in this case.  The spatula has it’s own slot to stay in.  Why can’t other products think of that.The cream itself is very rich.  I don’t think this cream is for everyone.  This works well for dry spots.  I have very bad allergies which causes me to rub my eyes.  I put this cream around my eyes at night, and the dryness has gone away in a couple days.  I will definitely keep using this on spots where needed.  I think this will also work really well in the winter, when my skin is very dry and irritated.  I’m always in need of a rich moisturizer in the winter, but a lot of creams break me out.  This has not broken me at all.  A little goes a long way.  Don’t use too much, or it could get greasy.

I received this for review from SK-II. This is really wow. I think I would give up on every other if I can convince my hubby that this is the perfect holiday and birthday gift. If only my birthday were more than 3 days away from our big holiday—time to problem solve (hehehe). SK-II LXP Ultimate Revival Cream is nothing short of amazing. It comes in a Rose Gold cylindrical container!! Rose Gold! How very very perfect is that? It also comes with a teensie tiny spatula, which at first I thought ‘meh’, but yes, I did indeed want to use it. I just dip it right into the little pot of creamy wonderful stuff and apply directly onto my t zone, chin and cheeks. No, I did not follow the directions and apply it to my palms and rub it together. I’m not sure who came up with those instructions but how incredibly nope. Then what? Rub my palms all over my face—lol, I’m dying just thinking what my husband will think if he catches me doing that. Well, I would scream if I caught anyone wasting this pricy stuff on the palms of their hands. And do you know the reason: so that you can get the scent to come out, like when you rub dried spices to brighten the seasoning. Just no and absolutely not. Believe you me, this stuff works and it’s not b/c of some aromatherapy mumbo-jumbo b/c science ppl. Yes, a relaxing scent could reduce your frowning but again, no. (it doesn’t smell strongly of roses either--the smell is just meh). After that, I noticed it fading away and my skin wanted the cream again. As far as packaging goes, I love how elegant it looks. This is a tough one to answer, only because it is situational. If you have been using a million products and can’t find THE ONE that makes your skin up to your standards, then this might be your holy grail, and therefore, it could be worth it. Also, like I said, I was able to stop using my makeup primer, and so I am saving money from having to purchase primers now. However, personally, my primer plus moisturizer plus my moisture spray that I gave up for this product does not equal or even come close to the price of this product. I also don’t have any fine lines or wrinkles on my skin so I can’t say whether this product improves any aging. I also don’t care for fancy packaging, I just look for functionality in it. So, for me, it is not worth the price. I think there can be equally amazing products out there for a third of the price. Other have mentioned pilling, this has happened before, but Inkey when I apply too many serums beforehand or go to heavy handed with the cream. While I have just turned 30, this has made a huge improvement in my skin for someone within my age/skin-type. I have only used this for about a month, so I cannot speak to the effectiveness of it upon wrinkles, lines, sagging, etc. It is unrealistic to expect to see results in days or even weeks when using a topical product, and of course nothing is going to give results like plastic surgery or fillers or botox. That being said, this product is very moisturizing, so if you are having issues with dry skin, especially with the colder weather or higher altitude living, I recommend trying this. I have been using it morning and night and it does diminish the fine lines that are due to dryness. I have the raspberry shade. It looks really pretty on but I find it dries my lips out rather than hydrate! I think you can find a better gloss for the price!
J’adore absolument tout se ce produit. L’odeur est agréable, la texture est wow, look subtil mais hyper féminin et très hydratant !
It holds for a long time, my favorite gloss ever. Even the marine joncas one is not as good. Buy this one

I have lip oils from all price ranges, from Nyx to Hermes and this is definitively the best bang for your buck. The smell is divine, the applicator is nice, it stays for a decent time and #04 even leaves a dash of color after the oil effect is gone.

I love this so much! It smells like raspberries and shortcake but it doesn’t have a taste at all thankfully! I use this in the daytime instead of lip balms, lip gloss and lipstick and it’s amazing. In the night I use the laneige lip mask. These two products helped my lips go from chapped and crusty to so smooth and soft!
I love the smell of the strawberry lip comfort oil and how it feels on my lips. It feels very moisturizing too. Will definitely buy again and buy other scents. It is very comforting for me.
Best lip oil out there :) Very hydrating, beautiful on the lips but not sticky! N

I honestly didn’t expect to loce this product as much as I do. I thought it would be thick, sticky and would keep running out of my lip line... and it doesn’t do any of these things. After receiving a sample of the Cherry (not from Sephora), I was so impressed with the product that I have now bought 5 flavors: Honey, Raspberry, Pitaya (Dragonfruit), Cherry and Plum. I’m someone who usually doesn’t put anything on my lips (can’t be bothered), but can’t stop putting in on! Love this stuff!

review_title: even though the color is lovely, it’s a no!

review_text: This is one of my favourite lip oils yet! The formula is very thin, non-sticky and is hydrating while giving you a sheer colour. It is very light on the lips and doesn’t travel outside the lip line which some lip oils do.  I purchased the shade Pitaya and it has a soft sweet fragrance which reminds me of those tube glosses. This particular shade looks very bright in the component but actually enhances my natural lip colour. I am already looking to purchase the other shades. I can’t recommend enough!

I have loved this product for years, and it is so crazy to see everyone going nuts over it all of a sudden.  For years I had the honey colour and I loved wearing it as a nude lip. I recently bought Pitaya to try, and it is such a beautiful colour!! Formulation is obviously the same, and it does stain the lips slightly, which I actually like because even when the oil has worked it’s way off the lip, it doesn’t leave you with nothing there until reapplication.  I do find this has decent staying power, but I would have to reapply several times a day.  I find with the applicator that a lot of the product doesn’t come out on there, so you do have to dip it back in several times. It feels amazing on the lips - not sticky or goopy, just smooth and beautiful and feels moisturizing (although I’m not sure if there are any ingredients in there to support that).  If you love lip oils, this is absolutely going to be a win for you. I also love that they fixed the packaging on this product, because I used to find oil used to get on the outside of the container somehow (so the outside was always oily), but not any more!!
review_title: Have used this lip oil forever!!

review_text: my new go to lip product!! im obsessed with it! its super glossy and hydrating i keep using it instead of my lip balm when my lips are dry! and it smells sooo good

J’adore ce produit. J’ai voulu essayé une autre huile pour les lèvres et celle-ci est parfaite. Non collante et une belle teinte naturelle.
Love it! I have it in two colors (# 5 and #8) and I really like them both! I use it all day every day. It feels great on my lips, smells good and not sticky! Would definitely recommend!

Just got this and love it. Feels silky, not sticky, and the applicator is really nice. Love that there’s zero shimmer. The strawberry colour looks red in the tube, but goes on a really pretty juicy sheer pink. Feels very hydrating.

These are great! I do have to replace them about twice a year but it saves a lot of waste, money, and is softer on my skin than disposable ones.
This is exactly what I wanted! It has one soft side and one slightly rougher side for exfoliation.

super easy to use and easy to wash! makes taking of my makeup so much quicker

very soft and easy to use. I m impatient to put them in the washer and see :)

These are soft and absorbent and wash up really nice.

These work really well. Wish they would put more cotton pads in the box, found it to be expensive for the quantity that you get.

really hard to wash by hand, cotton pads easily fall out of bag when in the washer. mascara and eyeliner stain the cotton pads, leaving a gray/black residue after each use. easier to just double cleanse.

If you are someone who removes their makeup with Micellar water, these reusable pads are for you. Way more practical than the single use pads you toss away. These work great and are exactly as I expected. Make-up can stain them but I’ve had good luck removing a lot of it by handwashing with castile soap from time to time (and machine washing for more routine cleaning).

Quality deteriorated after the first wash. I only use with a toner to wipe my face, no heavy makeup. Would not recommend. I’ve gotten better off etsy.

Only used for light toner and every single one completely falls apart. Whether you use either side. I bought new ones from another brand at a local zero waste store and they’re much better. I’m not sure why sephora failed so hard at these, def bummer since I normally love. Do not waste your money.

Not sure why I haven’t thought of buying this earlier but these are amazing!!! 100% would recommend these cotton pads, they are 100% reusable and the baggie is great for not loosing them in the wash! They work even better than the disposable ones and come out like new every time!!

These are a great way to reduce consumption of traditional cotton pads. So far, these have done a great job. They’re about 75% larger than most cotton pads so you get more surface area. My pads do have some permanent stains from eye makeup removal, but they are laundered, so it’s more of a superficial thing. Definitely wash the pads before your first use. I’m so glad I got these, after a few weeks, I’ve saved money and so long as these continue to perform as well as they do, I don’t see myself going back to traditional disposable cotton pads.

review_title: Why didn’t I do this earlier?

I washed them all before I started using by placing them in the bag and knotting it so they don’t come out of it.  That worked like a charm.  One pad also opened in the seam like one of the reviewers said.  If you don’t mind dirty looking pads all the time then you might like these.  If you’re only using it to apply toner these will work great.  The longevity of these will not be long if you wash them a lot.  If they become too nasty looking I will toss them and go back to disposable cotton pads.

I like these a lot. They are larger than a usual cotton round pad from the drugstore. One side is super soft and the other side is a little more textured. I have two sets, one to remove my eye make up and one to apply my toner with. I keep the sets separate which is easy to do since they have the little laundry bag. Great if you want to reduce waste in your routine.
Definitely want to but more of these! I absolutely love using these now!! I typically would buy just one use cotton pads from Target but I will be purchasing more of these for sure!!

Started to fall apart after the first wash. I use a lot of different reusable cotton pads, and none have pulled up and degraded like these ones do. I never got a chance to use them, as I washed them before my first use.

Better than not reusable cotton pads. I use it with micellar water and my skin looks fresh and better when I use this pads.

I love the two different sides: one for more exfoliation and one that is soft. review_title: Great set of 7 for eco-conscious consumers

review_text: Very useful but hard to launder. They tend to curl after washing which is a bit annoying, but overall satisfied.

Glossier cleanser, on the other hand, leaves my skin super soft and hydrated. It’s actually quite a difference compared to other cleansers. It’s definitely not for makeup removal since it’s so gentle. I always use this as the last step of my double cleansing routine with my Foreo. review_title: One of the best cleansers for my sensitive skin

product_name: Milky Jelly Gentle Gel Face Cleanser

review_text: Literally not a makeup remover, and I guess it’s good it doesn’t advertise as one either. The texture is very creamy and milky, it does have a very light baby powder/floral sweet scent I actually really like. The directions say to use on dry or damp skin, I used on damp skin and it was VERY grippy and thick, I thought it would remove makeup because it almost felt like my oil based makeup remover balm, kinda Vaseline and residue feeling but all that washed away with the water and left nothing behind. Very easy to wash off. I still had mascara all over my eyes though. So I double washed again and still had mascara on my eyes lol. But my actual skin felt sooo soft and conditioned just as advertised. I don’t like to moisturize before I go to bed because I will break out so this is good for me because I feel moisturized without applying any extra product. My skin doesn’t feel heavy or greasy. I like it!!! Just use on bare skin or after you remove all makeup
product_name: Milky Jelly Gentle Gel Face Cleanser

review_text: Have used milky jelly for years as my makeup removing step of a double cleanse and have never had a problem. Ordered a new bottle earlier this month from sephora and immediately could tell something was different. The face wash was much more opaque than normal, and had a slightly different texture. It also left a HORRIBLE film on my face that has never happened before. Since its a first step in my two-step cleanse I said whatever and kept using it since step number 2 removed the film. Well, after using is for a week or so my face has horrible breakouts, and this is the only new part of my routine. Compared ingredients from new/old and its definitely a slightly changed formula and they removed the polyxamer aka the first key ingredient they list here on their website. So sad, not sure how I am going to find a replacement, will be returning.
review_title: Ingredient Change beware! Caused lots of breakouts
product_name: Milky Jelly Gentle Gel Face Cleanser

review_text: My rosacea got so bad that even cerave’s hydrating cleanser made me red, itchy and horribly blotchy. I’m really happy I found this cleanser as it leaves my skin feeling clean and not red/irritated at all. The only thing I would suggest is that if you are washing makeup off your face to double cleanse with something else first and follow with the milk jelly. Personally I use farmacy’s green clean, also quite gentle for my skin. Hope this helps a fellow rosacea sufferer.
product_name: Milky Jelly Gentle Gel Face Cleanser

review_text: This milky cleanser is just ok. I would recommend using it if you double cleanse or if you don’t wear a lot of makeup. It doesn’t really break down makeup well and is very gentle.
product_name: Milky Jelly Gentle Gel Face Cleanser

review_text: Alright so this isn’t a foaming product so I understand why a lot of people feel like this isn’t doing anything but I can confidently say it does work, I tried this to remove makeup (used on dry face) and double cleansed with this and it does clean very well BUT I feel it heavily depends on the kind of makeup you use. For example when I used a tubing mascara it slid it right off my eyes with no hassle but when I had the ysl mascara on it just smudged it and made it worse and I had to the it cosmetics facewash to get rid of it. So this is a good basic facewash but I do feel theres a lot better ones on the market that do much much more. I will however continue to keep using this till I run out cause it does make my skin feel softer and not stripped but I won’t be purchasing. But yeah if you use makeup that smudges this may not be the right facewash to buy but if you don’t wear makeup this is a good basic facewash.

review_text: I purchased this product from the Glossier website as a set with a 1oz bottle of Futuredew (pro tip: Glossier’s products are a fair amount cheaper if you purchase them as sets, so I would find products you like and match them with a set that contains all/most of them!). The bottle of cleanser itself is fairly large, with a pump that dispenses a nice amount. I used to start off my day with two pumps of Glossier’s Milky Jelly Cleanser. It is very gentle and smooth, but I’m still not too sure how effective it really is. It is really good at removing obvious makeup/dirt/impurities from the previous night if there’s any remaining, but you don’t get that “squeaky clean“ feeling that you would get from a product like the Kiehl’s cleanser. That said, it is kind of nice that this product feels almost moisturizing, as opposed to drying, since some cleansers feel that way on the skin! It has a very subtle but nice rose scent, so it’s technically not fragrance-free, but I read in the ingredients that the fragrance is “under 1% and formulated without Acetaldehyde, Acetone, Acetonitrile, Benzalkonium chloride, BPA, EDTA, Methylene chloride, PTFE, PFOA“, so it shouldn’t be overwhelming to most people. Additionally, I have to give props to how this product is Clean at Sephora, cruelty-free, vegan, and formulated without sulfates SLS and SLES - I’m very glad how Sephora has made an effort to bring in more clean beauty products/brands - especially such a mainstream one like Glossier!All in all, a 6oz bottle of this cleanser lasted me just under a year, which is really good considering I used two pumps of this 1-2 times a day. It’s not the cheapest cleanser at $19, but I would say if you’re looking for a gentle cleanser that feels soft on the skin, I would splurge on this. However, if you’re looking for a sudsy, more “squeaky clean“ feeling cleanser that strips skin of everything (potentially including a bit of moisture, if you’re okay with that), I’d go with something else.

It forms a layer of protection on the lips. Can wear off after a few hours but it helps keep lips moisturized under face mask well. Although I think it is just a tad light for an overnight lip balm.

I wanted not to like this lipgloss because of the price but this so far is my favorite lipgloss. I use the La Mer lip balm first and my lips feel SO hydrated and not dry at all. My lips very easily become dry and flaky but with this and the lip balm my lips feel great. For someone like me with such dry lips this is a keeper. I just wish they had a slightly darker color or other colors with the same formula. It doesn’t so much plump but it does smooth your lips and keeps them nice and hydrated if you wear the lip balm underneath. Its expensive but I feel I’ve spent so much more on a bunch of other glosses I rarely use.
I came here just to state that upon first seeing this pop up in my feed u thought it was a screwdriver.

Here is the deal with this... it’s a nice product but I feel way too expensive for what it is, which is a lip gloss.  I saw no difference in the volume of my lips.  The color is nice, feels good on my lips and the packaging has weight, but seriously save your money. You can get the same effect with a less expensive brand!

OK, it is basically a lip gloss. Maybe not exactly earth-shattering and what “plumping“ effects there are are mild, but I find it completely lovely to use. Plush with plenty of slip but not at all sticky. Smells like their lip balm, a sweet but not candyish vanilla-mint, and has a nice lip oil type large applicator. Personally, I wouldn’t rely on this alone for serious moisture or healing but it is definitely the one I love using the most among my 20 zillion lip balms/oils/etc. Is it worth $75? Ugh, how to answer that for a splurge item??
review_title: Gods help me, I love this.

review_text: Very useful for my lip and it feels super comfortable, and it’s better than the Hourglass’s one.
Not worth the cost and does not actually plump your lips.

It tastes so good I have to stop myself from licking it all off my lips at once. It adds the glossiness without feeling like your lips are suffocating in wax, and the cool tingle it gives is borderline addictive. Thank you, la mer, for ruining the other peasant lip glosses for me.
Beautiful packaging (of course, check the price $ ), looks nice on the lips when applied; however, it is very drying and made my lips itchy.

I bought this for my daughter. She loves it. She said it gives just the right volume to her lips. They don’t look unnatural. She also said it keeps her lips moisturized all day. Once again, it’s pricey but worth the quality.

I wanted to love this product, but when I realized it has eucalyptus oil in it, I just couldn’t. Eucalyptus, or any mint oil, or camphor- the worst, actually does the opposite of moisturizing, and it dries out the top layer of lip skin, causing more chapping and peeling. Additionally, look at all of the ingredients! Way too many unnatural ingredients going onto lips, which go into the mouth, which end up in your system. You really are better off with an inexpensive Shea butter lip treatment, that moisturizes and protects, with few ingredients.
review_title: No eucalyptus/mints/camphors should go on lips!

beyond amazed by the results of this product. i got compliments all day!!

review_title: LA MER.. LA MER.. LA MER

review_text: Received this as a gift because I love all things la mer.  Struggle with dry lips and this has made my lips so soft and smooth.  I absolutely love it!  No color just shine.

I would recommend this product it you don’t mind the price and looking for a good “naturale“ gloss look that moisturizes your lips. i do not recommend if you are looking for a lip plumper. if you are price sensitive, don’t bother.
review_title: not a good volumizer, excellent moisturizing gloss

review_text: I am a huge La Mer fan and don’t usually question the price because it is fabulous; however, this product is not worth the price. It is nice and silky and offer a nice initial shine but it is short lived and does not do anything to plump my lips. If you want a nice convenient La Mer lip balm in a pretty tube that you do not stick your finger in then this fits the bill, but that’s about it. I gave it 2 stars because I do like the product but it does not do what it says it does. So if you want La Mer, stick with the lip balm in the little jar and if you want a lip plumping shiny gloss stick with the Sephora Outrageous Effect Volume Lip Gloss for $15.
I love this product and everything about it! It’s smooth, shiny, natural and smells like mint. Definitely will buy again. Hey, those complaining about the price? Well, it is Lamer!
My go to lip balm. Totally worth the money.

I was kinda scared to buy this with all the not so good reviews...but aren’t I glad I’ve tried this! I love the cooling feel this leaves on the lips! It makes my lips feel plumped and youthful. Yesss it is a little sticky but nothing more than a ysl lipgloss. If you are looking for a lip volumizer I would def recommend you to try this!

I’ve never tried La Mer but several friends rave about it. I already have a beauty regimen I love but have been looking for a great lip plumber so thought I’d try the brand. Omg- what a disappointment!!! This product did absolutely nothing. I’ve had more results from the $5 stuff at Ulta :( I will be returning.

this gloss is subtle, and probably should be called a lip smoother instead of plumper ONLY because there are others that plump more.  if you’re expecting bee-stung, this ISNT that. review_title: perfect all day every day gloss

review_title: Way better then TF lip injections extreme

review_text: It’s very similar to Dior Lip Maximizer in terms of consistency and minty flavour, but costs twice as much. Not worth the price. Packaging is nice, but I didn’t see any visible plumping.
I love this gloss for the plump juicy look of it. I don’t think this is super moisturizing but I don’t really think that is what it is for.

Slight minty smell and flavor but fades pretty quickly. It lasts longer than any gloss I’ve ever owned. Non-sticky imo It slightly plumps the lips with zero sting and keeps lips smooth and super soft long after it wears off.

It’s volumizing in a way that plumps fine lines via hydration. It doesn’t sting. It is somewhat effectively volumizing. It has a minty fresh taste like the La Mer lip balm but in a more convenient and glossier format. It feels very luxurious and I thought it was quite nice. I might consider splurging again. I wish the tube or it’s contents weren’t pink though. Clear like the balm would have been ideal.

This has a taste like the LaMer balm but it’s shinier, silkier, more minty and it has a slllight satin/shimmer tint.  It makes your lips feel super moisturized and look perfectly healthy and shiny.  It doesn’t last as long as say the Bite Agave lip balm/masks but I think it’s because 1) it’s a lot silkier/thinner and 2) it tastes good so I keep smacking my lips together.  I love this.  I’m buying another for my purse and probably another for my work bag.  Lots of $$$ for lip stuff but this is worth it to me.  Love it.
I purchased this when it was released in the La Mer website, I really enjoy this product! It really hydrated and gives your lips that beautiful plum pout. It has a minty taste and a very nice shine!
Feels amazing!!! It Offers pumping without the burn but not so much where you look ridiculous. I already have big lips so for me what this does is smooth them out. I’ll continue buying this

Purchased off lamer when it can out, had high hopes.. failed miserably..this is sticky, minty with a bitter taste and doesn’t plump at all.  It caused my lips to get red around the border. It’s clear in color and I couldn’t tell if it was hydrating bc I wore less then 30 mins due to the taste and irritation. Their original lip balm is good, this not so much. Packaging  is beautiful. Sadly had to return.

I don’t know what people expect from a lip balm, is it going to change your life 25 times better than a 3 dollar lip balm? Probably not. But then I have three 3 dollar lip balms I can’t bother to finish but this I get so much use out of it and I already get a back up.It’s a non sticky liquid balm with a mint level of in between the original La Mer balm and Buxum, on me I can feel the mint after couple of hours. And because they use menthol PCA instead of just menthol, it also delivery hydration instead of dry out your lips. And I actually see the volumizing effect because I want my lips to be smaller but they got fuller...........it’s luxury if it makes you happy and won’t break your bank account why not.

review_title: Does not live up to its claims.

review_title: I love Renergie Lift Multi-Action Night Cream!

the best product I’ve found for my skin!

A healthy moisture barrier will prevent so many other skin issues that people frequently struggle with, so a product like this is a good investment. I’ve tried a couple of other cult classic products (Stratia Liquid Gold and Krave Great Barrier Relief) that are formulated with the moisture barrier in mind, but I think this is my favorite as far as user experience goes. review_text: Wow! I must be one of the few people that Dr. Brandt’s Pearl Serum did not work for. At first, I was really excited to get a hold of this product. The closest I can describe the feeling is that it was though it was covered by a layer of saran wrap! It did finally absorb. I then applied my regular facial products on top of the serum. I waited until everything dried and then applied my makeup. Ten minutes after that, I felt an inner dryness in my skin! It was a very uncomfortable feeling! The serum was the only new product I applied that day.I waited a few days before I dared to try the product again. I thought maybe I may have applied too much serum the first time. So, I was very careful in applying a very thin layer. I’m really glad I decided to try this product. I just recently went back to school and working a full time job as an orthopedic RN and boy does this help me get thru the day at work and assignments. Amazing!!! Will certainly be purchasing again.!!

My girlfriend gave me this for a birthday gift when I turned 42 this year, and I’ve been hooked ever since.  I add it to my coffee or smoothie, and I definitely feel like my pistons are firing a little more smoothly for it.
This stuff makes me feel calm and balanced.  I’m sticking with it.

eye cream itself is not bad, but after every time you use it, the  bit remaining in the pump dries up and then gets pushed out the next time you use it. So there is a lot being wasted.

I was gifted by Kate Sommerville in exchange for a honest review. was hesitant to buy this product because it was so expensive.  A little bit goes a long way and the results are worth it tho! Very nice formulation.  The container is nice, because it is delivering a fresh product every time. It just goes on so smooth and does not interfere with make up. Beautiful product.

The best eye cream I have found to plump undereyes and minimize wrinkles. There are not many options for treating this area like Botox, so I’m picky. This is the only thing topical that actually makes a difference for me. I am 41 and have been using it three years. LOVE it.
My whole family ... three generations love this product !
by go to for eye care and preventative aging. the pump puts out just enough not to waste and it works

I love this product! This is the first eye cream I feel is light enough to wear under my makeup but still works! I’ve also noticed that my dark circles have faded. It is expensive but I can make the bottle last 6 months - use sparingly because a little bit goes a long way

I love this product! I’m on my 4th jar, what is all this talk about glitter?? In my one year of using it not once have seen anything glittery at sparkly! I’m a 60 yr old believer of this product...Thanks Kate!!

This product absolutely did not work at all! The glitter in in makes my eyes water. The fine wrinkles I did have turned into deep crows feet! However my Eyes did not.  it wound up drying up the skin under my eyes and has left one feeling tight and itchy.In trying to be fair, I’d love to try it for a longer period, but my face is telling me “No, this is not agreeing with me.“Plus for $90 for a 15 ml bottle, it’s WAY too expensive  As much as I hate returning things, this has to go back as i don’t want to wait to long, play the “Well, let’s wait and see“ game.  Wishing I could write a glowing review, this is not the product for My eyes and Me.Please don’t waste your money and ask for a sample, then use small amounts of it to see if it will agree with you or not..

This product was suggested to my by a skin care specialist at Sephora and I was pretty skeptical because of the price tag. I was shocked at my results! I’ve never used an eye cream that was this effective.

this feels really great when applied- definitely worth the price.  My makeup consultant encouraged me to spread any excess on my lips as a primer which was a great and very useful suggestion.  I love the smell and feel of the product- I will definitely buy this again!

review_text: I’ve used a number of different eye creams over the years on my 40 something skin. This one is amazing and one of my favourite. Great moisture and lightens my struggle with dark circles. Smell could be improved, but isn’t offensive.

You guys, I don’t know what it was, because I usually LOVE Kate eye creams; but this really didn’t do well on my skin. It felt dry and ‘powdery’ under my eye, if that makes sense. The consistency of the product was also very different as well, when contrasted with other eye creams. It’s a no from me unless you layer it with another hydrating eye cream which to me defeats the purpose. Or maybe an eye serum needs to be implemented into the routine then you layer this over? I wanted to love this though.
I honestly cancelled my appointment to my cosmetic dermatologist!!! This product is amazing and seemed to work almost immediately!  My under eye area was brighter and so smooth! Bravo, LOVE!!!
Love this eye cream....have repurchased as it seems to diminish the lines around my eyes.

I like that it’s unscented and glides on.  It does minimize the appearance of fine lines and hydrates but it just doesn’t go far enough.  I augment with a richer eye cream.  It’s more like a thicker serum but a tad overpriced for what it delivers.
I had very high hopes for this product but unfortunately it didn’t work for me. It is hydrating but that’s about it. To me it’s not worth the price.

I was very disappointed, no improvements, you pay $75 for glitter under your eyes. I used it for 3 months- looks like i did not use any cream for 3 months at all, skin started to look worst than before (
Was disappointed to find that there is glitter in the formula. One thing I am not looking for in an eye cream is glitter. Will be returning.

I don’t see any improvement for my under eyes other than a little brightening effect. When you rub the product on your finger, you can see that it has an iridescent sheen that has a brightening effect. I HATE HATE HATE the packaging of it- which is why I am going to return it. After EACH use, every squirt that I press in the morning has a thick dried up glob that comes out first, wasting a lot of my product. I cap it up every time right after I use the product so I don’t know why it is drying up every day.  Not worth the price I paid if I keep having to throw away a good chunk of the product. It DOES hydrate and absorb quickly into the skin, which is great when using under concealer!

I’ve been using this for about 3 weeks. I really like it. I’m a person that hates oily products and I am very picky of products that claim to be “oil free“, but this is a perfect consistency. I like the feeling and half a pump is all you need for both eyes. I do see a change in my eyes. They look brighter, less puffy, lifted, and cooler.

I had never heard of this line until a recent visit. I have to say, it’s the best feeling eye cream I’ve tried to date, and I must have tried hundreds by now! Doesn’t cause burning or redness and really seems to hydrate and make me look younger and less tired.

This is the first eye cream that has not made my eye lids and corners burn and peel.  I have very sensitive eyes and have tried a ton of different eye creams over the years. Recently tried a sample and it actually helped heal my dry peeling skin. Not sure about anti-aging part but GREAT for sensitive skin/eyes!!!!! and it is expensive but you barely use any cause it is a thicker lotion so a little goes a very long way.

I decided to give this a try after using some at the store during a skin care class. This is the only eye cream I’ve ever used that actually lived up to any of its claims. After a few weeks of use, I can definitely see a reduction in puffiness under my eyes and my dark circles are almost gone. Another plus - you need only the tiniest amount to cover the entire eye area, much less than any other eye cream I’ve used, so the price tag isn’t so hard to take. I highly recommend this product.

I feel like this sat on top of my skin and maybe balled up a little bit. Did not feel like it smoothed out my under eye area which was a first for an eye cream. I felt like even my regular moisturizers smooth my eye area out better than this. Maybe it’s just me...

I received free samples of this during my last visit to Sephora and loved it. It’s a rich eye cream that goes on smoothly. I wear it during the day under my make-up and apply it at night before I head to bed. Other eye creams I’ve used have caused watery, buring eyes, probably because I’m allergic to one or more of the ingredients. I’ve never had a problem like that with this cream. It’s great for sensitive skin. I highly recommend this.

I received a deluxe sample that has lasted a few weeks. I’m 45 & have been using Caudalie’s eye cru. It’s a great hydrating cream - BUT - after a week of using Age Arrest, I found it equally moisturizing, absorbs nicely & fast - & important for my 45 year-old eyes - reduced fines lines & seems to firm the upper lid area, too. Even my BOSS noticed & said I looked refreshed! Nothing changed but my eye cream. FYI, I feel my age shows mostly in my eyes - I’ve had bags since I was 28 & when I’m stressed or tired at work, it shows in my eyes. This product masks that, too! But it took a week for results.

I’m 32, and have just a couple fine lines forming around my eyes. I wanted to fade those, but my primary concerns were puffiness and dark circles. I’ve tried lots of different eye creams from Sephora and not only have they not helped reduce puffiness and dark circles, they seem to dry out my undereye area as well. This one is different: it’s effective in every way it claims!You should know that the results of this cream aren’t instant. I’m writing this review after having used it for 5 weeks. But after those 5 weeks I can’t believe how much my dark circles have lightened up--I barely even have to wear concealer anymore! After about 1 week my eyes started to be less puffy and now I hardly have any puffiness at all which makes for a beautiful wide-awake look and better makeup application. The fine lines around my eyes have started to fade too, and I hope that continues. But best of all my undereye area is always super hydrated. With other eye creams it was dry and my foundation and concealer would crack and crumble on it. But this eye cream has made my undereye area smoother, firmer, and more moisturized for younger-looking skin and perfect makeup application.The only real downside to this cream is the smell. It’s a gross yellow color and smells disgusting. But given the miracles it works, I think I can easily tolerate that. If you have the same issues I do, I highly recommend you try this cream. I think you’ll be as satisfied with your purchase as I am.

This cream is good for hydrating and is fine for sensitive skin. However, at this price, I was expecting more from this cream. There are less expensive products that are just as good, I will not buy this cream again.

This eye cream is EVERYTHING! I’ve been using it for about 2 months. I have extremely sensitive eyes, and this is the only eye cream that didn’t irritate me. Other eye creams can be drying, but this gives the right amount of hydration I need. My fine lines and wrinkles diminished dramatically. It also brightens and lifts! The consistency is a bit thick compared to other eye creams, but that doesn’t bother me! Holy grail eye cream! DEFINITELY worth the price!

I received a sample of this product and I brought it to use while on vacation in Southern California. I was so smitten, I purchased it upon returning home. It kept my eye area moisturized in the hot sun, it didn’t irritate my eyes (as a contact wearer, this is a huge concern), and it worked as stated. It applied smoothly and absorbed quickly. My under eye area is soft and after 3 weeks of use, it seems as if the wrinkles are less pronounced.

I have tried all kinds of expensive eye creams but this one rocks!!! I have seen an improvement in my dark circles, the fine lines around my eyes and my eye is hydrated and not dry anymore! I am happy with this eyes cream, you must try!!!!!!
Feels nice but does nothing as promised....save your money

This is my favorite new favorite eye cream, and I’m super picky! I have really sensitive skin especially around my eyes. This cream is extremely hydrating, and my wrinkles and dark circles seem to have diminished some. I will definitely purchase this again!

Until now, most eye creams I’ve tried just seem to moisturize my eye area. This stuff reduces puffy morning eye, erases fine lines, tightens the skin and of course moisturizers. I have not seen a huge reduction in dark circles yet, but it’s just week two of using the product. If in a months time the dark circles are gone I would rate the product a five. It absorbs quickly so makeup application in the morning is a breeze. Love this eye cream!

I have run the gamut with eye creams-my main concerns being dark circles/bags under my eyes, and the prevention of wrinkles. I have sensitive skin and almost every eye cream I’ve tried leaves me in tears-literally! This is one of the very few eye creams on the market that don’t cause my eyes to water like crazy, and I absolutely love how moisturizing it is, without being greasy. It absorbs well, really helps with my dark circles, and does have a faint, but pleasant, almost earthy smell. I received a sample of this, and it was more than generous, lasting well over a week. Will be purchasing the full size as soon as my current cream runs out. Love, love, love! Dare I say this is my new HG eye cream? FANTASTIC product!

I have been using a really expensive chanel cream without much change other than it is moisturizing. Before that I was using a cream from my plastic surgeon (he does my botox) which also was moisturizing but little else. Now this stuff is the bomb! I used for 2 days as a sample and noticed much more smooth skin under my eyes and less discoloration. Very moisturizing as it contains hyaluronic acid so I’m not sure why other reviews didn’t think it was! I just went and bought the full size of this and the skin cream and hope the skin cream does as much as the eye cream has!

I got this in a large free sample size and assumed it would be just like all other “hyped“ eye creams,I was quickly proven wrong. This cream works exceptionally fast and well, within an hour of the first small application to each under eye and upper eye lid, I noticed immediate tightening of my upper eye lids,which made application of eye shadow flawless without even using a primer and my weary look under my eyes had not completely disappeared, this was the first use, but it made my skin brighter and seem not so dark and left them very tight. This is a superb , high quality eye cream , possibly one of the best - definitely worth its price !

This stuff is magic in a potl! Saw results after only a few days! The crepey-ness under my eyes is practically gone! I haven’t noticed any improvement in my dark circles, but I didn’t expect to to anyway. The texture of this cream is very silky so a little goes a long way. I’ve used it under makeup and had no issues.

I defiantly see a difference over the past month and don’t understand the bad comments about it . LOVE THIS !!!!!

Made my skin burn and itch. Also had a gritty texture and did not seem to moisturize. Very disappointed for the price, but might work better for you if you don’t have an allergic reaction to it. On a positive note its a pretty good size and it is very thick so seems like it would last a long time.
This is a good eyecream for lift, elasticity and wrinkles, but it does not leave a smooth texture for applying makeup, so I use it at night instead of my original intention to use it in the morning.

I received an adequate sample of this and in a few days I noticed a significant improvement in the fine lines under my eyes. One thing I love about this is that it keeps the skin under my eyes hydrated throughout the day. I’ve used far too many creams that leave my eyes looking dry after only a couple of hours. After I finished my sample, I noticed the fine lines starting to appear again, so I made sure to get a jar of this and my eyes definitely look better again!
I love the smell! So tropical. It also feels great as an exfoliate without having hard bits that scrape my skin. I had a sample and ended up buying a full size as I loved it.
I absolutely love this! It smells amazing and leaves my face so soft.

Love this scrub! It smells AMAZING and the scent reminds me of summer. My skin feels so smooth after using it and while the sugar does melt quickly, if you use dryish hands and not too wet of a face, (as well as top it off with extra scrub where you’d like more exfoliation) you’ll be just fine!
Honestly love this so much. I feel like it does keep blackheads at bay and I use it about twice a week. Not stripping on my skin and it’s super sensitive.

This has been a BO miracle for me. For whatever reason, this summer, my armpits have decided they hate me. I’ve never really had this problem and regular soap and deodorant have always been effective. It’s gotten so bad though that literally every new product I get in beauty boxes goes straight to my armpits. I have been using this to scrub my armpits every day for the last week and it’s been keeping my stank at bay. I mean, don’t get me wrong, I still smell like a regular person at the end of the day. Bodies produce odor and there’s nothing you can do to completely stop that. But before this scrub, I couldn’t even get the smell off at all no matter what I did. It keeps me feeling cleaner throughout the day. I think it may have to do with the enzymes breaking down the bacteria and odors. It’s gentle enough that it doesn’t cause any irritation either from the enzymes or the sugar (the sugar dissolves rather quickly). They feel smooth and healthy afterwards. I will 100% be buying this again.

I received this in my monthly Allure Beauty Box and I used it last night for the first time. First thing I noticed was the amazing smell. I love this product. Does a great job cleansing my skin without drying it out and the smell is amazing.

I love this scrub! I have sensitive skin with rosacea and sometimes need a more physical exfoliant to deal with buildup while still not being too rough or harsh. This product is gentle yet effectively exfoliates. Highly recommend!

I would recommend if it’s on sale, hence the 4 stars!

This is the first time I have used a facial scrub, and it has been great to use so far. It leaves my skin feeling clean and smooth. The product also has a nice scent to it. i would definitely consider purchasing another bottle. I received this product complementary from Influenster.

this exfoliator left my skin super soft and hydrated. This is my favorite product from tula! works well on sensitive skin. Works gently but strong.

This review was incentivized for my honest review. I would continue using this. I would also recommend the Tula brand to family and friends, especially the ones that are into sugar scrubs

I have received this product complimentary from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I truly enjoyed using the scrub as it felt very nice on the face and left the face very moisturized after. Would be re purchasing this scrub
