review_text: The scrub did a nice job of cleansing my face. The sugar in it makes you feel like you are scrubbing out any impurities. I did find that it dissolved quickly once I started to rub it around. It would have been nice if wasn’t so quick to dissolve. Overall it left my skin feeling clean and fresh.

This exfoliator has a sweet smell, with a powerful scrubbing power. I have combination skin that leans more oily in the summer with extreme dryness in the winter and with the season changing it has been very flip floppy. I tried this product for a month and had no issues and it left my skin feeling very clean. I have super sensitive skin so I did end up with some redness immediately after using but that went away quick. As a firefighter I am always looking for the best way to scrub potentially dangerous substances off of my face and skin and this does the trick without being too damaging, nor does it have the strong scent that most products do.

Honestly can I just take a moment to say this is the BEST smelling product I have ever used, it smells like the beach. I am in love, this exfoliator is so Gentle on my sensitive skin, leaving it so soft and moisturized. I am SOLD!

This scrub is great for anyone who has sensitive skin. Normally I find that other scrubs are too harsh for my skin, but because of the natural ingredients in this, I don’t feel it’s harsh at all. I do find the sugars do dissolve quickly so you gotta use more product or less water on the face but otherwise great product!

This product definitely exceeded my expectations. I have combination skin (mostly oily) and this didn’t dry my skin out nor did it make it feel greasy afterwards. It’s done an amazing job at buffing away all the dead skin on my face and it leaves my face feeling so soft and nourished afterwards. I haven’t tried a probiotic skincare product before, so I’m not sure on how much this works in that area, but it’s something I will definitely be adding into my regular skincare routine! Definitely would recommend this product!

This was a pretty nice scrub. I enjoyed how gentle the exfoliation felt while still doing it’s job, although sometimes I had to use a little more product because the sugar seemed to dissolve really quickly. I really love the scent of this scrub too since it’s not anything too crazy. Another complaint I have is the price point for it. It’s a nice scrub but if I hadn’t gotten this to test, I probably wouldn’t have bought it.

I received this product for free from Tula and Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I love the way this product makes me skin feel afterwards. review_text: This product absolutely works, if you use it as I describe below. The problem with any product that volumizes is that almost no one will know how to use it. Therefore, the reviews are mediocre, and then few people use it, and it eventually gets discontinued. I noticed results in about 1.5 weeks. I came here specifically to leave a review, knowing before I came that they would be awful, in hopes to educate people and thereby keep this wonderful cream in production.How to use it:You must use this or other volumizing product to *contour*. Meaning, you do not use it all over your face, but in specific areas that you want to plump. If you use it all over, you will not notice much of an effect. In fact, this could be counter productive in making you look bloated.I’m using this solely on the hollow areas under my eyes, my upper cheeks, a bit on my neck, forehead, and the back of my hands. Depending on where you have volume/fat loss, you may also use it on your temples, tops of feet, around elbows/knees. Look at younger photos of yourself to see where you have lost volume. Watch videos of doctors explaining fillers and look at before/after photos of fillers to see where to apply.I dab on a small amount it after my serums and before my facial cream. My pores are prone to clogging, but I haven’t had a problem with this. Maybe because I’m using it sparingly, and only in areas where it’s needed.Within about 1-2 weeks of use, I noticed those areas where I had used it were more filled out and looked more plump and youthful.I highly suspect this effect from this product is temporary (it’s based on peptides, which work quickly but are temporary in my experience). I have used Volufiline, which is a permanent topical that regrows your fat. It does work (again, contour with it as described above), but it does a certain amount and then no more. THE OIL AND EXFOLIATING CRYSTALS COMBO IS GENIUS!!! This is my favorite exfoliator by far and doesn’t irritate my desert-worthy dry skin. My skin feels comfortable but clean after exfoliating. I usually bite the bullet when I try new products because there’s a high chance my skin will freak out! But this one is a winner!!!The exfoliating sugar/sea salt crystals aren’t too rough but still very effective. The oil feels very comfortable and luxe and smells like their Renewal Oil. The oil itself doesn’t feel too thick and washes off easily. It protects my dry skin when I exfoliate, and I feel that it’d also help if I overexfoliated. It also makes me clean my face more thoroughly - making sure that I get everything off. The ingredients list is wonderful as well. I absolutely love, love, love this this! It’s pricey but worth the results and comfort!!!

review_text: I wanted to hate it, ladies, gents and folks.  I gave it 4 stars because of price. Over $100 for a face scrub!!  Ugh.  I suffer from dry skin and rosacea.  I got the rosacea under control with a wash, cream and oral pill and to help keep my skin dewy and healthy this was recommended to me.  I waited until I’ve been through 3 tubes of the stuff.    Maybe you’ll hate it...?  All I know is that I normally need moisturizer within 10 seconds of a shower or face wash.  I actually forgot moisturizer the other day.  Unheard of for me!!!!!  It leaves my skin soft, dewy and glowing.  My moisturizer sinks in so much faster after use, too.  I use it approx 3-4x per week.   I’m not overly fond of the smell,  I can’t place it but it’s not my thing.  But I can’t complain about the results.  It does not irritate my sensitive skin, it sloughs off dead/dry skin, it leaves my skin feeling smooth and refreshed.   I included a flare up photo of my rosacea and what my skin looks like currently.

A wonderful way to treat yourself. I’ve tried a bunch of scrubs but find this truly to be one of the best. A little goes a long way and tube should last awhile. Smells great. Skin is soft afterwards. I’ve tried a lot of La Mer. This is hands down one of their best products.

I find using this product paired with the regenerating or hydrating serum vs the contour serum works best to give an extra hydrating effect. ( then lamer soft cream).

All in all, this was one of my favorite self tanners for the body, out of the many I have tested & tried. I always find myself going back to this one. It’s easy to use for a mom on the go like myself, no rinsing, no waiting an hour to dry before you get dressed, no funky smells as you sweat, plus it makes your skin feel like silk, & gives a perfect natural tan. My new fave ordinary product. Smooths texture immediately and can visibly see a difference. Feels oily at first but then soaks in really nicely. I only use 3-4 drops in the morning and my skin has never been better! It has completely eliminated those weird bumps.
Nice, clean and refreshing. It makes my skin look smooth. I like it.
Started using it on recommendation, Noticed a visible difference in my skin right away! Use it every day. My skin has started glowing! Can also be used as primer for the dewy Glowy finish!

I apply every morning and then use my sunscreen. It has a nice oily texture and goes on well with 2-3 drops max. Best recommended for dry-combination skin, or even dull, dehydrated skin. I have used for 2 months and it has brightened my skin. Because of the oily texture it adds a glow after application. On the cons side it takes a while to absorb, I would say at least 20 minutes. I think after all I will continue using it. PLEASE REMEMBER TO WEAR SUNSCREEN!!
My favorite The Ordinary Product. Moisturized my skin and reduced sun spots. Serum texture is slightly oily, no tint, non-clogging, and evaporates/absorbs in 30 mins.

I want to love this product. I can tell it has helped my skin. I have dry skin so everything soaks in really fast. This product feels like it sits on top of my skin like it is not absorbing. However, it may be something that I am personally doing wrong. Although, through trial and error (combining different products), I still find this to be true. Maybe it is the nature of the product, I’m not sure. I feel as though my skin isn’t “drinking“ it in very quickly.
review_title: Love it but it sits on my face

review_text: I’m on my second bottle and notice the difference in lightening the dark spots I have on my face due to acne and even a scar I have on my arm. It is on the Oiler side so only one tiny drop is sufficient, no need for more than that. I make sure to rub it in all the way.
Doesn’t absorb in skin. Oily and hard to dry. Not recommended.
Did not notice any difference. Very oily texture. Would like to return.

I don’t know why this serum doesn’t get any buzz compared to their other vitamin c formulas, because this is the best vitamin c serum I’ve tried! It’s perfect for dry, dull skin. My skin has completely changed after using this (it’s been over 2 months now). If you have any discolouration or dullness, you need to incorporate this in your skin care regimen now! Apply a hyaluronic acid serum after and your moisturizer (I use the first aid beauty) and you’re good to go
This product is very hard to absorb. Super oily texture and it burns me after apply. Immediately breakout the day after use. Save your money and get far from this product

I LOVE this product. At first, I hated it because it was giving me weird red splotches on my face. Finally, I realized it was a reaction from when I went in the sun! Now I always make sure I have spf on top of it before going outside and I’ve had no issues. It literally makes your skin glow. It becomes so even, and soft. The serum absorbs quickly, I’m not sure why others think it feels greasy, it does not. But you do need to make sure you’re using a very small amount or it can and will take longer to absorb! This is probably one of my favourite Ordinary products ever. My acne scarring is lightening by the day and my complexion is so much brighter and has a soft look.

I’ve only been using a week, but it’s stickier than the Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate Solution 20% in Vitamin F. I now use the latter in the morning and use this in the evening. Will circle back if I notice anything beneficial or detrimental.

Love this product for brightening skin! It’s helped a lot with my evening my skin tone due to PIH from past acne marks. I mix this with the resveratrol + ferulic acid serum - this combo layered underneath my Elta MD sunscreen makes it an antioxidant powerhouse! On some nights, I will layer this with 0.25% tretinoin and wake up looking so refreshed! Be careful mixing actives though - I’ve worked up to these concentrations over several months and know what my skin can and cannot take - listen to your skin!
review_title: Affordable Vitamin C serum for skin brightening!

review_text: A little too strong for my acne prone skin! If my acne calms down, I will definetly try it again. But I really don’t think it’s suitable for use with active acne.

This VitC has a rather oily consistency despite it being oil-free (check out Deciem website for more detailed info), that to my surprise, my really dry skin actually appreciates. It dries down eventually (a bit longer than my other watery serums) but keeps me moisturized, and is great under makeup – it tames down my dry patches. Be careful of interactions with other active ingredients. I made the mistake of using AHA one day before using this and my face reacted horribly. The Deciem website lists the no-no interactions when using this (including AHA), so do give it a read cause it’s very informative! To compare, The Ordinary’s Ascorbyl Glucoside VitC was fine to use with AHA/BHA, but don’t do it with this one.
review_title: Love it, but be careful of mixing w/ other actives

review_text: I absolutely love this product! For clarification, I am not a dermatologist but I mix two drops of this with 2 drops of the ordinary resveratrol and ferulic acid serum and I am shook and apply daily. I have only been using it for two weeks, but so far, it calms any irritation on my skin (I recently had a nasty breakout from a poor-quality retinol), provides a dewy glow, and fades away dark spots! I can’t ask for anything better. For reference: I have a medium, olive complexion prone to dark spots & acne and a normal skin type.

I normally use the 20% ascorbic acid with E and fruelic acid combo. But since I started prescription strength tretnoid, my skin has been extra sensitive, so I picked this up for the transition. I really enjoy it, since I can still see the benefit of the brighting power of C, minus the irritation. Once I get back to my normal vitamin C, I’ll use this up on my hands and legs.

Even though this is technically not an oil, this formula is the oiliest Vitamin C serum I’ve tried. It does not absorb into my skin. It’s sticky and thick. I’ve used several of Deciem’s other products including the Vitamin C from the Hylamide line, which is also an EAA solution. That one also starts out oily but does dry down. I’m not sure I’ll be able to return this one because of the lockdown but I’m going to order a different formulation of vitamin C from the Ordinary.

This is another win from The Ordinary. It’s a non irritating formula that feels like oil going on. After it dries down/sinks in, it’s a great base for makeup. It has no silicones so it doesn’t break me out like some other vitamin C products. It gives me a glowy look. If you’re extremely shiny or oily it would be better to use before bed because it does add to shinyness.
Amazing product. Skin looks brighter after one use. Would definitely repurchase once it runs out.

Really like what this is doing with my skin since I added it to my regimen. My skin is soft, clear, no breakouts, and my scars are fading. I was using vitamin c initially but this is 10x better. I use this in conjunction with the mandelic acid.

Not sure if I like this, I’m noticing my skin texture is getting bumpy and the tone isn’t getting even at all, in fact I’m noticing red blotches...I don’t have sensitive. skin. I’ve gotten a few pimples since using this and I don’t break out this often.

I’m blown away with the impact this has in my skin. Starting seeing difference right away! Brighter complexion, hydration, non irritating and also gave skin a corset effect. (Might be cause I also use the buffet serum) The ordinary needs to get into more Sephora stores. The results from all the products I have tried are amazing. Just do your research and refer to the ordinary website to get a full understanding of the line and products. (Sephora site is good on the product information but the layout of other site makes it a little less confusing)

I’m 36 with combination skin. Noticed fine line development on forehead and I’ve used a few la mer products before. Absorbs great! Even with the “no rinse out”, didn’t feel any residue. However, I didn’t notice any difference in my fine lines. My skin does feel tight. So I’d recommend this product more for depufffing

I was skeptical at first because I had tried other La Mer products wihtout any difference. I had tried the mini version of this first and It felt great and I thought I was noticing some firming. So I bought the full size. I have to agree that the packaging of so much thick resin/ acrylic of the tub is grossly un eco friendly as well as misleading. They should do something about that. But I have really noticed a difference in the tone and firmness of my face. I’m 50 and even though I don’t feel so old, I’m starting to see the signs and wiht this I see a difference in my cheeks and jawline for sure. I use it about 3-4 days out of the week and I leave it on instead of wiping it off. Definetly looking ot keep wiht this product.
review_title: Stay with it, you will see a difference!

review_text: This is wonderful! It tightens & firms so fast! I only use once a week because it’s so pricey but it’s well worth every dollar! It leaves my face feeling soft as well! I can actually skip my night routine and just use this once in the morning! I use shisheido weinkle smoothing cream at night and I use Caudalie in the morning along with this once a week and I can see drastic changes to my face
This is a rather expensive way to soften skin. I’m not convinced it does much more than the La Mer cream alone does. The jar itself is only 40% product and 60% plastic, which is truly eco unfriendly.
review_title: Wins an award for wasteful packaging.

review_text: Ok, first off, this price is ridiculous for what you get. The cream does feel great on the face, and I love the applicator brush they given you, but that’s about it. I noticed no difference in lifting or firming, and it actually made my skin feel a little dry afterwards.

It’s not just the name, the mask moisturizes , tightens and just make my face looks fresher and younger. This is the one for me that makes my skin baby bottom soft, I love it. It was my first La Mer purchase but wasn’t my last, my skin care routine is now almost entirely La Mer and my skin is healthier at 61 then it was at 26.  It is worth the cost for something that gives me such great results.

I have been using every week and am almost done with my first tub (1.7 oz). I love the brush and how the mask feels when I first apply but I don’t really notice and difference and the mask is quite pricey. Also, it states to leave on and the mask sometimes irritates my eye area. I won’t be repurchasing. I feel like their are other products that show results faster and are much cheaper. I wouldn’t recommend.

This mask isn’t lifting or firming. I didn’t find that result in any way, not even remotely, so I wouldn’t recommend this mask if that is your goal. I found this mask hydrating. It still has the La Mer scent, is lovely to apply, and wear at night. I finished the whole jar. But for pure hydration, I still prefer the La Mer moisturizers like the Moisturizing Soft Cream, so I would pass on purchasing this product.
review_title: Hydrating, But Doesn't Lift or Firm

review_text: I really wanted to like this, but it broke me out SO much the next day. It was a tragedy. Every time I use this, I break out and I do not have acne prone skin. I also don’t see the “lifting and firming“ effect either unfortunately.

Other win from La mer I’m almost 30 and I don’t think I’ll see much of the lifting and firming but I really don’t care. This mask is amazing first off you don’t need that much of it.  Second It just melts into your skin once you put it on! And last my skin feels so soft already.
AMAAAAZING!!! you ABSOLUTELY need to get this. Worth every $$

I looked at plenty reviews before purchasing and was still sceptical when putting the cream on. I had just passed 40 and my skin lost a lot of elasticity and my cheeks were tired and drooped. The mask is like a lotion consistency. After exfoliating I put the mask on in the evening bit expected it to work in days not hours. It made my skin soft and hydrated at first but when I woke up WOW! I could not believe how it tightened. Never experienced such results over one night! All the ripples on my face disappeared and it became perfectly plumped! Thank you La Mer! You did it.

If you’re in your 20s - 30s don’t expect to see any firming or lifting,  you’re too young for this product.  However I’m 30 and I will say this mask (more like a moisturizer really) is liking wiping a beauty filter on your face. Is it worth the money - up to you really, you’re paying for the name in my opinion...

Nice product!  Great for skin over 40,  great mark better to leave on over night.  If you are in your 20’s - I can understand why you left a not so great review- this is not for you!  I am almost 50 and I wish I started using this sooner!
For the price it was a huge disappointment.   Worked like any moisturizer.   Not worth it’s price.

No difference after using, the texture was not bad, but basic on the high price, two star is a maximum. BTW I am a 28 dry to combination skin, there was about 5 uses in a mini bottle, in order to see some result i used a lot every time.

Love this mask. It’s the first mask  my skin fully absorbed in 3 min, nothing left on the skin. And made it feel soft and hydrated. Wanted to hate it because of the price but couldn’t .have to admit that it’s the best mask I have tried... and I tried a lot of good ones before.

Works great in the world of anti-aging!  You do not need to use much of the product either.  I went out after I used it and two people commented on how well my face and make up looked.  I will start using the whole line in the future.
good but run out too fast
I love the texture, smell, and the brush that came with it, it’s the softest mask brush I’ve ever used.

Does it lift and firm? Not sure my skin isn’t in the worst condition to tell and i’ve only used it 3 times over a course of a week. HOWEVER: it does show IMMEDIATE results for anyone who has LARGE PORES. From the very first time i tried it and yes i left mine over night, the next morning my face felt great and looked great. I typically have dry skin and sometimes combination, i have a few sun spots and some pores with age seem to get larger. This mask as soon as you put it on in a few minutes you see it shrink your pores, it has  a smooth affect too. It’s not oily in the morning and for me keeps my face in place as far as smooth and firmness goes but again not sure for someone of more mature skin. I have fair skin, and I am 32 years of age. This will last me probaby 3 months if I use it 2 or 3 times a week. Perhaps I will notice even more benefits as time goes on, definitely helps with texture too.

Let’s spill the real tea here. I tried it and just like the majority of these reviews -- the product hydrates and soften ----- but is that what the description says? Did I just spend hundreds of dollars to hydrate my skin? The product says FIRMING and LIFTING-- you get neither. Don’t fall for the hype. The people raving about soft, smooth and hydrated skin might have very well had that experience but that is not at all how this product is marketed. Hydrating and softening is not the same as lifting and firming. Buyer beware.

I was completely skeptical of this $250 mask. I just used it last night, slept with it on overnight (you’re not supposed to wash it off)... OH MY GOD. Just woke up this morning to extremely soft, smooth, bright skin with the most even tone I’ve ever has. I have aging, combination skin with large pores and past acne scars. My t-zone has been oily but flaky. This miracle in a jar has shrunk my pores and diminished my acne scars and fine lines, literally overnight after one use. My skin is so incredibly soft, I can’t stop touching my face. I can’t wait to see long term results. I’ve had TCA peeks, glycolic peels, and microdermabrasion in the past, and NONE of that compares to the results of this mask. So yes, it’s a hefty price tag, but it’s also similar to the amount of money you would spend on a one time treatment at a dermatologist office. Only you get an entire jar.

You need this in your life! I love this. I feel so smooth faced and confident when I apply this.  I don’t wear it for only 8 minutes. I use it for a primer under foundation. Listen: LADIES OVER 35, YOU NEED THIS AS A PRIMER. IT IS EVERYTHING!! it gives me a smooth face,  fills in pores and fine lines. I love it
good for repairing!!!
I love love this mask so much.it make my skin so soft

I really wish I hated this thing, but I can’t. It has done wonders for my skin! I don’t know about the lifting but it has made my skin so much smoother, more hydrated, and significantly more bouncy! I have unbelievably dry skin that is constantly peeling so this was really a miracle. I can’t give 5 stars though because for $75, I want more product. The thing is TINY. I thought it was a sample sized product at first!
really love this mask. i got this mask because of the review’s. im turning 40 this month and wanted to look my best and im so happy. My skin felts and looks tighter.
This is an amazing mask! I put it on before bed and leave it on! My skin in the morning is so soft and hydrated!
This is my go-to mask when my face is dry or has been exposed to too much sun
review_title: My Favorite Mask of All Time!

review_text: Every penny spent on LaMer is worth it, I was having my skin kind of dull, I haven’t use it that much to notice a firming result, but definitely it gives me a very fresh touch and my skin looks brighter.

OMG!! This mask is amazing, my skin is very dry, I only bought the mini package to try. The first night i put it on the face before night cream and then I can see my skin is glowing in the next morning. I don’t see skin become firm , but i do see my skin become really smooth. Sometimes i didn’t sleep very well , as long as i apply this mask before sleeping , my skin will look perfect and continue to use this mask for one month, i found it’s away easier to apply foundation as my skin has been looking flawless and glowy

This stuff is truly magic.... I have oily, acne prone skin with huge pores and acne scars. I have been testing this product out for about a week now, used it 3 times and it really works wonders in terms of repairing the skin. My pores are much smaller, my scars and active blemishes have healed significantly, and my face just looks much smoother over all. My coworkers have given me so many compliments today on my skin so I had to come write this review! Oh, and I should mention that I am running on very little sleep and a gnarly hangover today and my skin does not show it one bit :) As for the lifting and firming, I would say it does firm pretty well considering the huge reduction in the size of my pores, can’t really say much for the lifting. Amazing mask regardless, I would say it is worth the price tag as a little goes a long way!

In love! At 34 years of age I definitely want to maintain. I was really concerned over the wrinkles my laugh lines left on my skin. I am a first time la mer subscriber. Always thought “it’s probably not that great” however I caved in and purchased the lifting and firming mask thinking-“if it don’t work I’ll just never purchase it again” after the first couple of weeks I noticed my skin feeling softer but no major difference in the “lifting “ after applying three times weekly for a whole month I noticed the crease of the wrinkles my laugh lines caused had totally vanished. although my face doesn’t look lifted it’s softer and wrinkle free and that’s all I really wanted SO GLAD I didn’t have to take the Botox route. Just purchased my second jar. I’m a very happy! Thank you La Mer so much. Confidence is priceless!!

I’m convinced that La Mer is magic.  I have aging, oily, acne prone skin.  Since my first sample of Crème de La Mer I’ve been adding La Mer to my skin care.  I’ll never give it up.  When I added the Lifting and Firming Mask to my routine I was blown away.  My skin has never looked better in my life.  Blemishes  heal almost overnight even they even appear at all.  This stuff is amazing.  I do add my Crème de La Mer over the top so I’m sure that’s part of it all but, this is a game changer for me.

I love this light mask.  It really isn’t necessary to rinse it off.  I use it at night and leave it on until I cleanse my face in the morning.  My sensitive skin wasn’t bothered by this product at all - which is a miracle.  I will buy this again and again.
Excellent product, suggesting everyone!
This mask is amazing! It helped to reduce my large pores and made my dull skin brighter! I’ll definitely continue to buy.
You really do get what you pay for. Worth every dime. Results are almost immediate.

While the La Mer products are on the pricey side, I am convinced they are worth it. I just turned 59 (for the first time) and my skin looks much younger. After using this mask, my skin always feels brighter and softer, with pores and fine lines reduced.

Instead of lifting or firming, this mask does the best job at repairing/rescuing your skin when it’s in trouble. Say if you’re having a serious allergic reaction to certain skincare products, which happens to a lot of sensitive skin when trying out new products, or you’re experiencing a huge breakout, or you’re just trying to recover your skin from a day of exposing under the sun, this product will do an amazing job if not the best. However, like I mentioned before, it doesn’t work very well as a lifting and firming mask. When it comes to anti-aging, there are a lot of brands that are better than La Mer, since it focuses on repairing. If you’re looking for a mask that can rescue your problematic skin in no time, this is the one!
After one use, the result is visible! The pores get smaller and skin gets soft and firmer. Amazing result!! Can’t live without

I’ve purchased this many times!  It is the only self tanner that DOES NOT STAIN clothes and doesn’t get all over my sheets!!  It’s a perfect glow.  Make sure to put lotion on dry areas of body.  I use with the mister bottle (gamer changer) and blend out with my hands.  Super fast and low maintenance and everyone comments on how glowy I look - it also lasts almost a full week for me! (I’ve also never noticed white things in the refill which a lot of comments were saying).

I dont like self-tanner- the smell, streaks, the transferring. IOP has none of those issues. I have the medium and it smells faintly like cucumber. I like the ingredients, and while it may not get you as dark, I can wear white and put it on this in wi

I agree with others that application is key! just get the continuous mister bottle, it’s a gamechanger. I’ve used dark for years but recently switched to the medium and I feel like it looks more natural on me, especially for the winter/spring then I’ll use up my dark only for summer. Like I said I’ve purchased this water for 3+ years, never had the white spots others mention but it literally looks like its the coconut oil separating from the water.. smh read the ingredients lol. It’s very hydrating for me I have dry eczema prone skin and this is the only tanner that hasn’t irritated or dried it out. This stuff also doesn’t have the worst tan smell in the morning, which I hate. Lotion up your dry spots prior and you should be good.

Application is key. I use a continuous sprayer and mit to blend it out after spraying in each area. I also use a makeup brush on my hands and feet to blend it out better so it doesn’t leave any blotches or noticeable fake tan streaks. Love the formula so much! It smells great and dries quick and don’t transfer - the best part.

Honestly loved this. It’s all about application! I personally put it in a continuous spray bottle and blend with a mit! Left my ankles and hands a little spotty but next time will just wash those areas shortly after application.

I prefer using this compared to regular self-tanners because I don’t have to worry about it transferring and I don’t have to rinse off the product. I basically spray lines one body part at a time and rub in thoroughly with an old sock (lol). Rub in as if it were moisturizer, and you won’t get streaks. I do two coats on my legs. Then I usually clean up my room or go on my phone for about 20 minutes while it dries down. I try to stand most of the time to avoid creases. Again, I much prefer taking 30 minutes to do this process then have to take the whole day like with other tanners! RE: white clumps in bottles- I think this happens as the products sit on the shelf longer than a couple months. I pulled mine out after winter and found that it had some clumps too. It worked like normal!
This is my favorite tanner! I use it once a week and it never transfers on to anything.
i used it once on my legs and i’m completely satisfied. the comparison is after 1 time and that’s my arm and my starting color. i’m quite pale.

I used to love this formula and especially the refill packets because when used in a continuous spray bottle the color (dark) was PERFECT for me. Just as other reviewers mentioned, my last bag had stuff floating all throughout it. Having bought the tanning water in the bottle and the refill bags I know in the past this has just looked like water, no substances in it at all. I tried shaking it up and even rolling the bag between my hands but nothing broke it up. Now against my better judgment, I did still try to use it in my spray bottle and see how the tan turned out. Something seemed off but I couldn’t place my finger on what it was, maybe it got patchy quicker? For now I’m gonna go back to Loving Tan and see if IOP can fix their formulation.
I will continue to rebuy this stuff. It creates a streak free, natural looking tan that lasts for a few days. Love it.

Received this product in my online order and I was so excited to use it. I didn’t pay too much attention to what it looked like in the plastic bag and proceeded to fill up a mist bottle, and then I noticed as I was pouring that there was clumpy white substance. Never got to use the product and out $22. Super disappointing.

The color is good but I cannot get this to apply without this being streaky and uneven. I use a continuous spray bottle and a mitt and every time hate how it turns out. Never have this issue with a foaming self tanner (my fav is St. Tropez). Definitely do not recommend when there are better products out there.
review_title: Streaky and better products on the market

review_text: Worst streaks ever. Drips down to feet and stays wet for a solid hour and a half. Loving tan brand is way better

Once you figure out how to use the continuous spray bottle, this stuff is awesome. It is nearly impossible to tell where you sprayed so spray farther away in your first application to get a sense of color and your technique. Color looks pretty natural though and doesn’t have that orange tinge.

Didn’t even get a chance to use product because there is mold in it, I was worried this would happen since I read reviews before purchasing that mentioned this but thought I’d take my chances… (I don’t know if it’s actually mold but my friend has this and theirs is clear water).
With the continuous spray bottle from amazon, application is very easy but does stain hands if no gloves are used and can be splotchy if not applied evenly

I LOVE this tanner! It has a really pretty tone and develops so nicely. My elbows and knees didn’t look gross and I like that I don’t have to wash it off. The only thing to watch for is that there’s no color guard, so you can’t tell where it is right after application.

I’m honestly so shocked by some of these reviews. This is my HOLY GRAIL! I use it with a continuous spray bottle I got off Amazon and it works so well. It gives the most natural beautiful tan and the best part is you don’t have to wash it off! I agree it does take awhile to dry down but it’s so worth the wait. It’s never blotchy and never orange. I love the smell as well, reminds me of sunscreen and being at the beach.

I was really excited to try this tanning water and it showed up with all of this floating white stuff in it? I’m not sure if it’s mold or what but I know this isn’t right because I also ordered the gift set and the tanning water is clear. I would never put this on my body.

I love this tan and how easy it is to use. I use it with a continuous mist spray bottle and a mitt to rub it in. I use the shade medium and am thinking about using the dark one next to see if I can get a little darker. I do absolutely hate the smell and the way it feels while waiting the 4-6 hours. It feels awful and makes me sweat and feel worse. But definitely will continue to use it. Can’t wait to try the dark next!!

I was interested in this product for the fact that it used less plastic to produce, but don’t fall for the gimmick. Crazy splotchy, clings to dry areas (even after exfoliating and applying moisturizer), takes absolutely forever to dry down, I used most of one pouch on one application. Wouldn’t recommend.

I love the color this gives my super pale red skin. It’s so pretty. But OMG it smells HORRIFIC and it doesn’t go away. The DHA is powerful in this unfortunately and it literally lasted 3 days and I couldn’t handle it. I was showering twice a day for 3 days to get the smell off. I probably won’t buy it again because of this.
Yes I was dark but blotchy! If you saw this on tictok and expected some amazing transformation, this isn’t it.

Absolutely love all Isle of Paradise products. Super easy to spray on and use. I exfoliate my body then add lotion on all major dry areas like my knees, elbows, ankles and wrists then I’ll spray it on and use a tanning glove to spread it out. Only reason I took a star off is because the color I got might’ve been too light for me. It took multiple applications until I saw a difference. Also left a small streak, probably cause I didn’t spread it out properly.

I got the medium color for my light skin, hopped on the tiktok face to try this. At first I thought wow it’s perfect, but midday after putting it on last night it’s starting to look orange. It also has a strong tan chemical smell to it and tastes really bad. It’s clear like water when sprayed on so make sure to rub it in really well and wash your hands afterwards. I wouldn’t buy again bc i can’t stand the smell and taste of it on my hands especially.
This is gross. I just refilled a brand new bottle and it’s  all clumpy and moldy. I’m not even sure how to go about returning it since it’s a refill pack.

I was super nervous buying this product but let me tell you it is amazing. I am so freaking dark and I have been getting so many compliments. Just like any other tanning products be mindful of your hands and feet

The feeling of having it on for 4-6 hours sucks. It’s a gross feelings to wait it out. I couldn’t take it anymore and left it on for 3 hours and still got nice results. I’m really loving these. I worked for a dermatologist for 10 years and am very familiar with dermaplaning practices. I’d say this is a great product for beginners, especially if a spa/derm isn’t in your budget or of any interest. The most important thing is the angle at which you hold the razor and not performing this too frequently (over-exfoliation is a def a thing). Make sure you’re always holding the razor at a 45-degree angle against your skin. Short downward strokes are the best way to go when you’re dermaplaning at home after you cleanse and dry your face. Keeping the skin taut and moving from top to bottom is the general rule of thumb. Take it slow too and be conscious of the unique angles/curves of your face. Dermaplaning is a very intuitive practice! I’d recommend only doing it every 3 to 4 weeks for optimal results. Afterward, avoid direct sun exposure/extreme heat for a few days days, don’t use scrubs or other exfoliators for a week, avoid chlorine on your face for a week, apply serums, moisturizers, and sunscreen as usual.

review_text: Earlier this year I noticed a bump on my finger. I figured it would eventually go away on its own (a bug bite, possibly?)I put off getting it professionally checked, and then a few weeks later COVID19 changed everything. I realized at that point it would be awhile before I go to any medical office. I tried several home remedies but the bump remained. Then I came across the description of this product and figured I would try it. By the time I got the product, my bump had been on my finger for 3 months. FIRST IMPRESSION: This is as thin as water, if not thinner! Like other reviewers say, they shouldn’t have “lotion” in the product name - it’s somewhat misleading. I can see why the scent is too much for  people - it IS STRONG, however it fades moments after applying (for me, anyway). TO USE: I squeeze a little bit of the product into the palm of my hand, then use a finger from my other hand and dab where necessary. **This is the best method for me!** I tried using a cotton swab/q-tip but it’s not as effective as the “lotion” ends up soaking into the q-tip completely. RESULTS: Works effectively for new bumps and breakouts if applied within a day or two. It takes up to four days for anything new to go away on my dry skin. As for my bump on my finger that has been around for a few months: it has drastically decreased in size after regularly using this product a few times a week. Sometimes I apply it several times a day. I’m very happy with the results so far. I have been using it for over a month now and I am only 1/4 way through the bottle.If you can get past the scent and figure out an application technique that works for you, then I think this product is worth every penny and you definitely get your money’s worth and you should see results! If my bump of a few months can go down in size, imagine what it can do for you :) good luck!

Honestly, it’s one of my favourites now. SO MUCH BETTER than the Drunk Elephant which causes cystic acne in spots when I use it. Is it worth the money compared to Inkey List? Maybe not, but it’s damn good and I can use it nightly. Doesn’t cause me to break out at all, but I do wish they would disclose the percentage of retinol in the product.

This stuff is AMAZING. I’ve been using it for about a month now and it has completely changed the texture of my skin. I’m 31 and my skin just started looking way less smooth lately, and nothing else was working. I tried the different acids, lotions, etc. and this was the only thing that made a difference. I did the one day on, one day off for 2 weeks, and now I’m doing 2 days on, 1 day off. The only peeling I’m having is around my mouth area and it’s super mild. Love this product and I’ll definitely continue to use it!

I’ve been using various different retinol night creams for years, and this is far and away the best I have ever used. I was pleasantly surprised because I’ve found that a lot of Origins moisturizers I’ve used in the past leave me oily/ shiny and clog my pores. Not the case here. I don’t have very sensitive skin, and my skin did go through a peeling phase for the first two weeks or so of using this nightly (thank you, quarantine), but it was so worth it. It has made my skin so smooth and soft and radiant, so much so that several people have commented how great my skin looks, and this is the only new thing in my regime. It’s effective at keeping fine lines at bay around my eyes/forehead/mouth, which all retinols should do, and is overall nourishing. I use it on my face/neck/decolletage. This is the only Plantsciption product in my regime, and it has be seriously considering buying more of them next time I need to replenish my serum, etc. Smells great. Lasts a good amount of time (4 months ish). Makes your skin glow. I’m a believer.

I’ve been using this for about a month now. My skin is definitely going through some purging / flaking, but it’s been manageable. It’s also feels tight if I don’t layer on the moisture in the morning. The texture is really nice and it’s super moisturizing. I’m curious to see how my skin looks in another month or so. This is the first time I’ve consistently used a retinol product (tried prescription tretinoin and the irritation was too extreme for me)
Feels good on my skin, not greasy. However I have sensitive skin so have to alternate usage as advised. Been using 2 weeks now and my skin texture feels so much smoother!

I was searching for a retinol due to the recent news of neeeeeding one as a part of my night routine. I use the origins frothy face wash so I decided to try this. It’s definitely expensive but worth it. I have not had any negative issues (redness/breakouts/dryness) and I have seen a clearness in my skin. Glad I tried one and loved it!

I bought this for my mom because she loves Origins skincare. She has been loving it! She has a very simple skincare routine, and this has become a part of her routine. She says she feels like she’s noticed a difference. It is pricey, but most retinols are.

You guys! you have to give this a try! I’m surprised that there so few reviews for this product. First of all I have a acne prone sensitive combination skin. I have been using this product for 2 month now and I can see the difference very clearly. even after 2 weeks in, people started giving me compliments on my skin! I know! My skin glows and is soo soft and smooth, there is no irritating scent to it and absorbs to the skin with no stickiness. After washing my face, first I apply a toner, my serum, then this product only at night. Highly recommend it!
I have normal to dry skin and I saw an immediate difference after one night of use.  Skin appeared more radiant and youthful.

My first time using retinol in my life and I’m glad that I picked the right one! Must follow the instructions on how to use the product, for the first two weeks, use every other day, so the second time I used this product, my skin started peeling, it stopped peeling after the first week of using the product, my skin feels so soft and radiant! I was surprised that even with the peeling, my skin was not red or irritated, not sure how it works, but this retinol did an amazing job. Dark spots almost invisible, pores are also invisible and expression lines are gone. Love it and will buy it again because it worth the $$$Just for a full disclosure, I’m in my early 30th.

I’ve been using this product for 2.5 months now and really love what it’s done to my skin. I’m in my late 20s and just began adding retinol to my skincare routine last year. This is my second product and is likely what I’ll be sticking with for a while! The tube has great value and lasts a long time when used as directed. After washing my face and applying serums, I warm a pea-sized amount on my fingertips. I tap the product into my skin, starting with my areas of concern (for me, my forehead and laugh lines). I experienced a little tingling when I started the product, but I eased it into my routine by using it every other night for 2 weeks and found that my skin adjusted quickly. Thanks to the other ingredients in this cream, I haven’t experienced irritation or dryness, which was a concern with my fair and sensitive skin. I follow with a thick but mild night cream and have loved my results since day 1!

This is a fantastic product.  Truly the first product that I have seen a huge difference in my skin.  I’m 43 years old and nothing I’ve ever used has worked like this.  I noticed the dimethicone comment here and reached out to Origins about it.  I wish they’d take it out, but I can not deny what it’s done for my skin.  You will breakout when first starting a retinoid.  It’s called purging, so please don’t be discouraged.  I use it every other night.  My skin is constantly exfoliated, softer and clearer.  I’m also trying herbivores natural retinoid and can comment on that after some time.  I went through a whole bottle of this origins and feel like I can’t live without it.  It’s amazing!

This product is fabulous!! Gentle, yet very effective. It provides excellent hydration and leaves my skin looking bright and refreshed with improved texture! Some people said this caused breakouts, but that is what retinol is actually supposed to do if you have acne/acne-prone skin - these breakouts happens with both over the counter and prescription retinol products because it is exfoliating your skin at a deeper level, so it brings anything clogged back up to the surface. Breakouts should go away within 1-2 weeks. I didn’t experience breakouts with this product even though I’m acne-prone and overall I’m very impressed with the results!

I never write product reviews but I feel the need to for this one. I am a 41 year old woman with 2 kids and a full time job. I drink more wine than I should and I don’t sleep enough. That said, I have good genes so the deep lines haven’t developed yet. At this point in my life, my concerns are even skin tone, elasticity, and fine lines. This stuff if amazing. I started using it every 3 days with an added layer of moisturizer after and worked my way up to every other day in the past month. Its safe to use every day but I feel that every other day is enough. My face glows, the lines on my forehead have disapeared and my face feels smoother than ever before. This is the first product I have used from this brand and it was an amazing introduction. I will have to try others.
After the third time using this product my skin changed almost instantly. Seems smoother and plumper.

There are multiple ingredients that should NOT be in skincare. There are lots of stripping ingredients in here, some of which are listed before retinol. Dimethacone is NEVER something you should have in your skincare. It is usually used in primers for its pore filling properties...who wants that with skincare? All that does is PREVENT things from sinking into your skin. A sad realization because I wanted to purchase this product but I will have to find something else. Keep in mind that the green checkmark doesn’t mean all the ingredients should be in your skincare.

I’ve used retinol products for about two years now. I was so excited for a retinol in a moisturizer. Consistency was perfect. But whenever I used it (over night), I woke up with a couple breakouts. (My skin isn’t sensitive at all btw). Had to return

I am OBSESSED with this product! I was breaking out like crazy and I had a lot of really horrible acne scarring and literally within two days I could already see a difference in my face. I love how this is hydrating as well and seriously, you don’t need much! They recommend a very small amount and honestly, a small amount goes a long way! I have sensitive skin and dermatitis rosacea and this product has not made it worse or irritated my skin at all!
I’ve experience some dryness on my cheeks but its totally normal first time using retinol. So far i do like it.

I am in my mid 30s and it is just starting to be time for me to incorporate a retinol cream into my routine. I have very pale combination skin that is prone to hormonal jawline acne and is dry but prone to congestion.The first thing you notice when using this product is the smell. It is light but sweet and maybe a bit flowery. It dissipates quickly after applying this product.The bottle tells me to use a pea sized amount, but I found it a bit hard to distribute that to my whole face so I have been using about a kidney bean sized amount every night. My skin tends to be on the sensitive side, so I am SO happy that I have suffered no irritation from this product. It absorbs very quickly.After using this product for 9 consecutive nights now, my skin seems to glow. The just-starting-to-appear lines around my mouth are GONE. I have some sun damage on my cheeks, and the appearance is massively diminished. Almost invisible. I can’t believe that such a gentle product can be so effective!My skin did not break out any more than usual. When my hormonal acne appeared  it cleared several days faster than usual. The only difference to my routine has been this product. I’m very pleased with this purchase. I would rebuy this product.

This is my first time using a retinol product and I’ve been loving it so far! The formula is gentle but still provides results - my skin has definitely started to look and feel smoother. I look forward to continued use and improved skin tone, reduction of wrinkles, and more!

I have oily/combo skin that is a little sensitive. Since I’m turning 30 soon I wanted to add a retinol product into my skincare routine.  I’ve tried other retinol and phyto-retinol products that have irritated my skin and made me break out. I have a few Origins products so when they came out with this retinol, I wanted to see how my skin would react. After 2 weeks of use, doing the recommended every other night application, my fine lines around my mouth, forehead, and neck have drastically diminished. Another added bonus is that it’s helped minimize my large pores from my oily skin. The application I’ve found most effective is putting a pea-sized amount into my hands, rubbing the product into my hands, and then lightly patting the product onto my face and neck. Love this product and will definitely repurchase.

I really liked this at first. It applies very smooth, aside from dimethicone—most ingredients seemed like a positive. I was trying to chalk it up to something else in my skin care routine but I eliminated this and had to accept it’s the culprit. I returned. :(

review_text: Great for wrinkles AND maskne! I use retinol faithfully in my nightly routine and just switched to Algenist. I’ve used it before and remember liking it. My face feels plump in the morning and it is maintaining all of the previous wrinkle prevention (I’m 51) from my previous product. In addition, it has helped tremendously with the maskne I’ve been experiencing. In fact, it has disappeared completely over the past 3 weeks of use and I wear a mask for 8+ hours a day for my job. It was becoming a horrible issue for me. What a pleasant surprise.  I will definitely replace this when it’s gone.

I admit I’m a skin care junkie. I’ve probably tried ever serum on the market & love this Algenist Retinol product!  I only wish it was priced more reasonably & also that you could open the metal pump container & had a ‘heads-up’ when the product was finished.

I have extremely dry sensitive skin, so even though I feel it did do its job, one down side is it makes my skin feel even drier - but no breakouts. So once you apply more hydrating products, this could be a great product for retinol beginners like me.

Though it might’ve been my moisturizer doing the work. Also, I really hated the fact that this product is sparkly! I don’t see the point of it and it’s pretty annoying to have shimmer everywhere after using this.

I have used this product  since it was introduced.  It’s excellent, and it really does reduce fine lines.

My skin is able to wear this daily, but it took a little getting used to. I use this off and on, and when I’m consistent about using it for a few weeks I definitely see results: firmer looking skin and fine lines are less noticeable.

B.Bio did not!  Had to reapply to target dry zones.  Beautybio did, however,  give me a very slight glow/sheen post application, but that too disappears after 15-20mins.  What’s up with this brand?  The only product I love from them is the cleanser & lip balm.  Everything else - including the microneedling device- has been a fail, at least for me.  Seems like the beautiful packaging, marketing and initial “feel” of the products (like 20min hydration) trick our perception.  Appears to be a very myopic approach to branding and skin care.   I wonder how many customers will continue to use this line long term...?   I think this is a transient experience of trending “luxury”.This may be going back if I don’t see any difference in my skin after 10 days.   Not impressed.

I read an article about woman that had used self bronzer/tanner in their moisturizer to help cover melasma and remembered I had a sample of this. I decided to try it and was hooked. I bought a bottle immediately and am glad I did.  I use 2-3 drops (not dropper fulls) in my moisturizer and then wait 5 - 10 minutes before applying foundation. I absolutely LOVE it. I wish I would have known about this product years ago.  It’s sold out right now so I hope it’s back in stock before I run out.

review_text: This product is very tricky at first! The bottle tells you to add a lot more than you actually need, depending on your skin tone, and that tends to make it turn orange. Used well this products gives a beautiful healthy tan + glow! It definitely takes some trials and errors though

I bought this on a bit of a whim, because I’d been going through a really terrible patch with my acne, and wanted some sort of light therapy treatment, but the Dr Dennis Gross mask was a bit too much. Great device to enhance your masking ritual. The heat allows the skin to absorb serums faster that a sheet mask alone. Very pampering experience. Compared to the UFO mini, the addition of cryotherapy helps soothe the skin and tighten pores. Compared to the original UFO, the UFO 2 achieves the target temperature faster and adds more customizable full spectrum LED phototherapy. I upgraded for the latter so I could get the optimal benefit from their newer botanical masks.You can use any of the multiple Foreo skin masks with this, but they are a bit messy to get onto the device, and there is plenty of serum left in the package for additional treatments. Applying the UFO 2 on top of a sheet mask is less complicated for me and feels more relaxing as the face is covered by the mask the whole time. Another DIY option is to use polyester facial rounds with the serum of your choice (although it would be better if the pad could soak in the serum first like the Foreo masks do in their package). Do not use the UFO 2 on bare skin without a mask or pad as it will not glide or spread the serum as well.Hopefully Sephora will add some of the other Foreo masks from their Farm to Face Collection that really make use of the full spectrum lights. Currently they only carry the Coconut Oil and Manuka Honey, which are both really indulgent treats for the face.The Foreo app can be a little finicky at times, but it works fairly well, saving the most recent mask settings for later use. Still annoying that you also have to scan the barcode on the package to use their mask programs. You can get around this by using custom settings on the app or ditch the app completely and press buttons to manually start the programs for the Make My Day and Call it a Night masks.Overall, I am pleased with the upgrade, but the steep price tag is quite a splurge.  The time it saves compared to wearing a sheet mask alone for 20+ minutes would be the main reason I’d recommend investing in one.

review_text: I’m going to give it to you straight in this review as a big skincare enthusiast who wants you to buy the right products for YOU.I am a huge believer in microneedling, but with stipulations (that this device meets, more on that later). However I don’t think it is something every last person needs. Microneedling the right way is a pricey treatment, and it is for: *hyperpigmentation*. It has anti aging benefits, but so does LED (one time cost via home devices.) It’s the wrong system entirely for acne (go with benzoyl peroxide/retinoids). But for stubborn scars and/or age spots - nothing beats microneedling. Nothing.Here’s the deal with this device: they did it right. Dermarollers are an unsafe system; proper microneedling involves disposable needles.As such, this system is more pricey. Far less pricey than in-office ($20/treatment after the initial purchase), but still an investment. FaceGym also threw me a curveball with the vibration aspect. At first I went “but why?” However, as someone who has used more standard microneedling-I quickly discovered that this aspect makes for a far more enjoyable experience. I expected more pain for no more gain, but I appreciate the vibrations now that I’ve used it. It helped me get into the groove better so to speak.As for the liquid aspect. Tbh it could work better. It’s a little tricky to get it to come out evenly, and there’s always liquid left behind. This aspect could be improved, although I get the principle of widening channels within your skin for greater absorption. Nice idea, execution is 4 stars. In complete fairness, this is true with every similar device I’ve tried.Does it lead to results? Yes. Overnight, I see improved radiance - every single time. In several years of microneedling, I can personally attest to the reduction in hyperpigmentation.My tip is: use this once weekly, thoroughly treating your skin. More than that isn’t really necessary IMHO. $80 a month, and the results WILL be worth it

I use it on my face, neck and décolletage, and my skin feels firmer / tighter to the touch. It’s a fairly thick cream, so I don’t use too much at one time otherwise I think it’d be a tad greasy.
product_name: Rénergie Lift Multi-Action Day Cream with SPF 15 - All Skin Types

review_text: For 3+ years I’ve been using Neutrogena as a moisturizer, and it was okay, until a friend gave me a sample of this baby. I was skeptical and scared to use it at first because I break out easily if my skin doesn’t like a product. But one day, I just had to try it. I fell truly in love! I already noticed the difference in a day. I actually did an experiment using Neutrogena under my makeup, and then Lancome -- BIG FAT DIFFERENCE! Using this product made my skin looked porcelain. It’s a little bit greasy at first, but it goes away. The smell is pretty luscious too, another thing that I like about it! Price wise, it’s very reasonable, just because it works like magic. I think the last time I had a perfect skin was when I was 16!
product_name: Rénergie Lift Multi-Action Day Cream with SPF 15 - All Skin Types

review_text: I’m 20 and in the military, needless to say my skin definitely shows the level of my stress. I still breakout pretty frequently and have started noticing some fine lines around my “expression“ areas. I’ve been using this cream for about a week now and it’s just what I’ve been looking for! I haven’t had a single breakout since I started using it and it helped get rid of the ones I had previously. It also smoothed out everything else and my skin tone is more even and glowing! The SPF is a great added bonus, I’m pretty pale and never think to use sunscreen so having it built into my daily moisturizer is perfect!
product_name: Rénergie Lift Multi-Action Day Cream with SPF 15 - All Skin Types

review_text: The price is a little more than I like to spend but it feels luxurious and moisturizes extremely well. This is not enough SPF for me in California and so I have to use another product along side this.
product_name: Rénergie Lift Multi-Action Day Cream with SPF 15 - All Skin Types

review_text: Nice moisturizer, but sometimes it left white marks if not massaged in the skin properly. While it feels nice on the skin, I didn’t see any major changes while using it

I have been using this cream for about a week now and I definitely see a difference in my fine lines. I’m 34 and fine lines are coming up more frequent then I like but with this cream it definitely has lessened my fine lines and leaves my skin feeling soft. Great under makeup and keeps my skin feeling soft and moisturized. It’s expensive but worth every penny. My skin does not get irritated from using this cream and I have pretty sensitive skin.

This stuff is magic, it makes even my deep set wrinkles almost disappear when I put this on. the only issue is that it pills up and leaves bits behind on my skin, if it weren’t for that I would give it 5 stars. It works best to just use it directly on the wrinkle you want diminished so there’s less residue/pilling

The reason why everyone says how good this cream feels and how smooth it makes their skin feel is because there is Dimethicone in it.   It literally fills your skin in.  While this cream may be great to use once in a while, it shouldn’t be your daily moisturizer.   Best used at times when you really want your skin to look good, perhaps under makeup.  There are definite short-term improvements.  But Dimethicone is sketchy.  Especially if you have skin conditions like acne or whatever.  It harbours bacteria and moisture and doesn’t really allow the skin to breathe.

A very nice cream. Glides on smoothly, it’s light and airy and sinks into skin without an issue. I have normal to oily skin and this was wonderful! My skin stayed dry, my pores appeared smaller over a period of 1-2 weeks. Worked well under makeup.This is priced pretty high, but I do think it definitely is worth the price. My skin appeared healthy and more youthful over time. I will repurchase this again.
Glides on smooth. Penetrates and leaves skin very soft. Has improved my skin so much. Overall this product does what it says it does. Great scent.

Amazing product.  Always allow it fully dry before applying primer and/ or foundation. Also I found it by far the most affective anti aging and smoothing texture cream I’ve ever used. But I also found, unlike other cream that you apply in circular motion, this cream you apply by  gently smoothing on. I allow it to dry 20-30 mins before my makeup. ( example... after my run ,shower ,wash face , apply serum .. let it sit a min , then this face cream smoothed on gently) then I go make breakfast) and that way it’s fully dry and I feel and see the INCREDIBLE game changing results. Sorry for the novel but I truly believe this cream is the most amazing moisturizer. It made my rough, sun damaged, breast - feeding pimples scars, aged, dry and combination - dry skin look 99.9 percent better.

I decided to treat myself to a new facial cream... This one looked like a good one to try. Love the formula and texture. Very moisturizing, absorbs nicely in the skin. So far so good as far as results go. My skin has never looked better, honestly!

Don’t understand negative reviews.  This has very little fragrance that dissipates immediately and is non greasy.  As with the rest of the line, I have received more compliments on my skin since I began using their products than at any other time in my life.  I also can’t believe the difference in my neck as I’m past 50 and this has truly been firming.

I had been using the original Algenist firming and lifting cream for a couple years and loved it.  It’s what got me to go with Algenist for all my skin care products.  Now it’s gone and replaced with a modified name and formulation.  I was able to try some on the back of my hand from a tester at another retailer.  I really didn’t care for the feel of this cream.  Algenist has front loaded the silicones and this feels too much like a foundation primer.  I could feel the slickness of the silicones, and that was about it.I like and use the new Elevate Retinol serum, but I think Algenist missed with this one.  I’ll have to start looking for a replacement brand.

I love Algenist products and this is no exception. As I approach 40, I’ve noticed a loss of elasticity in my face - a little more sagging, a few more fine lines - but I still struggle with combination skin and acne. This noticeably firms and plumps my skin immediately upon application, hydrates nicely and yet doesn’t cause breakouts. It also layers well with other products (serums, oils, etc.) as part of my nighttime routing and absorbs nicely (not overly greasy). I do find it to be a little pricy - thus the 4 stars, but overall I find it to be effective.
review_title: Good Plumping and Firming Night Cream

review_text: I received this as a deluxe sample sometime last year and I love it. I’m 24 but because I work nights and I’m out in the weather I had some deep crows feet and puffy eyes. The first time I used it I could see a difference in the puffiness. After a week of putting it on once a day the puffiness was gone and my crows feet were slowly going away. It’s been almost a year now, my eyes are always hydrated, my crows feet are gone, and the skin around my eyes are silky smooth. I’ll add that I have sensitive skin but this cream never irritated my skin.

I remember my Mom complaining about turkey neck as a tween, I’m much more sympathetic now. I’ve tried many different products and I don’t remember why I picked this one. Can’t say I’ve ever tried Algenist before but now I’m a believer. You can see the difference the first time you use it. No matter what I’m using on my face or body I always reach for this for my neck. It hydrates and smooths.
Great moisturizer, but really haven’t noticed any lifting and tightening.
review_title: Great moisturizer but haven't seen what it claims

review_text: I have received this product as a sample and after a couple of days, i could see a difference but my skin is normal and dont have much to correct. This products is amazing but caused some breakout. Also, after putting this cream, there was like some small white residue.. so i’m not sure if i’m gonna buy the full size

This stuff works! I noticed a difference after only a few days of use. I got a deluxe sample first and I was very impressed with this product. My skin was firmer and my fine lines reduced! They even have the 4 oz. online. So worth it!

I’ve tried a lot of night creams and while many have been good (even very good), none have wowed me like this one. When I tried it in my hands first, I was amazed at the immediate results—all the little lines that age my hands seemed to vanish and my hands looked so much smoother and younger. Results on my face and neck have been similar: my skin feel soooo soft, and lines on my neck, forehead, and between my eyes are diminished. I’ve only been using it a few days! The texture is this great whipped formula that doesn’t leave me feeling oily or greasy, and there’s no strong perfume scent. It is pricey, but this is one of those products I would definitely splurge on.

i have mixed feelings about this product. got it as a sample, put it over my serum and felt the tightening effect but an hour later my face felt kind of dry so i put my josie maran argon oil on top and the product started to flake off my face in little white pieces. the fragrance didn’t bother me. really wanted to like this but my face felt dry.

This moisturizer has too much of a perfume smell for me.  While it is extremely emollient, I just can’t stomach the smell - I have been using it only at night and mostly on my neck just to use it up, but I wouldn’t purchase again just because of the smell.

I’ve been using this cream for about a week and a half and I have seen a dramatic improvement in the size and appearance of my pores. I have very large pores in my tzone and I can’t believe how smooth my skin looks!! I seriously thought this could only be achieved with lasers! I purchased this because I have crepey skin on my neck and big wrinkles around my neck, I’m 36, so overall lifting and contouring seemed like something I needed. I’ve research for months and read a million reviews on different brands. This one seemed the best. I focus this cream mainly on my neck but work it up to my face as well. It feels thick and almost pastey, but it goes on nicely and it makes my skin SUPER SOFT. I’m talking like a baby’s butt soft! It makes my face and neck look smoother instantly after i apply( my face has seen the biggest improvement)and it gives it a baby soft powdery feel, if that makes sense. My neck skin looks a little smoother but not a big enough difference yet to be like “wow” but I JUST started using it. I’m excited for the results after a month of use! But tightening of my pores is well worth the price tag!!!! and once the magic starts happening on my super wrinkled neck I know I’ll be amazed. :) I love algenist, use other products as well. So this was a no brainer!
review_title: best cream for tighter pores and smoother skin

review_text: After receiving a deluxe sample, I surprisingly fell in love. I bought the full size version. After a few months, I am still impressed. Truly makes your face glow in a refreshing and youthful way.

I first got a sample and used it in the morning. After using, I found my face was visibly sculpted. Then I purchased the full size. This time I used it at night. When I got up the nest morning, I was surprisingly found that my face was lifted, toned and looked smooth and few years younger. I seldom write reviews, but this product is amazing, and doing what it claims to do.
review_title: Amazing, it really works as it claims.

review_text: Love it! Not only did it get rid of my obnoxious smile line wrinkle and my forehead wrinkle. But it also tightened my pores and has severely helped with breakouts! I love how creamy it is too. Made my skin feel baby soft!

I have rosacea with acne, making finding facial products challenging. I first tried this via a Sephora sample (and since bought) and was shocked at how significantly improved my skin looked after one night’s use. This feels really nice on my skin—smooth and silky, not greasy or sticky. It pairs and layers well with my facial oil (Herbivore’s Lapis). I use it at night and wake to softer skin that looks younger (I’m 40). It can get a tiny bit clumpy, which is why this is my night cream. Also, I don’t notice a scent, and I am VERY particular about smells and can’t handle anything with a scent. All-around great product.

I just used a sample of this cream this morning and I’m buying the full-size right now! It makes my skin feel sooo soft and smooth, it’s freaking amazing! Unfortunately, it is really expensive, more than double what I normally spend on moisturizer, so I will have to use sparingly :/
I don’t understand this product. Maybe I am using it wrong, but it was really thick and hard to rub in. After a while, it started flaking and peeling off my face? Left with a bunch of white residue.

Received a sample of this product and could not believe my neck! In one day I saw a difference. I take good care of my skin, but, I am older and sagging occurs. Wish I could get it in a smaller portion so I could order today. Will save up and order.

I received 2 samples of this amazing product, my skin is noticeably smoother the fine lines are diminishing and my face glows!  This product dose not feel greasy or heavy when applied. I have been using Algenist products for 5 months now and the products are  worth every penny.

I’ve been using this as s neck cream for a week or so and I am LOVING it. After patting my essence into my neck, I follow with the Estée Lauder night repair serum and top it off with this neck cream. The results are wonderful. I’m only 24 with no obvious issues with my neck or décolleté so I didn’t think I really needed a neck cream until I started using it. I can now say that my neck looks firm, there’s been a slight improvement in my wrinkles (who knew I had neck wrinkles?! I didn’t until they started to soften lol) and my skin feels and looks smoother. I’m hooked. It’s spendy, but I’m positive it’s worth it.

After receiving a sample I saw an immediate difference in my skin.  It looked fuller and my skin glowed.  Algenist promises a difference in just 10 days and I’m at day 5..❤️.  At night I used it under the Retinol Serum.  My skin looks great.

The Elevate Cream contains gold particles and their algae complex (as alguronic acid which is in the majority of Algenist products).  My skin likes the algae and this definetely moisturizes my skin as well as helps shrink pores.  This absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave skin feeling greasy at all- great for summer use! I wish this didn’t contain the gold and I also wish this were packaged in a container other than a jar.  This did moisturize my skin but I expect a little more when this costs as much as it does.  My review video below has more details on this product.

I’ve been using this for about a week now. It is honestly the best face cream I have ever used. It makes my skin look and feel perfect. My skin just glows from this cream! It leaves me as soft as a newborn baby. It isn’t oily and it absorbs super fast. I have two of the deluxe samples and I will definitely be purchasing a full size version. This is replacing both my day cream and night cream. I have sensitive combo skin, by the way.

The reason why I gave this an average rating is because personally, I can’t get over the fact that it’s heavily fragranced and contains several dimethicone and dimethicone cross polymers. I had this notion that algenist was a natural brand but upon further inspection it’s far from. If you look passed these two factors and you go further down the ingredient list, you’ll see there are a tonne of beneficial hydration and anti-aging ingredients like polysaccharides, plankton extract (I assume to aid in firming?), peptides, sodium hyaluronate (promotes hydration), squalane (a more stable form of squalene) and a slew of other beneficial ingredients. If you can get over fragrance, this is a great anti-aging product with instand and long term results.

I got this as a deluxe sample and have been using this with my day serum and night serum each from different brands - so I can try and see if I am getting results without using something similar too close together and I have to say I really love it so far I’m not seeing huge differences in any lines but I can tell that over all my face does look dramatically better.  I do believe I will buy the full jar once I run out.

Huge difference in the first day (and this is coming from someone who takes very good care of her skin). Probably as close to a holy grail as I’ll ever find. As soon as my deluxe sample ran out, it was immediately missed. Buying more.

I received this as a sample and I REALLY want to buy the full size but may have to wait till my birthday since $96 is a bit much. I’m 42 with good skin but in just 5 days of using this sample I noticed a very noteable improvement in my skin. My skin is smoother, so soft, and just has an overall younger look. I wish I could afford to use this head to toe!

Ok this is a serious game changer guys. I just started using this (I have combo / oily skin), and it’s literally changed my skin. I have never had softer, smoother, tighter skin in my life!!!! Even my boyfriend comments on my skin and how soft it is every night before bed! Do yourself a favor, BUY IT!!!

product_name: GOOPGENES All-In-One Super Nutrient Face Oil

review_text: My skin loves this oil!  I’ve been using it for several months now.  Previously used the Kora face oil, but my skin was changing ...(aka aging) and I needed more moisture.  I also have sensitive skin and I cannot use retinol, so I was looking for an option.  I was interested in the bakuchiol ingredient.  This Goopgenes oil is fantastic.  I only need about four drops (maybe just 2 on hot summer days) so my first bottle has lasted a long time.  I apply the oil before my moisturizer.  My skin looks fresh and nourished.  No more dry patches.  My fine lines have in fact reduced... my forehead look so much smoother.  To address other reviews regarding the scent... maybe like celery or fenugreek?  It’s not bothersome if you’re used to herbal stuff.  The colour of my oil was a light olive green, which is within normal range pictured on the website.  My skin is so much healthier and vibrant with this oil.  Completely worth it.  This product delivers on everything I needed.  Just bought my 2nd bottle.  I never want to be without this product!!!
product_name: GOOPGENES All-In-One Super Nutrient Face Oil

review_text: As per other reviews, when I first got this in the mail, I called Goop’s customer service to ask about the color. The employee I spoke to told me the color was normal, and not to worry. I like that it’s a unique looking mask. I didn’t like that the nose and eye area wouldn’t lay flat and contour to my face. Also, the mask isn’t wide enough to reach the jaw area like Sephora’s other sheet masks do. This only covers half of your cheek. review_text: THIS IS NOT A PEEL OFF MASK. They call it “peeling“ as in a chemical peel.
