I was a little concerned about it being irritating (I’m always hesitant when it comes to citrus but I’m not sure that’s based in anything lol) but it wasn’t an issue at all for me. The scent is really yummy but not strong and can only really be smelled when applying and washing off. I would have enjoyed it if the smell lingered while wearing but it’s probably a good thing irritation/sensitivity-wise that it doesn’t. Another positive is the price—it says 5 uses but will definitely last longer. I tried using more product the second time but it didn’t make a difference.The reason for only 2 stars is that this is NOT a peeling mask and it doesn’t seem to do much of anything. I’ve used at least three times, waiting different amounts of time, using more or less product, with and without water, and no matter what it is impossible to “massage” the product or make it “peel”. Usually peeling products combine with the oil on your skin and the product balls up, gently removing dead skin cells. But this mask dries so fast that it creates a rubbery film that won’t budge, peel, or even rinse off without any sort of cleanser. It has what feels like little exfoliating granules but they just sit on your face since you can’t massage them around. I even tried using as a scrub cleanser and it just slipped off and left the same rubbery film. I also didn’t notice any brightening or polishing effects unless the rubbery layer is supposed to be a polish. Luckily it didn’t irritate my skin (except for the excessive scrubbing/washing) or cause me to breakout. Maybe those with oily skin will have better luck?So one star for price, half a star for smell, and half for not being irritating or causing breakouts.

got this from the littles set! I had dry, flakey and red skin around the bottom of my nose and about 1 week after use it was gone!

They even recommend not using a cleanser in the AM if you used this in the PM so as to not strip your barrier and make your skin overly dry (but I always cleanse both AM and PM due to my acne prone skin). My routine right now is to use Cetaphil or ProDerm gentle cleanser in the am and apply serums and moisturizing sunscreen. Then I use this in the PM with my Foreo Luna. If it’s been a really long day or I know my face is really dirty from sweat or I’ve actually worn makeup for once, I’ll double cleanse with DHC oil cleanser in the evening to loosen and push out dirt from clogged pores before using this. Overall, this is my second mini and I’m very happy having this in my cleanser rotation. It’s always a good idea to have a thorough cleanser in the mix.

Omg wonderful product for early 30s! Got it as a sample now purchasing the big size.

I buy this for my grandma. She absolutely loves it and I’ve used it as well and your skin feels so silky afterwards. I won’t but it myself because it’s expensive but for her she loves it.

Pure luxury! Works great as a primer, after pressed into your skin it just melts in does not just sit on top of your skin. It has a mild fragrance not overwhelming. Received complimentary for review.Leaves a great base layer and much more than a primer. I’ve been using regular and really like the difference it has made in my skins appearance.

Dior skincare is a dream. This does more than just moisturize, it evens out skin tone & improves the texture. I switched off for a few weeks and really found other brands falling short of this. Would highly recommend!

This my first time using Dior skincare product, I used this serum everyday for 7 days and I already seeing great results, my dark spots and acne scars starts to fade, it brightens My skin and feels smooth and soft, has a nice luxurious scent & great packaging .cant wait to see a better results. This Dior serum is such a luxurious step in my skincare routine. This is my first time using this Dior product, I really like the thought put into the reusable packaging. I received this product complimentary for testing purposesMy skin is combination and I was afraid it’s be oily but it dried within ten minutes . The smell is amazing and fades as it dries . It was my first product that turned me from Lancome to Dior! I remember that 2 years ago when I just start to use it I was shocked by how it made my face glow naturally just in 3 or 4 days! This was overpriced for what it is. I feel like you could get the same smooth makeup ready skin  effect with a moisturizer and a primer for half the price or less. Would not recommend unless you don’t mind overpaying.
Keep your containers! My hubby finally had time to cut mine open and approx 75ml left in the bottoms! Even though they stopped pumping the product out they still felt like they weren’t empty
This product was just so amazing. Left my skin feeling super soft and visible improvement overtime.

Great product. Works on bare skin or under makeup providing naturally smooth and luminous finish. I use about a half pump to a full pump daily on the face and neck. The texture in light and good for all seasons, skin textures, and deep complexions.
Very pricey but it does get the job done, has a nice smell and texture.

Ugh, I wish I didn’t love this stuff but I do. It is the perfect amount for those “no make-up” days and you still need to run errands. I just fill in my brows, put this stuff on and some lip balm. I look just good enough to be presentable AND it’s good for my skin since it’s a serum. *sigh* I guess I will keep buying it and pray that 20% off sales happen often enough that I never run out!

This stuff is like crack for your face!!! oh my, yes its expensive but you will not be disappointed!! I go to wk at 4:30 am so I don’t have time to do full face I slap this on and add lipstick, BAM! DONE!! everyone asks me what is different about my face, like did I switch makeup. Skin is baby butt smooth and evens out your skin tones. LOVE IT!

amazing! worth the price. I use this as a primer or just as the last step of my skincare routine and it smoothes out my fine lines and reduces redness almost instantly. I am on my third refill. love this!

Buy the refill! If you want the awesomeness that is Dream Skin (and it really is just as good as you want it to be) but don’t care what the bottle looks like (though the refill is still attractive with its silver pump - it just doesn’t stand up due to its curved base) then save yourself $22 and buy this refill. review_title: Great for Acne prone skin & with textured skin

review_text: I love this product!! I use it as primer and sometimes I use this as a light moisturizer, I use capture total creme and the lift sculptor serum that matches the moisturizer as well and it’s a great triple threat combo.

I would’ve given this product a three star review but soooo many people seem to love it so I didn’t want to deter others. I’m 30. I have some wrinkles around my eyes and on my forehead. I have dark circles. I have medium sized pores. My skin tone isn’t super even but not bad. Combination skin I think. Noticeable differences after a few uses were my pores appeared a bit smaller and my skin was SO SOFT. My makeup stayed in tact longer through the day (or maybe better skin just made up for it?). I’ve been using the product for 3.5 weeks now, every morning and sometimes at night as well. I haven’t seen any other differences. I like it. I don’t love it. So for the price I probably wouldn’t purchase it again. But I’m glad I tried it!
I will never use anything else ever!! The best I have ever used.

I love this face cream so much! I fell like when I wear it don’t have to wear foundation or powder. It gives me a perfect moisturized matte complexion without covering up my freckles or making me feel like my face doesn’t match my body
I absolutely love this! For everyday use, I apply this and then some powder instead of using foundation. It’s very lightweight and smells good. It also leaves my skin feeling smooth.

I agree that this product is extremely expensive, but it is totally worth it. review_title: The best skincare product I’ve ever used!

review_title: Amazing product, about time Sephora had the refill

review_text: Starting to really get into Charlotte Tilbury products, as I have mature skin and all of her products leave my skin absolutely glowing!! I then use the balm with the towelette to take off the remaining makeup, sort of as a double cleanse. It leaves my skin more moisturized that way. I haven’t tried it as a balm or moisturizer yet. But the possibilities are endless with this product. If you’re on the fence, I’d say give it a try. Especially if you have drier skin.

You either love or hate the smell. I love roses so I think it’s super luxurious. It is very sticky as an overnight mask and I was going to write it off until I saw how nicely my makeup applied the next day. I had flakey dry skin around my mouth and nose and this hydrated my skin so well. I couldn’t believe it. I just have a trial size but I’ll keep using this for sure.
Was so excited to try it out. Well, the moment I put it on my face, that smell was horrific,i have to return. Disappointed, big time!

Not what I expected at all. I use this balm as a moisturizer and primer under makeup, even though it is marketed for removing makeup. I have never had so many compliments on my skin. It gives the perfect “glow from within” look and I use less makeup as a result. I’ve nixed foundation from my routine and use a bit of concealer under my eyes and around my nose only. A little bit of product goes a long way, and I find it both provides a protective layer on my skin to assist with dryness and helps my makeup last longer.

Look, there’s a good reason I knocked a star off of a product that works really well. I don’t use it as a cleansing balm, but as an occasional overnight mask I love it! It resolves dry skin like a champ.   HOWEVER. If you share a bed with a man, you run the risk of him identifying the strong floral scent of this product as WEIRD, THAT SMELLS EXACTLY LIKE A PINK URINAL CAKE. And he’ll be right.    Go ahead and ask any guy to smell this product and he’ll absolutely recognize it. As someone who worked in the cleaning supply industry, I can confirm that this combination of florals IS a dead-on dupe for the pink deodorizing disk found in men’s public restrooms. So, yes, it works wonders...but that smell, though.
review_title: Works, but there's something you should know...

review_title: If you have dry skin - this is amazing

A daily staple. Pulls the make up off effortlessly. I apply this before I take my shower. It has time to penetrate the skin. Amazing.

Actually quite disappointed in this product. I love Charlotte Tilbury products but the smell is very strong and I honestly am not a fan. It also does not really work well. Does not budge the mascara second wash is imperative. Would honestly like my money back. It was very expensive.

I’ve used this balm under my eyes at night for extra moisture in the winter months or when I’m wearing concealer too much! You won’t regret it.

I absolutely love this product! It’s the ultimate multitasker! It boosts your skin with so much hydration and it smells like jasmine heaven! I use this as a joint body moisturizer, so on my ankles, knees, elbows, neck, and anywhere else that needs an incredible amount of emollient moisture. I use it the most as a sleeping mask and I actually prefer this more than the Night Magic Cream because it’s more hydrating and leaves my skin baby soft in the morning and my pores look visibly smaller. Over time, my skin looks more healthy and glowing and I have fewer breakouts! For the size and performance, it’s worth every penny and it will last you the year (or later)!
Leaves my skin feeling great after. Takes off mascara well. Scent is not too strong for me (as other users have indicated).

This is my newest addition to my personally acquired Charlotte Tilbury skin care regimen and it has made all the difference in my skin. I always thought a cleanser is just a cleanser, wash with it, rinse it away, move on. Not this one. After washing off my makeup at night, I use a small amount again and massage it into my skin. I use the Magic night cream on top of it, and the Magic Rescue eye cream, and that’s it. My skin has never looked better and my routine has never been so quick and simple. Individually these products may seem pricey but when you consider how long they last due to how little you need to use each day, and how few steps there are, it’s a bargain. As for this cleansing balm, I have tried many high end similar products and none perform as well as this one does. Buying here at Sephora is risk-free with their great return policy, or go into the store and ask for a sample before you buy it. This entire line is amazing. Buy it. Now! Go!

review_text: Not a terrible product, but definitely not worth the price. I have normal skin, a bit sensitive but no acne. I absolutely am in love with La Mer, but this one is a bit odd. It felt nice when I put it on. I left it on for the amount of time recommended. Then tried to wipe off the excess. And that was the weird part. It felt stuck on my face. I even splashed water and the water repelled off like rainex!! It felt like I had wax on my face. I then read the ingredient list and it said dimethicone multiple times at the top of the list and thought omg! Dimethicone is a silcone(wax). Which can coat skin and hair and trap bacteria. Which I guess can also hold moisture too but I really felt the wax on my face. Water was beading off. I washed my face with a cleanser to get it off and felt a small amount of residue still left on my skin. I’m not sure I would pay $170 for high amount of dimethicone in my skincare that can trap bacteria. None of the other products have that ingredient. I’m not sure how I feel about this one. Every other product is remarkable! And my favorite. But I’m just not sure about this one.
review_title: felt like wax was on my face

I tend to forget to leave skincare reviews because it takes time to know if it works, then I forget and if I post, it won’t be “purchased verified”because it has passed the 90-days window. However, This deserves its flowers that it also is! I have sometimes sensitive, combo-skin that is exposed to drying chemical exfoliation. So I need something that will balance oil production w/o being too heavy to clog or too superficial that it will not actually absorb. It’s the reason I’m into gels/liquids more than creams. After looking through products, I bought this as it seemed to have a lot more pros and it surely does. It is simple, vegan, non-essential oil, non-irritant working with the acids I use, fine-misted, non-greasy/sticky, with no artificial fragrance. All packaged in a dark glass container, which is best to avoid rapid degradation and better for the environment when disposing. Most importantly, this jasmine mist has the ability to absorb into the skin to quench it rather than sit on top. Very soothing and the jasmine scent is not bothersome to me. I’m not a fan of jasmine scents sometimes, however, this one is natural and disappears shortly after misting!I keep it in my fridge to preserve, since it’s a more natural product composed of jasmine essence. 4 mists after the shower, when my face dries, is what I do even though 2 is really only needed but it feels great applying on the skin. Even topping up throughout the day is refreshing. My face doesn’t feel tight or sticky and my skin doesn’t over-produce oil to compensate for the lack of true moisture, usually the result from other products. Also, I haven’t broken out after incorporating this into my routine. I use it before all other skincare, my goat Ordinary Niacinamide serum, Glycolic Toner, sometimes AHA mask. So glad I bought 2 during the rouge sale so it can last me a while. Natural is not always better when it comes to skin products but here it is.

You know that old saying, “you get what you pay for“, well, that couldn’t more true when deciding whether this product is worth the cost. Yes, it truly is.At 56, I’ve tanned my entire life, but in my 40’s I realized laying out in the sun or using tanning beds was no longer the best thing to do for my skin. I’ve used every single self tanner in every different formula available, from high end brands, mail order brands and drug store brands. Some were okay, some were really bad. But, then I tried wonder oil.Wonder oil is just that, a wonder oil. Application couldn’t be easier, just roll it on and rub it in just as you would your lotion. Because it’s an oil, it’s easy to tell where you have applied it and as one would guess, it’s very moisturizing. The color is beautiful and natural. I have olive skin to begin with and tanning brings that out deeper and darker, wonder oil gives me the same color I would get had I laid out or used the tanning bed, deep and natural looking.One of my biggest issues with self tanners, and that which will make or break a product for me, is how it wears and fades. We all know that splotchy look some self tanners give as they fade, not this one. Wonder oil fades evenly with no splotches whatsoever which makes it easy to bold upon the initial base.I apply wonder oil twice weekly to maintain my tan all summer long, this product builds upon itself beautifully without any streaking. The key to a good self tan with this, & any self tan, is the foundation you use. For your initial use, make sure your skin is exfoliated well, shave the day before, & wait at least 1/2 hour after a shower before applying. Because it’s an oil, it does take longer to dry down. I put on a light robe & continue with makeup & hair before dressing. In between applications, make sure you’re moisturizing your skin daily and you won’t have to exfoliate after that, just continue applying wonder twice weekly all summer long for a beautiful, natural looking tan.

review_text: I’ve been using this moisturizer for years!!! Happy to see it’s finally at Sephora! I have sensitive skin and combination/ oily. I love using this moisturizer under my make up, even if my make up has spf.
product_name: Oil Free Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30

review_text: Love this stuff.  Doesn’t pill, works great under makeup and has SPF!  Not too thick, doesn’t make me greasy at all, and not a strong SPF scent.
product_name: Oil Free Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30

review_text: I love this cream. I’ve been using it for years. I put it on before makeup, and it makes my skin feel hydrated, but not greasy. It dries down quickly for me. I am so happy they have this at Sephora now!
product_name: Oil Free Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30

review_text: So glad Sephora has this brand now! Mario Badescu is the reason my skin looks and feels amazing. I have always had trouble trying to find the right skincare routine due to having combination skin, and this moisturizer right here is perfect for combo/oily! It feels somewhat sticky and dries fast when yo first put it on, but the sticky feeling fades away and leaves your skin feeling soooo smooth!
product_name: Oil Free Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30

review_text: Ironically, this product made my skin feel really slick and oily. I like that is has SPF 30, but I couldn’t stand looking like a grease ball every morning.
product_name: Oil Free Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30

review_text: I was beyond disappointed that they discontinued the Sephora tanning mist. So I gave this a try.. I like that it’s pretty easy to apply, no streaks, dries pretty quickly and it’s buildable.. but the SMELL. Omg it’s atrocious. With the original Sephora spray I could put it on and not have to shower after and it had no scent. And this one looks so good when I wake up (some fades after the shower) but there’s no way I can not shower after leaving it all night, the smell is so bad that sometimes even after I shower I can STILL smell it. If they did something about the smell it would be a decent tanner. But it’s not for those who want to be really really dark, its a pretty natural colour and I don’t find it orange at all, after one use I have a bit of a glow, after 2 uses it’s more noticeable

No allergic reaction or itching, thankfully; great gradual and natural color. Ordered my second bottle. I have never had the “bruised knees” look or color buildup on the backs of my ankles, which is a “gift” from so many others I have tried. Just works for me!
review_title: Second bottle, and I’ve tried them all!

review_text: I have used various self tanners for decades and can honestly say I have never had one that did NOTHING, until now. I liked everything else about it…easy application with thin foam, the self tanner scent wasn’t bad, and the price was excellent. However, none of those things matter when it gives you ZERO color. I exfoliated prior, showered and then applied. The next day I applied again, and then tried a third time just to make sure it didn’t need more build. When I say no color, I mean it did nothing. Despite it being cheap, I still went back to the store and returned it! Will stick with my go to drugstore brands for now.
Definitely a more natural self tanner. But that’s what I was looking for. If it smelled better though..

Smells bad and didn’t work at all! Like literally no change in colour. They used to have a spray that was a nice colour and worked well. I would definitely suggest paying a little more for a different brand
If you want orange skin go for it...I’m so disappointed and it smelled exactly like apple cider vinegar.The day after you put that on it will get even more orange be careful!
First time tanner here, I enjoy the light weight feel it’s not heavy on the skin.

Seriously amazing, don’t need a sponge to spread, comes out as white foam and leaves no streaks. I hop in the white sheets after and it never leaves a mark. I love love love it. I’ve bought 3 bottles so far and a bottle of the face self tanner

Il faut savoir qu’il s’agit d’un autobronzant graduel, je ne m’attendais pas à cela d’un autobronzant en mousse. Ayant la peau assez pâle, j’ai tout de même trouvé qu’une couche donnait un hâle ‘bonne mine’.
Please bring back the spray tan version. This one doesn’t even come close. What a disappointment.

This is by far my favourite tanning product. This is definitely more on the natural side and I would agree is buildable. I love that I can apply at night and wake up with a golden color, not orange or grey looking and I sometimes don’t even rinse off. I like the “runny mouse” as I find one pump can do each arm and two pumps for each leg. Also doesn’t stain my sheets or clothing. Already on my third bottle

Completely completely bummed! For over 5 years I used the Sephora Tinted Self tanning mist and loved it!! I can’t believe it was discontinued- I would’ve ordered 10 more of them if I could’ve. So I tried this Sephora tanning body mousse. And it is NOT a mousse, it is a watery foamy mess!. I waited to see if it would be a buildable tan for me and nothing. I have used it four times in the past 24 hours to build on the ‘tan’- and cannot even tell that I darkened at all. It’s an awful mess!!! I Purposely did not put it on my belly so I could tell the difference in what is my real body color and what is the buildable tan color and there is no difference after four applications in 24 hours. One Must have to be really pale for this to show up. I have Mediterranean olive skin when in the sun, however, I have not been in the sun so I have no real tan. I’m pretty pale. Such a disappointment. Don’t spend your money on it, and Sephora! Bring back the Sephora tinted body mist!

Great sun kissed color without the worry of damage from sun rays! This lightweight mousse applies easily and absorbs quickly. It smells nice and left my skin feeling hydrated but not sticky. It creates a nice builldable color. I love it and it’s my new go-to self tanner of the season! I have yellow undertones to my skin and it didn’t look orangey or fake (see photos).
It spreads nicely but barely makes a difference, and literally none after one application. Also disappears quickly and smells like tanner.

Not a big fan.  I give it two stars because the tan is natural looking and buildable, but that’s about all that great about this product.  I’m not sure why they call it mousse, it’s more like a foam.  It’s not easy to rub on because it’s so runny, and the smell is extremely unpleasant.   I’ll continue to use it until it’s gone, but wouldn’t purchase again.
Ça donne un effet très très naturel. Je ne vois pas une énorme différence pour être bien honnête.

Applied the first layer as soon as I got out of the shower after I exfoliated & I applied it with the st tropez tanning mitt. It is pretty sticky for about a half hour so I wait till I’m not sticky to put clothes on. I didn’t tell a difference if it developed after the first layer & my husband couldn’t tell either. I let it sit for about 4 hours then I went in for a second layer & slept through the night. I didn’t have any staining on my sheets & I woke up this morning with a deep tan! It’s a beautiful glow as well. Not streaky at all & not Orange!!! It has a very strong tanning smell that lingers all day. I still smell it on me now. It smells like jergens natural glow. Highly recommend. The foam comes out white so you don’t see where you rubbed but there’s no streaking at all!! I’m light-med & I have a subtle tan from Laying outside for a few days but this took my tan to a whole new level! Really impressed with this

Super super streaky. I’m surprised no one else had this issue. I rubbed it in really well and followed the instructions (and I’ve been trying different self tanner’s for about 20 years!).... but this left such dark streaks. I’ll definitely be wearing pants until this washes off!

Perfect for anyone with fair skin. Amazingly subtle bronze glow. It isn’t a huge “wow, you went on vacation“ tan but it gives a healthy, not orange-y, colour. Still smells like self tanner, and is a bit sticky for the first 30 mins after application, but I haven’t had any issues with colour transfer or anything. Obviously, like all self tanning products, make sure you exfoliate before use and I would recommend a tanning mitt so you don’t get colour on your palms.
review_title: one of the best self tanners for the price it is

review_text: I have had many terrible experiences when it comes to self tanner (as I’m pretty pale) but this stuff is MAGIC. I used the st tropez mitt to apply and I was left with a streak free glow. I was apprehensive about purchasing considering it’s not “light to medium” but I couldn’t be happier with the results. I didn’t want anything too intense so I did a very light application and this exceeded my expectations!
review_title: If you’re pale, this stuff is perfect!

review_text: I love the fact you don’t have to wash this off when you use it. It dries very quickly and doesn’t feel sticky, personally, I wait around 15-20 minutes before putting on clothes overtop. As others said it is a relatively subtle tan which I like since you can build up instead of it being too dark too fast. The only downside is the mousse is clear so it can be hard to tell exactly where you are putting it and if it is even. I also found that the tan develops over 24 hours instead of the stated 3 hours when they recommend putting a second coat on for a deeper tan.
review_title: Best leave on tanner for really pale people

review_text: It’s okay for a super light wash of color! The pros are that it goes on clear, doesn’t smell and doesn’t fade patchy at all. I use it on my face, too and it gives very subtle color. I have a light olive complexion. Sephora, please make a darker option!!!
I am new to self-tanning and I love this. Not too dark upon first application, good price, not streaky and is buildable. I will definitely purchase again
Not loving this as it didn’t give much color. Its great otherwise, goes on smoothly and doesnt smell bad. Just doesnt give a whole lot of color!
review_title: Not great if you're looking for a notable tan

review_text: Loved it! Very similar to Bondi Sands tan products except this one didn’t dry my skin out and it also didn’t have that typical sunless tanner odour. A nice golden colour. Nothing to dark and NOT orange, just a natural day in the sun look.  Will be buying again for sure!

I used to use the Bondi Sands mousse religiously until this one! There is no colour guard. Smell is typically fake tan smell, no coconut. I’d say one application is similar to the medium Isle of Paradise products, and a second application is smiler to the dark products. A lot of self tanning products in general I find really dries out my skin, but this one doesn’t. Fading isn’t patchy, and last I’d say 4-5 days. I like to use isle of paradise drops or their tanning butter to touch up. Overall, a great, more affordable product/dupe to St. Tropez and Bondi Sands mousse!

This self tan is easy to apply, although the mousse is white (no colour guard) so there isn’t an immediate colour payoff.  The result isn’t super dark.  It’s a soft even tan.  If you’re looking to become a few shades darker, this isn’t that drastic.  I’d give it 3 stars, but it’s getting 4 because the ingredient list, and the fade isn’t patchy.

I’m giving this 3 stars because I didn’t look orange and the colour was pretty natural sun-kissed. There was no staining on my clothes or sheets which I was very thankful for. The tan didn’t last very long on my skin abut 2 days, but I also shower often and use exfoliating mitts. However, one coat is definitely not enough with this stuff. I was expecting it to be fair, but I was kind of disappointed that I had to go in it’s a second application. Also this stuff smells so strong of the fake tan scent and it lingers on clothes. Honestly I would repurchase this again if it wasn’t for the smell.

Holy Cow. Ok I have to admit this was my first time using self tanner and I was highly doubtful about the whole process. I am glowing. The tan looks completely natural and is even throughout my body. I do not look orange. As a pasty white woman I wanted to even my complexion from my yellow tone tanned shoulders to my blue toned hands and it did just that.

love love love. very soft, buildable, and natural color. I put it on two nights straight to build a deeper color and I probably could have done a third for a more dramatic color. Not orange whatsoever, applied evenly, and faded beautifully! Does has a slight self tanner smell, but didn’t bother me. Slept in it overnight and didn’t get on my bedding at all. Looked like I just got back from a weekend trip in the sun

this met all my hopes. i love the undertone of this!! not orange like most self tanners. if you have an olive undertone on the light/medium side this is perfect for you. it’s not super dark but after the first application wait three hours and apply again for a deeper tan. this is also mess free and did not stain my white sheets. gave it 4 instead of 5 stars because i did reapply twice for a deeper tan but not a big deal at all for me. i will continue to buy this. leave this forever please ❤️❤️❤️
This is shimmery!!Algenist has many great eye cream! Don’t get this one!
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: Just not sure this product does anything. I would not get this again.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

I wasn’t so sure how good it was working until I switched to it cosmetics eye cream which I felt more hydrated but did not erase wrinkles like the Algernist! I buy this originally in a kit with two other products and loved them all but especially the eye cream.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: Deflates eye bags!!! Praying the low ratings don’t get this discontinued because it’s essential to me. No other product has made my eye bags flatten. I only really put it there. LOVEEE
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I got this as a sample and used it for three days and got a terrible reaction under my eyes by the third day. I do not recommend if you have sensitive skin !!
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I have only been using this for a couple of week so I have only noticed the moisturizing effects of this product.. This product is super thick, like a paste consistency. My skin is dry, so after I wash my face I need to put a moisturizer on afterwards. This eye cream is very hydrating. For me, it does not crease my makeup or create a “cakey“ look. This product will probably be too heavy for oiler skin or in weather that is hot and humid. It doesn’t wow me, but it works enough for me to be satisfied with it.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I loooooove this stuff.  A year or so ago I noticed that my eye around my crease was kind of drooping so I picked up this stuff and it’s right back where it was supposed to be!  It took a little time but I use it once a day at night and I’m not having any issues
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I was shocked how well this product gave me results after 6 weeks and I have bought $200 eye creams that were just okay with minimalist results.  Second eye cream I have used with Algenist and I am VERY impressed with the quality of their products!!!  Rarely do I have must have products and write reviews and this on e deserved it.   A Sephora rep recommended it to me.
review_title: Exceptional eye cream for the price!!
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I love this eye cream. It lifts and illuminates are eyes beautifully. I enjoy doing little experiments like using one eye cream on my right eye and another on my left. Algenist’s elevate has out performed other Algenist eye creams without fail. I also prefer it over Tatcha and Eminence (spa brand in same price range).  This is one product I’ll keep using. At least until I find something that outperforms it.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I have seen improvement in the texture on the skin around my eyes. I love the product! The packaging is not great. The product comes in a pot, but is too thick to “grab” with your fingertip. You need a tiny spatula, which is doesn’t come with.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I have tried several Algenist products, and this by far is the best. It absorbs quite quickly and leaves skin flexible.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: Terrible eye cream. I purchased it for the 10 day result but nothing has changed but terrible reaction to this product. I keep getting stye in my eyes. It’s not moisturizing enough. Then I thought maybe I have to give it 4-6 weeks to work. I will be returning this product and have photos of my eyes. I also purchased the serum and it’s terrible as well. My face as red bumps.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I thought this was ok at first, but by the time I was 1/2 way through the jar the consistency had thickened making it very difficult to apply...now if I wanted to use I would have to really rub hard to get it to absorb  - no thanks, especially in the delicate under eye area!
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I liked (not loved) this eye cream.  Didn’t really do anything for fine lines/wrinkles around eyes.  However, it did give my eyes a bit of a glow around my eyes. Too thick to put on over makeup, so I used this only at night. I am still searching for a life changing eye cream...
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I love the Elevate serum by this same brand, but the eye cream doesn’t seem to be anything special. It’s certainly better than using nothing but there are better eye creams out there. I’m bummed it didn’t work wonders for me like the serum did. I have a deluxe sample which has lasted me for forever, so the full size of this would definitely go a long way.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I received a sample of this. I’ve tried dozens of eye creams from every brand (Fresh, Estee Lauder, Philosophy, Shiseido, etc). I have crepiness and some deep lines in my undereye, and some looser skin of my upper eyelid. My skin is dry. As I’ve tried so many products, I didn’t expect miracles. I’ve been using it morning and night for about a week. With most skincare, you need to wait a few weeks to see results (If any). It’s been about a week and I’ve noticed a drastic firming and reduction in my not-so fine lines and crepiness. Simply amazing. I have tried another eye cream from Algenist and didn’t have this kind of result. I’m honestly blown away. The cream is thick, and has a pearly appearance. If anything, it helped brighten. But thankfully it did not interfere with makeup application. It was emolient enough for my dryness without leaving a greasy residue like some other creams I’ve tried. It’s expensive, but not as expensive as constantly searching for the results this actually brings. The search is over!
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: This product was recommended to me by a salesperson at the store after I admitted I don’t mind paying a decent bit of money for an eye cream if it works. She explained to me that the company gurantees results in 10 days so I gave it a try. I really dislike this product. I saw no results at all after using it for well over a month. If anything it made my undereyes worse which seems crazy but it really did start to seem like my fine lines got deeper. Going to return it, there is better products on the market for much less even.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: No results, and the product smells bad. It is not worth to purchase, better brands out there
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: help with puffy under eyes and darkness.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I have tried almost every eye cream you could think of and none of them worked for me. It wasn’t until I stumbled upon this miracle worker! I saw results within one week. My eyes no longer look puffy or tired. Will keep repurchasing!
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I added this eye cream to my daytime routine.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I have a weepy eye. The salty water really drys out that particular eye and both are dry within the aging process anyway. (I’m 57)  This cream gives all day moisture I can feel to the touch. I let it soak in as much as I can and find I can apply makeup over it’s slightly tacky feel. It’s a little grabby, if that makes sense, and the makeup doesn’t slip and slide off. I just use a light touch during application. I will buy again.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I ended up returning this after the sales person recommended it to me, I wanted something for under eye wrinkles and this cream did nothing for me. It was a decent moisturizer and illuminated a little bit but that’s about it.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I’ve used this for about a month and didn’t notice any positive results.  Instead, I began seeing lines underneath my eyes that I haven’t seen before.  Also, the product does not absorb well at all.  By the morning, I can actually brush off some of the product off like eraser bits.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: Love love love this product. I have a toddler and also bartend at night so i average about 5hrs of sleep sometimes less on weekends and my undereye area was looking rough. I purchased this product as an impulse buy while at sephora and I’m so glad I did. Started seeing results within a week. Visibly reduced lines and major improvement to under eye bags. I was using face masks every weekend but since purchasing this product have not needed to. I wake up looking refreshed and even feel confident enough to go out without the usual layers of concealer I was using. It does have a pearlescent hue to it so I would not recommend wearing it under make up. I use it evernight before bed.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: Bad product and super expensive. I wish I returned it and got my money back. I have it to my mom and she didn’t like it.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I wanted to like this...but it felt like putting Chapstick under my eye. Nothing added to benefit and like someone else said.....too heavy. And it doesn’t seem to be absorbed at all. I’ve tried it off and on for about a year. Trying to find a way it wouldn’t be a total loss of money....but it was. Plz find something else.  Couldn’t even give it to my friends....they kept bringing it back. Sorry but it’s the truth.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I had been using Algenists eye renewal balm for years, but I recently noticed that it just didn’t appear to be doing anything for me anymore. I’ve tried their genius eye cream, but I’m 30 and that stuff was WAY too heavy for my eyes at this point.BUT ALGENIST found an answer!I love how cushiony this eye cream is! It smooths on like a dream, and I dare say this will last me for a very long time! I apply this to my undereye, my orbital bone, and my brow bone. It moisturizes just enough so it’s not greasy, and absorbs nicely. Sometimes before bed I’ll put one layer on, wait for it to absorb a bit, and then slick on another layer if my eyes are feeling super puffy or I’ve been burning the candle at both ends. It’s kind of like an overnight mask for my eyes that way!I have combo/oily skin and this doesn’t travel to my pores and clog them up like other eye creams have done. I also love how the cream is somewhat pearlescent, which reflects light off of my hereditary dark circles (no seriously though, no eye cream can help it, I’ve had dark circles since I was in preschool), and makes them vaguely less noticeable.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: I love this eye cream. Everything about it is awesome. I love how rich it is, I love how hydrating and moisturizing it is, and most of all, I love the color!!! That slight ethereal radiance brightens up my under eyes so beautifully. When I put it on in the morning, I look like I’ve slept for 10 hours. When I put it on at night I don’t look like I’ve worked all day. My makeup rests on it nicely. I use it with the serum and it’s straight up divine!  Love! Love! Love!
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: My title says it all. I wanted so much to like this. I have just slight sagging sometimes under my eyes and the heaviness of this cream made it worse! DO NOT SPEND YOUR HARD EARNED MONEY ON THIS! I’m taking it back. I believe I am done with this line. I’ve tried every product, and the money you spend on these little liars in jars IS NOT WORTH IT.
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: Sorry Algenist. Im a big fan of all the other products ive used, but this one just needs more moisture. Im sure in time it may help with crows feet but i couldnt make it more than 2 weeks as it dried me out even more than I was. Looked worse. Need some hyaluronic acid in here or something. 3/4 of a jar left, and just cant use it :(
product_name: ELEVATE Firming & Lifting Contouring Eye Cream

review_text: Packaging is lovely, so is the scent, I love that part- but it doesn’t do what it’s supposed to. It doesn’t hydrate and it’s not a good lip balm. For the price that you pay for, you’re only paying for the brand, not good quality as you would expect. Of course results may vary depending on the person who is using it, but I personally would give a warning to prospective buyers. If you want to pay for the brand and just have it as a cute little aesthetic piece, by all means go ahead- but there are FAR better lip balms for a third of the price.
review_title: Good perfume concept, bad lip balm

review_text: I love lip balms since Covid I have hard time wear lipstick at all. I have bought any lip balm any cosmetic/make up company made. Unfortunately I was disappointed by Dior. The color is very pretty and a perfect nude. But: It was hydrating the first 5 minutes and then it started drying out my lips. I had it on for one full day while traveling reapplying often and the day after my lips were completely destroyed and chapped. Disappointing coming from Dior.
i don’t know why the bad reviews because this lipstick balm is the best. I applied only one time at the mall and Color and shine stay all day. Looks beautiful and juicy.
It is more like a lipstick rather than a lip balm. It even dries out my lip a little bit. However, the color is beautiful and long-lasting.
I wanted to love this lip balm but the colour wasn’t long lasting at all.

The reviews are mad about the price but at the same time what did you expect from Dior? It does what any lip balm does, hydrates and makes you lip soft. This lip balm also made my lips look glossy. If you hate the price so much then stop complaining and start saving.
LOVE! Just love. I have 3 of them for bedside, handbag and makeup table. Best lip balm I think I have ever used!
I’m here to let you know 100 matte is the perfect nude! I have light skin with neutral undertone. Love the natural formula.

Overall this was a letdown for me and mine is going back. It’s frustrating that you can’t see these in store because this Cherie color is NOTHING like pictured. I had to double check that I wasn’t accidentally sent the wrong color. Pictures show a soft nude pink, but this is DARK red. I tried it on hoping that it applied much lighter and looked somewhat like the picture but nope, it’s just red. I was also disappointed that it didn’t feel more hydrating. This is just less pigmented lipstick in my opinion and not the color OR formula I thought I was getting. I also felt like it faded away to nothing rather quickly and my lips felt dryer after. The pluses are the luxurious case and nice dior smell.
review_title: Beware of colors & not very hydrating for a balm

review_text: Don’t like the scent. It doesn’t moisturize that much. Would sadly return.
I love the color and the way it feels on. It is a great nude lip color. Makes my lips feel soft.
I have had every red you can imagine. This is the holy grail. Pure velvet!!!
I don’t like the smell, too floral and perfum-y. It doesn’t work for me, my lips are not softer or nicer after I wear this one. Too pricey for what you get.
Love this lipstick, Nude Look is the shade I’ve been looking for finally something that complements my skin tone! Love it!
Holy grail for no makeup makeup looks.  It’s really hydrating, it looks like I’m wearing nothing.  Alongside the lip maximizer in rosewood, it looks very plumping and gives a natural finish.
review_title: Holy grail for no makeup makeup days

review_text: Since I have to wear a mask all day at work I have been on the hunt for a holy grail lip product that would give my lips a little oomph without smearing inside the mask. There is a very slight sheen to this that makes my lips look lush. It isn’t a lip mask, so don’t expect it to transform or heal your lips, but if you’re looking for something better than regular balm. I also love that it’s not greasy or tacky.

I love Dior in general and wanted to love this product but the beautiful color didn’t last at all. I reapplied quite frequently to no avail. At the end of the day, my lips weren’t that moisturized. I’m not a fan of the scent either. If you don’t like strongly scented lip products, proceed with caution.

I wanted to like this balm, but it didn’t really hydrate my lips and wore off very quickly. I found myself reapplying every 10 min. The colour was gorgeous, so I gave it three stars. When you’ve used self-tanner a long time you learn that there are a few things you have to do to prep your skin for self tanner… Exfoliate and hydrate the areas you’re going to fan for a few days before you do the self tanning. If you have patches of dry skin ANY product you try is going to patch because the active ingredients work differently on dry or dead areas. That isn’t the fault of the product since there is no product that will work optimally if you don’t prep your skin before you self tan. SO - I prepped my skin as usual then put on my usual hydration, then I just sprayed my face and body generously with this and that was IT! I waited 5 minutes for the product to dry and put on my makeup and went about my day and 4 hours later I had a perfect even all over glow in a beautiful natural golden shade. It’s so much better than a gel product! The mist is so fine that it deposits completing perfectly without blending! No blending whatsoever!!! I couldn’t believe it! No product on my clothes or bed sheets - a totally clean tan. I am beyond happy with these products they are BY FAR the very best self-tanning products I’ve ever tried in terms of results, ease of use and no bad side effects like patchiness, smell or clothes staining… I know I must not have misted perfectly because I was in a hurry but my tan is the most even it’s ever been and even previously hard to reach areas like my back are perfect. The ONLY reason I could see anyone having an issue is if they did zero prepping or the skin - which is something you have to do with any self tanning products. If you want to try self tanning this is the kit - just watch a video about how to prep the skin properly and you’re literally golden.

review_text: I’m honestly so impressed with Mount Lai quality! I recently got their de-puffing and textured rollers and love them so much! They both came carefully packed in pretty boxes preventing damaging. There also were some instructions on how to use the tools, which was very handy. Both rollers look absolutely beautiful and well made (the textured one is more pale as you can see on the pictures). As for the texture I personally find it to be a bit harsh for my face so I’m using it on my neck and shoulders where it works great. I usually use these with some face oil as the final step of my morning routine. I start with the de-puffing roller from the center of my face to the periphery and then change the roller and use the textured one for my neck and shoulders. It takes less then 5 minutes a day and makes such a difference in my skin leaving it looking younger and tighter!If you’re thinking about investing in some facial tool - Mount Lai is a great choice! They make really high end facial tools that look stunning and work perfectly well. I can’t wait to add some more to my collection!

Such an amazing gift! Is quite pricey but so amazing! As soon as I took it out of the packing it was so cooling I felt there was no need to put it in a makeup fridge, loved it and I reallyyyy hope it gets the job done

Absolutely in love with this jade roller that was given to me by mountlai for free ! It has really made a difference in my skin and i absolutely love it. Would 10/10 recommend this to others and will continue to use it and incorporate it to my daily routine.

I had never used a jade roller before, and did not know if I would like it, but this one is so nice to use! I love the texture on it and I think that it is more beneficial than using a smooth one. I use this at nighttime and it is so cooling and relaxing. I love the look of the roller too. It is so pretty to look at that my mom wants one now too. It arrived in really nice packaging that would prevent it from breaking so I was happy about that. I need to use it more to see how it holds up to daily use. The color is a little more vibrant in person and is really pretty
This is absolutely amazing I have horrible migraines and this helps me relax

This is a great tool to have. Yes, it’s pricey but if you’re like me and you sometimes are puffy in the face or if you want better absorption of your products.. this is a great additive to have. It also comes with a 1 year warranty from the manufacturer. I especially like the textured feature - it wake my skin up!

I’ve been on a Mount Lai kick and purchased this a few months ago. I usually wake up with a puffy face (combo of allergies and lack of sleep), and this helps immensely. I usually put some rosehip seed oil on in the morning and then use this to gently roll over my face. It helps to depuff me and the texture is rather energizing. At night I sometimes use it in areas that are starting to get more prominent lines, such as around my mouth and on my forehead. Echoing other reviewers, I was concerned about the potential quality issues, but I haven’t had any problems so far. The texture for me is very pleasant, but I’d be sure to use this slowly and mindfully, and don’t press too hard. I probably wouldn’t use this if I had more delicate or thinner skin.

I’ve been using this product over the course of a year and it’s been such a blessing. The texture makes a huge difference for me and it feel amazing on my skin when using with a serum or thick moisturizer. I’ve noticed when I use this often, my face is less bloated and the muscles around my jaw is a lot less sore. I was skeptical from reading the reviews, but have never had any quality issues. I’ve also purchased this as a gift for one of my girl friends and she loves it as well.
I really like mine! Too soon to tell if it’s anything special but it is nice to massage my face.

Great right out of the box! I got this to replace my beloved double-sided textured and smooth jade roller, and I hope this works half as well.
I do love this roller. It’s exactly what I expected for the price. Love holding it under hot water and then massaging my face.

This brand is expensive/overpriced and this is probably the only product I like from this brand that’s worth the money.

The perfect toner, in the sense that it removes dirt and oil, while being gentle on the skin. It’s the perfect in between step for post-cleanser and pre-serum application. It also goes a long way in my opinion.

review_title: Best toner I have ever used

review_text: The best toner you pay for quality and it last a while I use all her products and my skin has never looked this good .
Glowy skin after using it for a week. Completely changed my skin, wow!

It also removes all residue and corrects your skin to its optimal pH balance. If you can spare the money I feel this is one of the best toners on the market!

I really like this toner! It’s simple and makes my skin look nice, feel refreshed and never dry. Probably won’t end up repurchasing on the regular because of the price, but def recommend!

I would rate the actual product 5 stars, it’s one of the best toners/essences I’ve used so far and it had an immediate conditioning effect on my skin that I haven’t seen with any other product in this category. In terms of texture it’s a bit similar to a Japanese ‘lotion’ in that it is slightly slimy/viscous, which was a pleasant surprise for me as I was expecting it to be watery like the Tatcha and SK-II essences. The texture makes is very pleasant to spread and pat it into your skin, and it’s immediately moisturizing with no tightness and you can see your skin texture look smooth and evened out right after application. While it isn’t necessary an affordable product on its own, it’s more affordable at $75 for 150ml than the Tatcha essence ($95 for 150ml) and SK-II essence ($99 for 75ml) which I was using before.HOWEVER, like some of the other reviews point out, the packaging is bad. It leaks a bit along the pump even when it’s standing upright, and it leaks more when it’s on its side. I’ve never had my other essences leak in any position, and it’s annoying for me since because of this I can’t take this with me when I travel without decanting. The packaging should not let the product leak out at this price point, so taking off a star for this. I’m going to re-purchase, but I hope they improve the packaging.

Anyways, that’s the reason I gave 4 stars, since it’s wasting the product but overall I do think I like it!

I decided to try this product on the bumps on my upper arms because any other lotions, dry brushing etc. wasn’t helping. I’ve used it 2x and the bumps are basically gone!! I’m so relieved. When using this product on your face it’s fine, idk if it’s worth the price. But the fact that it cured my KP makes it so worth it!
This is the perfect toner if you need something after cleansing to really balance and calm your skin. Sometimes I even just pour it into the palm of my hand and just pat it in within cotton round!

It’s hard to express how much I adore this toner. I’ve used toners from numerous brands over the years: Kiehls (blech), Amorepacific, Dear Klair, First Aid Beauty, PTR and probably some others I’ve forgotten about. This toner is simply on another level. This brand seems like a lowkey scam at times but there is something in the sourcing of the ingredients that can’t be denied. This is a ultra high quality toner without astringent properties that is so nourishing that it leaves my skin feeling like silk. I wanted to hate it and I wanted to hate her brand, but tbh everything I’ve used from her (except the scalp serum - a miss) has been excellent. Toning is such an important step in skincare and so many toners on the market are awful, but this isn’t one of them. Do your research, toner should be nourishing and without any alcohol or witch hazel. It should give the skin back what good bacteria is lost in the cleansing process. I’m subtracting one star for the packaging. It is not high quality packaging and it leaks. I’ve found that it leaks whether it’s in the locked or unlocked position, contradictory to what some other reviewers have claimed. Overall, I don’t even care about the packaging that’s how much I love this product.

Using this with the rest of her line, I have balanced skin.  I suggest using one pump in hands and applying to skin like an essence.  Use a cotton pad if you are concerned about trace makeup removal after cleansing.  I am not even through half the bottle, and it has been several months.  This also makes my skin feel very smooth.

This is an excellent toner if you have sensitive acne prone skin. It is 100% scent free so I know there is absolutely 0 fragrance or irritants in this product. It is also great at removing residual makeup and dirt that my cleanser left behind. I have tried a handful of other alcohol free toners and they always irritate my skin and dry me out. I have sensitive skin with mild rosacea. I use a retinol at night for acne, so I have to use extremely mild products. This is the best toner I’ve tried so far that doesn’t irritate and removes any remaining dirt and makeup, which I can visibly see on the cotton pad after every use.

Okay I literally thought this did nothing and almost didn’t repurchase. It was a nice toner but I felt like it didn’t do anything for my normal to dry super sensitive skin. As stupid expensive as this is for a toner I will continue to repurchase because I feel like it actually keeps my skin so clear and smooth. Worth it

This toner immediately hydrates my skin and clears away any cleanser residue before I apply the rest of my skincare. The bottle “locks” when you turn the nozzle. I haven’t experienced any leakage unless I forget to turn the top back to a locked position. It’s definitely expensive, but lasts me about 2-3 months with twice daily use.
Love it! Immediately brightens and really helps with acne
Great toner - I love that it scentless and helps skin feel soothed.

review_text: I have and love two other products from the Mega-Mushroom line: the micellar water and the face serum. review_text: This is an okay mask. I bought the 1oz size during the Fresh sale. It has a very cooling effect that feels like menthol. I do like the texture. It’s very smooth and soothing under my hands, and an interesting texture for a wash off mask. Also this mask sinks in and goes on invisible and matte, so it has the perk of my being able to use it during work from home days/zoom calls/running downstairs to grab my mail/etc. From the reviews, I think I expected something a little more marvelous, but at the end of the day it’s only a brief wash off mask. I am glad I didn’t splurge on the full size, and I do think it’s overpriced for what it is but I might appreciate it more if I had more redness or uneven skin tone. review_text: I’m very iffy on this SPF. I think if you are completely aware of what it is, it’s not as jarring, though. This is a serum—a very oily serum. Being this way, the consistency is that of an oil. It is super runny and spreads and sits like an oil. It’s very messy if you’re not prepared. You’re meant to shake the bottle before use—well, it’s so liquidy that it gets everywhere, even if you close the nozzle. You’ll have to put your finger over the opening otherwise it’ll get everywhere. It’s very runny, so if you apply it directly to your face, it will be down your neck by the time you’re ready to rub in. If you’re putting in in your hands, you’ll just have to be careful as it can easily spill. On the face, it’s clear you just put oil on your face. It is right on the border of a hydrated glow and an oily face. I will say, I am a full face matte makeup person and it sits just fine under all my makeup. I was expecting it to fight back since it was so oily, but it behaved well and mattified just fine. I do think it added a subtle sheen under my matte look, which isn’t bad. The smell is also very kelpy/algae-esque. Not bad if you don’t mind. I don’t know, I think I would recommend if you know what you’re getting into and read reviews. If you’re looking for something low maintenance, perhaps not this. Worth noting absolutely no pilling and no white cast (am a WOC).

I burn very easily in intense sun even when I apply/re-apply sunscreen. Having red, hot-to-the-touch skin after a day out in the sun has always been the norm for me. During my vacation I decided this was the perfect time to use one of these and oh my god was it an instant relief. Not only that, the redness subsided instantly and it stopped my face from turning into that “2nd day sunburn“ that everyone knows and hates. This mask is not your typical sheet mask, it’s not a “sheet“ mask at all since there is no material/sheet to it, it’s more of the texture of those cell-infused jelly-like masks. There’s also a chest mask which is super handy because that’s another major problem area for getting sun damage. These have been my go-to for any kind of travel or sun activity for at least 3/4 years. Most recently I used it in July after being in 107 degree Las Vegas weather during the hottest parts of the day and it also helped add some moisture back to my skin that was sucked out by the desert heat on top of subduing my pain/redness. The Bad: The jelly-like texture mask can be tricky to put on/navigate your first time around. It’s much more delicate than a sheet mask and can rip/stick to itself if not handled with gentle care. The Ugly: If this mask also gets discontinued I will hold a protest at my local Sephora with picket signs and everything. You have been warned, Sephora... don’t you even think about it! :P

review_text: This is the best eye treatment I’ve used yet. I use it under an Olay eye cream.
I’ve been using this product since it came out . I mix it with  the Capture Totale Dior eye cream . Very happy with it .

As a loyal fan of the face boosting formula, my opinion os that this eye boosting version is good enough on its own as a sole eye cream. I have tried it all and surprisingly, Dior takes the cake on skincare. The skin boosting serum won a Nobel prize and my skin is proof of it!

I’ve been using this product for a couple years. It is amazing! I’ve switched a couple times to try other products but nothing else works as well. I’m writing this review because I haven’t used this product in about a year and realized my under eyes never looked as good as when I was using this product! Like not even kidding. I never noticed how good my under eyes were until I stopped using this product.
This is my ’go-to’ for fighting those wrinkles we all want to avoid.  I truly see a difference in the amount of wrinkles around my eyes and between my eyebrows!

Good texture, absorbs quickly, no issues applying makeup over serum, but doesn’t seem to actually serve its intended purpose. I stopped using another eye serum to try this and my fine lines, over a couple months of use, have become substantially more evident. For the price point, definitely was not effective for me. My eyes look drier, which rarely happens, as I have the most oily skin type possible.  Will be switching back to prior eye regiment.

I’ve been using eye creams since my 20s, and this one is the only one I’ve re-purchased. I’ve tried Kiehls, Lancôme and Shiseiso but none work the way Dior does. I use it day and night, and have noticed that my under eye area looks full and soft. Totally recommend!
review_title: The best eye cream I’ve used so far!

review_text: I bought this serum because of the great reviews so my expectations were high with this serum. I’ve been using it for about 3 weeks, day and night.  Haven’t seen a difference yet. For the price point, I really wanted it to be amazing.
I love this serum. The feel, the smell and the moisture. I use this product primarily for moisture and prevention. I use Sheseido ibuki eye correcting cream on top.

So, I’ve been using this product for months, night and day, and I haven’t noticed a change at all in fine lines and wrinkles. Given the awesome reviews, maybe I’m missing something. It does seem like it’s moisturizing and if I splash water on my face in the morning, I can feel the silky texture from the night before. Unfortunately, I wanted to love this and can’t.
This is one of the best serums I’ve ever used. Love it.

After trying luxury brands to indie brands and natural brands, etc., I was like ok, I ain’t getting younger, my eyes need the serious stuff, so after reading reviews on countless products out there, and though there’s only a handful of reviews left on this particular product (and good ones too!), I thought I’d give it a shot. Part of the struggle with eye serums (personally for me) is that I have yet to see true results, and regardless whether luxury or indie brands. I don’t notice anything drastic, I’ve been only using this for about a week since I bought it. I don’t think it’s terrible but I don’t think it’s super amazing either. I definitely love the pump vs jar, it does hydrate well (and a little drop goes a long way), it doesn’t necessarily brighten (as say the banana eye cream from Ole H., but I did not like the texture-y feel that product left under my eye) but for a serum it does make my eye look slightly brighter (quite possibly due to it looking more hydrated). I’m knocking off a star because I was hoping to see more visible results for the price point. And I have been using it morning and night.
I use at night only. Its nice and creamy and helps my wrinkles.

Love it!  Where do I start?! It has a light scent which smells great.  The pump design is more hygienic than small jar.  One pump will get you just enough to spread evenly for both eyes, but it’s not a large amount!  So this bottle will definitely last you a while.
