(Not to be confused with good, fatty alcohols like Cetyl Alcohol which is great for your face!) It’s 2020; we have too much information for brands to continue formulating with drying alcohols and fragrances. Will try to use this as a hand mask or something as the skin there isn’t as sensitive and I won’t be wasting the product.

I am a huge Lancôme fan. I love Lancôme a lot but this mask is not what I expected. It doesn’t do anything to my skin but make it look kinda pinkish. I was hoping it would help me with my acne but no it did not. I was using it twice a week and I just gave up on it. I thought it was crazy how it sinks into your skin and feels like your just wetting your face after the 5 mins is up to remove your mask. That part blew my mind but this mask is not for me. I will continue to use it but to finish it but I will never buy it nor recommend this products if you want something to help you with your acne.

Writing this before I even rinse it off because the rose smell is over powering anything and everything else. I don’t know if I will last 5 minutes! I did receive it as a sample, I would not buy the full size.

This mask just felt like silicone and rose fragrance on my face. It felt nasty to put on and I had to rinse it off immediately. I much prefer the fresh instant perfecting mask instead. It has the cooling effect and a much better whipped texture.
This mask feels great and does give my skin a glow and “Dewey” look afterwards. I wish I could use it daily!

I’m disappointed in this face jelly mask as I expected it to make my complexion look dewey. I have very good moist skin and I saw no difference after using this mask. I’ve been using the mask a month now. I won’t buy this again. I’d like to try the other Lancôme rose mask which u rub as a cream and sleep with it on all night. That might be more moisturizing.
I’ve used this mask a few times. This mask clogged my pores and made them appear larger.

This stuff is amazing.  I received it as a free sample and had to buy it myself.  I really like the cooling feature and how it’s a quick 5 minutes.  I do have fairly sensitive skin that’s prone to redness and this does not irritate my skin. This stuff smells amazing and leaves a hint of road after washed off.  The one downside is that it goes pretty quickly... But when I’m out, I’ll be buying again.
This is now must have in my beauty regimen. It goes in light but has such powerful results. The smell is amazing and your skin will glow when you use this.

This product needs more reviews! Why did I wait to buy this! The very first application made a huge difference in the texture of my skin. Dry spots gone, texture more even and redness reduced. I have lots of different textures as I approach 50. My skin was also really soft. Created a really smooth foundation application. It was astonishing really. Every use yields the same smooth results. Looking forward to seeing how it performs this winter!

Awesome mask! I love that you only have to leave it on for 5 minutes. The cooling effect is great, especially if you have been out in the sun all day. It really calms your skin down and refines your pores. I like to do it at night after I take my makeup off or before I apply makeup that I need to look flawless. This mask also has a very nice light rose scent. I’m going to put it in the refrigerator before I use it next for an extra cooling effect.

I would say that this mask is really fantastic for event makeup prep, as it made my skin incredibly smooth and also reduced the appearance of my pores significantly around the sides of my nose, chin, and forehead, which are my texture trouble spots. I have drier leaning skin, and I notice that when I use this mask, my skin is a lot glowier than usual without being super dewy or oily looking, which I really like. I love how you only have to leave it on for five minutes and that it leaves the skin with a tingling, cool feeling. I have used it a few times now and I am planning to repurchase whenever I run out, which will probably be a while because a little bit goes a very long way. I would recommend this mask to anyone who is looking for an instant skin fix for an event or someone who enjoys cooling skin products.

I wanted to love this stuff, but it just wasn’t it. The pump runs out very quickly (its also not super efficient and I feel like there was still product left that I couldn’t get out). The color is way too subtle (and I have really pale skin). If you’re wanting a tanning mousse that is worth the money, I would recommend Loving Tan.

I wanted this to be a great product. However, the pump broke the second time I used it. I used the tanner with the mit and it still same out rather streaky on my legs - perfect everywhere else. Also - I don’t love the pina colada scent. The whole point of a sunless tanner is to be undetectable so the scent is somewhat of a give away. Also when you sweat it smells worse. Save yourself the money and just buy the Jergens Natural Glow firming lotion - smells better and works just as well.

What a beautiful tan this gave me! I bought the mitt from this company as well- the mitt broke first time I used it, but the application of the foam was great. It’s clear and blends so nicely. The smell is so mild and even after it dries the smell is SO minor. I’m so pleased with the result! It’s nothing too tan, it’s just right! Very happy with my purchase and will continue to buy from this company.
My pump broke after two uses. The color was great, but I had to throw the bottle away. Will not repurchase.
Love it! Color is very natural and dark.  I already have olive skin.  Easy to use.  I get compliments on my tan all the time with this self tanner compared to others that I have used.

Good color, but streakier than the face version that has hyaluronic acid in it.  And I liked that gel better than this foam.  It was more hydrating.  Smell is stronger than I would like.  I apply with an Artis brush because I just can’t stand the mitts.  Also I do think best to leave on overnight for full color to develop, which can be inconvenient.  Overall I’m a fan though.

Great product. Gives you a luscious tan comparable to St. Tropez. It’s a little difficult to see where you’re applying because the foam is white/clear but I’m assuming that the coloring agent would compromise the product from being “clean“. Overall pleased, will re-purchase.
Wow, where have you been all my life in best self-tanners. Foam goes on clean and spreads evenly (best if used with mitt). Resulting fast tan looks amazing. :)

I actually liked the color this produced and it wasn’t hard to apply. I used my hands (washed them immediately after) and applied, rubbed it in, in circular motions as directed. The next morning I had nice color and no streaks. I am not sure how some people experienced streaky areas. All I can think of is maybe they over-used it in one application rather than building upon the color over a course of a few days. ???Anyways, I gave it a 3-star rating because it still has that awful self tanning product smell that I hate. Maybe you’ll be okay with it but I wasn’t. The smell doesn’t dissipate at all until a day later, after the shower.
review_title: Ok if you like the tanning smell

review_text: amazing product ! I’m new to self tanners and this looks beautiful - NOT orange!!! BUT you need to definitely buy the mitt or you will get streaky and stained ! This was so easy I did it 24 hours after I showered and moisturized, made sure to put lotion on my feet, backs of my hands and wrists RIGHT BEFORE I applied the tanner, and just used the mitt to apply! I avoided my face though and most of my neck for which I use St. Tropez Self Tan Purity Bronzing Water Face Mist to even things out! Then I waited an additional day to shower (I know but I wanted it to stick) After i showered I lost a little bit of color but not much ! VERY PLEASED !

THIS IS IT. The BEST tanner I have EVER used. I am pale as can be, a redhead, and this gives me the PERFECT tan. Completely streak-free and it looks incredibly natural!!! And it’s BUILDABLE!!! I applied it on Friday and again on Monday and it honestly looks so phenomenal I can’t believe it. I use their 2-in-1 exfoliating/tanning mitt and exfoliate either on dry skin or in the shower before using this stuff and have the best results. I have found my Holy Grail tanning product. THRILLED it has the “clean at Sephora“ stamp too!

I love Coola and had high hopes. I’m fair. Like paper white. I was surprised how light I was after my first application. Maybe I was being too cautious. I did use a mitt for the application. Which was a first for me and loved it. Totally recommend using that for any self tanners. After the second used I could see more color. So maybe it’s a good thing that it’s not so in your face like”hello I self tanned last night.”  But.... I think the smell is so strong. I don’t know how people think there isn’t one. It’s totally self tanner smell. And it gets stronger!!! No way it smells of coconut. Which is disappointing. But it’s to be expected with any self tanner I’m assuming. Not sure if I would buy again but it seems like a lot of product and dispenses nice.

No guide color so you have no idea what spots you’ve missed until the tan develops, which takes like 6 hours. Once it does develop it’s just orange and then washes off the next day. I don’t understand why this has so many good reviews

I was going to a party and decided to use some of this on my legs and arms...Forgot all about it until someone sd wow ur tan is to die for and one person sd OMG since u arrived u have gotten darker... def shows to some degree within an hour. the smell is great.

This mousse is soooo easy - if you’re an experienced self tanner you will love it. No mitt needed!  Quick and easy. Only 4 stars because the pump is low quality. I’m half way through the bottle and I’m not convinced the pump will survive what’s left; it gets stuck in the down position and sometime leaks. Otherwise the color isn’t orange and it dries almost instantly. Smell is inoffensive and not strong.

Had high hopes but alas this was not meant to be. Firstly, its a mousse which is fine but when you press down on the nozzle, some of the product gets on your hand. Annoying, as I usually have only one mitt that I want to dispense the product in. I hope I’m making sense. Secondly there’s no color so good luck figuring out where you applied it. The scent is non existent at first but a few hours later, it’s unbelievably strong. The pros is that once you shower, the scent goes away. The color is nice but man it left me with weird streaks. No thanks.

I absolutely love this sunless tanner! I use the Coola application mit, and it glides on smoothly. It dries very quickly without a bad smell, and it provides natural looking color within 2 hours. I also love that it has clean ingredients I can feel good about.

I have this and have used many other self tanning products. It dispenses as a mousse and using a mitt I apply it all over my body. As it applies it turns clear. There is no way to see that is was distributed evenly on the skin until 2 hours later when I see the places that I missed. Also while I am standing there naked waiting for it to dry even a brow dryer never dries it because it remains tacky. It works but it is streaky and sticky. Two stars off of from me.

No color guidance so of course I wake up the next day with color missing from various parts of my body in addition to orange spots. I’m not a first time self tanner - exfoliated and moisturized the 10 days leading up. Used an appropriate soap before hand. Applied with a mit - and in the end I look ridiculous.

This is the first sunless tanner I have ever tried, and I love it. I can now confidently strut out sporting shorts without worrying about blinding people with my winter whiteness, or looking like I escaped Willy Wonka’s chocolate factory. The serum smells nice, not really coconut-like, but maybe a bit citrusy. Tropical somehow. The serum is clear, and doesn’t rub off and stain or discolor sheets, so that’s nice. I won’t say its 100% natural looking, since it’s not quite the same shade as my natural tan in the summer, but it doesn’t really look orange or like a fake tan either, which I was afraid it might. I have somewhat sensitive skin,  and had no issues with this product. It’s a little sticky when first applied, but it disappears once it’s dry.

It’s hard for me to explain just how amazing this product is, but I’ll try. First, my legs were blindingly pale. I used a normal amount of this product on each of my legs. It dried quickly. Within 30 minutes I noticed a slight color change, but a few hours later, my legs were a perfect tan. It lasts through showers and shaving. It doesn’t rub-off on my towels or cloths. I applied it on Monday and today is Friday, I’m still tan. I’m not as tan, but still tan. I have no complaints about this product. It does smell like a self-tanner and not coconuts, but you only smell it for a few hours after applying. It works better than expected. I highly recommend it and will continue to use this all over my body!

This is THE BEST self tanner, and I’ve spent decades(!) trying the best (and worst) of them.  SO NATURAL looking  and not a bunch of drama with smeary lines, orange hands and the like.Seriously, I have had people this week comment on how good my tan has gotten with all of my hiking and other outdoor exercise LOL.   Yeah, I’ve been getting in a few miles a day, but my tan is pretty much all Coola. It doesn’t have that awful “tanner“ smell, but there is still an underlying scent that is reminiscent of all tanners. **I have NEVER used a tanner that didn’t have SOME kind of tanner smell to it. I don’t think one exists. Even Vita Liberata (which i bought on Sephora a while ago) has a little of that “tanner“ smell, and that’s lauded for its lack of smell***  Using the applicator mitt definitely helps with even distribution and blending of the mousse. (I love those things!)COOLA is my new favorite tanner!
review_title: Looks like I just spent a week on the beach

review_text: Like others here, I have tried many self Tanners, but the sun comes out is my favorite. Not only is this a clean brand, so you know the ingredients are good for you, the tan is beautiful. I would say it’s better if you’re a fair skin type like myself, if you’re tan, this might not be for you. It takes a couple of applications to build up to a darker tan, but it goes on smooth (also used the coola mit), looks natural, and doesn’t smell! You also don’t look green while you’re waiting for it to develop
Doesn’t transfer, doesn’t smell bad. I’m very pale and this looks good on me. Wonder if this would work for deeper skin tones.

Very happy with this sunless tanner. Love that it’s clean, has a pleasant scent, and is easy to apply. It definitely left an even, natural looking tan. It also dried quickly within a few minutes, and didn’t rub off onto my clothing or bed sheets, which other brands I’ve tried have done. This is now my #1 choice for a sunless tanning mousse!

OBSESSED! I have used countless self tanners and this is by far my favorite!!! Pro’s- Doesn’t smell terrible-Didn’t get on my white sheets (did not shower after applying before bed)-Nature look not Orange - No blotchy spots CONS*DONT HAVE ANY!Would definitely recommend and plan on using ALL Summer!
This is the best sunless tanner. Ive tried them all. The color is natural and the foam is so easy to use. It’s also not as drying as a lot of other sunless tanners.

This product is absolutely amazing. My skin has seriously never looked better. After using it the past month my skin is so much brighter, clearer and looks overall healthier. My makeup goes on so smoothly, and my skin is very hydrated. This definitely helps with acne, I haven’t had a breakout in weeks. My uneven skin done and texture has improved. It’s so easy to use and my skin looks and feels amazing. I will continue to repurchase this product! I also have sensitive skin and had no issues using this product.

Ordered this because I love the peel and was excited to try the face wash and moisturizer! Imagine my disappointment when it arrived and only the peel was inside the box. If you’re going to advertise something as a set it should include the entire set!
I love it, it makes my face skin soft and brightness!
Hands down the absolute best product. I’ve been using this line for about 2 months and I absolutely love it. If you have large pores or textured skin this is the product for you.
Im obsessed!! After just using the pads in the store as a sample I fell in love and bought immediately. Cant wait to see how my skin looks soon, because it definitely feels amazing.

I have sensitive skin so this kit is perfect because I don’t use the universal daily peel everyday. That would be too much for me but I absolutely love the results from using this. My skin feels fabulous and looks glowy. This product was gifted to me by Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare.

I received the AHA BHA daily peel pads as a free sample in another order. When the kit went on sale I decided to purchase since I enjoyed those daily peels so much and I was not disappointed! I use each product in this kit daily. I’d say my favorite is the pads, then the face cleanser, and then the moisturizer. I’ve been using this kit for about a month now and I have had very noticeable and dramatic changes to my complexion.

I love the Universal Peel Pads! They make my skin look absolutely amazing and I always have a stash of them in my skincare drawer.  I don’t use them daily but instead about 3 times a week and that’s enough to really make a difference in my skin. My skin is clearer, smoother, and has a glow to it when I use these regularly. The Alpha Beta® 3-Step Kit works! I received it complimentary from Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare.It comes with a cleanser, moisturizer, and peel that work together to help reveal my best looking skin. I love that my routine got stripped down to the three basics with the addition of sunscreen during the day.

What an amazing bundle! I’m a huge fan of peels, but never tried peel pads before. I’m very impressed! So easy to use and the results are visible after 4-5 days of using. I must say that if your skin isn’t used to acids - don’t go too hard and use the peel pads every other day, so you don’t end up damaging your skin. I really enjoy this set.  I started peeling my face once a week with this treatment and I really liked the result. My skin looks glowy and renewed, without dead cells and cleaner pores. It’s good.On the other hand, I also really liked the facial soap, it cleans well without irritating or drying out my skin, and the moisturizer is ideal for normal to oily skin because it is light and absorbs very well into the skin.

My first starter kit from dennisgross and more than anything im loving the peel pads. They are gentle and don’t make my skin sting. I love the way it refreshes my face kinda brightening up and i def see my pores on my nose looking more even and tight. The moisturizer is soothing and calms your skin if irritated by the peel pads. The cleanser is gel based and also feels refreshing. Overall love the whole kit. Gifted by dr.dennis gross skincare.

I used the Alpha Beta pads years ago and really felt it was great at exfoliating so I was excited to try this new kit! If used together I think the results are nice for keeping skin smooth and exfoliated while also giving it enough moisture. Only caveat for me is there is alcohol in the ingredients which I don’t really like to use. But I haven’t had excess dryness so I guess it’s okay. *This was gifted by Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare

this set has completely changed the texture of my skin. i see a huge difference in the size of my pores AND the darkness of my dark spots. I spend my summers in the sun so my skin has a few sunspots and this has helped so far. it was complimentary from Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare

I’d like to say that it’s such a great set to try the essentials set. Unfortunately, it’s too irritating for my skin that I had to stop. It’s probably because I’m also using a retinoid in my routine. I received this gifted by the brand. I really like this set and it helps my combination skin. My skin appears most even toned and the texture has improved significantly. The 3 step system is really easy to follow and gentle enough for my skin so i would recommend to anyone.

DrDennisGross gifted me their Alpha Beta 3-Step Kit - Universal.I want to tell you this 3 step system is amazing. What an incredible set! Especially for the price. I have been using the peels for years and they are the skincare item that makes the biggest difference in my complexion. Worth every penny.

Thats what I love the most if a bundles which are great to try products and very valuable!  DDG been with me for 2 years and there is nothing bad about the brand. This set goes a long way towards improving skin texture! My skin is baby smooth and glowing lately after using! If you are struggling with dull skin and uneven texture, I would ABSOLUTELY give this kit a try!! 5 stars!

I love how this set gifted by Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare has everything you need which makes it so convenient. I feel like I can always trust Dr. Denis gross products to perform well and I love the peel pads. I’ve noticed a difference in the texture of my skin and how much it’s glowing.
This set is a must have for your skincare routine. It is gentle enough for sensitive skin and will not cause irritation. It does a great job of brightening your complexion and clearing imperfections.

I’m a long time fan of these peeling pads, and this set is the perfect way to restock on the peeling pads and try the cleanser and moisturizer as well. using all these together makes my skin SO smooth. this was complimentary from Dr. Dennis Gross.

I love all Dr Dennis Gross products and was super excited to see this universal 3 step kit. I travel super often for work, so i love easy kits that contain everything I need. Cheap packaging and very drying formula. For some reason they made my lips more chapped! Colors are fine but not worth what you pay for.
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: Nice colour, but terrible design and quality. The clear lip chap was nice, but the tinted ones are very grainy and the tubes don’t work very well. You can turn them up, but won’t go back down. Not worth the money.
review_title: Not worth the money - Poor Quality
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: I usually use Burt’s Bees lip balm and tint. This was an impulse buy over the holidays, but I don’t regret it a bit. Love the natural looking colors, and this stuff stays on your lips for hours.
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: Colors are great. I don’t find any of them to be grainy at all. The tinted ones do have a slight sweet taste but not much to notice.
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: I like the colors; a nice sheer wash giving a ’your lips, but better’ tint, and they’re very moisturizing, but the taste is very off-putting. It’s very sweet, which is fine if you’re not eating anything while you’re wearing any of the shades, but if you are, it rather ruins anything savory. I’ll eventually use these up, but now that I know it has such a sweet taste, they won’t be the first product I reach for. I won’t re-purchase.
review_title: Tastes sweet and not in a good way
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: The clear is decent, tinted is grainy and not moisturizing at all. Disappointed & not repurchasing!
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: they’re okay, i wouldn’t spend this much on a product again
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: After having these almost a week I can confidently say that these are so worth the money and the bad reviews are likely from people who haven’t dabbled in clean beauty before. Here’s what to expect with clean beauty: these won’t be as stable of formulas as the brands that use more preservatives meaning they’re fragile and you can’t go in with heavy hands or wind the tubes all the way up and expect them not to break. They were a bit grainy at the top but nothing that doesn’t melt away when you rub lips together (like extremely mild exfoliating lip balms). The actual feel of the formula is top 2 on my list and I’m a lip balm and lipstick junkie. I can’t decide if I’m going to make the clear my HG balm from now on instead of my glossier balm .com. That was not even why I purchased these. I wanted a colored nude balm for everyday at work and got much more. The nude is a very pretty terracotta/warm pinky brown color. The darker color looks exactly like my Charlotte tilbury walk of shame lipstick shade. I will be repurchasing and I beg you Gwyneth to start selling colors separately as well.
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: Wish the clear weren’t packaged with these way-too-pigmented, grainy textured colors.  Sephora should strongly consider selling the clear lip balm solo. The price point for 3 was appealing but wish they were all clear.  It just doesn’t last long enough to justify $20 per tube.  Otherwise, I’d buy no other lip balm for the rest of my days.  Hard pass on the colors though! I gave them to my mother, who actually wears lipstick.
review_title: love the clear; not at this price point
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: the colors are great and the consistency of the clear is nice and smooth, but the two more pigmented colors were quite gritty. wouldn’t buy again.
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: Gwyneth knows all, but … this was my first Sephora return in years. The product itself was too soft (it fell to the side right away) and the tube would be empty in a flash. The highlight is how chic the packaging is, but that wasn’t enough this time. Still love you though, GP. Xx
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: Loved this clear balm, actually it’s my favorite. It only lasted about a month and I can’t justify $20 a month for lip balm. She should ditch the packaging and tube to make it more affordable.
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: Very disappointing. The two tinted colors felt gritty and were not flattering on me. The clear is okay, but gets stuck when I roll it up and down. Overpriced fail for me.
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: Probably not worth the price, but they are very nice lip balms. I like the colors and the consistency. Would I buy again? No.
review_title: nice balms, but not worth the price
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: These are exactly what I want in a tinted lip balm. The colors are natural looking and flattering, and the texture feels great. Just enough color without being too much. Please make more colors!!
review_title: My favorite tinted lip balm so far
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: Out of this trio, love the clear lip balm the best. It does have the perfect texture and “slip“ as described. I love that they don’t have a significant taste or smell. I’ve got chronically dry, flakey lips, so the tinted balms didn’t work for me because of the way the formula settled into the dry parts of my lips & didn’t look or feel right. I’ll still use them at home until they’re gone because I hate to waste product. I found Quench tinted balm by Tarte works better for me. I love a good deal, so I would purchase a trio of the Goop clear lip balm; one for the purse, one for the office and one for my travel kit.
review_title: Love the clear balm...the tinted, not for me.
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: Moisturizing and the colours are lovely. My go-to lip balm, without doubt. No fragrance and the balm is smooth with no grittiness in the tinted form.
product_name: GOOPGENES Clean Nourishing Lip Balm Trio

review_text: These are the best lip balms I have ever used! They also make great gifts!

I thankfully just received this today. My supersensitive, redness prone skin has not been handling the summer heat well. I’m talking about red splotches, super warm to the touch skin. I will be keeping this on hand!

Bought this on a whim and I don’t regret it! As the other reviewer noted it’s not a mousse; it’s fairly thin and almost lotion-like. The lady at the store advised it’s good for about 7 uses but so far I’ve used it about 15 times and have about half the tube left. I put on 2 thin layers and leave it on for about 15 minutes. I find it’s great for reducing redness and inflammation but I’ve yet to see a reduction in overall blemishes. My skin is oily and it’s less oily after usage but not completely matte. It’s slightly moisturizing so it’s great if you’ve accidentally over exfoliated as I’m prone to do. It works better if I incorporate it into my overall skin routine. Also, as a side note: it’s suggested on the tube that you take a selfie for the Sephora collection but it’s fairly transparent and not apparent after about 2 minutes unless you glop it on. For the price and what it actually does I think it’s worth a try; I’ll definitely buy more once I’ve run out.

I took off one star for the misleading description of this “Mousse“ which is basically the same consistancy as lotion, and not “a foamy texture mask,“ as the bottle claims. It doesn’t feel light and foamy like I expected when I saw “Mousse Mask“, and it’s very thin. If you don’t really glob it on, it’s basically like you just put moisturizer on your face. My skin is neither excessively oily nor dry, and I only have minor blemishes that pop up randomly. After using this, it didn’t moisturize my face, but it also didn’t dry it out at all. However, it did make my skin super soft, and it absorbed all of the oil that was on my face before I used it, and totally mattified my face! I’m impressed with how soft and smooth my face feels now, even hours later! Also, it has a hemp scent that is faint and pleasant, not overwhelming at all (and my nose is very sensitive!). I find the scent really relaxing. A good mask to use at nighttime to prep for moisturizer, while you unwind for bed. I can’t speak to whether it helps with acne because I don’t have any right now, but I didn’t notice it really did anything for my pores thus far.It’s definitely worth $7! I’d have given it 5 stars if it was actually the consistancy of a mousse, and thick and creamy enough that you feel like you’re wearing a mask instead of mousturizer! If you’re looking for a mask that’ll soften your skin and won’t hurt your pocketbook, this mask is definitely worth a try!

review_text: This is a great value. I can’t believe how many products you get for such a low price. Normally if you were to buy each of these products individually you would be spending a lot more money. I love Sunday Riley products. I’m a licensed aesthetician and have been using their products for over a year and a half now and have noticed a huge Improvement in my skin. The only drawback that I can see is the dimethicone in the products which generally I try to avoid. It is a synthetic plastic and a silicone. I’m not sure why they would choose to use it in their products as most companies will use it because it is cheap and it provides the illusion that the product is working but over time it traps impurities, is hard to wash from the skin, and causes an increase in acne and other skin disorders. With that said, I have been using the good genes on and off for quite some time now and I can’t deny that my skin is dramatically exfoliated after just one use with an even texture. The fine lines are improved over time with an increase in plumping and softness to the skin. Definitely wouldn’t use the Good Genes everyday as it would be too exfoliating for my skin. I notice a definite increase and brightness with just one use of the Vitamin C. I just wish they wouldn’t use dimethicone. Either way they have some great products that do not have the dimethicone like the Ice Ceramide moisturizer which I use everyday and is great for dry skin. It gives that glass appearance to the skin that we often try to achieve through other products unsuccessfully. I am still giving this 5 stars because the rest of the ingredients are great and the pros definently outweigh any cons. Hope this helps.

A couple things to note: this has an outer, reusable metal tin container and an inner plastic “refill” portion. The plastic refill portion has a solid plastic cap. You can either keep the cap on inside the metal tin or remove it. That being said the plastic cap tends to stick to the product inside so I found it easier to just keep the plastic tub open without the lid. I do find that even then residue ends up on the lip of the product resulting in the tub sticking to the metal lid which I have to gently pry off every so often. If you are going to travel with this you MUST keep the plastic lid on or it’ll get messy really fast. Additionally, while I really like this formula I would warn you this is not a rich cream. If you have dry skin this will not lay thick (it’s very lightweight remember) and imo will moderately moisturize. It does a great job hydrating your outer dermis layers though. If you have dry or broken barrier this may not be your holy grail but for a day-to-day moisturizer I really enjoy it. Would definitely recommend if you have the money to splurge. review_text: I’ve been using this oil for a few weeks now, and I’ve noticed it really does give my skin a natural-looking glow (and pretty quickly - I only need to use it one night to see results the next day). I’ve dinged a star for a few reasons: 1) there is a tell-tale self tan smell, and it’s pretty obvious upon application. It’s not a big deal nor overpowering, but the product claims to have no smell - which isn’t accurate. 2) The tan is pretty foolproof, but like other posters said, you can exfoliate it off and it doesn’t fade completely evenly (not to the point where it looks bad, but it’s important to keep this in mind). Also, be cautious using around eyebrows; it’s completely over processed on mine and made the skin much darker than the rest of the face. Overall, a great product though that has not broken out my sensitive skin nor made me look orange. It hydrates and conditions skin well. Will probably repurchase.
review_title: Great product, but a few things to keep in mind
product_name: SLEEP OIL Rejuvenating Miracle Tanning Oil

review_text: Let me start by saying I’m not a self tan expert. Every year or so I start out the spring wanting to be tanned and so I buy new products, only to be disappointed, allergic to them, or decide I’m just too lazy to keep it up. I got this product over the weekend and used it on Sunday (before bed time bc I was so eager to try it) and here’s what I noticed: I had color almost immediately after applying. Granted, I’m extremely fair so any color is “color“ for me. But it kept developing over the 12 or so hours I had it on, and when I woke up in the morning, I was quite brown. At first I was upset thinking that I looked unnaturally tan but I was able to calm it down with some lighter powder. It might not work as well on all skin tones but I think fair girls should be prepared for some serious color change. Second, the oil was quite “oily“ at first - which, duh. But I’ve never used a face oil before and it didn’t really register to me that this would be an actual oil...so I was a little surprised. The oil absorbed quite quickly though and by the time I went to bed about 4 hours later, my face was super soft and not oily at all. Third, I have very sensitive skin, and I can be prone to breakouts. Like sensitive to the point that the only moisturizers I can use are cerave or cetaphil. So far, this hasn’t clogged my pores. If I tried to use it every night, that might be different, but because the color payoff is so good I definitely won’t be using this every night. In fact I have to reapply my Vita Liberata body tanner again tonight bc my body and my face don’t really match....anyway. Also, I’m not too orangey. I think any tanner on my skin shade turns me a bit orange (never brown) so I’m thankful this is only a hint of orange, and mostly golden toned. Just beware how much you use the first time if you’re very fair skinned!
product_name: SLEEP OIL Rejuvenating Miracle Tanning Oil

review_text: I was using the Coola Tanning Serum before this but wanted to try this, too. I prefer the Coola Serum. I feel like even if I exfoliate regularly I can rub off part of the “tan“ on my face after a few days of application. It’s nice and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin so if you prefer an oil, this one is okay.
product_name: SLEEP OIL Rejuvenating Miracle Tanning Oil

review_text: Love this product! I have combination skin and keep a meticulous skin routine, I was skeptical about using this product after my serum, worries about it mixing with the serum, not keeping my skin moisturizer over night, etc.. so easy to use, BUILDABLE color, so you won’t get crazy color over night, but affective and makes my skin glow. Love it!
product_name: SLEEP OIL Rejuvenating Miracle Tanning Oil

review_text: I got this after returning from a short trip to Florida early January. I’ve been applying this product once a week after using a chemical peel (drunk elephant Sukari babyfacial). My skin soaks the oil right in and I wake up to healthy glowy skin. It has a slight self-tanner scent that is not overbearing. I really like it and it’s been my winter skin savior!
product_name: SLEEP OIL Rejuvenating Miracle Tanning Oil

review_text: I truly love this product. I dinged one start because I feel it is more of a buildable tan than an overnight fix. However, it is beautiful on the skin and absorbs well like another reviewer said. It feels moisturizing, though I do layer serum and moisturizer atop. It helps to even the appearance of skin tone and create a dewy, natural look. Highly recommend this product for a flush of color.
review_title: Buildable, Dewy, and Natural Gradual Tan
product_name: SLEEP OIL Rejuvenating Miracle Tanning Oil

review_text: This product is amazing! I use it at night and wake up with beautifully glowing skin. The oil absorbs pretty quickly and never has transferred on my jams or sheets. The first few times, I was worried and put a towel over my pillow, but no need- there was no transfer. Also, if you want a little less color or if want to use another product too, you can mix the oil with your night cream. When I do this I just give it a few extra minutes to set before going to bed. If you’re looking for a natural, healthy face tan, try this oil- it works so well!
product_name: SLEEP OIL Rejuvenating Miracle Tanning Oil

review_text: I have had many peels both at home and professional in office...this lives up to the in office procedures I have had.  Well work the low price!

I use this product.  I an sad to see the less than 5 star reviews. it’s exactly what you expect and need a peel to be. Strong, powerful, and no “facial tech personnel’ needed... all DIY with the same lovely powerful results! ❤

This is the best thing to ever happen to my skin. I had acne prone skin with melasma and large pores and i had tried EVERYTHING....nothing worked until I incorporated this into my skincare routine. I use it twice a week and i leave it on for 5 mins. I exfoliate with Dr. Brandt microdermbrasion before i put it on and it tingles!! i am on my third bottle and i now have clear skin....my skin has evened out, i barely breakout and my pores are barely noticeable. I can go out without makeup in confidence and i am so happy. This product alone will not work miracles, however, it will buff off layers of dead skin cells so other products can better penetrate your skin and work their magic. I have struggled with my skin for years so i do have a strict morning and night time routine. incorporating this into my routine is the best decision i made in 2020.
Leaves my face smooth and glowing. I use it on the body too.
I purchased with high hopes, it came and I tried it twice with experiencing NOTHING. NO TINGLE AND NO RESULTS.
Sadly, no difference in skin and barely tingled. Tried 3x. Have had better home peels.
At home peels are a waste of money. They’re never strong enough. I’ve tried them all. Didn’t notice a difference w this.

This is by far the best at home peel I’ve found. I don’t normally write reviews but this product has surpassed my expectations and I’ve found myself only reaching for it the past month and leaving my other options on the shelf.

This product is effective! I’ve been using it for 4 months now, 1-2 times a week (simply apply on a cotton pad) and I’ve noticed a SIGNIFICANT improvement on my skin texture, acne scarring and milia bumps. The results are immediate and long term. Would strongly recommend this product, just give it time! I wish I took pictures. That’s how impressed I am with this product. For reference, I’m 28, acne prone with oily skin. Also on a dermatologist prescribed low dose tretinoin cream tx. Hope that helps!
WORTH. IT. Considerable difference in the texture of my skin. My skin is noticeable much smoother.

I’ve finally found a way in which this product works best for me. I’m not good at following the rules but I did start out at 2 minutes. I upped the minutes as time went by but was not all that impressed with the results.  So, and I don’t necessarily recommend this unless you totally know your skin, I started using it with my favorite masks 2x a week. I’d swipe it on and then apply the mask on top. I usually leave it on for 30 minutes before removing. With this method, I’m seeing the results I’ve expected. My pores appear smaller, skin is much smoother (no more orange peel) and my hyperpigmentation is slowly going away. I use 3 different masks, not at the same time of course, and rotate them each time.  My skin is acclimated to this type of treatment so I’ve not experienced any side effects.
review_title: Found a way to make it work!

review_text: One of the better at home peels. I have dry skin but it’s resilient so I use this twice a week. I feel very itchy when it’s on my face so I guess that means it’s working it will go away once you wash it off. In the beginning I didn’t notice a big difference, however, after working my way up to 4 minutes WOW. My skin is baby soft, super smooth, pores are almost invisible!  I’ll definitely purchase it again my skin looks and feels great!

This makes my pores smaller and gives me an overall glowy effect for days. Note that my skin doesn’t actually peel, at all. I think that’s normal and with this it isn’t even necessary. It does exfoliate my skin. I use it 2-3 times a week for 5 minutes, then rinse. I really love what it does. Totally recommend this.

I ordered this in hopes it would tide me over during quarantine while I can’t get a peel from my esthetician. It works fairly well, though I get better results when I leave it on for 3 minutes instead of 2 (my face has built up a tolerance for glycolic peels, but I would NOT recommend this if you are new to them). I use it twice a week and it’s kept my skin looking smooth and some of my smaller wrinkles at bay. I have combination skin and follow this up with a hydrating serum and moisturizer, with no actual peeling afterwards. The product smells pretty bad, but I don’t think there’s any way to make something like this smell good.

I bought this product and was pretty excited, considering it states 30% Glycolic Peel & “benefits of an in-office peel”. I have to say I am extremely disappointed. I was expecting great results, or at least some results. I even left it on longer than the 2 mins after not seeing results the first few times..I’ve seen nothing after 4 treatments.I realize that seems relatively quick to expect results. However, I know what to expect from glycolic chemical peels, they render great results pretty quickly. I’ve had chemicals peels at my dermatologist office before that were less potent (20-25%) and had more drastic results 1 week after my first visit. I plan on trying it for a couple more weeks, if I do not get the results I’m expecting I will be returning this product.

I’ve been using the Sobel skin rx along with DR. DENNIS GROSS SKINCARE Alpha Beta® Extra Strength Daily Peel. I usually alternate every other day between these peels. Between both of them, I 100% see improvement in skin texture. My skin type is combination. I’ve been on a strict skincare regiment for about 10 years and I do see an esthetician for facial peels and such. For home care and maintenance, this is really good. After 2 weeks, I saw my skin texture change to be a lot smoother. I also purchased the sobel facial wash with 29% glycolic, retinol, and niacinamide Gel Serum.  Overall, really happy. I will purchase again to keep up my home skincare regimen.
review_title: Really good for homecare skin matinance.

review_text: On initial use of this product it felt like a mild serum and i saw no immediate results the next day from using it, I kept using it twice a week an uped the time to 5 to 7 mins and my breakouts that I’ve been recently suffering from   and marks completely cleared up, even some old marks that I had from prior breakouts cleared up. I’m glad I didn’t give this a review off the bat, because at first i thought it did nothing, but once u keep using it you do notice a difference in your overall skin texture and clarity. My advice would be to give the product time to work and wait 30 days before writing an actual review. Entrigued to try some other products under this brand

I have 20% glycolic acid pads from the brand Pixie (found at target), and they work better than this. I feel more of a slight tingle with them and i don’t feel anything with this. I’ve gotten to wear i don’t even wash it off (like recommended). I just use as normal toner and layer products on top of it.

I was really excited to try out Sobel SkinRX. It had been some time since I had a facial and now with quarantine I needed to find an alternative. My skin is sensitive and this seemed like a product that would be both effective and non-irritating. Unfortunately, it is non-irritating, but only because it is not effective. Frankly, I’m not quite sure how to describe it. It does nothing, nada. With 30% glycolic acid, I would think there’d be at least a slight tingling sensation on my skin...but there isn’t. It feels more like a light astringent that needs to be rinsed off. After several uses, my skin neither feels nor looks any different. Definitely disappointed.
review_title: So mild it's like it's not working

review_text: I’m really happy with this peel so far (have been using it twice a week for a month). I was using the ordinary 30% peel and then babyfacial before that. I like that this peel has some soothing ingredients included, unlike the ordinary (although that is a great peel!). I don’t feel like it’s too expensive either as it’s a rather large bottle. I LOVE that they put this in an opaque bottle (light is not good for essentially any ingredients that will help your skin). I also love that there are no fragrant/citrus oils, fragrance or drying alcohol in this. I contacted the brand and they said they don’t use these in any of their products, which I love. I have lots of experience with acids so I apply this twice a week and leave on for 10-15 min, rather then the 2 min they recommend. Is my adult acne prone skin suddenly perfect? No. But it’s done a great job of making my skin smooth, glowing and “balanced”...I don’t have frustrating oily/dry days and I believe this has played a part in that (by the way, I’ve also started using Peter Thomas Roth niacinamide cream and I believe that is helping as well- I strongly recommend both of these for anyone struggling with frustrating acne, post acne marks, etc.)

So I’ve only used it three times and so far it works pretty well. It doesn’t tingle much to me, I’m not sure if that’s because of the calming ingredients or because I’ve been using acids on my face for awhile. Either way, it’s a plus. I love that it works in two minutes, I left it on a little longer last time though. I’ve used the Drunk Elephant TLC Sukari mask and The Ordinary’s red AHA serum mask (can’t remember the name) and this gives the same results in less time.

I absolutely love this! I have seen beautiful results after a short time using this once a week. It has a little tingle when you apply it and then rinse it off after 2 minutes. Super simple and it works great. I also love the glass bottle its very luxe. Definitely recommend. Can’t wait to try their retinol peel.
Absolutely helpful. It has diminished my hyperpigmentation and made my skin softer helping me out with texture problems. I love the fact that it’s a two minute peel while giving off amazing results.

This peel is EVERYTHING. I use this twice a week and my pores are visibly smaller and my skin is glowing! Definitely recommend if you have oily skin like myself and need an at home peel that will clear you up!

If im not using the antipollution drops this is what I’d be using! The Good C vitamin C serum has great antioxidants that also work as repelling radicals! This helped with uneven pigmentation and always use this during the Morning routine before lotion.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I got this serum as a free mini-sample. I’m using it on days that my skin has been irritatedovertreated. That happend, for instance, when I recently used the Dr Dennis Gross Firm & Brighten serum, that I got as a sample. I’m using this until the irritation moderates.That way, I’ll be using some vitamin C. I normally use a 10% ascorbic acid (no derivatives) serum, and my skin tolerates that well. The Dr Dennis Gros serum I used has 15% vitamin C and also lactic acid. I might be able to work up to regular use of that but for right now, I’m sticking with the Sturm vitamin C until I get back to baseline. .
review_title: Nice for when you need a Vitamin C Serum Lite
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: Smells disgusting. Like dog urine. And makes my skin feel tingly and weird.
review_title: Absolutely not. I’m lucky I got this as a sample.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: This is one of the first Vitamin C’s I can use that doesn’t leave me red and irritated. Lightly hydrating also. I can see why the scent puts some people off but it’s very, very mild. I barely notice. Most other C serums would leave me in worse shape than before so I can at least use one now and not be red/splotchy all the time.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: My derm recommended this C serum for the fantastic ingredients, but I can’t get over the smell.  It smells like onions.  Will go back to using SkinCeuticals C solely due to the bad smell.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: My skin felt less clear and radiant when I was using this product as compared to other vitamin C serums. I would not recommend.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I love this serum. It’s different from all the other vitamin c serum I’ve used before. I love the consistency, it’s not super thick and sticky. It doesn’t look like you have a vitamin c serum on your face when you apply. It’s super expensive but I might put some money aside to grab some.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: Good product for lightening freckles caused by the sun (i.e. sun spots). I find it effective to pair this product with a sunscreen afterwards and I after using it every day for a month, the sunspots on my face has gently lighten up. Don’t expect a miracle but this Vitamin C serum is tolerated well by sensitive skin. I have it 4 stars because the price point is expensive, but it is a good product overall.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: This is a very nice & moisturizing serum, but only has 5% vitamin c.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I’m obsessed with skincare products and this one did nothing for me.  Will not buy again.
review_title: simply put, not worth the money
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I absolutely love this serum. I saw a difference in my skin texture after only two days. I tend to be on the dry side and the good C (in combination with the face cream rich) makes my skin glow and feel so smooth while helping with hyperpigmentation.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: Dr. Sturm asserts that the skin only needs 5% Vitamin C to be effective. Her reasoning is that any higher percentage is irritating and counter productive. That being said, I switched from SkinCeuticals CE Ferulic to this and am not impressed. CE Ferulic is magic; makes my skin even, glowy, almost look airbrushed. Sturms serum is okay. It smells like onions, which I don’t really care about, but this is the only skincare change I’ve made and its caused breakouts. I want to believe that they’re purging, as the breakouts are in atypical areas, but I’ve been pretty consistently breaking out after a couple of weeks of use. Ultimately, I just don’t think the results compare to CE Ferulic, which is a far superior product at a similar price point. I prefer the consistency of the Sturm Serum, but prefer the results of CE Ferulic.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I’ve tried a lot of vitamin c serums and this has been my favorite. Let me preface my review by saying I have extremely sensitive skin, rosacea, fungal acne, lupus, and hashimotos. The hashimotos leaves my skin dry in most areas but oily on my nose. Other vitamin c serums have caused me to break out and have been too strong for me. This is the only one that has delivered results without being too harsh. From day one I noticed a beautiful glow and the best part is that it didn’t aggravate my rosacea. If you’re used to using stronger products with higher concentration or percentages of active ingredients this may not be for you. I don’t use any retinoids or acids on my skin because they’re too harsh. This is a definite staple!
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I saw immediate results from this product on Day 1 - the first time I tried it, I had a deluxe sample. I used it with no intention of purchasing it whatsoever, but ended up noticing that it really helped me even out my skin tone and add radiance (without shine). I mention the shine thing, because I often have that complaint about Vitamin C serums, but not with this one. I’ve been using consistently for a few weeks now since purchasing, and I continue to really love the results. Plays well with my other products, and my skin definitely looks better on days when I use it than on days when I don’t. I think this is important to note, because I’ve found most vitamin C products to have cumulative benefits way moreso than immediate ones. Let’s talk about price. Is this more expensive than some Vitamin C serums? Yes. However, it’s still less expensive than *the* C E Serum almost all skincare enthusiasts have tried at one point or another. That being said, $145 is steep and I’ve used other Vitamin C serums at half the price of this and liked the results. So I had to knock a star off purely for value. One thing this serum has over all the other relatively competitive Vitamin C products out there? No hot dog smell. No smell at all really. I never minded having a face full of barbecue scent at 6AM, but I know it drives some people insane. This serum is definitely for those people.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I have been using this for about two months now and can say I like the results but definitely do not LOVE the results. Especially for the price. Personally I saw more noticeable results (in terms of evening skin tone) from Summer Fridays CC Me. This serum has a really nice texture and absorbs so nicely but there are options out there just as nice if not better. Also there is definitely a weird smell to it which I’ve noticed with this and Dr. Barbara Sturm’s toner as well idk what that’s about.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I got this as a gift from my sister-in-law. Thank god I didn’t buy it myself. It did absolutely nothing for my skin besides typical hydration after putting on a serum. I used the whole bottle and honestly my skin did not change in texture, brightness or plumpness.. nothing at all! So I looked at the ingredients.. $190... for only 5% vitamin c? And aloe Vera is the second ingredient... y’all no wonder nothing happened!!! PLEASE do not waste your money on this! There are so many actually effective Vitamin C products (Tatcha has an excellent one) on the market, ESPECIALLY at this price range!
review_title: $190 for 5% vitamin c? no thank you
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: Who likes this and do they have mature skin? This gave me breakouts and clogged my pores. It has a milky texture that is too creamy for any skin other than dry, imo. I was using a sample packet. I would not purchase, and it’s very over priced. For reference, I don’t have skin that clogs easily or is sensitive.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: If you can get a sample of this, definitely give it a try. I have very sensitive, dry and reactive skin. Introducing new products often breaks me out. I had a few samples of this vitamin c serum and was really excited to give it a try before swallowing the hefty purchase price. I have previously used the Volition strawberry C which I hated, and the Caudalie serum that’s an alternative to vit C which I loved to give you an idea of my past experiences with similar products. This serum is absolutely lovely. The texture is light but not too light (very similar to the Caudalie) and a little goes a long way! It absorbs well and quickly making moving to the next step in your routine a breeze. I’m 36 and have some fine lines, some discolouration and redness. I have seen my redness go down, my skin looks more even and I’ve experienced no breakouts. Very happy and will repurchase again for sure. I plan to switch back and forth between this and the Caudalie as I enjoy both very much. Hoping to try more from this line in the future.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: Anytime I apply this serum, I can’t get over how it smells like onions!! I don’t know if it’s just me, but the smell is very bothersome that I don’t see me re purchasing. I am not seeing a huge difference with my skin, overall a no for me.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: Absorbs quickly, and so gentle ! Good for a combination skin type And daytime serum.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: Love this gentle vitamin C that doesn’t leave my skin red. If you think it’s expensive don’t buy it. Tired of these annoying reviews about pricing. Nobody is forcing you to buy luxury.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: This serum is good, but it’s definitely not the best Vitamin C option for the price. I don’t think it’s justified when there are more potent and beneficial options out there for more than half the price, and they are just as gentle. This is enjoyable to use and is definitely an indulgence, but considering she said Vitamin C was terrible for your skin a few months ago, I’m not sure how effective this will be long term at a concentration of 5%.
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: A little goes a long way, so I know the price is scary but trust me. My skin has never looked better. My acne scars have practically vanished after a few weeks of use. I can’t rave enough about this. I personally sent an email to the Sturm Team and told them so!
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: I purchased this serum from Dr. Sturm’s website when it was first released and I’m so excited it’s finally coming to Sephora! This is the most gentle and effective vitamin c I’ve ever used. The formula absorbs so quickly and leaves no residue behind, also it has no scent which I appreciate! It is expensive but if you can afford to give it a try it doesn’t disappoint!
product_name: The Good C Vitamin C Serum

review_text: This tanner is just awful. It dried extremely patchy and streaked very easily. It was difficult to apply because it took forever to dry. The green of the guide color did NOT wash off so I was green, not tan. The “tan“only lasted about two days before it all washed off. The tanner also dried me out so badly I developed several dry flaky patches on my body that have not gone away even after discontinuing my use of the tanner. Do not waste your money on this!!

IT’S GREEN!!  Not “green undertones“ like some tanners have. This stuff came out of the bottle green and stained my skin Hulk green.  WHY is Sephora selling this?  I’ve read the reviews and clearly I’m not the only person who’s bottle was full of green self-tanner.  Thank god I didn’t put this on any visible body parts or I would have been walking around like the jolly green giant for days until it faded.

I would give this 0 stars but it was not an option.The foam was pure green goo and it took rubbing alcohol to get the color green off my hand and clorox for the counter it dripped on.  I thought it might be the correct formula but it did absolutely not change to a bronze or any tan like color on my arm.

I’m a huge fan of Tarte “Brazilliance-PLUS+” so I was very disappointed when I couldn’t find it here in Sephora’s awesome app. In my search, I did find this product here instead. Based on my very positive results during the last 5 years using the “PLUS+” version (and liking Tarte products), I purchased this product. BIG mistake! This product is not at all similar to the “PLUS+” version. It is a foam-type product that weakly spreads on, giving an uneven look — even with the best of care in applying. It streaks very easily. The color is an UNnatural ashy-dark tone, which may work well for cool skin tones (not sure), but not if you are looking for a warm-tone self-tanner this would not be the one to use. Luckily I was able to find the “PLUS+” version before summer’s end, so I gladly ditched the “Tarte Brazliiiance 2 Hr Express.”

I don’t love this for body as it isn’t dark enough for my preference, however I love using this just on my hands/feet. It doesn’t OVER darken the knuckles which most self tanners do. I use this throughout the week for touch ups because my hands always lose color first.
Such a great color, but a pretty bad tanner smell and it fades after 2 showers it seems.

I’ve used this product at least 10 times now and to be honest, I’m still on the fence so breaking it down to pros/cons.Pros: the color looks super natural on my olive toned skin, it’s not too drastic and is more cool toned which looks more like a day at the beach than a week long Hawaiian. I also love how easy it is to apply - you can see the color when you apply and it makes it super easy to avoid steaks Cons: holy crap this dries my skin out - like itchy, scaly dry if I don’t immediately apply lotion after applying. Even with the lotion I can really only leave this on for 4-6 hours without feeling like I need to rinse. I have sensitive skin, so maybe that’s the issue, but I have also never had this reaction to any other sunless tanner (St Tropez, Brazilliance original, Tanceuticals, etc). I also don’t feel like 2 hours really gives you enough time for the color to turn, I notice much more color at hour 5. Once you do get that gorgeous glow, it also doesn’t last long, I’d say 1-2 showers (in addition to the rinse off) before you need to reapply also stains like none other until you take that post application shower.

the bottle is a hit or miss. sometimes the pump is fine and sometimes its leaky but if packaging doesn’t bother you and you only care about the tanner, its like a hybrid of tartes old discontinued tanners. its not terrible. smells like vanilla. kinda wet feeling so wait longer than 2 minutes before putting clothes on (like the bottle says). i would suggest the st. tropez mitt not the one tarte sells.

this came out a very cool toned brown color on me, it did not match my skin tone in a very obvious way. It wasn’t orange so there’s that and it did work very quickly,  lasted about 3 days. but the color was so wrong and the bottle leaks everywhere that it is not worth the purchase. the old formula was a very nice golden color,  this is just disappointing.

I never tried the original but I think this one is really nice. I’ve tried MANY brands and before this my go-to was St Tropez Express in the blue packaging. This Tarte one is nice because it gives me great color and it wears away nicely on my skin. I find it lasts pretty decently in terms of wear time too. I only gave it 4 stars because the bottle leaked everywhere and created a huge mess when I went to shake it after 1 shake! I think they need to improve that! review_text: I’m a fair-med skin tone gal who tans very quickly and doesn’t burn easily. An athlete who faces a yearly project of evening out the multi-layered tan lines from different short and sports bras, I’ve been looking for a clean self tanning product that also won’t turn me orange or melt off when I sweat buckets (which is pretty much daily). Thought that might be too big an ask, but I gave this a try and I am impressed. I’ve used Coola’s sunscreens before and loved them, so I felt it was worth investigating.Prior to this I’ve used two other competing well known green beauty self tanning lotions, which delivered pretty good results but would fade very easily and messily. The Coola spray is a perfect match for the tone of my actually tanned skin—more golden brown, no orange—and subtle but buildable. It does start to fade after three days as claimed, but the fade is very even and can by easily buffed with moisturizer and/or exfoliating if needed. Overall: totally worth the price for the ease and effectiveness. One bottle costs the same as two bottles of the self tan I used to use, and it looks like this will last for about two months of regular application. My tips: Use a light even spritz to begin with, and blend in as directed. Let dry while doing chores or whatever (haha) and avoid wearing tight clothing for the first 2-3 hours. Better to go easy and build than try to aim for crazy coverage on the first go, you may risk getting too much buildup of product that you won’t see until later ;)

review_text: This lasted for 2 months with sporadic use. What I like/love:1-2. The cleanser is not stripping (like my old cleanser) and cleans off makeup and skincare products (serums, toners) effortlessly. This is the only cleanser so far that has most effectively and efficiently removed my full coverage makeup in one go. All the other cleansers I have tried so far need multiple cleanses, much more product, and leave a filmy or stripping sensation on my skin.3. It has a smooth, pleasant, and lotion-feeling texture. 4. It smells like cherries and coconuts and whenever I use this cleanser I feel like I am using a lotion from a luxury tropical resort. The smell goes away / my nose gets acclimated to the smell within 5 minutes of use. I don’t mind fragrance in my products and I would rather have a cleanser smell like this one than my old cleanser that smelled like silica/metallic soap. 5. I like the color, texture, and sustainability focus of the packagingWhat I don’t like:1. The cleanser does not cleanse off my mineral sunscreens. After trying it multiple times, more than half of my sunscreen remains on my face. Maybe it works for chemical sunscreen. I always get allergic reactions and/or cystic acne from chemical sunscreens so I only use mineral sunscreens.  2. I very much prefer skincare products with a pump over having to squeeze out the product. 3. I have to clean the cap and/or opening of the bottle each time I use it. Also the outside of the bottle got a stain from my foundation that I had to scrub hard with dish detergent to remove (I had to clean off the stain or else I would stain my fingers with foundation each time I use the cleanser). Stains on the packaging are hard to remove. 4. Having said that, I would re-purchase this if the price for the full-sized bottle wasn’t expensive. I feel uncomfortable buying cleansers over $25 CAD. Overall, 3.5 stars, rounded up to 4 stars.
product_name: Mini Total Cleans'r Makeup Removing Cleanser

I checked the ingredients- there’s not only bergamot oil but lemon essential oils. Those have the highest risk to agitate the muscles membranes in the eye. I know I know- it’s a CITRUS oil cleanse. When I read the description it highlights coconut oil over the citrus aspect and I guess I just kind of grazed over it.So! Having said all that. I find this great on days I just want to have a nice experience, if I didn’t wear eye makeup and can skip my eyes, or if I do a micelles cleanse on my eyes first. Just avoid your dang eyes.

I have acne prone skin and this does not break me out, leaves nice clean radiant skin. Plus it smells so good! The muslim cloth is a part of the package. It’s little bit pricy, but the package lasts me for 3 months and I’m using it every day. I highly recommend this product!

I have used all kinds of high end products, even medical grade because of my past career. However, La Mer is the top of the line and I love that this mask stays on, and infuses into your skin. It is a great adjunct I wake up looking much better - by that I mean softer, radiant, more of glow, just with more life and youthful after the nights I use this mask.

This is designed differently than other massage rollers I’ve seen out there... the jade balls have a slightly oblong hexagonal surface, as opposed to smooth jade balls. The result is that as these roll across any area of my skin that has fat (such as my cheeks), it gently grips the flesh between the texture of the balls and tugs it in that direction, instead of just gliding across the skin. In my experience so far, that is the feature of this design that actually makes it worth it. The blood flow in my face feels more stimulated from this gentle “pinching“ motion than it ever has from a smooth roller, and I have my own way that I like to roll my face that always pulls upward. So this roller is always massaging/tugging the plumper areas of my face “up“. I’m extremely happy with that - but careful not to tug on delicate areas. The construction of this is excellent for facial sculpting, but perhaps more fragile, so definitely register it with Mount Lai and try not to drop it. And this natural jade feels a lot more delicate than what I’m used to handling in terms of beauty tools (plastic, metal, or even thick glass)... I’m sure this would break if dropped. If you’re worried about the breakage issues, they do make this same design in rose quartz. I haven’t gotten that version but in my experience, rose quartz feels a bit heavier and more shatter-resistant than jade. Personally, this roller is an A+ for me as long as I use it right for my face and don’t break it. Hope this helps.

review_text: I love Tarte because of their clean products so I decided to try this Serum and add it to my routine. I have used 1-2 pumps while my skin is damp followed by my Clinique Moisture Surge Gel moisturizer and I’ve loved the results! I do the same thing in the evening before applying my Lancôme serums and moisturizer. I am so shocked to see the reviews stating this didn’t show up or did nothing for some. I don’t normally write reviews but I couldn’t believe the ones I was reading on this. This tanner has been the best self-tanner experience I’ve ever had in my history of self-tanning. The tan goes to such a flattering brown instead of orange. I do believe this claims to show in as little as 3 hours, which is why I think everyone is saying it doesn’t work. I have never left this on for just 3 hours. I will usually leave it on for at least a full day before I even think of going near water! The longer you keep it on, the more it will keep on developing, and trust me it will not stop. If you leave it on for more than a day it will almost over - develop, meaning go a bit orange, but it will become a part of your skin as you will notice once you wash it off, unlike other self-tanners that feel like they are only on top of the skin and make me scared to rub them off by accident. I feel like this one truly “absorbs“ into your skin. I also usually do a body exfoliation prior to applying, as well as moisturizing  any areas that are prone to dryness, like knees, ankles, elbows, etc. Use a basic moisturizer like aveeno that will do a good job but sink in quick. After that’s absorbed I use 1-2 pumps each round and start blending into the skin in circular motions. Its easy to blend because you can see the difference in colour on your skin. Once again I’ve never experienced any problems with this amazing tanner but I have also never kept it only for only 3 hours. I recommend everyone try this again for at least a 12 hour period and watch how deeply the tan develops. It may not be so noticeable if only done for 3 but longer than that you will definitely see it show up. The whole 3 hour express claim for this product was obviously not well executed by St.Tropez, but the product definitely works, just not quite by what they say it does I guess (also referring to those looking for a deeper tan).

review_text: I was not expecting to love this product so much. The Sephora brand products are always a hit or miss for me - They are either a must have or a never purchase again. This product is an example of the former for me. I bought this in the hopes that I could minimize the appearance of my pores, and I was not disappointed. Throughout my high school years, I had an obsession with squeezing out all the gunk (sebum) in my pores, and was left with enlarged pores and very red skin + some scarring. Typically you need to wait a minimum of four weeks to see results with any skin care routine, but I saw results after a week of using this! It made my pores less noticeable, and I noticed less cakeyness with my usual foundation. Another benefit was that my skin felt cleaner to me. It was the extra little step I needed after cleansing. Overall, I definitely recommend this product if you are looked to minimize pores, reduce redness due to skin swelling/irritation, and an overall brightened look. My only regret is not taking before and after photos of my face! ConsThere really aren’t any, but I like to include any drawbacks to legitimize my reviews. You get a lot of bang for your buck with this product. The bottle is a decent size for its price of $16, and cheaper than many of the other brands you find a Sephora (though in my opinion it works better than most). But because I apply using cotton pads, you need to use quite a bit of product to soak the pad and have enough to press down and hold on each section of the face. This bottle lasted me about 2 months, so it’s a little bit of an investment as a student with no income. But all in all, totally worth it and the price is actually cheap for the benefits you get so don’t let this con hold you back from trying it!

I have sensitive skin to begin with since stopping accutane my skin is prone to flakiness when using strong actives. I have not had that problem at all with this kit, even though I started off with applying the treatments every day. The acne on my chin went from angry and red and infected to completely smoothed out with just slight post-acne marks in three days. I have never had salicylic acid or benzoyl peroxide products work that quickly and with such minimal irritation before. I’ve kept the exfoliating solution and skin clearing treatment away from the parts of my face that tend to be drier and don’t experience breakouts, which probably also helps to minimize irritation. The moisturizer hydrates effectively without any sort of oily residue and leaves a matte finish. While the products have made the sebaceous filaments on my nose less noticeable they have not gotten rid of them entirely, though at this point I don’t think anything will. I’m so impressed that I’ve ordered a few more products from Paula’s Choice including the full size of the cleanser in this kit and a niacinamide toner that I’m hoping will help to reduce the look of my pores further.
product_name: Clear Skin Kit Acne Treatment Kit

review_text: I bought this when I was having awful hormonal acne as a last ditch effort to help improve my skin, and while in the beginning it def did dry my skin out and I flaked severely, the end result only a good 4/5 days later was worth it. My skin is smooth and free of acne. I’ve always had a red face (according to dermatologists I’ve seen in the past it’s not rosacea lol even tho I’m skeptical about that diagnosis) so I don’t expect that to go away but when it has come to the acne that has plagued me for most my life this really did help out in getting it under control. The period where it dried me out did suck but I used first aid’s moisturizer to help negate the dryness. This is def gonna be a major part of my skin care routine when I have cystic or hormonal acne.
review_title: Lifesaver from Cystic and hormonal acne
product_name: Clear Skin Kit Acne Treatment Kit

review_text: Great kit! Thank you for giving us a smaller version to sample all the things! This helped me make my decision to buy the regular size bottle of the cleanser. The other salicylic acid solution and the benzoyl peroxide treatment products are great, but only use them as needed on the areas need, not for everyday use. Even the cleanser—now that my skin is clear, I only use it 2 days a week normally, or 3 days a week during PMS/period time for prevention and maintenance. I alternate with a gentler cleanser. Obviously if you use a salicylic acid cleanser and solution every day, you’re going to dry out! Make sure to use a really good moisturizer with SPF afterwards too!
product_name: Clear Skin Kit Acne Treatment Kit

review_text: Holy grail.  Unsure about bad reviews. I caved and got the kit. Best decision ever. Woke up pretty flawless.
