review_text: I don’t usually write reviews but this product doesn’t have very many so I figured I’d share my experience.The short of it is that it is pearlescent and absorbs well.The interesting thing about this emulsion is that it doesn’t have the sunscreen smell despite what feels like a large concentration of spf blocking ingredients and that it works with white cast. The Lucent Emulsion has a few chemical spf ingredients and a touch of titanium dioxide (it’s the last listed ingredient) and so many may worry about white cast. This product though has a bunch of pearlescent shimmer in it so the white tones just give your skin a more radiant look. I think you’d still need to be rather fair skinned to successfully wear the product and the tube feels kind of small considering that it is a full face moisturizer. I’m still working on picking a secondary moisturizer to use on top but my skin feels comfortable with just toner and this.Like I said, the tube feels a little small to replace a moisturizer in your daily routine and it’s kind kf expensive not to be used for spf and as a general skincare step so ymmv. Personally, I like the shimmer and how it feels and smells but I wish it was at least 25 spf. It’s frustrating to be at just below the recommended minimum. PS I don’t wear makeup so I can’t say how it stacks with any.

review_text: I cannot recommend this. It pills when you mix with other serums AND alone! Let’s not mention that when you apply I can oddly feel every texture & pore in my skin. I’d recommend trying another product.

When putting the moisturizer on my face it didn’t spread easily, wasn’t moisturizing and definitely not to be used under foundation. It also felt  irritating on my face. The day after using it my skin started breaking it.

I’ll try using less, and if that doesnt work Ill try using it on top of thinner oiler moisturizers to see if they prevent this one from pilling.  Maybe after playing around I’ll find the sweet spot- but not sure if I’d buy this again even though it’s very affordable.For reference I’m 49 with very dry skin and fine and deeper lines as well as skin sagging - this definitely addresses all three noticeably after only a few days.  I don’t look 20 lol but it’s definitely firming and tightening my skin at least while the product is on.

(if anyone used Sephoras Leave in Conditioner for hair with Amino Acids, it is similar consistency on your hands)  Once you apply it to your skin, it feels like it dries off within seconds, frequently I forget that I already applied it and end up re apply it, because it feels that dry.. It does not add shine.Your skin will feel thirsty. I usually purchase Fresh, Origins or SkinFX but I am on a budget and I trust Sephora brand skin care + makeup, so I bought this daily moisturiser. I love that it has no scent!
review_title: Don't do it ladies, buy SkinFX.

review_text: Pros: This moisturizer does not feel oily or leave me looking oily after applying. Cons: Thos moisturizer feels like it just sits on top of my skin and creates a film that pills on my face.  I will not be repurchasing this.

review_text: Its a great cream..I love the light weight formula.
Super moisturizing! Great for dry skin, morning and night! Makeup goes on perfect over top of this cream!

Pretty effective at making my skin smooth and reducing the depth of my fine lines. FRAGRANCE FREE FTW!!! Yas thank you Sephora for listening to customers and start making your skincare fragrance free. This makes the product safe even for people with sensitivity :) this is perfection
the old formula is so much better! it made my skin plump, firm, dewy, and made it feel so hydrated while still being lightweight. bring it back please!!

Definitely one of my favorite serums and products. Goes great with Sturm’s clarifying moisturizer. Clears your complexion (and makes it more even), while providing hydration. Great serum!

So first off I have struggled with skin issues from eczema, to acne, hormonal acne, dermatitis and everything in between . I have extremely extremely sensitive skin and just about anything irritates me . Dr. Sturm is amazing and is so helpful and willing to answer any questions if you reach out! The photos are 3 days apart! No makeup!  It hasn’t completely healed up but there’s such a difference In the small amount ! I wish I could share more pictures but it only allows two !

I love this line. I occasionally get hormonal breakouts on my forehead and chin and this serum helps to clear them right up in just a few days. I also really love how is is not harsh on the skin and does not cause any burning like other acne lines I have tried.

This is a gentle—GENTLE—acne treatment. Sturm’s mantra is harsh chemicals damage skin over time & we need to be patient with our skin. Some things in her line are worth it (this, hyaluronic serum, scrub) some are not (face cream, cleansers). If you’re expecting a harsh acne-zapping serum, this isn’t it. I use it on breakouts that are fading or just beginning. It does WONDERS on speeding up acne fading & works like a filter on bad areas. I’ve had mine for about 6 months with daily use on my chin. Expensive, but if you have a hormonal problem area, it helps. I usually use it for emerging and fading breakouts, using benzyl peroxide when they’ve peaked. Pricey, though. Would love a cheaper alternative.

UGH. pains me to write this review because I was so hopeful it would really help in treating my acne. I have been using this serum for almost 6 months. I am 37 yo with acneic combo skin. I found it to be very hydrating and soothing, really helped in getting rid of the dry areas - hence why I’ve used it for a while. However, it doesn’t do a whole lot in the Clarifying sense - perhaps there was a slight reduction in my acne, but really nothing noticeable. Therefore I just can’t justify re-purchasing anymore. im ditching this product because I found another serum that actually does just as good of a job in hydrating my skin (stacked skincare HA serum). Sturm products are of high quality when it comes to hydration and absorption of product- but this one did not deliver in the aspect of clarifying.

I am 45 and Barbara sturm products have worked wonderfully on my fair, sensitive, redness prone and chronically clogged pores.  I don’t get painful, big breakouts, but instead lots of small annoying bumps.  I use the sturm cleanser, toner, clarifying serum and clarifying moisturizer and my skin started to become much clearer after 3 days.  When I added the clarifying mask once a week it became even clearer.  Yes, this is an extremely expensive regimen, but it did work for me.  I think it works best on those who cannot tolerate acids, and retin a anymore.  I used them for many years but my skin became so red and sensitive with a compromised skin barrier.  These products gave me the best skin of my life at 45 and I finally feel comfortable without makeup.  I recommend this if you can afford it and have aging, sensitive skin with mild acne.

Here, let me save you $250 - this serum is nonsense. It does nothing, and it has the consistency of dog drool. I used it for more than a month and it did nothing. Something that actually works! This helps calm existing acne and prevents from new ones forming! Highly recommend. Although it is really pricy it will last you a long time. I just use it once in the morning on the areas I tend to breakout in.

Fortunately I don’t use it on my entire face so it lasts longer. I only apply it to my chin & nose areas. Recommended.

This serum, along with the Clarifying Cream and the Clarifying Mask, has drastically improved my skin. It’s expensive but I genuinely haven’t tried any other line (and I’ve tried PLENTY) that has delivered as much as this one. just tried this out and so far so good I have hormonal break outs and I had a pretty large red painful pimple on my jaw line and it reduced the size redness and inflammation after only 10 min. I would give it 5 but I’m still testing this guy out.

Glad I got it on sale... I don’t think it does anything! I won’t be buying again. I bought it because I’d heard it was good for acne and wouldn’t irritate or might help PD. i have seen no changes or improvement!

did nothing much, there is nothing special about this mask that would justify the $145 price tag.

review_text: I have combination facial skin (oily around my forehead and between my brows, dry everywhere else). I didn’t buy the NuFace toning device so I wonder if that was the reason I didn’t see any firming after a month or so, so I might look into it. If so, that brings the price point much higher so it’s something to consider.

review_text: I had never heard of Hyper Skin before trying this product but I love their packaging and I think this duo is a great value. This duo features Hyper Skin’s Gentle Brightening Cleansing Gel with Mandelic Acid & the Brightening Dark Spot Vitamin C Serum. Gentle Brightening Cleansing Gel:The box containing this duo smelled like the tangerine/citrus scents from the Body Shop. The culprit of this delightfully fresh smell is the brightening cleansing gel, and it struck me as a nice scent to use in the morning to help wake you up. Which is great since this cleanser is gentle enough for both AM/PM use and works well with acne-prone skin! The texture is a very thick gel that can be hard to spread and even harder to remove if you use too much product. So it’s best to follow their advice and use only a dime-sized amount for each cleanse and lather it in your palms. What’s great about that is that this cleanser will last you a long time before running out so the price point is worth it. I thought it was interesting to note that the instructions also recommend letting the cleanser sit for thirty seconds before washing off which is something I don’t see often! Brightening Dark Spot Vitamin C Serum:This Vitamin C serum is a powerful little bottle to help fade hyperpigmentation more efficiently. Texture-wise this feels almost like a mix of an oil and gel to me; it’s thick enough to not slide right off your fingers/face but when spread it it glides over the face easily in a thin layer. The serum is smooth on the face and adds a glow but it also leaves a slight tacky film (less so than some other Vitamin C serums though). As for the packaging, even though the serum looks small I think this would last at least a month. However, the price is a little much for the quantity so if you’re on a budget then a different active ingredient product may be better for you. As for anything regarding skincare, consistency is key and you cannot see hyperpigmentation disappear overnight.

You’re going to first want to find your triggers, second sleep on elevated pillows, or a beauty pillow to reduce puffiness. Sleep is first regulate your sleeping schedule is number one, then reduce salt intake, look at diet, take diuretics on weekends, get active and move your body to drain the water. Next, start icing, ice your face and eyes and you will see a big change in the morning. Also try to do a face soak in ice cubes, cold water, and green tea leaves, then try a de puffing massage, also try do a warm compress with salt on eyes. If you still see minimal results, try RF machine once a week, or a facial tool like a roller, non Jade, the double knob silver roller that works really well. Also, take allergy pills if needed, dieuretics, once a week, zinc, and get enough pottasium, and eat less high glycemic foods. See a doctor if you think you have chronic edema or underlying conditions. If that fails, then try this. The eye serum is great. The mask is pretty expensive and didn’t last me more than three months. The eye serum doesn’t work for everyone though however it’s one of the few upper eyelid serums out there. Again as I said: - Facial massage - Icing face with ice/cold water - Find triggers and take allergy pills/vitamins - reduce salt intake and regulate sleep and get beauty pillow - Increase physical activity - See a doctor if all else fails

review_text: Buy a stamping device versus a rolling device. They don’t get caught in your hair or break off hair follicules. Also make sure you are using the correct needle length for scalp, 1.5mm. review_text: While wonderful on their own or mixed with more compatible ingredients, lactic acid and Acetyl Hexapeptide 8 are NOT compatible. review_text: First things first; the consistency is like water. But don’t let that fool you.Review; the Ultimate Essence is far more powerful than the “regular” essence. I had been using the lower intensity of pitera for years in SKII’s Essence. Last year, I took advantage of the 20% off discount and bought the Ultimate. I won’t go back. Though expensive, it truly evens out the fine lines, pores, and texture of the skin over time. You will not notice an immediate effect. But, after 1-2 months, you’ll begin to see a real change in the smoothness of your facial skin. Your skin will become noticeably softer.Hint; get a 1 or 2 ounce eyedropper bottle and pour the product into it. It lasts much longer and keeps the remainder fresh. I use 6 drops over my whole face twice per day- morning and night. The whole bottle then lasts 8 months plus.

I am obviously in the minority but I wasn’t impressed with this. I have been using the original essence for years and can tell that it really does help my skin. I tried this for a month and did not notice that it did anything different, I also did not like it as much because it had a slightly slimy feel to it. To me it is not worth the higher price and I will stick with the original.

So far, I’m happy with this investment.  My textured, 44-year-old skin has become softer, and plumper in just 2 weeks of use.  This essence is extremely hydrating as well.  Now the price is a bit scary for most people and I get that and so if you are on the fence about it, I would suggest two things for you...  #1 Buy at Sephora or get a sample at Sephora to try.  If you hate it, they have an awesome return policy.  #2 I don’t think you’ll need to return it as you will see a difference within two weeks.  Please know that a little goes a long way and so, you can expect this bottle to last a very long time.  Twice per day, I put 3-4 drops in my hands, rub them together to warm it up and I can cover my face and neck and have left-over to smooth onto my soon-to-be-aging hands.  I suspect that the longer I use this, the more results I will see as this really has brightened my complexion.   I don’t apply with a cotton square because it is wasteful.  The cotton absorbs too much of this expensive product.  This also absorbs very quickly into the skin and has no odor!!!  I can quickly apply other products right after applying without any issue.I have heard that this product is amazing for anyone who suffers from acne, so be aware this might be a great solution to help clear up your skin.The packaging is pretty, but in all honesty, they could do better with the functionality of it.  But, when you pay a premium price, people sometimes desire beautiful packaging.  I personally would rather have functionality over pretty.  The screw cap is a pain to screw back on when I have wet hands after applying.  I don’t think a pump is necessary as I can see the pump being wasteful in not determining the right amount to dispense.  Therefore, my suggestion would be a flip-top cap.
review_title: The price is scary but it lasts a L-O-N-G time!

review_text: I regularly use a cheap plastic, gel filled roller I got from Amazon that works well.  I already have the GloPRO micro needling tool so I purchased this thinking the stainless steel would allow for it to stay colder longer.   I used this less than 5 minutes after removing from the freezer, and while it was extremely cold and nice at first, it started warming up from my skin less than 2 minutes after use.  I will be returning as I need it to be cold to keep my face from itching after the micro needling process.

I like using the Cryo Skin Incing Attachments while watching tv. The small roller makes the skin of my face feel alive like splashing with cold water, and the larger roller takes away all my tension and anxiety as I roll it behind my neck and on my arms and legs and even my stomach. They are so easy to use and to clean up and put away that there’s no issue with using them frequently whenever the mood strikes.

The Cryo Rollers are a literal breath of fresh air in the morning. They help me wake up because they are like splashing cold water on your face, but without the watery mess. My face has depuffed and it’s great to use right before applying makeup too. Also a great tool for headaches though it’s not it’s intended use :)

I added this to my night routine and am never looking back. I cleanse, apply the nightly, then a moisturizer (alternate between the Quench and the Ultimate) and follow with the cryo roller and I’m loving the results. Not only does it feel amazing, I feel like I wake up with tighter, glowier skin in the morning. I usually use at night cause that’s when I have time, but love how it feels after a warm shower in the AM. The small attachment is perfect for around the eyes and it’s so easy to switch between the two heads. A++ in my book.
Great product! I’ve been using it for nearly three weeks and it helps me with the puffiness around the eyes and sore muscles. It’s a wake alarm for the skin in the morning. So far, I’m loving it!
review_title: Almost better than coffee in the morning!

review_text: I have been using this in the morning every day to depuff esp under my baggy saggy eyes and it immediately tightens and looks more firm!!! I put mine in a Ziploc and keep it colder in the fridge and works like magic!

The cryo roller has been a game changer for me with morning swelling in my face.  I hate waking up with puffy eyes and this clears them up and helps me feel SO refreshed.  Recently, I had a terrible headache and rolling this on my temples was incredible!  Highly highly recommended!

Love EVERYTHING BeautyBio!  These Cryo rollers are amazing and a must start any day.  I’m particularly puffy around the eyes in the am and there is an instant reduction.  A side benefit is using along the temples when the occasional headache flares.
This is a must to every morning skincare routine. It instantly reduces under eye bags and puffiness. It’s great in the morning to help wake you up and lasts all day. I would highly recommend it.
review_title: A must to your morning skincare routine

review_text: I spend most of my day on Zoom calls and I noticed my face was puffy in certain areas, especially under my eyes.  Before important calls, I use the Cryo eye attachment head and roll under my eyes and within 5 minutes, the puffiness is reduced.  I keep my Cryo attachment heads in the freezer and they are very cold.  Be careful not to leave it for too long in one spot when rolling.  I left it for too long on one spot and had a small red spot but it went away in 10 minutes.  This is my new go to before any important meeting.
review_title: Amazing!  Helped to reduce my puffiness

review_text: The texture is liquidy and has citrus scent. review_text: I have had a hard time finding a SPF for my face that I really love. Sometimes the product gets a little too close to my eyes and makes them super watery. review_text: I love this brand, but this product was a bit of a disappointment for me. The formula feels very greasy and takes a while to dry. review_text: The sunscreen smells nice, doesn’t leave a white cast and layers well under makeup. I really love how my skin looks with this on its own as well. review_text: This is a nice “all in one” product since it’s moisturizing, has high spf, and also contains vitamin c. It’s relatively lightweight considering it’s a mineral formula and doesn’t leave a white cast on my light medium skin. The price is definitely up there but it is a nice formula!
product_name: Daily Defense Moisturizer Mineral SPF 60 with Vitamin C

review_text: I received this sunscreen complimentary from Soleil Toujours. I am a huge sunscreen advocate. I wear sunscreen daily, and I always use the appropriate amount which is about 1/4 teaspoon. It’s more than people realize, but it’s pertinent to this review. This sunscreen is a mineral SPF that comes in gorgeous packaging, and I love that it has a pump. The product also has a nice light scent that I personally enjoy, and the product feels like a luxurious serum that glides on the skin. 10/10 for packing and user experience. Unfortunately, that’s where the good experience ended for me. If you’re using the correct amount of product, this sunscreen leaves a white cast--and I have very fair skin with pink undertones. I spent a considerable amount of time rubbing in the product to get it to tone down, and then the streakiness started. Even after 40+ minutes, the product did not dry down in any fashion and I can’t imagine putting makeup over this, as the sunscreen was still moving all over my face. I hate to leave a negative review on SPF, because it can be so personal and what might work for me, may not work for you. That being said, everyone should find an SPF you LOVE and wear it every day! this one will not be that for me.
product_name: Daily Defense Moisturizer Mineral SPF 60 with Vitamin C

review_text: I’ve been looking for a sunscreen that really helps my skin look and feel better and I finally found one that I love!!! I’m obsessed with this product and I love how beautiful and luxurious the packaging looks! Must try !
product_name: Daily Defense Moisturizer Mineral SPF 60 with Vitamin C

review_text: I am so thrilled to get to review this product. I am a huge proponent of zinc, SPF over chemical for many reasons, and my dermatologist always says to use mineral when I can. The problem with mineral, is that the texture is often thick, and it leaves and intense white cast. Neither of those things are true with this product. The texture and absorbency is amazing and it leaves no visible residue. I think it’s comparable to Dr. Brandt mineral sunscreen but I like this better because it has a higher SPF and I like that it’s dispensed by a push top tube instead of a dropper. No exaggeration within two minutes of trying this product. I went onto Sephora and buy other products from this brand because I just know they’re gonna be amazing.
product_name: Daily Defense Moisturizer Mineral SPF 60 with Vitamin C

review_text: Love how lightweight this product is and it blends well with my daily moisturizer!
product_name: Daily Defense Moisturizer Mineral SPF 60 with Vitamin C

review_text: Switching to this cleanser had been an amazing new addition to my skincare routine. It’s light and luxurious foam that doesn’t dry out the skin. The texture of my skin is incredible. Two pumps is all you need. 1 bottle lasted 4 months.

I adore this cleanser. Yes, I hate the price, but it lasts forever, doesn’t strip my crazy sensitive skin & prone to breakouts skin, but removes all my makeup thoroughly. I most often cleanse once, but a few times a week, I use for a double cleanse to first remove makeup & sunscreen & then to cleanse my skin. I cleanse first thing in the morning, after workouts & again at night if I’ve reapplied sunscreen or makeup. I’ve had this for 3 months & still have a lot left. It’s crazy expensive, but I suffer from Perioraldermatitis, hyperpigmentation, combination skin that will break out if any ingredients are comedogenic. My skin is a million times better since I’ve used this. I was using Jan Marini, which was causing my barrier to thin away. I started using a few Dr. Sturm products - including her ridiculously expensive moisturizer (desperation from a really bad PD flare up), which I seriously love, but it’s too much money for constant use. I will buy the cleanser again b/c I haven’t seen another product as both gentle, non-drying- and yet effective that isn’t the same price. My skin is super balanced, not oily, but sensitive. I read every ingredient & don’t leave anything on my skin with coconut derivatives.
review_title: Great for sensitive, PD prone skin.

review_text: I really love this product , is gently and don’t dry the skin , but works perfectly well cleaning I will buy it again for sure

I purchased this elsewhere because it was on sale, but I figured I’d review it here because there are still no reviews. I have very fair, acne-prone, oily skin (sometimes dehydrated from Tretinoin), with mild rosacea. My skin can also be somewhat sensitive. That being said, this sunscreen doesn’t irritate my skin or break me out at all. It’s not greasy at all and doesn’t make me oily. It has a nice, light scent, no white cast, and sinks in quickly. It also has a really pretty pearlescent effect on the skin that is lovely on no makeup days (It looks nice on my fair skin, but I can’t speak to how this will look on darker skin tones). Also, the bottle is absolutely adorable. I haven’t worn this under makeup, so I can’t speak to pilling in that regard, but it hasn’t pilled overtop of my skincare. I plan on using this for days when I’m not wearing makeup so that I can get the full effect of the pearly sheen. The only things I wish were different are the price (so expensive for the amount to be used daily) and the level of spf (I wish it was more like 40-50 spf because I’m super fair skinned and on Retin-A). This definitely isn’t going to be for everyone because sunscreen, and skincare in general, is so personal. Alkyl glucosides used and still technically are considered mild and gentle BUT several years ago were found to actually be allergens that can cause allergic dermatitis reactions. Literally won allergen of the year in 2017. You can google the studies. While a lot of people won’t have reactions many don’t realise that the reason they are breaking out in bumps, redness, little white heads all over is from a reaction to glucosides in products. They are in so many amazing products from all brands and all types of products because it’s still considered genérele and mild but just know that if you are prone to contact dermatitis, have a compromised skin barrier, or sensitive skin in general you should try your best to shy away from glucosides. The most commonly used being decyl glucoside. If you’re one of many that have used Glow recipe and loved the result but not the reaction of breakout you got. Check the list. It’s in the eye cream etc. you might have less of a reaction with rinse offs such as cleansers BUT studies show that you should refrain from even using rinse offs because of worsening future reactions. Hoping this helps people who have had issues with skincare and can’t seem to figure out what the ingredient is. Glucosides come up in search as being safe for sensitive skin until you keep researching. A lot of sunscreens use it as well and it’s not always the uva/uvb ingredient irritating your skin.
review_title: Warning for contact dermatitis and sensitive skin!

review_text: I first heard about this product when I saw the famed make-up artist Bobbi Brown talking about how she stopped wearing foundation because she has been using it. Then I heard one of the Kardashian sisters talking about it as well. Now I’m not a celebrity crazy person. I understand they are paid to say these things but still I was curious. Bobbi Brown has her own skin care line so for her to unofficially endorse another brand says a lot. But then I saw the price and I was like “uh, that’s okay.“Then 4 months ago I got a sample from Sephora for an order I had placed. I figured it’s free-what’s the worst that can happen. Full discloser I’ve been using Lancome’s Genefique for about 20 years-and I swear by this stuff. I also use SKII’s essence and their night cream-religiously.I will say this product with one use makes my face look like I just had an oxygen facial. If you want to experiment then try this-just use the A.B. The Rich Cream around your eyes only. (Our eyes are the first place where aging starts-around the age of 24-25 years old) This way you have something to compare it to. Now the sample last me about 3 months-I used it every day. So for those who are on the fence because of the steep price-the stuff goes a long way and it’s super concentrated. You only need a tiny bit of it. The pores about my T-zone have shrunk to almost normal size. (I have large pores around my nose from teenage acne. I’ve tried everything to shrink it from laser therapy to prescription Retinol. Nothing seem to quite work) The Rich Cream also has minimize the scars from my nose from surgery I had 2 years ago and the fine lines around my eyes has gotten softer. I now only use the A.B. system. It’s pricy but think of all the hundreds of dollars we all have thrown away trying out products that seem to work for a while or never worked as advertise. I know I have a drawer full of them. I’m telling you-it’s worth the hype! You won’t reget it.

The Rich Cream gives noticeable results and this is a great value. Normally the cream itself is $180, so it’s like getting the other two products for $5.  Is it pricey? Yes. It also performs, so in my opinion, it’s worth it.
